Awful experience I am a very frequent business traveller and have seen a lot of airports in the world But this one exceeded my worst nightmares We were in the line for the security check to Amsterdam combined with Paris We had over hour to go through security for Amsterdam Paris flight had min but it took ages Only one gate was open another one was idle no personnel The guy performing the screening was taking all the time in the world as if we were not in a hurry Personnel were very unfriendly yelling at us Paris passengers were really getting worried they could not make their flight The screening guy did not notice this In the end someone called all the Paris passengers to the front which upset the screening guy very much He really flipped and sent back the passengers to the end of the line When we started complaining about this ridiculous situation the guy even stopped the scanner and called the airport police He deliberately stopped the process to make us miss the flight After minutes the police came and we could explain the situation They checked our passports and convinced the screening guy to start checking again We barely made our flight It was the worst airport nightmare of my life Never again Berlin Tegel It is a disgrace for the Germany capital a country that has the name of being well organised and pnktlich I advise them to check out Schiphol Amsterdam for a much better experience

This airport is a disgrace Poor or nonexistent facilities and tiny duty free insane overpricing for a small bottle of water and it is basically a portacabin I cannot believe that this is how Germany wants to introduce visitors to its capital

Me and my family just arrived today and had the worst experience ever in the Berlin Tegel airport First of all the queue of immigration was terribly long and we waited for an hour and a half just to go through immigration Once we got through the immigration me and my brother got our baggage but my mums baggage went missing so we waited till there was no baggage on the belt anymore I called the missing or damaged baggage but no one picked up Then I saw staff with a bright green vest so I went to her for help But the answer she gave me was missing baggage is not my area dont ask me is not my business then she walked away quickly I was standing there feeling helpless then I saw the sign of baggage service so me and my family went there for help The staff there asked me to fill in a form and wait till they have any news We are really worried so I ask her when exactly can we get back our baggage she replied she didnt know We felt the answer she gave was really unhelpful so we went to the customer service counter I told the guy at the desk that my mum has health issues and all of her medicine is in the baggage then he replied thats not his problem because my mum shouldnt have put the medicine in that bag in the first place He was really rude and judgemental since the reason my mum didnt take the medicine out of the bag is that the cabin bag was supposed to be taken onboard by herself but the easyJet staff told her that the plane has not got enough space so they had to check in her cabin bag My mum has all of her heart medicine sleeping pills and antidepressant in her baggage Now my mum might have to fly back to the UK since she has been in serious health condition for over years

Templehof is a dream The architecture is beautiful and the departure hall is stunning Some of the original features can be found a true jewel It oozes nostalgia and would be a tragedy to lose such a wonderful piece of history The most civilised journey Ive embarked on to date was Templehof to Brussels

Very convenient for the city centre Unfortunately there are a limited number of routes but Brussels Airlines offers a good service several times per day The advantage is that the airport is uncrowded at times almost deserted I regret that it is now living on borrowed time There is a Berlin Underground UBahn station nearby but there are quite a few steps so it is difficult for passengers travelling with luggage let alone disabled travellers

I travelled from Berlin Tempelhof on I arrived at the airport at for a flight I have never experienced a more chaotic airport When I finally cleared the initial security screening and checked in for my flight I commenced queuing once more the queue which was very slow became absolutely chaotic when people entered the queue from the sides and no airport staff or security staff intervened The entire experience showed a level of inability in the security or airport staff to ensure orderly queuing and safety of passengers I will be very reluctant to use this airport again

Tempelhof is Berlins pre WWII airport and is one of the older operational airports in Europe Its an arrchitectural treasure Its also a friendly nice and peaceful airport Unfortunately they are going to shut it down in the next few years because of lack of travel demand and because it is in the located in the middle of a densely populated residential area

One for the historians of airport architecture a real timewarp from the s and earlier This was the original preWW Berlin airport The paucity of flights serving Tempelhof make for a very stressfree environment Emerging from the terminal one finds oneself in an ordinary residential street the facade of the terminal blending in with the neighbouring apartment blocks The UBahn station is just m away and one is in the heart of Berlin cheaply and in doublequick time But look again at that facade towards the top theres a gap Wasnt that where the old regimes notorious symbol used to stand

Easy to get there free parking just in front of it super fast check in and so on It took me minutes from the moment I parked my car to the lounge Highly recommended The only problem is nearly no flights leaving here

International Airport What a joke Although new this airport is lacking in accommodations and facilities for travelers For example theres only place to get anything to eat or drink in the entire airport Stand in a Long line to order burgers n fries chips and two drinks for For that you can enjoy a course meal at star Ascots for two Or you can feast on a huge Sunday Brunch at Fourways for for two Ive included photos of the restaurant poster and then of the Real restaurant Only items actually offered none from their poster There is one shop which closes at pm There are very few travel supplies typical of any other airport They claim that the shop is duty free but liquor prices are higher than in town Do not expect any common airport facilities other than this If more than plane arrives or departs at the same time expect a backup at every stage of your experience Honestly Ive had better accommodation and service at regional airports handling local traffic and single engine planes Bermuda is an extremely friendly welcoming and inviting country with Much to offer any traveler What a shame that the Airport authority leaves a holiday traveler with such a ugly parting view Clean up your act folks Its embarrassing

Like Bermuda itself this airport is a thoroughly civilized experience not very busy so not crowded with a rather predictable traffic pattern of arrivals and departures Facilities are very adequate and the dutyfree shop has a reasonable variety albeit a bit expensive On entry customs officials are polite and welcoming When checking in for our departing flight the official who had to pat me down for a followup security check the machine beeped when I went through apologized for having to do so and thanked me for accommodating the security process All in all a refreshingly unique experience one that is alas vanishing amid the alltoocommon post overzealous and ironically ineffective security measures elsewhere Bravo to Bermuda and its airport

BerneBelp is a small but excellent regional airport It is currently connected to Orly with Air France and Munich with Lufthansa There is a bus shuttle upon each regular flight arrival even delayed flights travel time to Berne railway station is around min A major problem is the heavy fog in winter I have already been diverted to Basle airport twice

Like many other domestic airports in Nepal Bharatpur airport offers very basic facilities only Check in counters dedicated to the serving airlines security check little parking area few basic seating chairs in a small area toilets not so clean though no AC For arrival a small baggage collection counter outside The airport currently operates flights to Kathmandu and Pokhara Sauraha a tourist spot is nearby this airport

We were travelling from Bhubaneshwar to Hyderabad recently The airport was clean and nice but was shocked a little later at the security at this airport While we were flying a person behind my row was complained about dripping water The stewardess was puzzled and checked the luggage rack There was this bag belonging to a passenger that contained a bottle of water that leaked drenching all the bags in that part before trickling down on the heads of people below Note that this is a colored rectangular serrated bottle and not one of those branded mineral water bottles sold inside the secure zone Also note that the passenger was ablebodied It is clear that the security checks simply waved the bottle past Having travelled from Newark to Hyderabad via Mumbai and suffering innumerable checks and having spent a small fortune on buying water inside the secure zone I was shocked at this incident I suggest that the rules be strictly implemented and a refresher course be held for the personnel

I was pleasantly surprised by Biarritz a small airport where everything seemed to work fine I was particularly impressed by the fact that the immigration officers on arrival and departure were smiling and courteous I wasnt expecting to see the negative reviews below but they are not too recent so maybe things have improved

Ugly airport with hardly any restaurants and the few present close at pm To describe the person screening arrivals as unfriendly would be a mild understatement being extremely unpleasant wont get you a bonus In short if you can avoid flying to Biarritz avoid it at all costs next time Ill take my bike

This has got to be the worst airport in terms of BorderCustoms that I have ever seen There were two immigration officers that took over one hour to process one Ryanair flight They were deliberately slow unfriendly and rude officer chatting on the phone Just unbelievably poor

Chronic organisation when two planes arrived it took almost an hour to get through passport control On return the famous Gallic shrug came to the fore with noone seemingly interested or caring about chaos and delays Police attitude was unbelievable with their insistence of accompanying people visiting the toilets The joy of flying into German and British airports

I was travelling with my wife back to London from Bilbao airport We are both doctors working in England and of Indian heritage I was selected for random complete check I have no problem with that except that I feel I was racially profiled We both stood near the counter to see who else was picked up for random check Only other person was another black male I accept that you have to check people randomly but I didnt feel it was random at all Do you have any figures to justify it What was suspicious about me except that I brown

Because of the items in the news about delays and queues we were quite worried about going to Bilbao airport We did have to wait a few minutes at passport control but not too long The airport is a new building very light and modern we didnt have to use any steps at all which was brilliant On our return journey we purchased food and drinks in the cafe they were nicely prepared and the area was very clean and tidy All in all a very good experience and the area can be proud of the facilities

Bilbao is not the most comfortable airport getting to the plane is quite fast minutes maximum and leaving the airport after landing is fast too minutes You can get to Bilbao by bus theres a bus each minutes

What a contrast to arrive from the chaos of Stansted Plane lands bags come off quickly passport line mins maximum Taxis right outside airport arrivals or bus stop turn right and go to the end of the concourse My record for checking in at the hotel is mins from the wheels touching the runway Coming back on Easy Jet last flight out of the night so its a bit quiet but again you get through quickly Grab a beer Dont even bother queuing until you see the incoming plane land and reach the gate Very relaxed place to fly in and out of

Flew to and from Bilbao Arrival was quick plane unloaded by Gateway The building looks nice and is clean The bad surprise was that we had to wait more than minutes to see the first bag on the belt at a time we were the only plane arriving I find this unacceptable in big airports and even more in a small one Departure went well coffees breakfast facilities everything on time A pity we got stuck in a bus minutes while the plane was at minutes walk

Simple airport but security check is a joke compared to the other airports I used A usb cable is considered electronics and is rechecked separately tooth paste is repacked into a plastic bag I go through this airport times per year and it is the only one my bags dont go through first pass Not a single time Out of these or rechecks of my bags they never found anything wrong Like I said it is a joke

Firstly there were no family queues so I had to wait in line for min with two crying month old toddlers We were not allowed to take the twin stroller upstairs they said it was to big for the security check which was wrong would have gone through easily Most twin strollers are designed to fit standard doors and a wheelchair bigger then our stroller rolled through easily But the danish computer says no mentality was not budged Anyway we had to hold crying twins and the hand luggage a lot of luggage comes with two toddlers while the stroller was folded and marked After that the guy said then you take it to the odd size luggage desk Yup holding a folded twin stroller while holding a crying toddler is super easy Going through security no priority for baby families we had no place to put the toddlers while taking out electronics liquid baby food etc out of the bags so they were running around crying Finally after coming through security there were some strollers available at the airport very nice strollers as put by the guy that checked us in There were strollers there were broken so we took the two dirty ones that were left Never ever flying through there with toddlers again

Travelled from HKG to FRA then to Billund for a business trip A tiny airport with insufficient facilities A serious lack of staff while they were not helpful at all already Self checkin machines available but not enough assistance at all Medium length queues but moving very slowly

This is a fantastic airport Short walking distances nice staff good easytonavigate easytouse layout a stressfree atmosphere nice cafs I used Billund as a transit passenger on my way from Copenhagen to Berlin and my only minor remark is that the TRANSIT signs just pointed to a locked door I had to walk back exit and go through security again Never mind there was no queue and I doubt the locked door is standard procedure since the security folks got a little bit puzzled when they saw my Copenhagenissued boarding pass Dont hesitate to use this airport

An airport serving domestic routes in Nepal capital Kathmandu to the capital of Koshi Pradesh and two other places in the eastern hilly regions Very basic in services and facilities IATA code BIR For arrival a belt is there to collect luggage that is manually handled Aircrafts that this airport gets is ATR Beech Twin otter and the likes For departure a small hall is there which houses check in counters dedicated to domestic operators few seating benches toilets security check points and one cafe Not clean looks dirty Parking is available outside Taxis are available for conveyance

Honest to goodness its an embarrassment when you come from a developing country in Africa thats got their act together then you come back and you suffer the degrading humiliation of Birmingham Right from the drop off being over a mile from the checkin The departure lounge toilets not having seats or broken and the standard of hygiene I simply cannot understand how environmental health allow them to operate at all The duty free was three times the price of buying retail at the destination My one takeaway of the airport is to never use it again

It took hour and minutes from joining the prequeue for bag drop to getting through security on a Monday afternoon at the end of September What is a prequeue When they hold you for minutes before getting to the bag drop queue Then a minute prequeue for the lift to take you to the queue for security They took out the staircase last year and made everyone use overloaded lifts Our lift said Out of Service before it wheezed up to Departures three minutes to climb one floor When a Ryanair plane is a haven of peace and civility you know you have just emerged from a circle of hell Is Michael OLeary paying them to ruin the airport so that his planes seem better The airport works so hard to ensure it is the worst airport in the UK Couldnt they spend of the effort on making something anything at the airport actually work I cant review airport shops as my minute queue meant I had to run to the gate Could I have arrived earlier Wouldnt have helped as you cant check in a bag more than minutes before departure

Avoid avoid avoid at all cost unless you like queueing Its a shambles of an airport You queue at every point in the departures Ive never seen anything like it They took escalators out and put lifts in and thats where the queueing starts

Avoid this airport at all cost I have traveled quite a bit in my life but Birmingham Airport was an experience I never voluntarily hope to relive I now better understand why my year old mom preferred NOT seeing her son than having to go through this ordeal This was twenty years ago Nothing much has changed Chaotic going from one long snake line into the next being herded into an elevator only to be driven into the next line I truly felt like cattle I wonder how those taxfree shops make any money because you sure have no time or energy left to shop or get a bite to eat And when you finally arrive at the gate and actually glad that the plane was delayed otherwise it would have been a close call you have to sit on the floor to rest your feet from being on your feet for hours on end My advise pick another airport and take the train to Birmingham OR go via Dover and drive up to Birmingham Driving on the left of the road is less stressful

Staff should be retrained on customer service Especially American They are very rude and disrespectful Flight crew got off the plane and went to another gate min after we were suppose to board When we asked whats going on we received nothing but attitude from the gate agent Another gate agent walked up and totally ignored our concerns Were at B for flight to CLT Shortly after the gate agent says there is a maintenance issue and they wont be in for another hours We all had the same question Why wasnt the plane inspected the night before being its an early morning flight Secondly why isnt maintenance onsite during hours of operation This is very unprofessional If there were other options outside of this place that were closer Id explore it because no one deserves to be treated this way especially early in the morning Id rather drive hours to Atlanta than to deal with these Attitudes after we pay our money for a service My recommendation Dont fly out of BHM especially with American

Security lines are insane This is my rd experience with it and Im starting to piece together the scam Dont we pay a surcharge on every ticket purchased for the delightful experience of trusting TSA to keep us safe by making us remove our shoes and other useless acts They keep the security lines long creating stress and panic so you consider signing up for Clear year and more privacy invasion with a retina scan and fingerprint capture So the elite those willing to fork over the dollars on top of their federal and any other taxes that fund airports and plane ticket fees cruise on through security while the other of passengers languish in line and miss their flights How on earth the warlord of the Birmingham airport allows of TSA staff to service the elites on the TSA PrecheckClear side vs the TSA employees on the side of the regular people only makes sense in a corrupt government deal I thought that this would be aggravating for the airlines on the other side of the curtain wondering where the passengers were who paid a pretty penny to fly like cattle while being prodded to pull their masks over their nose the whole time But a little research revealed that the airlines invest in companies like Clear Silly me Its a circular racquet probably formulated along the lines of the Chicago red light camera and parking meter debacle Bottom line pay your toll at the troll bridge or suffer along with the peasants

Recent Improvements have made this small airport quite reasonable There are a few dining and shopping options and the area is fairly large and pleasant They still play terrible elevator music Free internet is a bonus The airport is conveniently located to the city but there is no public transportation available Parking is day bit it is often difficult to find a spot

The airport has been and still under going renovations The issues with no food past security have been fixed The wait times are typically very short Security can become long on Monday mornings but typically it is very quick as well Walking distances to and from gates as well as to and from parkingcar rental are rather short There are no miles walks to gates or otherwise The biggest issue with the airport is the quality of staff at food outlets but that is not much different at a lot of airports Overall it is a very good midsize airport

Small airport which seemed a bit chaotic Flew with Turkish airlines their first flight was delayed so check in for mine was busy due to counters checking in two full flights Immigration was quick didnt ask to many questions Security metal detector doesnt work they just pat down everybody coming through After security not much food places on one end can get busy in the departure area Boarding was a mess no queuing system for two flights with desks close together so people kept getting into the wrong queue Fine airport for a short time

Simple clean and functional airport Check in and security ws doe with ease The food vendors are on the expensive side and do not accept credit cards Seeing as most passengers rid themselves of local currency prior to leaving this presents as a problem

It is a small airport with standard facilities Need more Jetways as most of the time the aircraft is forced to park far away from airport building However the officers attitudes in the CIQ area are amazingly modest compared to the ones from the other neighbouring Central Asian airports such as Almaty and Astana

Overall the airport does the job and is an adequate small international hub but travellers beware of a dangerous scam by unregistered taxi drivers here My driver was touting for custom with the rest of them as I came out of customs and immigration but turned out to be working with a fellow passenger who stopped the car between the airport and the city and extorted money from me to complete the journey Two young men to one older man no contest here Foolishly I only spotted the warning signs that the two of them were trouble too late and am grateful that it was only my pocket that was dented Only ever take a registered taxi with the yellow taxi sign on top or better still have someone meet you It sounds obvious but as most flights arrive here in the middle of the night it is possible to be caught out as I was

This airport is a blast from the past Its very basic very small and with very few services After passport control all they have is a small cafe and a little souvenir shop Xray and metal detector was not working so they just did a basic manual search for everything There is a small lounge upstairs before passport control but not working and terminal is full of insects Its like a s bus station and they only have or flights a day GuineaBissau is very poor and this airport reflects that

Myself and husband have used Blackpool airport times in the last months yes you pay each departure tax but you can see nothing has been spent on the upkeep I will still say we prefer going from Blackpool there is less trouble and a lot less fuss From landing and picking up our cases we can be home in an hour we are very sad at its closing We have just arrived home last night we went from Blackpool put had to come back in to Manchester which we think is a nightmare very sad customers

This place is the pits Ever since they took over which is several years ago the owners impose an Airport Development Tax ADT of per person Yes if you are going to be back in less than weeks it entitles you to free parking how can a tax of per head be free on a quagmire at best with absolutely no security The tax was allegedly to develop the airport hence the name but every cent of it goes into the pockets of the Directors Not a single penny has been spent on improvements The owners will argue that the place has been improved and it has However the franchises that use the place duty free cafe newsagents etc all paid for the improvements so dont believe the owners The place is also filthy and cold and when it rains they have to use buckets to collect rainwater As for the security and checkin staff the checkin staff turn up when they feel like it and the security staff are rude and surly and totally objectionable Completely different to the pleasant and helpful staff at Manchester

Dreadful do not let your student sons and daughters fly home from Blackpool My son had to scrape the ADF fee from his pockets He is a student with virtually no money and had no warning that he was going to need an extra Very unfair and simply disgusting I intend to complain to Jet about the airport they are using

We travelled to Turkey on Jet midAugust returning earlySeptember We travelled from Blackpool as the holiday was some cheaper than using Manchester The car park ticket machine had run out of tickets but that didnt matter as the barriers to P had been broken off We parked a good minutes walk from the terminal but its free so I dont really see that being a problem The terminal building is very basic and is more reminiscent of a coach station but checkin and security were both quick and easy as was paying the ADF and we were sitting in the bar area enjoying our first drink of the holiday while wed still have been in the security queue at Manchester An important point was that because we were going on a small plane to a small airport checkin at Dalaman on our return was incredibly easy drawing jealous stares from fellow travellers who were in long queues On our return to Blackpool from wheels stop through security and baggage reclaim to leaving the airport took less than minutes You absolutely cannot get better The airport has a runway planes somewhere to sit and somewhere to get a drink What else do you need

Whilst the amenities are those of a small airport they are still extremely limited My main concerns regarding this airport are the poor services offered by the lounge and payment charged is way in excess of services on offer There are limited drinks no WIFI limited snacks and maximum stay without flight delays is approximately one hour Also when flight arrivals are able to collect their luggage and able to visit the conveniences there is only one female toilet one male toilet and one disabled toilet all with insufficient toilet rolls Totally unsatisfactory when approximately people are landing

The poor lighting inside makes it look as if you have just walked into a fairground dark ride The gents toilet singular youll notice always smells of something unpleasant The advertising blurb tells of facilities that are never open and it has a help desk that is manned only when the staff feel like it which is as good as never It looks like an uncompleted job on which the builders have walked off because the service pipes are all exposed and there is not so much as a false ceiling to hide it all It has been like this for decades To then ask the public to pay each to refurbish something that should be done out of the operating profits over many years is a disgrace Forget expecting to see a terminal akin to those airy ones with glass and steel as at proper airports this is a chickenshed inspired windowless dark oblong box You are unable to see any aircraft from inside or outside so plane spotters stay away

Arriving at Blantyres Chileka airport is a colonial experience Arriving from Johannesburg the airplane is taxied in front of the arrival hall School classes have already been run out to see the big bird landing The building has a wooden veranda and there is a special area were people are expected to cheer after the president has landed The first time I arrived at Chileka the luggage was simply dropped on the tarmac The passengers had to fight to get their possessions Of course quite some passengers did not find any luggage at all as it had stayed behind in Joburg Immigration is quite impressive with a lot of stamps in passports and on listings To get out you have to go through a door then you turn sharply turn left and right Again left until you bump into the departing passengers and their luggage Since half a year we have a new arrival hall at our airport

I flew from Blantyre airport a number of years ago and was struck by just how quaint the whole set up was It is a very basic airport not far off the common tin shack analogy that comes with most African airports There is very little to do and there is just a bar to distract you The best thing about Blantyre airport is the Duty Free shop A selection so limited it is almost refreshing Malawi Gin Whisky JW Cane spirit macadamia nuts coffee and nick nacks I bought to W light bulbs that had been turned into paraffin lamps Wonderful

Bloemfontein airport is currently undergoing improvements to its buildings and facilities This is with a view to the FIFA Soccer World Cup to be held in South Africa I love this little airport because there is an air of excitement and a bustle of activity While the upstairs cafeteria is undergoing improvements there is a downstairs cafeteria where refreshments may be purchased The airport personnel are some of the friendliest i have ever met Their are ample parking and car rental facilities available

Very pleasant and easy airport Rental car lot a few steps from the exit door Spacious airport has gates but only about half are in use Only complaint is restaurant is before security and closes their grill well before the last flights depart in the evening

I personally really like this airport Its small but does everything it needs to It looks more like a sand castle than an airport but every time Ive used it its been easy to check in Unfortunately there is no smoking area anywhere in the airport and considering a fair portion is non smoking I find that a bit strange Also once I was delayed and as there are no tannoy announcements you are left wondering about that status of your flight which if youve travelled TACV can be understood However if youre a resident of Cape Verde you do get used to the no stress mentality even if it can be frustrating sometimes Theres a bar either side of check incustoms and they serve snacks Theres also a small duty free shop but most airlines stock would be more comprehensive

BDTPAC The airport is located on the Colon island you can actually walk into town but still taxis will charge you only usd thats nothing really Theres only one building very small one xray and two counters one for each airline there are no carousels youll have to wait them to offload your bags so you can pick them up on arrivals hall on departure the airline staff will open your bags to search for dangerous goods etc The airport was under refurbishment but I believe it will soon need a better upgrade

We departed from Bodrum Airport decided to try get some food Theres hardly any eating outlets what there is are extortionate we looked at chicken burgers but at we decided against it bottled water was also expensive Surely lowering prices would encourage people to buy

What a shame this place leaves you with such a negative feeling of Turkey No place for filling up water ridiculous prices by any airport standards for any liquid or food staff generally acting as if they dont want to be there and finally a random intrusive search of body and hand luggage in the waiting lounge by people who should be working for correctional services Also free wifi requires espionage search to find the kiosk you need to get a required pin to connect

Worst experience ever I felt totally unsafe in a sort of hostile territory Firstly resent having to scan my passport in a random machine to access WIFI The vending machines are in Turkish only Something went wrong after scanning my card I asked several officials All i needed was help with translation not my job ring number etc It seems they were sort of enjoying it as the people I had asked were all around me on their phones though at work while i was obviously distressed Uncomfortable too

Very unfriendly staff almost aggressive Very slow check in euro for cheeseburger and euro for a coca cola euro for a coffee Never experienced this before and we travel a lot I will never go there again Better go with Izmir airport

This place is an absolute joke The new amenities are useless there are lots of staff doing nothing and the Covid checks and extra security checks means everything takes times as long with long queues The only water you can get is from a vending machine or the only food booth charging extortionate prices This place is the worst Ive ever experienced including Moscow The new management should be held accountable and sacked

Perfectly adequate facilities spoilt by sullen even aggressive staff The place is expensive and food availability and options poor as you would expect In contrast Izmir airport two hours to the North is altogether different so if travelling to a destination anywhere north of Bodrum give that consideration They also have more extensive flight options

Everything was delayed staff were all over the place and not communicating with one another Im and had to be pushed in a wheelchair Im not a small person I know that but for the staff to sit there and say Im fat was very inappropriate I was tempted to ask for her name and manager but like I said I had a broken ankle and I didnt have any fight in me to go back and fourth I just needed to get out of there My friend had to push me around even though we had handicap service and she had to follow behind a worker who disappeared eventually Like I said before very unprofessional Another experience we had was at the ice cream shop The lady was refusing to serve my friend another flavor because we couldnt do that we need to pay more granted money is not an issue but she refused to serve her even after my friend told her to charge her I dont know if everyone was having a bad day or what but everything was made difficult Staff needs to be trained better and have hospitality

Modern airport and hub for flights in South America But we cant find staff that speak English apart from the immigration officers and they are rude as well We were here several times connecting between various flights in South America

Most of the staff doesnt speak English and doesnt understand etickets At first they insisted to send us to the check ins and make hours of queue despite us already having the tickets and only hand luggage Afterwards during the boarding they kept bouncing us from a gate to another because they didn bother checking properly the tickets In both cases we had to search for the only member of the staff who could understand how an airport works and explain it to their colleagues They should be more professional organised and should learn english given its an international airport

All staff pretty rude and didnt speak any English Nobody seemed to want to help in any way Thats fine but I get to security and basically all I have is my wallet and a water bottle They snatch my water bottle and throw it away Very wasteful and rude Would have chugged it right there no problem Extremely annoying and frustrating way to end my time here in Colombia

Bogota airport continues as one of the worst transit experiences continuing the war on water years on Bottles of liquid are instantly and shamelessly dispatched for I presume later use while a bottle of water costs USD or airside Always remember not to bring duty free or even a simple bottle of water in your hand baggage The previous immigration check is slow the entire area in front of the booths is occupied by people queueing Allow minutes to traverse this mess The WiFi continues to be almost unusable slow and dropping connections A local SIM card or roaming are still essential to be able to communicate The food court at the very very far end of terminal after multiple nonfunctioning walkways has limited opening hours until pm unremarked on any display or even in front of the court or restaurants A miserable selection of fast food was all that was available Flight announcements are haphazard colliding varying in volume so its almost guaranteed that the announcements for the flight youre sitting closest to will inevitably be drowned out by someone screeching into the microphone at the far end of the terminal All in all a very poor experience

It is another normal airport Period I arrived Monday around PM Immigration queue was around minutes EU passport question about if for tourism answer business meeting stamp all done Customs do you have anything to declare no this lane please minutes after landing out Upstairs to buy local SIM card for data K COP for week GB nice ladies helping to activate it you need the help back down to get the taxi go to queue for yellow ones K to the city up it to K to be polite Return Friday flight PM arriving to airport PM left city PM this time of the day it takes hr from city to airport Passport control security minutes again Security took away my beard scissors cm that have been OK around the world only Dubai has done the same once from times All cool Did not even try the airport WIFI found that this sucks everywhere Enough shopping after security I did get my souvenir coffee and other stuff Eating after getting in to airport security area is an only real problem there is a food court where everyone queues for Burger King and next to that there are some notsopizzapizza place and some other strange places where no one buys anything Based on my experience for an EU citizen it is very OK airport only thing to complain about is the eating possibilities

hr queue at migration check Horrible service and respect for the passenger by the supposed to be the best airport in Latin America Besides cant conceive the employment of buses to arrive at the terminal

Busy regional airport with many flights to South Korea Manila and other Philippine airports Airbridges and some remote stands Opened in and relatively modern in terms of layout with level for departures and one for arrivals Speed of baggage retrieval very good and distances from arrival to the carpark opposite the airport very short Free WiFi available

Quiet new airport opened in Check in was efficient Distance to Alona Beach only a few minutes Therefore very comfortable for people staying at the beach There are only few food stalls available Overall a fast and efficient airport

Upon arrival at the airport there was a huge line but only a few staff I went through Alaska Airlines It was very confusing where I was supposed to go because there were so many people and so many different lines The lines didnt look like lines at all I checked in at the kiosk got my boarding pass then a lady who was walking around helping people said I needed to get a bag tag printed So I had to go back in line and wait to get the tag printed I had to pay a fee even though I have elite status and have never had to pay a bag fee before I had never gone through the kiosk before Then when I got to the front she said I needed to wait to answer some questions After standing there several minutes and seeing many people get helped who were there after me I was finally helped They just needed emergency contact name and number Then going to the line for the security check there were about people there I got to the airport an hour before my flight and when I got to the gate they were already boarding Seriously they need more organization and more staff to help customers

The airport is a small regional airport However there is a nice souvenir shop and a decent number of places to eat given its modest size One thing you will see in the airport is life size cardboard cut outs of the famous Boise State American Football team the towns most famous export There is a bus link from the airport to downtown but when I went it appeared to be having serious delays A cab into downtown is not too expensive The queuing times are very quick as this airport never really gets too busy as it is small

Pleasant enough airport small yet not crowded enough for it to be oppressive Free internet for your laptop throughout the terminal is good take note Seattle Dulles and OHare Easy enough to find your car hire too and the petrol station outside the airport isnt too much of a rip off Only real complaint is the signs tofrom the airport could be better

In a comment it was said that the airport is great for arrivals but terrible for departures This is absolutely true It was the worst service Ive had and the worst airport Ive ever used for a return flight from abroad On February we were passengers with my husband on flight PGTBB from Bologna to Istanbul Sabiha Gken Airport It took so long for us to checkin our baggage When we saw the queue to pass through to the airside before passport control we couldnt even do a tax refund As we were hoping for this disgrace to end so we could return to our country boarding started from gate and we were lucky enough to sit and wait until the line thinned out When the queue decreased we joined it Two female ticket agents were handling the boarding Despite having no cabin baggage with us we had checked it in the ticket agent told me that my two pockets one about x cm and the other about x cm contained too many items and that I wouldnt be allowed on the plane with them At that moment my husband was also waiting for the other ticket agent to do the boarding Since I had never heard such nonsense before I told her that if I had too many pockets I could transfer some items from one to the other and discard one pocket Clearly this didnt sit well with her as she was going to ask for money Suddenly she told me she wouldnt let me on the plane and instructed me to go to the back of the line I raised my voice and warned her that she had no right or authority to do that and that she was obligated to let me on the plane In response the other female ticket agent rudely turned her back and made threats like Well call the police and we wont let you on the plane An airport that shows such disrespect to tourists should be ashamed In the end they should be thankful that I didnt call the police because I didnt want to take the passengers time They ruined the end of our wonderful vacation because of their attitude which we had never encountered in any airport before

Not enough seating after security No fast track before am for business passengers No lounge after security No respect for priority due to all in the same bus In fact the business travelers stand longest in the bus No priority boarding after unloading passengers from the bus Front door not ready so from the back door all the way to the front

This is the worst airport we have ever flown from Our cruise ended in Ravenna and we had the choice of flying home from either Bologna or Venice We chose Bologna because it was nearer Big mistake Through no fault of our own we arrived at the airport at am for a pm flight to London We couldnt check in until pm so we had to hang around with our luggage for hours The checkin area was heaving and there was limited seating The seats were metal and very uncomfortable There were shops and food outlets so we could eat and drink pm came and we were able to checkin A large queue quickly formed behind us but the lady in charge refused to open the checkin until she had had the floor cleaned to remove a few scuff marks We checkedin eventually cleared the long security queue and found ourselves in Departures If we thought the checkin floor was bad Departures was an absolute nightmare For an international airport the area was very small and horribly overcrowded Seating was even more limited than downstairs and people were sitting on the floor We saw one woman sitting in a corner breastfeeding her baby There were long queues for the toilets There were a couple of food outlets but no seats so it was a choice of stand up or sit on the floor All in all Bologna airport was a very unpleasant experience and we will never fly from there again

Terrible airport like something from the dark ages Old and no signage Lots of staff in the wrong place Its not set up for transit Forget about seating they have for hundreds of people The staff though friendly dont have knowledge of things You just have to wonder around hoping for the best

This might be the worst airport in Europe Ive traveled here twice and The gate area is a zoo People constantly climbing over each other to just find room to stand let alone sit The checkin and security are bad but not as bad as gate area I literally created this account to vent because I simply do not understand It is pure misery and adds stress to an otherwise wonderful trip to see family and friends in the region Airport management and regional authorities should be embarrassed about this Other Italian cities like Firenze have terrible airports too but I really cannot compare to Bologna EmiliaRomagna is one of the few regions with relative wealth in Italy which makes this more tragic Tourists come spend your money on rag and get back in your cattle vans and go away Whats worse is when you make comparisons to midsize cities in countries like Spain Mlaga Valencia etc which have less money but still have comfortable clean and wellorganized airports

The airport is misery Bagagge lost and no info of when to receive it Had to go back to airport the next day and stand in a queue for hours in a small corridor without air and with angry and stressed others who lost their luggage several days ago Only one part of the queue could be helped during too short service times The staff was overcrowdwd and work under nonworthy circumstances At departure no seating and overcrowded because people need to circulate to buy in the shops or restaurants I will never use this airport again

We flew British Airways from LHR to Bologna on th February Despite a halffull plane BA failed to load my suitcase We reported this to the Lost Luggage office The young lady who assisted us was rather casual about the matter even though we told her I had no clothes but what I was wearing and we were only in Italy for days and we had a hour drive to Jesi She told us that we could wait to have it delivered to us but it wouldnt arrive until the day we left or if we guaranteed we would come and pick it up today we could collect it at hrs pm We said we would definitely come back at pm to collect the bag even though it meant wasting a day waiting around We confirmed that time three times with her We duly showed back up at the Airport at and rang the bell to the Lost Luggage Office Noone answered We then noted the sign on the door that said opening hours Another set of people whod also lost luggage were also trying to make contact with the office After trying the phone number provided to us by the girl in the morning and ringing the bell repeatedly we found an information counter and explained our problem to the woman there She rang and spoke to someone INSIDE THE LOST LUGGAGE OFFICE but they refused to speak to us or answer the phone or door Finally at pm they answered the bell and let the now THREE groups of people trying to get their luggage in By then we had accrued a Euro parking fee and then had to drive to a rural area near Jesi and get into a farmhouse in the dark Bologna Airport has flights coming in pretty much but a lost luggage office that is only open hours a day and refuses to help people outside that time even if people are present in the office I am extremely disappointed with the level of service at Bologna Airport I have informed all my friends some of whom travel to Italy regularly to beware of routing their travel through there unless only taking carryon baggage

Congratulations everyone on the wonderful new airport at Bonriki The building is such an improvement on the previous facility and now provides travellers to and from Kiribati with a modern beautifully designed space to start and finish their Kiribati adventure I understand their are more features such as a cafe and lounge still in progress but in the meantime could airport management please think of a way to provide water to passengers in the departure lounge as we just experienced nearly hours in hot conditions without water Many thanks cant wait to return and see the next stages of the development

Kiribati is a very small country and as expected the main airport Bonriki Tarawa is very small It is about the size of a very small warehouse but it was undergoing rerefurbishment Being a very small airport the staff were very friendly After checking in and having passed immigration you have no option except to go out of the airport and hang about until boarding time which I found rather charming There are no facilities other than clean toilets but nothing matters in this Paradise of a country

Bordeaux Airport is arguably one of the least impressive airports in Europe The overall experience can be quite unpleasant especially for those traveling on business Customs lines are painfully slow and the officers can be quite unfriendly Learning a few basic English phrases would certainly help particularly since Bordeaux promotes itself as an international destination Despite its relatively decent size there are no adequate business lounges and the zone Affaire is frequently closed There are two internet options available but neither seems to work reliably Once youve cleared security good luck finding amenities theres virtually nothing beyond the small boarding gates Currently my flight is delayed by two hours and I cant help but wish I could return to the city instead of wasting my time here To the Bordeaux Chamber of Commerce please take action to improve this situation

The stay at the airport was okay The baggage claim on arrival worked quickly The signposting could be better The arrows were often unclear to me eg pointing downwards when you should go straight up a flight of stairs Unfortunately I came across a very unfriendly person at security control who became downright arrogant when I initially didnt understand her in either French or English Its a shame that people like that work in customer service Other airports can do better

This airport is beyond belief No clear signs to security It is hidden away behind an escalator Nobody to ask Wasted minutes to be directed Passed through security to find a queue a mile long for border control Another minutes wait and actually missed my flight Unbelievable Never seen such a chaotic setup After missing my flight the queue disappeared Advise anyone to turn up at least two hours before a flight Or try another airport

This is possibly the worst airport Ive ever been to specifically the Billi terminal The queues are chaotic passengers have no idea where to go due to lack of signage the queues go on forever and continue outside where you have to stand in the sunrain For some unknown reason we scanned our boarding passes times once to get through the security gates once with a lady standing ahead of us seconds later and then once when our bags were checked A severe lack of organisation and efficiency The facilities are basic to say the least the term cattle shed springs to mind This part of the airport needs some investment to update it

The worst airport I have ever experienced Facilities were dirty and antiquated food quality and range was appalling airport check in staff were fine but security arrangements were antiquated Long delay in getting through border police and final waiting area was tiny with no food or drink outlets available and toilets on different floor

Some shop staff at the BillyEasyjet Terminal have no education On a simple question about a perfume a girl from the staff responded to me in a super aggressive manner clearly telling me to look elsewhere Its only am and I would have preferred to start my day in better conditions To be honest your staff is as lowend as your airport Certaines personnes du personnel des boutiques au Terminal BillyEasyjet nont aucune ducation Sur une simple question par rapport un parfum une fille du personnel ma rpondu de manire super agressive en me disant clairement daller voir ailleurs Il est seulement du matin et jaurais prfr commencer ma journe sous de meilleures conditions Pour tre honnte votre personnel est aussi bas de gamme que votre aroport

Although Bordeaux enjoys global renown its airport presents a stark contrast as the worst representation of the city Despite satisfactory arrival options via public transport and an acceptable checkin area the horror unfolds postsecurity The Ritazza bar fails to satisfy even the most basic needs and the journey to gate is marred by decrepit surroundings and malfunctioning escalators The area of gates has a couple of vending machines selling drinks hot beverages and junk food Chapeau The absence of any information for improvement exacerbates the disappointment In rating zero stars would be a generous gesture

After completing security we purchased food at the cafe only to find that there were only comfortable chairs and these were dirty torn and old They need to be thrown in a skip There are other tables which were filthy The floor was covered with food and debris I suggest the management team of this airport take a stroll out of their ivory tower and clean this utter disgrace Then organise a proper eating area The management should be ashamed

The staff are unprofessional and have poor manners The officers are arrogant and disrespectful The airport building is nice but not kept well No good transportation and poor roads from airport to city They dont get the fact that they need to give customer service

In the present climate I cannot understand that Bournemouth Airport fails to have a drinking fountain or even just a tap in the toilets that supplies cold water I appreciate that normally the Cafe at the airport oblige but presently they are shut due to the pandemic and so the only available free water is out of hot taps in the toilets

As a favour to my very good friends who were having a short break in Malta following yrs of being together i offered to drop them off at the airport their flight was at pm so we arranged i would drop them off at am to save them having to pay for a taxi I had never done this before and as they were literally travelling with two small pieces of cabin luggage the plan was to drop and run as you would expect however once my friends had got out of the car i was forced by a very unsympathetic car park attendant we will call him that to be polite into the car park as apparently that was what you need to do for drop offs I had assumed there would be a tiny window of time for such purposes ie mins or so which would be free of charge but i was then charged an extortionate fee of for literally taking a token from the entrance barrier and going straight to the payment machine I think this is absolutely disgusting and just another way of ripping the public off when they are trying to do someone a favour there definitely should be a small area for these sort of situations allowing people the seconds it takes for someone to get out of the vehicle and collect their baggage from the boot and then leave When i confronted the car park attendant about this he just shrugged his shoulders and said that what it is with absolutely no sympathy at all although it is only i feel like i have been robbed as all i needed to do was turn around an leave but as there was another car coming up behind me i did as this man said but had no idea i was going to be charged for obliging him As you can gather Im still fuming about this so wanted too make a formal complaint about it and will be contacting the airport directly as well once i can get through there is plenty of space there for a drop off point to be put in place so completely outrageous as far as Im concerned

The problem is there are never enough check in desks open and queues are horrendous because of this People getting stressed as a result as no time airside to look around or have a coffee etc Needs addressing as an hour wait to bag drop is not acceptable

Departure We often fly from Bournemouth because it is convenient for us In comparison to other regional airports it is backward Luckily my wife and I had no hold luggage on our last flight so we were able to avoid the long queues at the luggage checkin deskThere are no auto baggage checkin machines as there are for instance at Bristol Airport The cafes ability to provide a good service is widely variable and on one occassion the simple act of obtaining a coffee and snack was a flustered staff ordeal There are not enough staff at the gate resulting in slow loading of passengers and the solo girl was struggled to cope when a passenger problem occurred Arrival Very poor No auto passport machines where on average it takes five minutes to pass Bournemouth has three desks with border officials average time to pass is about to minutes if towards the middleback of the queue Make sure that you arrive at Bournemouth airport with pounds sterling as there is no ATM at the arrivals terminal If you need cash for a taxi you have to walk to the departures terminal to get it Transport by bus is not available on weekend afternoons after about to drop off passengers which is also added to taxi fares Conclusion An underfunded for profit only airport which has failed to modernise It has very little attraction for those who have wider airport experiences

Hartford airport is very small I arrived hours before my flight because I was coming from Vermont and wanted to allow for traffic but that was way too early for what was available at the airport The hall immediately past security has plenty of restaurants to choose from along with a number of rocking chairs that have a nice view of the apron The Gates concourse also looked like it had been recently renovated and also had a nice selection of restaurants and shops However the presecurity areas and the Gates concourse were dark and dim and were unpleasant places to wait Fortunately everything at this airport is very close so if your flight leaves from Gates you can wait in the postsecurity hall and go to your gate at the last moment Still itd be nice if the airport would renovate the Gates concourse and the presecurity areas so that it looks as nice as the Gates concourse

The TSA pre check line is not adequately highlighted when coming in to depart As a result we ended up in the annoying line where you have to remove coats belts shoes laptops everything but tooth fillings Plus a full body screen breast area pat down leg pat down Really I have no artificial limbs no metal knees Tampa isnt nearly as annoying TSA pre check lines are clearly identified from the moment you enter the airport Cmon CT shape up

As noted the checkin area is open air and spacious The shopping area beyond that was expansive All in all nice The gate area used by most domestic flights however would be more suited for a small provincial airport with few flights There is not nearly enough room for the lines of people waiting to board Thel snake thrugh the small terminal making it difficult for others to walk by My fight was not through a jetway but via a shuttle bus The monitor above the door we were to use first correctly reflected our flight and time and then suddenly switched to another flight leaving from another gate there had been no gate change Brazilians commented that a tourist eg for the World Cup in would be completely lost The bus trip to the plane was very long For arrivals the directions on where to go for the baggage claim area vs connecting flights were confusing The bagage claim area is rather big confusing and dirty It took over half an hour to get my bags Signage to taxis busses etc is inadequate Still all in all Id rate BSB above many other Brazilaian airports Its easier to use than Rio or Sao Paulo at least until you get to the cramped gate area

BSB has its modern part but it is still a quite bad airport seems that they dont care about changing anything on this airport its busy on weekends Staff can be quite rude and as in most of Brazilian airports everything is overpriced Youd be better eat somewhere else before flying

The apparent discrepancy in previous comments is easily explained The BSB terminals quality is strikingly different between the boarding gate area and the presecurity one The latter is really nice The citys highaltitude tropical climate makes for amenable temperatures almost all year around and makes air conditioning dispensable in the wide open entrance area which is a really pleasant place Checkin is usually fast and efficient except on late Thursday and on Friday because of the already mentioned busy traffic of Congressmen and their aides going to home states there is a fairly complete shoppingmallstyle food court with many options including movie theatres good shopping with not only the usual luxuryitem style but also plenty of those lastminute simple essentials Once past security however things change It wouldnt be bad were it not for the fact that the boarding gate area was simply underdimensioned for the traffic it gets Pray to get a jetbridged gate because the ground level boarding area for bussed remote positions is very small and can be really chaotic at times Arrivals are usually fine though enough conveyor belts and luggage arrives fast enough to ensure a quick turnover Signage could be better on arrival and transit areas Transportation is indeed a problem the buses mentioned are regular urban buses with no space for luggage and are infrequent Taxis are really expensive but are mostly the only practical choice But a lightrail line is planned for the next couple of years and that should improve things a lot

The facilities are quite good there are many eating options cafs etc The airport has been recently extended and nicely renovated However the attitude of the staff does not always meet the expectations set by the airport itself mainly regarding the staff at the boarding gates Some of them are merely there to check the size of the hand bags several people for one gate and are not helpful at all In some cases they dont speak English Ive also experienced rude and condescending attitude towards me while not even addressing me directly which was humiliating As a customer this is not the treatment one would expect Ive also seen the same towards other passengers in several occasions so it is important to take this into account but I hope they will be able to improve and give more importance to kindness in order to make the experience pleasant for everyone

hour delay with no information Supposed to be a pm departure Display board at BUD contradicted information we received by Wizz Air on website Never any SMS update from Wizz Air At pm we received a voucher for food All the shops and food services close at pm so getting this coupon after the services are all shut was a joke You buy cheap you get cheap Finally plane departed close to am with no support from Wizz Air and no communications after the flight Why doesnt the airport service remain open until at least pm each night as there are so many later evening flights We are encouraged to check in hours early which means I spent hours at that airport Ridiculous No airport services available I wish I could include a photo of how busy the airport departure waiting areas were thousand people with no where to go nothing to buy not even coffee or bottled water I felt sorry for the parents and all the small children laying all over the floors

Lines everywhere LATAM has echeckin but functionally everything is manual They seem to do their best with a lousy system The lines seemed to be a function of families having major malfunctions My checkin took no time at all It was a long walk to the actual gates Security was not bad Many places to eatlocal Starbucks KFC They dont seem to use jetways even though they were present and I was on an early morning mainline flight Arrival was no bettercattle car bus from the plane long wait for luggage and lines everywhere The taxi to the center is just a little more than the Liendo shuttle

Chaotic check in for Latam flights Long lines few staff working Airport itself is ok Once through security lots of seating available and food stands Not enough information screens so be prepared to walk to check on departure times and ever changing gates Many aircraft are reached by bus as there are a limited number of jetways

Ive been here a lot of times and this is still hands down the most inefficient airport ever Getting a special luggage through takes ages and when youve payed you have to wait to deposit it Everything is done in snail pace with no understanding of customers needs Every year I swear to never return

I flew into EZE and out of EZE a week later international flights for both The arrivals process took about an hour and the lines moved slowly but the staff was proactive in getting us through the process as quickly as possible including by waving us over to the Argentine Citizen lanes once all the citizens were processed Departure however was a considerably worse experience The signs on the road into the airport clearly state that all international departures check in at Terminal A so thats where my taxi driver took me However it turns out that Delta and Aerolineas Argentinas international departures check in at Terminal C so I had to make the minute walk over there in the hot sun it was in the s Fahrenheit that day After arriving at Terminal C I changed into long sleeved clothing because I was flying somewhere much colder however the Air Conditioning in the buildings was poor so I sweated through my clothing very quickly just while waiting to check my bag Finally it seems that EZE has a rule that nobody can bring liquids over mL onto a plane going to the United States This rule seems was enforced on all flights to the US But I have not seen that rule enforced on flights to the US from Europe or Asia so it seems like its airport or at least Argentina specific It was incredibly annoying because it meant that I couldnt take any water with me on the plane Unfortunately if youre visiting Buenos Aires from very far away youll likely have no choice but to use EZE But be prepared for confusing directions poor climate control and stricter security protocols then youll see elsewhere

Very clean airport and great lounges However prepare to be ignored if you dont speak Spanish Check in queues are pathetic and need review Modern display boards work well but show random and irrelevant times Staff are very unfriendly and not able to help with anything

Modern but has poor circulation in and out The wait for immigration was glacial and there was a customs form that wasnt collected The line for the bank to change money was glacial Terminal B the location for the shuttle into the city is really just a kiosk in front of the back entrance for terminal C some distance away The taxi ride from the center was about US plus tolls Departure was relatively easy which may have been a reflection of being a Saturday afternoon although there were few places to sit while waiting for the airline to begin checkin Few places to eat or shop in the departure area Note that there is no exchange after immigration so you must change money when you checkin with the airlinethe selection of goods postimmigration was disappointing and you cannot take water onto flights The lounge used by Star Alliance was ok with a range of things to eat The same vendor runs the lounge for Delta and American which I would assume are similar Bathrooms were in need of better upkeep Not the worst of airports but one Id happily never use again

The airport is quite a distance from the City It took me about minutes It is a modern airport with all the services you expect Let me speak first about the arrival We arrived early in the morning Other flights had arrived too The lines snaked and coiled for passengers to clear immigration It took nearly an hour That however was enough time for our checked luggage to arrive in baggage claim Our bags were put through a scanning machine by customs and we stepped out from shops to a concourse full of tranportation services We purchased a taxi service USD to our hotel A taxi driver escorted us out of the terminal building made us wait at a spot while he went off to fetch his taxi It all worked On departure which was late at night we arrived in the evening Check in was smooth Security check was also smooth Lines to get your passport stamped again on departure moved fast The American Airlines lounge was jammed with people what with five flights to the US departing in a short span of time The lounge offered a large variety of food and drinks but not enough place sit and relax Only one major shop selling duty free items Very few if any Made in Argentina products except for wine There is a McDonalds As is the case an additional security check is conducted just before boarding the flight to the US with the carry on bags opened up by security men and women wearing rubber gloves There are quite a few chairs in the departure area This is the primary airport to enter Argentina so if you are visiting this country it is next to impossible to avoid it I would be happy not to use this airport again

The rather new terminal C is very nice if you go left instead of right after you go through immigration We didnt know and we went right which was just one restaurant basic and ugly Before boarding the plane we went left and it was a whole different world nice wine bars restaurants shops etc Then we had to board the terminal has gates with Jet Bridges but we had to take a bus to the plane under heavy rain even though our plane was the only one departing

Really quick migrations Security checkpoint was full but the line moved really fast People were nice and smiling Is one of the cleanest airports I have been at it really surprised me A lot of duty free stores and different things to buy only thing a bit outdated is that I saw signs saying they are planning to remodel Amazingly fast wifi One bad thing though Lack of plugs to charge phones And if they have they dont have like a universal plug only an Argentinian one

The nonacceptance of cash at any in airport store is so irritating Leaves a bitter after taste when all the advantages of this small airport are ended with cashiers yelling we dont take cash Dont you like American dollars

Getting through this airport was such a breeze our home airport is Pearson which is insanely busy We were able to apply for TSA cares for our autistic family Tameeka helped us from start to finish of security and was so warm and thoughtful in helping us navigate their first time through Highly recommend using this service if you have a family member with disabilities We applied for the same program at Orlando and no one helped us the staff were rude and the lady guarding the family and disabled line tried to turn us away Thoroughly disappointed especially compared to Buffalo We will definitely be flying out of Buffalo in the future

In Buffalo Airport you cannot pay anything with cash So if you dont have a credit card you cannot buy any food or drink or anything else there and of course they take away your drinks at the security check This is a nightmare especially for travellers who dont bring credit cards

Well I went to pick up my Uncle because he is flying in for Thanksgiving He was waiting at pillar The person in front of me cut me off and the person behind me pulled up so tight to me that I couldnt back up to get out and the parking person or security person who directs you out of the pickup area came over and was absolutely atrocious Swearing at me repeatedly I will never fly out of this airport again and my family will never arrive by this airport again

Security gave bad information on where to pickup Megabus This is a chronically late bus service and security knew they werent giving good info Its not marked in the bus area The whole situation is sketchy I never got to take my trip lost a lot of time and some money on a chilly morning Really had it with these people thanks again for keeping us safe

Nice Airport Well organised checkin for B and speedy transit through TSA roomy concourse and nice Buffalo wings There was a fire alarm while we were there which was dealt with with only minor disruption good views of the apron and active runway A good alternative to Toronto for Niagara

The Buffalo Niagara Airport was quite an experience It was easily accessible and was fantastic with the hotels right across the road The staff were okay We were flying early in the morning so they might have been tired but they seemed alright The airport was larger than I expected The parking was easy and cheap Overall it was a nice experience

The most basic airport I have been to Having been brought up in Burundi and been travelling there and back to the UK over several years I think this airport has gone downhill Many years ago this was an exciting airport People could see you off from the observation balcony but gone are the days My dad wasnt even allowed into the airport to see me off Airport staff will make your life hell just to say your last good byes to family My Kenya Airways flight to Nairobi was slightly delayed coming into the airport due to a power cut I have never experienced anything like it My arrival into the airport was just as bad with airport staff wanting to open all bags and wanting bribes in order to keep things Thank god my family had airport entry passes which meant we werent left short changed In all honesty I would still recommend as its just a crazy yet brilliant experience

This is a very basic and small airport Facilities are limited Most parts of the airport are covered but are not air conditioned relying on natural ventilation Mosquitoes could be a problem at some times Fortunately there are not too many staff hassling for your money baggage reclaim was reasonably efficient No real problems departing Again there are very limited facilities There are a couple of shops selling the usual tourist fare and expensive bottles of alcohol The barcaf is not bad but is overpriced for a simple snack The business lounge is nothing more than a room with a TV

BUR is a no frills no wow no stress airport and those are the best things about it Easy to park with valet getting through security is usually a breeze and there is little fog to cause delays Theres a Peets coffee and the cafe is overpriced but decent Do you really expect fine dining on what is primarily a short haul airport basically an SWA airport Other than the charming s air about the place you get on and off the planes old school style with stairs and with SWA can enter through the front of back of the plane the latter to avoid the slow pokes SWA boarding lines are well organized If I were to complain the rest rooms are smallish and Terminal B for United is too small Seating can be somewhat tight close to boarding time Baggage claim is usually reasonably fast but there are only two carousels so dont dawdle If you are going to the westside or even downtown youre in for a long cab ride but most travelers live in one of the nearby valleys and if youre a tourist its close to Universal Studios Theres a train within walking distance that will take you downtown or to Ventura County during limited times Overall a very good travel experience because it is easy and stress free

Security took about mins Checked in online but the line to check in didnt look long Seating was a bit tight at our gate but we were next to other gates Boarding you walk straight to the plane and board using stairs Minimal restaurants and shopping but this airport is small Didnt have to use WiFi

Burbank provides a convenient and easy alternative to LAX although the departure hall in Terminal B is too small to accommodate more than flights at a time There were flights an MD a and CRJ regional jets boarding simultaneously and the small space and cramped conditions caused confusion and delayed boarding for everyone

BUR provides a pleasant alternative to LAX The terminal complex is a bit small so during peak times it can get crowded but security and checkin lines move quickly There are no jetways but being in California weather is seldom an issue and its quite nice walking onto the tarmac to board your plane by stairs If youre in a wheelchair they will use a mechanical lift to raise you to the aircraft door The food and shopping offerings are bare bones and quite disappointing If using the Metrolink rail is convenient to your travel BUR is an excellent alternative because there is a station across the street from the terminal but the airport is a bit difficult to get to by road because there is no freeway access within miles Traffic at rush hour can be difficult

Small airport dating back to the early days of aviation when the thinking was that would be aerodromes in most towns Today BUR is convenient airport for those wishing to avoid LAX You pick up your bags from the baggage conveyor belt outside the terminal
