Small NW Tasmanian airport with flights to Melbourne Tasmanian destinations Neat tidy with easy checkin baggage collection Small cafeshop enough seating for size of aircraft using airport Not a bad little airport

Cagliari Airport is an absolute shambles From the moment of arrival its clear that chaos reigns supreme The staff seem overwhelmed resorting to shouting to manage the crowds Flight delays are the norm and passengers are left completely in the dark with no information provided The airport is plagued by frequent blackouts adding to the confusion and slowing down everything to a crawl The situation is exacerbated by the lack of proper air conditioning With temperatures soaring passengers are forced to endure sweltering conditions leading to discomfort and distress While the airports train connection is a positive aspect the closure of flypasses leading to the airport is an added inconvenience Its truly disheartening to witness such a poorly managed airport in this day and age Cagliari Airport is a black eye for Europe and a complete embarrassment for Sardinia Its clear that urgent improvements are needed to bring this airport up to even the most basic standards I strongly advise travelers to avoid Cagliari Airport if at all possible

The only complaint is the lack of logic in boarding flights In COVID time would be ideal to board from seat number starting from the back of the plane in order to avoid contact with people seating in front rows In Cagliari dont seem to know at all this method that we have experienced at Heathrow airport and Fiumicino airport as well We tried to suggest it to the airport staff doing the boarding but they seem clueless and helpless Big crowd gathering at the same time with no proper queue and security distance I wish a manager at Cagliari airport would have the kindness to reply and explain why It would be so easy to update the system and believe me the boarding will be quicker and safer Thank you

This is a European regional airport and a tale of two airports really The nonSchengen flights come from Gatwick BA Stansted and Dublin Ryanair as well as a flight from Moscow When all four arrive at roughly the same time Passport Control is chaotic There were two snake queues those with identity Cards only were ushered into one and those with Passports ushered into another A third queue then formed and this is where the chaos began and people were jumping from queue to queue The departing situation was a lot better Quite a busy departures area but nicely designed The gates for the nonSchengen destinations are Passengers can go here straight away and clear Passport Control Once through Passport Control Ryanair passengers should head downstairs to gates while BA passengers should wait in the lounge just through Passport Control Not sure where the Mosco flight departs from I doubt if I will be travelling here again anytime soon but departing from this airport is much better than arriving at it

This is my home airport Completely renewed a few years ago its now a very good and modern airport Near the city center just minutes by car Its a small airport but its probably the better choice to come to Sardinia Depending on winds you can have a fantastic view over the famous sardinian beaches from your airplane window In the summer sometimes you may find crowds at security checks There are just a few overpriced shops but this is common in italian airports Car rentals taxis and bus are easy available

International airport is just conveniently next to the domestic one Only one coffee place and another shop to grab a bite souvenirs shops inside the gate Considering only a handful flights I think these are sufficient Theres one filter water fountain near gate Overall it can be improved when it gets busier more flights Both elevator and escalator were out of order on the day we departed

International airport is just next to the domestic one Two coffee shops and souvenir shops Consider how small the airport is these are sufficed One water fountain near gate Coffee from one of the vendors was alright Both of the elevator and escalator were out of order on the day I flew

Nice airport but everything at it is exceptionally expensive Bought a meal and paid about x what I would normally have to pay Ridiculous prices anyone would think itd be cheaper than Sydney or Melbourne but is more

The security check staff were unbelievably rude and disrespectful Nil communication skills and as a result we felt most unwelcome Not a good look for the gateway to the Barrier Reef

Cairns Domestic Airport has to be one of the worst airports in Australia Make sure you bring comfortable shoes as you will be doing some walking The terminal actually has gates connecting to the aircraft from door however it does not direct you directly to the terminal rather than a venture down ramps and semi outdoor corridors eventually into the terminal building When you arrive with another airline you will need to pick up your bags in a different building then walk the long way around to the departure building Then even the runway layout is special where the aircraft have to turn against the runway then turn degrees for about a few hundred meters this means that at busy times you can ensure some stationary time waiting to take off

This has to be the most inefficient airport Ive experienced Countless security checks Very limited seating which resulted in having to sit on the floor The cigarette smell looms everywhere in the airport

Worst airport ever Long long queues for first security screening for both economy and business then passport Took hours Then another long queue to get into departure gate Lots of bribery to jump queues Not enough staff or antiquated equipment Everyone scanned and then patted down Will not go via Cairo again

Departure is very tedious Our flight got delayed not due to the airports fault but it took hours for them to get our luggage back Most of the luggage returned were wet and damaged Arrival however is very quick and easy

I have traveled through Cairo airport multiple times before and my experience this time was a significant improvement A marked improvement in signage and organization within the terminal itself which made navigation through it a breeze The checkin process was quicker wifi stands and mobile charging stations were finally added the major downside however was the security procedures which were as slow and unorganized as usual and needs a ton of attention Despite the many areas for improvement i was impressed by the positive changes implemented since my last visit and hope they will continue

Previously Kolkata was one of the worst airports ive experienced but now it has a new terminal which is sufficient in size and clean It is still not anywhere near to compete even IGI Delhi or Mumbai airport though I appreciate the cleanliness I would like to see more restaurants or food courts and cleaner toilets Presently there is one food court at the domestic departure and couple of cafes at the international departure No shopping plaza Wifi is poor and only free for min but you need to have an Indian phone number to connect Staff are slow

Calcutta Airport has come up to speed in the recent years and its about time too I only used to fly into CCU because it was the closest International Airport to Orissa and cut my journey time by a day However it was always a tiring and bothersome task fighting my way through the immigration and baggage handling policies they seemed to practice slow slower and at one stage stop Flying in wasnt too bad on a good day I could be off the plane and in a taxi within the hour depending on the carrier However departing from CCU was a chore Immigration then check your baggage tags to bags then Passport Control then a small tussle with Security and Baggage Check then finally the what seemed like a mile hike to the plane However those days are gone if you fly in with BA they insisted on a proper Gate being constructed and it is now up and running Much to my delight its just a hop and a skip to the plane and then youre on your way Yes you still have to grapple with Security and Passport Control but the last three times I have flown intoout of CCU I have been spared the ordeal of searching for my bags and tallying them up with my ticket tags

Security is the absolute worst we have experienced Flew all the way from Armenia and had a delay necessitating an unscheduled overnight in Calgary Stopped the next day at security b and scanned our bags Security checked manually and questioned a liquid they claimed that honey sugar solid mass was a liquid We insisted it was not they asked us to open the sealed container and put it upside down to see if it was liquid and we complied and sure enough it was solid Then told us oh well its a liquid Manager insisted it was a liquid even though its a solid They took it saying it was a liquid No problems at Yerevan Tbilisi Frankfurt or Charles de Gaulle But Calgary has an issue Staff not reasonable at all and terrible attitudes All other staff volunteers and airline staff we encountered were fantastic

I am deeply disappointed by the treatment I received while going through security at Calgary International Airport on September st The security staff were unprofessional and seemed to be on a power trip showing no respect or courtesy to passengers I was subjected to an invasive patdown despite wearing skintight clothing which felt entirely unnecessary and violating One agent threatened to confiscate my iPad simply because it was dead and I didnt have a charger which is absurd Many passengers myself included were left concerned about missing connections due to the slow inefficient process Furthermore a female agent exhibited clear discrimination showing leniency to some passengers while treating others like myself with harshness Additionally I witnessed an agent in customs speaking to another traveler in an extremely unprofessional manner once again displaying behavior that felt more like a power trip than proper procedure This was the worst airport experience Ive had in all my travelsand Ive been all over the world I strongly advise others to avoid Calgary Airport and I will be doing the same in the future

Seating is awful No place to charge anything so bring your own power backup Businesses close ridiculously early Domestic flights are scheduled willy Milly all across the vast terminal with no rhyme or reason

I have mixed feelings about this airport Upon arrival the checkin process took almost no time at all and I was on my way in a matter of minutes Terminal signs presecurity were limited but easy enough that I was able to find the C security checkpoint quick enough Security was a different story The wait was brutal taking over an hour to clear On top of this the staff were not very fast chatting to everyone about travel plans flying etc Terminal signage postsecurity was much clearer and my gate was found quite fast Departure was also very efficient and boarding went by fast and I was departing on time Overall this airport has good and bad but its one of the better airports that Ive been to

The security experience in the Calgary airport was by far the worst In fact it was ridiculous So so slow Maybe people in front of me and it took minutes to get through Refusal to open other lines or security staff just standing around talking What an embarrassment

Worst experience at an airport I have ever had I am a casual travel writer and photographer and tend to carry sensitive equipment depending on the project In this case I was to be shooting a film project and had a few rolls of mm film The day before I arrived to the airport I called both the airport and the company handling security and was assured that my equipment would be hand checked at my request and that they deal with film often enough that they dont run it through the scanners Upon my arrival at the security check I was told that they didnt care what I was told and I was to do it their way or be removed from the airport The individual behind the scanner proceeded to not only unroll fresh undeveloped film making it useless but proceeded to treat my gear as unprofessionally as I have ever seen My cameras were thrown down on the belts and tossed into bins My canon AE now requires fairly large repairs to the shutter and the lens mount This is a vintage camera so repairs are costly I have flown through rd world countries with better airport staff then what is seen in Calgary Absolutely unprofessional unpleasant and overall uncaring Very pathetic

Security staff opened and manually checked my bags normally this is fine however my belongings were showed off to non security personel like a show and tell session Incredibly unprofessional behaviour that is totally disrespectful Security was also very inconsistent and had rules that were not advertised for example I was unable to take sand and stones that I had brought with me from another country in my checkedin luggage I had never had an issue with this on any other domestic flights I had taken they also dont allow you to fly with honey

I find the VAT refund claim procedure at CPT to be a bit of a scam There are no signs at the checkin or prior to going through security to advise where to go to claim for tax refunds but as soon as we got through passport control there was a sign and a counter advising about tax refunds When we enquired we were told that you have to claim the tax back before you clear security This desk was just to pick up the card with the amount that you had claimed on it So now we have to wait until we get back to London fill in a form and get it stamped by the customs staff then send it back to South Africa along with all of the original receipts in order to claim the tax back If I do that I cant insure any of the valuables that were bought as you need an original receipt as proof of purchase and to prove actual value So I guess this is how they stop people from actually being able to claim the tax back as people either dont bother to do it once they get back because of the hassle forget to do it come across a problem with the info they were provided at CPT airport so cant claim or choose not to if its a choice between claiming the tax back or insuring the items against theft etc Any airport I have been to before you have to clear security to get to the tax claims desk I guess to prove you are actually leaving the country So I find this a very underhand way to keep hold of tax that visitors have paid and are entitled to get back

Possibly the worse European airport I have even flown from crowded no seating no charging no water no AC really lamentable Check in process was reasonable as was security but once airside theres nowhere to sit most people opted for the floor

nd largest airport in Philippines has terminals T is for international flights Checkin Level has main banks of Checkin counters AD at the back is the Departures area firstly Passport Control with manned counters and then Security Scanning both of which were quickly achieved Main Departures has the usual array of shops and duty free shops and cafes Some views of the gates and airfield There is lounge which covers most of the carriers premium customers its tired but has a reasonable selection of food on offer and seats with view of the apron Airport busy but did not feel overcrowded

Arrival was fine was met by my fianc Departure was an entirely different matter Huge lines trying to get through customs they really need additional desks and staff Got through with only minutes to get to my flight which was already delayed by minutes Overly bossy check in staff member boarded the aircraft in an incorrect sequence I was supposed to be in row but was the last person to board As well as this there was no room for my cabin baggage Dont know why but my fianc was not allowed to even enter the terminal Difficult when you are saying goodbye to loved ones

Just horrible Luckily we came hours earlier otherwise we would have missed the flight st There is a weird ticket checkup at the entrance of the airport although boarding passes are given inside We had to look for tickets in our emails or print them beforehand you can imagine how difficult that is without internet in a foreign country nd There is an unimaginable long queues at the immigration desks both at arrivals and at departures There are between to officers checking documents for thousands of passengers flying international Even a year old can do the math and realize that this doesnt work rd You have to pay a scam airport travel or passenger handling tax or whatever they want to call it which is PHP aprox Instead of dealing with the airline for it they want more money from tourists and create extra queues for this kind of payment If you dont have money to pay it you will basically miss your flight Keep in mind paying with credit or debit cards doesnt work unless you have a visaCard My wife had a visacard and still didnt work so we had to go to an ATM get out of the queues and pay an ATM fee of an extra PHP But they still claim it works with Visacards th There is no air conditioning If you never traveled in a packed bus with closed windows in Africa before well try to imagine A great way to start and end your holidays NOT

When exiting the country be ready to endure a seemingly never ending queue for the security check This was the longest wait I have experienced and airline staff for imminently departing flights were desperately searching for their passengers who were stuck in the line The dutyfree shops were mediocre at best
This is a really nice airport the arrival and departure terminal are separate which is very convenient The airport hotel was amazing
I arrived at terminal what a pain If you like stairs and to walk min to take your train this terminal is for you Its brand new so its clean but its so low cost I will avoid it at all cost now

Good small airport for a short transit Not as big as NRT which makes it not as daunting Small shopping selection but pretty good food Efficient staff and quick security measures makes transit quite painless

I used Nagoya as a transit airport between Indonesia and USA Quick arrival procedures Everything was well signed in Japanese and English Transfer desk was unmanned but I bypassed as I already had boarding pass for connecting flight Security was fast and polite Terminal was clean and orderly My flight was delayed by hours Terminal has high ceilings and big windows looking out over ramp providing an open feeling Clean restrooms Only restaurant which only takes Japanese Yen and a Starbucks but there are several money exchange booths I did not find an ATM anywhere Lots of dutyfree and highend shops but only one poorly stocked news stand Free Internet throughout airport both via wifi and several laptop stations with Ethernet power plugs chair and light Lots of vending machines throughout but only take Yen

When we arrived exiting the terminal is quick and our bags only took minutes Departing is also very efficient as its not a large airport and theres only one TSA checkpoint Security only took about minutes to pass through Although the airport is lacking any duty free There is a small cafe area to buy some food Only two gates Our flight even departed early At am Overall a nice little airport

The airport is very small so there is a lot of queuing Check in was fairly smooth once it opened and the check in lady was helpful and efficient Oversized baggage also taken at the desk which is good when youve got ski equipment There was then a long wait until we were announced to go through security Waiting area was limited and the food sat in a semi outside area where smoking was allowed There was a very long windy queue through security Limited facilities before and after security There is no lounges available

Avoid this airport Our inbound flight was a hour delay and our return flight is currently hours delayed but could be longer The inbound pilot blamed it on the weather but this was a lie and its being blamed on a technical issue for our return flight This is a regular occurrence according to the flight attendant I will not be travelling here again at any cost

Because of the coronavirus there are not many flights leaving the airport and the airport was almost empty in general the airport was clean and quiet customer service was good there are not many shops for shopping and Starbucks coffee was working

Arrived at Chengdu on domestic flight from Shenzhen No problems getting to town on the bus A dew days later I had to depart on a domestic flight to Jiuzhaigou Beware there are two terminals both a distance from each other I got off at the wrong terminal no sign of a transfer bus so I had walk Not much fun in the rain

The security are rubbish no customer service at all they need retraining or sacking I was traveling with no luggage only had my phone in pocket of shorts and Tshirt They scanned my whole body like I was a criminal Avoid this stupid airport at any cost personally I will never ever come back
Functional adequate satisfactory are descriptions that come to mind Unlikely to offend but not memorable

What a terrible airport Minimal staff is not there AC not there Mobile charging points not available Food and restroom tho just forget about it If AC cannot be affordable at least put some fans Power saving mode is ok but it should not effect the passengers I have experienced airports in India but Coimbatore is the worse I suggest you to get into airport just and hr before flight departure Dont keep any hopes on food here It is the same menu as we see in the normal veg restaurant No kfc no burgers no pizzas Even staff also feeling hot and they too admitting the this is the worse one

Small and borderline useless Arrivals is straightforward plane bridge escalator baggage claims exit Being a small airport baggage arrival is quick Departure is still housed in the old terminal which is damp poorly lit has bad shopping and little food Thankfully its efficient so charging points work and there are enough seats to be had Bus boarding is on the same level as waiting and bridge boarding is in a set of brightly lit corridors on the floor above All in all an adhoc renovated airport that remains small town
In my opinion airport is not at all up to the mark Only one aerobridge duty free shop No internet facilities eating outlet Needs to improve a lot
This airport is of a very low standard The baggage delivery is very very slow and not enough departure gates only two gates are there right now On the whole this is one of the worst airport in India

Its a pity the city of Coimbatore is growing fast at the global level and yet the airport does not cater to international flights except for the meagre Sharjah flight Yes it is neat and tidy but it is also getting a bit cramped The Government at the Centre and State could look into Coimbatore as a potential for international flights The private domestic airlines had success when they were offered permission to fly there I feel if foreign airlines are given permission to do so they will meet with success too In domestic flights Indian airlines did not show much regard to suitable travel times to and from Coimbatore In the international side Air India has not shown any interest at all I feel they think it would be a loss for them to fly there So since they are not going to lose out on anything foreign airlines or other private airlines of India could be given permission to fly to Coimbatore on international routes
The airport is tiny Too many passengers use this airport The potential of this City is enormous Government needs to show some care for Coimbatore

This is the first review on airlinequalitycom for College Stations Easterwood Airport Frankly I had seen a host of negative reviews on Google and was skeptical about flying out of CLL I am elated to report that my concerns couldnt have been any more wrong First the parking is ridiculously easy immediately in front of the terminal Parking for the first two hours is free and daily parking is something like Second its very easy to get to from Texas AM the airport is on university property or anywhere else in College Station and Bryan but it feels like youre legitimately out in the country Third every single personnel I met from airline checkin agents who double up as gate agents since the airport is so small to TSAsecurity to the cashier in the one little snack shop postsecurity were quite friendly and professional TSA PreCheck also works like a charm there Fourth I was impressed that I was able to check my bag in with ease from CLL to southern Asia Fifth the terminal has obviously been recently renovated so its very modern and clean and yet it feels oddly spacious for such a small terminal probably the smallest actual one Ive ever been in As a side note the airport is so small that to walk from the lower level where groundlevel parking is to upper level for checkin security and departures one must either walk up stairs or take an elevator Thats right theres no moving sidewalk or escalator there This is such a nice alternative from larger busier airports such as Houston Bush which typically has good customer service but is smelly and beyond outdated and Houston Hobby and Austin both of which are very modern and clean but have generally poor customer service

June Arrived at Airport hours early check in and security smooth and quick At boarding long queue for passport control flights for UK leaving at same time not enough police to check passports Manchester flight gate was held open till mins before take off all passengers just about squeaked on Stansted flight gate closed min before take off time about passengers inc us denied boarding Plane sat on tarmac while they unloaded our hold baggage So plenty of time to have boarded us if they had left the gate open a few mins longer Cologne Bonn Airport website misleading says security typically mins which was true No mention of very long queue for passport control No announcements to say Go to Gate minutes before departure to ensure people get through on time
Most dreadful experience ever Missed our European flight with seconds due to a security queue of hours Very impolite and unfriendly staff Never again

Car hire drop off and bag drop off was seamless and extremely quick However there was a crazy queuing situation to get through security The line snaked through the terminal just to get to the boarding pass check point where only one checkpoint was open The long queue then extended to get through security In all it took us hrs from the point of joining the queue to clearing security We had arrived early so were not delayed but it would have been very stressful if it had made us late the airport staff claimed they could not get anyone through any quicker There was also a lengthy queue for the fast track line albeit not as long as the main queue Mitigations were the staff were very amiable and the queue kept moving albeit slowly Recommend factoring in at least an extra hour to clear security andor paying for fast track

Passport control is extremely poorly and inefficiently run I entered a line which was clearly and unequivocally labeled as mixed that is for both EU and all passports After standing in line for minutes and finally getting to the passport control window the lady officer rudely told me that the line was only for EU citizens pointing above her head I looked up to see that indeed they had just changed the signs after I had waited all this time She did not care that the sign had just changed or that I had been waiting all this time She insisted that I go to another line where I had to wait for more minutes

This airport went from being one of my favourite airports to one of my worst The quality of security personnel in this airport went from efficient and polite to downright rude slow and well below standards for a first world airport From having two terminals each with its own security gates the airport now has only one security entrance serving both terminals This causes extremely long queues to form and adds to everyones frustration The passport control entering terminal is now completely inadequate and catering and refreshments airside of the passports gate are pathetic The frequent flyer lounge has been privatised this was another bad idea The company running it cut down on service that now is more of a cafeteria with sandwiches and warm beer than a business lounge This used to be such a convenient airport for me to use but I now avoid it whenever possible Sad to see something good deteriorate so markedly

This is the worst airport experience that I had to go through And this bad experience is not due to the long queues or the lack of information but for the incredible rudeness of the staff at the security check I have never in all my travels encountered such rude people They basically should not be in contact with the public if all they can do is shout at you I will do whatever is possible to avoid this airport in the future and will advise any person I know to do the same This is a first and I am deeply sorry that it has to be about an airport in Germany a country I have lived in and which I love But these persons should not be employed if they cannot show the minimum of politeness

Colombo International airport is a joke Never had such a horrific experience as a tourist on an international flight This airport is notorious for ripping you off and charging unconventional baggage fees for carrying a personal item such as a purse or even food They weighed our food and charged me over for my purse and food They even wanted to wear my jacket that I was wearing I do not recommend this airport and they are notorious for treating tourist like this as I was advised when I landed in the Maldives Sri Lanka in general is a phenomenal country with amazing people

I had long transits through Colombo airport on the way to Jakarta from Mumbai I got an amazing deal but this meant two long layovers at Colombo which I initially thought would be alright However this feels like an airport which has not been updated for ever and ever The transit area is just a long corridor along the gate holding areas with a limited number of steel chairs and hardly any charging points The FB options are also very limited anything longer than a hour layover would be awful I had a hour layover both ways but thankfully Priority Pass gets you access to the Lotus Lounge which is comfortable enough to spend some time they give you upto a hour wait at the lounge on a single entry The food service and the beverages at the lounge are quite good though and there are enough seats to get comfortable in Unfortunately charging points are limited but atleast there are enough to manage as long as the lounge is not too crowded

Everything here is slow disorganised and so old fashioned Its like they dont care about bringing this airport up to date Lines are long staff are slow inefficiency all round In the toilet is a sign saying toilets are free Didnt stop a cleaner asking me for money The room after yet another security check you wait to board is inadequate poor ventilation not enough seats no water no toilets no communication re delay nothing For a country known for hospitality this airport has none I cant recall a worse airport Sad really

What a hot mess Arriving at am there were hundreds waiting for immigration clearance No real lines no one to supervise the pushing and shoving They opened another counter but instead of maybe choosing families and elderly the young pushed through Took nearly two hours to get kerbside and we had all paperwork in order They need someone at immigration to control lines and make it fair for all instead of the free for all it is

I will never go to Sri Lanka again after dealing with this airport Forced on to a hour flight with no water with no warning we had to go through security again at the gate where they take the water you bought for the flight We were then left in a gate waiting room with no access to water or toilets for several hours during which time the flight was repeatedly delayed with no announcements being made to customers Trying to get through the airport is chaos from the moment you arrive The bizarre check in structure has several additional steps than the standard airport and an unclear order Lack of signage or staff to help get everyone in the right queue Lengthy queues spiral around the lobby with no structure and move painfully slow The food and drink prices in the airport are obscene Wifi doesnt work There is nothing good about this airport Dismal end to a beautiful holiday

First of all they asked me to take off belt shoe jacket There was two lines when I entered through metel detector no one even checked me on the other side They were only checking the selected people After the security screening comes a big shock Right before where I show my boarding pass comes a person asking for my passport and boarding pass He then began looking at the pages of my passport as if it was fake He then demanded my college name my postal address how many times I have been to the destination country As if I was illegally trying to enter Srilanka While all I was doing was transiting in that airport After all the hassle right before the gate of plane a police again asked me to open all my luggage I had never experienced this in some of the most advanced and far developed countries No sense of customer service sympathy

Their security people and policies are out of control They have been so strict for no reason I am a precheck customer and they found sea salt scrub in my carry on and took me aside to test it I made it and I could have and offered to eat it They told me no and then proceeded to take all of my belongings that I had already picked up including my purse my shoes and cell phone I find this practice illegal and highly invasive I had done nothing wrong and because youre incompetent staff was not able to read an explosive test properly had to call someone to walk him through it then they inconvenienced me by taking my things and treating me inhumane For my next flight Im driving to Denver Its cheaper too even with having to pay for parking Also when you randomly select people to test their shoes through precheck that practice sucks too You are inconveniencing people that paid to go through security without being harassed

I have been flying in and out of COS for years and over the years the TSA acts worse and worse they act rude and no common courtesy whats so ever They stand there saying next lets go hurry up dont move this or that you get scanned and they either say move or I need to touch you more and then still no kindness at all They act like they have so much authority Ive had senior military leaders who speak better to people They dont deserve this position Hire contractors who know how to speak to people professionally TSA leadership needs to watch these people Start treating people with a little respect

The lack of reasonably priced and convenient public transportation options to and from the airport is a major downside to this otherwise attractive airport Why the city bus system stops just short of the airport is hard to understand without invoking a conspiracy theory involving the expensive and inconvenient commercial bus taxi and limousine services that enjoy a monopoly in this market

The lack of reasonably priced and convenient public transportation options to and from the airport is a major downside to this otherwise attractive airport Why the city bus system stops just short of the airport is hard to understand without invoking a conspiracy theory involving the expensive and inconvenient commercial bus taxi and limousine services that enjoy a monopoly in this market

CMH is a nice midsized airport Always enjoy how easy it is to get in and out as I park in the garage that allows direct access via an underground walkway Its seldom crowded though Ive had the occasional long wait to get through security I will echo another reviewers comments about the rudeness of some TSA agents The young lady helping us load our trays with our personal items shoes etc on our most recent trip was actually quite pleasant However some male agents on the other side of the xray machines were harsh and disrespectful to travelers including myself One in particular seemed super disgruntled and lacked basic communication skills to boot Unfortunate given the customerfacing nature of his job On a previous trip I can also attest to the fact that my wife underwent a pretty intense pat down because she was carrying baby formula through security with our childmaybe this is typical protocol nowadays but I think she was surprised by an agent searching inside the underwire of her bra something we hadnt seenexperienced when traveling with our first child Food options as others have stated are pretty weak There is Starbucks available if you have the time to wait in line a while during peak hours Overall I think its great for flying inout of my hometown but probably not much to get excited about for someone passing through

Terrible experience The security checkpoint guards were yelling at customers and speaking to them in the most disrespectful possible ways for no apparent reason at all Customers were very shocked and upset Im from NYC and have never seen professionals speak to customers in any context in such a hostile and unhelpful way Completely unacceptable

Decent airport as far as security lines and accessibility but otherwise just annoying Pretty much all the restaurants close by We were lucky to find a vending machine with a sandwich in it Baggage claim is also always slow
Come on CMH pm on a Tuesday evening and not one restaurant on B concourse open The pandemic is easing and everyone seems to be flying again We would like to eat
The longest worst and most exhausting airport experience I ever had Only boarding pass barriers for thousands of passengers before the security check Took more than an hour in that queue

Very dirty airport all over From gates restrooms to restaurants seems no cleaning Departing from terminal F the most crowded terminal only very few options to sit Probably less than of passenger can have a seat Absolutely no charging options The total airport experience is way below average in Europe

At this otherwise quite nice airport there are no charging sockets anywhere to be found One has to charge ones devices in smelly toilets or hunt for a cleaning sockets somewhere on corridors or other odd places No chance to sit comfortably while charging one has to either stand or sit on floor There are no sets at departures gates in international C wing No walkators either
Another one of these airports for which making money from shopping is more important than traveler convenience Long distances you have to walk no walkways no train no bus avoid if possible

Worst airport experience ever Queue for passport control took hours When you got there only officers on yet desk areas And the ones that are in attendance they dont work hard are SO SLOW could not care less that the departure area is crowded by their inefficiency Will not be back to Corfu airport

Very unusual queue system here somebody needs to go to other airports and bring back a foolproof system of queueing as there seems to be no system here Some staff were seen just chatting to each other rather than calling travellers up to check in Security staff at passport control were chatting and laughing with each other rather than getting hot tired travellers through at a fast pace not much consideration for elderly or people with disabilities were installed in their bizarre queueing system Water was for desperate travellers No time to view dutyfree shops due to queueing Such a shame

Crowded limited seating small selection of standard shops no first class traveller lounge no BA lounge Caters mostly for package tourist market Very poor and few departure board information No information desk One of the worst airports

We booked a holiday with TuiMarella Cruises and chose Corfu airport because it was close to the ship port I am writing this message to warn others to avoid this airport if you are with TUI Marella Cruises and travelling on a Friday to Friday holiday to Corfu during the summer of for the following reasons All the chartered TUI flights arrive within minutes of one another over a hour time period causing absolute chaos at this very small and inadequate airport that is unable to support the approximate passengers that are about to descend on it at this time every Friday We waited on the plane for over an hour because we had to wait for passengers from other planes to disembark onto the buses that take you meters It was very hot and uncomfortable The queue for passport control was another hours wait standing squashed together a claustrophobic nightmare Fortunately we did get inside the building others were out in the blistering heat Our baggage by this time had been thrown off the carousel and we had to hunt through piledup luggage to retrieve it I do not think this is the fault of Corfu Airport this is TUIs fault I suspect for selecting a cheap airport and ship port to make more money from their holiday sales The return journey from this airport could have been catastrophic I believe that it is a health and safety issue and should be investigated immediately Again all the charted TUI flights depart at roughly the same time and the airport doesnt have the capacity Once at the airport you will see all the cruise passengers that had disembarked the ship hours before you still standing outside the airport in the blistering heat waiting to check their bags in and little do you know at that time you will be joining them at the back of the queue which extends onto the road where the coaches are trying to turn around without knocking someone over There is no shade There are large coaches with exhaust fumes adding to the heat If you are sensitive to sunstroke and heatstroke like me it will be hell I had to leave my husband and go into the terminal This was very upsetting There was no space to move inside the terminal All the departures were mixed up together and TUI staff were trying to squeeze groups through the crowds because their flights were about to leave A long queue through security and straight onto the plane No time for dutyfree No time for food Then told when on the plane that Corfu Airport only has one lift for disabled passengers and we might miss our time slot we were already delayed by hour

On arrival we had to wait minutes on aircraft as two were disembarking passengers ahead of us Once off we had to wait at least two hours to finally get through passport control On our return flight we were queuing for at least hours we were advised to wear hats and have water which I bought from the street food caf opposite the terminal Once inside the departure board told us to go to gate however we were another hour and a half before we got near a check in desk Much polite talking to the TUI Reps at the airport did not seem to help as did every bus turning up with more passengers to add to the frustration we were delayed as four people could not get through the check in line any faster One who looked elderly and frail

I recently passed through Cork Airport and I must express my profound disappointment and frustration with the airports security team The level of rudeness and unprofessionalism I encountered was nothing short of appalling From the moment I approached the security checkpoint I was met with curt and condescending attitudes The staff seemed more interested in exerting their authority than in assisting passengers or ensuring a smooth and respectful security process Their behavior was unacceptably hostile making an already stressful process even more unpleasant I urge Cork Airport to address these issues promptly and ensure that their security staff is trained to treat all passengers with the respect and dignity they deserve I sincerely hope that future travelers will not have to endure the same negative experience I did

Combative and aggressive security staff Swissport staff were very helpful My flight was delayed by two hours so I got to the airport later hour before my flight was going to leave At the top of the security queue my boarding pass would not scan The person scanning boarding passes not sure of his name immediately said the flight had left incorrect and that I had to go down to the Ryanair check in desk to get a boarding pass printed incorrect His manner at this time was combative After I spoke to Ryanair staff who were very helpful they instructed me to return to security where he got more and more combative coming up extremely close to my face and repeating incorrect information repeatedly The situation was resolved when a more senior member of security and operational staff instructed him to conduct a manual check on my boarding pass and allow me to pass through security

The airport is small and easy to find ones way around One member of staff seemed off hand She wanted to check my suitcase after xraying so it was opened by her She picked up items that there souvenirs and held them up to a colleague as though they were something more than souvenirs This made me feel angry No explanation was given as to what she was concerned about I would not travel through Cork Airport again and do not recommend it to others

I have to agree with the review below The security staff at this airport are extremely rude and aggressive They seem to take it as a personal insult if you show some initiative such as dare to pick up a tray yourself to speed up the baggage scanning process Move into an area of the conveyor belt that has space for three people but is only being used by one and you can expect a volley of abuse from a staff member The angry demeanour and lack of basic courtesy is absolutely astounding I dont expect much from airport security staff but these guys or some of them anyway fail to meet even minimal standards of acceptable behaviour

Overall I dont mind Cork airport in itself Its the security screening that annoys me every time I commute from ORK twice per days and Ive done this the past years The problem is the security staff Rude distant and talking to you like youre years old As youre not allowed to pick up trays by yourself youre always waiting with your hands full of items to screen separately laptop liquids shoes etc I aways place the items anyway on the counter in front of the security officer Standing there with my shoes off and on the table and everything laid out before him he doesnt even look at it but states loudly do you have any liquids or laptops This happens every time Last week I was asked to remove my shoes I work in the airport in Oslo so Ive purposefully bought a pair of Chelsea boots without metal in them and I ask why Because I need to see your ankles Im wearing a skirt with tights and dont see the need but I comply because I know not to argue with security personnel The two business men behind me were wearing leather shoes and suit pants that could fit an extra pair of legs in them but they dont have to show their ankles for anyone Thats Cork airport security staff for you

The officer patrolling drop off was incredibly rude I had two large bags and an Infant My mother carried my daughter in for me while I checked my bag There was no line so this didnt take long The officer started screaming about the truck demanding to know who it belong to and he said it was black so it didnt register because its a deep navy blue I was being helped at the desk and I said Im nearly done it will be two seconds and he demanded now I requested to speak with a supervisor who told me we were both wrong I will avoid using this airport at all costs moving forward No one deserves to be treated like that I didnt even get an opportunity to give my mother a hug goodbye He knows who he is

Corpus Christi is fine small airport In remarkably good shape and well kept Very simple and easy to navigate TSA security was a breeze no lines and all staff were actually very firendly Not much offering presecurity but couple of shops and restaurants post security Easy to get to just west of downtown

It looks like a white elephant but what an elegant one Corpus Christi appears to handle only connecting flights to Dallas and Houston thats the international bit with just three airlines operating there It is light bright airy and wonderfully free of the normal hustle and bustle of a modern airport Checking in took three minutes passport control and security about the same they have new full body scanner Each airline has its own gate complete with airbridge to connect even to small planes

Very small airport Checkin starts hours before departure The small cafe on the right is the only place with a clean toilet and AC When you have checked in there is nothing It is the most boring airport Filthy toilets No info at all about departures if they are late You know when the planes are leaving a lady shouts out It is a bit of a joke but no waiting time due to the small size of the airport The AC is not working outside the cafe so it is a bit too hot

Actually more of a bus stop than an airport There are no facilities besides a pharmacy and getting through security is pure horror The whole thing simply looks as if it hasnt had the slightest bit of maintenance since the day it was built

Modern facade entry and checkin ok though crowed when large planes are scheduled However behind the easy border post it gets worse Only restaurant rather a shabby bar before the security check No refreshment facility after the slow security So dont go to the airport too early though the airline will urge you Its terrible to sit more than an hour on very uncomfortable seats in the departure hall if any available or in the bar European airlines have their own security check before boarding Arrival is chaotic and terribly crowed if arriving on a larger plane particularly at the baggage claim Be prepared to fight you through to the belt while receiving some elbow checks and bruises Friendly staff

I live in Valencia and work in the UK and use the round trip service fortnightly and have done so from the beginning with thomsonfly Although the facilities are small and limited at Coventry this seemed to be reflected in the cheaper flight prices and at the same time suits my needs of a reliable bus service to and from Valencia But recently I have noticed the flight prices increasing without the offer of discounts for regular flyers with this in mind I have looked elsewhere Staff at Coventry are polite friendly and helpful but it will be all in vain if you have no customers

Flew from Coventry for the second time We found the trick was to check in and then go to the caf across the road before continuing to departures Theres nothing there but a little shop and toilets Watch out if theres flights as the limited seating can fill quickly with full flights No problems with the baggage or staff Return flight was cancelled however due to inappropriate landing facilities at the airport due to the bad fog Small airport good in general but could do with some major improvement if theres going to be a big passenger increase

Before departure it is impossible to find drinking water or a socket to charge a mobile phone They extend the airport for Wizz Air but there is no chance to bring Ryanair and provide better prices Nothing to buy using your card only by cash

The flight departure from Paris Beauvais to Craiova Romania Is not the first time this company are not landing the flights meteo conditions fog This time the plane landed at Bucharest where nobody are waiting the passengers find a solution The only solution they have is to go back to Craiova in a bus I was forced to find a solution with my money to reach my destination The problem is the flight attendant knows the plane will not be landing at Craiova but the plane must go back and you are informed during the flight Is the weather conditions in Craiova are not good enough to land safely they have to close this airport Ill try to find another company

Flying in to Tobago airport you will find minimal facilities with xray or your baggage being the norm youll wait a while for your cases The experience when flying back out was underwhelming The check in area is outside the main building in the heat long queues and staff who are happy to chat to eat other mill about and lack any kind of customer service Youd expect that departures is open all the time Nope Again you have to wait outside with no aircon just a ceiling mounted fan just outside the entrance and wait until the staff decide theyre readybothered to open The best I can say is that the grunts of communication were followed up by pointing at what you needed to do and where to go Appalling and very slow The departure lounge itself has air con but the plastic seats part of the airport upgrade are shockingly uncomfortable If you want duty free shopping youre limited to a small shop about the size of a single bedroom with vodka rum and a few bits and bobs a perfumesoap shop and souvenir stall with tshirts keyrings and beach bags There is a small counter area where you can buy drinks and snacks this is not Costa You may be sad to leave Tobago but the airport will encourage you to get on your flight

By far the worst Caribbean airport I have had the misfortune to ever visit Arrived with Monarch unfortunately Monarch Cabin crew wrongly advised passengers with children under they only had to fill one immigration form with the childs details on the back which is what the form says Having queued for over mins to be told we needed to fill a form for each person multiply that to times on our flight chaos ensued One fan in that whole arrivals hall had youngsters fainting after the hour flight When we got past passport control we got to baggage reclaim with the fastest belt I have ever seen great that allowed quick retrieval of cases only to join another queue to get our luggage Xrayed the same cases that were xrayed at Gatwick as we waited the baggage belt overfilled with the passengers from row back to row on the plane jammed at the exit door and piled into each other causing a jam with no airport staff to be seen a passenger eventually hit the stop button We eventually got out after hours the airport maybe be able to handle endless ATRs from Trinidad but not an A and Monarch have been going there since at least when I was in transit from Grenada I love the Island but would never come back through the airport where no welcome was given anyone tourist or resident

I have been once to this airport as others said the place is tiny I wonder how it looks when BA and Virgin are around Boarding into small propeller planes is already a mess they search your bags at the boarding area even though you have already had your carryon xrayed

I have used Crown Point airport times over the last years and each time I return I pray the airport service has improved Unfortunately this has not been the case Customer Service remains a missing module from the staff training I can only imagine that much training is dedicated to being rude and unhelpful to the weary travellers The security staff appear to be on a mission on to be as difficult possible searching everyone irrelevant it the metal detector beeps or not And the words please and thank you devoid from their vocabulary On my last departure from Crown Point and it will be my last two international flights were due to leave within hours of each other The duty free had no cigarettes and the alcohol was extremely limited The cafe charging inflated prices had no sandwiches and were ill prepared for the demand Two staff took mins to serve one person with bottle of water The ladies toilets has three cubicles and a queue to match a bank holiday sale in Harrods I strongly recommend the management of Crown Point visit somewhere like Thailand to see how you can be efficient and polite Crown Point International Airport I think not Good luck if you use it to depart from you will need it with lots and lots of patience

Arriving at the airport was quick and easy However trying to leave the island is difficult is not extremely unpleasant The few shops in the departure lounge were closed when we got through customs Even though we had plenty of time and were the only people waiting they would not let us go downstairs and get any food or water They were rude and made it perfectly clear they were annoyed with us On top of that they kept telling us to stay on one side of the departure area Just make sure you get whatever fooddrinksouvenirs you want before going upstairs to the departure gate

Outdated tiny airport If a large plane is either disembarking or embarking the facilities are stretched beyond capacity The staff are not properly trained and often rude The Caribbean Airlines flights to Trinidad can be a hit and miss affair and if one if using Tobago Crown Point to transfer from an international flight to a Trinidad bound flight or vice versa be prepared to be told that your flight is overbooked delayed cancelled

I flew into and out of Crown Point from Frankfurt once flew out of of Tobago to Trinidad and on two other occasions tried to do just that without success The airport is very small mostly handling flights from and to Trinidad There are very few amenities inside but most of the crucial ones on the concourse just outside ATM fast food etc The staff at migrations and customs upon arrival was friendly and helpful but flying from Crown Point proved an utter nightmare on two occasions While international flights are handled relatively smoothly the staff dealing with the shorthaul Caribbean Airlines trips to Trinidad was exceptionally incompetent and unhelpful Several flights were cancelled and at no point were passengers informed of this fact Time and again long queues formed at the checkin counter which none of the about ten people standing behind this counter believed necessary to attend for three hours When asked to provide even the most essential information on which to base a decision staff would still not inform us about the cancellation of the flight In the end we spent one entire day at this airport without being able to fly By far the most shocking airport experience I have had in many years of travelling compounded by unbelievably rude and unqualified staff My only advice is to take the ferry when travelling from Tobago to Trinidad

For the size of Curaao the airport is adequate Its modern aesthetic provides a sense of travel elegance and comfort The eightgated facility offers ample dining snack and shopping options Checkin at am was smooth and security checks were efficient The following is heavily influenced by a deeply negative experience I believe I suffered one of the worst injustices a traveler can face I saw my suitcase for the last time as it was placed on the conveyor belt It was never loaded onto my plane nor was it scanned onto any departing plane from the island Despite the airport having only eight gates and a single conveyor beltwhere any fallen luggage would likely be noticedUnited took three weeks to conclude it was lost It was stolen not lost Words cannot adequately express the violation I felt Therefore I strongly recommend tagging your luggage with tracking technology such as an AirTag to monitor its location Would an AirTag have changed the outcome in my situation I cannot say However it might have provided a more positive impression of Curaao than I currently have Additionally if you are taking a propeller plane for island hopping and it is raining bring a poncho or umbrella as there is considerable outdoor walking required to reach the aircraft

My Mom required wheel chair service and we received superb service especially on our departure by Devon He ran to get my Mom as there was a gate change and looked for me as I was getting a snack for her None of the crew advised us but there was Devon with his wonderful smile

Immigration reasonably quick and cheerful baggage reclaim takes a long while I know its a big plane and a small airport but waiting minutes for the first bag to arrive is not really on Particularly when there appeared to be no other arrivals Departures worked like a dream No queues for immigration or security so top marks for leaving

Arrival was okay departure was a disgrace CheckIn at the dropoff counter went fast but then we had to wait minutes in a queue because there was only one person to check boarding passes for hundreds of passengers for two planes there we two control counters though but the second was not occupied Then we had to wait minutes for the luggage checking only two rows one of which closed directly after us and the last or passengers had to do with only one row Then another minutes queue at the passport control We had not even been controlled yet when they already rung the last call for our flight By the way buy your Blue Curaao in the duty free in front of the passport control They had the lowest prices of the whole island

Curaao is an important hub in the Southern Caribbean In terms of quality of services provided facilities friendliness of staff and officials it doesnt come close to the level of other hubs eg St Maarten Although some cosmetic upgrades were made the facilities are in dire need of modernization The food courts are a rip off horrible menu items at exorbitant prices taking advantage of your misery during long layovers and the usual delays having no choice but to purchase inferior nutrition The air conditioning never seems to work properly and you have to be lucky to even log on to the public wifi Forget about any business correspondence via email and seeking refuge in the below standard executive lounge If you can avoid the airport

Flew in with AB from DUS CUR is a small Airport that has drastically improved over the years overall it is looking great for its size However it is clear the Airport cannot handle the traffic though I suspect This could also be poor planning IC Flights to DUS and AMS open at the same time Together with regional flights its simply too much for the Airport to handle without impact on customer service and comfort Massive queues everywhere CheckIn Security Immigration Toilets and even at the Shops etc All because approximately pax are at the airport at the same time

We flew from Cusco to Juliaca recently on a trip to Peru This airport is kind of odd It is not an extremely busy airport but is really too busy for its size This may have happened recently because we flew into and out of Cusco five years ago and I dont remember it being crowded There isnt adequate seating many people were standing the shops and food choices were few and check in was chaotic I have read that the airports limitations have been noted by local officials and a new airport is being planned nearby but could be some years away I would recommend this airport because it isnt terrible and there is really no other choice

We were stranded in line for LAN Peru at the Cusco airport Due to LANs incompetence it took over hours for us to talk to someone Their customer service folks were not able to rebook us and took forever to deal with each traveling group Not enough reps were there either As time wore on the problems with the airport restrooms became aggravated No toilet paper and at pm no more flushing or washing of hands They shut off the water Not enough seating and they had all the doors open so it was freezing We couldnt get out of line or lose our places No food or water available after pm for sale anywhere in the airport We couldnt leave until we saw the rep so stuck in the freezing cold Upstairs waiting area being torn up and not enough seating either
Nice clean but crazy expensive food USD for a Cappuccino for a Bnh M Besides that its a nice airport with all facilities you can expect
Food and beverage are too high in price Its not worth The immigration need to be queued with long line I really love Da Nang city so hope the airport could improve it in the future

Appalling Food was exorbitantly expensive more so than any international airport I have ever visited I felt like a cow being milked for money during my final hours in this beautiful country What a disappointing end to my time in Vietnam Security staff were extremely rude and inattentive Long painful lines manned by a a single security checkpoint kiosk all other security kiosks were not staffed A number of tacky souvenir stores that all sell the same products at rip off prices Dirty toilets as well Make sure you eat and do anything else that may cost you money before you travel to Da Nang Airport The international terminal made me feel like I was being scammed

I was not very impressed by this airport but I guarantee that it is well run if compared to its neighbors They use jet bridge for bigger airplanes and deplaning is very quick Immigration takes forever as every single officer really makes sure they know where you are staying and what you plan to do in the country with me they were nice but I saw them being nasty towards other travelers Senegalese included The WiFi did not work for me but on arrivals you can buy a sim card in minutes ATMs are also plenty and dispense local currency without major charges The ride from this airport is very expensive for Africa euros one way as the airport is located some km outside downtown Dakar Keep that in mind when planing to get to the airport as traffic in this city can be a nightmare

Dakar Airport is old and slow and in pretty bad shape There are no bridges its bus only Lines at passport control both in an out can get very long There is only a single security check point on the way out Luggage delivery can take an extremely long time minutes especially when multiple flights arrive around the same time There is no transit facility To transfer you have to go through immigration and security again

Dakar airport has not changed in the last years still a big untidy mess with busses to go to the planes On arrival same old passport booths you better speak French but they have started to take finger prints and pictures like in all other African airports the capturing of biometric data is totally useless as anybody can get into the country by driving through the desert or bush On departure finger printing again on a machine that has not been cleaned for months disgusting A new airport has been built km outside of the city but they will only open it when Senegal has a national carrier

New Year Eve Standard control and luggage transfer after arrive from Madrid Chaos and no information about belt No trolleys No fresh air hours for standard control before return flight passport checks Police confiscating packed standard AA alkaline batteries left same batteries unpacked No information in English language About seats for passengers of flights

Flew in from Joburg on a New York bound flight landed at am and was the only English speaking person in the air port Despite my surfboard being lost and difficulties explaining what a surf board is arrival was fairly easy Airport very shabby and old looking but this is west africa Customs was virtually non existent on arrival but strict on departing Beware of the Taxis and the people offering to change money for you A taxi to Dakar should cost no more than to cfa dont be conned Look for a cab away from the entrance near the bus stop across road on the right side is your best bet Dont be harassed and dont get into a taxi with more than the driver onboard Keep your wits about you

Fresh breeze with a smell of seaweed that you might experience when you leave the plane You will then probably end up in a long slowly moving queue for the passport control still dressed in your muchtoowarm clothes from Europe Last time we passed there the area beyond the passport control was crowded and rather chaotic To pass quietly the customs control without any checking was therefore not so difficult Travellers not used to African conditions will probably also find the taxi drivers quite difficult to handle have an appointment with somebody beforehand if possible On departure the main difficulty was to find the right counter otherwise it went smoothly Anyway the Senegalese seem to be aware that the situation is not the best possible for a new airport is said to be underway We flew Air France As Delta Airlines has a codeshare on this flight one would expect checkin staff to have some knowledge of English but that was hardly the case Should not Delta Airlines demand that their customers can be served in English

We read the star reviews of Dalaman Airport on this website before our trip and were still appalled at how accurately awful this was This is by far the worst airport we have ever been to among countries Departures There is only free wifi at the kiosks in the checkin area good luck finding them otherwise you have to pay for WiFi Arrivals no wifi at all Yes you will be arriving in a foreign country without any wifi Most shocking are the extortionate food prices A McDonalds Big Mac meal actually costs water is nearly If its in TL do the conversion with a calculator as you wont have WiFi to avoid the heart attack Most of the other food places are in EUR so youll already know youre paying for a doner kebab meal We winced watching families buy food here easily gone If possible pack food at your hotel and if not seriously just wait to buy food on the plane somehow its cheaper There are three different security checks at the airport entrance after immigration control at the gate They are all poorly manned with incompetent staff shouting and grabbing your belongings for no reason The rd security check is the worst of all as they will pat you down dump out your bag spread everything on the table for the whole flight to see and supposedly swab for drugs with some box on wheels Everything feels a phony at this airport they expect you to believe security agents wearing plastic cleaning gloves touching you up and fondling your belongings will find something that the metal detectors and Xray machines havent In short avoid this airport at all costs If you must fly from Dalaman mentally prepare yourself and your wallet After being robbed for food youll be treated like a criminal at the gate Pro The airport looks nice very modern and clean

Terrible airport euros for the worst cheese and ham roll you will eat wanted euros for a small snickers bar Security way over the top Bags xrayed times then singled out for hand luggage checks at boarding gate everything out the bag case off tablet and kindle everything swabbed for drugs or explosives supposed to be random but Turkish waved through while families who are not a risk are checked excessively

Scammers out front harassing you right away trying to help with bags that get aggressive when you refuse help One even grabbed me when I refused to pay and ran away when he seen a police officer Security then throw your bags through scanners and rush you to collect your things when you have multiple cases Then the food court is ridiculously priced I paid for two bottles of water and packets of chewing gum Total scam and shambles of an airport you even have to pay extortionate prices for WiFi the whole experience is painful and expensive

Arrival was very good no fuss at all Bought duty free cigarettes which were very well priced booze ended up being cheaper in UK sadly The departures though is just incredibly stressful I cant stand security at the best of times but its so over the top here I do not know if its the norm for the turkey but the checks before boarding the aircraft were incredibly panic and anxiety inducing They make you feel like a criminal and do drug swabs all over you and your stuff I will also mention the prices are criminal and you should avoid spending any money inside this airport Water and food is cheaper on the plane

The double security at this airport was not explained to us in advance so that was a suprise The lady at the gate for the wheelchair access kept us waiting until all the people in the queue already waiting had gone through which we thought was reasonable She then kept us waiting while she let hoards of people who arrived after us through then she kept us waiting while noone was actually in the queue but every so often people would arrive it was becoming slightly irritating by this point Unfortunately we dont speak Turkish and she didnt speak any English so we dont know why we were kept waiting all this time while noone else was in the queue Her only job would have been to lift the barrier and let us through to the wheelchair access route We were only allowed through when someone working at the airport arrived pushing a wheelchair otherwise I think we would still be there She looked really peeved that she had to let us through following after them In comparison the security guys in the area we were waiting to get through to were really helpful and friendly

You dont really have a choice as this is the only airport in the area especially if you are going to Oludeniz or Fethiye But if you can avoid this prison From your very first steps into the airport you are subjected to xrays and bag checks thats before you even check in The staff are about as cheerful and welcoming as what youd expect when signing into His majestys Prisons Once youve checked in onto passport control and the nd bag check flights leaving in the space of a few hours So how many gates open and one for the prison guards once youve finally managed to get through and youve had your belongings thoroughly checked your through to the Duty Free which youll need to remortgage your house and sell your feet pics on Onlyfans to get a bottle of whisky and some sweets for your colleagues at work Nevermind the food court cant be as expensive Nope double priced meal deals I could not get my head around the simply outrageous Meal Deal from Eat ups A stale sandwich and small Fanta for pounds it was even advertised as a Deal Oh the WiFi is unreachable as you need a code from the kiosk but no one has it the paid super WiFi work though shock And finally when your gate is called and you can escape this prison you have all your belongings swabbed and yet another scan Guess its security and it would stop any potential security threats but this is too much Love Turkey but this Dump leaves a sour taste when leaving Positives its clean

Flew from Dalian to Beijing on China Southern Airlines We arrived in good time to check in along with about others trying to check in for their flights There were desks but no organised queuing system and it was a mad crush until we managed to push our way to check in Passport control was similar hundreds if not thousands all lining up to pass through the many desks and lots of people were just rushing up to the front to avoid the lengthy wait The security checks for hand luggage etc after we had passed through passport control were quick organised and incredibly thorough On arrival at our departure gate there was another chaotic scene as some passengers for an earlier flight who had been refused boarding were making a stand and refusing to leave threatening the staff who had left their post to hide behind a locked glass door Police arrived but just stood there and allowed the rioting passengers to continue with their shouting and throwing furniture around This went on for some time until after the departure time of our plane which was unable to get to the gate because the earlier flight had not left yet Nobody spoke English and there was no information on the boards regarding our delayed flight Eventually there was a mad rush to a gate yds away we followed and eventually boarded our plane We arrived at Beijing three hours late and missed our connection back to London with BA The hassle we had rebooking and securing accommodation for the extra night would take up many pages although BA were very good
Terminal E has very few food options None healthy No place to get a magazine snack book Its like solitary confinement Bring food and reading material

Was told multiple times that our luggage was put on a flight we switched to MULTIPLE times by multiple people They did not They were put on our original delayed flight that overlapped with the boarding of our last flight and they were not moved in time If we were just told there was no guarantee we would not be so upset Rude staff and unclean conditions make this airport one of my least favorites

Whats not to like about DFW You can park at any terminal and take the SkyLink to whichever terminal youre departing from Departure from Terminal E and arrival at Terminal A Parked across from Terminal E United Airlines gates TSAPre took a little bit longer than usual to clear minutes Both Terminals A E are spacious with plenty of shops and dining options Terminals were clean

Very limited seating while waiting for a flight In addition it seems that all the flights are scheduled out of the same gate area which causes the congestion Also has poor information on how to get from terminal to terminal However when you do figure out how to get to the next terminal the tram is an easy experience

I believe myself to be semiwell traveled and have experienced many airport scenarios in my lifetime middle aged and will have to give kudos to Dallas Love Field TSA agents for their remarkable work getting me from the baggage claim area for general boarding all the way to my gate with time to spare in as little time as I can possibly fathom I actually witnessed a family who did not make their flight one prior to mine but same gate and persisted by raising their voices that the gate agent should have known they were there but because TSA took so much time they were late The truth later came out that they were ONLY in line for one hour on a holiday weekend That is exceptional but poor timing on their part Everyone in the aviation world knows that on a holiday weekend there is a hour minimum time preparation period to make your flight So a free plug for DLF consider this Saying all of this not only was TSA awesome in their timeliness but the gate agents kept their cool and handled the situation with excellence

The airport was very crowded for the upcoming Memorial Day weekend Nonetheless there was plenty of seating at the gates and dining options ranging from sit down restaurants to fast food The terminal is bright spacious and with plenty of windows through which to see the airfield Going through security was a breeze with TSAPre The Airport WIFI is easy to connect too and fast The major drawback to this airport is the lack of bathrooms The bathrooms are small and there are only stalls in each of the mens bathrooms On a busy travel holiday this meant waiting times of about minutes Given the number of passengers that fly through the airport daily renovating andor expanding bathrooms should be considered

If you are using Uber or Lyft do not use this airport If you have a disability or are elderly it is extremely difficult to get to the area for pick up and there is a lack of signage and a lack of personnel for assistance Use DFW I used to love this airport but not anymore Whomever made this decision did not take into consideration people with disabilities or the elderly
