Flew to FLL days before Christmas The roadway into the airport and the terminal were beautifully decorated for the season For preholiday travel the terminal was busy but not at all crowded There was plenty as seating available as well as plentiful dining options from sit down restaurants to fast food to choose from The terminal is bright and very spacious with plenty of windows through which to see the airfield Even though it was night time one could look out across the well lit airfield and see planes taxing and taking off Going through security was a breeze with TSA Pre clearance

I first arrived in Damascus in Feb Since then I have been back and forth almost times a year since then I am an Englishman who met and married a Syrian girl in The airport in my view was more relaxed in the old days whereby you could check in and walk back into the loungecafe for tea etc with your friends and family

Our late night arrival was surprisingly easy to manage After a coached journey to the terminal some planes use jetties it was straight into the immigration hall currency exchange immediately on the right which had a couple of lanes for non Arab passports The lines moved quite quickly and we were soon into the baggage hall where our bags were waiting Customs took no interest and one is soon landside where there is an ATM one of a small working number in Syria a Currency Exchange and minor shops We were met on arrival so I cannot comment on ground transport arrangements but there did seem to be numerous taxi drivers seeking fares There are many worse airports throughout the world most of which are major airports

Damascus airport must be one of the worst airports in the world We were checking into a Saudi a flight and no information was provided on the overhead screens as to which gate was to be used for checking in In this end one had to push trollys to all the gates to guess where the Saudia passengers were being checked in At each counter there was a guy loading baggage on the belt and it was expected that we hand him some money The regulation of smoking in the airport was appalling the whole airport stank of cigarettes including the toilets The airport was undergoing refurbishment but the experience was chaotic

Expect to be ripped off by the taxi drivers taking you into and out of the city Dont go with any of the people hassling you as soon as they see you come out of the airport for an airport taxi They would charge you a mindblowing euros to the city The immigration process was fairly OK even if slow but they could do with some signposting in English Back from the airport I was ripped off SYPs by a yellow cab The check in process is appalling I dont know for what does one pay syp departure tax The check in desks are in a severe need for refurbishment My checkin desk was not even shown on the noticeboard and then a fellow passenger showed me to my checkin desk indeed it had a handwritten sign stuck with sticky tape to the roof saying LONDON The duty free section is quite large and varied and one could make a few decently priced purchases from here One looks forward to visiting the airport when the refurbishment currently being undertaken by a Malaysian company is completed

Im impressed with all the improvements made at Dammam Airport Its easily my favorite airport to fly inout of in Saudi Arabia because of its compact size array of services retail and food and beverage outlets Its website and WiFi connectivity are also quite good and easy to use

It can not be worse Although the airport was almost empty with no flights or passengers the services were at their worst levels Security people were totally unprofessional and had the worst attitude you have ever seen Facilities are outdated and apparently no one tries to maintain it

We have been sat in Dammam airport watching aircraft on a rd party app land and take off from all surrounding airports except Dammam because apparently Dammam airport has fog This is the second day we are facing a cancelled flight because of fog Here is the problem we all passengers not traveling together are all looking outside and there is no fog not any no patches of fog nothing at all anywhere So why are flights being cancelled because of fog The airport staff here are so unprofessional untrained and incompetent that it is a genuinely scary prospect to be flying out of here Time to move our arrivals and departure airport to somewhere else who actually want aircraft to land and take off

This airport is old haggard and unclean People that work here are lazy rude and have trouble diverting attention from there mobile phones to actually do there job The queues were unnecessarily large as there is insufficient staff to operate the customs desks

Dammam airport immigration slow and unclear which of the many queues you need to join The whole process takes much longer than it needs to At least luggage piled waiting for you then all baggage hand and hold to be scanned before getting to arrivals Usual selection of outlets foreign exchange car rentals Outside is a taxi booth where you state your destination and get tickets which are fixed price fares to your destination Departures is on the upper level with various checkin islands the information board is actually behind you as you get there to tell you where to checkin Passport control is more efficient leaving the country after which is security before arriving at the duty free wall Big selection of perfumes some tobacco and chocolates but no alcohol There is a Papa Johns Pizza and Starbucks coffee and a Baskin Robbins The terminal looks out onto the runway and most gates are via air bridges

Airport tremendously improving Immigration so easy relaxed and kind All sections of airport is now much spacier than precorona times New marvelous CIP Lounge as alternative to the old stuffy Tanzanite Has nice foods snacks local craft beers outdoor areas but lacks curves in design tarmac windows champagne and music

Worst airport experience ever The staff is corrupt I got harassed by a customs officer with two other watching for a bribe Eventually he openly asked for money When I picked up my items and walked away he actually found me in the lounge and openly asked for money For a country that relies so heavily on tourists they need to monitor their staff better Ive seen a lot of airports with poor facilities due to them being in poor countries but harassment of passengers is something else altogether I am going to avoid this airport and this country like a plague

No internet available Staff rude and unhelpful For instance the guy at customs stopped had a drink and sent a message on phone then minutes later looked up and took my passport Customs is slow and unorganised Even confusing Terminal is poor

Unlike an earlier reviewer my arrival experience was much easier I had obtained a visa before I left London and hence had not got that issue to deal with on arrival It was a short walk across an airbridge into the small old airport Then down some stairs into a rather cramped area where visas where purchased on the right and forms filled in on the left We did not know we had to fill in a landing card which asked for almost the same information we had given on our visa application We were fingerprinted photographed asked questions for which the answer was already on the form passports stamped and through to baggage in minutes Our flight was virtually empty but I would imagine that on a full flight it could be a different experience Our bags were in the hall and for the first time ever someone checked my tags against the bags I said were mine Another XRay and then outside There was the usual melee of taxi touts etc awaiting everyone I have heard of ridiculous prices being charged US for a return trip to the nearest ATM because the airport ATM was not working but luckily this did not apply to us because we were transferring to another part of the airport This is an old undeveloped airport and it looked as if there was little work taking place on the almost completed new airport so do not expect anything to change for some while I have been to far worse airports and this was not as bad an experience as I had prepared myself for

I have used this airport regularly for around years The airport gives incoming travellers the worst experience I have ever encountered and thats saying something For a country which relies heavily on tourism it is a national disgrace to welcome tourists in the way they do There are plenty of other reviews here detailing the dreadful immigration process etc and the dilapidation of the facilities Once you are through that you have to deal with the official taxi mafia who produce a menu of charges which is ridiculously expensive Uber works well in Dar generally but if you use them at the airport you need to meet your Uber at the fuel station at the airport exit The official taxi mafia will throw stones at the Uber cars if they come inside the airport Enough said For the sake of Tanzania I hope they get the new terminal up and running as soon as possible and implement entirely new systems with thoroughly trained staff

I may be expecting a little too much but I found this airport to be really poor We arrived about hours prior to our flight as we were connecting to a different flight through Dar and had to retrieve our baggage in between flights We started queuing to checkin about hours before our flight and we only had about mins to spare beyond security before boarding by the time we had checked in and got through security All just incredibly slow Incidentally if we had checked in online it would have been no quicker as the checkin and baggage drop queue were one and the same Admittedly some of this may have been the fault of the airline Qatar The baggage handling system was none existent Literally Our bags werent loaded onto our plane The route from checkin to passport control to security just takes way too long There is nowhere pre security for drinks or anything to eat and there isnt much more beyond security The only place to eat is pretty poor and overpriced The whole airport looked incredibly dated and in need of refurbishment Its a shame because Tanzania is a fantastic country and the main accessegress point is poor

Indigo airport staff are not good I have travelled a lot through various domestic airport in India seldom come across airport staff from Indigo or other airlines that talk rudely and asking money for counter checkin of passengers Argued to pay checkin amount otherwise they were not allowing for checkin No kiosk checkin available at airport nd negative feedback If airport is not ready why it is being operated Stop charging illegal amounts from passengers Better stop Darbhanga airport until ready with standard protocol

Velocity platinum flyer Self service check in was poor No customer service and people queuing just to check in because of min checkin timeframes Security were rushing people through barking at people to come through Stopped at the northern common for something to eat and the service was just as average Overall a very average experience Would not be in a hurry to come back through Darwin airport again

Departed and arrived at Darwin on an international flight from Dili Timor Leste As we were the only flight out and then back in an Airnorth Embraer seating passengers we had the international part of the airport to ourselves Darwin Airport has been refurbished over the last couple of years and is now a midsized regional airport with good facilities There are two times of day around am to pm and pm to am when due to the peculiarities of Australian airport curfews down south Darwin Airport is very busy But it still copes Outside these hours it is quite relaxed with short queues I find the ground staff and even security to be polite efficient and even cheerful and there is an adequate range of food and shopping outlets Virgin and Qantas have good lounges in the domestic section of the airport there is a small paylounge once you have gone through passport controls and the usual nonsense of the obstacle course of an overpriced duty free shop blocking the way between immigration and the departure lounge On this occasion as previously from checking in to the departure lounge took about twenty minutes and a similar amount of time between landing and catching a taxi

Darwin Airport is a small to midsized airport It has limited food options during the off peak times of the day but is sufficient enough There are plenty of seats to wait on before boarding and the maximum time taken through security is about minutes

Why such aggressive security procedures by airport staff for entry to transit lounge including targeting individuals in line for special scrutiny and confiscating water provided by airline Worst experience at an airport Almost missed getting back on plane on time Ridiculous

Arrived at airport to find very little assistance and no checkin staff available despite mid afternoon time Upstairs in departure lounges are old cracked dirty and missing pieces of vinyl No bar facilities available again despite mid afternoon time and crowds of people in the lounge area Very poorly sign posted Nil star rating if that was possible

I arrived here on a Jetstar flight from Brisbane with my year old mother who needed a wheelchair This latter was provided by Jetstar but then we were on our own to travel from the plane to the baggage area not an easy task as signage was almost nonexistent and some doors along the way were locked necessitating a rather anxious wait until an official with a key card arrived The only lift in the main area of the terminal was broken down although there was no sign about this just a loose flapping internal wall that was evident when the doors opened This discouraged all users including us In the end we ditched the wheelchair and proceeded slowly down the escalator There was a total lack of information signage or assistance of any kind in this outdated dirty terminal I intend to avoid this airport in future

A sad little airport with minimal facilities Reminds me of a old soviet area airport They charge you P as a terminal fee There is no option to pay by creditdebit card its hard cash or you are going nowhere A total scam to pay for what A sub standard airport I feel so cheated by this grubby practice and airport I dont know why I am complaining as nothing will change

Out of s of airports I have entered this is nearly the worst I normally fly through this airport twice per month or more Because my fiance and our kids live here There is inadequate seating Belligerent staff baggage claim takes over an hour In short Filipinos at this airport are horrible hosts

Terminal was small but efficient Toilets are smallish but clean Building looks run down and dreary but noticed significant improvements in the departure lounges There are still not enough seats though for lounges with widebody departures Almost next no nothing FB and shopping options Hope they push through with planned expansions this airport is crying for it

This has to be one of the worst airports I have ever used its drab it lacks any form excitement Food outlets are poor and dated as is the airport itself However after reading a billion peso upgrade was made a few years back I wonder well I dont really because I think I know where the funds went

Davao City airport in the Philippines is spacious queues are minimal pre check in After check in you head upstairs to the departure area pay your departure tax and pass through security You then find yourself in a the domestic departure area where there is plenty of seating and TV screens Flight announcements are limited my flight was delayed by hours yet there was no announcement to advise

From and to Singapore on Silk Air This is a functional airport which in the Philippines is high praise Security checks are numerous and slow as everywhere in the Philippines but because of the small number of international passengers moves quite quickly The same can be said for checkin baggage claim and immigration Toilet facilities are sufficient and clean On the downside for those who need shops there is only one very small cafe before immigration and a kiosk selling very basic items in the gate area All in all a good facility in the Philippines

International flight from SG Arrival quick but when passengers started to queue up for immigration the lights in the hall were switched off The only thing that lit the hall was the sun from the windows After minutes of darkness someone finally realized they needed to turn on the lights Departure was ok except for the time consuming queue for xrays Basic international airport Theres room for improvement

Security TSA checkin needs a remodel non district missing information A narrow hallway Seating in boarding area poor Seats torn walls in need of TLC Entire area needs a new property manager only nice open clean area was the car rental area

A nice airport very clean Weather is often bad but the airport cant control that Has a delicious restaurant and a nice little gift shop The luggage claim was a little slow and they took one of our pieces of luggage to the checkin counter without informing us Other than that a very nice little airport

We travelled through Delhi Airport to go from Amsterdam to Chennai For this we needed to pick up our checked in bags from the security belt and go to a checkin counter again Picking up the bags went smoothly everything after that was everything except that We were initially supposed to have an hour stopover in Delhi of which we managed to spend approximately half an hour not standing in queues By the time we reached Delhi Airport there was a long queue at the check in counters for domestic transfers This queue started in a straight line but this quickly turned into chaos with everyone trying to push each other all over to get in front of the others The staff in this time was doing nothing but shouting at people giving them wrong directions to get rid of people rather than help them out After standing in the queue for about hours we finally reached the counter just to be told that the belt does not work which was weird considering bags were still moving on it We knew there was nothing wrong with the belt but they basically forced us to go to a different floor for checkin promising us there would be no queue Surprise surprise what do you think we encountered there Just when we thought we survived the drama we ended up in the line for security Once again people pushing to cut the line but alright this is nothing the staff can do anything about What they can improve on is not shouting at the people travelling some people might consider this human decency but maybe there is a different definition of this in supposedly the best airport of India The opportunities to improve include clarity in signs for where to stand in queue not changing the places the customers should go to for the queue not shouting at customers attempting to understand customer frustrations that are created by staff not confusing customers by giving contrasting advice from different staff members

I travel a lot internationally and the overly complex chaotic unhelpful militant and unfriendly atmosphere has been experienced each time I fly into Delhi There are no airports that compare to it in terms of its chaotic endless overly redundant processes While flying in from Chicago we stood by the baggage carousel for hours without explanation Many passengers missed their connecting flights including me I therefore had to buy a new flight for the following day as my flight insurance would not cover Delhis inexplicable delays No explanation no apologies no interaction at all from staff Its basically survival of the fittest so be warned In transit to Rishikesh India after visiting Nepal after security screenings the last redundant screening required I unpacked and unwrap all of my healing sound bowls bought in Nepal Not only did the ridiculous request undo complicated packing the security guard seemed to take great pleasure in making the process difficult I had to deal with him for an hour for no good reason The one Indian who spoke to me with a hint of kindness asked me what my impression of India was so far Unwelcoming

Every employee except one was rude dismissive and completely unhelpful We paid for a hotel stay at the airport since we had a long layover Airport staff were making us stay in a certain area with no explanation as to why We explained to one worker that we were currently paying for a hotel and he was the only one who seemed to care or try to help Others barely gave a response and put their head down as to ignore us and hope we go away They kept insisting we needed a different boarding pass in order to go through security however when we finally could go through the boarding pass we had was fine The security personnel was picking her nose before touching me and did not even say when she was done or that I was free to go She just walked away without saying a word After making it through security other workers we dealt with were very rude We changed our seats at our gate and I said thank you so much a couple of times with literally no response from the worker Overall horrible experience No organization or order and very rude workers

I had an unfortunate experience with an immigration officer at the airport that left a negative impression on my travel experience The officer was rude and dismissive which made an already stressful situation even more challenging Upon approaching the counter I expected a professional and efficient interaction but I encountered an officer who seemed uninterested in assisting me and spoke rudely to me Their curt responses and lack of patience were frustrating especially when I had questions about the process It felt as though my time was being wasted and I left the interaction feeling disheartened Travel can be a hectic experience and having to deal with an unhelpful immigration officer only adds to the stress

Presidente Nicolau Lobato Airport is the only international airport in the nation of Timor Leste East Timor It is located about km from the CBD of the capital of Dili Typically there are about five or six international flights per day connecting Dili with Singapore Bali and Darwin It is a very small airport I arrived from and departed to Darwin which meant that there was only one plane with a relatively low passenger capacity seats at the airport The airport was able to easily cope with this I suspect when two As are in at the same time it is a lot more congested On arrival there is a short walk across the terminal to a covered walkway leading to the terminal building The first queue is to purchase an on arrival visa for visitors this costs USD which must be paid for in cash No credit card So bring your exact amount in US Dollars with you Having purchased your visa you then queue to go through passport control Once your passport is stamped only a few steps to a small baggage carousel which is set on very fast your luggage will just about fly off the carousel due to the centrifugal forces Then another short queue to go through customs and quarantines This is all sort of airconditioned and the officials are polite but not exhibiting the charm and welcome that the East Timorese are rightly renowned for Another twenty or so metres takes you to the taxi rank no more than USD to go into town When I was there the queues were very short and we were out of the airport within about twenty minutes Would be longer if bigger planes were arriving and departing On departure through an unmarked door which looks like the entrance to a shop First your bags are xrayed and then you go into a relatively small room which contains the checkin counters then fill in departure card and go through outwards passport control and security There are a couple of small duty free and handicraft shops and a small cafe but no lounges The departure lounge is airconditioned and more than large enough for our flight Then out along the covered walkway and a short walk across the tarmac to the plane Summary a small airport and quite efficient and sufficient for the flights to and from Darwin

I arrived at and left from Douala airport twice in two weeks As Central African airports go its not too bad But if you are only used to big international airports its not much fun If you are arriving on an international flight immigration takes for ever They have a new system which involves having your photograph and fingerprints taken Leaving on an international flight is also tiresome you are continually asked to show your boarding card and passport as you pass along the corridors Toilets are variable some have running water others dont One big plus at the gate passengers with oversized hand luggage were firmly told that it was going in the hold Bravo If you are travelling to Brussels dont be alarmed to see your plane arrive and then leave very early Its doing a quick hop to Yaound and then comes back Checkin is a bit of a lottery If you arrive too early you are refused access to the checkin area which is airconditioned unlike the main areas Arrive in a normal time frame and you could be in a long queue For the uninitiated your place in the queue is marked by where your luggage is not where you are Airport staff are generally unsmiling but not intimidating A tip there is an upstairs restaurant in the concourse Its not bad at all and has a well airconditioned section However staff at the snack bar at the bottom of the stairs will tell you the restaurant is closed Dont just believe them go up and check Another tip if you have an internal flight on Camair go straight to the office in the concourse and check that it is actually going to operate Its not going to be a certainty

The main issue I had as a transit passenger at Douala International Airport was that you cannot go strait to international departures after arriving on an international flight I had electronically checked in for my connection flight already I arrived from Malabo on Ethiopian and traveled onward to Johannesburg on South African Airways I had to enter through customs and got issued with a transit visa free and then had to exit through customs again to international departures Once in the departure terminal there is a business lounge that you can also enter for US if you travel economy It looks like they are busy upgrading the place so all considering it is ok

I flew into Douala on Swiss and departed on Virgin Nigeria Both experiences were quite pleasant I had only hand luggage and was in and out of the airport quite quickly When departing we waited at the gate which was quite calm and cool Yes its a bit manic as you walk out of the airport with people and noise everywhere but lots of places are like that If you know where you are going or have someone to meet you its fine

Not much has changed in this airport built a years ago The outside is decrepit Security is virtually non existent Touts were able to penetrate the immigration arrival area where apparently for a fee they assist arriving passengers with the immigration forms I witnessed this with a group of Chinese arrivals More touts swarm you in the baggage arrival area where you are also hustled to part with cash in order that they may assist you through customs Everybodys luggage is supposed to be searched before exit but I think this is more of a money grab The whole experience can be very unsettling to the western traveller Exit was not much better The airport staff often try to extort money for hand luggage with limits set at kg A small bribe will get you past this nuisance I forgot to pay airport tax before getting to the immigration counter so the immigration officer graciously offered to collect it for me From my hands it went straight to her left pocket Duty free is rather limited A few arts and crafts stands some selling local music cds dvds local tea coffee and some snacks An airport to avoid even by African standards Security screening is performed by the airlines themselves The only place where I was not hassled by money was in the toilet No way I can foresee the FAA approving direct flights to the US from this airport

This is by far the worst airport I have ever been to in my life with the worst employees I have ever encountered Tried to pick a fight with me while helping my grandmother who is in a wheelchair and decided to cuss at me and call me names because I was simply trying to find information out Absolutely uncalled for and outrageous and I can for certain tell you I will never be coming back to this airport again which is a shame due to this is always a connecting flight to Richmond va I would rather go out of my way than to ever come back to this hell hole of a place Im extremely embarrassed by the staff and how they handle situations But I will say shout out to the one guy who helped us out after getting cussed at by other employees he was great and they should have more like him Thank you for making me smile after such a horrendous experience

We were traveling to Belize for vacation and we ended up missing our flight even though we were at the airport hours before our flight with a parking ticket as proof The international line had no ending point with people jumping line unable to do preflight check in and we told multiple airport employees we were going to miss our flight to Belize after we saw multiple people get pulled from the line and given help to get on their flight to the Dominican Republic that morning No one would help us and the airport nor airline which was American Airlines will take responsibility for their part in us missing our flight I will fly out of Knoxville from now on and so will my husband and he flies weekly

Dominica Airport has several names Douglas Charles Melville Hall The closest town is Marigot The captial Roseau is actually on the other side of the island Minibusses take appx two hours for the distance make sure to exit Minibusses outside of the airport premises to avoid an extra EC pP fee There is really not a lot going on at Dominica Airport The check in hall features a total of counters Apart from a bar there are no other amenities outside of the security area Inside of the security area there is appx seats a small shop with local products and another small dutyfree shop Customs and security procedures are quite cumbersome Please note that during security screening all products with a flammablewarning are seized despite any size limitations with a smug remark that of course nothing flammable could be allowed into the cabin The waiting area is climatized but thats it Outside there is a small car rental Free Wifi is available close to the door to the security area and inside the provider is Digicel without a password Free Wifi is also in the bar next to the check in counters Allinall Dominica Airport is not a great experience

The security control at the airport was extremely slow A female security officer had taken a role to rearrange all the items passangers had put into the plastic crates literally organising them in the box to her liking for no obvious reason This meant that time per passanger was extended hugely When finally my time came and I had passed the control I took my crate to the adjacent table to avoid jamming the short end of the conveyor belt this triggered another security officer to come and inform that since I was using that table it obliged him to do the swipe test for explosives Alright nothing against that Before he finished the test the same ubermeticulous woman came to claim the crate back which would have been returned without her colleague intervening already long before as I had only three items in there and then they decided to start mocking me and joking that I probably wanted to keep the crate as a souvenir I felt completely bullied as in those situations you are on the mercy of them letting you go or keeping you behind Mind you during the entire security check process I had not made any remarks not shown any emotions or otherwise provoked them After I was cleared I asked a nearby police woman if she knew where the supervisor of the security control is to be found She kindly went to get a middleaged man from the line to me and he confirmed to me to be the supervisor but did not present his name or rank or anything He simply stated that all the procedures in Dresden are dictated by police order to detail which they simply execute He was not ready to admit anything else but the fact that Dresden is different from all other airports I was disturbed an frequent traveler I have never ever experienced anything like this

Easy through security but was hoping to relax in departures with some decent choice of food Didnt happen Only one cafe with a sad choice and overpriced If youre hungry get food before passing through security
My flight arrived at around am The airport was dead yet bags took forever to come out The airport was clean though There was minimal signage

Most staff working at airport cannot communicate in English properly the security check point in particular They speak German only Considering it is an International Airport this must be improved as a priority Many foreigners travelling fromto here possibly have problems with them because of miscommunication Not recommended to travel via this airport

The airport is big upon my arrival I passed through the electronic gate and it did not take more than a minute to complete my entry procedures into the country and it was more than wonderful The treatment of the airport staff is wonderful we received our bags quickly and there was no delay Upon our departure the treatment was also professional friendly and fast from the staff and there was no delay in stamping passports security check or check in We tried two restaurants to eat at the airport and the food was very tasty travelling through Dubai Airport is a wonderful experience

The airport police in Dubai are really unpleasant When I went through security one officer made me remove my suspenders even though they were attached to my trousers and difficult to take off and put back on He couldnt have cared less In general locals in Dubai are not particularly friendly In Dubai they probably believe that quality of an airport is the infrastructure but for me it is people who make the difference

Me and my husband have really big travel experience but never had such a bad transit experience as in Dubai Both times to Bangkok and back our experience was bad With h time between our flight to Bangkok we almost missed our flight as AirPort personal guided us to wrong terminal Information on screens is not sufficient we did not even find our flight in the screen when arriving As our connection was in a different terminal you need to figure out where exactly yourself Also we had to take train and then wait very long time for a bus Security control times On our flight back we had h between flight so we made it Would definitely look for different transit airport if possible next time Shame on such a rich country to have such a mess in their airport

This a not an airport its only a shopping mall the customer care does not exist I booked for my parents wheelchair service due to first flight delay by Emirate airline they should wait hours in airport My mother with serious back problem and my father stage lung cancer under chemio therapy Took two hours to have wheelchair every time the airport employees were saying takes only min my parents walked quite long to reach the area of waiting list for hotel and wheelchair In the way back from hotel although the Hotel employee mentioned several times that a wheelchair must be ready in front of airport nobody took care again my parents walked a lot and stay in waiting list and no place to sit sown first the wheelchair of my father was ready after minutes for my mother during this time they tried to take seat each one minutes to help each other the wheelchairs The whatsapp is filtered you can not make any phone call

We landed at Dubai Airport just before midnight following a and a half hour flight from Frankfurt The Immigration Hall is new bright and glossy but the set up was confusing as there were sections and it wasnt clear which one to queue in The process was slow and laborious and the staff on the desks didnt go out of their way to speed things up It took us about minutes to finally get through and into the baggage reclaim area our cases must have by then done about circuits on the conveyor belt The Metro had by then shut down for the night so we joined the queue for the taxi Queue is maybe a misrepresentation as various people tried to push in even though there were barriers along the queue We eventually got to the front and it was a complete shambles with drivers touting for business and people shouting The whole arrival process and effectively in the middle of the night was a very bad experience and created a very poor impression of what is supposed to be one of the worlds leading airport

We were flying first class on Emirates It took us almost hour of endless walking and elevators just to get to the immigration area for passport control We queued for at least mins and then needed to continue walking to find Emirates desk to find our driver who was not meeting us with our name sign It took us around hours to finally leave this airport Dreadful customer experience Never again They need to send all their airport staff to be retrained in Singapore Changi airport which is vastly superior

Terrible facilities barely any customer service We have spent hours of transit today in the airport and we had trouble with buying coffee from vending machine to using the shower facilities Vending coffee machine only accepts Dirham and Only in Dirham coins No one is responsible to provide you the coins you have to magically find some and no clear instructions After all the trouble we went through the coffee was hopeless I through half of it out FYI a very average coffee which we buy AUD in Melbourne is AUD in this airport Shower facilities there is only showers in each facilities at each end of the airport One standard and the other one disabled not mentioning that the guys one were both locked NO soap no towels and np shelf for disabled shower The showerhead was terrible and was splashing water everywhere during the shower Prices are generally goes to the roof including food and accommodation and for any purchase even a small milk they would ask for your boarding pass I do not want to give them consent to collect my information merely because I needed a bottle of milk I think our hours transit couldnt be less impressive that this I do my best not to book my flights through this airport again

Went to Dubai for business with my wife and got a flight to Al Maktoum International DWC Brand new airport parts of it still in construction Much easier than DXB to go through has less shops though Not much variety for eating but enough for duty free Airport staff much more attentive that at DXB this to be expected though considering the traffic volume is much less than DXB Only downside is that it is far away from downtown Dubai if got business there I would give a high score as it is a brand new airport and facilities are improving all the time A pleasant experience overall

I live in Dubai marina and this is a fantastic option to travel from Small quiet check in to boarding in minutes Its still in its infancy before being ramped up to being a hub but it is a joy to use compared to big busy DXB Bags are always office in minutes and you sail through immigration

Weve used Dublin airport a fair number of times and it has both positive and negative aspects Passport control staff courteous Nearly everyone friendly Bus info better than it used to be Bus areas mostly unsheltered it does rain here WiFi very poor unavailable in several areas Trolleys unavailable far side of baggage drop collect no wheelchairs or child facilities either Food Drink poor nowhere to get coffee tea except in a paper cup most food disappointing

I cannot overstate my disappointment and frustration with the treatment I received at Dublin Airport on two separate occasions Irelands immigration system is already infamous for its massive backlog of permit and GNIB card approvals or renewals and these delays are putting people at serious risk of being unfairly denied entry It is unacceptable that individuals who are deserving of entrywho live and work here legallyare subjected to unnecessary chaos hostility and disrespect from immigration officers Returning from Scotland Despite carrying a printed email from immigration confirming my work permit approvalan email that explicitly instructs individuals to have it on hand while travelingthe officer I encountered dismissed it outright When I offered to show my expired GNIB card alongside the email his response was shockingly unprofessional This level of hostility is absolutely unacceptable from someone in a publicfacing role While he eventually stamped my passport the interaction left me feeling humiliated and undeserving of such treatment Arriving from Manila The second experience was even more infuriating I had been waiting in the nonEuropean line when an immigration officer directed individuals with approved GNIB cards to the EU line I approached her explained that my card was expired but my renewal was approved with documentation in hand and she told me to proceed When I reached the desk and handed over my printed documents the officer dismissed them outright stating Im not letting you through because you dont have the proper documentation I explained that my documents were approved and that I was waiting for the physical card due to delays caused by the government backlog When I mentioned the other officers instructions and pointed her out he retorted with Well I didnt tell you to do that did I Back of the line I was exhausted but persisted explaining my situation again and offering my expired GNIB card for review He begrudgingly looked at it rolled his eyes and sarcastically stated Why didnt you just show me this to begin with I explained that during a previous interaction I was explicitly told expired cards were not valid His dismissive response Im not that immigration officer After much unnecessary backandforth he finally stamped my passport and remarked snidely Well I guess youre in A System That Enables Hostility These demeaning encounters reflect a deeper systemic problem within Irelands immigration process Immigration officers appear to have too much power and anonymity in making decisions with no consistency in following protocols or language guidelines For a country that promotes itself as welcoming and progressive this kind of treatment is disgraceful The first point of contact for travelers and residents should be professional respectful

After reading some of the reviews here I was expecting a real hellscape but instead I found a functional if not very exceptional airport with no real issues for me beyond all the walking more about that later I was arriving from and returning to the US through Terminal using United Airlines traveling at what appeared to be busy times for arrival and departure Arrival was uneventful with a quick trip through immigration The terminal seemed well organized and signed ATMS will give you pounds Euros or dollars I was taking an express bus to Belfast which meant going through a labyrinth of covered walkways in the ground transportation area outside the terminaldespite being able fit and used to walking a lot at home this was more than what I wanted after an overnight flight and the signage could have been betterit was easy to get off track The ground transportation area looks like an former surface lot repurposed for shuttles long and shortdistance buses etc Some areas serve both terminals such as those for hotels while others are meant to serve Terminal or Regardless a lot of walking Ditto on departure Departure was easy and went quicklyimmigration and security didnt have much in the way of lines Security had less of the militant hurry up and wait I usually experience in the US and elsewhere There could have been better spaces for putting bags and gear back together after security but otherwise fine There was less in the way of shopping and food service than I expected If you live in a place that heavily taxes liquor you might find some values but otherwise the prices werent great though not as bad some airports Ive used The seating was adequate although it tended to be toward the end of the shopping area The currency exchange couldnt change my leftover pounds to dollars wo converting them to Euros which seemed ridiculous given that theres a nother country that uses Pounds on the island US Customs is available about hours before your flight There wasnt much of a line and I didnt have to go through security a second time I didnt know if this was because of Global Access but it meant I didnt have to give up my water yes they dont let you bring water through this checkpoint Immigration also was quick although it was easy to miss the path to Global Access The US terminal has an abbreviated set of shops and a caf so you can wait until your gate to buy water I didnt see a currency exchange or ATM The gates are posted once you pass customs and immigration The seating was adequate unless you were boarding a jumbo jet This was the one part of the airport where I saw moving walkways but the whole process of getting there involved a lot of walking The general tone of things was more businesslike than friendly which was fine with me Not a bad airport overall but it would be a lot better with less walking

I think Dublin airport does a very good job of dealing with large number of passengers efficiently and with courtesy I travel through there at least once a month and rarely come across any issues I think when they get more of the enhanced security scanners it will be even better

Dont really know where to start First off the food is limited and is absolute garbage and way over priced But the thing that really stands out are the staff Never in all my years of travelling have I come across such rude and arrogant people The women on the desks at terminal are vile Witnessed the one we were delayed for hrs so watched here this whole time be so rude to a lot of people Especially and old couple who nearly missed there flight due to the airport putting gate on screen then changed it to gate where we where sat at last minute These old people struggled to walk And its a long way between the gates She did call there names quite a few times and once they got to gate she was screaming and shouting at them like they where naughty children Almost on the verge of bullying Once they had gone She and the others at desk where what I believe to be cursing the old couple Then laughing about it and very open about it In the time we sat there we witnessed numerous times things like this happening to customers
Worst airport I have ever had the displeasure of departing from Food was diabolical and staff were so ignorant I think Ill walk the km next time

My wife put her Passport in the tray to pass through Security but it was missing at the other end Staff looked said it was missing and that there was nothing more they could do Fortunately my wife has dual nationalities and we were able to use her other Passport to get a new Boarding Pass We tried to report the loss to the Police but was told that we would have to leave the airport to do so This would have meant missing our flight Just before we got on the flight we were approached by a Policeman who said that the Passport had been found inside the scanner

Language barrier and extremely rude security staff The airport was fairly small clean and easy to find your way I did not have to wait long in the queue Both check in and other procedures ended very quickly to my surprise Most of the staff at passport check and other parts of the airport seemed nice but there was one terribly rude lady at the handbag check who I assume didnt know English and therefore thought she could touch me without permission and grunt at me to express herself There was one wooden mushroom that I bought for decoration purpose in one of my handbags and seemed suspicious to her on the xray she first grunted and angrily pointed my bag When I started to talk in English she called her younger colleague to tell me that they have to check inside my bag Its zip was broken so I had to sew it so they said they needed to cut the bag open I asked if they had bags to put my belongings or anything to sew it again but at the end they cut it While they were busy opening it I was so panicked and confused and I dont know I thought they were done checking my other luggages that were apparently waiting in line When I attempted to walk towards my bags waiting on the conveyor belt the same lady who didnt know English raised her hand to push me back and yelled at me And she and her younger colleague found the wooden mushroom and pulled it up from among my clothes only to look at each other and laugh Let alone a simple apology none of them showed any effort to make any explanation until I asked And during the rest of my time the lady spent her sweet time lifting the deodorants and some other liquids which I forgot there from my bags and grunting at me for each as if I committed a crime At least the younger lady tried to explain to me in English but it was only when I asked a objected to or questioned the situation I can understand that the security staff has to be very careful with the passengers and and are obliged to implement the rules but this is not the way to do it No one deserves this just because they are foreigners it is important for all of us how to show respect to each other and communicate properly And since it is a touristic destination it should not be too much to ask the staff to know English

Traveled here during covid time The terminal building is newly built and well laid out Signaling was very clear and seats floor etc were exceptionally clean Security control was fast and easy but seems a mess when theyre a huge amount of passengers the same time as theyve only a few lanes Inbound passport control can take a while as generally only a raw desks are open Outbound is fine Theyve some large dutyfree shops Biggest letdown is ground transportation Taxis are overpriced and a bus is running at odd times

Depart this airport for Amsterdam and arrived at this airport from Amsterdam The airport is a small but quick airport Security could be quicker however was adequate for the size of airport They are no shops airside but there is a cafe landside Toilets are clean and they are plenty seats TV in departure lounge Arriving in Dundee was straight forward little walking to the taxi rank as the taxis are allowed right up to the main door

Dundee Airport is very small but has a modern terminal building Facilities are not suprisingly rather limited but the checkin is very quick and easy Free parking is available The only route is the Scot Airways service to London City Airport which operates several times daily The only negative aspect is the lack of public transport links but a taxi ride to the city centre takes only five minutes The main AberdeenGlasgow railway passes the airport the lack of a station is annoying Compared to the long queues and delays at larger airports the tiny Dundee Airport is a delight to use and a useful alternative to Edinburgh or Aberdeen airports The view of the city and the River Tay on takeofflanding is stunning

Decided to fly direct from Brisbane to Dunedin rather than via Christchurch then driving I had previously flown into Dunedin over years ago and the differences were huge from then until now It is a small airport for a small city so it is compact but effectively laid out International flights arrive at an annex that is connected to the main terminal building by a corridor There are no Smartgates at immigration but it only receives a single international flight at a time it was also good that all three counters were manned for quick processing To get to the rental car office you have to leave the terminal turn left and reenter the annex building which was quite a cold walk on a late night flight For the return trip it was a very busy morning with several domestic flights departing near the same time as my international flight thus international passengers were held in the main terminal area until those domestic flights were processed before being allowed through for screening However there is only a couple of vending machines at the international gates with a small duty free so it is better to not rush through

DUD is a small but efficient airport with everything you need Landed from Wellington bags out very quickly The airport is quite far from city centre mins cost nearly dollars by Taxi and dollars by super shuttle Departure is well organised checkin sufficient airline lounge is located upstairs security check right before you board

The pick up area at arrivals requires urgent attention How can an international airport have a pick up zone for so few cars To make matters worse it has a boom that has to operate in that connection Absolute nightmare Designers rethink

Why are there no porters in drop off and pick up points to load luggage onto trolleys Older ladies should be considered when travelling without s male or when being picked up or dropped off by a lady Luggage is heavy for ladies to lift There used to be porters its now no longer a service Why

Durbans new airport King Shaka International was opened for the World Cup It was designed as a stateofthe art regional airport for Durban KwaZuluNatal region The is plenty of space for stopping in the dropoff zone with direct access to the terminal There are seperate checkin islands for BA SAA and Emirates The departure concourse is spacious with enough seating for waiting passengers In the arrivals hall there is a food court with a Piazza some shops a Woolworths banks and post office Also a tourist information office After security there is plenty of space Unfortunately some lounges were closed due to renovations but this is only temporary The domestic terminal has plenty of space so a quiet corner for reading or working is not a problem If more international arrivals departures materialise then the current departure gates could prove to be a bit underdimensioned in the future

The long term car parking at this airport is a nightmare There is not enough and some genius has blocked off the additional parking adjacent to the long term so there are empty spaces there There are cars parked in places that is not an actual parking bay and also on the pavements these people are paying to park there when there is no proper space The airport has also removed the golf carts which transported passengers to the terminal and replaced with a few cars which are rarely there at off peak hours like the early hours which means a long walk to the terminal often in the dark Other South African Airports offer discounted rates when you book and pay in advance This one does not so it is expensive to park there and with limited facilities The security point in the domestic section is often crowded due to not all the check points being open In international if you get more than one flight arrive the immigration queues can be long and frustrating

Small regional airport mostly domestic flights with limited international flights Was told it was built to accommodate World Cup in South Africa You can definitely tell the airport interior and parking facility are modern and efficiently laid out Because it is a small regional airports you shouldnt expect too much on shopping or dining options However for an airport this size its shops and restaurantcafe options seem adequate actually surprisingly many One short coming is its dining food court area It was rather poorly laid out and seem unwelcoming

A generally good experience at Durban airport Arrival is quite simple and they seem to keep the touts out of the waiting area The checkin is well organized and immigration outbound proceeded quickly There are a number of shops and restaurants The food and the shopping are forgettable but not expensive Decent amount of seating at the gates Wifi works fine
A fantastic new airport that is miles ahead of the old Durban International Bright spacious and with a feeling of quality

Kazi Nazrul Islam airport RDP Durgapur is a new greenfield airport in the the industrial city of Durgapur West Bengal Eastern India It is a growing airport which holds much promise for improving air connectivity to this part of the state and can become a major player in boosting tourism and business in the area The connectivity from the city to the airport has improved but still needs more intervention including development of the surrounding areas
Was disappointed during checkin Asked for an airport facility fee each even though nothing was mentioned while booking the flights The lounge and airport were freezing cold despite extra fee

Customer service has deteriorated significantly since my last trip in Jan I arrived to catch KL on March Checkin agent said she could not tag my suitcase through to my final destination claiming that a routing of flights cannot be printed on a single tag I have taken many flight journeys in the past with a single bag tag printed at the starting airport I suspect that the real reason is that doing so involves some complication and that she just couldnt be bothered The airside gents toilet stank of sewage so badly it was impossible to set foot in there Finally there was no priority boarding for Skyteam Elite members on the KLM flights boarding was done by everyone stampeding for the gate queue as soon as the flight was called If this airport wants to survive let alone continue charging passengers a departure fee which its rivals in the region do not it needs to start running a much more professional operation

I flew from MME for the first time in almost a year largely because the cost of KLM tickets to a long haul destination have for some reason become more expensive than their equivalents from MAN This time however there was only about a difference between the MMEAMSSEABUR flight compared to going from MAN and I thought that was worth paying for the convenience and absence of queues that MME offers On the outward trip at least it was Apart from the KLM flight I boarded there was almost no traffic at all I get the impression the loss of charter and holiday flights due to the recession must have hit MME hard and it remains one of the most stressfree airports Ive ever used There was one irritation The Iceland volcano business started while I was away as a result of which my return was delayed by four days While I was away I emailed MME telling them that my car would overstay its paidinadvance booking in the airport car park asking them not to clamp it or have it towed away and asking if Id be liable for any extra charge Dont worry your car is safe and no extra charge came a very quick reply However when I did return there were no airport staff around anywhere to get my ticket validated and I had to pay an extra in the machine to get out of the car park I later wrote to the airport enclosing the receipt and asking if theyd consider refunding me Its now two months later and Ive had no reply Admittedly this is a very minor problem compared to the volcano disruption some people experienced but given that MME must be having real problems retaining routes and passengers not surprising given how much the cost of KLM flights from the airport have gone up I didnt find that very impressive especially given that the volcano disruption would have meant fewer departing passengers and thus my car was not taking up a space that someone else would have wanted and been willing to pay for

I should report good news On a recent flight to AMS my preprinted boarding pass could not be read by the scanner at security and I was dealt with as were other passengers in a similar situation very brusquely and rudely by a couldntcareless itseverybodyelsesfaultbutmine attendant On my return I wrote a letter of complaint to the airport manager received an immediate acknowledgement and within a few days a detailed and thoughtful apology not just a standard halfhearted general foboff Excellent PR which I applaud

I have used this airport much more regularly since my previous comment and cannot fault it as a quick departurearrival point I flew in from AMS on Saturday afternoon and even with hold luggage to collect was driving away in my car just minutes after touching down There arent many facilities and the staff are willing in a slightly amateurish way rather than polished in PR techniques but who cares when progress through the terminal is so quick and easy Lets hope it doesnt grow too quickly for its own good

I agree with both previous comments Although my most local airport I used it for the first time only this week to fly out to LUX via AMS with KLM then back from BRU via LHR with BMI I was on the road barely minutes after landing on my return hand baggage only but had some trouble checking in at Brussels where the staff still referred to the airport as Teesside then again passing through passport control at Heathrow when I gave Teesside as my destination and was told somewhat sharply and lacking any humour in tone or body language by the man on the desk that there was no such place Seriously road signs must be a real pain for strangers to the area why on earth cant quick stickon amendments have been made by now Overall however a pleasantly small and efficient operation although like LeedsBradford of which in many ways this is a smaller version passengers will need to be prepared to get very wet andor cold when joining or leaving aircraft in poor weather

Came to Dushanbe airport at around am for my very early flight to Istanbul The new terminal is small but functional and easy to go through Not plenty to do but the airside cafe is quite nice with good selection and the free wifi was actually quite fast Duty free shop has the typical selection you see everywhere and some local products Plenty of places to sit down unless more than or flights going at the same time its not a very busy airport

After going through a nightmare in Tashkent airport I was expecting to face something similar in Dushanbe I was surprised in a positive way Yes the airport is old no facilities but it took me minutes to get the visa another to go through passport control and once I finished with that my suitcase was already waiting for me No custom forms to fill out only a short immigration form Thinking that this may have been an exception I arrived to the airport hours before my departure minutes for check in no queue in passport control and literally a minute in security check no one cares about things like liquids taking out laptops etc Which left me with more than an hour and half in the terminal where there is nothing to do A small duty free expensive and a small bar are the only things for entertaining no wireless of course Overall not bad at all The new terminal building is supposed to be ready this fall

Welcome back to the s Soviet era customer service and chaos Dushanbe only has flights a week from Istanbul most flights are from Moscow if they had more the system would collapse On arrival it took hours to clear immigration once I got my visa I had to wake up the border official to stamp my passport Usual FSU customer service standards it took minutes from getting to the desk to receiving a boarding card with the check in agent calling her friends and wandering off during check in hand writing passenger details carry your own bag through the scanner etc They relieved me of exit charge for which I got no receipt so I am not sure if this was simply a bit of Tajik private enterprise or a tax on foreigners Airside there is absolutely no space the airport was designed before security measures and you simply have to wait until minutes before the flight before you go through Duty free closed with only flights of westerners a week you would think it was worth their while to open it and nothing at all airside aside from a few plastic chairs Land side there is a coffee shop selling bizzarely coloured cakes and a variety of beverages but as the Turkish Airlines flight is horribly early in the morning I did not feel up to consuming anything so cannot comment

This is not the first time flying from and to Dusseldorf but everytime and also today we need to wait extremely long to get our luggage Today it took over hours to get it I have trackers in our suitcases and I saw that they were already in the back for a long time Except our stroller so we now already waiting for two hours for a stroller Which is one of the first things you need as a parent traveling Its really ridiculous Hire some more people for in the back

We landed at and went directly to the bagage claim area There we waited and waited with no information about the delay of our luggage After minutes they announced that because of a staff shortage the moving of luggage was a problem We waited another minutes before we finally got our luggage

The security staff especially one lady is extremely rude I experienced the same rude behavior of this lady before Most unfriendly and rude security control She Should learn behaviour with older people Its just the way you tell things to a guest She yelled at me like a year old school boy who made a mistake because I put the box with my belongings in a vertical instead of horizontal direction towards the belt I told her that its not the way to yell at a year old person and she laughed at me telling me that she only advises guests two times how to put things correctly and if its not done the way she wants it she would yell

The staff in the security check point are extremely disrespectful I wasnt aware of the rules that all travelers need to take out small liquid bottles and put them in a small plastic bags In the US if the volume is below oz you are fine They had me take out all my laptop iPad Kindle and phones and put through the system to the other side When I was taking out my makeup stuff I asked if they could let me keep all my stuff together and they said no What is even worse is that when I asked what I should take out from my makeup bag and put to the plastic bag they provided The security woman yelled at me Everything Have you ever taken a plane before I was like Yes but never in Dsseldorf You guys are different She yelled at me again do you have a problem If you do take your stuff and leave I was shocked Ive traveled to over countries in the past few years and been through many many airports I havent seen any one who are as disrespectful and unprofessional like those in Dsseldorf airport That is unbelievable and unacceptable
Very poor On a plane from UK and only of passport control booths open Therefore long slow queues Didnt they know a plane was landing Ridiculous

I fly an average of times a year and Dusseldorf airport is the worst airport I have ever been to They stole half of my ml liquids because the plastic bags were to big I always use the same plastic bags for my liquids all over the world and this was never a problem anywhere They treated us like criminals and were very arrogant They abused their power on us And we almost missed our flight I will never fly from this airport again and advise anyone not to go here Go to Keulen airport much better

This has to be in the worst airport Ive ever used in the UK and across the world for treatment by security staff I know there have a job to do but well their ability to deal with passengers is shockingly bad I took my prescription medication in a separate clear bag with the labels on As I had been instructed to do at another UK airport being advised having the prescription labels matching my passport details would help the process I may as well have been trying to take liquid cannabis instead of anti inflammatory creams I was repeatedly asked for my paper prescription I can only assume the staff havent been ill for a number of years so have no idea the NHS has stopped issuing paper prescriptions its all done electronically After the minutes of interrogation with me finally getting the NHS app working to show them they were actually my prescriptions I just wondered shouldnt there be more interested that my passport maybe false if it aligned to all the details on the prescription labels on my medicine And they didnt believe a word of it More interested in a little bottle of something bigger than youre allowed Final indignation because theyd messed me around so much before the scanners I then had a full body search going through It is the last time I ever use this airport

Wow it is some years since we used our closest airport It was a shock We knew that EMA was a massive cargo hub but did not realise how much the focus on cargo has detracted from the development of passenger services To say that time has stood still would be fairly accurate The postsecurity facilities are small and desperately overcrowded Too little seating and what food and drink outlets there were were overcrowded On our return we disembarked the plane always stairs here no investment in air jetties and had to walk outside the entire length of the terminal to enter what can only be described as a holding shed From here to the four egates Three aircraft had landed in quick succession so it was all crowed and slow Walkways to car parks are rough and most passengers walked on the road as these at least were properly tarmaced I dont know if EMA is the worst and most neglected UK airport but it certainly feels like it

Ok flying out form this airport but coming back from our holiday we landed at pm what a really bad experience There were in our party of them were children it was late at night traveling back they just dont care It took us hours just to get though passport control to get to our baggage only person on passport control and he didnt care Well we never go there again

International Airport far far from it Upon arrival you are immediately greeted by a set of stairs that a chairlift would struggle to reach the top off Walking through portacabins to a large shed only to be joined by another large flight for immigration checks mins in a queue to get through the biometric machines Then into pick up luggage quick use of bathrooms a total disgrace Urinals out of order no toilet paper water on the floor Finally to Top it off You must pay to have the luxury of using their luggage trolleys Ive not seen this at any airports but Im sure Glasgow will follow on just like Prestwick have Why Tourists want to visit here is beyond me
Absolute waste of time an early flight but no meal deals or yesterdays food sold WH Smith and Boots quite happy to sell overpriced food not impressed

What an awful airport Check in never seen anything like it tiny scales and then after checking passengers have to take their luggage from the tiny check in desk and lift it onto the conveyor belt Some people were struggling and no airport staff helped them Crowded and not enough seats to accommodate passengers Chaotic and not what I expected of the beautiful country of Scotland Put me off traveling through this airport again

Arrived at Edinburgh airport to fly with Ryanair for a am flight to Alicante Chaos from start to finish We checked in at one location then had to drop bags at a different location which took minutes The queue to reach security was all the way outside and took minutes to get up the escalator When up stairs there were hundreds of people with no queue system in place where absolute chaos ensued There was a lack of staff and systems in place to ensure a smooth transition and to make sure everyone caught their flight I have never in over years of travel witnessed anything so unorganised and absolute mayhem We over heard a member of staff saying it takes minutes to get through security eventually after minutes we asked a member of staff after showing our boarding passes were we hoping to miss our final call she let us skip a bit of the queue but we still had to queue and by the time we got through the security queue the flight had closed for boarding The swissport staff stated the bus had departed to take passengers to the flight and we could not board despite the flight still waiting for take off The member of staff was not helpful and directed us to Ryanair check in which we did to be told to go to the Swissport desk who then told us to go back to Ryanair check in desk We insisted on speaking to their manager who was helpful and we then had to go back to Ryanair check in who arranged a flight the next day for pounds each My partner and I had to book an airport hotel that night this terrible experience cost over more and we lost days from our holiday My advice is avoid Edinburgh airport if possible there are too many early morning flights which they are unable to accommodate due to staffing and chaotic systems in place Shocking service and staff ranged from very helpful to incompetent and those who simply did not care and were uninterested

Edinburgh is one of the worst airports you could ever have the misfortune to use flight arrived no steps no buses to tranfer to building then wait an age for baggage to arrive its a disgrace operates like a third world country its like they are not expecting a plane to arrive an embarrassment

My husband and I arrived back at Edinburgh airport at had a transfer booked for pm thinking this would give us plenty of time to get through security checks and collect our luggage Clearly we were wrong We passed through security which is always a bit of a shambles but nevertheless we waited over an hour on our luggage so missed our transfer There were flights coming through one carousel which was not great But worst of all the baggage handlers we spoke were rude and unhelpful Swissport who were our baggage handlers basically did nothing to help Worst of all people sitting in the office doing absolutely nothing

Arrival back at Edinburgh makes me embarrassed for any tourists arriving in Scotland Ive seen better and cleaner airports in rd world countries The weird flights of stairs and narrow corridors before passport control means a huge crowd develops before you can join the queue Definitely not enough space for arrivals Passport control queue moved slowly No decent signage to say where folk with certain passports should go Ideally UK passports could be a separate queue but you get flung in with the majority of other nationals Eventually got through passport control and wanted to use the toilet Did an about turn when I saw the state of the gents cubicles and urinals is not enough for international flights arriving at the same time Especially when one urinal is overflowing with urine and of the toilets covered in urine and faeces Disgusting Tried a different bathroom after bag pickup and reversed out again as this was in a similar state Speaking of bag pickup absolute shambles international flights bags going on to conveyor Waited for ages for our suitcases Ridiculous Road out of Edinburgh is like a rd world country road Potholes from one end to the other Cannot believe this is how we welcome tourists to Scotland Avoid if possible Glasgow airport far better

A national embarrassment Arriving you go upstairs downstairs walk a dingy corridor then repeat before arriving at passport control Home office not known for being efficient but border force here are useless and miserable Far from pleasant If I was a tourist arriving and based the country on this chaos Id about turn and return to my place of origin And quickly

Absolute mayhem for departures arrivals The normal dropoffpickup zone is closed to all except the accessible meaning that the normal pickupdropoff zone was completely empty while exhausted bewildered travellers were forced to walk a maze all the way through the parkade to be greeted by a lane traffic jam behind the parkade and try to find their equally bewildered family member in that chaos There are staff everywhere in safety vests waving wands around and preventing vehicles from stopping for pickup which only exacerbates the situation Surely resources could be better employed It appears that there is some kind of construction happening but that is in my opinion no excuse My mother I have been around the world in much busier airports such as LAX and have never seen such chaos Edmonton you can do better

One of the cleanest airports but car rental returns was a nightmare Sign was car rental instead of car rental returns No directions how to enter the gate turn right press button and obtain ticket Bar will be lifted Directions to P car returns not bold enough to see No employee to receive returns I wasted minutes and barely got into the flight If you can do something to improve it will be helpful for future travellers I read similar complaints by other travellers but does not look liked any changes have happened

The majority of this airport is fine for a Canadian airport except for the baggage management system which is worse than most other place in the world Waiting for over minutes after flight arrival for bags is outrageously pathetic Dhaka in Bangladesh has less wait times for baggage It is far past the time for this airport to upgrade to a modern system

Not Verified Terrible signage Arriving late at night into the domestic terminal trying to get to the US terminal you are led first to a bank of windows You cannot get through and next you find signage taking you to a set of doors that is locked all night long No one in the airport was helpful Once you figure out how to exit the terminal and go through US security the situation gets even worse Over passengers were held in a cramped area until in the morning Finally exhausted we were allowed to proceed to our gate I probably could have designed a worse airport but it would have taken a significant amount of effort

The only way to fly out of where I live as I do monthly is to get a connection either through Edmonton or Calgary My main reason for writing this review is I cannot stress enough how horrible Calgary airport is Edmonton is well signed information of gate changes is always available The staff are almost always kind and helpful There is fooddrinks or restaurants evenly distributed throughout the airport and not a far walk to get anything I need
