My benchmark is I travel every month for work domestically within Australia and also internationally Heres why Glasgow Airport presently sucks drop off fee for private cars Length of queue and wait time at security Obvious intent and opportunistic profiteering from services thatd be free at actual world leading airports paying to weigh luggage paying for priority security queue if you were efficient enough there would be no need for anyone to pay Airport overall tired and rabbit warren like

What an absolute ripoff Why are we allowing companies to rob us like this The government or the Civil aviation authority has got to step in to stop customers from being robbed So to drop off and collect costs Who are you lot kidding This gives a customer absolutely nothing High time that people protested on their doorstop God help us if other businesses started charging their customers for being dropped off to spend money on their premises Glasgow Airport get your masks back on like robbers do Hold your heads in shame

Glasgow Airport has become nothing short of an organisation designed to part unsuspecting travellers with their money The drop off fee has again been raised to a shocking amount for what amounts to nothing at all I find the whole concept of drop off charges to be extortion What other organisation allows people to charge to deliver their customers to their door On top of all this prepare for further extortion in the bars and restaurants The Caledonian bar now charge for a pint of beer and for a dash of lemonade in your already grossly overpriced measure of spirits If going to the airport my advice would be to bring sandwiches and avoid these highway robbers altogether

Return flights from Glasgow to Verona Check in was quick as was passing through security Facilities were alright bearing in mind our flight was at am Boarding was efficient Return again was stress free other than the automated passport gate refusing to let me through Baggage was already on the carousel when through security All in all a pretty good experience

One of my party fell ill on arrival at the airport an airport attendant was absolutely fantastic she immediately got a wheelchair Helped check in luggage and seen us through check in and security and seen us on the flight safely She could not have done more

Been using Glasgow airport for decades and my experiences have been steadily declining for quite some time now The new road layout around the front of the terminal building is very poorly signposted indeed Trying to pick my way through from the motorway to my hotel it was near impossible to see any signage and was charged four pounds to drive yards through the drop off zone not stopping Felt like Id been cheated even before i got anywhere near trying to check in Inside the terminal building on the landslide its been absolutely emptied out and looks very sad dreary and like a big neglected shed these days All the restaurants and eating spots that used to be available upstairs are all gone now Downstairs theres a solitary coffee shop an MS express and a pub called the spinning Jenny that served one of the most dreadful overpriced stone cold meals that Ive endured in quite some time On the airside there were at last some more food options available but the prices were absolutely extortionate The free wifi is only available for an hour and constantly logs you out and good luck trying to grab any rest if youre waiting around or any length of time now that there is an air hockey table and super loud arcade games in one of the vacant shop spaces without any doors to block the volume Overall the experience was like visiting a shopping mall months before it goes out of business but with planes parked outside Management need to sort this shambles out

to drop someone off and another on the way back for what Grumpy staff at check in border control security gates Not enough seating am in the lounge used by Lufthansa and breakfast was over Cases lost on arrival Menzies aviation are a joke I had to go looking for them to inform them No reference number was given to me and none of my contact details were loaded onto the lost baggage site A quick call to Lufthansa sorted it the next day They received my case on the morning of the rd Jan and didnt deliver it until the afternoon of the th despite it being labelled as rushsame day delivery Menzies have gone to great lengths to prevent passengers from being able to call them No phone numbers anywhere Ill be taking this up with the CAA Ill be using Edinburgh in the future

Not going to repeat so many other negative comments that I agree with at Glasgow airport however I must raise the question again as to why the one hour only free wifi business utterly ridiculous Im now on a hour layover in Toronto and free wifi all the way all day at the airport why so tight Scotland when other airports are trying to at least offer free access while at the airport but not Glasgow shame on your stingy offer

I was diverted to this airport as my TUI flight from Florida to Newcastle could not land due to fog at Newcastle When we landed we were informed we were to be bussed to Newcastle miles away over hours After hours sitting on the plane we were informed that fog had lifted we were to fly backplane engine would not start they were sending an engineer from Glasgow to look at the problem hours later we were to to disembark into the departure lounge people after hours we were told to stand in a queue for a food voucher most people had already paid for a breakfast The queue was out of the restaurant as only people serving as My wife is in a wheelchair Im I could not stand in line for over an hour I still have my x vouchers We got back on the plane waited another hours in total at this airport then told to disembark AGAIN to be told people we to be taxied to their homes I was on this plane hours plus then a wait for a taxi then a hour trip to Newcastle The airport did not have enough seats the restaurant was overpriced almost for a small hamburger People were smoking in the Ladies toilet Staff were rude at Passport control security I feel sorry for people who have no choice but to use this airport

Im complaining about the lack of public transport to Prestwick Airport I have guests from Italy who will fly from Prestwick on Sunday th August The flight is at am Its impossible to get to the airport from Glasgow to catch their flight The only option is to catch an expensive taxi Its embarrassing and gives the impression that Scotland is a barely developed country You need to do better than this

Security staff were rude and unfriendly Went through body scanner all ok however this guy stops me before he pats me done I inform him I have a Stoma bag his attitude changes telling me not asking that I will be subject to a further search I was furious treated like a criminal he said We can search you here in full view of other passengers or in a private room he calls over his mate I was furious and embarrassed by his actions in the private room they didnt check any of my luggage another pat down a total waste of my time They didnt even explain why what they stopped me for I have used this airport many times before and other Scottish airports and never ever have I been subject to a search even before I had a Stoma bag fitted

Staying mins away I love this airport might not be many facilities but with fewer flights theres no hold ups security checks are quick and never experienced long delays Staff more than helpful maybe plan a coffee shop for late arrivals but being near to home doesnt really affect me

The girl who initially was nice to us at the information desk then proceeded to question us at the departure lounge She looked disappointed when we produced our negative results and examined them very closely Travelling right now is stressful enough without somebody who is having a bad day create more stress

Loved this airport no long queues and you get through security really fast We only went with hand luggage going to Palma so we arrived hour before the flight and this was plenty of time We normally use Glasgow airport but would definitely use Prestwick again Only wish they would do long haul flights to save us having to go to England to get around the world

In a word horrendous When you arrive with starving kids and they arent serving food at in the afternoon We were told this was due to the food arriving ie delivery brilliantly managed The only food place that side of the airport and its not serving food absolutely genius Then you go through security and the only food place has no kids options one vegetarian option and literary nothing healthy bar one said salad Expect to serve your children a bowl of chips or toast not a single vegetable Just pathetic absolutely pathetic Another restaurant is opening but what use is that to me Its an airport not a roadside cafe It also takes days to actually getting your order Never ever shall I use this poor excuse of an airport again Dont be swayed by the cheaper flights they are cheap for a reason I had to board a plane with hungry kids which has both upset and angered me

Food and drink very expensive or times what you would pay at a normal caferestaurant outside Dirty dishes left lying on empty tables Quality so so Departing was OK but arrival around am was just what was not needed after a delayed hour flight from Malaga with exhausted passengers to be met by only security persons on entry I should add at this stage that I am slightly disabled at present as I am recovering from a replacement ankle operation so have to use a stick to get around Also as my case had been damaged by Ryanair in transit I could not wheel it along so had to use a trolley to get it to Car Park As there was an excalator to get up to the bridge and over to the car park I enquired of Information how I might get my trolley to the car park They kindly showed me to a lift which took me up a floor and then along to the top of the escalator where I was met with a notice which declared trolleys no further Really helpful So from there I had to carry my suitcase over the bridge down the stairs to the station along the platform out and down the path to the car park and finally struggle to get it to my parked car by which time I was absolutely shattered a real welcome home I doubt Ill ever use Prestwick again

Airport staff is not at all supportive Plus the food is super over priced and doesnt make any any sense Only thing good is the wash rooms other than that nothing to boast about Drastic improvement needed

I had the very worst experience with the airport facilities especially the toilets They are not keeping the standards of an airport and the staff are not even bothered about the cleanliness or the basic needs inside the toilets Very worst experience ever had using an airport toilet in Goa
Large and fairly spacious airport unless theres a couple of wide bodies departing The terminal is new and smart without being stunning Good range of shops

In Goa domestic terminal the seating is inadequate at oclock in the morning lots of seating arrangement is in very poor condition and badly maintained For the kind of travellers that are passing through this terminal national image projection is very poor This is when sanitation staff a lady promptly came over to clean spilled coffee due to unbalanced chairs set Seating here is so close that your knees knock If these seats are unfit to use please have them replacedremoved Food offered from kiosk turned out to be stale chicken burger But was returned thankfully At the same time I would like to appreciate courteous behaviour of all individuals on duty

One of the worst airports I have travelled to Being a frequent traveller i have travelled to places where airports are virtually non existent but Goa Dabolim airport takes the cake The rubbish bins near the departure immigration were unclean the garbage was not cleared and there were flies all over the bin Dirty and unhygienic The international departure area had no lounge for travellers to relax and the seats were dirty The security area where scanning took place was filthy and the trays provided were dirty Its a shame that GOI is even called an airport

hours to reach gate standing painfully in different lines Entry to airport bag scan checkin immigration security check with long queues in each line and understaffed immigration and security check is very disturbing Being an Indian I feel sad with state of airport with all tourists getting agitated I doubt if any tourists will ever want to return and will recommend visiting Goa Very disturbing considering passengers have to travel in flights ranging hours to hours Please make their life bit easier

This is a cheap and nasty airport When we parked our car there is hardly enough room to open the door as there is only inches to spare between cars On one occasion I had to climb through the sunroof to get out of the car The airport is generally overcrowded and noisy In some departure lounges customers are all seated or lying on the floor Its not too bad on a quiet day but at other times there long queues even at the toilets Such a shame that such a beautiful place doesnt have a decent airport

Hopeless Faulty Air NZ kiosk out of bag tag paper No help there with Air NZ staff Over zealous customs treatment No Air con in international lounge No lounge facilities We expected Qantas code share lounge as advertised None in international lounge area Very poor for on international airport Air NZ staff need to be there before hours of departure Great week in Coolangatta Disappointed with departure

The arrival hall is not equipped for the number of people arriving You are made to line up to use the few arrival card machines Other Australian airports have multiple units placed along the arrival corridors Customs staff dont appear to be well trained and make you open your bags for things you have declared like tea bags

Free water at Domestic departures is hidden from view with no signage in a blatant tactic to extract more from the travelling public Almost the same at International departures free water exists in the furthest location possible with a small sign not visible from the terminal main area This is just evil corporate behaviour International arrival experience was poor long queues Baggage carousel at international arrivals has a design fault causing bags to fall off and create bag chaos which passengers need to fix I will avoid this airport in future
Upon my arrival at Gold Coast Airport from Bali I experienced the worst border security treatment The officer detained me forhours This airport has more officials than passengers
This airport is not capable of handling the volume of passenger traffic Waited minutes for stairs to disembark upon arrival Now upon departure the queue for security screening is metres long

Gold Coast Airport new terminal is a joke Its smaller than the old terminal I arrived on Scoot Airlines which landed at the same time as other flights Around passengers trying to clear Immigration which has enough room for about passengers I cant imagine how packed this terminal will be once more airlines start to arrive Obviously no thought was given to future growth my recommendation is go through Brisbane Airport at least you have separate lines for Australians

Attention Air NZ staff at departure processing th October Gold Coast Christchurch Air New Zealand NZ OOL CHC A B A very big thankyou to the team for getting us home My wife Pauline found she had lost her passport as we were booking in We were resigned to missing our flight but staff showed such wonderful determination and commitment in helping us through this crisis and spent such a long protracted lengthy time on the phone resolving our issue we have only the highest of praise for her and her staff Heartfelt thanks to you all from two very grateful Kiwis

Functioning but nonair conditioned air bridge to terminal Terminal building is easy to navigate and path clearly leads after heading down escalator to baggage pickup Baggage arrives after minimal waiting time of minutes Many people in terminal besides passengers and employees Mainly porters Everyone appears to know everyone else so I guess that security is not an issue Inside and outside terminal many drivers call out offering lifts in carsvans heading to Gorontalo city as airport is to hour from regional capital Fares are negotiable but is the norm Bules may pay more Toilets ATMs and lower end eating facilities as well as souvenir stalls are easily accessible Forget having a drink

STNGSE Arrived on Ryanair Single runway so only one plane can landtakeoff at a time Very compact with everything close by A very short stroll from the aircraft to the terminal where Passport Kiosks quickly processed everyone The Baggage Claim is one conveyor and there are limited toilet facilities before getting to Arrivals Hall Arrivals is midway between the Checkin Desks and the Security Scanning Outside the airport there is a taxi rank usually stocked with cars for each flight and the bus to the centre of Gothenburg Picnic tables are still outside on the grass where you can relax Security is OK and then a smallish Departure Lounge which is very busy if flights are going at similar times The Duty Free has various things but no alcohol There is a cafe selling hot and cold drinks sandwiches and similar and a small bar selling drinks There are Departure Doors of which Gate has Passport Control for nonSchengen flights NB Whilst Security is quick if there are two flights at the same time the process slows especially as most passengers travel with volumes of hand luggage that need liquids etc removed It is a good little airport and friendly in size
Why cant I use cashmoney at this airport Just want a drink and dont have a card with me but refused surely if I have money you have to accept it

The security staff are too rude In years of Gothenburg commuting I have Goosebumps every time I go through security check The ml liquid limit for women is absolutely ridiculous and exaggerated knowing you can buy tons of liquid after security check Any other country in EU does better than Landvetter Today its August and Gothenburgs airport isnt keeping up with modern flying conditions yet

I fly frequently from Landvetter and the staff is just the rudest Ive ever met at any European airport They are often unaware of international rules and Ive never experienced such a recurring combination of aggressiveness and blatant incompetence Airport staff are usually polite and helpful even at busier airports like Frankfurt or Amsterdam Im giving stars out of instead of just because the facilities are very clean and the waiting time is reasonable its a rather small airport with very little traffic Food options are limited generally unhealthy and expensive

Arriving not a bad little airport very calm and not at all manic Got through the border quickly and on to Arrivals Hall There was a delay to the delivery of the bags but an electronic sign for belt advised at wait time bags would be delivered and they were delivered at that time Vintage Volvo sitting on a plinth at belt Departing terminal was bigger than I expected and again very calm and not at all manic However to get landside there are three electric gates one for Fast Track Then there is a flight of stairs and an escalator to reach a gallery along which you walk to Security As I was leaving escalator was turned off as there were a lot of people going through at the time and there was a queue on the stairsThis was the only downside The terminal is being upgraded but this was only obvious at the Schengen gates and If you are leaving from B do not forget to got through passport control

I think everything is ok but not the baggage claim It is too long waiting for luggage When we arrive it said on the board that luggage would be there When no luggage was there at I went back to the board and it said that it was on the track it was not We waited minutes more So we landed at and was out of the building Thats too long waiting

Landvetter airport is a rather small one well organized and neat Security checks have seldom long queuing and are generally fast Lots of toilets are available very clean with taps to fillin bottles with water So do not hesitate to pass security with an empty bottle Shopping options are limited as the airport is small but the choice is more than correct This airport seems well managed

The airport was pretty good actually However the security staff were appalling My wife has Brochietisis COPD and Asthma combined with fallen metatarsals Walking is difficult and she can only manage short distances without getting breathless However she does her best to avoid using the wheelchair services for a bit of selfesteem We went to the nearest security gate and were directed to one about m further away which then required another m walk then a total of another m back to go airside Despite explaining my wifes issues the staff did not care one jot and when we asked for a supervisor they laughed Just to add interest today is my wifes birthday Made a major dint out of a brilliant holiday and ensured a very flat ending

We arrived early for our flight The queue formed and we stood for a long time A lady came over and said our whole queue should move across Apparently other people had been checking in to our flight at another desk for a long time Our queue was very slow It seemed the staff did not care
Worst airport ever Queued for absolutely ages upon arrival despite security gates being available Staff were useless and lazy Absolute joke of a place

After reading several negative reviews on this page regarding LPA Gran Canaria airport I wish to make a defence I find the airport similar to many of the Spanish airports operated by Aena in that it handles the volume of passengers proportionately and professionally Bear in mind the vast majority of passengers passing through the airport are there for leisure purposes this has always been a difficult balancing act to please the foot traffic Knowledge and preplanning are the key to success Informative information can be found online about the airport for example httpsgrancanariaairportcom is just one example Especially in this day and age with covid and the uncertainly about travel with changing restrictions it is paramount that planning ahead to provide a heads up of potential problems and issues is a must

This is the first time I have ever travelled through Gran Canaria airport and I must say its a pathetic excuse for a departure lounge They are renovating the departure lounge but I am concentrating on the area already renovated They have no idea what good service is if they think waiting minutes to be seen in Olearys Or minutes in Burger King is what travellers expect then they must live on cloud cuckoo land They have made some nice restaurants in the refurbished area but tended to plan in adequate seating Really the airport is a prime reason to never visit the Island which we wont be

What appalling service Jet had everything sorted boarding was on time but the airport had other ideas minutes wait to provide a bus to the plane and frankly we could have walked a lot faster then further delays while that bus emptied and returned as there only appeared to be one They they had the cheek to tell our pilot that as they had made us miss our slot they were pushing our flight time back by over two hours After a great deal of complaining we were told we might be able to go sooner but currently are still sat on the aeroplane with no signs of any movement We always go to Tenerife and this was a change the hotel was lovely we said we would return but now Im not sure Lots of other poor reviews on here about the airport Gran Canaria you need to do better Not to mention that you probably cost the airline many thousands with your lack of busesdrivers and we are still in danger of losing our crew if they go over time Try harder please if you want tourists to visit you Nowhere to sit either not nearly enough seating and what was there was dirty Plus way more expensive than Tenerife airport so you lost my custom there too WiFi didnt work either

Our experience at the Granada airport was absolutely horrible I am not sure if it was the airline Iberia or if it was because of the small size but the service of all of the workers were completely useless rude and incompetent Judging by the service Im assuming that Iberia gives no customer service training First of all one of us did not have a valid confirmation number although the payment went through and received a confirmation email Afterwards the attendant just sent us to a phone number which was hold and never answered So we had to go to the Spanish number but no one would help us to book a ticket or even help us call the phone When we went to the service kiosk area they left saying they had to catch the flight that we actually needed to go on In fact the flight we needed to book was not available online so we absolutely needed help from someone at the airport but did not receive help until we talked to them multiple times When we finally received help the woman was rude and saying snide comments and only was able to help minutes before This was an absolutely horrid experience particularly for a very stressful event We are very upset with the airline but also at the airport for being rude and making it a more stressful situation especially when it was not that hard of situation to fix I hope for the future that this airport will improve vastly in order to be any form of actual competence Thank god we had a native Spanish speaker within our group if we didnt we would have missed our flight and have to rebook for almost times the price

We got to the airport minutes before the scheduled departure time Despite this we were not allowed to check in our luggage in the plane because it was too late even though the plane was no more than yards away from where we were Instead of trying to help us they just ignored us and left us stranded in the airport Because of this we had to pay a rescue fee in order to be rescheduled in the next mornings flight and not missing our connection on the next day I have never seen that lack of willingness to help travellers From now on even though my final destination is Granada I will be travelling to Malaga or Sevilla airport People make a difference

GRX is a small regional airport Boarding and disembarking aircraft is usually very quick due to the limited aircraft movements Passenger facilities are limited waiting areas are small no lounges minimal eating outlets and taxis are hard to come by which is surprising for an airport However some of the nicest security screening staff that I have ever come across always smiling and patient with passengers UK and US staff can really learn something here

Granada Airport is located about km west of Granada Single runway small terminal Regular buses run into the city If you arrive late no worries as it is only a short taxi ride In recent years the number of flights have increased Mainly to Madrid and Barcelona but with also Liverpool Stansted Melilla The usual facilities for a small airport so dont expect too much

Convenient place to fly out of if they ever maintained their flight schedules My past three flight out of this airport have been cancelled When I ask why they make an excuse of weather but its not delayed the flight is flat out cancelled While all the other airports in the near area are fine DSW MDW OHare Complete waste of time no apologies no alternative provided than roll the dice and come back tomorrow Airlines used to work to get you out that day or even provide alternate airline solutions You either rebook on an app wait on a phone for hours or get sent on your way at the counter Word of advice if you actually want to get somewhere on the original day intended drive to Chicago or Detroit

Flown into this airport times in the last months always a issue getting a arrival gate getting the ground crew to show up and then getting your luggage under minutes after arrival A joke for this size airport Management should be embarrassed Time for some changes

Terrible management of remodelling and onproperty shuttles Ive traveled through numerous airports small to large some under construction others remodelled The remodelling of GRRs interior is taking years and is painful to navigate and claim luggage there are carousels for all the airlines and flights Further there is no room for all the passengers who have no clue where ones bags are coming With regard to the parking shuttle there was too little capacity As I knew there were more people waiting for the shuttle than its capacity I started walking to the economy lot I made it before the shuttle which I only saw arriving in the lot as I was leaving The people are nice though

August was my first time using this airport and I will never use it again Security staff is hands down the worst I have ever had the displeasure of dealing with The most misserable people I have ever met in my life with a goal of ruining your day I will never use this airport again just because of them Huge inflated egos with a badge Avoid this place at all costs trust me

Friendly little airport which stinks of burned toast from a bagel vendor They really ought to get the vendor to install a ventilator hood The faux jazz piped in everywhere is also a poor choice The CNN monitors are loud but not as bad as some Ive been here a while because of the lousy service and rigid rules of Delta Airlines so this is a wellconsidered review

Living in South Florida and used to departing from and connecting through massive airports GRR was a breeze Now the new parkingbuilding is fully functional and beautiful it is all in a natural colour of brown The checkin area itself is nothing to admire and very basic Than you walkup to a shortramp and there you are Steps away from all the terminals This area does have a small foodcourts with the basic pizzaburger fare It also has floortoceiling windows bringing in plenty of natural light GRR had a major problem its airfare were outrageously expensive even the discounted ones However after lowcost Allegiant started servicing Grand Rapids tickets prices dropped dramatically even last minute ones This can only bring more business to West Michigan

GRZ is a small but efficient and welcoming airport served from the UK by RYR Arrival was quick and departure pleasant made more so by an excellent meal in the upstairs landside restaurant Nice views from there and further upstairs and unusually these days is a waving area One thing lets the facility down a little There is a nearby station but train times are incidental no real connections and we thought the station was badly signposted ditto coming back where you just had to guess where the walking route was

Had an ok trip using Binghamton Regional Airport flew from Binghamton to Las Vegas with one layover in Philadelphia The morning started off rough with a half hour delay to Philadelphia and when we did finally board the plane the grounds crew had to deice the aircrafts wings taking another minutes this is the one April when it was very cold Had a rough flight to Philadelphia on a Dhc turboprop however the flight attendant was kind enough to announce all departures in the next minutes of course Las Vegas being one of them and asked if the passengers would let the people with earliest departures to be let off first By the time we got off the plane and into the main terminal there was only minutes left and we had to make it to terminal c from terminal f which is a long hike We were told that we would be better off not taking the bus over to the other terminal so my family of four being young children had to run halfway across the airport Making it to the terminal in a half hour we were sure we missed our flight however my business company planned the flight and notified the staff that passengers would be arriving late and they held the plane for us The plane to Las Vegas was a and it is particularly long and of course our seats were in the back so we had all eyes on us as we walked to the back The flight to Las Vegas was quick and we are very happy with us airways but not with Philadelphia or Binghamton airports as Philadelphia is not easy to transfer terminals and the half hour delay in Binghamton could have been used to deice the plane saving time

This is my home airport Upon arrival I was pleasantly surprised I had the entire security checkpoint to myself no other passengers This was incredibly lucky on my part There are no VIP or First class lounges here Rochester is a place people arrive at or depart from there are virtually no layovers here This is not an overly busy airport Taxi times are short and the runway never gets stacked up I heartily endorse the Red Osiers Prime Rib Sandwiches shop airside too The only drawback in my opinion is a dearth of ground transportation options taxi rent a car or RTS bus RTS busses dont run very often and travel through one of the worst neighborhoods in the city on their way downtown
Worst ever TSA took minutes to get trough such a small airport TSA workers just standing around talking and laughing thats what we pay for Shame on TSA at Greenville GSP

It was my first time flying with rambunctious toddlers One of my granddaughters had her own seat the youngest would be on my lap Long story short l forgot to obtain a boarding pass for the month old and was unable to get through the busy security checkpoint TSA agent saw my distress and stepped in with a wheelchair ride for the girls and escorted me back to ticketing Had it not been for this agent I would have missed my flight I cannot thank her enough

I fly weekly for business and flew in and out of GreenvilleSpartanburg for the last quarter of and a bit of Its a small airport with only one runway and one long concourse with arbitrary A and B separation The major airlines serve GSP but flights are limited I mostly flew on American which only seems to connect via Charlotte an mile flight First being so close to a major hub like CLT caused almost weekly delays as my flight was often held on the tarmac by CLT airtraffic control so we could fit into the traffic pattern I never actually missed my connections in Charlotte but did have several walkjogs across the airport to reach my gate while the final groups were boarding But GSP itself is nicely maintained with superfriendly staff They offered TSA PreCheck when I flew in and out I got to know the Avis rentalcar staff by name and theyd give me free upgrades Best of all if you use GSP you have to order a tuna melt from the snack counter on the lower level outside security They mix the tuna salad from scratch in front of you and make the besttasting tuna melt Ive ever eaten

GreenvilleSpartanburg GSP is a regional airport in northwestern South Carolina It gets its international name from its customs clearance facility for air freight to serve the foreign companies with operations in the region it has no international passenger flight although its foot runway could handle them Greenville SC has become one of the most dynamic small cities in the US and the airport is finally upgrading to reflect this change of status Immediate inconvenience comes from a major construction project to upgrade facilities Boarding areas are comfortable even though services are fairly basic Baggage claim is very convenient Outside pickup and dropoff areas are being improved but can be somewhat cramped at present The biggest limitation is security which is totally inadequate during construction and features no TSA PreCheck

This is not the worst airport Ive seen in my life and I have seen many Its your worst nightmare coming true When we landed on time wed to wait minutes for parking slot But that was just a beginning Next Saturday people were waiting in hour queques to luggagecheckin desks Moreover there is just ONE desk for skis OFC with separate another h long queque In the airport for skiers Complete chaos checkins and security control still in progress for passengers that were supposed to fly home more than h ago Add absolutely amateurlame but friendly personnel endless boarding passID controls stopped counting after th Israelis could really learn from them and or toilets for entire airport for complete picture Never again experience avoid at ALL COSTS Fly to Lyon or Geneva additional time to get to the resorts is definitely cheaper than loss of mental health in this pitiful place

Absolutely horrendous from start to finish Delays I can handle and are not the airports problem generally however the chaos on check in and baggage drop etc was unfathomable Tannoy announcements telling travellers to be at gate now when everyone is standing in a check in queue was not great neither oversized baggage needs a separate system not an aisle in the middle of all the check in aisles Horrendous experience however I feel that things will it change Cheese in duty free was good hence the score

Hundreds of people shut outside the airport in the freezing cold not allowed to enter due to overcrowding Inside it is everyone for themselves people everywhere chaos at check in desks Baggage belts not working staff scrambling over desks Out on the runway passengers walking all over the place no concerns for security or safety by staff Horrendous experience The time you might save by flying here compared to Geneva is not enough to warrant setting foot in this airport Dont do it

This airport is the most disorganised of any that I have flown from Some small investments in barriers to organise passengers at check in could make a massive difference There is a general lack of guidance by the supervisors to transit passengers through the airport Whilst the transfer to Geneva is an hour longer if you are going to experience close to a minute delay I would say its a better investment of time Rather disappointing given the proximity to the ski resorts

My travel through Grenoble airport operated by Vinci was the worst experience in all my many years of travelling Having checked the reviews after using Grenoble as a route to the Alps in February I see it continues to get the same bad reviews as six years ago I suspect injuries would be highly likely in an emergency situation due to overcrowding We were standing for more than hours to get through security Vinci have to have passengers standing because otherwise they would have spend money to more than double the size of the departure terminal There is literally not enough floor space to allow passengers to sit down for the flights they schedule through the airport on Saturdays

Astoundingly incompetently run airport seriously too many passengers for this small airport to cope with literally teetering on the edge of falling apart if one more thing goes wrong or a couple of staff go sick No info on booking in screens why not should be an easy fix so they have extra staff to try and organise this section minute wait Long queues to Departure Lounge people where again they employ extra staff to pull out passengers in danger of missing their flight as they spend so much time queueing hour wait Long queues to get through Xray security minute wait insufficient staffmachines all this leads to no time in the departure loungeduty free before you are again moved through to the gate where you are packed in tight and where there is yet another minute delay

The worst airport ever I had to fly from Grenoble Airport because my flight from Lyon Airport was cancelled and this was the only option available going back to Gatwick at the same date due to French workers strike action I carried snow chains for my car because I drove in the French Alps at high above m where according to French government you have to have winter tires or snow chains for your car I carried my snow chains because the rental car company didnt provide winter tires and the snow chains for days was extra I took my own snow chains I had no problem taking them in my hand bag from Gatwick going through Lyon Airport arriving in France Neither UK border on departure nor British Airways had any problems with me carrying them in my hand luggage because they are only kg weight and fit into my back pack However upon departure from Grenoble very rude lady at security check confiscated the snow chains with the argument that she doesnt allow these on board also she stated that Grenoble airport doesnt allow snow chains too When I asked to show me proof where this was stated and I showed my previous tickets that I flew with them in my back pack she said if I dont sign the paper that they are confiscating the chains I will not fly she took my passport and my phone with my boarding pass When I asked for her batch number and name and her supervisor too so I can complain I was refused the information
The absolute worst airport in history So poorly run Any other airport I have travelled through is better by a huge margin Any of the other local airports are OK just avoid Grenoble

Nice little country airport with well caredfor gardens Interestingly busy place with Regional Express flights dominating Checkin rather odd with no checkin allowed until minutes before departure No wonder lessfrequent flyers get confused when faced with checkin for other airlines and airports closing minutes before departrue eg Jetstar and here we have an airport not allowing any checkin at all until minutes before departure Makes for an interesting rush of people Pleasant terminal spoilt by a television blaring away in one corner making it difficult to get some work done Good car rental facilities but beware on driving out of Griffith Airport around dusk watch for big kangaroos in abundance on the airport access road

This is the only airport that I have come across that does not allow bicycle helmets though security I got turned back from security because of my bicycle helmet a large crowd gathered to try and help me but the security people had a piece of paper saying no motorcycle helmets and had never seen a bicycle helmet before I am going to actively try and get this changed as checking my bicycle helmet is not an option for me This airport does not seem to take feedback This airport does not seem to want to improve their service
Not friendly or helpful at the front desk and unorganized They were not helpful when the Volaris airline cancelled our flight and pretty much told us to deal with it on our own

I hope to never have to arrive or depart from this airport The staff is beyond rude It seems as if they were corrupted as well They send you to the military people to get checked and they charge you extra money If you ask questions they lead you wrong on purpose Not one outlet is available there was puddles of water in various places gates are far and the whole place is over packed

The staff at this airport are always in a bad mood to begin with When it comes to doing their job as informative employees they failed immensely I was ignored multiple times when asking where to find a fill out form The employees there treat people so badly My mother flew in from LAX minutes after I did and was yelled at for not knowing what form to fill out on the way out It was her first time traveling and my sister had just passed Instead of being treated with kindness and helpfulness she was yelled at These employees are always rude unhelpful and honestly dont know how to do their job Please enforce a training for better customer service or hire people that know how to treat people with respect I would rate a but unfortunately I cannot

I went through security and explained I had a disability and I needed to go through the priority lane The lady refused to allow me access As such I had a major meltdown and anxiety attack at security Shame on your staff

Overall I find Guadalajara Airport to be quite user friendly with helpful staff a decent variety of restaurants cafes and shops Security lines are usually efficient and quick Terminals clean and plenty of seating space Several airline lounges and affordable ground transportation options to the city center and nearby areas One of the easiest Mexican airports to navigate

GDL seems to have completed the main phase of its cosmetic renovations but still lacks some of the structural improvements to provide more spacious checkin counters space in the waiting lounge and more jet bridges Latest development witnessed many international flights still on the tarmac awaiting pax to arrive via caterpillarlike buses Simply unacceptable for Mexicos second largest city and third most enplaned airport in the country

Wonderful experience they saved me from missing my flight I was traveling with my family in China and this airport was my second transit trough this country My first encounter was with Chongqing airport which was significantly worse because my flight was unexpectedly cancelled and they just barely managed to book another one I still had a little time but I was worried if I could make it in time With just minutes left I rushed to find my check in and when this amazing staff found out how little time I had they literally enscorted me and my family to my gate They were communicating with walkie talkies so we were being preferred throughout the way to catch our flight The most pleasant staff ever I will be forever thankful
Worst service I have ever encountered in an airport talked to me like Im a criminal when I have done nothing wrong For an international airport in a supposedly tier city totally unacceptable

If you are Chinese this airport is adequate Any other nationality forget it Ridiculous necessity to scan a health declaration form the majority of this form is in Chinese Also when entering a new country its unlikely people have internet on their phone to do so The few assistants available only speak Chinese A lot of the free WiFi stations do not work the ones that do work have very confusing instructions Will never fly through China again
It is clean modern and spacious There are many restaurants and shops Passengers would not be bored during the waiting time Employees are friendly and helpful Signposts are clear

Guangzhou Baiyun Airport is the most impressive airport for me The ground staff of China Southern Airlines are very warm and have a good attitude This aspect is much better than many domestic airports Since I booked the hotel next to the boarding gate I needed to get the ticket to pass the security check and customs one day in advance The staff of China Southern Airlines helped me to coordinate with the customs and security check departments and finally I checked into the airport transfer hotel successfully

I have used both terminals recently and compared to some other airports in Asia and China this is overall a much better airport That being said I dont agree with some of the reviews here and I definitely dont mind to be at this airport This airport can easily be reached by subway And even for a minute ride to the city the cost is only The waiting area at the gate is spacious with enough seats provided some areas at the new terminal even have massage chairs free of charge You do need to have a Wechat account though to make use of this free service Toilets are clean and you wont have issues finding one Immigration procedure never took me more than minutes arriving or departing This cannot be said about some other airports in China The other good thing when flying with China Southern Airlines is the quick checkin procedure It never took me more than minutes So if there are reviews here for long queues at the checkin counters it is most likely due to the lack of staff of that particular airline For instance dont expect a quick checkin when flying with AirAsia The only minor things of this airport are the security staff and lack of western food options Security staff can be really intimidating rude and superior They dont speak English well and they dont have the need to explain something If they cannot read the specs on your power bank they will confiscate it without explanation They expect you to speak Chinese and not the other way around so much for an international airport However if these are the only cons I wont hesitate making use of this airport
One of the least efficient airports ever Security check is a joke everywhere you have to wait for hours We almost missed our plane as arriving hours before departure wasnt enough

Small airport with few services Long enough customs procedures and passport control if you land late in the evening when there is little staff on duty However it offers a good free wifi service also available outside the airside

Full body scanner was implemented and opting out for an alternative search is not an option I fully dislike being exposed to technology from which we have no real idea of the consequences especially since I was not aware of these kind of controls taking place

mins WIFI free then you have to buy Wow rd world country indeed Gate waiting chairs benches are hard as rock Have the seat dividers so you cant lay down Loud Speaker announcements are totally notunderstandable Duty free is delivered on gangway not given to you when you purchase Was impressed to see food venues open early early AM Selections in Duty Free fairly limited Other mostly touristy knickknack so so

I was interested to read a couple of other reviews of Guatemala airport mentioning that random items had been confiscated at security as this was also my experience and it marred an otherwise positive impression After Xray scanning a guard asked to search my bag and I cooperated fully He pulled out my small nail file and a pair of safety scissors with cm roundended blades and confiscated both items He then added insult to injury by smiling and saying Is OK as he dropped them through the slot Im an experienced traveller and both of the items that were taken had been through numerous other security checks on many previous occasions including in countries with reputations for being especially strict The episode left me and my partner feeling irritated and grumpy as it was so unnecessary I would never have any problem at all with established security rules being enforced but La Aurora should ensure that individual officers arent confiscating peoples belongings on the basis of arbitrary and unfounded personal decisions

This is the only airport where I encountered street vendors positioning themselves outside the terminal building hustling passengers with trinkets and snacks Departure from this airport was far from trouble free There were numerous passport checks along the way at the entrance to the terminal at check in naturally prior to entering the departure hall at passport control naturally at security check and on my way to the departure gate I was stopped by a policeman who demanded to see my passport He ran his fingers over the pages of my passport and then asked how much money I had This unusual request unnerved me so I asked him why he needed to know how much money I had with me He relented and returned the passport to me Then at the departure gate a further passport check and the emptying of all hand luggage for a thorough check including the lining of the case I was glad to leave the airport

Guayaquil airport is one of the best around The building is modern very functional and easy The staff who work there always are profesional and the most important thing is that you always has a feeling of been safe

We took a TAME flight to Baltra Galpagos Checkin was very easy with very short queues and very clear instructions given how to get to your gate For the Galpagos Islands you are required to go through a host of quarantine checks and you are required to pay US per person to receive a certificate Without such a certicate you will be unable to board nor will you be allowed past the passport control at Baltra The airport terminal is very organised and gates are well spaced Great airport Also when arriving in Baltra you are required to pay an additional entry fee of US

Ive flown through this airport several times this year and generally consider it a fairly basic simple nofrills experience Its close to the business areas of Guayaquil and normally transit through migration security etc is quick and painless Not however yesterday the queue for the exit control and security snaked halfway down the terminal building Even allowing hours to pass the controls was not enough time to reach my gate before the plane left This is utterly unacceptable the management company needs to get its act together and provide efficient passenger handling
Good airport nice shops and the seating is comfortable great restaurants very respectful staff and flights always on time

Guayaquils airport has most of the services that we have here in Australia they even offer jetways into planes There are restaurants ATMs machines banks coffee shops and entertainment it passed our expectations without doubt

This airport is small Very small Arrivals is small and cramped Departures is similarly small and cramped Departures is dominated by a way overpriced duty free shop at one end and at the other is a small eatery In between is a small seating area and toilets I had planned on arriving at the airport a couple of hours before my flight and am glad I didnt because there is literally nothing to do So if you are using this airport my advice is to arrive with just enough time to check in and avoid the duty free shop

I am a resident of Alderney and use Guernsey airport on a regular basis The customer service provided by GS security staff is non existent Every opportunity to make your journey swift and courteous whilst carrying out these very important duties seemed totally irrelevant to the staff on duty today I was travelling with my mother in law who was in a wheelchair after having surgery The amount of undressing and unpacking of hand baggage was totally unacceptable After extra body searches with an ever increasing queue of people I retrieved our belongings and started to re pack and get dressed Unfortunately my mother in law had left some small liquid bottles in her bag Understandably the items had to be checked I apologised but was met with a stern look and rather than rescanning the bag had it completely emptied and re searched I was not alone This was happening to many others flights were departing at the same time in an otherwise empty airport There was no urgency or friendliness Someone near me said that they felt very intimidated and like they were in Russia Whilst I have no problem with tight security checks I do have a problem with the lack of customer service This is a consistent problem whilst leaving Guernsey I dread going through every time Why is it such a problem Youre innocent until proven guilty unless travelling through Guernsey airport In my opinion the worst experience of anywhere that I have travelled through I am retired BA cabin crew In this review I put no I wouldnt recommend this airport but thats such a shame because service throughout the Island is fantastic and no way reflects the island of Guernsey
Lost my phone at Guernsey airport and the security staff on that day pulled out all the stops to get it back for me so grateful a wonder team Everything else ran like clockwork

Had minutes at Guernsey airport before sending off my better half Went to the upstairs bar for a farewell pint Only person serving but queue only deep No urgency clearly and over minutes later eventually served to be told that there was no beer No effort to rectify the fraught beer supply either Inflated prices inflated waiting times deflated staffing with deflated service

The Airport is really small and the departures lounge is small and unintuitive The weird door thing doesnt do anything as you could board any plane once out there Past security the duty free shop is small and is not a world duty free There is no WHSmith or Starbucks in the terminal Otherwise extremely good service

Guilin airport is not as big as I thought for the number of passengers the shopping places are limited and I could hardly find a decent cafe here Crowded terminal obviously cannot cope with the number of travelers The goods offered in shops are expensive and water is not provided anywhere as any other airports do

Previous comments on GPT are no longer true Often GPT is cheaper that New Orleans or any other nearby airport The presence of AirTran keeps fares very reasonable and service is pretty good in all directions The new terminal to be completed this year will be beautiful

The airport is small clean and convineent however very expensive To fly into or out of this airport makes no sense with the outrageous prices Better prices available from MSY an hours drive away from the west andor MOB an hours drive from the east Note this information is prior to Hurricane Katrina and may not be accurate at the moment but if and when normal operations resume this information will serve similar to preKatrina GPT

Through Goiania on a trip from Sao Paolo Small regional airport with surprisingly high number of flights on what appear to be only domestic routes Arrivals experience good walked from plane to terminal and out within minutes of leaving the plane On departure very straightforward I would recommend not going airside until necessary there are no facilities at all apart from one snack bar insufficient seating and very crowded as in fact the whole place was Easy to find a taxi There are plenty of cashpoints as well but these are outside the terminal on the kerbside road Also a small viewing gallery upstairs

The international terminal of Haikou Airport is a very spacious terminal I have ever seen The terminal is small and dedicated The staff of VIP room help me to carry the language when I arrived and welcome me before I check in and keep me company all the way to the lounge There is a beautiful tropical garden in the terminal The staff in the airport is professional and dedicated I want to thank them for treating me so well

Haikou Airport is not too bad but the toilet facilities are a bit dirty They do not provide toilet paper on the toilets so youll need to get some paper from the paper towel supply next to the toilets Checkin gates dont seem to be crowded at all When I got to security I thought it would take quite long but it had been really fast minutes to scan my hand luggage After security there is a cafe bar located before you enter onto the terminal Now this is where it gets hectic You simply cannot breathe while youre trying to capture a picture of a plane on the tarmac The people just smoke and smoke and basically you could just see everyone smoking in the bar When I approach the toilets in the waiting hall I see them as third class squat toilets They are so dirty and no one seems to clean them with detergent This is what is hectic for foreigners but I am Chinese so I would understand this The waiting hall showing departures do not have English read on them so you have to understand a bit of Chinese to get through the airport as efficiently as you can

A small modern gate airport Smiling and timely checkin security and boarding Pleasant airy shared lounge with good Mongolian and other ethnic items reasonably priced Ours was the only plane at the airport let alone scheduled to fly around midday but all shops and facilities were fully open and staffed Only criticism is the lack of a bar which I would prefer to for example the bridal wear store

Hakodate airport is fairly small but the building is modernised with only two floors Before the security gate on the second floor a small shopping arcade selling mainly Japanese goods Like all Japanese domestic airports Hakodate is well organised clean and efficient It caters mainly for passengers travelling with ANA and JAL two of the major Japanese airlines and Do airline a subsidiary of ANA If you are staying in the downtown area there is direct airport bus from JAL hotel the Grand hotel and the Hokodate train station to the airport The bus fare is yens and it takes only minutes
Nova Scotia is known for its friendly service But not at this Airport or at least not with Swoop Airline Hard to pay for a walker for a Child with a disabilities an extra dollars
A decidedly mediocre airport Winnipeg and Quebec City are similar in size but are far advanced in terms of services on offer design and overall experience What happened in Halifax Depressing and sad

The airport is lovely and everything went smoothly for our arrival from Glasgow Security and customs went quick and luggage transfer was seamless However there needs to be regulations put on businesses on the other side of security that are selling products for outrageous prices The cheapest bottles of water I could find cost me They were ml size Everything in this store was ridiculously priced Food items way overpriced Talk about gouging tourists that have little options for items to take on the plane Airports should take responsibility for this happening everywhere We came from Scotland and Ireland and thought it was bad in those airports But here in Canada we witnessed worse

Why does security screening not separate travellers with connections going to USA and huge families travelling on charters Stuck behind hundreds of families and just about miss my flight Easily able to queue travellers not on charters people for am flights and customs doesnt open til am Very bad planning and execution

The CheckIn area was nice however it wasnt easy finding the Passenger Screening area The way we found it was by the long lineup into the food court Passenger Screening was extremely slow and we waited in line forever When we got in there they only had out of lines open Im not sure what the point of having all of those lines is for if youre not going to open them I think its crazy that it takes people to man one line When we got up to departures the shopping was all cheap junk no fancy stores or even nice stores We didnt find any restaurants either just coffee and wraps etc We were leaving from gate and there was literally no seating in the area The other end of the airport was nice with lots of seating but the end near our gate seemed older and had minimal seating We also had a tough time finding any seats with power in them All of the ones we tried didnt work Overall the place looked junky dated and crammed Nowhere near a world class airport The outdoors looked very nice But get inside and its a different story

Very small but friendly efficient airport Not a great deal to do and not many shops particularly airside but staff are always remarkably friendly and helpful which makes a change from most other airports I visit
This is my second time in Qatar and the eGate is not working properly The immigration lane is frustrating it took hours just to reach the counter

Flying from Cape Town to Dublin to attend a conference and later return to Chicago from there I was looking forward to my first chance to check out Hamad Doha Airport Qatar Airways was fine except we arrived late in Doha We had to take a crowded bus to the terminal and it took over a half hour There were traffic jams on the tarmac I then had to run a long way through jammed concourses and just made my connection to Dublin On the way I saw crowds of people a bunch of luxury stores and chain eateries and some trees and plantings in one area Color me unimpressed
Love this airport but can someone explain the logic of having to throw water away that has just been given on an incoming flight Doesnt make sense

No storage lockers actually there are but disabled due to health and safety concerns There is no option to leave your backpack or cabin luggage if you want to hop for quick tour of the city due to long layover Food venues are poor in variety of choice and amount of places eg coffee and pastries are everywhere same no variety Quiet places are next to the family place so you have a toddler with temper tantrums next to you while trying to take nap or sleep Good Onsite gym with treadmill and pool But not available Power sockets are made to be compatible with every plug so you dont need adapters Something every other airport should follow

Doha Airport has gone from ok to unacceptable since its opening in While bus gate arrivalsdepartures were the exception then it has become too frequent in recent years I am flying through Doha about times a year more than half of my flights in were remote bus transfers The departures via bus gate are particularly stressful with very limited seating unorganized boarding and stressed gate agents The picture shows my latest bus gate departure with crowded areas and inadequate seating

Transit in this airport both inbound and outbound The transit time of hours was not enough to experience this enormoussized airport with a lot of offerings and facilities such shopping mall indoor gardens etc Not the best airport if one is just transferring from one flight to another because it takes time and energy to find toilets prayer rooms and gates But the best for long transit as you will not get bored This airport lacks free shower facilities

Hamburg airport security lane on departure experience was not what one expects from a German airport Staff incredibly rude and unfriendly We were flying business class on Lufthansa and were asked to remove all creams and liquids from the cabin bag We had packed these items as required in the plastic sleeved cover but they removed an after shave lotion and a hand cream as they didnt fit exactly into the bag This was the most unpleasant customer experience at any airport What makes this even more annoying is that the adjoining security lanes were fitted with newer CT scanners which do NOT require airline passengers to remove items from their cabin bag This newer technology should be operating at all their lanes and would have saved us this unecessary delay and the very rude staff Australia has this newer CT scan technology already installed at airports which allows for an enhanced customer experience Until Hamburg airport upgrades avoid this place

Often hourlong lines for security and it never fails that one or more members of staff are rude The airport is quite small and easy to navigate but the impolite staff makes travelling through here an unpleasant experience

We took the train to the airport went smoothly Its easy to orientate in the airport Check in was done in a few minutes Next was security very long lines must be many passengers that loose their flights Since we were a family travelling with a child we got a special family line Not very many in front of us but the line moved very slowly forward Some of the security points were closed The security made a big number of controlling the stroller they even contacted the police that wished us a nice trip Much time used This maybe explain part of the very long lines Inside we walked and walked and walked until we reached the gate With cold wind and rain it was not nice to wait to board out on the tarmac

Arrived in Hamburg en route to Edinburgh from Istanbul Expected renowned German efficiency and a smooth transit through airport for final flight home Complete mayhem with a near miss disaster ensued instead On arrival all passengers were funnelled along corridor and down a narrow staircaseescalator combo Unknowingly this was directly into a narrow glass lined corridor with an abrupt disgorgement into passport control This resulted in a sudden crush at bottom of escalator as there was already a crowd along corridor Thankfully a quick thinking passenger hit the emergency button on the escalator which prevented a much more serious crush In addition the glass lined corridor was hot due to setting sun and overcrowding There were passport control personnel It took around an hour to move through passport control with no staff available to explain the situation or ease the overcrowding Total shambles Once through passport control another blockage occurred at security Absolute shambles with people skipping to the front due to connecting flight departures Queues were closed and merged several times due to malfunctioning conveyor belts and overcrowding Tempers were frayed Luckily we had just enough time to make our flight but as someone with a spinal issue due to terminal cancer attempting to run to departure gate was stress I couldve done without Absolutely shocking and indeed dangerously laid out and disorganised airport Never again

Everything BGardner of the UK on June th and David Cormier US on June th said is absolutely exact We traveled on June th we got to the airport in Hamburg at am for a flight to London on British Airways After spending hour and minutes to check our luggage at the BA counter we had Echeckedin the day before we then got in the securitycheck line which snaked and a half times the length and width of the airport One and a half hours later we finally cleared security Half the security check points were closed The other half was staffed by rude and overzealous Kleenex needed to be removed from pockets personnel who gave the impression of being on a work to rule campaign and did not care that many customers were now about to miss their flights There were no airport personnel to assist through all of this I have travelled millions of miles in my life and have never experienced anything this bad As far as I am concerned I will never set foot in this airport again

Been flying through LBC several times with destinations such as Dublin and London Stansted I have encountered only once uncomfortable experience with Ryanair flight to Dublin being delayed for almost hours Thanks to the Eu new regulation I received a voucher for a small meal at the LBC restaurant LBC is easily accessible from Hamburg City with the direct bus service The airport condition improved somehow A new duty free zone has been up and provides wide selection of goods especially perfumes Unfortunately it is located in the departure hall just behind the security control

Ive flown to and from HamburgLbeck with Ryanair on many occasions Skavsta and Stansted and as long as you know what youre getting yourself into when you book its fine This is a very much a basic flatpack airport but the bus to Hamburg takes about an hour for a pop and deposits you right next to the main railway station so frankly especially as Ryanair airports go its perfectly reasonable If something goes wrong and youre stranded here all day then naturally youll start to tear your hair out after a while but occasional expansions and temporary chipboard flooring aside its hard to argue with the place when youre paying beer money for your flight

Travelling recently from Lbeck on a Ryanair service to Stansted was a pleasant surprise This small regional airport placed in a residential suburb south of Lbeck had five checkin counters open for one departure the staff even smiled regularly and the new temporary departure lounge is roomy The walk to the aircraft isnt long so Stansted is beaten in every category
Nice small airport Close convenient parking Super fast customs on arrival Unfortunately the baggage process was extremely slow It took minutes to get my suitcase

I am a year old girl and this is my first time using this airport as well as flying anywhere by myself I arrived and got confused on where to go for my luggage I asked a security guard for help and he was honestly the rudest person I have ever met He sounded so annoyed that he had to tell me where to go instead of listening to me he got mad at me and wouldnt let me speak and began to yell at me Flying by yourself for the first time is hard enough without the airport personnel making it even harder

Hamilton International is a great little airport and very convenient for people trying to avoid the hustle and bustle of Pearson My family is located in southern Ontario and I always use this airport The only complaint I would have is the decision of management to serve no alcoholic beverages

Very convenient to reach from anywhere I would call it a no frills airport If this airport is to compete as an International airport it has to invest money in renovation and updating of the building In general I am thankful for the close proximity of this airport

Very nice alternative to using Toronto Limited flight destinations but check in for domestic and intl flights is simple Security clearance on departure and arrival is a breeze Parking is a short walk Not much by way of services in the terminal but you also do not need to arrive hrs prior to a flight There are no gates so be prepared to walk to your plane via the tarmac

We were flying home on July from Hamilton Island Our flight was with Virgin As it was pouring rain we noticed at the airport did not have any cover at all As we noticed Qantas was parked very close to the entry not that far of a walk but still no cover at all for passengers Very disappointed that every single passenger was saturated getting on to the plane Virgin did not park close it parked far away Very disappointed wont be back

It is a new and clean airport However regardless of long queue there were only officials for immigration procedure and I waited for minutes What was worse is that when I was shopping in the Hangzhou speciality shop one clerk followed me without giving me advices even blocking my way I felt I was treated like a thief Very bad experience

Arrived from Chengdu and the collection of luggage was straight forward and simple although it was quite a hike from the gate we arrived at However only after I walked out of the terminal to the various buses that I found out that you needed to buy a ticket inside the terminal Counter had no English signage and I walked passed it because it was displaying train schedules

Pretty basic as airports go Way out of town it is simply ridiculous and taxis are well keep your belt on and wear a helmet if you have one The airport sort of works but this is a typical domestic Chinese airport not great not entirely hideous but you know what If you want to fly to Hangzhou its this or nothing I can tell you it is heaven compared to the central rail station
Toilet cleanliness is awful This new airport could have been better than the old military airbase however it still has long way to go I will give it a star or no star

Airport uses a lot of natural light The design is modern especially the departure lobby the ceiling its so high The staff in the airport have good manners The luggage arrived quick and theres plenty of checkin counters too The bad thing airline lounges terrible

On Sunday th of March returning on the BA flight to Heathrow we had gone through passport control and security Also passengers for a Turkish arrive were also waiting at the gate when there was an announcement from the Police that there was a security breach and everyone needed to go back to out and wait and again come through security and passport control There was chaos as those who had bought duty free had to go back and get their purchases sealed There were no announcements in English so we had to ask people what was going on Apparently the crew of the Turkish Airlines had gone through without border and security checks Delays and confusion were not helped by only having two convey belts used as we all had to go back through security once the all clear was given No formal apologies No suggestions of compensation from an airport error Not a good experience

Once again I review my home airport Its now the third time in a row that I arrived by train and the escalator from intermediate floor to departure terminal was out of use As I am used to it I know alternative ways but for guests which are new it is not so easy This should be really improved as it is an absolute no go This time check in and passing security was fast However I recommend everybody to pass security as late as possible as behind security check there is actually nothing other than a small duty free an expensive snack bar toilets and a small smoking box Overall I dont like the departure area however arrival is usually quite good average time from leaving the aircraft to get out of airport for Schengen flights is mins only

I live in Hannover and use this airport quiet frequently Despite its small size which should make it hassle free every time there is something which annoys me Either the lift and escalator to the train station is not working or there are long queues in front of security the WIFI is not working properly or the power plugs dont provide power Up to now I have never flown from here without a problem Arrival procedure is very good luggage usually comes within minutes Food and beverage is ok for a relative small airport Parking a car near the terminal is overpriced for short term from second day its almost same price then for a week Airport is easy to reach by train but it would be even better if the lift or escalator would work

It used to be a nice small airport Easy lay out and everything is close Lots of parking is available and a good variety of shops That means the airport should get a good review But there is also the human part and there is something completely wrong None of the staff at Hannover smile Instead you look into grumpy faces We wanted to have something at one of the bars We took our seat and waited for the bar tender He looked at us and gave the order that we have to come around to his cashier That was done in such a manner that we left I do not expect the security stuff to always be smiling but is it too much just to give a short good morning after they have greeted the passenger

Do not land here if you are nonEU and in transit The airport is designed such that if you are an international transit passenger you have to enter Germany before checking in to a connecting flight despite the fact that it is with the same airline and the connection is only minutes This means you need a visa for Germany even if you have no intention of entering the country No other airport I have ever been do you need to get a visa just for being in transit

We were charged for two fresh coconuts at the Vietnam Gift Shops next to Departures This chiseling ripoff is four to fivetimes the price these cost in cafes in the city We only paid it because our attention was elsewhere at the time Beware these obscene costs

Was in transit from Saigon to Hanoi arriving from International and connection to Domestic The simple word is Chaos immigration is slow unorganized and crazy slow Keep at least hours for safe transit between flights While arriving from Cambodia at Hanoi airport just going pass security it took more then minutes and finally reaching gate just nick of time Completely unorganised lack of space and very slow process

Arrival fine but departure was another story Chaotic and long security lines made for a frustrating experience The other problem I found with Hanoi Airport was the inadequate air conditioning especially airside Vietnam is a hot and humid country surely the airport authority must realize this

The airport was shining new and clean with clear signs and directions both in Vietnamese and English The international departure was smooth though queuing time for immigration and security screening was a bit long due to the jam in the morning Not many dutyfree shopping compared to some other international airports in SEA Dining was expensive seemed the restaurant was trying to make money from tourists Boarding gate was good with a lot of seats Toilet was clean
