Theyre not accepting eboarding pass and i have to go to the counter to print the pass however the counter only can print my ticket hours before the flight time There are no self check in kiosk and its very inconvenience the airport staff also not friendly and not helpful

This is the most annoying airport Ive been to The shops all sell the same rubbish the staff arent at all interested and all the prices are in US dollars Thats like going to Heathrow and all the prices being in Vietnamese Dong I understand that goods might show a conversion but to just have dollars is irritating And the wifi is rubbish

Harbin airport has two terminals domestic and international This airport is a bit old the government is building a new terminal Toilets not very clean and facilities are old Wifi is acceptable beside the airport wifi you can also access to your carriers wifi spot on the airport You have to queue for a long time for checkin unless you dont have any checked baggage and your airline has auto check in kiosk Harbin is a hub city for China Southern so China Southern occupied half of the entire counters However there is a special check in counter and security check path for flights to Beijing Harbin airport only has baggage claims so during the rush hour you have to wait for a long time for your baggage come out

Despite of being the main international hub of Somaliland Hargeisa Egal International Airport is small and pleasantly old fashioned Arrival was uncomplicated and baggage delivery fast You can buy your local sim card right in front of the only baggage delivery belt For departing passengers there is one waiting room with optional openair seating which is only separated from the apron by a decorated fence Security and immigration are housed in a newer building on the landside There is one coffee outlet a small souvenir shop and two departure gates which are simply different seating areas on the first floor For boarding everybody then walks out onto the apron through the same door All staff including the immigration and security officers were extremely friendly and courteous

Bradley is my home airport I fly from and to here multiple times a year to visit friends and family While it isnt as big as the New York airports or Boston fares are usually among the cheapest in southern New England and southeastern New York and BDL provides service to all major eastern hubs such as Atlanta Detroit Cincinnati Charlotte Minneapolis ChicagoORD Washington Philly and Baltimore as well as numerous Florida destinations Las Vegas Denver Toronto Montreal Cleveland Raleigh San Juan Cancun and starting later this year LA and Dublin Ireland Concessions are ample and security is usually manageable in under thirty except some mornings I nearly always fly Delta and their service out of BDL has been fantastic Flights to Salt Lake City Seattle San Francisco and Nashville would be ideal additions

Flew through BDL last week I like the new set of security lanes open on the US Airways side of the terminals No line at am despite a dozen flights departing around am The new arrivalsdeparturesgates boards are easier to read However there doesnt seem to be one power port in the US Airways gates even though theres wifi

Im a Connecticut resident and use Bradley a halfdozen times a year Terminal A is perfectly serviceable nothing fancy but it does the trick Luckily most carriers use it Terminal B which I understand will be closed at the end of cannot be demolished fast enough It is an eyesore with next to no services I guess its only advantage is for people who wonder what air travel used to be like in the s and s They can see firsthand in Terminal B I wish BDL had service to longer haul hubs like DEN and SLC but I guess there isnt enough demand Nonetheless Im perfectly happy using the airport Its smaller size means fewer delays quicker deplaning and some breathing room

BDL is my hometown airport I found plenty of kiosks for checkin at US Airways and went through security quickly On the airside at US Airways gates very limited options in terms of stores and restaurants and the good shopsrestaurants are at the other side of the terminal Upon return finding luggage is easy and the pickup for valet lots is fast the amenities are limited but the airport is streamlined and easy to use I prefer BDL plus connection to a direct flight from BOS or JFK anytime

As a lifelong Connecticut resident I am ashamed at our one major airport but then I should remember this is small potatoes compared to Boston New York Atlanta Charlotte The new terminal is clean and bright and a huge improvement over the old provided you are flying airlines that use it Security seems totally confused and amateur compared to other airports and after checking in you simply deposit your checked luggage in a heap manned by security staff who seem distracted and uninterested in what you are doing Worst of all is upon return it takes far too long to get your baggage On a recent calm winter night wed all deplaned a Delta flight and it took about minutes before any luggage began to appear at the carousels About bags came out and then there was another minute wait for bags and then on and on You can generally plan on waiting at least minutes to get your bag at this small airport This performance is inexcusable

A small Airport Everything you need is present But be warned Just outside the arrival hall when leaving the building there is a table with people selling bustaxi tickets It seems that this is an official booth We got ripped off We were not brought to the place we asked and checked several times and in the end had to pay more then the double So please be warned The airport should do something to this

Used this airport in Dec It was a small regional storey level airport level was the dep and arrival hall while level was the boarding area On the arrival hall there were immigration counters all counters were opened for the Tiger Airways flight from Singapore Private taxis were available and it cost about B to the town area No fast food outlet in this airport only restaurants in the arrival area Security was tight all luggage had to be screened upon entry to the terminal Once past immigration theres only a small vat refund counter and small shop in the boarding area The boarding area has gates for the domestic while was used for the international flights There was no aerobridge available for gate passengers hence has to use flight of stairs to level and walk about m to the aircraft Facilities were limited however the airport was clean and staff were friendly
Regional airport not that busy Efficient checkin Services pretty basic but everything works Newer TG Business Lounge very nice
Hatay HTY I flew into Hatay last year for my daughters wedding celebration airport was small but adequate and staff were helpful

Although a new airport Hatay Antakya is a seriously disappointing and inadequate experience The terminal building is the size of an average suburban house meaning it is woefully illequipped to handle the two daily flights it receives The sole baggage belt in the Arrivals room is about m long and when people deplane the queue to get at the belt is about people deep The one person they appear to have employed to handle baggage means at least mins wait for bags from a plane a mere meters away Stepping out of this tiny reclaim area and finding yourself literally in the car park is a good indication of how minimal this airport is Cannot comment on the departures side but presume this is equally as small The link road to the main highway is still unpaved Bizarre

Worst airport I have been through When we arrived it took over hours to get through mainly getting our luggage When we departed there was only one security line working and the queue soon built to hundreds of people When we finally got through to the airside we wanted some food as we had left our hotel at am before breakfast was served The only food available was a disgusting hot dog in a dried out stale bread roll No food was available on on our flight so we had to have a hot dog each Awful The only drinks available were beer Fanta and water We had a bottle of water each So hot dogs and waters were US I was hoping to use the last of my Cuban pesos but no only hard currency accepted airside So the Cuban pesos will go in the rubbish There were cafes airside but all served the same menu I realise Cuba is a developing country but if they want to attract tourists its not the way to do it They need to let private enterprise operate at the airport No toilet paper in the toilets either

Upon arriving at Jose Marti the passport control queues were fairly short but the baggage claim area was awful no air conditioning and hundreds of passengers in a very small area You couldnt see your bag on the carousel and had to ask others to pass the bag to you The arrivals hall is very busy and that creates a slightly uncomfortable atmosphere though there are lots of police officers around the ATMs Getting a taxi is very easy On departure everything in the airport moves at a very slow pace passport control had quite long queues and I was fortunate in that I was able to go through the premium desk There is one VERY small cafe in the departure lounge that serves ham and cheese sandwiches ice cream and soft beverages bring something with you There is very limited seating so try and find a spot quickly If you have any CUC left over you can buy some cigars and rum but be prepared to wait FOREVER in the queue The gates are extremely close together so my flight to London was next to KLMs flight to Amsterdam in a very tight corner they need to make more space in the terminal Overall its not an airport I would recommend but I would go through it again out of necessity

We had a stopover in Havana coming back to London from the Bahamas When we landed in Havanas we simply could not believe what we saw The airport itself looked like some kind of a warehouse Inside the airport was very dark that made you feel very uncomfortable The immigration officers were very unpleasant At customs you simply did not know what to do There was no information available how to navigate and where to go next Outside the airport was even worse it felt like we went back in time to There was no information how to catch the connecting flight We only learned from the taxi driver that the international departure terminal was miles away When we arrived there things were not much better There no any bars or restaurants no space to seat no information desk The departure lounge had one so called fast food counter serving burned soggy chips undercooked burger and thats it Overall it was an amazing experience for all the bad reasons

Very small old fashioned terminal nothing wrong with that as check in was a breeze All luggage checked and weighed together then put onto a trolley No computers everything written out including boarding cards Once checked in usual hand luggage screening and off into the small departure lounge Rows of plastic seat along with a few little shops selling the usual goodies from Myanmar and snacks A very good caf with great coffees and teas Usual badge so the staff know which flight you are on All very relaxed and you can watch the flights taking off and landing Toilets worth a miss

Travelled in and out of this Burmese provincial airport early last year arriving from Mandalay and leaving to Rangoon Pretty basic but it was OK and really belonged to another age of flying This because you could wander out onto the runway between planes arriving there werent many and if you wished you could go to your hold luggage which was stacked on a trolley awaiting the planes arrival and put things in or take things out of it Many of the Burmese passengers availed themselves of this facility as our plane was an hour late arriving When its light appeared in the sky on its approach an airport official suggested we all go back into the terminal so we did An airport still in an age of innocence with no apparent need for security of any kind

Very quiet and peaceful airport well equipped with benches places to sit and even lie down It is not a large airport so the catering facilities with shops are small but sufficient Very nicely designed areas where you can sit and experience Finnish nature For the first time I see an airport where you can relax physically and mentally It is also a bit cold it perfectly reflects the climate of Finland It does not heat up excessively and there is a delicate chorus which can be annoying at first but after some time you get used to it

Transferred from a flight from Tokyo All passengers had to reenter security by design which is annoying in itself but the real issue is how this was handled Security was lightly staffed and very thorough which created long wait times But the biggest issue was the personnel and system which was extremely inefficient and especially at some lines From when I placed the bag on the belt to when I could leave with my luggage it took more than minutes and only with standard checks A record by far Would have missed my flight if the time between flights wasnt so long Terrible experience

Swanky new recliner seats around Gate but only if you are under foot or over foot tall At the headrest was painfully positioned forcing my chin onto my chest Shame because everything else is brilliant

One of the worst airports in terms of the security check Super inefficient in terms of checking the luggage and it takes forever to wait for your turn If you have any connection flight avoid this airport at all cost

What an aggressive experience at this airport First we had a transfer many people had transfers They were very understaffed for the kind of luggage control they did From all the bags was controlled for really tiny little things and very precise bag by bag many people were missing their flights They were very unfriendly and unresponsive to their over exaggerated research To have in mind people already were checkt or times I had to throw my sons toy away because it could be a weapon I asked them if they were serious and yes that is exactly why I was checking again because me and my son are dangerous They said we could harm people I was flabbergasted with what do we exactly harm people with a wooden catapult with paper wraps Wow Helsinki Im very surprised by this Thought you are a kind country But this is just crazy and unwelcoming

Seems like theres constant issue with luggage Long wait times almost always much longer than many European airports I visit frequently Cannot be shortage of staff anymore that excuse was valid a year ago Probably savings driven

Unbelievably bad air conditioning barely works Terribly dirty toilets almost of all flights delayed mine included Few and tiny information boards and no place to sit insufficient seats We had to stand for hours Apologies to all the airport staff who are making the best of it

Worst airport Ive ever encountered Chaotic far far too hot and overcrowded No air con anywhere Not enough seating area and everywhere is crammed full of people The toilets are absolutely disgusting I dont think they have been cleaned since last year No locks on doors cubicles filthy id rather cross my legs than use their disgraceful toilets Its a truly awful stressful experience from start to finish I will not be flying to Crete again because i just cant bear it its far too unpleasant an experience for me

Firstly very small overcrowded crammed and compact airport Secondly the toilets are diabolical smell of urine filled the area and worse Thirdly shops Poor food gifts tasteless We purchased Baklava for friends Plastic tasting advised friends not to eat once tasted myself not anywhere near what we experienced while visiting the beautiful island Fourthly not enough seating

We spent hours in Saint Lucia after our flight was delayed The airport staff was incredibly incompetent dont care and straight up lied to us at times Theres dirty visqueen literally just stapled to the ceiling The food is mediocre at best very limited and incredibly expensive The outside looks like its been to war Theres no where to plug your phone The WiFi is slower than a snail They put passengers in hotels that had no running water and blood on the sheets Then gave us food vouchers that wouldnt even purchase a full meal We spent on Chex mix and sodas No smoking area and denied exit after hours sitting around

This review relates to Hewanorra the main international airport of St Lucia not the smaller George F L Charles Airport in Castries which serves regional caribbean routes Hewanorra is a relatively small airport with no air bridges Arrivals Hall looked old and tired but was at least air conditioned All immigration desks were operational and the queue moved quickly Bags were already waiting by the time I cleared immigration Customs were very attentive regularly challenging passengers and opening quite a lot of bags Porters moved like lightning to pick up and carry bags once through customs for which they will expect to be tipped whether you asked for their help or not Coming back check in area was relatively uncrowded and well organised Once through security the departures hall is small crowded and outdated Several rather tacky duty free and gift shops are available There is a First Class lounge which while basic by the standards of major airports is quiet and comfortable in comparison to the departures hall if you have access Not a great airport but its the only choice

Hilo Airport does the job Large area of unused terminal but the part we used was OK Travelled with carryon only so cant comment on baggage Went in and out with no fuss TSA preapproved Not much in the way of shopping but not many people about to shop Sat and had a qiuet drink whilst waiting for our flight no rush Its a bit outdated but as I said does what its supposed to

Its been a few years since this airport has been reviewed so heres an update There is no cellphone waiting area when youre picking up passengers and the security people are very quick to ask you to move The last time I picked up a friend I stopped to call him to tell him I was there using a phone while driving is a ticketable offense in Hawaii and the security woman would not stop talking in my window at me to move while I made the quick call There was almost zero traffic at this time so I was not impeding others from loadingunloading The TSA security is unprofessional to a level Ive not seen at any other airport Ive been to I have heard them conversing loudly about the contents of passengers bags on numerous occasions The decor is extremely dated and the seats are very uncomfortable and of course there are very limited outlets There is a bar but I would not visit it The airport in general is uncomfortable smelly and unclean People keep reviewing it as having short wait times but I dont think thats right considering the small amount of traffic at this airport

The airport is huge with only of nearly dozen gates being used The rest of the airport is roped off Its a long walk from the gate to the baggage claim Baggage arrives promptly since there is only one flight in and out at a time Not sure about dining options or shopping Rental cars are right outside the terminal At this airport youll realize how small a town Hilo is compared to Honolulu

Hilo International Airport was once THE airport on the Big island before Kona International Airport on the other side of the island opened in the ss Now Hilo Airport is a shadow of its former self with jetways no more than of which are in use at any given time The decor is kitschy s Hawaiiana and the terminal is warm and welcoming Hilo is one of the few US airports where the gate area and the ticketingbag claim are in separate buildings separated by an atrium The ticketingbag claim area has a bar a bookshop a souvenir shop selling Hawaiiana and packaged tropical fruit and a lounge area The gate building has no facilities The parking and car rental areas are just across the street from bag claim and the total walk from gate to kerb is only a few hundred feet Access to and from Hilo town is easy and traffic is usually light

Despite being a small airport it has jetways Decor is a bit dated think Honolulu but on a much smaller scale but its clean and in good repair Large common waiting area Onsite car rental and return is really convenient In common with other Hawaii airports TSA personnel seem to have a stricter interpretation of the rules than their mainland counterparts All passengers were made to remove shoes including sandals and flipflops when I wasnt required to do so a week before at LAX

ITO is absolutely lovely I flew in HNLITO and out ITOOGG Outdoor type airport and probably the most easytouse airport I have ever had the pleasure of using Very tropical theme Car rentals are right across the street from curbside pickup Checking in is very easy for those using Island Air There is a restaurant in the middle that gets very busy during breakfast so get there early if you dont want to stand in a line that goes out the door

Hiroshima Airport is a small domestic airport and international services at this airport have only been commenced recently so I do not have a high expectation upon my visit in midNovember The airport is small and there are only limited facilities and restaurants available and they charge JPY for people who wish to visit the observation decka down side compared to the major airports in Japan where the observation decks are free of charge Access to the airport is not at all convenient as no trains or subway lines can reach the airport The only choices are limousine buses and rental cars from other cities Nevertheless the airport is very clean and the ground staff both immigration and airline staff are efficient It took me shorter than minutes from disembarking the aircraft to leaving the airport The limited number of restaurants can also provide a satisfactory range of food choices for visitors Given that Hiroshima Airport is only a small regional airport the airport has met my expectations and I would not hesitate in using this airport again upon my next travel to Japan

Hiroshimas airport is somewhat small but is intelligently laid out and easy to navigate Perhaps because of its relative newness it appears to be quite pristine inside with a good range of services for travellers The biggest drawback is the distance from Hiroshima city well over a half hour outside of the city As another reviewer noted the IBEX flight requires walking out onto the tarmac which could be a hassle in inclement weather

I live in Hiroshima and regularly use Hiroshima Airport to fly to Tokyo Narita on my way to Europe This IBEX flight leaves quite early and I usually travel by taxi from Hiroshima Checkin and security checks are always very smooth but an annoying problem with the IBEX flight to Narita is that the plane is too small to use the normal gates So we use Gate A walk down the stairs and across the apron to board the plane Umbrellas are supplied on rainy days I would use Hiroshima Airport more frequently when travelling to central Tokyo but I think that the plane still cannot beat the Shinkansen for this distance just over kilometers It is a pain to have to travel out to the airport kilometers from Hiroshima undergo the checkin and security check board the flight and then have to travel from Haneda to central Tokyo The journey via JR is only marginally longer and involves far less hassle Nevertheless as a regional airport Hiroshima is very good

The line up was so long after a long flight No water fountain at the airport customs have their most arrogant faces on not welcoming atmosphere that you should treat the tourists Also the locals keep pushing you and try to butt in lines Honestly Vietnam is a beautiful country hopefully the government will do something to improve the experiences overall

I sure hope you never misplace your luggage at this airport or with Vietjet because lost property will keep your luggage and not return it until you agree to an ultimatum It doesnt matter if you have medication in your suitcase which you need to survive they will not return your suitcase Luckily i knew someone who was going through this airport and was able to collect it in person
No one checked our vaccination upon entry which raises alarm bells Jetstar staff as usual are incredibly rude and money grabbing The facilities are cute and basic

The business constantly overcharge a PayPass fee even when you tell them you are going to insert your card they will automatically charge the extra amount Very dodgy Hobart airport especially during covid when contactless payments should be free

The food and beverage selections are appalling For a state that has some amazing wineries and craft breweries there are no options to purchase any of these great things at the airport Come on promote and celebrate the amazing tourist potential of this state rather than sell bland mass produced selections Also this must be worse airport in Australia to charge your devices there must be only powerpoints hidden in really obscure places Very disappointed with this airport

I think the airport itself is absolutely fine but the food choices are absolutely appalling if you are traveling after We had a delay and a hour wait and all that was available was one cafe selling pizza pasta and toasted sandwiches which were exhorbitantly expensive and not very nice There was no fresh food and no choice A disappointing end to an absolutely brilliant day road trip around that lovely state

Flew in and out and had no problems despite the fact the airport is partly under reconstruction On arrival our plane parked close to the terminal and bags soon arrived on the single very small belt Car Hire has moved across the road and is a short walk away Plenty of buses and taxis were there to meet passengers Departure checkin was quick the lounge has enough seats for flights and there are adequate cafes and shops to keep most people content This is a small rural airport which works well and gives a flying experience like it used to be in the old days

Ive only flown into Hobart once and out of Tasmania via Launceston so my comments will be limited to the arrival side Virgin Blue passengers now get to use a baggage carousel basically a long conveyor belt however the baggage pickup area is very small and quickly became crowded even though my Virgin Blue flight wasnt very full It was rainy when I arrived so I wasnt too keen on the lack of jetways but it did allow my flight to empty quite quickly as we had the use of two doors I like Hobarts onsite car rental unlike Launceston but the separate rental car terminal shared by several companies was very small and was too quite crowded

We have travelled to this airport three times now in three years There have been no upgrades in that time We realize this is an airport in a third world country but couldnt they at least keep the bathrooms clean We know that you must access this airport in order to get to the resorts an hour away Long lines filthy bathrooms on the main level and little choice in duty free other than alcohol and cigars Tips Use the bathrooms and snack area on the second level fewer people and cleaner facilities The honey is cheap and good in duty free we always bring back lots for friends and relatives Limited food choice at the snack bar so you may want to bring something from the resort to eat before flying out or eat at the resort snack bar

This airport is getting busier and busier as more international flights come and go dailybut the facilities are not enough to handle the high volume of passengers As a result one has to stay in the queue for a long period of time for everythingimmigration checkin security check up luggage pickup

On arrival at the airport three hours in advance of the flight time I went inside and immediately noticed two things Incredibly long lines for check in and an unbearable smell I waited in line for one hour and twelve minutes to check in and headed for the washrooms Every flush in the terminal was full to overflowing and there was no water with to flush or even wash ones hands Disgusting On arrival at the booth to pay my departure taxall I had were a peso note and a peso note I gave these to the man at the desk and he took themput them somewhere under the counter and folded his arms and refused to look at me againI got no change I went to the cadeca to change my remaining pesos to Canadian and I received cdn On questioning the lady she screeched no changeno coin I am totally disgusted with this airport I loved my stay in Cubabut my experience at Holguin will in all probability keep me from returning

The national terminal used this time for a flight to Havana unexpectedly via Cayo Coco with Aerocaribbean Everything as before but two tips for travellers I had purchased my ticket in Havana earlier in the week it was en eticket and so I was surprised at the delay minutes at check in whilst the official went to a back office and wrote out a paper ticket I queried this and was told that the worldwide disappearance of paper tickets had not yet taken effect in Holguin In the departure lounge was a small counter selling drinks and basic refreshments it accepts only CUP Cuban pesos the national currency as opposed to the CUC convertible peso Therefore foreign travellers returning to Havana on an internal flight requiring refreshments need to obtain some CUP in advance of their flight I would not recommend unofficial currency exchange with fellow Cuban passengers within the departure lounge

Holguin is a small airport not used to more than movements a day so when things go wrong they simply dont have the staff to sort out the problems I experienced delays in both my inbound and outbound flights so I got to see a lot of the airport Immigration is a major hold up since they are very thorough at checking and have few staff I went through the gates times and each time spent over an hour in the queue The departure lounge is small but with plenty of seating and an excellent view of the apron and runways from the observation balcony upstairs There are a few shops and a money exchange kiosk that changes money at the exact rate ie it doesnt charge commission There are two bars serving food and drink but this being Cuba the food selection is limited I was there for days and all they had was cheese and ham rolls for the entire time Overall its a pleasant enough place for normal transfers but you wouldnt want to spend a lot of time there Expect to get wet if its raining as the covered airstairs the busses and the terminal building all leak during heavy downpours

I highly appreciated how clean the airport was and gave points to its clear signs and directions as well as fast WiFi and FB services Immigration both Arrival and Departure however was a disaster and a big shame to the airport management team At the Arrival a very long line of tired passengers was patiently waiting for the slow staff to complete their inefficient processes Took me an hour to go through the immigration The staff who handled my documents was super slow kept checking and asking even though I showed him everything flight ticket hotel reservation tour reservation and even told him it was not my first time to Hong Kong He even checked the other visas and stamps in my passport slowly one by one Same as the Departure those who could not use the echannel had to queue and wait hopelessly Staff suddenly stopped checking passport he walked out of his cabin for minutes and then came back and we needed to wait Not deserved a star airport quality at all

I noticed my cell phone was missing going thru security They directed me to the Airport assistance Desk behind Gate I pleaded with the lady there to have someone visit the plane and retrieve my phone from the pouch under the tray She immediately called her colleague and gave her my arrival gate Cathay Pacific Flight my connecting flight and gate leaving in a few hours time I walked to my departure gate and my phone was waiting for me Great service thank you

Very clean and big airport Nice facilities Good open space Lots of shops and restaurants and fast food services including MDS and KFC All of it was pretty much airside The queue in Security wasnt that bad Nice airport and a lot of air conditioning
Excellent hardware but the signs to transfer gate are unclear The gate security staff were rude
Shocking to find no city check in services provided both in TST and Central All city counters closed and I cannot find any online information to advise passengers accordingly

I do not understand how people claim this is a top tier airport I found the staff to be very rude and abrupt with voyagers on arrival immigration officer was nice to me but I saw them being very nasty towards certain nationalities The lavatories are filthy and no staff near to be found The signals on the old part of the airport are actually better than the ones on the new terminal which can be confusing to say the least Prices are the same as in town but I found the airport express to be a little bit expensive considering the distance Check in staff seem not to know what they are doing and have to be calling their supervisor constantly it leads to huge and slow lines After this experience I can attest there are so much better airports in Asia and Southeast Asia

First time ever in Pacific Islands working for two months in Honiara I had several trips to and from the airport collecting and dropping off our staff K Joseph has summed up Henderson International extremely well You walk from the plane to the terminal its less than metres Queue on arrival was not too bad and luggage was available fairly quickly Plenty of trolleys but note that they are all kept by the baggage carousel Be warned though that if youre bringing in any equipment for work I had a couple of computer monitors with me you will get stopped by Customs and charged a refundable import bond only took ten minutes to get the refund when departing If you need a trolley when departing the simplest thing is to walk straight through the open security door where you came out on arrival across the Customs area and grab a trolley nobody will stop you most of the time theres nobody there TO stop you Most departure days are nightmarish the plane for Brisbane leaves at pm and you really do need to be in the queue by Although we had a couple of flights where it only took ten minutes to get people checked in the average was at least an hour an a half The day we returned home it was over two hours One advantage of the airport being only minutes from the centre of town is that its possible to check in really early and then go back to your office or hotel until after pm The only thing to make waiting at the airport bearable is the quality of the milkshakes the best in town and at SBD about NZ its no more expensive than anywhere else in Honiara The toilets dont always flush and the taps on the handbasins didnt work so use those facilities elsewhere if you can

The staff at the airport were by far the worst I have ever experienced The airline staff made a mistake with my bday so with my ticket could not go through check in after waiting in line When rushing back from the ticket counter with the right ticket there were only min left from the final call so I asked the queuing staff if they could help me both of them answered with cold voice and poker face NO After finally getting to the front of the line by asking favors from passengers I told the lady who did my security check that I was terribly late Shes like thats why you need to get here earlier I explained to her that airplane made a mistake and this was my second time thought the security line She said with a big smile looks like not only you were not able to get in the last time you are not going to get in this time either You are going to miss your flight And she said in a way as if shes super happy that this happened to me This is beyond bad service it felt very inhumane After all what type of human with basic integrity would dosay things like this to a months pregnant women whos worried sick

TSA security screening area is in desperate need of improvement Took an hour for us to be processed No air conditioning or decent fan system The single huge fan was pointed directly at agent sitting on his butt not the dozens of sweltering passengers Possibly not enough tsa agents Because the dog is here according to agent everyone was given precheck We paid for that convenience apparently for nothing Also we travel through HNL frequently a transferring between mainland and inter island flights is confusing and time consuming No matter how many times we do it

I found this airport very confusing When we got off from the plane there is no sign for us to take that shuttle and nobody was available for us to ask In the airport no clear signs for where to get food The only Elevator signs are outside of gates and nowhere to be found inside Oh man Tell me about how annoying it is running around with a child Plus no free wifi after mins It is ridiculous

By far one of the worst airports I have ever had to endure All be it there are signs of improvement being made The security area is pathetic Very crowded with no AC and total chaos I described the checkin area as a giant parkade and that still holds true Very dark open area The food court consists of kiosks with the eating are just outside Birds flying all over the place and eating from the tables left uncleaned We have been through this airport since the early s and have seen it grow over the years Maybe it is time for a complete refit

Think again before flying into Honolulu If you have a connecting flight thats over hours waiting Be prepared to sleep outside the airport on concrete while you wait with people around for security to allow back into terminal Apparently social distancing isnt a think anymore

I am disappointed to say that I think Hobby perhaps the whole Houston Airport system has quite a problem with luggage cart rental I was traveling on Monday evening with my daughter and grandson from Denver to Houston While on vacation my daughter injured herself and was wheelchair bound When we arrived at Houston Hobby baggage claim where I needed to rent a cart to retrieve luggage and get her to the handicapped pickup place while getting my year old grandson to move along with us easily I swiped my credit card and was unable to get the cart loose so I swiped again and got the cart and was charged twice I am now trying to get a refund on the second charge and am unable to get through on the email address they provide Then I tried making a complaint As I did so I marked complaint on the format they provided to contact them It kept deleting my phone number so their system would not accept the complaint I decided to check compliment where it promptly took my request for a refund What has happened to the Houston Airport system It should not be difficult to contact the right person for a mistake

Travel to West Texas from South Texas to visit grandkids times a year Seems like I always have hours to wait either way I am going So I am always looking for a relaxing place to sit I have noticed on this trip that some of my favorite places to eat are no longer here What a pity The sit down food available at the present time is extremely poor over priced there is always a wait to be seated even seating for one If you choose the fast food options there are long lines then no place to sit to eat Why must the city of Houston rip travelers off by charging outrageous prices for food that is barely a step above fast food Also more of variety of food offered would be nice
I miss the Pappas restaurants in Hobby Good food selection and reasonable airport price The replacement food service is double the price I will not be a customer

Dont often fly into Hobby but in rare cases its a better option Not to thrilled with the airlines youre pretty much stuck with Southwest Was looking forward to eating at Pappasitos but guess the city kicked them out And the day of my departure most of the restaurants were closed Not fun because I arrived hours early Even though I can expense my dinner I decided to just wait till I get to my destination Ill fly into Houston twice more in the next two months and will continue to use IAH as there are many more options
Where are the healthy food options in this airport Ridiculous that the only options are donuts and fast food This is People want healthier options

The enforcement of the mask mandate at this airport is a joke While waiting at gate there were six passengers not wearing masks and several people walking the concourse without out masks including one SW airline employee

The security check line is always confusing you will be taken through a weird zigzag line then end up in one line Then an angry employee will yell at everyone there are two lines So people move over other customers get upset because there was no indication that there are two lines and they get cut in front of Then once you are in line to get searched the employees yell something sarcastic or mean about changing lines dont look at me funny I only work here Then you will end up changing lines again for the actual security check All the while the employees treat you with anger like its the customers fault that it is so unorganized If the lines were more odvious like all of the other airports in the US the customers and employees would be much happier

Never ending construction now including Terminal B with closed lobby So E C B checking in at C and no doubt it was busy Took Skytrain to B but there the so called grab and go United club was closed This never ending detour traffic jam inconvenience is exhausting B construction will take til late and shouldnt E be open by now It will take decades to get some decent reputation back from travellers Maybe tell travelers when the misery might end

TSA Pre Departed from Terminal D and was hoping for short lines at security for TSABusiness Class The extra line was going around the other lines and took minutes even when sign stating minutes for the regular line The place was packed and TSA pre kinda closed I got a pink sign to be labeled TSA pre If i recall correctly the plan is to close D Lobbysecurity completely in the summer of How can a packed D security checkpoint close and also Terminal B Lobby and checkpoint closed till late go all through E Is this another IAH mishap waiting to happen in this endless construction misery

International arrivals and immigration here is a debacle Mid morning weekday arrival from SYD min walk to a packed immigration hall Both US and foreign queues were hundreds of people long I counted out of gates open for the visitorvisa holder queue and it took minutes to get through Multiple passengers with connections tried in vain to get assistance from uncaring staff Add the time it takes to collect and recheck bags and then reenter security for a domestic connecting flight and you will need a minimum of hours to ensure that you and your bags make it

Terminals C and E are beautiful shopping centers with attached gate doors Seating and the inevitable waiting areas are lacking badly Designed to sell food and merchandise to travelers but not to accommodate their travel experience Disappointing manipulation from the expenditure of so much money for improvements

The best new area D is worthless when you cant get out of the Airport The good experience we had arriving at DA was way overshadowed by the traffic mess Still gridlock going to and from this Sunday Dec st Took us an hour to get out coming from C Garage The E Intl pick up was still blocking lanes When will this end This situation makes passengers hate IAH for generations I hope I can recommend IAH again when this endless construction at E has ended then the B construction will still go on

My original flight had been cancelled and I was diverted to Washington on a later flight connecting to Houston I had missed the connecting flight and ended up spending the night at Washington airport waiting for the earliest flight outbound to my final destination Upon arrival at Houston IAH I was at that point very tired and frustrated with being inconvenienced at spending a night in the airport freezing cold I ended up in terminal C baggage seeking to claim my suitcase which i eventually found At this point my phone battery had died and had no inkling where I was to meet my mother for pickup Now despondent and mustve been noticeable as I was approached by a very nice and polite member of staff from the baggage claim This lady greeted me giving her first name as Cat After explaining my plight to Cat she not only took it upon herself to contact my mother on her mobile unfortunately I received no response at that time and Cat called the number back leaving a voicemail explaining the situation and to contact me Cat also let me use her battery pack charger to charge my phone while I waited for my mother to respond I would like to say a big thank you to Cat I believe there is only one known that works there Thank you for taking the time to help me out and seeking solution to what ended up as a positive outcome I was eventually picked up Cat you were on that day of distress and still are an angel of saving grace today Houston management you have a good employee representing you and compassionate with her job Employees who looks after the airport customer going above and beyond for others should also be looked after with recognition of their true worth to your operations All the best Cat in Terminal C neither will I forget that date

The staff was relatively pleasant in most places but not all The Starbucks staff were awful Bathrooms were less than desirable To get through TSA Precheck I had to go to opposite side of terminal couldnt go through appropriate side and then had to walk all the way around again and hopefully catch up with the rest of my traveling party Although wait in TSA line was minimal definitely a huge minus

Hua Hin airport offers a direct connection to the resort city of Hua Hin and the surrounding towns of Prachuap and Cha Am and saves the visitor the relative hassle of a and half hour bus ride from BKK airport and a similar time from DMK Don Meuang Bangkoks other airport Especially if you are coming from Malaysia The only airline currently operating a service into Hua Hin is Air Asia God bless them from Kuala Lumpur to Hua Hin The route has been a success and rumour has it that other routes will open up from Hua Hin ideally Chiang Mai to begin with OK to the airport review Its a relatively simple regional airport With checkin counters a small snack counter and adequate seating in the checkin area You go upstairs by escalator to passport control security and then the departure lounge again with adequate seating and a bathroom There is plenty of car parking by the airport and about metres out of the main gate is a Family Mart like a which sells snacks To get in to Hua Hin you can catch a taxi or walk out the gate and catch a Green songtao baht to town then another baht if going on in the direction of Market Village and Khao Takiab One of the pleasures of using the Air Asia service is that as the plane pulls away from the terminal building the ground staff wave you goodbye Thai gesture of respect its a nice touch Anyway many thanks to Hua Hin airport and Air Asia for making this route a reality

We live close to Humberside and find it very convenient for onward connections from Amsterdam Because it is so small check in and security are quick and easy On arrival back at Humberside we were off the plane and had or case in mins It would be a terrible shame if it was forced out by the opposition It is much less stressful than Manchester

This airport is vastly improved since the previous comment Ideally situated for the catchment area south of the Humber After nightmare journeys just getting to Manchester Aiport my visits to NZ are now via Humberside and Amsterdam Minimum fuss no crowding a relaxed start to a lengthy trip Additional package flights are now offered and the Amsterdam hub is a definite plus There used to be a direct link to LHR with Air UK but this was discontinued before the demise of the airline and never revived Although not essential could be useful on occasion Landing costs I believe

Very basic airport handling mostly summer charter fights but also year round KLM scheduled to AMS which is a boon if you want to avoid LON or other UK airports Really quick and relaxed for both departures and arrivals Really quite under used has a small shop a restaurant a travel agency a couple of kiosks and quite expensive parking No public transportation

This is my home airport and I fly inout of it times a year Good facilities that are being improved only gates so endtoend in the terminal is about minutes walk baggage service is fair to adequate and security lines can be long especially early morning but seldom more than minutes at the worst Still if youre not flying to a hub city youll have to change planes to get where you are going and of the flights are commuter jets that are tight fits for a pounder like me Overall preferable to starting in Atlanta but make sure you plan for the connection

The airport is like one huge tourist trap Although the toilets are free of charge like inside all airports the cleaning personnel asked for Standing in the queue only toilets for women I watched how the cleaning lady insisted even when it was evident that the person queuing didnt have money at hand The toilets were very dirty maybe because personnel stands at the door just asking for money In the toilet in the restaurant area KFCCoffee Coster the cleaner asked for money plus smoked In the duty free shop there were no testers of eg face cream never seen this at any other airport sales people approached me and almost harassed me and youre completely dependable since they dont provide any testers All products are extremely overpriced even for airports Eg l water for egp Theres no information counter tourist police security that you could get for help eg against the toilet personnel

My worst comment will go for staff They treat people like animals As one doesnt understand their accent they make fun of you or just ignore that you even exist If you ask why are you paying something they look really angry and dont want to explain At departure you fill a form that they dont even read and so I dont understand why we need to fill it I could place there any name and it wouldnt be checked I bought a bottle of water and when paying there was an argument between staff members and you just stay there waiting for them to stop to be able to pay The only good thing is that the boarding areas are good

Scam like practice at the shop near gate no I was charged nearly pounds for a bottle of coke This is the highest price ever I have paid for coke bottle anywhere in the world Airport needs to do something to stop this corrupt practice

The whole airport is a disgrace x body and bag checks before I got to my departure gate Everyone is out to scam you from the visas on arrival to the stalls selling water in the departure lounge Shady characters all over the place I saw cleaner toilets out in the desert It really puts me off returning to Hurghada

Second and last time I will travel to this country checks for hand luggage and at the end you have to take off your shoes and take them through the scanner At the last scanner I had to hand over my lighters that I can normally reuse which has never happened before in any other airport but my halfliter bottle of water and large can of sunscreen fit through without any problems etc So they take away things that they can sell Hygiene is also lacking and how unfriendly Everything has to go fast and they shout that we have to go fast but when everything starts to get stuck they push you back to stand in one line that more checks are not carried out on this its just a shame I will not step foot in this country again

Departure area has a cold and unfriendly atmosphere Security procedures are tedious and unnecessary complicated Personnel is very unfriendly Bomb Squad personnel kept batteries and sweets at will for their private use Overall there is a great discrepancy between the warm and friendly welcome on the arrival site although the building itself is also cold and unfriendly and the cold and aggressive behavior on the departure site

My bag was screened for times as the security personnel could not judge the items under screening it got screened comes to scrutiny like wise times sorry the same bag was screened with no issue Finally all the items in the bag have to put in tray for screening which is very shabby and inconvenient for passengers

I flew into this airport on Islay island from Glasgow on a Loganair flight in the morning and returned almost a week later This is a rural airport close by the sea and is extraordinarily easy to use The SAAB aircraft was parked close to the small terminal building we picked up our bags that had been unloaded on the tarmac and walked in The walls were decorated with posters of the many distilleries for which Islay is justly famed There were also individual displays of whisky bottles and other items from these distilleries A small cafe provided a good range of snacks and also some souvenirs for last moment purchases There were ample spaces to sit A short conveyor belt brought in checked luggage quickly Across the check in counters are kiosks for the local car hires I had a car to be picked up The agent had all the paperwork ready The car was parked just outside I was out of the airport grounds driving on the left in less than minutes after landing On my departure I parked my rental car across the terminal building and slipped the keys into a slot in the kiosk The check in counters were staffed by Logan Air personnel in their uniforms that sported the easily recognized tartan plaids Security check was very thorough including patting The waiting area after security check had a rest room and was enclosed by glass which offered panoramic views The aircraft was just outside and we walked to to it It was a very relaxed experience with a high degree of friendliness and efficiency The airport is situated midway between the islands two larger communities Bowmore and Port Ellen

Arrived just before midnight with TA from KRK and was surprised with a hrs delay of my flight to Hong Kong The airport facilities are subpar in comparison to Zurich or even Helsinki which I could have chosen as alternative transit for the same journey So called nap zone is far from comfortable when youre drilling the walls past midnight No matter how many dining and shopping options provided you cant call it a worldclass airport if they dont get the basics right for such circumstances that is a comfortable lounge with reclined chairs Its all utterly useless and irrelevant to a passenger who transiting at midnight and expecting to spend a whole night at the airport when they are drilling the walls around past midnight Signages are confusing Flight status boards displayed in local language only Not the way to go Turkiye

Beautiful new architecture doesnt make up for an airports miserable customer service Upon arrival security officers shooed me away from several busy passport control areas before I found one where I could get in line after a very long walk Lufthansa lost my bag Dealing with Celebri their baggage handler was a dragged out exhausting ordeal I had no communication from them after making lost bag claim for more than hours Phones were not answered and calls not returned after leaving messages three times Bag was finally located four days later when I had boarded ship for Viking cruise but was still in port The Lufthansa baggage service Celebri refused to deliver my bag to cruise ship at the port or release it to Viking representative at airport Celebri made me return to airport in person to claim my bag The airport is a LONG ride from town Celebri is hidden in a secure area and can only be reached by a telephone by an unmanned information kiosk Celebri employee who answered phone said she was eating lunch and would come out to help me in ten minutes Multiple other travelers showed up called Celebri and were given various snarky answers as to when a representative would come out to help us It was more than minutes later when a surly young man came out and guided us back to the secure area The only answer I was given for why I had to claim my bag in person was Customs After four days without my suitcase being forced to retrieve it in person at the airport was an abusive four hour descent into a hell of rude indifferent Celebri employees in an airport that is already not passenger friendly They didnt just ruin my day they ruined my vacation by treating me like garbage I strongly advise NOT checking a bag if you are flying to Istanbul

First of all I dont understand how all the airport employees dont understand a word of English their car parking is a huge scam the sign shows one price however you will get charged almost triple the price if you did not read the extremely fine print in Turkish language at the bottom of the sign All I can say it an obvious scam and thats the last time I am using this airport

Nothing inspiring about this airport at all Dull overcrowded and expensive Arriving and transfer to Istanbul I gather trains and buses are expensive and infrequent So theres taxis Firstly like restaurant menus there is a local price and a tourist price Get into a taxi and youre snared The journey to the city centre is some distance and the trip can take anything from mins to hours depending on the traffic so the taxi driver will be able to justify the cost We paid for each trip by private taxi organised by the hotel Seemed reasonable Top tip As the passport queues when arriving are the usual length v long avoid logging on the airport WiFi to update the taxi people until youre through as the connection only lasts minutes Phone package was a day if thats an alternative for you Departing You have to join the queue to get your bags and self scannedso you can join the next queue to get your bags and self scanned again Not that anyone seemed too diligent in inspecting the screens Once through there arent enough seats and theres no water fountains anywhere What we thought was enough lire to buy a couple of drinks and a snack each was actually just enough for the former Again the free WiFi lasts just minutes but theres loads of machines around to buy more time Dont know how much but lengthy queues at all of them Expect to be searched and wand scanned again at the boarding gate

Coke at Champagne Prices I went through this Airport in transit between Sharjah and Manchester Couldnt find any water fountains so I bought x ml bottles of coke price I know low cost airlines use this airport but in some cases the drinks can be more expensive than the flights Didnt spend long enough in the airport to look around much but the toilets were grubby and the general feeling was of a rd world airport I suppose you get what you pay for low air fares and expensive and poor airport infrastructure

Extremely bad climate control Bad in many aspects Crowded Rude and unrespectful security and passport control Prices in restaurants free shops and any merchandise price in the airport is extremely high A simple sandwich will cost you Free shops are charging you much higher than the product cost you anywhere else on this planet Im shocked that this is allowed to happen and airport authorities allowing this Be careful and keep this in mind

Very very quiet compared to both Istanbul airports Much cleaner as less people use it Access to city is decent with local transportation Much less traffic in every sense of the word

waits and say our goodbyes before she gets on her flight I have had minor issues with doing this with other airlines due to security concernsCOVID but this most recent visit I feel I have to say something about the customer service We get to the airport hours before her flight Its me my daughter and her half sister The ticketing agent was not pleasant from the word go No greeting no hi how are you just a very bland how can I help you She asked me for ID and I said mine or my daughters as my year old doesnt have an ID as she doesnt drive yet nor does she have a job She got a bit of an attitude and was like hers meaning my daughter I stated she did not have one for said reasons above She proceeds to check my daughter in and as that is going on I tell the ticketing agent that me and Nearest airport from Vaishnodevi situated at Jammu Airport with very basic facilities expensive food and no lounge options Security is very tight to enter the terminal we need to get our baggage scanned and also times manual frisking after that again one security check of cabin baggage and manual frisking Wifi needs OTP but no roaming for prepaid sim in JNK and most people have prepaid sim so no wifi Toilets were clean and also the terminal

Small airport easy to find everything Overall a majority of the airport had no issue However a single experience can ruin it In my case the airport staff at lost luggage was very unhelpful I had a bag missing and they had no setup for an overnight bag Going through the lost luggage department was like pulling out fingernails After an hour they finally open a case number that you can track online The number provided to their office would ring for a long time then either hangs up or is picked up by somebody who knows very little English While the lost luggage is the fault of the airline the process in Jerez is painstaking The taxi prices are outrageous Mine did not speak English so have your Spanish handy

Andalucias hidden gem This is the perfect antidote to the horror of Malaga Bags arrive within minutes of arrival the staff are friendly and the airport is tiny Departures likewise are quick security takes minutes and you are a short walk to the plane Anyone going to Spain between Estepona and Seville should consider this an alternative to fog prone Gibraltar or Malaga even if it means connecting in Madrid as the time lost driving out is gained by the speed of airport service Only minus is the lack of smoking areas you can go past security though multiple times without hassle and airline lounges due to space

One particular person at easyjet check in was very officious Going forward found the security personnel team abrupt in a manner that was totally uncalled for We do appreciate their job is essential to keep travellers safe but in the same token we the passengers have a right to due care and consideration passing through security Travel is stressful enough Have travelled to and from numerous airports and this is the first time I experienced this behaviour Needs addressed

A truly horrible airport with a makeshift immigration area that has simply sliced the departures area in half Unfriendly security staff and once airside there are very limited facilities not to mention seating areas in abundance The cafe and bar and shops are mostly all manned by eastern European migrants and the actual gate areas are a relic from the s around seats for plus passengers They extended and remastered this airport shortly after they culled tourism There once was a lovely open air rooftop viewing area which then became a glassed in lounge now even that has gone Couldnt wait to leave the depressing airport for the last time

I travel to Jersey regularly and am rather underwhelmed with the airport Arrivals is lifeless however staff are very nice and even helped me take my luggage off the carousel and onto my trolley There is also plenty of free tourist brochures and maps available if you want them Departures is a bit odd Check in was fast as I used the priority lane but the security people were very thorough which is fine except when they are rude as well There are plenty of shops etc particularly given the size of the airport However the airline lounge is after a one way door If you want to go back to the shops you cant I have no idea what they were thinking when they designed that part

Only entry gate for flights boarding together made a long queue Without boarding pass you can not enter No place to sit after security check No shop for a water bottle or teacoffee Not single mobile charger port working

JMU is located in the far northeast of China approx two hours flying time from Beijing and three hours flying time from ShanghaiPudong With a single runway doubling as the only taxiway JMU doesnt see much traffic One has to walk across the runway to the terminal building no provisions of covered walkways in this singlestorey terminal building Ok in summer but imagine in winter with degrees And it does get that cold up there the Russian border is only a few hundred km away The single belt means it can get crowded when a full China Southern disgorges is complement of passengers Trolleys are free but in a poor state As soon as the airport staff matches luggage tag against baggage receipt means youre fair game for the taxi touts Which is meaningless since they all use the meter The drive into Jiamusi city is uneventful and mercifully only RMB away Departing on Hainan Airlines was easy though the ticket counter accepts cash only should you need to purchase the ticket at the airport like we did The two checkin clerks went about their job quickly and efficiently Security was equally quick The single departure hall consisted of two gates a souvenir shop selling Russian matrioshka dolls and manicure sets and a smoking room Again boarding was by walking across the aircraft parking bay My only gripe were the taxi touts filthy toilets and lack of covered walkways

Stuck in Jinan airport due to plane delay Jinan airport on first impression is bright and modern Yet among Chinese airports it surely must be rated as one of the worst Passport check was quite inefficient and slow This due to the security check which not only had very limited space meaning that passengers pile up waiting and bags pile up when leaving the xray The check was unusually strict As a frequent business traveller I always carry the same items yet here my bag was searched quite a bit and resubmitted for check Once behind security there were limited facilities Heating had been switched off so the airport was freezing cold The coffee shops were simply disgusting with respect to their hygiene while the coffee was amazingly overpriced Unlike most other airports in China Jinan does not provide free Wifi rather a fee version Seating became rapidly limited as delays piled up Lounges are quite grotty as well No interesting shops at all Try avoiding this airport

I took a connecting flight from London through JNB to Malawi We had to collect our luggage and check in again for the connecting airlink flight The queues for the passport check were very long and there were insufficient staff who were unfriendly We had four hours for the transit The monitors with flight details were not updating so we couldnt find which gate to go to The staff did not know Due to long queues at security baggage and passport we had only mins in the terminal before boarding Thats about hours waiting in queues Most of which was in hot sweaty lines with no working AC Security and passport and flight detail systems failed at different times Worst and most inefficient experience of a major airport so far I think we were unlucky to experience multiple system failure but modern airports should have decent backup systems in place

Someone needs to take better charge of this airport The airport is poorly maintained bags take forever to get to baggage claim hour and on departure at this very busy airport there are only passport desks open Worst experience

The most unpleasant and not always effectual staff Ive ever experienced in airports and I travel a lot Just shy of plain rude with the traveler A woman at customs upon my return from Mauritius gave me me no eye contact grunted when I said thank you though she did not deign push my passport towards me but forced me to reach inside the window to get it back Thats only one example I hope never to have to go through that airport again

From being one of the best airports in Africa to travel through a decade ago Johannesburg ORT has rapidly become one of the worst On arrival you will find dozens of immigration desks available but only a handful manned by some of the rudest officials you will ever meet with lengthy lines as a result Visit the toilets in the arrival hall and expect the attendant to ask you for a tip for standing there and watching you while you do your business On departure expect a single out of or manned security lane processing hundreds of passengers leading to insane lines yet again The ACSA staff manning these lanes seem more interested in chatting with each other than actually screening passengers Further lines at passport control Theres a security company that mans various checkpoints at the airport called Eagle Eye Security The staff are thoroughly unpleasant to deal with My experience on my last trip was not a oneoff as I travel through ORT once a month and this is the usual experience What an embarrassing gateway to one of the biggest commerce centers in Africa

Awful unprofessional uninterested and barely functional An astoundingly poor experience when international visitors arrive to Johannesburg with seating frayed or falling apart ceiling boards too and that barely mentions the lack of signage Naturally the baggage carousel was broken which meant people and some staff started climbing over the brokenstucknonfunctioning carousel to try get their bags All in all minutes to disembark get stamped in struggle to locate and find baggage before having to redo the whole process again for domestic departures since FlySafair counters arent available in the part of the airport where international visitors could easily switch And of course none of this is explained or communicated among the dozen broken glitching screens or dozens of empty booths Luckily the actual staff that assist in the airport are friendly courteous knowledgeable and kind Get them into the arrivals area and fix that disaster Africas premier business city deserves much better than the pathetic effort youve attempted to throw together

Love John Wayne Airport it is close and convenient to the I and everything in southern California It is a lot easier to get in and out of than LAX and so much more modern Flew from here to Portland recently and going through security and checking in the bags was a breeze

The Airport is one of the easiest to get in and out of The only problem the airport has is in planning and building a convenient location for taxi transportation This problem did prevail when the airport was built There was no taxi designated location The one the taxis are situated now was an improvised one out of necessity Once again with the addition of terminal C which is far away from the present taxi stand is too far for seniors and others Something has to be done to improve this

Juba airport had been rated worst in the world by some passenger surveys with good reason However the original terminal has been replaced with a small but functional new terminal Arrival and departure procedures are now quite reasonable for a developing country There is a proper luggage carousel on arrival Departure is OK Checkin was a bit slow but no problems at immigration which is now computerised like anywhere else There are small but reasonably stocked shops before and after security and cafs too The gate area is air conditioned with new seating and TV You do need a paid voucher for the wifi though No longer an airport to dread using

Just like winning the lottery there are some things that you just do not expect to do Giving Kabul airport a good review is one of them But here it is I have been travelling to Kabul for many years and have always hated the airport battle But the new airport is different If all you want to do is got on and off of a flight quickly and efficiently Kabul airport does that very well The hour queues at immigration are gone More like minutes now Baggage reclaim is as good as anywhere else in he world It took about half an hour from landing to being out of the airport No problems with check in either My Turkish flight left exactly on time Dont expect too much in the way of shops or business lounge in the departures area but it is adequate Wifi Internet is working well and free There are lots of security checks on the way into the airport Expect lots of Xray checks and various vehicle and body searches That is just a part of life in Kabul these days Overall a good and efficient experience and a big change from the old Afghan way

A small airport which got completely upgraded because of the FIFA games in Russia On arrival be aware that border control takes min per person They thoroughly check your whole passport visa and picture The airport doesnt have many facilities only duty free store and some small shops Its best to use the official taxi service as there are many scams A trip from the airport to the city center takes about min and about rubles Most flights are domestic Russian ones with some international ones Staff are friendly but dont expect smiles all the time

Kaliningrad airport is currently undergoing reconstruction so it might have improved after this review The only way to get out of the plane is by stairs They use one set of stairs per plane Expect long queues at check in usually there is only one desk per flight available Before customs the airport has bar restaurant souvenir shops and small chemist After customs there is one bar and a duty free store Prices are decent but the quality at the restaurant requires a Russian stomach in to appreciate the food Make sure to use the toilet in the plane before landing after landing before customs there is only toilet The other toilets before customs are dirty and smelly There is an information desk but they only speak Russian There are enough taxis available choose a registered taxi with a sign to avoid being ripped off There are no other means of transport bus lines or trains to leave the airport The sound installation in the terminal is lousy In combination with the poor English of the announcers announcements are incomprehensible Security is pragmatic and efficient There is an xray and metal detector when entering the airport

Kalmar is a small regional airport Only gates but we have to walk out to the planes the same way Only a few airlines serve this airport The staff are friendly and efficient and the mood is quite cosy There is actually no stress and the place seem to be very relaxed There is a small bar and a small tax free shop which is open only when there are some international departures mainly some charter to Mediterranean destinations Main airlines using this airport are SAS and BRA for domestic flights mainly to Stockholm SAS to Arlanda and BRA to Bromma BMA The airport is clean even the toilets are of a high standard Even though this airport lacks a lot of things it is one of my favourites

Kangerlussuaq is where you enter Greenland on Air Greenland flights you arrive here from Copenhagen on their A and continue on board smaller planes to towns around this massive land Airport is very relaxed on domestic flights there is no security check so you simply arrive checkin your luggage and off you go The only flight you have security check is the one to Copenhagen Terminal is very small it has couple of shops and cafes and also an outdoor terrace where anyone can enter and watch the airplanes There is only one tiny luggage belt on arrival so when A arrives its very packed and for some reason it took about half an hour for our luggage to arrive They are now expanding airports in the capital Nuuk and also in the main tourist destination Ilulissat to receive larger aircraft so future of Kangerlussuaq is a bit cloudy

A pretty mundane affair looks quite old and tired especially when you arrive Departure was fairly swift no long lines for security and staff seemed quite efficient Overall a very average airport but this is my only experience of a Japanese airport

Feedback on my initial visit to MCI new terminal I am a Kansas City native this review is critical as it should be Overall impression is outstanding compared to the s era terminals It addresses the needs of a st century Midwest airport with all the modern necessities one would expect as a flying customer First impression walking in its big It spans wide and the design incorporating natural lighting with an abundance of windows is refreshing The evening sunlight streaming in through different angles really provides a nonrestricted feel as you walk about the terminal The respective airline checkin counterplacements are easy to identify and span the width of the front end of the terminal for easy access Security access is fairly streamlined and the entire process is able to accommodate large volumes of travelers nonTSA airport VMD corp more natural light as you progress through each arm of the terminal ABC with interior lighting not overbearing The walkways are wide and allow for excellent views of the tarmac exterior gates and various angles of the entirety of the taxiways and runways Additionally the escalators and walking escalators are positioned nicely and push you through terminal in a speedy manner More shops etc at each terminal branch providing basically anything the traveler would need The vibe and local venues are all a welcome addition and definitely fulfill the needs of the traveler Individual gates and structured well and offer comfortable seating and ample wireless device charging The one thing that seems odd is the placement of the gate flight monitors It is essentially in the seating area of the individual gates Why not place it directly behindabove the agent boothdesk for easy and quick access and explanation poor design decision Boarding the plane the traveler is treated to long glass jet bridges that allow for excellent views of adjacent aircraft and outside weather conditions This is a well thought out design that many major airports do not offer Overall the new MCIKCI terminal is a massive upgrade to the Kansas City area It has the opportunity for expansion and I would expect future modifications to address design shortfalls and customer feedback We concluded it feels like a mall when walking though the new terminal Three things need immediate addressing Mens restroom upkeep and sanitary conditions unacceptable Need to revisit the options of installing automatic hand blower machines and look at the cleaning schedules to ensure conditions do not deteriorate to the point of being an embarrassment Cleaning crews need to maintain a regular schedule on vacuuming the terminal carpet paper and debris everywhere Please explain how the gate flight monitors are controlled by the city How is this beneficial to the traveler or airline staff Local control to changemodify the monitors shouldnt even be a discussion This new terminal is supposed to represent the pride of Kansas City aviation
