Literally one of the worst experiences in my life never again I never even thought that an international airport can be closed at night am so that is also way I arrived late at the night with the trains is also hard countless delays and no trains during the night to the airportat the end it is really to be all night outside the airport or at the train station yet I dont know which is better So at the end everyone is waiting in the cold outside For luck at least there is a toilet outside so I guess it could have been worse Still no security no police as a woman that makes you really unsure for luck we the women just form a group and wait together even when we dont speak same languages just trying to make us feel more secure I had a flight really early in the morning and it would be impossible for me to reach in time when there are no trains in this direction at night The hotels are full also with the hotels around Memmingen is risky since you have to depend on the Deutsche Bahn witch is not always a good idea bc of the countless delays or the train not arriving at all I wouldnt recommend the airport especially if you have an early flight and couldnt find a hotel next to the airport The hygiene in the toilets in the airport is really not the best for example the toilets outside were cleaner and smelled better Otherwise if you have a night or afternoon flight I guess it is fine

Arrival was satisfactory maybe because we were the only aircraft at that time Departure was different Checkin was quite quick and the agent was helpful The queue for security was all across the building and took over an hour Immigration was slow but acceptable Airside lounges were very crowded hard to find a seat The airport is too small for the number of passengers There used to be two aircraft stands but now four two remote however the terminal has not been expanded in any way A rather unpleasant experience

Airport is simply not fit for the level of flights crammed I into a short window The queue goes out the door along with any chance of getting to your gate within minutes They park the aircraft remotely and use a bus to transfer from terminal so those that manage to make it through the queues just after the minutes cutoff literally miss the bus No chance if any assistance from airport staff Worth avoiding

I have used this airport for over years as a regular visitor to family in Landsberg Staff on reception desks security and passport control were excellent Unfortunately the Fellowes catering operation on the st floor is appalling I submitted a complaint regarding filled bagels on my last trip in December regarding dry tough bread unbuttered chicken and avocado filling devoid of filling Unable to complain at time as take away for flight Complained to Chief Exec Customer services and still awaiting a reply

Yesterday we arrived at Memphis airport at am for am flight to Philadelphia Upon receiving our boarding passes at the kiosk we noticed a long line of at least passengers waiting to pass through security The line seemed endless and we later found out that the airport only had four security checkpoints for over flights scheduled to depart between am and am When we inquired about the delay TSA claimed they were not responsible despite the airline attendant mentioning that TSAs understaffing had been an ongoing issue for morning flights Due to the long wait we missed our flight by minutes and were rebooked on a connecting flight to Philly via Charlotte Shockingly other passengers fact also missed their flight to Charlotte from Memphis My advice to others is to arrive at least hours early for flights departing from Memphis The understaffed TSA seemed indifferent to the chaos and there were confrontations in the line Many latecomers appeared distressed and there was even a member of the Memphis SWAT team present to maintain order before passengers entered the security checkpoint Good luck Side note Huge shout out to Rejoice the Gate Attendant at American Airlines for having the patience of a SAINT and getting us on the next connecting flight to Charlotte

Great MEM airport This airplane has been here for hours Weve been loaded for minutes Waiting for fuel Apparently they only have one damned small fuel truck He fuels a commuter jet and has to go back to the farm before he can do a second one Fantastic Crew had to wait hours last night for fuel Somebody needs to fix this place Nice terminal but management and operations suck at their jobs

Appalling Covid prevention measures at the airport Crowding at security with new rules about food slowing the process because of confusion about what needs to be removed No social distancing guidelines at gate and no mask enforcement People sit wherever they like and pull masks down I am truly shocked at how Memphis airport operates at the times when there is a mandatory mask mandate in place and all good businesses work toward social distancing Would not recommend flying out of Memphis any time soon
his airport offers easy entry and exit for domestic flights but lacks a Priority Plus lounge Car rental is on the airport site the most convenient for Alamo I have ever found

Word of advice if you plan on purchasing anything whatsoever after youre awaiting your flight by the gate after securitybaggage checkin do yourself a favor and keep some of that Mexican currency Naturally to save time you may opt to hit the first window to get your native currency exchanged back before going through baggage security on the way to your gate Heres the con Its common for you to want a beverage snack etc to bring on board right The businesses are purposely giving you less than the exchange rate when you pay them in your native currency USD for example One employee at the Le Pain Quotidien flat out admitted it to me like it was normal Its a double dip into your pockets with that and the fact that airports charge more money for items than they would on Wall Street Be a better person to your pockets and just eat a big meal beforehand because theyre not going to tell you theres another exchange on the other side It makes sense considering the efficiency of the airport employees is seriously something to be desired

Has to be the worst airport ever Unhelpful rude security staff making heavy weather of pointless checks for transit passengers Why do we have to go through passport control on transit Europe and Asia do not do this Insufficient seating Just grim Fortunately I wont be back

The rude security check by an entitled inexperienced careless rude extremely poorly trained young man who seemed too bored and just wanted to humiliate and degrade an old person completely ruined my nice two week holiday in Mexico City First he touched every single item in my suite case including my personal hygiene items and underwear Then he had me take out ALL the contents of my carry on bag without providing me with adequate bins My stuff was all over the place He wanted to check the lining of the suitcase even though it was very evident that there was nothing in there He ran the empty suitcase through the xray machine again and he was still not satisfied and wanted to humiliate me further A couple of his colleagues who were older female Security Check personnel were wondering about his behaviour I think he was just bored and wanted to get a kick from humiliating and upsetting an older person This incident has made me reconsider my good opinion of Mexico and makes me extremely reluctant to ever want to go there again Why cant they provide some training or have a responsible surpervisor who can control the disgusting and hurtful actions of these outofcontrol personnel who only want to humiliate and degrade travellers It appears that no one in Mexico City Airport cares about the conditions of the airport so I am only writing this to warm other travellers to expect the worst experience of their lives when leaving the Mexico City Airport

Unquestionably one of the worlds worst airports to transit in particularly of you have to change terminals I came into T on AM and flew out of T on AF Its so poorly conceived its beyond belief Why theyd have AM in T and all of the SkyTeam partners in T necessitating an absurdly long difficult transit is simply absurd You need to clear customs then recheck your bags walk one football field to get the train to T Once you get to T its another football fields to get to your airline check in desk and then more to the gate Complete nightmare Once in the terminal you can find plenty of small bottles of water for USD and Mexico world cup kit for USD all well above market prices in most of tye world and certainly in Mexico This place is a shameful disgrace and avoid at any cost

Absolutely no seats at gate there was an entire space of nothing So many people were sitting on the dirty floor Long lines everywhere not any good food options and it wasnt even that clean rather get rerouted Avoid Miami Airport

One of the security guards at H went out of her way to delay my flight by removing my things from the queue just because I asked a question to understand one of the steps she mentioned we need to follow The job could be hard and requires thick skin as she may have to explain the same things again and again all day but from it would good to have someone a bit friendly in location where they need to interact with customers

When we arrived on Thursday afternoon none of the elevators were working or the walking escalators Nothing is well labeled so we couldnt find our badge terminal and ended up at international baggage When you ask staff no one seems to know where to find Alaska We stopped for a burger at Burger King and had to wait for staff to finish their min conversation Then had to wait till she completed the line that had formed before she loaded our food which was cold by the time she got to it Then after we finally found our baggage we had to find the rental car shuttle Nothing labeled easy to find so we had to go up and down stairs multiple times to find it Again no one who works at airport seemed to know where we needed to be to get rental car Finally found it then found shuttle Then when we got to the rental car area not well labeled what shuttle stop is for our rental car place Priceless The exact same miserable experience was when we returned to go home that following Monday No walking escalators working No one knew where our gate was and no one knew where our lounge was We asked different people who worked for airport one of whom was a TSA agent Nothing well labeled and no helpful staff Tried to find a filling station for our water and again none to be found by restrooms and again no one knows You know its bad when security check was the only smooth spot in this airport

The layout is laughably stupid and pointlessly confusing The terminals have far too few chairs The TSA security check is quite literally at a angle downwards so when you are waiting in line staring at the repulsive floor with litter and zyn packs scattered about you are forced to struggle with your suitcase to keep it from rolling away Once you struggle to get to the screening area it is hideously disordered and the bag collecting area has room for people max When we had recently arrived at the airport the security officer we asked for directions due to the aforementioned pointlessly confusing layout informed us that because our flight was not for quite some time we would not be able to go through the TSA check and therefore had to stay in the front area I put it in quotes because the layout is so stupid I cannot in good faith call it the front This was as we later found out false While maybe another officer knew better then he we could not find another that spoke English All in all sufficient to say we will never return to MIA and I recommend you to do the same

Arriving at Miami International Airport to return to Rome we had the invaluable assistance at the automatic checkin before the Air Canada desk so I dont think an Air Canada employee helped us so much to understand how we had to make our boarding passes and what to do with our luggage Thanks to him the passage through this airport seemed delightful
A lot of staff were aggressive rude and condescending even those who are in the restaurants Signages and Instructions for the queues are not available Not enough seating areas Wifi is good though

When waiting overnight for an early flight it is cold dirty and unfriendly There are no comfortable seats to relax on and staff keep waking you up and moving you around for no good reason The toilets are situated downstairs forcing you to use the escalator Why cant soft lengthy seats be provided for the many travellers spending the night there waiting for early flights

The security person that checked me was so rude I went through the body scanner and it beeped which it was not a surprise it was always happens to me for some reason and she shouted for me to take my shoes off and go again through it Then during the search done by hand she even lifted my top up without even asking resulting in me being almost half naked in front of everyone I would not recommend this airport at all as I never had such a bad experience in any airports I have been to The pros are that the food is generally good there and there are lots of shops so if you have time to kill it is a good airport for that

Baggage arrived minutes after the flight arrived Security personnel would not prioritise me as my lay over was minutes only and time was running out fast When I arrived at the gate the ladies did not let me through as they said the gate was closed At the same time people we still boarding the flight many hours wasted and I had to pay with my time plans and money

Twice I have traveled through this airport with my mother who needed a wheelchair as she cannot walk the long distances to the gate without getting out of breath and risk of heart issues Our flight was leaving at am so arriving at am is useless as the Sala Amica staff do not start until am The totem where they ask you to register to request assistance also had no one answering so it was very worrying for Mum and frustrating for me The staff were friendly but its ridiculous to have flights coming and going with no Sala Amica staff available Mum had to walk with us helping her from the car to the checkin desk which was a ridiculous distance when someone has difficulty As her carer it was possible to ask to go with Mum and agreed Bergamo Airport please review how you support people with reduced mobility so you are available hours before flights leave otherwise you are putting people at risk physically and psychologically Also there is no time for passengers using the Sala Amica to get Duty Free shopping or use the facilities such as toilets and cafes This is an added stress and also reduces potential sales for the airport and the travel experience is poor Its good the cafes are open all night at least

Absolutely shocking service My daughter queued for minutes at McDonalds only to be told they had sold out of what she wanted No idea of customer service or using common sense like managing the queue and letting people know they were on limited stock prior to entering the queue

The best thing of this airport is that it is incredibly near to the city centre Normally it is a breeze getting there or arriving as in no time you are at destination if you need to be in Milan or get on a train or arriving at Milans main station Only thing really weird is how on departure after the security check they guide you by all shops you really have no possibility to take any shortcut

If you are thinking of making a transit at Milan Linate think again There is no dedicated transfer route through the airport so you have to leave the baggage hall find your way upstairs to Departures and go through security all over again On Monday we arrived minutes late from Naples Stopover time was scheduled at hour minutes so catching our next flight to London was still possibleat a pinch We get ferried from aircraft by bus go through baggage hall take the escalator up to Departures and find a long long queue to get through Security Fortunately we had booked Fast Track No queue but problems with the boarding pass scanners Ran through the newly extended Duty Free obstacle course and made it to the Gate with two minutes to spare The airline had held departure for ourselves and two other passengers So we made it breathless and stressed I see that there have been previous posts here about the lack of an easy transit route Its bonkers that the airport authority still hasnt managed to provide one If wed not had a Fast Track booking we wouldnt have made the second flight Be warned

My glasses were broken on security line and i was rejected a reimbursement On the security check we were asked to put everything including the sunglasses in the basket While the basket was inside the machine something went wrong and my sunglasses got stuck inside The head of security guard took broken sunglasses out apologised and promised that we are gonna receive the reimbursement We filed a form but customer relations declined their liability though it was confirmed by the head of security and ignore our emails

We arrived at the checkin at We finally checked in at Firstly the computer was slow then it broke down completely Our flight was at so by the time we got through security and grabbed a cup of coffee people were already boarding While still sipping my coffee I had to run to the toilet We were up at am and left our hotel at am This airport is a joke

Miserable security experience with surly underemployed staff One undersized table available at the end of each queue to repack your belongings once they pass through the scanner Combine that with poor shopping opportunities and food outlets and a generally oppresive environment makes for travelling through Linate one of lifes must miss experiences As someone who used to travel very regularly through Linate I can safely say there has been no improvement or investment in the airport and facilities over the last years

Awfully rude and highly aggressive airport security personnel What is a simple relatively quick body search after putting your clothes and laptop into the trollies turned into a highly aggressive pantomime act by one of the personnel who was conducting this I took offense to his behaviour and informed him of this to which he became even more aggressive to me In the end one of the managers had to be called Only happened to me in this airport As a result I wont ever come to visit Italy ever again

This airport is a complete disgrace There are a very few seats for passengers a tiny number of toilets and therefore large queues Information is difficult to find resulting in going through passport control more than once and the whole experience is an ordeal At the gate we were standing there for an hour waiting to board Why are there so few seats there is plenty of room I would give it out of

The rudest agents I have ever seen I asked a lady who was standing and clearly had a badge saying agent where the Air Canada checkin was and she yelled Oh My God Im not information Another walked away as I approached her and I said excuse me Im a passenger She turned around rolled her eyes sighed and said yes These people shouldnt be working with the public

Malpensa Airport is not International enough to call it International Airport The first time losing my luggage happened here with NEOS airline And cant seem to find anyone knows whats going on We finally reported to lost found On our departure date we experienced how indifferent the airport staff are We almost missed our flight the line to security is at least hrs long And since we had a Young Child with us we had to go through all passports instead of the quick line for no visa access I tried to communicate with the lady and the gentleman working on the quick lane we are missing our flight They didnt seem to care at all At the end we had to talk to all the passengers ahead of us to skip the line God bless all these nice ppl and the lady staff stood at the security glanced at my bag from duty free made a comment that you had time to shop in duty free I mean who are you the judge if I bought a few boxes of chocolates for my daughter You didnt help me and i dont need your judgement now Not impressed by the airport staffs customer service if theres any at all

Each time I come back to Milan Malpensa from other airports I long for the quick and modern security checks installed here I left on the evening of a small holiday period and there were thousands of travellers Despite this the security checks at Terminal handled the crowd without problems we waited about min for the whole process Being able to carry liquids to leave computers in the bags mean really accelerating the flow and guaranteeing a quick check After that the airport is nice there are seats to wait before boarding a lot of shops and restaurants possibly some more gates should be added

No seating when you pass security control everyone sitting on long steel pole plenty of room to put seating in place no idea why management have not thought of this terrible for people waiting Also water filter would be useful like most airports
People dont know what service means We have been waiting in the arrival hall for an hour for our bags to come No one in charge no information

Airport was clean and great but would like to complain about the customer service of check in passage There was problems with my check in and although I understand that its not their fault their attitude just stuck into me Really offended when they ask me if I have a business black card and when I say no they just gave me customer service card and told me to call even though I was right there I understand that it may be useful to some situation but the way they handle and the tone is just really unprofessional I saw several people just standing behind the door seemingly free and on purpose trying to avoid me Not even mad just disappointed

Busiest I have ever seen the airport TSA with a huge line of people closed lanes creating a major backlog and then no agent directing people about the policy of the day laptops in or out etc Only one scan machine so even once your bags went through security you were stuck behind people waiting on the scanner Walking through Concourse D they removed all water fountains and replaced with vending machines One water fountain in the entire concourse Couldnt find anyone who works there to help find a water fountain Busy weekday late afternoonearly evening and more than half of the vendors are closed so everyone goes to the same few causing service lines out onto the concourse and subsequent traffic jams Essentially they were ill equipped to handle the volume of passengers

This is possibly one of the nicest airports Ive flown through Staff were amiable the terminals were clean and wellmaintained and everything was wellmarked Security was a breeze and the baggage claim system is both swift and efficient compared to other airports

One of my favorite airports to make a connection through Ive flown through MKE maybe times or so and never have had to wait in a line to go through security There is also a very nice bookstore decent food options nice play areas for kids and an aviation museum The airport is also fairly stress free for making connections

Upon arrival at MRV discovered a new arrivals hall since my last visit in October last year Baggage very quick into hall Outside a pleasant array of kiosks should you need anything food wise Departures hall is spotless and some nice Caucasian shops to spend your Rubles in Security quick and easy and departure lounge has a nice cafe and a few more shops A pleasant experience before the hassle of Domodedevo

Horrible experience The Delta airline did such a great job getting us minutes earlier so we can get in time to our connecting flight but MSP airport didnt have the ramp ready so we got off late the agent at gate said the cart can take us to the other side of the airport well the cart driver said it wasnt his problem when asked what is the best way to get there faster he said he didnt know the other cart driver who again refused to take us sent us the wrong way You gotta do much better training your employees to first treat travelers with a little more kindness and compassion because a lot of us travel in stress and and really would like to see a little more help from the people who supposedly should know at least how to navigate through the airport The worst part was to see the same cart driver took other people to the same flight as we me and two of my underage daughters were approaching the gate in sweat and almost tears this was extremely frustrating to see that even harder to try and explain to my kids why this unjust thing happened This is completely unacceptable MSP Please do better job at getting your employees to be a little more helpful and kind or at least fair If you reject taking someone to the other side of the terminal please dont go ahead and just take the next completely healthy and not old family to the same place where the first ones are heading

Our Amsterdam flight arrived at time precisely hours wait on the tarmac because of the gate agent because of other reasons In the international arrival hall people officers to check passports hours waiting In civilized countries usually helpers are asking passengers about tight connections and help them through to catch their flights The assistants here were few and could not care less about us The luggages checked in and out for customs the re check points with other assistants watching their phones directing passengers how to put their luggage on the right position not helping or moving a finger in the process Security same rude treatment we supposed to push our bags through the tunnel at the flashing red light who would know workers standing there and screaming at us not helping at all I had to run like crazy to catch my flight and I would have never be able to do it without the help of a kind fellow passenger Shame on the management to allow this to happen Welcome to the USA was written on monitors It was a mess and a far cry from anything welcoming I will try never to go through that airport again

TSA line was long The wait said it was minute but it was minutes TSA security check didnt say a word to get the process moving They dont tell anyone to take off their shoes or about electronics to be prepared Everyone was upset because they didnt communicate which made the process longer One person was yelling at someone in a wheelchair

So getting checked in and boarding is easy Its the customs that cant get things figured out You know how many planes are arriving and how many people are on each flight then you should have enough staff to move people in a timely fashion Yet the simplest jobs your in a hr waiting line Go somewhere else if you can

We are on a layover from Cancun to Portland the deboarding customs area had one filthy gross restroom The Delta wing of the airport has very few restaurants choices or shops to browseentertainment while stuck here We ate at Mill Tavern although the customer service was great the food was not very few choices and very over priced They offered to remake my burger as the first one was too raw the second was cooked done it was just wasnt good fries soggy and flavorless Airport restrooms unkept poor food choices andor restaurants with comfortable seating to waiting Hope I dont have to visit this place again

Security is a big deal and everyone just wants to get though the most efficient way possible but I have never seen such a disrespectful illtempered employee ordering passengers about as I did today at Security checkpoint I witnessed an extremely elderly couple arrive at the TSA que They were traveling alone and obviously had trouble getting around They did not have the correct boarding documents but instead of showing compassion or helpfulness the airport employee yelled at them and told them to get out of line go back to the ticketing counter The elderly woman asked if her husband could wait there he had a very hard time walking but the grouchy employee said No you have to take him with you I dont have anywhere to stash him Like he was a piece of luggage or something Next she ordered me my family to a TSA booth that didnt have an agent manning it We stood there briefly looking to see if an agent was coming Next we stepped to the next agent to show our ID boarding passes She charged over to us and told us to stay where she put us I pointed out that there was NO agent where she sent us and she proceeded to start stomping around barking out orders My husband just told her we were staying in the line we stepped to because the TSA agent was already processing my daughter

The new airport in Miri is a blessing to all of us frequent travellers Although it is small it is efficient clean and cool If anything needs to be imroved on is the charges we have to pay for a small cup of coffee or a meal The charges are much too high for a domestic airport

Mobile Regional MOB is honestly not a bad airport even if its showing some signs of age The signage leading to anywhere a passenger needs to go is mostly straightforward except for signage to shortterm parking for some reason though some of it is older and fading Parking is easy and relatively cheap compared to airports in larger metros The entry into the terminal is one covered passageway Checking in luggage is painfully easy at one of three small counters Going through security is easy with small lines and painfully easy if you have TSA PreCheck There are only seven departure gates total and stores postsecurity One of those stores is one that almost everyone has to walk past or through on the way to their gate Hudson News pairing up with a tiny restaurant and bar equipped with cafeteriastyle seating It looks like the set of the old TV show Wings or perhaps a miniature version of a s mall food court This makes the airport so small that its quirky The personnel working in this airport are sweet and warm yes in an airport As for the drawbacks some of the ceilings postsecurity are quite low with the lighting dim Only some of the presecurity area looks like its seen any renovation since the s The signage from I and most of Airport Boulevard until you reach the airport is almost nonexistent MOBs location is so far out in the western suburbs that its really quite inconvenient whether youre coming from Mobile or other Gulf area cities in Alabama and Mississippi Mobile Downtown Airport is expected to open in and should be a vast improvement in terms of modernity and accessibility

The airport is in desperate need of an upgrade It looks old and is falling apart It certainly does not look like an international airport There is also no proper coffee shop or restaurant The basic coffee shop serves really bad coffee They should have a coffee shop such as Java or Artcaffe for the discerning traveller I also went to the small shop opposite gate The lady in there was just busy watching something on her phone with the volume up She was really cold towards her customers I also noticed that she was not issuing receipts and that the shop had not name displayed outside Not issuing receipts is illegal I hope the airport authority looks into this On the bright side the toilets were clean and had a nappy changing table

I used Terminal Passenger processing at this airport is very fast however the terminal building is in need of an upgrade Boarding of my flight was slightly delayed and no announcement was made Also no FID screens at the boarding gate It was quite hot and there is no airconditioning As I had arrived early it would have been nice to have a shop and caf of slightly higher quality although the hour free wifi kept me busy

Domestic arrival and departure at Mombasa Walk across the tarmac on arrival but an airbridge on departure The airport is beginning to show its age but more than adequate for the current passenger numbers The approach road is truly appalling and the main road as bad with seemingly never ending road works There is no airconditioning except in the business lounge cooling being done by the fairly constant breeze Minimal delays in passing through arrivals or departures A shop and caf airside and lots of little kiosks on arrival for car hire money exchange etc A pleasant enough small airport

Used Mombasa Airport late on Mon th March on a local flight very quiet about pax only one plane departing in the hour security good even picked up on detectors a small piece of lava we were carrying as souvenir from the lava field of Tsavo West Caf simple but adequate Ample seats and clean toilets

Typical African airport After you go through the first bag security there is a long hot wait to get checked in When you make it to the check in desk be prepared to be ripped off my advice is ask to see a supervisor or ask for the test certificate of the scales Dont waste your time thinking you can go have a smoke in departures as they charge shillings to get to the smoking room after that just another security check and a bag search Bear in mind once through that there are no toilets either Kenya has so much to offer pity they cant get it right

Arrived from Nairobi and flew to Amsterdam on September nd Baggage arrived quickly from our domestic flight couldnt immediately find international departures but were helped friendly at the outside service desk Security went fast but that could be attributed to the fact that it was a very quiet day only international flights departing after pm and we were early Enough available power sockets for charging Checkin opened a little over hours before departure once again we were helped by a couple of very friendly guys Staff on the lower floor overall was kind and helpful but we asked different people if there was either a Burger King McDonalds or KFC at the airport and none of them gave us a straight no answer they all directed us to the small sandwich counter on the second floor On the second floor staff spoke poor English Passport control went fast but was arbitrary they asked for my entire right hand fingers thumb to be scanned while my sister and father didnt need to have their thumbs scanned Free wireless internet of fairly good speed but very limited reach A dozen or so of duty free shops Half the ceiling fans were broken but since the second floor is not entirely walled up the fresh wind from outside cooled the waiting area down enough No power sockets at gate no toilets either if you need to go you can just walk right back After asking very politely and kindly if there was a way I could charge my laptop for the long flight hours they agreed I could charge it behind a desk at the security check where I left it out of sight for over half an hour and Im happy to say my faith in humanity remains the same it was right there where I left it when we boarded right on time

Traveled in FebMarch and fingerprints are now scanned upon arrival slowing down the process considerably From a departure perspective checkin and passport control were abysmal Flew Thomson from the UK who add additional layers of security checks not enjoyed by our German or Italian neighbours Upon arrival at the airport we stood queuing continually for checkin security passport control and beyond that a second baggagepassenger scan and finally a hand luggage searchbody search In all we stood queuing for hrs mins

We travelled back to the UK on th October when booking in our hand luggage was weighed which increased our allowance other passengers didnt have theirs weighed we were informed we needed to pay I offered to pay but was told someone would come and collect it thought this a bit odd but in a foreign country so did as requested In departures just before our flight the same check in person approached us and asked for the money I asked for some paperwork or a receipt but he said it was between us and he would have to get a supervisor I told him I was aware he was putting it in his own pocket and he was very concerned that I would report him I stupidly gave him the money to get rid of him as he was rather intimidating and our flight was due

We have flown in and out of this airport nine times and have found it chaotic Upon arriving there are not separate queues for those with visas and those who have to get a visa Everybody is in the same queue There are not enough staff on duty to organise queuing to make it more efficient Hence you arrive in sweltering hot temperatures and it takes over an hour to get through to collect baggage Can somebody not do something about this It is also pretty bad for departures too Very long unorganised queues and it takes forever to check in

First time I have travelled to and from Monastir airport and I dont want to do it again ever We travelled back on a Sunday morning at am and it was horrendous The checkin area was packed to the rafters and because the checkin desks were set out in an L shape each queue was queuing through each other and it was impossible to move In just the queue we were in one woman had an asthma attack and another one fainted Luckily the travel reps were on hand as no medical staff could have got through and they managed to get her into a wheel chair By the time we got through this part and then queued for passport control we had been on our feet for well over hours and only sat down when we got on the plane Most of the people on our plane said they would not go back there again

We travelled through Monastir Airport and found it to be pretty good for a small airport The queues coming in were fairly smooth and on the way out of the country everything went smoothly as well Facilities are perhaps a little limited but its only a small airport comparatively and at least it was clean

I agree most strongly that passport control is a nightmare I could not believe the length of time it takes to get passengers through and especially when the airport is so hot and lacked air conditioning I have visited this Airport twice now and hope that in future they can implement a more effective way of getting through control The rest of the airport was fine and even homeward bound found it was comfortably set out with refreshments and enjoyed a last encounter of some traditional Tunisian retail shops

Good airport but the passport control is ridiculous Each name is introduced into a computer and only when a green screen with Rien signaler nothing to mention flashes the passport is stamped and you can walk through Even the same procedure when you are leaving the country I traveled with my children one of them is a months old baby and for each of them even the baby the same procedure was applied The queue was so long that suddenly they realised everybody was going to be late for boarding so a lot of people were suddenly rushed through the luggage control without screening of Xray This made me feel worried as I think this control is far more important than the passport control

Impressed by this airport apart from the queue at Passport control It took ages once through to Departures everything was fine Duty Free was reasonable and plenty of places to get a drink or something to eat

I showed up to MLU for my morning flight I was there in plenty of time and I have flown out of Monroe multiple times A family in front of me was buying tickets for a flight tomorrow I waited and waited Apparently the woman at the counter the only one working thought I was with the family Once she realized I wasnt with the family she tried to get someone to help me but no one was there I waited long enough to miss the time to check a bag Finally a man came to help but immediately gave me a spill about being on time so I can check my bag next time I was polite but Ive done this many times Lets just say the woman working was not happy with him She tried to help me and I dont think it was her fault that no one was there to help her I had to wait from to catch the next flight I guess it is a small airport so theres not many staff I think the problem could be prevented
Slow slow Some of the laziest airport workers I have ever experienced Hot and humid Packed us into the jet ramp to await boarding Unheard of

What an absolute joke of an airport Young people working there are disrespectful and absolutely clueless in regards in what needs to be done Upon arrival we saw families with young children who had been queuing upwards of hours Jamaican culture as a whole is one of laziness and nothing better typified that than the carefree do as little work as possible by their immigration staff After asking constantly where we should go I decided to open up the self scan passport queue and help the additional passengers reach through immigration as the staff their refuse to do so unless you make commotion as I did If youre lucky enough to have a good experience going through this airport youd certainly be in the minority My advice is avoid this airport altogether and go to an island where you will be shown respect like Bermuda or St Lucia Will not be returning ever again

Ive been to Jamaica times over the years This last trip through Sangster Airport was the worst Ive ever experienced at any airport anywhere in the world in over years of air travel The utter lack of organizational skills the bedlam the sheer chaos produce nothing but frustration and anger for visitors The hallmark of Sangster is abusive disregard for arriving passengers who actually have had to pay for service fees slapped on to ticket prices We felt mistreated far from welcomed and we will never return to Jamaica as a result

The most disorganized and bureaucratic airport I have ever seen I have been there a few years ago but things have changed First we had to line up for an hour to go through the computer kiosk then other line ups to see different custom officers who asked the same questions on the computer printout Total hours later to get out of the airport It seems like they have layers of bureaucracy to keep people employed
The smoke detectors all have low batteries and keep chirping The announcements are loud and never ending The ambiance is like that of a prison but even less nice In short I would never return

Staff very unfriendly Not willing to help United Airlines policies assume all passengers must have a credit debit card staff doesnt take cash a form of payment Staff doesnt approach customers friendly to help find alternatives United Airlines staff doesnt help passengers to do the check in process Again the personal expectation is that ALL passengers know how about technology Age or social status might be an issue regarding use of electronic devices

The airport is really compact so the distance to walk between the gate and the curb is small The departure and arrival processes are really fast On the other hand because The Carrasco Airport has a small Terminal the commercial and service options are really limited and there are just a few options to eating drinking or shopping The immigration and emigration services are efficient There is an electronic system to verify passport egate that makes really agile the process of documentation verification The Security area xray needs better attendance When I was passing by the Security inspection Xray there was one senior couple slowing the only one row available The security officers did nothing neither helping the senior couple neither opening an extra row and xray equipment The baggage claim works well and is efficient In this travel time I had one normal luggage plus one special sport equipment bicycle that arrived to the baggage claim area earlier than me The WiFi is good when you find an antenna to connect but you will need to search the signal that is not available in all the spaces The signal is better on the second floor checking area but it did not works well on the ground arrival and curb so if you need the signal to send messages chat in WhatsApp or call Uber or taxi it will be difficult

Sitting and overlooking the abandoned runway at Carrasco International in Montevideo waiting for the mysterious fog to disappear makes you imagine what the world will be like without people The airport closed due to fog and to help with the delay there will be a strike in the fog that got few passengers stranded and roaming this modern but today useless building However the lights are glistering bright on the far side of the runway and you cant help think that South American mentality is taken much further in Uruguay than the rest of the continent I wish I could upload my photo of the massive visible concrete slabs and the runway lights chasing away airplanes completely shying away from their function I think you can even see the new Pearol football stadium they recently completed in the distance and luckily it doesnt snow in Uruguay

If you fly Premium classes and get off the plane first you will be lucky enough not to queue too long with immigration and passport control which is not too unpleasant They seem to be friendly Then directed to customs but through the Duty Free Shop which is the cheapest in SA you can buy up to US dollars of alcohol bubblies and wines and beers and liters of white spirits Customs are nice but tough Do not change any cash inside the international no zone area the exchange shop who are expensive with high commission will give you vile rates There are cash dispensers outside Taxi service to town at one price only but expensive though Do not take any taxi just airport ones that are of a beige colour Check in facilites are good Very few international airlines fly to Montevideo Security is vile and long queues done by a division of the air forces who are rude and not at all polite Immigration on you way out are rude and unfriendly Then again lounges after security and after Duty free yet again convenient prices you will find the lounge just the one for all F and C classes ok though Lovely little airport
Flew in and out of here on flights to and from Sao Paulo A striking modern terminal with reasonable facilities Very pleasant

Spacious clean well located well serviced bright naturally illuminated airport Large halls with folk articles shops and chemist money exchange bureau and wrapping baggage service A breeze Fine areas for check in and spotless lavatories Once checked in fast track to security and immigrations available Smiley faces all over the airport Excellent Duty free shop Very good VIP lounge

Montgomery Regional Airport Dannelly Field has been completely modernized and is one of the most attractive small airports in the US Checkin in close to the curb and security is efficient Food and drink groundside and airside is basic Deplaning is easy and baggage claim is close to the street Parking is reasonably convenient unless you are travelling mid week It can be a longish walk to the terminal

Small airport clean and easy to navigate The airport is very basic no major queues as there are no many flights Waiting area is clean not many places to recharge iPhoneiPad and laptop I was not expecting too much but at least a decent taxi experience When I arrived there were no taxis at all outside the airport I had to call a number that I accidentally found at the taxi rank A taxi driver replied saying that he would have arrived in minutes No one turned up After minutes another random taxi showed up Bearing in mind the experience taxi drivers are totally unreliable I booked a taxi on my way back well in advance as my return flight was at am The taxi driver did not turned up impossible to find other taxi drivers as no one was answering also the hotel reception could not find anyone and I missed the flight I travelled all around the world and I have never missed a flight in my life Its like this place is stuck in Rent a car maybe the experience is better

A small yet very convenient airport in the south of France From the plane to the exit takes no more than min Signaling shopping etc is all fine given the size and role of the airport Its not the most modern airport but everything is well maintained Theres a convenient bus service to the city center

We visited the Airport Restaurant Le Terrasse The rudeness was unbelievable We were ignored for over mins while tables who arrived after us were served before us When the waitress did arrive I ordered a carafe of wine in French She literally jumped down my throat to say she spoke no English and only spoke Spanish as an additional language Wow Such prejudice in the assumption that we would not speak French She had not listened to the fact that the initial order was in French As a Head teacher I raise my students with good manners and question those who have not taught so by their parent What the three waitresses do not understand is that they make themselves look bad Why do they want to carry themselves in such a negative way It takes energy to be rude It is less stressful to be polite They really made themselves look bad As we travel to the airport frequently I have a home in a France it would be good to see a change of attitude After all we are paying they are not doing us a favour

Better to arrive at than to depart from Baggage reclaim was quick and efficient and decent transport available shuttle bus and taxis Taxi to centre of Montpellier less than Euros so not too bad as four shared the expense Departure was ok but with a Duty Free shop saving very little and just one snack bar the place is one not to be delayed in Fortunately we werent but the departure gates are designed poorly and there is confusion especially when the priority boarding is progressing I would welcome a ticket system where those first into the departure gate area are guaranteed to be the first to board the aircraft This would enable the latecomers to risk having their cases put into the hold and those with regulation size bags would be able to use the gauges and thus make boarding a little more civilised

There is a frequent direct bus from the city centre to the airport which only costs euros and only takes mins The building is large and modern and air conditioned inside We had no luggage to check in so went straight through security which was speedy We had hrs to wait and I was dismayed to find the international departures area is very small with a single tiny coffee bar and one small shop selling duty free perfumes and local products Seating also very limited although thankfully the airport wasnt busy I dont think there are any air bridges so all departures mean walking down outside stairs onto the apron Nice if its sunny

Had a layover at YUL montreal airport for hours The gates to come to Edmonton wing was where we had to stay for this period The lounge area had decent chairs without arm rests that you could sleep on that was ok The amenities coffee shop Starbucks and Java U plus Urban food The price gouging for food is out of this world JAVA U sub sandwich heated with ham and cheese The URBAN RESTAURANT We had a meal of smoked meat sandwich boring with fries and a burger and fries one coffee and ice tea and the waiter expected a tip on top Mediocor warm fries and crappy sandwichs Absolute rip off and you get it all in full french only one person spoke in broken english This country is biligual The French want special treatment in Alberta and recognition of their language yet English people arent given the same considertions in Montreal Never gonna fly into YUL if i can avoid like the plague

We flew Air Canada Frankfurt to Montreal and final destination Quebec City When arriving at Montreal airport we tried to follow the In Transit signs but at one point we could no longer see them We asked an airport employee for directions and he gave us the wrong answer as did a second employeeWe had the feeling we bothered them After wasting minutes we finally ended up at Security the second time here The overall impression of the airport is that its management is unable to handle the very heavy flow of passengers There are not enough places to sit as we saw passengers sitting on the floor Even the security staff appeared overwhelmed and stressed apart from the lack of English fluency No way to eat in a restaurant as there were waiting lines We have experienced at least a dozen or more airports and this was by far our worst experience We will avoid in future

The airport is dirty and disorganized Westjet staff at this location were rude and not helpful I was returning to Canada from an international trip and had to remove my luggage because I was switching airlines My luggage could have been moved for me because it did not get re inspected I had to wait at a WestJet booth which was not open to allow the transfer I was not directed to a drop off line and got in with a crowd of new Canadians checking in and weighing multiple bags Staff knew I was just dropping off and refused to help me It was hard to find the drop off area because of signage I went through customs twice The waiting areas were dirty and crowded seats were comfortable and it was a nightmare Shopping areas looked ok but not many accessible from my gate area

Arrived in Montreal hours late from my original flight from London I was very worried I would miss my connecting flight to Ottawa I had to pass through customs and make my way through what seemed one end of the airport to another The signage was confusing and inadequate I tried to get directions and information from airport personnel I was brushed off almost every time I was given incorrect information which delayed my progress Some even told me they did not know where I could find a particular gate People were treated like cattle being moved along with no time to even give a word of explanation The moving conveyor belts were not working I had just come from Heathrow and although that airport is huge it is well organized and the signage is clear If I can avoid this airport I will Rude staff poor layout and signage are its characteristics

MSL is minutes from my home instead an hour twenty to HSV The staff is beyond exceptional up to and including the TSA employees Over the years I have had less problems with connections in Memphis than any other hub in the southeast Two years ago we dropped our year old daughter off for a flight to her grandparents We left for parts far and wide before the flight departed as we knew she was in good hands This wound up being one of the occasions when mechanical problems caused a delay The staff called me on my cell phone and explained the options to get my daughter to her destination We chose to allow her to stay and wait for the next flight that afternoon as her arrival time would not have varied much had we turned around and put her on a flight out of HSV I asked that they make sure she was fed since her wait would go over lunch time Long story short when we checked to see how she accomodated the staff insisted my daughter accompany them to lunch and picked up the tab She was provided vouchers for the hour layover in Memphis and the staff explained in detail how to use them where the eating places were located in Memphis airport etc She was treated exceptionally well and other than the long day actually enjoyed learning about the pitfalls that face air travelers at times first hand The same smiling faces that helped my daughter two years ago are the same ones that greet you at the counter today My only complaint is the limited flights dont allow me to fly out of the shoals as often as I would like

Flew out of MSL for a trip last month June Booked on the morning flight and was scheduled to arrive at my destination in the early afternoon on Northwest Airlink However due a mechanical issue the morning flight was canceled Northwest AirlinkOperated by MESABA called me at home and already had me booked on the late afternoon flight to Memphis getting into Arkansas that evening When time came to catch the connecting flight we had a gate hold due to severe weather over the airport in Memphis Finally arrived at my destination about minutes late I have to give the MSL Northwest crew a Job Well Done They showed excellent customer service and did everything they could to make my flight out as pleasant as possible Mechanical issues come up from time to time and the weather tends to throw a curve ball at us causing one to adjust travel plans This is to be expected The return flights operated on time from gear up to gear down from Arkansas back to Memphis on into Muscle shoals Weather Clear skys and mild temps during the trip home We even arrived in Muscle Shoals about minutes ahead of schedule As Mentioned in my previous comments MSL is a good alternative to other nearby airports Parking is just a day and if you book weeks ahead you can get fares lower than at the other larger nearby airports Granted flights are limited and experienced some challenges on my last two trips out of MSL Will continue to utilize the airport for future trips One additional fact Avis Rental Car does have a Rental center adjacent to the airport terminal building They Do Not have a counter inside the Terminal only Enterprise Rental Car does If North Alabama and Southern TN are in your plans check out MSL as an alternative to other nearby airports

The worst experience ever Very poorly organized and very poor quality Lack of staff and lot of waiting If you transfer remember that you have to go out and do the security check again which takes ages Security are very grumpy and unfriendly If anyone is planning to carry on a skateboard forget about it Mine got confiscated due to the airport rules even if I havent had any problem anywhere with this and I have been traveling with my skateboard for last years Avoid this airport

Lives up to its name no signs chaos rude airport staff overflowing rubbish bins of flight delayed and no aircon but great food Unless one wants to fly to Rome and drive not many options to visit Campania and it is worth visiting so just have to roll with it and accept it

Last week January my wife and I flew out of Nassau Bahamas We arrived at the airport two and a half hours early for our Delta flight to Atlanta Georgia I along with about other passengers was randomly selected by the US Transportation Security Administration TSA for extra security screening My wife went through the regular security screening The security screeners took an unbelievable to minutes to screen each passenger in the extra security line There were eight passengers in the extra screening line ahead of me More than two hours passed before I was screened As a result I missed my flight and had to rebook another flight to Atlanta and also rebook my connecting flight to BaltimoreWashington Airport My wife waiting over two hours for me to be screened chose to not get on our scheduled flight but to wait for me Almost all the passengers in the extra security screening line missed their flights

Probably the most difficult thing is to get to this airport If you are not staying in the hotel but in private accommodation as we did and you are far from Nassau downtown you will hardly see any taxis around There is no bus going directly to the airport You might ask the driver of bus route to drop you off at the nearby roundabout and then walk around half a mile to the airport The airport itself is divided into three different section You must have in mind that you cannot just ask from which terminal your airline departs as that also depend on your destination The US departures have a separate terminal
