Been living here for years If you ever park you car in the airport parking be sure for remove any important items from the car I have had my car broken into twice in during parking while on business trip It is simply the worst airport in Europe in regards to parking security and the airport police are doing anything to help or enforce security Apart from that service is generally pretty French as in none existing

I was waiting with my fellow traveller to board my BA flight on September nd We were hoping to have a glass of wine and something to eat at Bellota Bellota where we usually stop However this time there was no one to be seen I and several other travellers waited for minutes to no avail I walked just inside the area to check if there was a notice computer till wines food etc were all open and unsecured I turned by the unsecured opening and an enraged and shouting female demanded what I was doing I explained she said that there was no one to cover for her and that she was entitled to a break I returned to my seat and this female came screaming over to me seated with other passengers asking if I had photographed her as I had no right I hadnt I am an older female and found this altercation embarrassing and humiliating and not up to the high expectations of wonderful Nice Airport I have been using Nice since you could walk to the plane

At T Checking in was ok and so was security screening Walked into the departure area and it was filled with a queue for passport control I set my stopwatch and minutes later was finally through The biometric readers were out of action so everyone had to use the human inspection method I have never experienced such poor management

I am writing this because we are currently having a bad experience of Nimes Airport This is the worst airport experience Ive ever had The main problem is the lack of basic logic used in relation to the queuingcheck in system In very small writing one queue is marked as bag drop If you mistake this for the queue to go through to security which many did then you get turned away by a disinterested staff member and told to join the other queue Even if you do check in luggage you cant go through the door to security Instead of utilising the many potential entrances they were determined to make everyone in the airport form one queue and not for lack of staff If the airport read this then I would suggest letting people go straight through at that point And make your signs clearer Once through security you are welcomed with a lovely waiting room Phew

Ive been using Nimes Airport on and off for years and never found anyone working there particularly friendly or helpful maybe its because most of the interior is painted black During my last visit Oct I was subject to a new rip off they have devised They advertise parking deals which have to be purchased in advance so I asked to buy the month deal for the advertised tariff of euros The guy took my money wrote out my receipt and prepared a little plastic credit card for me to use for entry and exit When I asked why my expiry date was shown as st March he explained that all parking contracts have to start on the first day of the month so despite the date of purchase being th Oct my pass had to start on st October Furthermore there was an additional euro fee to issue the card My other memory of Nimes is the airport restaurant Service there was so sloppy and slow that despite having nearly two hours available it was never possible to eat all of your rather poor quality overpriced course meal without missing your flight Other gripes The little newspaper book shop closed in and has only recently reopened I would say in summary that I only use Nimes Airport if I have to Nearby Beziers is a much better option if you have a choice

A very small quiet airport and with only a few flights a day checkin is very quick and hassle free Probably one of the easiest airports I have ever used as long as transport to and from the airport is planned in advance or is directly connected to your flight Between flights a great silence descends on the place In the main hall there are several car hire desks one cafe stand offering good quality hot sandwiches and a small restaurant upstairs for those needing a traditional large French lunch There are no shopping opportunities either in the main hall or in the departure lounge a small cafe stand there The main point is that because there are so few flights passengers are easily organised and you are unlikely to spend much time at the airport and what could be better When arriving you need to rent a car OR pick up the ONE shuttle bus service linked to the flight that will take you into Nimes city OR have a friend collect you There is a taxi rank if you need to leave at a time not linked to a flight but taxis seem very infrequent we once needed to leave the airport at a time not connected with a flight and waited half an hour for a chance taxi to arrive as there is so little activity apart from the few flights a day The rentacar car park is directly across the road from the airport main exit just a few steps Most customers seem to use Hertz because it is advertised with Ryanair but there are several other car desks and it would pay to plan ahead and find the best deal regarding rates and maybe avoid the problematic and hefty supplementary insurance fee that Hertz offer unsuspecting customers on arrival Going back to the airport after a stay in Nimes there is just one shuttle bus per flight Dont miss it There are four points in Nimes city centre where the shuttle can be picked up and the main hotels have the timetable The hours on the hotel timetable were slightly different from the times displayed on the bus stop but the hotel timetable seemed to be the correct one The time allowed between shuttle arrival at the airport and last checkin time seemed too close for comfort but in fact it was fine just right and things work smoothly because there are so few flights Going back with a hire car the airport is very close to exit on the A autoroute very easy access Hertz and perhaps the other companies also have a base in Nimes at the railway station where a car can be collected or left as an alternative to the airport

Nimes is one of the most pleasant airports Ive experienced Its quite small is a favourable alternative to Montpellier for those of us whose eventual destination is in the Herault area not least because of its close proximity to the motorway and current absence of major roadworks It is a place to relax and stroll about while waiting to meet incoming friends and carparking is a doddle The flight to and from Liverpool with Ryanair is direct

Great Little Airport easy to find just off the motorway Departure Lounge only has seats toilets drinks machine but allows own food Reception is again sparse of amenities but has small cafe souvenir shop of camargue items at a hefty price Car park is literally opposite Disabled passengers have toilet share toilet with baby changing No disabled lift to from aircraft local fire crew manhandle wheelchairs down stairs very scary

Modern airport medium in Chinese terms Incoming by bus from runway efficient and fast very simple to get your bearings Outgoing fast very clear information very efficient checkin good facilities About min from city center

I have been flying out ofinto Norfolk airport my whole life and have always had a pleasurable experience with it this time was no different The Southwest checkin agent was very friendly as were the TSA employees at the checkpoint My bag got flagged as a possible explosive but luckily they figured out it wasnt A major plus ORF has to offer is its new bathrooms which were installed less than a year ago These are sleek modern and wellmaintained by airport staff The terminal itself reflects the era it was built in with smaller windows and lower ceilings than say SEA Instead of inducing claustrophobia though it gives the entire a building a more cozy feeling New seats at the gates with electrical outlets are also a major plus allowing you to charge your phone while you wait for your plane One downside of Norfolk International though is the WiFi It is very hard to connect to and hardly works Aside from that though this is a small practical nofrills airport that is impossible to get lost in and is located near the Norfolk Botanical Gardens another positive

As someone whos travels constantly for business Norfolk Airport is honestly the worst airport I have ever been through I have traveled through here well over a dozen times and not once had a pleasant experience here The ticketing agents are rude The TSA are frustratingly incompetent The airport is dirty and falling apart in many areas If you have any other option of airports I suggest you use it

It is a second tier nonhub airport so traffic is lower As others have noted it is surrounded by a botanical garden so the setting is beautiful Recently all of the food options were significantly upgraded Security moves quickly and efficiently The arrivals area is large and conveniently located next to the parking garage for a quick departure Rental car counters are right in the arrivals area Which brings me to the only negative waits for checked baggage are noticeably longer than almost any other airport Figure on a minimum minute wait Would recommend getting your rental car while you wait on your bags

Over the years have had the pleasure of travelling through this airport surely the best planned facility of its size anywhere in the world Maybe all wouldbe new airport planners should pay Norfolk a visit to see what a well designed airport should look like and thats not even mentioning the surrounding beautiful botanical gardens a very pleasant change from the usual grimy industrial areas adjoining most airports

Departed yesterday to Canada Inside the airport was like a sauna where you go to burn off excess fat it was unbearable last July came airconditioning wasnt working in some areas this year its worst theres no way this could happen at Sangster international airport it a shame people were almost half naked trying to cope Stripping down to accommodate the heat And on top of that the airlines wouldnt even do their progress much quicker Very disappointed as a Jamaican Please do better those fans that look like propellers not cutting it was so sorry for the staff Please you can do better

Arrival on a rainy day looking forward to breakfast ours was a lunchtime flight and we arrived in good time not much queueing to check in which was a good start However the restaurant stopped serving breakfast at around am stating it would not be ready in time for the flight the attitude of the people behind the counter seemed annoyed that I would be asking for breakfast at am I dont quite know what they were going to cook on that would take so long to produce a breakfast the only thing they were able to provide was tapas for breakfast I think Norwich Airport ought to reconsider their choice of restaurant provider as they dont appear to be able to provide basic food quickly which is what you need at an airport bearing in mind they already know how many people will be coming though the airport every day The choices after that were also limited both food providers stopped providing food around midday and then the only thing available were sandwiches which was ok for my husband but I am gluten intolerant and so this was not an option for me the best I could find was a packet of crisps and chocolate bar not such a a great breakfast This was such a disappointment for the start of our holiday Flight went on time Our return flight from Crete was delayed by a day and TUI dealt with this very well When we finally arrived back at Norwich airport late at night I was amazed to the see that the same old creaking held up by plywood luggage conveyer belt was still there the same one I remember being there many many years ago The noise was deafening squeaking you could see all the passengers looking at each other wondering if the luggage was going to make it up the onto the conveyer belt It does make you wonder what all the airport tax is exactly being spent on The experience at Norwich airport has not inspired me to use the airport again I do understand the delayed flight was not directly their fault however he size of the airport played a role in the ability to replace the flight But I dont think we will be flying through Norwich any time soon

Just had to leave this review on th May returned from Rhodes and my flight was delayed two hours Just after midnight left baggage reclaim to go to my car I had a flat battery and was unable to get into my car It was exceptionally cold and all I was wearing was shorts and a tee shirt I returned to the terminal where I met the staff at the parking desk At this time the terminal was empty and they were locking up The staff came out and helped me gain entry to my car but I had a two hour wait for the Green Flag breakdown The staff waited with me almost an hour and had to go home leaving me alone in the car park freezing cold but not before he returned to his office made me a hot cup of tea and brought it to me in my car A beautiful act of kindness and one I will never forget

Where do I start I travel with a folding mobility scooter I usually fly out of Stansted with no problems But the staff at checkin did not have my scooter registered with my ticket they said it was the first time they had to check in a mobility scooter After a long procedure they finally got me checked in with a lot of help from me Next was security As I had no checkin luggage I had my toiletries in a plastic bag in my cabin bag I was rudely told that my plastic bag was not the correct size I said that unfortunately Tesco does not supply airport plastic bags She just scowled at me and produced a plastic bag that was a little smaller than mine and said I would have to take my items out of my plastic bag and put them into the other plastic bag Unfortunately one of my items would not fit the deodorant which she said I would not be able to take onboard Finally getting through the security I saw a convenience shop and popped in to buy some juice I then noticed a shelf of travelsize toiletries so I bought deodorant and just to stick it to the airport security I also bought some hand cream I put all the items into my original plastic bag and boarded the plane On my return flight the security at Amsterdam Airport did not even bother to question my largersize plastic bag The security staff at Norwich Airport has this inflated sense of their own selfimportance I had booked a taxi to pick me up on my return and as it was raining I wanted inside the airport terminal until I received a text from the taxi letting me know he had arrived I walked out of the terminal but could not see my taxi I walked back inside and asked the girl in the office where do the taxis pick up and was told I had to walk down to the car park After paying that pound airport improvement fee I had to walk down to the car park in the rain absolutely appalling The only reason I flew out of Norwich Airport was because I was going on a short holiday to Amsterdamt Worst airport in the world and I have traveled through airports in developing counties

Poorly organised and limited airport with backwards practices The first issue is that the long stay car park is not signposted you are funnelled into the short stay with no way to back out and the contact on the exit barrier then acts surprised at your mistake even though others were doing the same just for the short time we were there Next is a Development fee that all adults are required to pay on checkin at around I was aware of this before attending but it feels like a ripoff as there are no modern amenities to speak of its the sort of scam you expect in a banana republic We had to wait hours for a replacement aircraft as ours had a technical fault and although this is not directly the airports fault I cant help wonder if the issue could have been dealt with at a betterequipped airport There are lots stories about the issues caused by the fact the airport closes over night Our return flight was affected by this not because we travelled late but because a delay to our aircraft because due to this from the early morning where it had to divert to the midlands Then final point and the one that left the bitter taste in my mouth and the reason for this review was that when I went to leave the prepaid carpark hours late because of our delay I wasnt allowed to leave until I paid a fee for the overstay With the fact I paid them for the parking and the development fee this felt like daylight robbery and the man on the barrier intercom simply told me it wasnt his problem and to contact my airline Overall a poor show Norwich Stansted is slightly closer for me and friends laughed when i said I would try Norwich that it would be backwards and not fit mof the modern age unfortunately you proved then right

Pretty boring airport Not much on the way of amenities or food places Lack of working power plugs and comfortable places to sit Rude cleaning staff Staff at S lack basic English competencies Only recommended for short layover hours or less

A friendly airport if you just want to watch the planes from the viewing area but not passenger friendly poor layout Up a lot of stairs for passport checks when you arrive Had to go through security the past twice on departure the both times they claimed I had passed through a public area after the first check Security patdowns are embarrassingly intimate

Having walked up and down several flights of stairs and then left standing on them to get to Passport control If any accident had happened we would have been stuck on the stairs Health and safety measures need to be examined there Passport control at this airport was extremely slow Queues of people with no toilet facilities was very disappointing They need to get their act together

Nuremberg is an amazingly convenient and fast airport You get there easily by public transportation from the metro station to check in its not even one minute walking and you can be at your gate within minutes of arriving Baggage delivery is quick mostly your baggage is already at the conveyor belt when you get there

Extremely ignorant staff particularly a female on the gate She was the cause of patient passengers awaiting an explanation becoming upset and feeling mistreated She waved her finger in one persons face She shoed another passenger away with both her hands She stood with her arms folded grinning Her manner is appalling and perhaps would be more suited in a prison The gentleman on the desk downstairs however was the complete opposite He was understanding and compassionate The row of employees downstairs knew who I meant when we mentioned this female to them It is not the first time was one comment Another passenger has witnessed her vile behaviour on a previous trip This one employee is the reason I will never return to Nuremberg airport The security process was good The food was very poor No warm food just sandwiches and pretzels The airport was clean Transport to the city was quick and easy

Public transportation to and from the airport is great Easy access to the city center and local attractions However the employees that work at the gates are by far the rudest I have ever encountered as a traveler If the job is that stressful then maybe customer service is not for them Carrying on a personal conversation while passengers are trying to ask questions about the gate or delay times of a flight is probably not the right thing to do

Its always very relaxing to fly from to Nuremberg Its a really small airport but everything works so easy and uncomplicated You can get there easily by train a subway station is directly in front of the entrance or by car you can park just min walk away checkin is very fast and boarding too There is no shopping and not that many food options but when you just want to get relaxed and easy from A to B its perfect And the staff are nice too even the security staff is always goodhumored More airlines should use this airport

Bagan airport as most westerners will know is a small domestic terminal all very efficient as they do not seem to use computers Bags are weighed at check in luckily as a group of they just calculate all the luggage together which in my case was good as I was overweight Again usual screen luggage before entering departure lounge which is small with a caf for Tea or Coffee and rows of plastic seating again unable to hear announcements but they give you a sticker to put on your shirt so they know who is on which flight

What a dump Arrived in the morning only coffee shops open and each had lines out the door No other food options On the return trip layover I made the mistake of stopping by a Mexican restaurant The menu was limited and food tasted like reheated frozen food The layout is poorly thoughtout The queues for the airlines spill out into the walkway Anytime a flight is about to take off you are unable to pass through the area Worth avoiding if possible

Compared to SFO SJC and SMF OAK is a total dump Food selection is really poor The airport closes food vendors and the walls stay up for years The terminal is very small The location and weather at OAK are good but thats it
hours at custom check point That never happened to me before One person helping over people Will never go to that airport again for an international flight

A security agent found some old coffee in a mug in my carryon and refused to dump it in the garbage can right next to us but made me exit and go all the way through security again Extremely discourteous There is no valid security reason to inconvenience someone this way when there is a garbage can right there They order everyone through in a hurried rush but apparently dont care about increasing traffic and passenger delay by doing this I tried to submit this complaint to the Oakland airport through its website but surprise complaint messages arent going through
If given the choice I will always fly into Oakland over SFO Its small efficient and flights are most of the time on time With the new BART connector train its super easy to get to

Flight DI landed at and waited mins for a gate at pm After clearing immigration at there were no bags It as pm before we exited the airport after landing Someone wasnt doing their job That delay for bags on top of lack of gate capacity is unacceptable service This isnt a one off Other family members had a similar experience on June for the same flight where they waited minutes for a gate again and werent allowed to deplane for another minutes due to a backup in the immigration hall Departing OAK June was another exercise in lack of airport capacity Checkin took an hour The gate had people sat on the floor everywhere due to lack of space for the size of the aircraft OAK isnt equipped to handle the number and size if international flights currently using the airport There are similar reviews from a year ago Clearly Oakland Airport management dont care about customer service

We arrived and departed on the BA flight from LGW Arrival was amazingly quick It took less than half an hour to deplane go through passport control and collect bags Being a Club World passenger undoubtedly helped but even so we were pretty impressed There was almost no queue to go through security at the time of departure lunchtime midweek so the process was painless Again we were lucky that it was so quiet A new business lounge has just opened by Gate Its rather small but has good food choice Getting to San Francisco is a cinch using the BART connector shuttle to Coliseum and thence onwards to downtown San Francisco In fact the whole experience is much better than at SFO And because of the competition between BA and Norwegian fares from the UK are very reasonable at present

As we speak the new terminal is only used for arrivals Departures still go through the old dated terminal My first complaint is that there are no baggage trolleys at the parking place Very uncomfortable My major complaint is about how departing passengers are transported to their waiting aircraft on the platform A bus waits outside the gate and is so crammed with passengers that I worry some elderly people or children may become unwell especially in the summer heat A second bus is waiting behind Its an absolute insult to passengers that this second bus is rarely used Odessa Airport you are treating passengers worse than pigs

Firstly poor info there is no airport mapplan nowhere on internet let alone on their web site The good info should also include that the trolleybus minibus works from till So the airport is OK and the queuing times are good At the arrival one waits up tp some min if there are no other planes passengers coming The taxi people are annoying but bearable The airport is practically in the outskirts suburbia and well communicated by minibus also one can walk some min to the nearest tram line if they wished trams work till There is a kiosk with food and drinks plus a freezer with icecream Several exchange offices rates are a bit worse than those of the city centre vs per euro No shopping in departures is rather a pleasant surprise

The most horrible service I have experienced Staff are rude ambience is stressful and not organized Even domestic flights seem like a nightmare as staff do not know how to be professional and organized Big attention to people who will travel from October if you dont have a printed ticket the airport has a right to charge you which is ridiculous How is it possible nowadays to charge for what you have already in the system

I travel for business every week so clock up a few miles and experiences along the way rd time through Odessa and I can say it doesnt get any better The airport is tiny and you would at least hope their process and procedures would be top draw Well you would be wrong Poor process compiled with staff who dont give a damn about the pain passengers are suffering just makes it the worst airport I have been to The staff dont realise they are in a service industry so do not smile and are surly and rude How can Kiev get it so right while this big holiday city airport cant times I have had to experience this coupled with the poor Turkish Airlines service that means I missed my connection today and write this from my hotel room in Istanbul Honestly I would trust these people to run me a bath let alone an airport

Arrived and departed as a domestic traveler between Tokyo Narita and Okinawa Naha Small and basic area for both arrivals and departure check in with only one small shop selling some souvenirs and cold drinks and a hot coffee stand but no actual food for lunches etc On departure the waiting area again has very limited food options with one small souvenir shop only offering some anaemic looking ham sandwiches There was one actual food stand but the sole employee was working at such in incredibly slow pace that after minutes waiting without being acknowledged that along with another passengers I had to give up waiting still hungry as my plane was now boarding A nice and easily navigated small airport with very friendly staff but I recommend bringing your own food with you

The international terminal of Okinawa compare to the domestic one is a lot smaller Like all other airports in Japan signage is clear clean and very organised Be warned the early birds for flights may not get the worms what I mean is due to its small size and limited counters available Very often an airline will only open its counter for check in at hours before the departure time There is no benefit to arrive early as you cant checkin yet plus very limited number of seating and restaurants The number of gifts shops and food stores after immigration is also very limited to a scanty few It is a little underwhelming so just dont expect too much its nothing like Osaka or Tokyo

Okinawa Naha Airport has parts International and domestic This review refers to the international departure The building is separate to domestic it is relatively smaller than the domestic counter part Very limited seating before immigration and small numbers of check in counter result in carefully timed and limited use by respectively airlines If you arrive early you often have to wait patiently for the check in counter to open Things improved after passing immigration and security However very limited number of shops available for that last minute souvenir hunting There is a small but functional lounge upstairs for use by premier customers As an international airport Naha is functional but small in every way

It appears that conditions at Naha have changed somewhat in the two years since B Walberer commented on it While I havent been inside the domestic terminal the international terminal was small clean and efficient There are two restaurants in this terminal now The number of retail establishments is still limited but that wasnt a problem While I had to board a shuttle from the plane to the terminal upon arrival an airbridge allowed me to board the aircraft directly on the return flight One thing Naha could improve on is the waiting time to go through immigration upon arrival
I live here and fly regularly New terminals are open airy and plenty of seating Limited but appropriate shopping Nice caferestaurant selection for a small airport Security swift and courteous

Easy in and out airport Decent selection of food outlets and shopping options for an airport its size Flew in for a day trip to visit and old friend and had no issues whatsoever Security screening was a breeze less than minutes Flew in and out of the B concourse

I was brought to the airport by a friend There is both adequate paid parking and also free minutes for drop off and pick up The terminal building is a little dated but it functionas well There were a couple of flights being checked in while I arrived and there were sufficient counters open so that queues were reasonable The security check was fast and worked well You then went upstairs where there is a lounge and cafes and space to sit Boarding in my case was on a bus but no problems

Well obviously no one reads this or even cares about it as nothing happens and my issues are similar to the ones everyone else is having Staff are extremely uncooperative and using language that is not understandable A person just said You alarmed as if we were supposed to know what that means Next thing we know is that they need to check our hands because we could be hiding something on our hands Next thing they say its just lotion or something Does the advanced technology that we use not tell the difference between harmful substance and lotion I know nothing will happen from this as no one even cares especially those from the airport but someone does need to care

They are restricting UberLyft but there should be a Cab at Airport We have to call a cab to go to the Airport which is ok but when we arrived there was no cab We tried to call several cab companies but they would not come to the Airport There should be phone numbers listed so it would be easy for Arriving passengers When we got a cab the driver told us that due to some reasons no one wants to come to the Airport so there are very little cabs available We travel lots so used John Wayne LAX San Diego Airport but this one was the worst experience on getting transportation How you can develop airport without proper transportation

At am on a Monday morning there were literally hundreds of people waiting to go through security Clearly everyone is frustrated with this idiocy I travel for a living and I can tell you this is unacceptable and incredibly incompetent to be so understaffed and unprepared Foolishness

Arrival it took over hours to clear immigration people working at the immigration gates Departure hours to get through security gates not open We were on an international flight so had to be at the airport hours before due to poor reviews we arrived hours before our flight Once through immigration food and drink availability horrendous Will never use this airport again

Leaving travelers sitting in the tarmac for over an hour when there is no weather on site after a cross country flight is not acceptable We can see the weather now rolling on meaning this hour will be extended further escalating aggravation onboard The airline was quick to clear us as landed in their system to give the facade of a timely travel experience but that is a complete fabrication of the truth MCO needs to improve the quality of the experience for a city that is supposed to be welcoming of its travelers

Why is MCO getting worse with each passing week As a frequent flyer out of all three terminals across several carriers this airport is pathetic Between the sheer lack of on site parking the lack of employees that speak English and unimaginably poor ground service I loathe this place I will do anything I can to avoid checking a bag because I know I am in for a minimum of a minute wait at baggage claim Thats on a good day The wait for a gate to taxi to the wait for a jet way brought to the plane then the incredible inevitable wait at baggage Carry on only isnt always an option for me As one waits the announcements are made at times only in Spanish but when they do make it in English usually secondary to the Spanish its incomprehensible Listen at any baggage claim youll hear passengers complaining about them After a ridiculous wait when you finally get your bag its smash to bits EverySingleTime Of every airport I travel world wide my home airport MCO is a disaster

The TSA women are horrible with no manners They should be saying thank you for visiting come back again Instead they tell me this is not Universal this is Orlando International Airport when Im going through the scanner They speak harshly to some and are nice to some Second time departing Orlando and they tell me I have something between my legs They told me either they feel me all over in front of everyone or they take me to a room to strip down Mind you Im traveling with a small child They really need to learn courtesy and be more polite Is this how they are being trained This is the Jet Blue TSA one had gray hair and the other had red short hair They picked up my sun screen in my carryon but not the big Fuji bottle in my sons bag smh So much for checking and security

My wife arrived on Flight AD arrived PM sharp and my wife only left the luggagesimmigration at Between the airplane get the finger luggage available it took hour and minutes Immigration was quick Also the terminal does not have enough parking spaces for its current operations This was the third time parking A and C where closed and I had to park elsewhere Luckily I learned how to park at train station and walked minutes to airport C avoiding a minutes walking from B parking to C

This airport has a extremely large number of visitors Ground transport and flow to and from are fine Concessions facilities and restaurants are far and few between sit down bar restaurant for many gates waiting lines everywhere all facilities both male and female have long lines Very far behind the times would rather fly to any other airport in they area

I live in Orlando so use this airport frequently I dont know what is happening but it continues to get worse and worse I flew internationally for holiday and returned last evening April th I left out of Terminal A and returned to Terminal C I parked in North Lot Apparently you can take a shuttle from C to the South Lot but not the North Lot WHY So I had to take a shuttle to Terminal A to then take another shuttle to my vehicle in North Lot The shuttle took forever to arrive to C I saw other shuttles Mears off site parking etc circle two or three times while I waited for the shuttle to take me to A When it did arrive me and other other passengers all informed him we were going to A however he dropped us at Terminal B and told us that was his only stop So I then had to drag my luggage across the airport to get to Terminal A to catch the next shuttle That shuttle arrived slightly faster however the driver didnt even get out of his seat to help any of the passengers board He just sat there staring at us A nice passenger helped me load my luggage onboard I had asked a couple people in the airport how to get where i was going and one girl actually told me it wasnt her job to answer that question When I did get to my vehicle and went to pay and leave the attendant couldnt have been any more annoyed that I was trying to pay her She barely could extend her arm to take my payment and seemed severely pissed off she had to actually perform a function I traveled to three countries and therefore three airports and am sadly embarrassed how our city is represented with regard to our airport After customs and retrieving my bags it took me hours to get to my vehicle last night which is horrible Why is there no shuttle to North Lot from C Why doesnt the shuttle that is supposed to take you to A not actually take you to A Why are the workers so rude and unhelpful Really poor on MCOs part
Worst wheelchair assistance experience ever Attendant assigned to me did not speak enough English to understand my needs ended up parking me off to the side and walked away

Traveling to Florida with friends for a cruise our arrival was fine The departure was not We arrived at the airport around am our flight did not leave until pm We were fine with this and tried to make the best of it The airport was clean but there is limited food selections prior to going through security The employee at the registers was extremely slow and not very friendly When you pay plus for a burger and fries you would expect better service The Allegiant desk representatives were rude I asked how soon before our flight could we check bags I was told hours which was great but the representative didnt look at me smile or ask how can I help The absolute worst was the TSA agents extremely rude and arrogant They were demanding and extremely unfriendly

I would like to share a positive experience I had with airport staff on December I came back from a weeklong trip to find that my car battery had completely died We called AAA but it was a long wait time due to the holiday weekend A very nice gentleman in an airport pickup stopped by to check on us and offered to jump start the car He was respectful and courteous and saved us quite a bit of wait time We will forever be grateful for his kindness and professionalism

I was wondering why you do not have signs outside for departure and arrival areas that depict location Like at least ABC or D When your pick up person arrives you cant give them any notice of your location to pick you up because all the signs say the same thing

This airport does not have a designated line for Clear customers Instead Clear employees walk their patrons to the front of TSA lines cutting in front of travelers waiting in line This is especially problematic in the lines closest to the Clear checkpoint Our line was stalled for at least minutes while well over people were allowed to cut in front of us throughout our wait It took me a while to fathom why my line was not moving anywhere near as efficiently as other lines Rather than spread this inconvenience equitably throughout the TSA screeners the Clear employees used just the closest line and rarely the next few They were rude and clearly unconcerned about the inconveniencing other travelers waiting in line This elitism may be tolerated at Disney World but is shameful at a public airport

If you like large airports with lots of shops restaurants and people then Sanford is not the sort of airport you would appreciate However if you prefer a small regional type airport that you can pass through quickly both in and out without stress then I strongly recommend Sanford We now look at TUI flight options first simply because they use this airport The staff are friendly including immigration and security and yet its only about miles north of Orlando and roughly a minute drive to the Disney resorts We havent been here since but I can confirm from the time we started queuing for immigration to collecting baggage was only minutes Compare this to Orlando International where you would probably be held in a holding area due to congestion

When trying to find Gate at am all passengers were walking in circles as area was poorly marked that all Gates enter through same gate I started playing hostess so passengers could stop dragging their bags around Should be an easy fix with an extra sign or staff directing traffic

Very very poor experience A Wednesday middle of the day and there were two passport booths open Absolutely huge queues Waited over an hour You expect this in poorer countries over the world You do not expect this in one of the supposedly most civilised and wealthiest Really unacceptable Spoils things a lot Not good Norway not good at all

Badly organised extremely chaotic and long passport queue For a country that manages exceptional feats of engineering and superb tourism all around the country it is extraordinary that it fails to organise such a basic airport function leaving millions of air passengers with a really negative impression of the country as they depart The Oslo airport building itself is modern and impressive this is simply a case of bad management With a decent plan it could be fixed if they can be bothered
Poor signposting of amenities The Information desk was closed in arrivals I tried to find the walkway to Radisson Red but only found it by accident

There was one entrance for two gates Also there is no display in front of the concerned gate for which airline city the flight is flying to As they give more importance to Norway language and the slang of the English it is very difficult to go through the gate by simply assuming

Avoid this airport if you have a wheelchair I travelled through Oslo airport with my year old disabled mother yesterday We flew in collected our suitcases and stood in line to recheck our bags on a British airline We had three hours and plenty of time to check in First the woman at the checkin was told by someone in Cargo that they wanted a photo of the battery Then they asked for some obscure information about the battery that we did not have and told us we could not fly unless we somehow produced a paper with the information My mother has been disabled for years and has flown several hundred times on flights in Europe and the USA with the same model of wheelchair she still uses Its a well known brand We have only ever been asked for the weight and dimensions of her wheelchair and the type of battery dry cell and how it turns off by key After standing there for an hour and a half another checkin person finally found some information online and we were told to go as quickly as possible to the gate I asked for help getting there as it was minutes before the boarding time I pleaded with the checkin person to get our suitcases on board they had been taken off the plane half way through this incident No help was given as we had to negotiate security the length of the airport and passport control by ourselves There was no time to use a disabled toilet which we knew from our trip through Oslo a week earlier had a broken seat and was dangerous which resulted in my mother not being able to use a toilet for hours she cant walk to use the ones on the plane This was a nightmare experience which only got worse when we landed at the next airport

Could have been quite nice small airport but some things has to be improved Its always understaffed security passport control cleaning and maintenance Especially on holiday time Its always the same management forget to check the calendar for holiday or peak times For the cleanness and tidiness looks like management fired everyone hired some incompetent externals and never leave their office chair to walk around the airport and check how nasty it looks

This was my second trip to Oslo this year but I have never experienced such an interrogation by Norwegian Immigration during my previous visits You would think that coming from a country with one of the most powerful passports in the world would help Im not trying to sound arrogant but one would expect that Oslo Norway Immigration would have done their due diligence regarding passengers arriving in their country especially given the high number of tourists As someone who travels frequently the officer would have seen that I have visited Norway numerous times before and would have access to intelligence regarding my background Instead I felt subjected to an interrogation with questions about what I was doing there how long I would be staying my return flight and the address where I would be staying This unnecessary scrutiny made me feel as though Norway does not welcome visitors and treats everyone like a potential criminal especially if their flight originates from Istanbul I understand the necessity of conducting checks on visitors but there is certainly room for improvement in their level of security and scrutiny

Check in procedure was absolutely a terrible experience Staff seemed very tired and frustrated Very few people working No staff checking how people put their belongings in the trays in the first place before entering the scanners only checking this carefully after the trays go into the scanners causing them to be returned back into the machines causing further delays and items getting lost In that procedure one of our ipads got lost causing further stress and anger even more anger when staff show no empathy at all Lines of people waiting and nothing moving Staff not helpful at all and not pleasant to deal with at all Very disorganized and this experience was totally unexpected from Oslo Airport It seems that very few people work over there in these types of jobs which could easily be replaced by more intelligent machines These staff members clearly seem to be tired frustrated and show lack of motivation to such a routine nature or work Our experience in Helsinki airport in comparison was wonderful and smooth They had super intelligent machines which did not require us to remove one single thing from our handbags and staff there were cheerful and very helpful

The staff in the Security check was horrible i have diabetes and my mother prepared the trip so I could have it easy when entering the plane But when we where going to put everything in boxes we clearly Said we cant put our cmg wich is a sensor that measure blood sugar through the body scanner and that I cant go through one they obviously didnt understand A man came and started to explain things and made us look like fools He also threw my things Down with a aggressive tone The staff Said I could go through a different machine instead and I thought that they probably know more Than me they broke the cmg wich made a mess Clearly the staff has no idea

A small airport where you can go from the luggage checkin to the gate within minutes There were enough places to sit down and the WiFi is good If you want to eat something before the security there is a restaurant with enough food pricequality top After the security you can also drink or eat something Boarding goes quickly

Ottawa is my home airport and given the population that it serves its very convenient It is not very large so it may not have some of the amenities larger airports will have showers multiple lounges etc but its fast clean and provides an acceptable amount of food choices Whenever possible I like to clear customs in this airport vs doing so in Toronto or Montreal

I really like this airport it is small and not complicated It is really clean and they have a small but nice section for kids to play Just wish there were more restaurant for the US side There are usually no delays The airport is a bit far from downtown so a bit expensive in taxi but hey they have Uber and lot of parking space

Arrived from London and agree with other reviewers about airport size and lack of walking needed to get through immigration and baggage claim Found immigration hostile to my wife US citizen but OK to me Inane questions and suspicious attitudes are unwelcoming Little choice of food in departures when returning to UK but interesting architecture and layout rivals new T at Heathrow

A fairly typical African airport I was not hassled for bribes or other payments Immigration and baggage reclaim were not a problem on the way in Departure was a bit confusing and facilities limited on the way out They are rebuilding the airport at the moment whilst it is in use So it is in a poor state but looks like it will be very good when complete No business lounge at present The airport is very close to the centre of Ouagadougou so no long drive is required to get anywhere

As a small airport on a poor island in a poor country so I did not expect much Previously I had arrived at the same airport As expected checkin was disorganised with locals carrying too much luggage in the form of large cardboard boxes Customs carry out a pompous but cursory examination of my old backpack Immigration checks fingerprints and take your photo after a bit of form filling After immigration you can go back outside the airport because security has not opened yet Security consists of a cursory search of the cabin bags You then enter the dismal departure lounge with only ceiling fans for cooling There is a decent toilet and that is about it At boarding there is another security check and the guy asked me to raise my leg so he could see the sole of my shoes I am not sure what that visual search achieved Later I saw the same security guys helping the aircraft to taxi If you want to see Anjouan you have no choice but to pass through this airport Keep your sense of humour

Second busiest airport in Finland after Helsinki now really quiet thanks to covid Terminal is reasonably big and has jet bridges so you dont need to go outside while boarding unless its a small turboprop like we had which cannot use jet bridges There are couple of shops a bar and a cafe and just like most other airports in Finland there are rocking chairs where to relax and even a piano anyone can play Checkin security and baggage claim went smoothly and fast since there were only a few passengers Airport is well connected to the city by buses and taxi

The airport is very small Only airlines go there Northwest Airlink United Express Midwest Connect and Comair by Delta There are only gates at the airport I flew there on Northwest Airlink and the guy that was at the check in desk also carried the luggage onto the plane Only CRJs go there There are very few shops so if you have a delay you dont have anything to do The nice thing about it is since that it is small you get through security very quickly Overall try to avoid it but if you have to then use it

Awful airport Not at all equipped to handle the number of people travelling through it Our plane was in queue to land and had to reroute to Jamaica because we were going to run out of fuel while waiting to land Two or so hours later finally landed Immigration hours of standing in line to get through Fast forward to departure again huge lineups and long waits to get through security no WiFi at the airport shopping is lacking food court is too small super long queues for every stall not enough washrooms again long queues for the small ones that are there not enough seating for all passengers The place feels crammed and overcrowded hot and miserable

They are not equipped to handle large crowds We arrived on a Saturday afternoon with other large flights It took hour just to get inside to the customs area and hours from the time we got off the plane until we left the airport No air conditioning no offer of water and no seating while lining up for customs For an island that depends on tourism they should be ashamed They are not equipped to receive air travellers

Arrived into Grand Cayman from Miami on Saturday night Immigration took minutes and bags were already off the belt when we came into baggage hall Only recommendation is a larger canopy by car pick up point as needed during heavy downpour we got very wet On departure took minutes from arrival to check in and clear customs check Limited seats at gates but more seats to right hand side as you enter departure lounge A bit warm but not too bad More space needed by desks at each gate as gets crowded Food and shopping limited but sufficient Few restaurants and duty free but food items very expensive Boarding is via walk to plane which is great if weather is good Passengers were crowding the gate before Boarding Zones were called All in all a good airport experience at a small airport

It is extremely unfortunate that the residents of the Cayman Islands paid such a significant amount of money for this airport remodel We departed Grand Cayman on Saturday March and it was absolutely horrible No place to sit waited in line for minutes for a bottle of water There are currently no restaurants or bars to have a drink at before departure The departure hall was packed wall to wall The air conditioning was obviously not size properly for the building and the amount of passengers We had a similar experience on our arrival We stood in line for over an hour to get through customs and immigration I have to say bring back the old airport it was actually better

Horrible security experience The random security checks were one in every people There was not enough staff to tend to security checks on a very busy day I stood waiting for a long time without my shoes as they were part of the security check items The guy checking took forever as he slowly emptied and scrutinized every single little item in my purse My children and husband waited for me at the gate as it took nearly half an hour just to get through with a random security check Worst security check experience ever and I travel often

Paderborn PAD is a regional airport supporting the OWL area PAD is mainly used for charter flights and has limited and unreliable access to other larger airports mainly MUC and FRA Overall I like my little airport but the Customs Officials have issues with foreigner and international travelers The Customs Officials are very unprofessional rude and enjoy bullying Their treatment will definitely spoil your vacation I am sorry but I cannot more recommend PAD for foreigners and international travelers

The airport and their airlines offer a wide range of European and North African leisure destinations but also large German cities such as Frankfurt or Munich Nice little shops and restauantscafes Staff are very friendly and the waiting times as well as the walking times are unbeatable Love flying fromto the Airport

A first class airport with a good range of facilities There does not seem to be the usual hectic atmosphere of most airports bringing back the pleasure into flying Decent food at non ripoff prices particularly recommend the caferestaurant on the mezzanine floor

A regional airport with very modern facilities catering mainly for leisure travel Lots of travel agents a decent checkin area restaurantbar glasswalled departure area airbridges in use There is a modest charge for parking near the terminal incl multistorey car park but car parks located a bit further away still just a few minutes by foot are free of charge

PKZ Airport is a small regional airport that is served mainly by Lao Airlines It has an international connection to Bangkok but mainly to other airports in Laos Small single floor airport with Departures at one end and Arrivals at the other end There is a CafeViewing place upstairs which provides very good views of the runway and apron where you can watch the few planes come and go In the main part of the airport is a Money Change booth and a couple of souvenir shops selling gifts books postcards etc and a Lao Airlines Office and the Airport SecurityInformation The Checkin Counters are in a room off the main Departure Entrance which has some seating just by the Passport ControlSecurity which lead into the Departure Lounge which has a very small but stocked ShopDuty Free No alcohol or cigarettes on sale which has some last minute souvenir opportunities There are also toilets in both Departure and arrivals areas and the main part of the airport Processing times very quick as flights are typically ATR sized less than people at a time The airport is very user friendly and things work well

I visited this airport last May Arrival here was a breeze with some improved facilities baggage claim was not chaotic like Jogja Departing from this terminal were welcomed by entering a narrow aisle however inside the terminal it was very big and lesscramped There were some shops along the way to the departure lounge Staffs were friendly but the terminal seating was a bit cramped and the WiFi here was just soso There are still some construction works at the time so it was a bit inconvenient Overall not a bad airport at all

Travelled to Palermo over the holiday period Whilst there has been some effort in improving the airport the place does feel quite tired at times and processes are less than smooth Staff generally dont speak English including alarmingly at immigration which is concerning at an airport which is an international gateway On arrival if you are held at immigration expect no explanation why and no attempt at communicating just silence and a blank stare while they hold your passport and keep scrolling on their computer Toilets apart from in the major departure halls are old dirty and not maintained although the ones in the main departure hall airside are now ok and seem to be regularly checked The ones through the nonSchengen area are quite traumatic to use and are filthy There have been concerted efforts to improve and modernise the shopping and food but this remains pretty poor General shopping is very overpriced compared to the city and the food poor value and of poor quality You would think as the last point to make a memorable impression of Sicily and also sell the island this would be a good opportunity to showcase the amazing food the island has to offer and also make the effort selling souvenirs but apparently not Gate areas are shabby and lack seating Not the worst airport but not a comfortable or pleasureable airport to go through

What a mess of an airport From TSA to space for waiting and eating The open airport area may be nice in the spring and fall but is not practical and dangerous during rain heat andor colder times Whoever thought this was a good idea maybe was ok many years ago but its not practical nor safe with huddle and bustle and people trying to get between gates and terminals quickly in the rain TSA is also not appropriately spaced and or staffed for the current passenger load Then try to grab a bite to eat and you are out of luck with the hour wait to get in and order food in the very small restaurant This airport needs a lot of work to safely and comfortably accommodate the passenger load

PSP is a beautiful airport in the secured area However the checkin to the security point is a long walk for the many retired people that travel through this airport The open air feeling is great in this warm climate The biggest negative is that when there is poor weather and those times are few is the lack of technology for pilots to land During a rain storm and low visibility we were delayed minutes while circling and then continued to Los Angelos then bussed back to Palm Springs

I arrived at PSP from SFO I have used the airport from time to time in the past It is quite capable of coping with its traffic but has experienced one major improvement whereby hired cars can now be collected on site This is very welcome especially when the heat is high

Small airport totally unfit for purpose when you consider the amount of pepple passing through Had desks open Waited until the queue reached Paphos harbour joke before they opened a third All in all over an hour of standing until we got through The eateries were all overcrowded with limited seating The info screens were very few and so small they were almost unreadable without a telescope Then we were sent through a gate to wait in a holding area in degree heat for minutes whereas we could have stayed in the cool All in all poor experience Would give it no stars if possible

After wonderful weeks in Cyprus my husband and I flew back home to Tallinn As this was our rd trip to Cyprus we were well prepared and everything went quite smoothly until we arrived at security I happily greeted the staff in English and began placing my things on the conveyor belt A middleaged male security guard approached me and began to make his demands in Russian I can understand Russian but my English is significantly better especially after weeks in an Englishspeaking environment I asked him to speak to me in English because I have already answered him three times in English and I dont speak Russian The official got angry at this and said in Russian that you are taught Russian at school in Estonia in fact the first foreign language in Estonian schools has been English for years and that the Russian language is not to blame in what he didnt specify I told him that he was attacking me by talking like that Then he turned to my husband still in Russian that they usually call the police in such cases My husband silently listened to the threat and we managed to leave I really didnt know that I had to learn Russian to pass the security check at Paphos Airport

I wasnt very impressed by the staff The two woman on duty did not appear to be helping visitors much Several of us didnt know which queue to join to go through passport control When I finally got there it was like questions They made me feel like a criminal Is this your first time in Cyprus Do you have house here Where were you in As if anyone can remember that I assured them it was my first visit to the island After some discussion between two if them they eventually stamped my passport and one of them slammed it down onto the counter I know they have to do their job but it wasnt very welcoming and they didnt have to be so rude

The lack of organisation and laid back attitude of staff at this airport is letting the whole of the holiday industry down in this area After touch down last night we were through customs and waiting for our luggage within minutes It took another hour for our luggage to arrive on the carousel Two of the carousels were working but neither of them had the correct flight numbers on so you were not sure where your luggage was coming from Our flight number never came up on either carousel There were was one member of staff trying to assist handicapped passengers and that was the only staff member I saw This was a very frustrating start to a week holiday The holiday industry in this area is relying on the staff and organisation of this airport to survive At the moment it is giving a very poor impression of the island

Very dirty noisy with boomboxes inefficient procedures outdated equipment Leaking roofs no proper waiting area before you enter immigration immigration is not permanently manned Avoid by all costs Very limited food sale Only positive are the very friendly people who handle the flights

Small airport checkin was quick and big smiles and friendly checkin agents Security took forever slow process and flight was early am departure so maybe that is why I cant imagine when KLM has a here and they are clearing people compared to a on Surinam Airlines Gate area is small and there are quite a few shops some were closed this early but when they are all open there are plenty of options No jetbridges so you get the experience of walking on the tarmac to your plane Toilets clean and prices in the shops reasonable Arrival is slow with immigration but bags were delivered quickly Plane parked close to the terminal and it was pouring with rain no umbrellas provided but wasnt too bad Airport is minutes from Paramaribo on a road with many speedbumps that is the biggest negative about the airport especially when your flight arrives at midnight and you dont get to your hotel until after am

I havent experienced Terminal E until today when I had my flight to Japan I was in airport hours before flight and I was in passport queue hrs before my flight and hr before boarding It was understaffed Our queue wasnt moving at all when they opened a separate queue of people way behind us and opened a new customs booth to let them in We waited for mins when I interrupted one of the info people saying our queue hasnt moved in last mins and that they took people from behind I was told this is not a restaurant and these are police when police has nothing to do with managing the queue and I was angry at the staff I nearly missed my flight if it wasnt for inefficiency of onboarding I was in L gate which you have to take another train and find your gate and security checks too it takes mins I am in France as expat and I rarely came across this behavior I find French lovely but this behavior in airports is only offputting and repulsive

Worst experience ever Waiting time for security over an hour unfriendly and not really helpful staff We had a long layover which saved us Its a maze with bad signage Next time I pay the extra and fly over Amsterdam

We were in transit on a Sunday night in January arriving into Terminal and connecting from Terminal and absolutely everything proved an obstacle The first flight was slightly delayed and we knew that we didnt have time to be too slow and had to change terminal to catch our connecting flight This included a train ride and a trip by bus The layout of the airport is pretty bad but the real problem is the lack of proper signage and the rudeness of the airport staff We tried several times to ask for directions but were met with shrugs not my job no English We were sent through security checks We ran but to no avail The gate closed before we got there and the staff said that they couldnt help us and left We had to spend the night in the airport with overpriced vending machines

It is disorganized and poorly laid out Signage is contradictory and confusing Do not attempt to get a ride share from the airport it is nearly impossible Following the detailed ride share directions to the pickup area will not yield a positive result The food options are abysmal and overpriced The airport layout is so random and lacking cohesiveness that its absurdly easy to miss connecting flights Security was a mess and you could expect it to take much longer than it should Also expect to have hand baggage weighed Even the WiFi sucks

This was probably one of the worst airports Ive experienced in terms of organization The issues started with the luggage dropoff process which took us hours We had to navigate multiple queues and deal with belt malfunctions that brought the line to a complete standstill for a significant amount of time Before security something Ive never encountered beforethey weighed our carryon luggage If your bag was even a few kilograms over the limit you were required to check it in In our case this could have easily been avoided since our checked luggage was under the kg allowance It felt unnecessary and poorly communicated The queues for passport control and security were long and tedious though I suppose this is typical of large international airports Still the overall lack of efficiency made it even more frustrating After all the stressful queues and delays youd hope for a chance to relax and grab a decent meal Unfortunately the airport offered very few places to sit down and even fewer options for proper food Most eateries were limited to snacks and there were almost no places to enjoy a real meal Ive traveled through many airports and this was one of the poorest in terms of seating and dining choices Overall the lack of organization poor communication and subpar facilities made this one of the most frustrating airport experiences Ive ever had

By far the worst airport experience I have ever had I will avoid this airport in the future at all costs On my way to Bangkok I nearly missed my connecting flight because of all the chaos at every checkpoint The signage is terrible and just trying to find your way around is a nightmare On my way back to the States I unfortunately had a hour layover here and paid for a closet with a bed in it at the airport yotel hotel The food selection was no better with only or restaurants if you can call them that of them all had the same prepackaged soggy sandwiches I honestly dont see how a city as popular for travel as Paris could have such a terrible airport I will fly through Amsterdam next time and take my chances

We arrived into the nonSchengen area of G and left the plane at am which was a late arrival We had to catch the flight to Oslo from BD D at pm Based on our experience it is normally possible to make such connection in other big airports eg Heathrow Frankfurt Schiphol if you follow signs walk fast and make an effort to skip lines at the passport control security using short connection as an excuse The BD transfer signs in G quickly brought us to the security check and then onto a shuttle bus which took us on a minute journey with the following itinerary GACTerminal and finally BD When we left the shuttle bus we still had hopes but our optimism started to fade when signs guided us to the second security check after the border control In the end we had made it to the gate by pm it had closed minutes prior to that and missed the flight It would have taken us up to rather than minutes with normal walking pace and no cheating in the lines Now the most important thing AF are all connected by pedestrian corridors which would allow you to both skip the ridiculous shuttle bus journey and reduce the number of security checks to one If you walk fast you will then make the connection Having said that you will never figure it out unless you are very familiar with CDG Dont repeat out error Dont trust the signs

Transited twice in November without problems Signage is good distances are large even within terminal e No problems either time though timings were circa an hour and a half Security check each time but fairly fast and efficient
