This is a very small airport on an island You have to get a ferry and a bus to reach it both free of charge It is in a lovely setting surrounded by trees The facilities are very limited with only one very small cafe no shops but that is all part of the charm

Arrived with no issue Bags were delivered in a timely manner rental car booth was easy to find and plenty of restrooms available The departure was another story altogether The line through immigration was a bit long and then security was even longer It kept moving so it wasnt terribly bad The airport has been renovated and the shopping area inside the terminal is new and very open The restaurants in the outer area before security serve their purpose but nothing fancy We were departing from gate B located on the lower level of the terminal We walked down the stairs into utter mayhem There must have been people all standing around waiting for their flights Then the announcements started this airline looking for Mr and Mrs So and So Then that airline looking for Mr Such and Such Then that flight being delayed until whatever Then all the while we heard nothing about our flight The scheduled boarding time came and went and finally the preboard announcement was made We were sitting but all the people around the gate started crowding in All the while the PA announcements kept going on and on We noticed the gate agent saying something and another surge from the crowd to the gate No announcement and we wondered what was going on so we walked over and found out that our section was being called to board Again announcements for every other flight in the airport not ours We got through and made it on to a bus to take us to the waiting aircraft only to sit there while two more boarding groups were called Total chaos mishandled by Delta

I only have one experience departure from this airport but not so good The problem is that they are unprofessional the border police probably never saw my eu resident permit and wanted to prove that is fake I lost more than hour and I needed to run to airplane with a small child However they had no reason to think it is fake Some police dont know or want to speak English Check in from counters were not working many people in row Security checking good

Small clean and efficient as some of the previous reviewers have said Outside of this the customer service needs major work in terms of communication between the customers and internal steakholders Had a flight delayed for over hrs for of those hrs there was no info on what fhe status of the flight was or anyone to talk too in regards to the flight Was stuck in the terminal with no way to get out

Travelled from Gteborg Landvetter Airport to Pristina in July and returned to Gteborg in August The airport of Pristina is very compact and small It has a restaurant in the checkin area and some shops In the departure area there is a dutyfree shop small but has some good stuff in it When arriving to Pristina we had to walk all the way to the arrival hall which in my opinion looks very old Baggage took a long time to get to the baggage carousels and they were on the wrong carousel They were on the carousel for a Swiss flight instead of where they shouldve been Staff were very helpful helped us to take the bags down from the carousel and explained to us that there was a misunderstanding between the staff But one bad thing is that they didnt bring baggage carts so we had to carry the baggage all the way to the car waiting for us but the walking distance to the parking is really short so frankly it was not a big deal When departing there were enough baggage carts and the whole checkin process and everything worked pretty smoothly and fine Theyre currently on the final phase of building the brand new terminal which can be seen from the runway Hopefully when I arrive and depart next time it will be from the fresh and modern new terminal

No change in Pristina airport It continues to be small and efficient The staff are polite and there is not much queuing On arrival the baggage arrived quickly The bar before the passport control is still the best place to wait Wireless internet in the departure lounge is free and works well There is a small but smart duty free shop

Back to Pristina in February The airport now has a proper baggage reclaim and is looking a little more finished The departure lounge has another shop and increased size It is still best to use the bar before immigration Overall this is still a good little airport

The airport has a capacity of million passengers a year It has two terminals passenger terminal and cargo It is a nice small airport There is a bar in the waiting lounge and also a restaurant a place where you can buy newspapers At the terminal it also a new Restaourant lot of airline companies has their offices in the airport building including British Airways Adria Austrian Airlines etc You can not sleep in the airport is closed after the last scheduled flight at pm Pristina center is very close as there is a Motel Aviano located km from the airport There is no buss service from airport to the city but the majority of travellers use taxi to get to the town The price is usually euro

Whats not to like about TF Green Airport It was recently ranked the d best airport by Travel Leisure readers Its newly remodeled bathrooms are like those of a star hotel Going through TSAPre was a breeze Cleared security in less than minutes Distances from security area to either end of the terminal are manageable WiFi is fast and worked flawlessly This used to be my home airport before I relocated to the Dallas area and it remains one of my favorite airports to fly through

This airport is consistently name among the best small airports in the USA Shops and eateries that were shuttered because of Covid have now reopened The airport is in the process of adding more amenities and concessions The newly renovated bathrooms are amazing Theyre brightly lit and significant improvement over the preexisting bathrooms Security was a breeze There was no line and I walked right up to the TSA counter and cleared security in less than minutes The distances from the security area to either end of the terminal are manageable WiFi is fast and worked flawlessly

There is a reason why this airport is consistently named among the best small airports in the USA Thanks to COVID some shops and eateries have shuttered and not reopened to date Security was a breeze There was no line and I walked right up to the TSA counter and cleared security in less than minutes There is a spill over of passengers from the gate area to the concourse nonetheless there is enough space to navigate the concourses The Escape Lounge is a welcome addition to this airport

This is by far the worst experience I have ever had with an airport I arrived an hour and minutes ahead of my flight and missed my flight due to a failure with TSA It took over an hour and minutes to have my carry on bag checked and to go through the detectors Also the workers were very rude about the whole process I overheard many people asking what do I need to do if I miss my flight I have somewhere I need to be at a certain time what do I do The response to these questions was youll just have to book another flight and take that up with your flight provider I understand that things happen and technology fails and situations occur but I was very disappointed with how the staff handled the situation I was also told just leave and come back before your flight Well not everyone lives around this area and not everyone is able or capable of leaving for hours and coming back whether that be due to funds or time constraints Due to my experience here at Providence airport I more than likely will not be returning mainly because of how unprofessional and how indifferent the staff was I hope that no one else has this experience
Very nice airport Small short ways with quick checkin short TSA waits short Gate walks and free wifi for minutes
Quick lines through security and it is a better option than flying out of Logan with the longer lines Airport restaurantsbars are limited but OK for all the longer that you will be there

Worst airport ever Long lines no seating and not helpful staff Unbelievably unorganized and constant delays Avoid at all costs We had a perfect trip other than this airport We will not be back due to this airport Again avoid this airport

This is by far the most screwed up airport I have ever been in and Ive been in plenty They seem to care nothing about visitors comfort or convenience I can hardly believe that they treat visitors to their island so poorly especially considering the high cost of staying there No place to sit or wait other than an overpriced bar yes even for an airport or a restaurant which is also overpriced with terrible service and unbelievably awful food its like no one cares which is the same vibe we get from just about everyone on Grand Turk as well Lines of people extending out into the traffic flow no place to sit and wait We were not even allowed to stand outside the airport on the pavement to wait for a family member arriving on another flight We didnt quite know what to do as there was no seating inside either The very rude airport personnel outside didnt help any either I have been to Turks and Caicos times now as I love the water and the excellent snorkeling but am now considering elsewhere at least until they get their act together with their airport Not worth spoiling the start and end of a vacation by having to deal with this airport

The airport customs are very long over an hour long and it is very hot The departure was the worse when you arrive everything is fine until you get to security they take again over an hour Once you get into the airport has some small shops barely any seats and the floor is dirty old carpet Their is a nice outside plane spotting area though No WiFi Though this place sucks you cant avoid it if you want to go to Turks and Caicos because its the only international airport on the island

My wife and I had a great time in Turks and Caicos Islands I was selected for a special search at the gate upon departure My wife was ordered to board the aircraft but refused She was informed that she would also be searched The female employee was very rude and abrupt to her I contacted the tourist website I was informed via email that this is a common complaint from visitors The gentleman wrote that he personally has been subjected to rudeness at this airport He asked for permission to forward my communication to the TCI airport authority where it will no doubt be ignored Turks and Caicos Islands is a beautiful place with wonderful people and a pitiful airport

The airport at Turks and Caicos is the worst airport I have ever experienced Turks and Caicos Islands are among the most expensive islands the require travelers to purchase insurance policies before arrival and then pack people like sardines in an unairconditioned airport Ive been to this island several times but will not return until they do something about this airport Absolutely disgusting

Cataratas del Iguaz International Airport IGR A small regional airport specifically to allow tourists to access the Iguacu waterfalls on the Argentinian side Checkin on the ground floor with a small number desks which open about hours before a flight Security up an escalator and were very quick Opens into a small Duty Free type shop followed by a cafe and a business lounge and then a Hard Rock Cafe Some seating by each of the gates which quickly get overwhelmed when A sized aircraft are on stand There are some work benches at the far end with stools and electrical plugs for charging All felt small but efficient and friendly Restricted view of the runway and apron through some frosted glass Boarding via airbridges relatively quick Runway small so takeoff quick so as not to block the runwaytaxiway

Puerto Maldonado airport serves those who travel to the Amazon Its small airport only or airlines operate flight daily Very organized Inside there are some shops and also there is one lounge for priority pass No boarding bridges Also they dont have luggage scanners They check all luggage by hand after you give your checkin baggage Overall good service

That airport is very close to downtown Puerto Princessa and is located around a green area Airport looks quite new and it was efficient to use Got my luggage within minutes Check in was also efficient There are some souvenir shops in departure hall and some simple food stalls After security check you find a waiting hall on second level is a coffee bar and a food stall in the departure level some shops which are not too expensive Overall a no thrills airport which is easy to use in all regards Free Wifi available

The Puerto Princesa International Airport had just opened its new terminal The terminal was clean and brand new The airport terminal had no jet bridge or ramp stairs so we had to deplane via an old fashioned staircase at the mercy of the weather thankfully at that time it was already dark The airport lacks formal transportation to the city center although the city streets is just a mere minutes walk away Definitely one of the best provincial airports in the Philippines if you consider dirt runways the norm

Clean airport but there are no drinking fountains and asking for a small amount at the food courts was refused They will sell you bottle water for Refused to pay that and found a cola for dollars I guess it is the last fleecing of airport guests before you leave

I love the PVR Puerto Vallarta airport It is clean and well organised It is reasonably well airconditioned allthough a few areas might be considered too cold Security is quick and efficient Walk ways and waiting areas provide plenty of space and there are work stations with plugins Directions are clearly marked and the airport is not huge There is a good selection of restaurants and shops My only complaint is that all the restaurants in the departure lounge close around pm That is unfortunate especially when your flight is delayed It is interesting considering that most people in Mexico do not go for dinner till about pm You also would expect them to stay open longer since this is an international airport and there are plenty of late flights This is by no means the only airport that has that problem though stars for food and beverages just because of times open The quality is great

After arriving you are assaulted by a phalanx of timeshare sellers and taxi and tour companies that descend like a plague of locusts When you finally manage to be able to leave through the doors there is another school of hungry piranhas who descend on you offering you highly overpriced taxi rates or tours Just exit to the left walk up the stairs and cross the pedestrian bridge to hire a taxi at one fifth the price Leaving isnt much better dont be surprised to pay dollars for a bottle of water or ten dollars for a crappy slice of pizza This place should be bulldozed and build something not controlled by crooks

As far as arriving expect a long line to Passport Control The wait was approximately one hour However the agents were very fast and efficient I believe they were so glad to finally get tourists to Mexico that they sped up the process inspecting passports At Customs you are required to press a button on a traffic light device If green you may proceed If red you will be approached by a Customs agent Once leaving Customs be prepared to be approached by people trying to sell you time shares or offering you transportation Its best to have your transportation prearranged as once outside the airport it is a madhouse As far as departure it can be hard to find a drop off point as traffic is very heavy Security was fairly fast and staff were pleasant Not a bad experience
The airport is hot and sticky They have AC but only use it to keep the temperature at around degrees There is a serious lack of information about flight delays and gate changes

Waited hrs in line for Sunwing to check us in There were people outside with the buses but only at the check in Numerous flights to check in people with only attendants not good service Westjet beside our line moved very rapidly

After being treated in a rude and abusive manner by some local person who decided he could hold up an entire Air Transat flight from Calgary February by slowly and methodically reviewing every passport supposedly looking for v entry visas knowing the flight originated in Canada we then had to depart today March Going through security they confiscated wooden knitting needles that my wife uses for intricate design Old and very difficult to replace We had already confirmed with the airline that we could fly with these onboard Also my wife flies internationally as an Executive VP of a major energy company Every flight every security around the world did not have a problem These incompetent people at security would not listen to our explanation used no common sense With these experiences arriving and departing thats it for Puerto Vallarta in our future travel plans

If you arrive at Pula Airport and you want to park your car it looks like a normal parking The first minutes is free of charge one hour is one euro that they didnt write what it cost for a day This is unbelievable because I was asking two police officers and they didnt want to answer me and when I go inside to the information office they only loss and say hello this is Croatia That means that you pay for one day of parking

Pula is one of my favourite airports to arrive to it takes sometimes min to get through I travelled to Pula in July and return experience was as usual quick swift and enjoyed the upstairs open space Arrival in September was the same The problem was the departure in September Transavia and Ryanair flights were one hour apart causing moderate number of passengers at the airport I arrived hr min prior to flight with hand luggage only and tried to pass the security There was nobody in the queue I was refused entry since the flight was not loaded on the system and asked to wait until h prior to scheduled departure This created surge of people at the exact time causing a queue at the security check without any social distancing measures At the ticket check after I had my boarding pass scanned I was asked to present UK Visas and Immigration document self isolation declaration to the airport staff There are two issues here and I hope somebody from the airport team is reviewing these comments As a healthcare professional and on the front line of COVID I am trying to distance myself The airport queuing system is doing exactly the opposite they are preventing a free flow of passengers and creation of queues I think this is a very poor practice putting at risk staff and passengers with large numbers of people without any good reason Another issue is being asked to present UK Government document to the airport staff I am following the rules and have paperwork ready but this is nothing to do with Croatian authorities and feel this is inappropriate invasion of my privacy I am afraid I hope this is a one off and next year we are back to normal

Worst airport in Europe I have ever visited Although the staff at the check in desks do their job they firstly dont do it with much of a smile but once checked in thats when the problems start We departed on a Sunday that had about flights departing roughly at the same time and it was total chaos trying to get through Security They only have conveyor belts trying to cope with about people all trying to pass through security at the same time The queue to get to one of the check points was about mins and it snaked around departures so much that eventually airport staff had to take charge and make the queuing line zig zag to avoid blocking the doors and check in desks Eventually because they knew that people would actually miss their planes they then started taking people out of the queue who were on the next flights and moving them to the front of the line Once you got to security the staff were rude with one security man physically shoving me out of his way so he could get to talk to one of his colleagues They snatch your belongings off you as you try and put them in the trays to go through the xray machine and shove your trays through before you have even finished trying to put your stuff in Awful place Id rather fly in somewhere else and drive

What chaos As others have said there is poor customer relations at this airport Queues for security and passport are horrendous taking hours as there are so few people working and then staff seem to spend time talking rather than providing a service No monitoring of other people jumping queues even though staff were standing around If you have to use this airport then allow loads of time Can not comment on any of facilities airside as we had to run for our plane after getting through passport control

Ive been flying in and out of Pula Airport at least four times a year for the past ten years and have witnessed the rise of passenger traffic back to its late ies levels Since this small regional airport caters primarily to tourists crowds are intense in peak summer months quickly outstripping the airports capacity to fluidly handle passenger flows Outside of that period it provides a really pleasant and refreshingly uncomplicated experience For its small size there are plenty of car rental agencies to choose from Resolving formalities of a rented car checking in and going through security takes no more than minutes Arrivals are similarly straightforward and if weather allows one simply walks the apron from the aircraft to the terminal building Services are basic with a coffee shop in the entrance hall another one in the departures area a wellstocked duty free and a tiny business lounge There is plenty of room for improvement particularly in the proactive assistance to passengers and providing uptodate flight information

This must be one of the worst airports I have ever used Arrival from the UK aboard a BA flight was fine although the queue through passport control was substantial The departure was a painful affair Long queues through security which is not geared towards catering for families was travelling with an month baby one cafe post security charging extortionate prices even for the most rudimentary sandwich one chaotic duty free shop and no waiting area to speak of tired and frustrated passengers were all herded together in the departures hall with the lucky few who managed to find a free seat carefully guarding it for fear of losing it if should they leave it for a second Free airport wifi does not work Airport staff unhelpful even if they see you struggling with a toddler and a pushchair you need to go down a flight of stairs to reach the plane and there is no help provided as soon as the gate opens there is a mad rush to reach the airplane and it is not possible to safely descend the steps whilst carrying a baby and a pushchair There is no baby changing facilities A horrid airport experience will not be using this airport again

Bearing in mind that the arriving departing passengers here are enjoying a holiday in Istria the welcome is not a good one Packed buses to the terminal when there could be an option to just walk the few yards to it Steps and more steps up into the terminal with no directions to a lift for the less than fit to use After that all OK except the airport staff please smile You are welcoming people to spend money in your country and first impressions can cloud the overall experience Departure has horrendous queues to check in crowded departure lounge I did appreciate the outdoor space there though Once again no smiles It was all quite officious and why I had to be called back to have my boarding pass checked twice I have no idea Im an almost grandmother Again steps and more steps crowded bus no option to walk to the plane The words Customer Care come to mind Could do better

This is a very small airport serving the island of Pulau Redang in Malaysia It resembles an airstrip more than an airport and serves only one airline Berjaya Air There is also only building with separate arrival and departure halls and small commercial shops selling souvenirs There is no airconditioning The baggage crew will collect the baggages from the plane and trolley them to the arrival hall where you would have to claim them There are no baggage belts Coaches would be waiting right outside the doorsteps once you clear immigration to transport you to your prebooked resorts Journey is about minutes from the airport to Berjaya Redang Resort where most people travelling via Berjaya Air would end up

The airport resembles a fanciful but tired airstrip Situated in Kampong Tekek and near the ferry jetty the entire airport is openair in concept There are separate arrival and departure gates all housed in a wooden building with small souvenir shop and dutyfree liquor shop and washrooms in the middle Baggage trolleyed from the plane to the baggage claim area where passengers must step forward to collect before clearing customs Resort coaches will be waiting at the arrival gate to fetch guests

Incompetent security very slow hence people have to wait in long queues Then poor infrastructure On st floor near gate no air circulation is happening no proper air conditioning is there Entire sitting area is full of mosquitos We are spending huge money through tax and govt is just looting our money

Most unfriendly and unorganised staff Why cant someone checkin hours befor the flight I came from a nearby city to take a flight and had to wait as the counter opens only hrs before No facilities unclean this place is

Incredibly incompetent staff almost missed our flight because they had error in system and they wouldnt care less to fix it took them h to give us boarding passes Please consider Mumbai Taxi to Mumbai is not that much and will save you nerves and possibly missed flights

Im a resident of this city and I can honestly say that this is the worst airport in India It is a defence airport but the state government has repeatedly shown their unwillingness to build a new one and that too from at least past years They simply hike the prices of land and then the subsequent govt cancels the proposal and bring in their own proposal to earn money Pune is a base to big MNCs and educational institutes and I firmly believe that it deserves far better than this
Not clean not many shops open during the night No maintenance at all Its not lively No professionalism Hence I would not recommend this airport

Probably one of the worst experiences that I have ever had with an airport It was nice to look at but it seems few now what to do I was traveling with a group of and over of us had problems getting to our departure terminal It seemed like all needed to have our luggage opened and checked that in itself was not bad The process of checking was terrible The agents had to constantly called some one else check to see if they were doing it Four in our group made it within minutes of take off You have a beautiful country but you will have join to the modern world in moving passengers Ill probably give you a couple of years to get it together and until then go back to Jamaica They got it together Maybe you should check them out and learn how move crowds

vSay what you may but I have seldom had an issue with this airport In todays world of checking in online just pass the long lines at the checkin desks if not travelling with bags Customs and immigration were quick and professionalno surprises The checkin at both terminals is now airconditioned Dutyfree was typically overpriced Just smile and move on I departed from Terminal A and enjoyed a few overpriced airport beers prior to boarding Heyits an airport Boarding the flight was painless with the bus to the plane I did note however that the staff at the gate were a bit perplexed when I handed them my homeprinted boarding pass All good though On the return flight again through immigration and customs in no time at all Please remember that if you are a citizen or a resident there is a separate aisle for you to the right side of the arrivals hall

Hundreds waiting in one large room after a hour flight Immigration asking stupid questions like why are you here and whats the purpose of your visit We were lined up on the tarmac whilst dogs individually sniffed us Absolutely ridiculous On leaving I think we went through or Passport checks and an xRay Ive known nothing like it but Mexico comes close

The worst experience of an airport I have ever had Arrived two hours before a flight to JFK Informed at check in queue that the desk was about to close not true Asked for COVID certificate not a problem it was on my phone The WiFi in the airport was so poor it took me minutes to login to the app to get the certificate Next we were asked for our immigration certificate The one I had completed was inbound only even though it asks for your departure date and we needed to complete a new one The same problem with WiFi my phone couldnt connect using WiFi to the internet to fill in the form Neither at this point could my wifes The lady from ServisAir behind the counter very kindly did it for us Weve now wasted minutes due to poor WiFi coverage in the airport Went to first line about metres long to have only our passport and boarding pass checked not immigration just a couple of airport officials Was sent through a barrier to the left and had our passports and boarding passes taken from us no explanation We figured out we needed to head after our boarding passes and passports so got in line for the xray machine that had no trays My wife went to find trays whilst I held the My home airport thus I use it a few times a year Check in has been as easy as anywhere else I have flown with similar wait times Terminal A can get busy midday but I have always found a seat I never expect in any airport to find food and drink at bargain prices thus not shocked I see some talk of coffee I had a coffee for pesos which is under As a resident I can bypass the hoards that arrive midday when entering the country There is a lane set up for residents and citizens to the right of the concourse I always feel a little guilty but hey I am a resident Best try to get flights that do not arrive between pm The baggage handler I had assist was obviously in cahoots with the customs official who tried to intimidate a propina out of me He told me to leave it with the baggage guy I left him nothing The airport does need more capacity to process those arriving or perhaps an automated system that is often found these days

People that work here seem more preoccupied with talking amongst themselves than paying attention to customers Although immigration has improved its processing of passengers there are still quirks Security procedures here are not lined up with US guidelines they took a pair of nose hair trimming scissors from me that had a round tip and not even in blade Just absurd Shops are expensive dollars for coffee from an automatic machine seems excessive

One would think that after years PUJ would figure out how to operate an airport Whoever runs the place has no clue with respect to airport operations or management It is definitely a rd World airport Customs and Immigration is ridiculous and laborious Staff are extremely rude given its a tourist airport The departure lounge has maybe seats for travelers and restroom The worst part is the PA system wont tell you when aircraft are boarding until the last call By then you are scrambling to get to the plane Checkin counters are openair with no ac They think their thatched roof and openair are cute but we want ac when we get to the airport on degree days Weve had enough sun and heat and dont want to sweat all the way to the plane The coup de gras is some idiot thought it was a good idea to put a pool by the departure lounge so you can swim while waiting for your plane Good news though There will be a new airport in Bavaro to compete with PUJ Should go a long way to put PUJ out of business The new airport investors seem to know what they are doing and how to run a good airport We will see My advice is to fly in to Santo Domingo and get transportation to Punta Cana and avoid the hassles

Long lines Unable to hear employees calling for flights that need passengers to skip to front of lines that are hour long Missed my flight because they cant communicate with passengers I was literally there in line I got a call asking if I was going on the flight I confirmed I was but was waiting to check my bag She told me check bag time for the flight ends minutes before departure and it was too late for me and to find a representative I cut everyone in line and spoke with a lady at the counter who said they announced for all people on my flight to go directly to the counter ahead of the line I told her no one in line can hear anything they are saying She said thats what shed been telling her coworkers After she confirmed I couldnt get a new flight for days I sat and waited for my ride to come back and get me and I then witnessed an employee walk around and shout the names of destinations whose flights were needing to have customers go to the front of the line immediately to check in I was furious because had it been done sooner I couldve been on my way home with my seven year old who was sobbing because he couldnt go home to his dad I will never use this airport again I am so frustrated

They should spend more money on putting gates in the airport instead of a multi million dollar resort Plus there isnt any place to eat and minimal places to sit When a full plane comes in and you have to stand for a minimum of hour it gets pretty bad at least for seniors

Pretty good facilities The negative side of this airport is the bad customer service from the custom officers I had to fly to Singapore and lacked one of the documents that was not required from previous trips the custom officer told me that I was not allowed to pass immigration and confiscated my boarding pass No more help was given other than telling me that someone from Singapore had to fax me or mail me the document They left me hanging there One of the young custom officers tried to help but was immediately directed away by his superior If there is one thing to improve about Qingdao airport it would definitely be the level of service provided by the custom officers At the end of the story the document they required can be printed within minutes and was not required of course I missed my flight

Not a bad little airport Plenty of space and seating if you need to wait a while But like all most Chinese airports the departure shops are terrible and expensive Bring your own snacks drinks or something to read Nothing to see there but it is comfortable enough

Nice modern airport Efficiently run Arrived here on an international flight from ICN and was bussed to terminal despite most finger docks being empty Immigration was a breeze and luggate was efficiently delivered On outgoing domestic flight to SZX our flight Shandong airlines didnt appear at all on the departure screens but was correctly displayed at the gate Flight delayed and no announcements made Good selection of outlets Pleasant environment waiting for the plane big bright airy About minutes drive out of Qingdao

We flew out of YQB UA on Tuesday October at pm I became very disabled after a bad fall in old Quebec Clty on Monday October After going to the Blessed Sacrement emergency and having much pain due to pelvic fractures After much pain we had to delay flight plans back home from Oct I contacted UA for disability help I was assured we would be taken care of at the car rental area and throughout the airport terminal also YQB website assured they are very proud of their disability service Fortunately after Avis personnel refused to help an airport employee saw us struggling to manage our luggage walker and wheelchair and offered to help get us to Avis Sadly I had to beg for help because the response was Our airport is too small Finally at Avis a young man behind the desk said I will help you And then took us to the UA Ticket Counter He refused an offer of a tip Then after getting baggage etc taken care of again we asked for help to go through TSA and boarding area At first the response was again Our airport is too small Fortunately a young woman said she would help And she did with kindness and refused a tip She dropped us off at boarding area after letting us get some food at a vendor and stopped so we could use the restroom She said she would be back to help us get our boarding pass and onto the plane SHE DID We are giving an excellent rating because of the people that did take the initiative to help us despite others refusing

Very rude and impatient security personnel It wasnt very busy which was good However making sure instructions are enunciated and understood before being rude would be better served The attendant that was supposed to be instructing you to enter metal detectors was more concerned with personal conversations than directing travelers and proceeded to yell at me advance move She was so far away from the metal detector I had no idea she was referencing me Bad ending to an otherwise excellent trip

We have traveled to many countries including throughout Europe China Russia etc but the Quebec airport is truly the most disorganized we have ever experienced First you cant check your luggage in until hours prior to departure which means you have to drag your luggage everywhere until that time We were coming off a cruise and were there hours ahead of time There were so many people there was no where to sit Then when it was time to check in it was huge lines with representatives giving out conflicting information kiosks not working properly etc Once we did get ourselves checked in and went upstairs the few food locations they had were jammed with very long lines Maybe flying into this airport would be okay but I would discourage anyone from flying out of this airport It is utter confusion

Small airport dealing mostly with flights within Canada and USA Security was quick and easy no language problems either and we were through into the departure lounge which only has a shop and cafe but does have good free wifi to give you something to do while you wait A good experience

Arriving from the US was easy and fast No long walks not monorails no buses You get off the plane go to customs get your suitcase change some money and grabbed a taxi all with a minimum of traipsing around Most efficient arrival anywhere Departure not so good Airlines staff was late opening checkin lines Baggage check man ridiculed my attempts to speak French and the woman operating the Xray was rude to passengers Furthermore the airport offers little in the way of food for purchase and dutyfree items
Love Quebecs airport Small but offers all of the facilities in a big airport Not too much people

Worst security queues and management The security team were either poorly trained or had poor equipment as my bag went thru times and found nothing It seems that the domestic market is not important and this maybe an airport management decision as international passengers had no queue while domestic passengers queued for minutes Not good enough

It is unbelievably customer unfriendly Baggage took over minutes to be off loaded There were no taxis waiting for passengers that arrived There was no one calling for taxi service There is very very limited shade Lucky it was a hot sunny day but imagine arriving on a wet winter night Its not rocket science This has to change Absolutely disappointing experience

Departing from here is like a form of torture The departure gates all face the sun and it streams into them without any blinds or sun shades The gates are therefore like little greenhouses filled with a hundred or so people all getting hotter and sweatier Only two rows of priority seating are in the shaded area the rest of lounge is entirely bathed in sunlight It could be helped with some airconditioning but sadly no There seems to be no cooling at all as I sit here quietly roasting To top it all off the sound system is tinny and like something from the late s which makes even The Who sound like a poor high school band Horrible cant wait to Board and get away

Oh Queenstown Airport You folks really let the side down coming and going This exkiwi visiting family with her partner had a minute queue for biosecurity coming in I fully support protecting NZ flora and fauna but how about some more staff then a minute wait simply for bag drop on departure again where are all the staff No apology at any stage either You need to do so much better
Worst airport ever Immigration had no people working and everyone waited over an hour and some hours Its like they had no idea flights were arriving
It was perfect I love everything about thr airport It was quick and has good staff Good food and its modern Just love it but I dont like the national airlines like TAME

Small airport and with almost no seats before airline check in Counter check in line only available to ticketed passengers Be ready to show passport and boarding pass physical or electronic ticket or Web check in Space for queues is limited so it could be crowded especially if theres another airline during check in process in the same area Restaurants for general public in another building outside the airport Almost nothing once you clear security and emigration Only one very simple paid lounge No courtesy lounges for Airlines

When you get off the plane at Quito Mariscal Airport you are greeted with a stunning view of the mountains The staff are all very friendly and the airport itself is quite modern While there arent tonnes of bars and restaurants like the airports at home in Britain it doesnt matter Because the facilities are satisfactory and the staff behave the way staff should I arrived in Quito after transit in Panama which was a total dump with extremely rude staff so to arrive in my final destination where I now live and to be greeted to my new country in such a friendly manner by immigration and customs was lovely

We only used the airport for arrival so cant comment on departure related matters The arrivals hall had all the facilities one would expect of a modern airport but was let down by very long immigration queues We had to queue for just over an hour There were two queues one for nationals of Ecuador plus nationals of a few other South American countries and the second for Foreigners There simply werent enough desks open for Foreigners but there were plenty open for Ecuadorians so they never had to wait more than maybe or minutes This really needs to be rectified and also there needs to be clear signage as to which queue to join In front of us was a couple from Peru who could have used the short queue had it been clearly marked On the day of our arrival Sept the new road from the airport to Quito had just been opened that very same day so the journey to the centre took us just minutes even though it was a busy time of the day Shame about the immigration queues as immigration staff were pleasant enough and this should otherwise rate as a good airport

Still not in full working order March One hour for bags to arrive from international flight Immigration fast and terminal clean The worst part is getting to Quito The traffic is terrible and there is only a one lane bridge across the gorge Try to arrive on Saturday or Sunday when you can do the trip to the city in about one hour Otherwise it can take you hours

Tale of different airports arrival was horrible Stood in the immigration line for hours Heard similar if not worse stories for arriving passengers for the next day Departure was fine Check in was fairly quick immigration was painless Appeared to have many storesfood options available but went to the lounge to wait An additional inspection was required to get into the gate areabe warned you are not allowed to bring in bottled water even though obtained post security Airport is very close to town minutes to hotel new airport appears to be about an hour drive

The airport itself is nice and clean but the staff were awful I consider myself pretty easy going and let a lot of things brush over but the way my daughter and I were treated was completely uncalled for It was myself and my year old learning disabled daughter traveling home from a vacation visiting family in North Carolina TSA yelled at and berated my daughter for struggling to follow exact instructions scaring her and made following instructions that much harder It turned our already stressful day into a nightmare I understand millions of people move through the airport and there are protocols that need to be followed for everyones safety but I can say with absolute certainty we will never fly into or out of Raleigh again Experiencing one moodyrude person is easy to pass off as they are having a bad day but literally everyone Staff really need to get in touch with how to treat travelers like human beings not prisoners Chicago OHare TSAstaff are top notch and were so kind for our trip flying out making our experience this morning that much more shocking

This airport is fine but the TSA agents terminal are rude and condescending I frequently fly with small children my th flight with twoyearolds and have never had a worse experience with TSA practically berating me over stroller Most airports have you breakdown the stroller and run through machine NOT here If you dont want to be harassed do not break your stroller down I would suggest you refrain from asking either because they will make jokes about you in front of everyone They are slow unhelpful and unprofessional

I fly every week RDU is always the worst airport I have to use And this is saying something since I have to fly out of NYC airports The security check point is horrible Regardless of time of day even am The line is so long it spills out into the baggage drop area And its ALWAYS this way The staff are so rude They obviously enjoy harassing people Then should you have enough time for food or coffee the lines are huge for these too Dont even think about Starbucks unless you get to the airport hours before your flight

I had a Frontier flight that was scheduled to depart at pm and found out it was delayed Upon hearing that I was ok and figured I could just enjoy some of the restaurants and found out that every bar and restaurant closes at pm I was told by an employee that when flights are delayed they are supposed to receive a memorandum that will keep the restaurants open until those flights have departed There are too many people that pay good money to fly and there are no accommodations to keep them comfortable and entertained until their departure I strongly recommend the hours change from to pm for closing time I understand these places open up at or am but you still have fliers who take flights late in the evening These little stores that stay open does not meet the demands of customers I am extremely dissatisfied

The Terminal AADelta etc arrival area where most airlines come in is the most poorly run pick up area I have ever been to Twice this summer I had to experience the gridlock of cars attempting to pick up people at this terminal There is no way to pull over to pick up people even when they are right there waiting out front The security officers yell at you to keep driving around adding to traffic issues and do not give you a chance to pull over My yearold mother was stepping across several lanes of traffic to try and reach me and the security officer was yelling at both of us I had already circled around times The poorly run arrival area looks like a COVID hotspot If they would let you pick up passengers there would be fewer problems They should redirect rental car buses to another location or spread arrivals out so there are fewer people trying to be picked up at the same time The security officers should get off of their Segways and try being helpful instead of yelling at elderly people and those picking them up

The woman taking care of boarding was very rude and overbearing She made me pay for a carry on bag I have a small under seat bag that I use all the time and went under the seat when I sat down I asked a flight attendant if the bag was alright there and she said yes I was told that she is not well liked by Allegiant staff and I cant imagine why she is employed by Allegiant I fly Allegiant all of the time but usually go out of Grand Island and they are wonderful I will not fly Allegiant out of Rapid again According to passengers this happens all the time

Personally Rarotonga airport like most of the Cook Islands is a little overrated Had to stand for minutes in a queue to check in on a concrete floor while we waited for the check in desks to open which they did minutes past their advertised time After checking in we were told we had to pay a departure tax which I was told is not part of the airline ticket price Customs and immigration not that helpful and my wife had to give up some perfume we had just bought or they would not clear us Limited shopping there but the toilets were clean Blaring music non stop which made it hard to hear the announcements so at times you were doubting you were at the right gate Not overly impressed

Half the terminal has been demolished to make way for the new terminal under construction Bit of a shock on arrival but should be fabulous when finished Befitting a gorgeous island such as Rarotonga Previously RAR didnt separate Arrivals and departures bit of a problem for the once weekly flight tofrom LA No airbridges in the new terminal planned from the renderings I could see So still a bit of a problem to from aircraft when a tropical downpour arrives as it want to do Reason being this is such a tiny aerodrome with short runway of approx m just enough for a Accordingly turnaround and parking area for aircraft precludes a fixed airbridge New departure area will still have the outside garden area so you can have one last look over the airfield to the beautiful mountain peaks before boarding On another note duty free no longer the stupendous bargain it once was Still pretty good compared to many big airports around the world Happy to see such a new terminal being built but also a shame that Raro is geting all grown up Hope the new terminal can retains its island feeling

Small airport by international standards Immigration and customs smiling and welcoming Departure easy with only one aircraft departure tax has to be paid and quite rigorous security procedure but done with typical Cook Islands good nature Walk from terminal to aircraft across tarmac necessary Could be a wet one in a tropical downpour

The airport might be nice small and clean but there is a big BUT hours before departure the queueline was already going all the way through the airport that means the double length of a normal full line but the checkin counter was not open They didnt work I am sure you had to queue for more then hours with that airport service I am sorry but the airport is not modern since they dont accept boarding passes on a smartphone they make you to go back in to the line to get the boarding pass printed Since I did already the checkin online and had no baggage I could go to the fist class line and skip the hour checkin line otherwise I would have been very upset and angry with the Recife Airport Also not perfect It is a bit complicated to store the luggage inside the airport and its very difficult to find it you have to ask a person

The airport terminal was built from scratch beside the old building currently closed It has a huge skylight from end to end making good use of natural light that reaches all floors through an atrium Many sculptures are integrated in the project which gives it an interesting touch Facilities are good enough The local delicacies stores are surely to be visited Totally sets itself apart from most Brazilian airports whose problems usually begin at finding a parking spot and extend through all possible aspects up to the boarding ramps

One of the nicest most modern airports in the country Decent array of shops and restaurants Not a large selection between security checkpoints and departure gates but that is typical and here it is still far better than at Fortaleza a city of similar size Airport is close to town especially beach areas so transportation is usually easy How many agents are actually working at the checkin counters can vary widely but I assume that is the responsibility of the airlines

Redding Municipal Airport Newly Remodeled with Same Shortcomings Not Ready for Prime Time For years using the Redding Airport RDD has been an exercise in frustration Much of the frustration stems its primary subpar I dont care airline United and pathetic staffing levels Heres the truth Redding Airport is treated like an inconvenient afterthought as connecting airports regularly delay inbound planes not once but at least twice You have a pm flight no worries count on departing around pm You had better hope your connections are not too close lest you miss them The new remodel has helped speed up what typically was a minute wait for checked bags for the one and only plane that has landed at the airport Now you wait about minutes for arriving guests to get their luggage Want something to eat while waiting Need to speak to a gate agent Looking for professional and knowledgeable advise Look elsewhere The lone restaurant Chus Too is rarely open to attract customers to the bar while waiting for a plane Ticketing is a ghost town until hours prior to flight so you better have your phone app at the ready and have your carry on bag packed like Bear Grylls with snacks and other necessities if you need assistance Need a car rental to escape the lack of services in Redding to drive to San Francisco in hopes of catching your connecting flight Not in Redding rental agencies are consistent in their underwhelming inventory no oneway rental availability and exorbitant rates to rent a roller skate Redding airport is great if you have lots of time built into your itinerary for frustration delays and intentional understaffing and lack of assistance otherwise make the drive to Sacramento Airport SMF

This airport is too small and outdated for a region serving million people in ten different counties It is definitely worth the drive to Sacramento or San Francisco to get better flights and many people around here dont want to make that long cumbersome drive The terminal hasnt been updated since but all that was remodeled restrooms and new seats and carpeting We desperately need a larger airport with more flights and parking options

Regina International Airport is viewed by many as a municipal airport as they only have domestic flights and their only international flights are during the winter holiday season The airport is trying to expand but with the loss of transborder flights its limitations to serve the global network are seemingly smaller That being said their amentities presecurity include a full service Tim Hortons SubWay and a restaurant alongside a Relay In the departure lounge there is a Tim Hortons express a cafe a bar and another Relay The airport would benefit from a lounge such as Plaza Premium Departure and arrival are very quick as the only delays are due to the inbound flight or the deicing of an aircraft

Flew in and out of RNO on Southwest The terminal layout is compact and easy to navigate There are plenty of slot machines but unlike LAS there arent so many that they take up too much floor space and leave not enough room to walk past Smoking is also not permitted anywhere inside the terminal which is a nice change from LAS The foodbeverageshopping options in the gate areas are limited but there is a nice food and shopping court in the main terminal area before you pass security The rental car facility is just across the street from the terminal so there are no timeconsuming shuttle rides The airport is only miles from the city centre and traffic tofrom the terminal is usually light The TSA screening area however is too small and understaffed for a gate airport If youre travelling at peak times expect long lines and delays

Awful airport Very few staff for a great deal of passengers Queued for nearly an hour to check in with staff No water fountain facilities as is standard everywhere else Staff in restaurants unwilling to help but you can definitely buy water Its degrees outside And the air conditioning is terrible Announcements are poor Fraport are more interested in making a ton of money Thats what happens when theres no competition around Theyre making a bad impression of the great country of Greece

Absolute carnage huge queue at checkin but in fairness had desks open so got through fairly quickly security pretty quick as well then the problems begin On entering the departure area there was extreme over crowding No seats people sitting and standing everywhere the limited food venues totally full with large queues passport control was reasonably quick which takes you to the non Schengen area departure area which was also extremely busy with the same overcrowding Too many tourists in too small an area Not sure if always this busy but beware of potential overcrowding

Absolute chaos Boarding queues stretched the length of the terminal back to the duty free section Constant Greek language tannoy announcements No guidance offered at any stage Delayed an hour and a quarter

Just one small step above cattle barn status This so called Airport is not set up and unable to accommodate the hordes of tourists that pour in an out of Rhodes Shengen flights are delayed beyond anything I have seen anywhere else There are not enough seats except if you fly nonShengen Great advertising for Europe incapacity to treat with a minimal decency travelers spending their cash in this island The spectacle of people and children laying everywhere in the floor in overcrowded rooms with no or not enough AC feels like being in a third world country hospital after a disaster Official airport staff will explain that its much worse in other places I think they should be allowed to travel This place is despicable Stay away by all means

We had a weeks holiday in Rhodes so arrived and departed Our arrival at approx local time was easy and quick We were off the aircraft through passport control baggage collection and customs within minutes Our departure was longer and check in queues were lengthy with over an hours wait however I believe that is the responsibility of the airline not the airport All staff were courteous and cheerful We had a snack whilst waiting for our flight the quality wasnt good and it was very overpriced so whilst I wouldnt choose to eat in the airport again I would be happy enough to use the airport and look forward to visiting Rhodes again soon

One member of our party has special needs and requires the special assistance service The airport ground staff were exemplary We travel regularly The assistance kindness efficiency and responsiveness of all the ground staff we encountered was the best that we have experienced I would recommend Rhodes airport as an airport with staff that genuinely assist those with special and additional needs
TSA pre check is so slow Its supposed to be faster than general boarding thats what Im paying for The lady doing the check in appears to be new or just slow She needs help am

Never had a problem til now TSA was extremely rude they were pushing everyone around not just me Speaking to me as if I were a child This was th June at am No respect whatsoever very unprofessional It was obvious they were abusing their authority

Airport is clean and seems to be efficient as airports go However the food service is dismal There are no brand fastfood which is what we needed in order to catch a bus out to a conference center The only offering was some place called Cheeburger Cheeburger yes a dated reference to an old SNL staple which food was neither fast nor flavorful Fries were greasy meat was halfcooked and the service was slow Certainly an international Airport can do better

Richmond International is a new stylish and perfect sized airport on the outskirts of Richmond major air carriers serve RIC flying to over domestic and international destinations in the USA and Canada The airport is mediumsized and easy to find your way around The security lines are short and hasslefree The airport atrium has a large glass roof giving the airport interior a very open feel A restaurant in the atrium has a large window with a full view of the apron for all the plane spotters Travel into and out of RIC is always hasslefree and fun

Richmond is a medium size airport that has recently been extensively renovated My experience flying in and out was very pleasant RIC is a human sized airport so it is easy to get around Baggage recovery was fast and painless with our checked bags appearing only about five minutes after we had arrived at the carousel The rental car desks are conveniently sited and the rental car garage is a two minute walk from the terminal Our total time from landing to driving off in a rental car was less than thirty minutes The airport is well connected to the adjacent Interstate highway so the airport is easy to get into and out of On departure checkin and security was quick and painless There is a restaurant in the secure area offering a view of the ramp a pleasant thing for the travelling aircraft buff Overall I was very impressed with Richmond airport and would use it again anytime

A pretty average airport quite dated and gloomy especially landside Going through security was no problem airside things are slightly more bright and modern The prices in shops are an absolute rip off even by the standards of an airport

We were in transit through Riga Airport We have three children one of them four months old We were having a baby stroller which we handed to the ground crew before boarding the plane in Milan and no other luggage When in Riga we have asked one of the ground crew to give us the stroller which was five meters from him telling him that we are in transit and we dont have any other luggage He refused us telling us that is not his problem and he dont careWe have asked couple of times after he just turned his back and left We have asked two other ground crew and they have tell us that we need to go to pick up the stroller from the luggage hall We have asked inside the airport four different staff members and received four different answers of how to proceed none of them making sense In the end we have exit the airport retrieve the stroller going through security again with three children just because they dont care None of the staff members were nice but the guy on the ground crew was very rude We have traveled a lot of countries but never faced this issue If you could avoid this airport I will recommend you to do so

Never been to another airport where the staff wont empty your reusable bottle for you nor let you empty it yourself on the spot you have to go to the bathroom facilities with all your hand luggage I poured it into the trash container and they told me off and threatened to call the police next time The security control is also really slow although there wasnt any queue The containers are provided individually by the staff so you cant lay out your stuff while theyre checking another passenger I cant say I dont recommend the airport but you have to be prepared for how the security control is handled

Use this airport only as must Once you are through the passport control toilet use is done only in group excursions So god forbid you have human basic needs Beautiful touch to this regulation is you will be called to the gate at least two hours too early

Its a small airport at an island abt km from Rijeka Checking in and out goes quite fast at our experience Some staff members in the shop are kind of grumpy Nevertheless we are very happy with this airport how they have arranged a hotel in Opatija for our group when our flight was cancelled all of a sudden in the evening Our flight company Transavia told some people to find and book by themselves a hotel but the airport arranged bus transport and a luxurious hotel so our compliments

It is a small easy accessible airport with a huge unexpensive parking lot where you can easily drink a coffee outside while waiting for your check in But after check in the true horror begins There was just one girl who checked the passports before security check and we had to wait for minutes in a small very hot alley The alley had no AC but a glass roof it was incredible sweaty to stand in a pushy crowd just to get your passport checked Around there were kids mothers with babies and older people heavily breathing Who builds a glass house in a sunny country as waiting area At this moment there were just two middle sized planes boarding and the people were almost rioting because of this horrible situation

MUCRJKMUC We arrived at Rijeka Airport on Croatia Airlines twenty minutes ahead of schedule Ours was the only aircraft in service at the airport The offloading of the hand luggage went extremely quickly After immigration control there is only one conveyor belt for all arriving aircraft It took quite a while before baggage delivery started There is no money exchange at the airport so you should have a few kuna with you for the taxi or the bus The checkin for our flight back started two hours before departure There were two counters open for only passengers Boarding passes were only available for the first segment After security and passport control there is only one snack bar with limited products and a dutyfree shop which can only be accessed when the aircraft is ready for boarding On the plus side a very nice terrace where passengers can sit in the open and wait for the arrival of their aircraft

Rimini Airport is highly recommended as a way to access the Adriatic Riviera This smaller than average airport is located on the edge of Rimini MiraMare and is well connected to Rimini and the train stations by coach and a local tram service is not far away either The negative aspect is that the lack of clear signs inside the airport for ground transport could be very misleading for newly arrived passengers and lead the newly arrived into the hands of very expensive taxi drivers Rimini Airport has some nice shops and is well set out I highly recommend this airport

We arrived at Rimini airport for a flight with Ryanair to Stansted First of all the check in queues were not organised People were pushing in and not queuing correctly No one was there to organise this Once through security we could not find a seat anywhere We managed to find a couple of chairs outside but the backs of them were broken All the tables covered in rubbish The bins were all over flowing with rubbish so no one could put anything in them The shops and bar had large queues it was horrible We then went to our gate and the queue for passport control was very long People were pushing in The Russian flight was called forward all the people pushed us They then had to call our flight as it was and the flight should have been taking off at this time Again more pushing and shoving This airport needs some organisation I have never been to such a poorly run airport

Flew in and out of Rimini Airport recently A very small airport that can hardly cope with the amount of passengers who use it Were brought by bus to the small Schengen arrival hall The forty passengers of our flight were almost too many for the luggage vonveyor belt I wonder how they manage aeroplanes of the size of a Boeing let alone an Airbus In the departure hall they have approximately ten checkin counters which seemed quite enough for a Sunday afternoon The Schengen departure lounge after passing the security check however is hardly adequate There were only two departures at that time an ATR seats to Munich and a Boeing seats to Luxemburg These two were already two many for the few seats they have in the departure lounge Moreover there is almost nothing you can do There is an overpriced restaurant a an equally pricey souvenir shop You cannot look onto the apron as all windows have frosted glass In short there is quite a lot to improve at Rimini airport

Dumont airport terrible service by GOL The queue has not moved for over hours Nobody speaks English for an airport thats full of passengers flying to and from overseas We dont understand why is there a delay nobody speaks the language and none of the staff are bothered From what we understood some people fought with the guy who looks like the supervisor and they were pushed in front What a joke Enjoyed Rio but wont be back thank you

This must be the worst international airport Ive flown out of Much worse than So Paulo We arrived at am for our am TAM flight to find a long queue for check in with only one person working and no priority check in queue at all Once through most of the very small rubbishy shops were closed Couldnt even get a coffee The lounge was also closed The seating is uncomfortable and impossible to sleep on which I really noticed given my kids had to be up at am to get there Power points are not easy to find and I couldnt even by a charge cable for my phone I could go on

By far the worst airport Ive ever experienced Nowhere to get a meal very few shops and the main duty free shop prices everything in US dollars Not much use for someone wanting to use their remaining Brazilian Reals You could in fact use them but had to convert the prices to see how overpriced things were and if you could afford it The few other small shops were all closing during the evening so missed out on trade Had to queue approx hr mins for a midnight flight even though it appeared that it was the only flight due to depart Only check in desks open which became effectively when two sets of people were there for over minutes No attempt was made to open more desks by the time wed checked in the shops were closing Not a good end to a holiday

Small airport closed at night not practical fortunately the staff and police are benevolent otherwise the time would be long few shops and hot spots but its small so Singularly lacking seats FR Petit aroport ferm la nuit pas pratique heureusement que le personnel et les policiers sont bienveillants sinon le temps serait long peu de boutiques et de points chauds mais cest petit alors Manque singulirement de siges

I have arrived with pretty bad expectations after reading the reviews here but every single person was so kind to me that I had to come back to leave a positive review Absolute pleasant surprise correct exchange rates that Im not used to clean easy to navigate staff super kind and respectful I am happy that my experience was different from others

A supposedly international city airport and in the huge transit area the managers dont even manage to install a few water fountains for cool refreshing water for tired and thirsty travellers especially those with children What an appalling omission It is a shame really as in most other respects the airport is very pleasant

Very unfriendly to westerners We asked for help and we were in a rush to take our next flight They only shouted to us sit down Also we where the only ones that had to go to a special security and they didnt want to tell us why Some people looked very angry at us It was an very unpleasant experience Also the signs where very bad We followed a sign and came on a closed area Some guy helped us but he was very angry We have been to many countries but this was the worst ever

Flew DXB RUH CAI Taxied for about minutes after landing and then on top of that had to take a bus to the terminal which took another minutes On departure also had to take a bus to the aircraft and taxied for a lengthy time again The airport staff are deplorable Everyone I came across was rude No one wants to help or acts like asking them something is a huge inconvenience Its the opposite of what Ive experienced in other GCC countries Saudi is lightyears behind UAE and Qatar when it comes to service and treating people with respect I would not recommend anyone transiting through King Khalid International Riyadh

The staff in Riyadh International Airport departure are very rude I drop my son in airport because he is going back to the US to study while we are waiting my son just to pass the immigration I was crying looking at him from a far because as a mother I am going to miss him but one staff guy rooming around shouting yelling at me to go away he was very rude illmannered disrespectful creature Ive ever met in my entire life How can Saudi Arabia attracts tourists if the people are impolite and discriminate expats Calling out the management in International Airport in Riyadh hire a professional educated and well mannered staff
Riyadh airport is a nice airport We had to transit from there and were surprised to see that how beautiful is even their domestic terminal
I arrived in Saudi Arabia for a layover for hours When I got there they asked me to pay for visas to stay in the airport I didnt leave the airport and was not informed of this earlier

The rental car area is appallingly signed It is conveniently a short walk from the terminal but there is only an initial ramp and then there is no path for suitcase dragging people to go to the next row apart from the gaps between the cars The different companies have small signs and it is impossible to know where to go If one is unlucky then you need to walk back and forth to find your spot Returning is the same problem to drive around and find the spot I am writing this as I spoke to the rental company and it appears everyone complains but the airport will not do anything about this Maybe this publicity will help them improve

The security screening at this airport is the worst Ive ever experienced and I fly a lot They insist you place liquids in a zip lock bag at the screening they dont supply them Just leave anything like that in your bag and youll have no issues If you dont have a clear bag and put your liquids in the tray they throw them away obviously telling you its their policy afterwards where they fail to tell you any of this before security Id put a ml face cream in the tray and he threw it in the bin after the scanner then sarcastically told me its my own fault as liquids need a clear bag Contradictory to his comment he had no issues with the toothpaste nasal spray and lip balm being in my bag His colleague prior to this told me the stuff I had would be fine They literally make this up as they go along My partner took their few liquids out and into the tray the same as me and was told they could keep them They have zero logic at this airport

After a wonderful time we encountered the most rude and unprofessional employee at the airport in St Kitts She clearly was unhappy with her job Being a TSA employee we expected a certain level of professionalism and courtesy as we have always experienced in the past at many different airports Since tourism is the main source of income for this island we expected better Her behavior would not be tolerated at my company therefore we shouldnt have to tolerate a rude and unprofessional employee while on our vacation

I left this airport on and was thoroughly disgusted at the way the staff behaved They were rude aggressive and unprofessional towards passengers who had been delayed by the tropical storm They did not even help the situation by processing the passengers quickly instead they wasted time arguing with them and shouting at them for being late for the flight which was through no fault of their own No passenger should have to endure this kind of treatment and the airport should dismiss these staff and replace them with staff who are trained in Customer Services skills I would recommend the international community to give St Kitts a miss until they do this as generally people respond to an impact on their bottom line St Kitts if you dont value international visitors find another industry as tourism will not survive Thankfully this was not a similar experience at the hotel and within other island tourist venues but the first impressions count The airport facilities are very limited no ATMs or exchange facility limited food and drink customs is very slow and unfriendly no special assistance for disabled and elderly passengers despite long queues Having travelled to other Caribbean airports this is better elsewhere eg Antigua St Lucia Barbados Dominican Republic etc so no excuses
for a oz Coffee is price gouging at its worst If you are hungry at this airport be prepared to sell a kidney in order to pay for anything Probably the most expensive coffee in Australia

This little airport is very nice and adapted to the demand and number of passengers There was only one cafe but with nice food and drinks Because of the small numbers of passengers traveling through that airport there was absolutely no waiting I would defenitly go there again

No long queues no hustle and bustle easy parking adequate facilities This is an airport where you can be sitting in your car ready to move off into the beautiful French countryside minutes after landing This is how air travel should be civislised

A small little provincial airport can be a touch uncomfortable in hot weather as the large glass windows absorb the sun as you wait in the departure area One small cafe serving reasonable food and drink Check in quick and car hire points convenient to main entrance Good main road access to the town of Rodez and Tarn and Tarn et Garonne etc

United Airlines flight supposed to depart at am We are currently still waiting at am because MFR is using a new rd party crew with only person qualified to load luggage Unacceptable We pay good money to fly with an airline that makes you feel safe Now at am were waiting on another company to deice the wings Flights are made months in advance The airport and airline were aware that trained ground crew is needed to load a plane along with de icing planes This is ridiculous

I love the Rogue Valley but thumbs down to this place at the moment They are building a new terminal to replace the dark and depressing thing they have now Unfortunately the parking lots and rental car lots are quite a long walk with all of the construction going on I struggled in F degree heat to take my bags from my rental car to the old terminal They do provide a rental car shuttle for rental car patrons One has no idea where to wait for the shuttle and he drove right by me The TSA staff seem to think they are running some sort of Vegasstyle comedy act the way they talk to you The restaurant is horribly overpricedget something to go at one of the many fastfood places on the way to the airport By the way the roads around the airport can be confusing and so are the signs

A small provincial airport serving Bangkok DMG Two airlines serve the airport NOK Air and Air Asia Avoid using Air Asia if I were you A couple of food outlets selling snacks and water Well set up and very efficient I have used the airport on many occasions I get collected when I use the airport so not sure what the Taxi connections are like
