Unprofessional and shocking airport staff I have flown from many different airports and my experience was one of the worst I have ever had We only had around kg additional weight for the hand luggage and had to pay At this airport there is zero tolerance The staff makes you weigh everything you bring on the plane and it cannot exceed a gram over kg Upon trying to find a solution the staff were incredibly rude unprofessional and treated us very disrespectfully Frankly they just ignored you and did not respond to any questions and even laughed at you I have never experienced such a condescending attitude from the CheckIn staff Also we learned this is the airport policy and AirAsia is usually more tolerant at all other airports we flew from Singapore Bangkok Kuala Lumpur Absolutely unreasonable The airport does not allow local food stands for the local taxi drivers near the airport If they dont pay for the overpriced airport food they cannot eat during the day The old airport apparently put much more effort into treating the taxi drivers fairly Very rude and cold staff at the entire airport from immigration to the shops No one says hi thank you nothing The airport did not at all reflect the great experience we had in Cambodia with incredibly friendly people It is a shame that this is the last experience you have when leaving the country I am sincerely shocked

My experience at the new Siem Reap Airport surpassed all expectations The staffs friendliness and proactive assistance elevated my journey Navigating immigration was not only expeditious but also conducted with an admirable level of efficiency The airports outstanding features combined with the exceptional service created an atmosphere of ease and comfort

This airport operates the shortest duration flights in Nepal to and from the capital Kathmandu The aircrafts that it receives is mostly ATR operated by domestic carrier Buddha Air or Jetstream ATR operated by Yeti Airlines The airport has very basic facilities a small hall with few check in counters dedicated to the domestic carriers a common seating area to accommodate to people few toilets before and after security checks Luggage is delivered on trolleys one canteen outside small parking area outside one short runway for about take offs and landing combined Very basic of airports one could imagine

It is five years since I have been to the Crimea The airport terminal is new and quite spacious The arrival area worked well and I had free WiFi while I waited for my luggage to arrive from the plane As far as departure was concerned there were plenty of check in counters and the areas were quite well sign posted in Russian and English There are good areas for food and souvenirs both before and after the security clearance It is an airport which seems to work quite well and is a big improvement on the old terminal

Poor domestic and international terminals due to inattentive and almost hostile services though domestic terminal is more pleasant in style Expect very long queues on domestic departures both during check in and security control On international departures I have come across numerous very nasty passport control policewomen It is better to wear a face with no emotions and not to answer back even if you feel you are being insulted and walk away once your passport is stamped On international arrivals you can save almost minutes if you grab an immigration form early and get in the queue before filling the form since incoming arrivals passport control is much slower than you will see anywhere in the western world You can fill your form in the queue on a magazine

My husband and I are transferring today to the USA We got off our plane from Bangkok and wanted to see the waterfall in the airport A wonderful kind and very helpful Changi Service Ambassador Tan Mey showed us the way to see the waterfall The train TT takes you past the waterfall You can see it after am

Worst customer service I have ever experienced Half of the staff dont know where the services such as early check in baggage etc are They then have the nerve to give you attitude for asking Staff are eating food at work without any sign saying the desk is closed Then talks to customers as if we are in the wrong for disturbing them First class airport More pretentious with poor service

Nice and clean airport with good overall services except passport control Like in all major airport passport control is automated and the machine did not recognize any person of our group which entered Singapore in the same airport the day before We were held between the automatic gates for or minutes before being directed to the manual control Even an airline staff of some Asian airlines was held captive for minutes Its very strange that in a tech city like Singapore automatic passport control is so bad

Terrible food choices only two places to get coffee or breakfast in T about a mile apart and very long queues Singapore has a coffee culture but this doesnt exist at the airport and doesnt seem to offer any real breakfast options when a lot of people will be travelling early in the morning No modern water dispenser filling stations to fill your own bottle airside only outdate water fountain that cannot fill a bottle very poor service Changi tries to have a beat in class reputation but its really failing on food options

I would like to convey my heartfelt thanks to Sharon and Gayithri who were on duty at the information counter at Seletar Airport Singapore on the eve of CNY reunion evening They both have gone out of their way above and beyond their normal duties in helping me to get a taxi My flight arrived at pm I tried to get a ride to no avail I decided to wait it out at the airport cafeteria after which I thought to try again this time at the taxi stand When I exited the building however the taxi stand seemed empty The police security on duty suggested I ask for help at the information counter by arrivals and I did that Sharon and her colleague persisted and helped me to get a taxi all the way from pm until I finally got into the taxi just short of pm which by the way stopped right in front of the arrival entrance so that I didnt have to walk far I am most grateful and wish to commend Sharon and Gayithri for their exemplary service I will always remember especially Sharon for her kindness and the personal service extended to me a foreigner who had just arrived Singapore and had turned to her for help

A lovely small airport once enter the departure area left hand side is check in counter straight went to immigration counter have your luggage security check and holding room and board Only one small dining place found in this area and right hand side is arrival area with toilet in the middle Once inside the gate hold room the airport free WiFi is not signal well Currently the only commercial flight using this airport is Fireflys service to SZB airport A more easy and faster way to the KL city area

Two years on from my last report and improvements continue to happen The check in area has been updated making for a comfortable experience and the new TSA security area is large and works efficiently A new hotel is now connected directly to the terminal Staff as usual friendly and helpful Forced to deduct one point for the lack of baggage carts If they are there they are well hidden

We left Skiathos on Friday June after a reasonable arrival at the airport and a wonderful holiday It was exceptionally hot with temperatures reaching C So queue to check in despite having printed boarding cards beforehand then another queue to drop off the hold luggage then another huge queue outside in the baking sun with the queue snaking around the building to go through security only a couple of scanners available and passport control Once airside all seats were occupied with many passengers sitting on the floor You guessed it long queue for the toilet longer queue for refreshments Absolutely horrendous experience which will deter me from ever visiting this beautiful island again No point in trying to beat the crowds by arriving early as access to the departure lounge will be refused as it becomes so crowded

Skiathos Airport is one of the smallest airports The arrivals area has one luggage belt and you are outside in no time Departure area as well is very small and the same staff that are checking your bags at the departure hall before you check in are also the security staff So when they are done in one part of the hall they go to the other part where they open the security checks It looks funny since they are jumping up and down the hall but airport is really very small and very manageable There is no playground for children and toilet facilities are basic There is only one shop at the departure hall where check ins are Everything is very relaxed They have no fingers so expect to board the plane on foot from the boarding gate Walking distance to the airplane is a few hundred meters

The small airport of Skiathos in Greece receives very few flights a day fortunately for us tourists It descends directly from the aircraft steps and you can walk comfortably hall for baggage claim after less than meters Given the few flights arriving at the waiting time for baggage is really ridiculous Inside the airport is just a small shop with a bar and cafeteria I must say that the organization of the desk is not exactly the best in my case there were two flights in that time slot and then the passengers were to form a single line across the airport to access the desk checkin in which there were only staff Once you checked in to access the waiting room for boarding where there is a small duty free selling tobacco magazines and souvenirs of the island There are sufficient seating for passengers waiting You can arrive directly with the car just outside the principal hall of arrivaldepartures So small but functional thanks to the reduced number of flights

Sligo is a tiny airport but checkin and security were a breeze and there is a comfortable bar while you wait After security passengers are penned in a gate which has no facilities and little comfort

If you ever wondered what it would be like to walk into a parallel universe where everyone is having a bad day every day Sofia Airport is your ticket to that adventure I step off the plane to be greeted by the most unfriendly and rudest staff Ive ever encountered Immigration at Sofia Airport deserves a special mention These guys are clearly operating under their own version of Schengen rules possibly sourced from an alternate dimension where logic and common sense dont exist Its like theyre playing a game of How confused can we make this traveler And lets talk prices Theyre right up there with other major airports but the friendliness Its nowhere to be found Its like paying for firstclass service and getting a seat in the luggage compartment In conclusion theres absolutely no reason to come here or transit here unless you have a particular fondness for being insulted If thats your thing congratulations youve just found your worldwide number destination So if youre into adventures of the unfriendly kind pack your bags and head to Sofia Airport Just dont expect any warm welcomes or helpful staff Youve been warned

If you enjoy dealing with customer service staff who spend the entire interaction staring intently at the floor during checkin and AGAIN at the gate then this is the airport for you Uncouth all around Two anacondalike queues at passport control The silent officer stared into my eyes so many times while fiddling with my EU passport I felt like I was FBI Most Wanted Just a necessary evil this airport

It was the worst experience Ive ever had at an airport A security agent who checked our IDs was super aggressive for no reason and swore at us in Bulgarian thinking that we wouldnt understand him I have seen a few aggressive officers around in my life however Ive never been sworn at for no reason so that was a shock and I cant believe that people like him are allowed to do jobs like this and are not fired I then wanted to report him however I was told that I needed to get out of the airport report him and then go through security all over again and I didnt have time to do this I would like to mention here that all airport staff we encountered were absolutely horribly rude and unhelpful They all need proper training

OK First impressions on arrival were neutral A somewhat dated airport by appearance linking to reflections of the s where I was a youngster Anyway as a frequent air traveller with Partially Restricted Mobility PRM I am acutely conscious of the fact that having metal inside my body following reconstructive surgery is likely to activate the security metal detection archway So it happened at Sofia Airport Despite showing a medical card and explaining my medical situation I was then forced through the default procedure adopted by less progressive countries So in this case remove shoes and jumper despite both being clothe Of course this does not stop the activation on reentering the archway So with PRM I have to remove footwear I have restricted mobility and suffer the indignity of further removal of clothing in public which exposes sensitive to me tissue scarring and then repeated attempts to not activate the machine Do I need to go thro naked Why is the default not to immediately use the handheld metal detector for people with declared PRM At progressive airports this has been my experience and avoids embarrassment whilst treating PRM people with dignity Of course ideally fully body Xray machines would completely eradicate this issue Shame on you Sofia Airport security staff Dont just default to basic principles have a progressive and appropriate security protocol for passengers with PRM

Dreadful its hard to know where to start from the barking security guy to the fact that with queues stretching out to the hallway they only had one of the two security lines open Or how about the way that staff ran around from one departure gate to the other without letting anyone know information or how about the bus driver who insisted on chatting to his mates whilst we all waited or how about the spitfire lounge where staff kept sending people back to get their table number without telling anyone you needed it when ordering Its an embarrassment

Poor departure information updates Arrived early for flight to Jersey as flight was showing on time Only when we passed through to air side did the flight show a min delay When speaking to the air crew they advised that it they knew the were delayed long before due to operational reasons Thanks for wasting my valuable time Southampton

The saddest thing about Southampton Airport is not that it is a small airport with all the limitations that can be expected of an airport of its size its the incredibly poor service and jobsworth attitude of the staff If something can be done badly or in a way to make your journey worse that is how they will do it From the miserable forced parking for drop off to massive overcharges for a minor amendment to a ticket or the smallest hand baggage limitations known to man with zero tolerance they all add up to an impressively rubbish experience All delivered by staff who genuinely appear to enjoy making your experience miserable Clearly this is an airport that only survives due its location convenient for many in the South but it shouldnt be like this They should visit London City airport to see how a small airpot can be an utter joy

I recently had a return trip from Southampton airport for a trip to Amsterdam flying with Flybe The trip didnt start very well as I realized upon arriving at the airport at am that had overbooked for the short stay parking by a week I asked the two employees at the information desk who I could contact to change my booking or get a partial refund and was given a card with customer services number which didnt open until am by that time I was already in Amsterdam Then proceeded to queue for luggage checkin for about minutes which for such a small airport is quite a long time I called the customer service number as soon as the call center opened and was told to send an email with my request to a different department which I did and didnt think anything more of during my trip Upon my arrival back to Southampton airport I noticed that my luggage had been very badly damaged during the trip back and went straight to the help desk where a gentleman wrote down some information and gave me a leaflet with information for lostlate luggage again didnt think anything of it as I was told someone would contact me soon and it was by that time almost pm A week later and Ive called customer services twice about the refund each time being given a new email address to send my request to not heard anything about replacing the luggage and no idea when Ill be able to get anything sorted because the different departments apparently dont speak to each other Generally not too happy

Why only open the departures area at am People are sleeping on the floor In my opinion this is absurd and makes no sense at all Also there is no free WiFi I knew Southend was a low cost airport but this is too much to handle I would avoid transiting here

Worst Airport food and coffee i have ever experienced at the caf top of the escalators Nice new building and fast and efficient check in Just woeful coffee

A quick efficient security check just inside the door then youre in a big lobby and go to a checkin counter which you must do at any rate for a flight out of Russia even if you printed a boarding pass online so dont bother There are plenty of shops and places to eat both before and after formal passport control and formal security each of which involved less than minutes queuing Quintessentially Russian the passport officer never smiled but he was efficient and in no way discourteous Restrooms are clean and wellmaintained I awaited boarding in a nice lounge but almost all the newspapers to read are in Russian which I cant read Ample seating area at gate My flight to Paris had boarding via a jetway

I havent been to this airport in years and I must say it has changed a lot for the better but still has a long way to go The arrival zone is small and grey with a few rows of very old and dirty seating The only colourful spot was a red warning sign right in the middle about taxi fraudsters The washrooms have probably seen better days and could use some maintenance We waited quite a bit for our luggage but after that everything was pretty quick no big lineups at the passport checks and we were out in no time The best part of this airport is its exterior looks nice and modern The departure zone was a bit strange You can get a luggage cart at the airport entrance but you wont get far with it They run the luggage through the scanners right at the entrance even before the registration desks and you cant get the carts past the scanners so after the bags are scanned youre stuck without a cart and have to carry your bags to the airline counter There are self checkin kiosks but only the third one I tried actually worked the passport scanner still didnt work and I had to type all the information myself but at least it printed the boarding passes for me But even with the boarding passes you still have to stand in the airline registration line where they check in the bags take the boarding pass you just printed away and give you a different one Staff at the checkin counter were very nice and helpful There were a couple of cafes and a restaurant but the service at the restaurant was very slow Security and passport checks were a bit slow but not too bad no super big lineups there There was some shopping in the dutyfree zone The dutyfree zone was actually not too bad albeit relatively small The flight left on time

International arrivals at St Petersburg airport are at the newer terminal which is spacious but simply decorated probably below the standard of a modern airport but international flights are not too frequent and it is never congested On your first arrival you may feel uneasy but it is smooth if you know your way To book a taxi it is good to book inside with taxi stands which charges a reasonable standard fare of under ruples to town and if you do not have the currency you may even charge your fare on a credit card The train is not recommended as it terminates far from town To go to the airport book a taxi but specify the use of a metered city taxi or you pay double if not specified hotels will book you a nonmetered taxi and if so agree on a fare first The airport is inadequate in facilities such as shopping and food outlets but is not bad

From the city to the airport in minutes The new terminal is fine Beautiful geometric lines used in the design Checkin for flight did not take too long The old building renovated and converted into a zone of local flights There are many shops and cafes There was a small queue of precontrol before departure

Stavanger airport Sola is a small airport like the one in Bergen and Trondheim Not many international flights but quite many domestic The terminal there is only one is years old but they have started to upgrade everything All in all a comfortable airport

Worst airport I have ever experienced for passport control and security checks Ridiculously understaffed resulting in huge queues and waiting times Staff just stand around and do absolutely nothing to try to bring some sort of organisation to the chaos Would avoid this airport at all costs Only positive is that food prices are reasonable

Expensive transfers to airport The airport itself has decent facilities plenty of toilets seats and wifi is adequate Security wait times have improved from disaster of Be prepared to wait in long lines on arrival at immigration There are no egates and seems short staffed especially at night Overall the airport is OK but has areas of improvement

The airport is very small and virtually all of its flights are internal Swedish flights Firstly the airport doesnt open until am on Sundays if you show up earlier you will be waiting outside until it does which in winter in Sweden will not be much fun Secondly the first shuttle bus from Stockholm city centre to Bromma doesnt leave Stockholm until am on Sunday and it takes about minutes By contrast shuttle buses to Arlanda leave every minutes all day These factors are well worth bearing in mind for arrivingdeparting Bromma The lounge is also closed on Sundays The airport has a small selection of coffees and cakes and a very small and not particularly extensive souvenir shop possibly because the primary users are Swedish people on internal flights

I am a big fan of this airport It has only four or five checkin desks and lots of plants and pine furniture in the small departure hall It feels quite homely The staff at check in and at the small cafe have always been pleasant when I have flown from here I have also flown from Vasteras when the weather conditions have been dreadful very cold and heavy snow and everything at the airport and the shuttle bus from Stockholm have functioned with typical Swedish efficiency

This is a basic airport very small and expensive with only a few stores both landside and airside However security is quick there is seating and charging points available in the cafe The connections to public transport are poor you will need a taxi to take you to Nykoping railway station or take the coach however this is expensive and can take up to two hours There are indoor smoking booths near the gates

The building staff services and everything you see there is unlikely to be part of an international airport especially in the northern Europe It was undoubtedly the worst place to build a commercial airport Very far from the city center and not very convenient to commute More importantly the amount of unfriendliness one experiences is beyond description I did know that Sweden had introduced ID check even for European passengers I was holding my passport as we entered the airport and suddenly a group pf officers appeared in front of us One of them approached me and stood in front of me He didnt say anything but he was only staring at me I gave him my passport and ID Im sure he didnt know the difference as he was looking at all pages and visas for a long time Without saying a word he gave them back after minutes Other staff were not better

This is the worst airport I have been to Not once have I got a smile from the staff in about trips Security is super slow queue for mins The new built terminal has steps to enter and exit making it very hard for elderly You even have to pay if you want to stop and drop off a passenger I have been to lots of airports but this takes the price

This airport is nowhere near Stockholm I was charged SEK About to get a taxi into central Stockholm as its kms away There are no taxis available on the rank outside and calling for one on the phone on the wall took forever and when they arrive they park up across the road and its up to you to go and ask each driver and they arrive it they are there for you The bags did come out very quickly but this is a very small plus considering the distance the airport is from the real Stockholm I will be flying with SAS next time as I will save a small fortune for getting to and from Stansted and to and from Stockholm airport

Arrived to airport before am as it is said on their website it is open from am So waited outside in freezing December for more then one hour This information must be crystal clear changed on the website or they should really open the airport terminal at am

Strasbourg airport is a nice enough regional airport but I do not recommend it for transit passengers for the following reason It is not designed to deal with them despite many regional flights using it as a changeover location You have to pass customs and security when arriving then go straight back through at the departures end of the airport With a typical transit flight having minutes between your arrival and your next flight departing so your connecting flight is officially already boarding the moment you land this can be a challenge Thankfully the security check to get to the gates is quick and efficient I made my connection though I wonder if I would have if my connecting flight hadnt been delayed I was surprised that on my return flight to Amsterdam I was required to pass customs even though France and The Netherlands are both Schengen countries Access to the gate was blocked until someone came to man the border control area minutes after passengers were asked to proceed to the gate No staff had any idea why so there was much passenger confusion
Disrespectful security staff refusing to speak English and showing ostensible non kindness Treating EU citizens as terrorists on a Sunday morning at am Worst experience in an airport

Treated badly by the Security Why are they so rude and disrespectful I just left for my trip to Mallorca this month I noticed just how rude the security people are at Stuttgart airport I used to travel quite a bit for my job and have experienced many airports and I would have to say that these people are by far the rudest security people that I have ever encountered The female officer in charge spoke German without asking me if I could understand it or not She showed me that I had to place my shoes on a little step in German I tried to do what she showed me but she started screaming at me then showed only the bottom soles of the shoes without any possibility to hold myself for securing this position Especially I objected to an unusual pat down I received at a checkpoint Apparently this female officer is getting ruder since So say an increasing number of travelers citing their own experiences of being harassed and harangued by the screeners who are supposed to be helping them I realize that these people deal with thousands and thousands customers everyday and I am sure that some of these customers have attitude problems but shouldnt air travelers also be treated respectfully and compassionately I recommend the security screeners to be trained in general etiquette including subjects such as effective communication common courtesies and appropriate language use The agency also has a customer service branch responsible for tracking the complaints and working with appropriate personnel to resolve grievances

I cant remember when the last time I was here but nevertheless it was a pleasant surprise to use the airport again Many places to have food and the atmosphere was pleasant Just one thing that I disliked was the toilet in the common area It was really smelly and should be dealt with immediately

This used to be the old airport for all departures from KL but after this trip I realised this airport isnt old at all In fairness the upgrades have given Subang a good uplifting and made the airport hasslefree for passengers Theres a good restaurant upstairs serving hot food We didnt have any difficulty getting to the gate and we got there with time to spare Signage was good airport checkin and security not too difficult to clear For local and regional departures Subang would be the airport I will consider from now on

Not enough ticket agents to handle queue More security guards standing around talking than ticket agents to help Carrying luggage from basement on overloaded elevator to th floor then down for boarding pass where there were one sometimes boarding pass agents while I queued up By the time I negotiated the airport I missed my flight Malaysian Air scheduled hours between flights Not nearly enough time for getting baggage going up floors then down for the boarding pass International flights a passenger needs at least hours especially at Kuala airport Extremely poor customer service and organization Not yet arrived into the st century

Modern and easy to use No queues to speak of Firefly the main user are efficient and a cheaper alternative to flying Malaysian out of KLIA However beware transfer times from downtown KL especially during morning and evening peak times even more so on MondaysFridays Although nearer to the city centre than KLIA it can and did in my case take longer to get to Subang mins than it would have taken to get to KLIA

Passport control on arrival was fast and friendly The baggage reclaim did take a while as the luggage is brought from the plane in lots of small batches so if youre unlucky and your bag is in one of the later batches youll need to be patient Customs control is also quite long and is quite different from what one expects as staff will check phones cameras etc The staff were all polite though and smiling and treat your belongings carefully Departure is similar and there is a rather strange system of customs officers checking declaration forms over the shoulder of the checkin staff processing your flight The airport itself is spotlessly clean spacious and has all the shops and cafs you need all fully staffed by friendly personnel

Pyongyang airport in North Korea is small and almost empty with very few flights and few passengers It is to easy find the guides you need for your visit in North Korea You dont have to look for them they wait for you and find you after the passport visa and customs control The document check and the customs control are surprisingly smooth and fast It takes about minutes to pass the airport building including the controls The officials are friendly or at least not unfriendly as you might expect in this extremely closed communist country You have to deposit your mobile phone at the customs control but it can be kept by the guides during your visit and you get it back when you leave the country

Brace yourself for a rd world experience at this airport every time I use it I swear and declare I would sooner travel a further hour away to Brisbane airport to experience what you would expect in a st world country we had a herded arrival into the crowded public waiting area for departures heaving with people and observing no seating places vacant into the equally crowded baggage collection area greeted with a big sign on the wall from the Sunshine Coast council saying we are working on improvements same sign that has been there for years with NO sign of improvement as evidence only change is parking fees which have doubled in that time and take you further away to park Then yes a minute wait for baggage it is not worth coming here nor is it worth it feeding back to the council as it gets you nowhere

Sunshine Coast Airport MCY services mainly flights to Sydney SYD and Melbourne MEL with some services to Adelaide ADL and seasonal international services to Auckland AKL New Zealand A new low cost airline will soon be operating from the airport which will make flights north to several cities in Queensland and other flights to Melbourne and regional New South Wales and regional Victoria The airport terminal is located in Marcoola about mins north of Maroochydore Private Airport transfer services Taxis Ubers and public buses service the airport however the public bus system does not run a timetable that would service all arrivals or departures Paid short term and long term parking is available with some of the long term parking having sails to provide limited protection from the elements There is also an offsite private parking business within the airport precinct that offers secure indoor and outdoor paid parking The terminal has Checkin counter areas for airlines at the northern end and a covered breezeway then leads to security screening and the departure area at the southern end of the terminal The luggage carousels for arriving passengers luggage are also located at the southern end of the terminal along with rental car counters toilets Luggage sometimes can take a while to arrive on the carousels as it appears the incoming aircraft is unloaded and the bags for the departing flight are then loaded before the arriving flight luggage is finally brought into the terminal and loaded onto the baggage carousel The departure area has food outlets that sell food and drinks at the usual airport prices as well as a few shops including a surf shop and a news agency books newspapers etc The northern end of the departure lounge also operates as the international departure and arrival area when the seasonal Auckland flights are operating at other times it forms part of the domestic departure area Gates serve both as Arrival and departure gates and their are currently no aerobridges so you will walk down stairs onto the tarmac and into the terminal Facilities are available for disabled passengers who cannot utilise the stairs The airport at times can be very busy especially if flights are delayed otherwise their is plenty of seating As most flights are coming from Sydney and Melbourne weather or other delays can have a knock on effect causing delays to outbound flights The real advantage of using this airport is avoiding around a hr min trip to Brisbane Airport on a good day when there are no traffic delays or accidents on the M to Brisbane Airport The airport is expanding and the terminal facilities will improve as part of the expansion project Overall a very good airport experience

This is a small regional airport with maybe a dozen flights a day so maybe it does ok but a booming population and tourism means that it can get crowded On arrival walk through the main hall full of departing passengers and then crowd around the tiny baggage carousel you really have to shove people out of the way when you see your bag On departure checkin and security were fast despite no selfcheckin kiosks but you then have to walk back outside to access departures then theres a few cafes shops and a bar in the departure hall Prices seem even higher than normal for airports Theres an attempt at an observation deck but it has poor views and seems meant for smokers No airbridges and you can get long walks to the plane in the unpredictable Queensland weather Still the airports much more convenient for this area than Brisbane Airport theres plenty of parking longterm for a day or even less you can look it up on the website but the booking function doesnt seem to work and theres a great approach over the water probably for noise abatement then a hard turn at ft to line up with the runway seconds before landing

Most things and services at this airport are good except the WIFI I use this airport twice a week The free WIFI is not operational Waiting minutes to log on then dies faster than loading a single web page Dogs could get the mail quicker than this service The WIFI is as slow as dialup before dialup was invented WWW used to be for waiting waiting waiting Here it is NNN nothing nothing nothing If it cant be provided dont advertise it

Aeroplane landed at wrong terminal without telling any passengers Plane was already delayed and this added to the delay as we were put on shuttle to domestic terminal Also meant baggage was late arriving No correct signage of which correct carousel to collect baggage from Got into a Grab car Asian Uber at the airport and our driver was quickly stopped by local airport taxi workers They snatched her keys from the engine and her phone from her hand There must have been men at this time Horrid experience If Grab drivers are not allowed in the airport then the police should be involved not local thugs Absolute disgrace

Small and always a risk for bad weather but they do an amazing job clearing the snow closed less than hrs per year despite getting more snow on average than any comparable city Rarely any delays at counters or security Free WiFi Not much in the way of food or shopping No public transportation into Syracuse taxi only

I flew in from TRF th July and returned th Inbound went well no passport control between Norway and Poland luggage came fast and no delays getting out of the airport On departure things were not that smooth baggage system failed but much worse was the queue through security Our departure was at the same time as a Ryanair flight to Dublin and it took the best part of hours to pass Staff was not rude but in dire need of learning how to smile and treat people nicely Pity since the facilities are quite nice once you get through security When boarding the plane there was no one leading the way from the terminal so we had to find the plane more or less on our own Hardly satisfactory from a security point of view All in all it wasnt that bad Szczecin Solidarity is one of the smaller regional airports and as such rather new to international traffic I think they have come a good way and knowing the Poles I suspect they soon will do the required adjustments

Flew from here to STN and the service to get through passport control and security check is abysmal Only gate for each open and with full Ryanair flights STN DUB boarding at the same time I queued for minutes to get through Security staff who look like armed forces personnel are extremely surly and work to a go slow If flying from here check in well early and go through passport check and security as soon as possible

I have been using this airport for about years now and found it to be a right pain sometimes First the good points not far from Szczecin town centre mins by bus or car it has a good bar sells nice beers Now the bad points very slow moving queues when arriving here They dont make much of an effort to get you through passport control quickly Bags sometimes take a long time to arrive even though only flight arrives When leaving SZZ the army personnel that check you are quite surly and unhelpful You have to remove your shoes and belts There is no organised queue system for Ryanair flights just a free for all Waiting lounge is very small Can get very overcrowded when a flight is late Overall needs improvement and the staff need to be more cheerful stars max for now

Szczecins Solidarity Airport is one of the smaller regional airports in Poland The cartaxi ride from Szczecin takes a bit longer than expected but once there you will find a pleasant airport located in a wood away from the city It has only a small terminal but it is very modern fresh and complete with all facilities bookstalls shops cafs etc that open also for early morning departures Im told there is a small hotel nearby The staff is helpful Only a handful of flights depart each day so the terminal does not get crowded and the atmosphere is casual and relaxed And the security check was very thorough which I appreciated

There is not enough seating if two flights are departing within a short space of time The prices for snacks and drinks are exorbitant more expensive than London Gatwick The toilet facilities are appalling hold your breath and get out quick One outside a janitor gives a square of toilet paper and holds his hands out for a tip Would travel through this airport again but would be a lot more prepared

Tabriz airport is small but efficient You cant expect an international airport will all the dutyfree etc Its built for domestic flights but still offers a few flights to regional capitals and holiday destinations Tabriz airport is the home for ATA airline which is a private Iranian airliner Direct IstanbulTabriz flights are very convenient and as I said with minimal bureaucracy at the airport The airport itself is tidy but with a limited choice for customers The transit hall and the checkin area relatively small but they meet the purpose The selection of food and beverages is limited though there a few nice souvenir shops Tabriz is known for good food Dry Nuts Sweet shops which are all available at the airport

Tabriz is a small modern airport with easy access from city center Taxi costs only Euro I was at the airport hours before flight and there have been only one other flight in this period I was almost alone there and already start to worry as the check in for my flight starts only minutes before departure They have plenty of souvenir shops and one cafeteria Multimedia screens helps to kill the time All went smooth and fast No smoking rooms and wifi available

Arrived in terminal The facilities were quite outdated and the queues for immigration were quite long I departed from terminal The security lines were short but the food options are extremely limited Also the airport is designed quite inefficiently I was overall quite disappointed

The airport was a bit far from the city but well connected to the public transportation with clear signs and direction It was in general clean Queuing time at the immigration was not too long for us As many other Asian international airports TPE was full of restaurants and a shopping paradise for passengers to kill waiting time Each boarding gate had a different theme and sometimes did not have enough seats for everyone
There is very good food and Wifi Internet The dutyfree shop has all kinds of brands and it is cheaper than neighboring countries The immigration inspection is fast and not difficult

Queuing time was minutes long to get through The staff were unhelpful I cannot imagine a single person in that exceedingly long queue thought there was not a better way to do this process If you can avoid transferring flights at this airport do so It is inefficient I keep thinking theyll correct it but in seven years it has remained the same

What to say I transit every year in or airports and first time here as first time with EVA Air May be I have been spoiled by traveling with SIA or Qatar Airways but here it looks like a flashback Dark old and odd First and last time

Decided to fly via Kinmen to mainland China instead of HKG This required using Taipeis older Songshan Airport instead of Taoyuan Airport Access to the airport is very quick and easy using the Taipei Metro direct to the front of the airport something that Taoyuan is yet to get I used the Domestic Terminal which is odd in many ways as the domestic arrangements in Taiwan do not follow an international standard For a start there is a KG limit despite the airlines website saying KG was okay the error was simply a copy and paste from the airline international sister airline and followed international rules The CheckIn counter were arranged in small islands however after getting your boarding pass you then had to go to another counter along the airside wall for your baggage While the queue was almost nonexistent why it can not be done at the same counter at the same time defies logic Baggage tags simply state the name of your destination in English and Chinese no bar codes and no straight forward ability for transferring to other flights Due to the limited space on the airside gates passengers are asked to wait in the CheckIn Hall where there are amble lounges and Eleven convenience store When your flight number appears above the Security Door you can then proceed through to your gate Flights are very frequent and regular so this was not a great issue and waiting by the gate or the lounge makes little difference Overall it was efficient and quick despite its quirky nature On my return flight the baggage hall housed two belts and the bags appeared quickly enough and I was through and on the metro back into Taipei in little time

I live in Tallahassee and have used the airport aka TLH for more than years TLH is a very expensive local domestic airport to use It very small for an American capital city However it is accessible to most people who live within miles of Tallahassee The current facility is a significant upgrade over our old airport but not worthwhile for the airport construction price paid maintenance costs and amenities provided Unfortunately I would have to recommend that travellers drive from either Atlanta or Orlando rather than rely on timely and enjoyable arrivaldeparture from TLH

A very tiny airport not worthy of a city that hosts FSU and the state capital of Florida Pretty far from city limits and costs an arm and a leg to fly into I suggest JAX instead The terminal is clean but thats because there is only a few square feet of actual terminal Not many eating selections to choose from Long term is more expensive than it should have been

Worst airport for customer service Automated boarding pass scanners dont scan right and when you have an issue you cant find an employee in sight and when you find one they do not care one bit Dont ask for a manager because they will start saying that you the customer is being disrespectful

Nice airport However poor signage for pickup by Lyft or Uber Baggage clam then have to go back upstairs to get picked up Very poor design A lot more walking for disabled Any very confusing for someone not accustom to the area Very disappointed in the design

TPA is the cleanest airport I have been in compared to ATL and BOS This time I lost my ID and was frantic The TA were so nice and said that it happens more than you think There was a slight delay on Jet Blue but they made it up in the air I prefer Jet Blue cuz I have never had a problem Only once flying into Newark but it wasnt the airlines fault Our flight was diverted because their was an explosion at Newark so all flights were diverted to LGA and JFK Luckily I wound up in PA somewhere and they had to get us a hotel Missed the wedding shower cuz then pilots were on overtime Big mess Finally I got to Newark and rented a car Was glad to get back to Tampa

Airport staff offered no assistance with flight cancellations or my wheel chair due to a significant injury to my foot Personnel stood by while party struggled managing luggage a year old and my disability

The airport is extremely small smaller than most bus stations Services are extremely basic On the landside there are only a small waiting room maybe chairs and one info desk Nothing more Not a single ATM make sure you do have some cash when arriving here On the airside there is a small cafe upstairs and a bit larger waiting room maybe or chairs but still small And only one gate Out of the gate you walk straight to the airplane no apron transport cause it is so small However I can say that my experience with it is almost only good Everything worked efficiently security is quite thorough on the arrival there was even a police dog but it was correct and did not make unnecessary complications Security queue was well organized and it waiting was not too long A bit of a hassle in the boarding queue where the staff opened an additional check and some people from the back of the queue managed to get in front But all in all no big problems efficient procedures on arrival and departure baggage claim was also prompt I can imagine that it might be a bit different in the high season when there are more people

Flying cheap is always a compromise and the departures facilities at Tampere are no exception On my journey the overcrowding and understaffing resulted in long long queues for everything check in security loos etc Babies cried and cried angry voices cursed Ryanair scrums formed all rather stressful and unpleasant Very few seats around most had to use the floor ps be aware that in Finland the expensive taxis are more expensive on Sundays and in the evenings
Diabolical shambles of an airport with very poor organisation and too many flights for it to cope with Food offering airside is also abysmal Flight queues intermingle and announcements are inaudible

I am a tour operator I organize itineraries and lead groups mostly in Morocco I recently had a group of US university students and staff arriving at the Tangier airport on Vueling flight VY on Friday morning February The flight was due in at and arrived at It took the group until just under hours to get through the immigration process I was waiting for them in the arrivals area I had phone contact with the staff They told me there were agents working when there is room for more to work People waiting were getting so frustrated that they were applauding sarcastically whenever a person got through As soon as my group was together in arrivals I welcomed them to Morocco and immediately apologized for the miserable welcome they had received I had to change the mornings itinerary and drop an activity I was back in the aiport a few days later to see the group off and I had time before my own departure so I sought out the airport manager who directed me to fill in a suggestionscomplaints formit was obvious he was not interested in hearing from me I told him anyway I have also sent a complaint to ONDA the national airports authority in Morocco and they have responded saying just about nothing Morocco wants tourists and the money they bring but they treat visitors to a first impression of incompetence indifference and a lack of respect Marrakech airport used to have people wait for up to an hour for immigration clearance and they got better I hope Tangier airport can improve too They really ought to be ashamed

I am a US citizen who was departing Tashkent airport for NYC on October th at am on HY flight The customs lady started berating me for having a kilo or pounds over the limit for my checked baggage When I offered to pay for the extra she ignored my offer and kept berating me in Russian for not knowing customs rules Then she asked me to put my carry on on the weights and continued to berate me for having another kilo over the limit for my carryon She finally let me go Absolutely unprofessional and unethical treatment of foreign tourists I will never go back

This airport is really lame When you arrive you see throngs of people swarming the ticket counter with nobody outside the queue trying to control the crowd You have to have your bags scanned on entry at customs and at security You also need to have a printed copy of your electronic visa to show passport control Once behind security there is only one shop the dutyfree shop But thats in name only All the wine is twice as expensive as on the street The conversion from Euros to USD is terrible and its a must if paying by card Its best to try and push back and tell them how much it should be in USD using the current rate Meanwhile there is no business lounge for carriers besides HY and there are no jet bridges just old buses There is no free WiFi Uzbekistan is trying to make a name for itself but the departing experience is like something out of Midnight Express I might never be back

Strict levels of security bordering on the obsessive Luggage is scanned twice You are searched even if the metal detector does not go off as you pass through it It is understandable Beware of possible ripoffs at the DutyFree Shop They can give you the wrong conversions from euros to Uzbek sums if you want to pay in local currency

Tashkent airport is one of the least welcoming ever but at least there are sovietera aircraft to look at When I arrived There was just a walkway leading from the gate to the immigration which took a while but was acceptable Then there was security It is like Ataturk airport only more strict Once you approach the terminal you pass through a metal detector Then once you enter the terminal am etal detector When Checking in the attendant at the counter seemed to be too focused on the job at hand he didnt really hear my requests up until I got my boarding pass Then departure security the staff yelled at me for not putting my wallet into the xray machine since I thought that it was only carryon baggage After that immigration Another person travelling in our group took so long when we asked why he said The officer just kept checking and checking and checking Then departures was welcoming And then the cobus to take us to the plane had no air conditioning so it was scorching

Date th Aug Time hours Flight hours First state The entry to airport is thru one small gate only The security was struggling with passengers at a time No sun shade It took minutes to enter first stage Second stage is on upper floor No issue but only one gate For Boeing wide bodied check in staff only How can they manage plus passengers It took minutes to get boarding pass as one check in staff closed the counter leaving a long queue for the only one checkin staff Third stage is customs I have seen customs only during arrivals But it is in Departure also at Tashkent It took minutes Fourth stage is Immigration Counters are but staff is very slow Took another minutes Fifth stage is security Open shoes take shoe cover Took minutes At last we reached Gate B just minutes before departure time

I forgot my prescription glasses in the Duty Free in Tbilisi Following a few emails to the Duty Free department I received a positive response that they were found Two ladies did everything in their power to have them returned to me I cant fault these people they showed care and sympathy to my problems They are Natia and Inna Thank you so much

The first interaction with the airport staff immigration on arrival was terrible The lady was rude and unpleasant treating me and my passport disrespectfully by throwing it and removing seals from the pages reserved for visas without any communication When I asked her to kindly stamp on a used page with sufficient space for the Georgian stamp as I had limited empty pages she simply said NO without any elaboration She then tried to talk to me in a language other than English I assume Russian but I am not sure and expected me to understand Her overall attitude was rude and her tone of voice was unfriendly and irritated I have traveled to more than countries and have never been treated with such disrespect

The staff at the airport is perhaps the rudest Ive encountered in my life They havent been properly trained on how to treat visitors They yell and talk to people like they are dogs The country was a wonderful place to visit full of good people however the men checking your bags are hateful condescending and outright disrespectful I dont mind it I can take it but to talk to my wife the way they did is unacceptable Low quality ignorant staff its a horrible representation of such a beautiful country to deal with these people

Staff are very rude They checked me thoroughly and ask to open my bag and not to touch anything i was just standing there and they are also checking the other passengers coming after mins i ask the security if i can go and get my bag she said oh yes you can i forgot She made me wait for nothing They have an overpriced for their food inside the airport I will share this experience to my colleagues and other friends

Small airport with no arrival duty free shop Passport control staff attitude towards me was unacceptable Had a valid year multiple entry Schengen visa in my passport but they asked me to show them the money I had with me along with my return ticket and my hotel reservation While leaving the country I noticed filthy toilets and very few options of restaurants

Modern airport generally fine On arrival the taxi situation is uncontrolled resulting in ripoff cabs I ended up angrily being demanded GEL on arrival in Tbilisi for a GEL journey They seem to try to block Bolt which doesnt seem to work On departure good luck finding a coffee for less than in any caf seems to be run by a cartel

Reading all the bad reviews I cannot help but agree on how rude and unprofessional the airport staff is Check in staff eating pumpkin seeds security staff with a massive ego and immigration officers acting in a disrespectful manner Even the food and beverage staff have no clue about service and hospitality Being such a beautiful tourist destination you would think service is a priority but we found it very disappointing Good food great nature and not the warmest people

Long queing times Tehran Imam Khomeini airport rude and unfriendly staff Not worthy of such a friendly and hospital country Waiting times have been extraordinary long We had to pass diffrent security and xray scans to board the plane Unfriendly and stressed staff all over the airport

Tehran IKA Airport looks like an isolated domestic terminal rather than international Arrival immigration is small and if two or more flights arrive at the same time it will be chaos Baggage conveyor belts are limited to three which seems no maintenance has been performed for a long time At the same place the toilets are dirty most of the time The departure section is little better in comparison of Arrival Wifi is free but could not be used at all Passengers security checks are conducted two times Departure section is a little bit organized The airport website is just in Persian language Finding a car park is so hard At the time writing review no public transportation except taxi are accessible In comparison of other region airport like Dubai Qatar and Istanbul airports IKA is messy

For a city of this size Tehran Imam Khomeini airport is quite small Overall a modern airport but immigration procedure at arrival took a long time Also a bit chaotic at baggage claim as the space on the belt is tight if a B arrives At departure all went fine but the food in the restaurants was awful Even in duty free no alcohol was avaiaible and there are no smoking rooms after security check No free wifi available

I have traveled a few times there and had no problem but this time I missed my flight due to the malfunction of the airport The flight information board doesnt work properly any more and they only announce your flight once so be careful Pay your exit tax in a bank before you go to the airport Dont rely on the bank there like me The cashier was serving one of us form the queue and passport from a travel agency without our knowledge so some people from the queue were missing their flight The police or security office werent helpful and were nasty It seems as if the Airport site doesnt let you to write a review since its getting probably lots of bad ones Hopefully they sort the airport out soon

Tehran Merhabad is the old main airport of Tehran Easy access from city center Before security check there are plenty shops and restaurants after security check the choice is lower Long queue and chaotic scenes at check in also at first security check before entering the airport Second security check was taken a bit easy they not even use hand held dedectors No wifi available smoking rooms after security check available Waiting area after security looks like a bus station

Very modern newly built structure with passport control relatively smooth I expected tighter gothrough experience If you think of your immigration check at JFK going through passport check at IKA is a walk in the park I had carryon luggage so I rushed through exit with one more X Ray control to go Nothing major but of course avoid to bring in alcohol Departure was early in the morning Very congested security check before you check in you have to squeeze all your luggage and metal stuff under the x ray and then your physical check is very slow If you fly economy not much to do in the airport Couple of good coffee shops with plenty of tables and seats few duty free shops There is one nice handicraft shop tough Careful about public announcements that are delayed Flights were announced departing when I had seen them happily taking off minutes earlier Smoking area is below the main floor with very nice view of the apron No internet available in the public space Once you move to your departing gate there is another security control The boarding area is okay with nice reclined seats overlooking the runway and one small coffee shop Overall a nice airport with huge room for improvement given the beautiful building and the fair share of international traffic

Departing on am flight to Kerman All bags Xrayd before you enter the terminal There was one queue for my flight and only one person checking everyone in but she was fantastically efficient and once at the head of the queue the process must have taken only seconds Amazingly people behind me were thrusting their tickets at her whilst she was dealing with me Airside departure lounge was full and despite a lot of seats very few free There seemed to be about flight leaving at the same time as mine The lounge reminded me of a s bus depot Plenty of shops around to get souvenirs and snacks although I didnt use them It is a small affair and all gates are in the one area Toilets were grim with long queues Go before you arrive Flight information screens toggled between English and farsi but the English version stayed on screen about of the time It seemed I was the only European person there Suddenly the screen above the departure door flashed up for my flight Bus to the plane for an on time departure On the return journey bus journey back to the terminal and baggage re claim was very fast I was out of the airport within minutes of landing Some taxi offices in the arrivals building Overall Mehrabad is a place to catch a domestic flight no more no less A long delay would be a nightmare here The transfer to the international airport is about an hour through heavy Tehran traffic

Although the computer information screens are in Farsi and English I would advise completely disregarding the English information Flying from Terminal to Esfahan on Iran Air the computer screens read Delay without estimate next to my flight An hour after the scheduled departure time this suddenly switched to boarding When I enquired I was told I was too late to check in By this point the info screens were showing Await further information on my now departing flight Moral of the story Ignore the screens and be at a check in desk any check in desk an hour before your flight is leaving and stay there until someone gives you a boarding card Dont take no for an answer and dont ask the airport info desk theyre nice but clueless speak with the airline Airport itself is fine but frequently descends into chaos that only a minimal amount of planning or thought would avoid You quite often see hordes of staff racing around and shouting trying to resolve a confused multi flight boarding situation when it would have taken just one of them to head off the problem with clear directions half an hour earlier Would strongly recommend arranging for your hotel to send a car to pick you up on arrival It is not possible to figure out how the airport taxi system works without practice and often its the last thing you need when youve just landed Taxi touts attempting to charge a markup on the maxmimum rate are common Ensure a fare at the start and dont let him drive off until youre satisfied

Mehrabad airport is an old and small airport that shows its age The tarmac is worn out and inside terminal is very dark and boring Duty free shops are expensive and theres not a good eatery at the gates Also I noticed security was taken easier than other airports given that I walked through the metal detector and it beeped but nobody apparently cared I also noticed that their body search was very basic On another occasion upon return I walked into the Homa class lounge without having proper authority and no one seemed to care In the lounge although nice looking there was nothing special All in all its a tolerable airport but far from being a world class gateway I am hoping to see the brand new airport opened in my next trip to Iran this summer

Tehran Mehrabad Airport is what you expect Very basic very s and just not that great Its not modern shopping facilities are limited and eating and drinking is minimal also its very crowded at certain times especially around midnight I always wondered why Iran didnt put some money in airport improvements Because as we all know an airport is the first and last thing visitors to the country usually see It turns out that they didnt improve the airport because they were quietly building a super modern airport Imam Khomeini International Airport that will be fully operational in

Traumatising experience in this airport last friday Everything was ok when we arrived but it was a whole different story when we left Israel The first security check before checking in our luggage is simply ridiculous We got interviewed by a very young girl who was clearly having fun torturing us with the most stupid questions who packed your bags did you leave your bags unattended what did you do with your bags since you finished packing it was endless She went to see what seemed to be her supervisor many times with our passports surely with the hope of delaying us more But they seemed to tell her off and she finally let us go She put a number on the back of our passport and after checking in our bags we got sent to the infamous line very strict bag searching security check Rude staff there again who will shamelessly open all your bags and go through all your stuff We arrived hours prior to our flight and were at the gate minutes before boarding What a joke

We were told we need to be at the airport hours before our flight We arrived from Jerusalem to Tel Aviv airport by train and took a mins bus to terminal The security checkin process at the departure door was surprisingly fast And the bags checks were pretty fast too They opened up a separate area for a faster bag check process The whole process only took mins and we have hours now to kill at the airport Note that this was a pm flight and we arrived at pm on Monday

I recently arrived at Thessaloniki Airport with my monthold child in a carrier expecting a smooth transition after a long journey Unfortunately my experience was far from satisfactory Upon arrival I had to collect my luggage which included a travel case with two bicycles a stroller and regular luggage Managing all of this alone was already challenging but it became nearly impossible when I tried to get a trolley To my dismay I discovered that trolleys could only be accessed with a coin which I didnt have There were no machines to obtain coins nor were there any employees willing to assist or lend a coin Despite my obvious struggle and the presence of a small child no staff members stepped in to help The lack of basic assistance and the unavailability of a simple solution to access a trolley made the situation extremely stressful and frustrating This level of service is unacceptable especially for an international airport that should be equipped to handle the needs of travelers including those with young children and large luggage I hope the management takes steps to address these issues and improve the overall experience for future passengers
Good airport no delays it was fairly quiet when I travelled Security and passport checks all done efficiently Staff were polite and helpful

The Fast Track for Business Guests is used by employees of the airport who think they have the right to move forward without asking I have been flying out of SKG many times this year and this seems to be routine practice to have the paying customers wait in line since the employees consider themselves as being entitled to have priority Fraport should definitely change this practice

Despite enjoying a very relaxing holiday in Greece the experience was ruined by rude immigration staff at Departures As I walked through the metal detectors the alarm did not go off I think this upset one of the immigration officers so she then rudely said random selection The man politely swabbed my hands but did not like the fact that I was collecting my belongings This is because I knew that the result would be negative The woman was very unpleasant In the departure area the airport is very clean and the shops are kept tidy There was enough seating in the gate area

I was twice in Tianjin Airport First time it was domestic flight the second time it was an international one I was positively surprised about the airport and its open and bright architecture No signs are missing very straightforward as well as very good shopping and food opportunities I flew the second time with Air China and I would have appreciated it if the airline provided permanent open checkin desks but they didnt So if you are too early as I was that time you have to wait until the desks are open to drop your Bagage All in all a quite good experience

The new terminal is a big step up compared to the old one but still it does not give the passengers a warm feeling Its big and but feels small crowed and untidy comparing to Incheon Intl airport Most of the facilities are not well designed Signs are confusing and some do not make sense Most staff are unfriendly International departure area is not an open design passenger need to go through a door to check in at the counter and if you want to come out you have to go through the same door again totally unnecessary Seems that the Chinese has long way to catch up with the world standards

I arrived on a national flight from Guadalajara The gates of the Tijuana Airport are quite modern with jetways at each gate There are restaurants and shops along the concourse It was necessary to have my passport checked by an immigration officer who saw it was a US passport and waved me through without looking at it The customs inspection was minimal The baggage claim area is OK When I checked in for my departing flight I found passengers were required to go through screening and customs inspection to enter the checkin area It is possible to exit and go outside while awaiting boarding time after you check in The street entrance to the airport is under construction and it is necessary to walk past the boardedoff areas to enter the terminal There is a bus station at the airport right by the terminal for shuttle buses to CA Overall this airport is not bad and will be very good once construction is completed

Very very weak services with luggage on arrival airplanes worth of people waiting for one rail of luggage under the pretext that it is under construction even though one already arrives at the supposed new terminal All in all a very poor service for a new and modern airport

A small airport divided into mini terminals domestic international arrival and international departure Border control was fast and efficient despite the large amount of passengers The terminals itself are clean and well maintained but rather s looking Access to the aircraft is by bus boarding only There are many taxis to the center but negotiate well A few busses are available too but look like from a museum

Small airport short ways to the gates but very unfriendly staff Today I was yelled at because there was some metal applied to my shirt After checking everything several times I had to go to a cabin and undress myself The staff member was arrogant and did not speak in a way that I would call appropiate As I regulary fly from this airport I have often at times had similar problems On the other side everything can easily be found at the airport and cheap food can be purchased

A pleasant but very small airport I took the number bus from the town out to the airport Bus tickets should be bought from a kiosk these are usually located near tram stops It was a short minute ride to the airport Its a bit of a comically small airport with a handful of check in desks With hand luggage only I went straight to security lines available The security guard told me incorrectly by liquids bag was oversized so I had to dispose of some items Not a problem given it was the end of my trip but a little annoying given there was not a legitimate issue Security was quick nonetheless There arent many facilities in the airport A couple of small shops are there not extortionately priced There is no drinkable tap water to fill bottles There are not many toilets Seating could be tight if there were multiple flights Communication for boarding was clear and we departed as scheduled

It is a small airport operating both line and low cost flights The security check and the boarding went very fast the waiting areas are ok The quality of the sound system is low it is difficult sometimes to understand the announcements especially those in English

Primitive airport I was told to go to the airlines office so they can verify airport check in was included in my booking even though I was showing staff proof I had a priority booking which included this service Staff is rude and unhelpful The airport is crowded clearly operating beyond capacity Absolute nightmare Impossible to avoid since its the only airport in the country so practically a monopoly

A small airport serving the capital Its a bit of a chaotic place long queues staff arent the friendliest and generally messy The terminal itself is clean tho and seating is comfortable As its the only major airport in the country this it what they can offer Taxi trip to the center is lek

I was disappointed I knew that Albania is a not so developed country but I expected that at least the airport would come up to European standards I failed Checkin and passport control were okay Security very eagerly took the small bottle opener which was easily allowed at other airports There are a few shops outside so it is worth buying things and drinking there before security check because inside there are only very limited facilities and they do not accept creditbank cards All prices are displayed only in Euros which is strange in a country where Lek is the official currency Wifi was okay I cannot complain about that Travellers have no other option than this airport so lets hope Albania will step on the road to modernity soon If more tourists come a better equipped airport will be necessary

The airport has got very poor quality of housekeeping service Our flight was at pm and we arrived airport around pm To our surprise there were lots of mosquitoes at seating place After complaining to airport authorities they have given us number to call housekeeping incharge He arrived there after more than half an hour And he blindly said us that either we have to seat in front of AC flow or bear the mosquitoes as he cant do fogging He just given us this excuse and walked out from there I have observed few foreign traveller also there

This is a seriously bad airport honestly the worst I have ever visited It is far too small for the number of flights it serves with poor facilities All staff I dealt with were fine its the physical building and facilities that are lacking The loo is dirty and smelly the caf too small and had run out of a lot of drinks and foods on the menu The space for queuing for security and passport control is hot cramped and crowded as is the airside space I loved Tivat town but please sort out the airport

My recent visit to Tivat Airport left me utterly disappointed and frustrated to say the least From the moment I arrived until the moment I finally boarded my flight the experience was nothing short of a chaotic nightmare Understaffed and Overcrowded Upon entering the airport it became immediately apparent that the facility was severely understaffed There was only one person checking flight tickets leading to an outrageously long queue that snaked through the terminal To exacerbate matters there was also just one queue for both hand luggage and personal control causing massive congestion and delays No Relief from Crowds and Heat The airport quickly filled with travelers waiting in line and the atmosphere became stifling There was a complete lack of adequate air conditioning or ventilation making it unbearable to stand in the packed queues The lack of seating aggravated the situation leaving elderly passengers and families with young children particularly vulnerable and uncomfortable Unprofessional and Unhelpful Staff Adding insult to injury the airport staff were shockingly unprofessional and downright rude They displayed a complete lack of courtesy and seemed indifferent to the plight of passengers struggling with the chaotic conditions Requests for assistance were met with dismissive gestures or simply ignored further deepening the sense of frustration among travelers Overall Impression In summary my experience at Tivat Airport was one of the worst I have encountered in my travels The combination of understaffing overcrowding lack of basic amenities and unprofessional staff created an environment that was not only unpleasant but also distressing For an international airport these conditions are simply unacceptable and reflect poorly on the management and operational standards If you have the option to avoid Tivat Airport or choose an alternative route I strongly recommend doing so

Tivat Airport is a nightmare Small hardly any staff overcrowded hot and no wifi It took nearly hours of solid queuing with only check in desk person checking passports Unable to move due to the entire airport full of passengers Avoid if possible

I would like to thank two ladies at the Check In who were simply awesome With hundreds of people around them they saw I was very late due to traffic my fault completely They conducted my registration and took me through lines I was late was my flight to Brussels Thank you very much Tivat Airport

What a dump Queues going in all directions From outside you have to get through the queue to security to access the gates Your own boarding pass is not acceptable they throw it back at you and give you one of theirs People queued wide to get through security manned by person The gate number on the boarding pass is not the one used The airport departure lounge was pouring with rain inside No information and nowhere to get out of the way

ANA is using Terminal for some international flights The inside is new ANA lounge is spacious But if you do not have access to lounge the FB is very limited Shopping almost inexistant This terminal is really small and most flight has to be boarded by bus Really not acceptable for an international airport Terminal is far better
