Be careful when having dutyfree I took Air China from Singapore to Beijing Airport for a layover we were hand carrying our dutyfree bought in Singapore for my relatives When passing customs into domestic flights we were told DutyFree were to be put in cargo so we sent it to be put in cargo Keep in mind we were using a fabric bag so its not very protective We put the fragile sticker on the bag and GUESS WHAT They put heavy hard casesd luggages on top of our bag and they threw our bag onto the belt to bring it to cargo hold I could feel the thud from the throw as I was in a Window seat above the cargo hold They even threw our bag in the cargo hold They threw our bag times so hard I could feel the thud in the cabin After we got our bag we found the dutyfree leaking It was a bottle of alcohol for my relatives Airport was ok just the ground crew
Big modern airport not many people which was surprising A bit of a hassle getting my hour visa but got there in the end Straight through security and hopped into a taxi for downtown Beijing

Efficientish lots of empty desks and machines but we moved through OK The travesty is the business lounge which is abysmal am no decent coffee pre packaged soggy danish pastries and beef curry offered as the hot option No champagne Just terrible

Big nice and clean airport But thats all The airport international departure is way too big the airport is very empty Checkin is very frustrating Travelled with Qatar Airways and always have had pleasant experiences with them Not at Daxing airport kg overweight for person was an issue Needed to rearrange After that the checkin lady wanted to weigh the cabin luggage That was slightly overweight as well But she wanted to charge USDkg Although it is the airlines right never had this experience before with Qatar Airways She didnt want to issue the boarding pass until we cleared some stuff After some negotiations we said we will clear at the gate This frustrated the journey At the end they did not check anything at the gate The queue at the checkin counter was very long After queuing for a while we realised a separate queue for onlinecheckin Time wasted The signs were not clear and the personnel was not proactive to inform people You also need to do a health declaration arrival and departure But the machine at the airport is a joke and doesnt work most of the time The security check checks every inch of your body never had this experience as well They have to take a photo of you prior you clear immigration at the immigration and when going through security Every baggage you have they need to take a photo of you and the baggage For what Shops were closes in the evening after pm and hardly any food courts or restaurants Disappointing The connection to the airport is not so convenient high speed trains every hour or so from Beijing West Railway Station but the tickets need to be bought in advance Or metro but if you are coming from downtown you need to change metro couple of times Taxi would be an alternative Overall I would prefer Beijing Capital International Airport

The traffic of Beijing Daxing airport is very convenient You can get there by highspeed rail The design of Daxing airport is very grand and novel There are many selfservice checkin machines in Daxing airport There are many open windows at the manual checkin place and the queuing time is short The efficiency of security inspection is high but there are few open channels which leads to a long queue time After passing the security check there are many restaurants in it and the price is the same as that in the urban area The departure and arrival of Daxing airport are mixed There are many turntables at the baggage claim area and the waiting time is very short Its just that the airport guidelines need to be improved I was a little confused when I went to Daxing airport for the first time Airport WiFi is fast and supports takeout at the gate

As might be expected clean and efficient In fact arriving at the place was empty there seemed to be only one other flight arrival around that time But the gate is a long way from the immigration hall There are moving walkways but it nonetheless took a while Then a long wait for baggage My main gripe though and a cautionary note my Swiss army knife was confiscated at the train station Carefully packed in checked baggage never in carryon so no problem for the flight But getting in to the ticket hall for the train to Beijing baggage is inspected and my knife was not allowed Be warned This made it an expensive train ticket I would have enjoyed a coffee and snack but neither airport arrivals or the train station had anywhere open
Please add employees at passport check this is unacceptable The queue is never seem before for me This feedback applies for the last few months for departures

Because of all the bad reviews I arrived hrs prior to departure There was no security check to enter the building you could just step in As I flew with Ryanair to Cypres EU passport I asked at the Ryanair counter if my printed online boarding pass is ok It was I was the only passenger to proceed the security checks at that time so I could just walk through Overall I was airside in minutes and enjoyed the Cedar Lounge

A nice airport and frankly I am surprised at the bad reviews I arrived there at approx hrs Entry and checkin were very easy Security was straight forward and immigration was very easy Once on the airside a restaurant was open as were the dutyfree shops The only downside were the grumpy staff of the shops who obviously had not woken up yet Announcements were clear and boarding was orderly and we took off on time

Even though I am Lebanese and should proudly put a high grade for my national airport I cannot but curse the authorities and the staff there for the big mess created I came in hours before my flight departure to Europe whereby I couldnt do an online checkin Coincidence that Europeans have blocked online checkin for Beirut I managed to miss my plane due to the waiting line at the first scanner hours prior to my flight and I missed it No help from any security or staff to skip the line I feel ashamed by such incompetency

Small for a supposedly international airport but the only international flights I saw listed were to Suriname Terminal building was clean and modern albeit somewhat sparse Plenty of small shops and places for snacks There is one larger restaurantbar with a view of the tarmac Taxis appeared to be plentiful

The airport is undergoing more renovation as it seems to have been doing for the last or so years so much so Id say that since around Im really not sure Ive been through the airport twice and its been the same in terms of features layout and processes due to continuous upgrades And yet with this there seems to be very little change in the improvement to customer experience The departure process is head and shoulders above arrivals although is by no means in and of itself world beating The food places are of lowaverage quality with generally lacklustre service and yet at very high end prices While Ive been lucky with queue times of late Ive seen plenty of people complaining on social media about ridiculous wait times at departure security despite so much noise from the airport about the improvements Seating and comfort is minimal unless you are spending at one of the overpriced eateries and the general patina and cleanliness of the building interior in many places leaves a lot to be desired On return the processing time at immigration wasnt too bad and the wait at baggage was OK too however the appearance of the arrivals area from departing the plane until exiting the terminal is very dated grubby and lacklustre It does seem like the management approach to patchwork upgrades over a very protracted period of time does not yield great results as there is never a moment where a clean start to finish customer experience is pulled off Finally and this was exacerbated by our early morning flight on a November morning any airport that calls itself International should be offering skybridges as standard and not leaving passengers to walk the apron in the cold and rain

Ive seen a lot of bad reviews of this airport but I wanted to reassure people that the airport is not as bad as it seems Most of the travel crisis in July was not the airports fault Yes it is slightly run down but the service was excellent and it serves as a good base for EasyJet and Jet Security was a breeze and Jet queues were non existent I actually found the toilets clean and the airport was clean with clear signs to the gate and there was no delays I am sorry if you had a bad experience during the travel crisis but with more airlines joining in I can only assume the airport will improve Jet has locations from Belfast I found it clean convenient and will travel again with Jet next year Staff were polite even when I accidentally left my aftershave in my hand luggage going through security They gave me a plastic bag to put it in and were friendly with me Ive never had any problems with the airport The other thing is the Northern Ireland economy isnt Dubai economy so its not like you are walking into Dubai International with Etihad Airways and expecting everything to be made of glass Belfast City may be more efficient for short haul flights but Belfast International has more destinations overseas I think for an airport in Northern Ireland with the current economy Belfast International is actually an excellent airport despite the reviews Its probably best to bear in mind Dublin Airport and London Heathrow Airport faced the same kind of issues as Belfast when it came to delays so Belfast isnt the odd one out It probably gets more of a bad reputation just because its slightly run down But I think its excellent and is set to improve I have heard reports of vomit on the floor and rude staff but perhaps that was sorted by the time I was travelling Many external factors meant there was delays and issues It could do with being updated and prices reduced but apart from that it is excellent I dont have a photo but the lounge looks first class I would highly recommend this airport and would give it stars all the way considering the issues it faces were not its fault its just got a worse reputation than it actually deserves Airport Hotel nearby means its efficient and there are plenty of car parking spaces too Brilliant Would highly recommend this airport

Toilets in baggage hall absolutely disgusting Smell of urine would have knocked you down no toilet roll or soap in dispensers and not a cleaner in sight What a welcome for any visitor to northern Ireland This problem needs addressed urgently

In general the airport is tired and shabby and in urgent need of a total upgrade but I was really shocked at the poor standard of cleanliness at this airport The ladies toilets throughout were awful Granted we were flying out at a busy time but arrived back at a quieter time in an evening Many toilets were blocked dirty and smelly No evidence of cleaning staff around which is evident at most other airports What a welcome to visitors from other countries

When is this airport going to be sorted out Consistently the worst airport in Europe Ridiculous waiting times for both passport checks and baggage reclaim every time I use it which unfortunately is way too often what with little other choice During a recent trip we touched down early only for no one to available to taxi us to an arrival gate which took mins then a huge queue from the tarmac to get through passport checks mins then a min wait for bags What an absolute shambles and embarrassment to visitors to our country Gone somebody sort this dump out

First time here Very small airport and no long walks or queues On landing we were in the baggage hall in under three minutes Bags arrived in a couple more minutes and we were out and looking for the car rental desk On return there were no queues and at security we did not have to take anything out of our bags Our flexeconomy ticket gave us access to the Aspire lounge which was very quiet but well stocked with food and beverages Probably the longest walk from lounge to gate in the airport took about four minutes Having picked up our rental car we were only a short ride into the heart of the city Would use this airport again

A small airport with all the benefits of that short distances quick security not too crowded Its also quite quick to get into the city Limited flights compared to Belfast International or Dublin but when I have the option Id choose this over the others The business lounge is also very well maintained and spacious plus good food and drink options

The airport management just cant leave well enough alone They have changed the layout of the roads in the airport to accommodate their parking charge to drop offpick up passengers the new system is quite confusing for anyone not familiar with it and to drop offpick up is just pure greed Car parking was ok for a change the anpr camera actually worked this time and issued me with a ticket then opened up Check in was simple enough but as before there is a distinct lack of seating in departures The vast bulk of seating is swallowed up by overpriced eateries I didnt see any mobile charging ports etc although I believe there are some in the private lounge that will cost you around to enter So in summary BHD management have decided to stick the boot in during the cost of living crisis

Airports service areas woefully understaffed as usual In the Artisan pub there is only one employee taking orders making coffee and pouring drinks The queue has snaked to the gates all morning and Ive waited over minutes for a toasted sandwich The Starbucks queue is even longer There are no spare seats in the terminal and all of this seems to be ok with airport management

Their staff attitude is absolutely horrendous I booked my car in to the long stay car parking while I was away for ten days I get back to realise that my tyre is flat and I didnt know how to change it Ive not been driving that long I go in to the car park desk to ask for help to change my tyre and the man tells me theres nothing he could do and he did not know one single member of staff that knew how to change a tyre About members of staff later walked past and pretended they couldnt see me
Belfast City is now the better of the two Belfast airports It beats International by a country mile No more needs to be said The passengers are less manic than a lot of those using International

As a regular flier who flies at least monthly I have to say this is the worst airport I have ever experienced No facilities to print out your boarding pass at the airport unless you join the minute long queue at check in despite it saying on their website that there is Completely unhelpful staff who ignore you and wont even answer a question unless they are shouting at you to do something Damaged my suitcase which fits perfectly within the guidelines on a sharp bit on their checking equipment and then tried to say my suitcase was oversize which it isnt and has been through the checks at numerous other airports with the same airline Seem only interested in profit and extorting as much money as they can whilst failing dismally at any form of customer service

The experience at this airport is highly unpredictable A oncefriendly environment can turn completely unfriendly particularly at the transfer desk managed by the operator Menzies On two separate occasions due to inability to issue a boarding pass to the final destination at the departure airport I was forced to deal with them The service was disastrous unprofessional arrogant and unfriendly Despite having three people behind the counter only one appeared to be working One staff member redirected passengers to a nonexistent line while visibly stressed by the mere presence of customers as it interrupted her phonechecking Meanwhile the other employee was busy arranging a massage over the phone This level of service is unacceptable

Changes at the airport are for the worse While the old Terminal was a true architectural gem its upgrade in the early s brought the modern Terminal However the ongoing extension which has dragged on for years is nothing more than a dull corridor made from prefabricated materials With this latest expansion the airport has shifted from being one of the most passengerfriendly for regional transfers to one of the least accommodating The attitude of the staff has also deteriorated from being exceptionally relaxed and friendly to becoming cold and in my most recent experience eg at the transfer desk even arrogant and rude This is something we were not accustomed to in Belgrade One area in need of improvement is cleanliness Belgrade is now one of the dirtiest airports stepping into the terminal from a bus transfer feels like stepping into a trash can The state of the toilets only adds to this poor impression
The official airport taxi is highly corrupted Toilets run out of tissue Poor facility Poor service Disorganized Unhelpful and rude staff

This airport is a mess it is under construction on the outside of terminals It is very difficult to understand how this airport works and no one seems to know Very disorganized outside You have to buy a taxi ticket on arrivals to go to the city Inside it is clean but lacks better signaling

June th gate Aa flight to Tivat around LT Encountered absolutely completely inappropriate attitude from security officers on preflight security check One officer threw my laptop aside as if it was a stone On my remark a female officer approached and started treating even worse explicitly rude and challenging Both officers I encountered acted in an incompetent impolite way that was completely not appropriate for working with people I recommend everyone to be very careful while visiting this airport and if you have options available better avoid it altogether

It was necessary to bring my dog with me back to Canada from Belgrade via Frankfort to Toronto She is not used to travelling but I did medicate her as requested by the staff Booking directions from Lufthansa were to check in the dog at No one was available until about Transporting animals is stressful and hard and waiting in the middle of a busy terminal was unacceptable If the dog had been checked in on time and normal procedures followed as advised by the airline covering the cage placing the cage in a quiet area there would have been no concerns Because I was forced to wait for staff to attend I had to run to catch the plane to Frankfurt As a senior citizen this was not a fun experience

Unwelcoming airport with poor customer services It was a full flight from Houston and several of the passengers arrived at the boarding gate with the assistance of airport wheelchairsmobility support On deplaning in Belize we were held in a long queue for well in excess of an hour during which time there was no support for the passengers with mobility issues who were visibly uncomfortable Holiday makers choosing Belize amongst the dizzying array of destinations deserve a little more than the curt services given

After having travelled around the globe Belize Airport is the most inefficient and unfriendly airport Ive encountered so far At arrival long waiting time more than an hour to get through customs with my family with three kids Unclear instruction about forms to fill in Being treated like we did something wrong tone of voice of customs personnel completely out of order After passing the first checkpoint there was a second one checking all the paperwork of their colleague again and raising pointless questions to us The departure procedure was not much better rude personnel at customs desks Yes again more forms to fill out and again two separate booths Really bad vibe entering the country and when leaving So unnecessary

Covid social distance rules totally out the window Departure area very very over crowded Lack of seating poor air ventilation This is a sight for a super spreader event Not a great experience after such a wonderful holiday vacation when a Gold Standard suppliers have worked so hard to offer a Covid safe environment

Friendly little airport but no preferred traveler or TSA Precheck No public transit Taxi to Belize City is US Forget WiFi No airport restaurants There are small duty free shops coffee shop with bakery and a few tourist shops with snacks for sale Duty free stores have many local rums at a cheap price Very uncomfortable hardwood seating The one pretend restaurant is a booth in the passenger waiting area Order overpriced cooked food then the order taker disappears Wait minutes for scrambled eggs When it finally arrives the order is wrong and food is inedible No dining area seating

Thank you for your kind service My elderly parents flew out and the patience and attention to their comfort was impressive and appreciative They contacted me upon their arrival and both were very calm and satisfied They have been worried about flying days coming into it All that went away at the airport in Bellingham They were greeted upon their arrival at their destination with the necessary extra services Thank you so much

The new linha verde green line was a very good improvement in this airport access all the journey now takes about minutes in express way Even with more and more passengers increase month a month its still lacking international cities Miami Lisbon and Panama City are directly connected The baggage claim is a problem only is located in international area and is very small and you must wait a lot of time until you get your baggage

One of Brazils better airports although its design is stark and gloomy though airy Used aforementioned Conexio Aeroporto bus service to get there punctual fast and good quality Food wise all the usual airport restaurants are here but on the third floor to the left is a real find if you want real food and youre on a budget the Restaurante Social looks like a university canteen but serves palatable food at nonairport prices

I concur with the comment below Confins is underused But there is a big plus Conexao Aeroporto buses that take you to the city centre are punctual and efficient Things have changed since and there should be more improvements in the future

The new Highway Linha Verde connecting the Airport to Downtown Belo Horizonte will definitely help with the distance issue The Airport itself is modern and well maintained But I think it has potential thats not being used The lack of international flights is another problem Most flights have connections in Rio or SP making BH hours farther then it really is It could take less than hours from New York but with the connections it takes about hours if we are lucky enough to find a flight from Rio or SP Hopefully with the Industrial Airport more international flights will start to be available well see

Very badly located and designed airport The checkin areas are outside it doesnt rain but it can be very hot the airport is too far away from the city no fast connections as well In terms of services it has banks restaurants newsagents cash machines and a post office There is no internet access for passengers which is ridiculous for the third biggest airport in Brazil I had to send an urgent business email and had to beg the local administration office on the top floor of the terminal to use one of their computers for minutes Thanks to the good nature of most of the Brazilian people this was allowed saving me from a lot of problems but if the management is willing to put mobile phones rechargers in the terminal I could see they were available for everyone for free they could also make the effort to put a couple of internet access points

I traveled to Bengkulu Indonesia to visit friends for the first time in November Flew on Lion Air Upon arriving at the airport we deplane using stairs and walked on the tarmac to the arrival building It was late afternoon with the sun just about to set The airport building is very quaint Nice outdoor gardens greet you and on the day I arrived a nice afternoon breeze Slowly make the way to the inside of the terminal where one luggage belt half inside the terminal and a portion outside the terminal awaits The luggage eventually arrives and it gives you time to see the pictures of some of the sights to see in Bengkulu Once luggage in hand you go outside where there are various options for transport to where ever you are going I was met by friends that took me to the hotel Two weeks later I left Bengkulu and experienced the departure area You go through the usual security immediately upon entering the terminal say your good byes outside the door then walk to the check in desk where you obtain your boarding pass and check your luggage English is not widely spoken at the airport if at all but I had no issues whatsoever You then go to the gate area nice seats air conditioned tvs bathrooms and probably restaurants though I left on the first flight out and I not see anything to buy food or drinks Eventually they called the flight once again no English and we boarded the same way nice walk outside to the waiting aircraft All in all a really nice experience in this airport

Trip Verified Does not even offer to buy a hotdog in this place this is the Worst airport in Europe No service basically no restaurant if you not feel for fish Long walk to Get to the gate Etc only come here because i have to do sometimes They always blame it on that they are upgrading the place A construction site all the time

Poor wheelchair assistance on departure and arrival Departure was worse as I really needed a wheelchair to get me to the gate Was told to wait at a particular spot and if no one showed by PM that I should probably try to make it on my own Well PM came and I hobbled as best as I could to the gate I have traveled extensively and used wheelchair services for more than years in multiple airports both domestic and international I have never received such poor service Never traveling to this airport again

This airport was very disappointing and frustrating to say the least Our original flight was canceled and rebooked for the next day at am We had problems checking in and locating the gate since it was not located on the departure board We couldnt find one person working after leaving security It was like the airport was deserted Security told us the gate would be in E somewhere We heard by passenger word of mouth which gate it would be I will not be using this airport again

So few options for food when you have entered the departure area But the most annoying thing was a guy asking your opinion of the airport asking while eating not awaiting your answer while your mouth was full of food and all you had to enter was your personal information birth address activity at destination etc and not even one possibility to rate the facilities or anything of Bergen Airport They were just shamelessly collecting private information

New airport building opened in August Large and airy construction gives a positive feeling to airport experience International Arrivals involve a bit of walking to the Baggage Reclaim and International Arrivals which happen on the ground floor Car Rental Caf and Bureau de Change all within the terminal building Bus Taxi and Tram are out by the front door Undercover walkways connect to short stay car parks Departures are on the st floor with the usual automated checkin Security pretty quick with more capacity when things get busy The Departure Lounge overlooks the end of the runway and has air bridges to most departure gates some bus departures for small aircraft parked remotely Good selection of shops and cafes A big improvement on the old terminal building

A relatively small but busy airport serving a key city on the coast of Norway Most flights are domestic within Norway Domestic Arrivals mix with departures and there are baggage belts on the ground floor behind the checkin desks no specific separation between general public and flying public On the ground floor there are convenience shops selling snacks drinks etc and a small cafbar The Checkin is predominantly selfservice with very few staff evident Upstairs to Security and Departures The main domestic departures has a few food outlets a book shop and a convenience shop there is a further section for International Travellers with full Duty Free options Most planes land at a gate with pier so little need to be outside No announcements or Last Calls are made so you need to look at one of the many monitors to check your flight status A small but efficient airport which probably gets very busy on Cruise Ship days Free WiFi

I flew fom Bergerac airport to Stansted today When i had cleared baggage body and passport check I went to the lounge to realise to my horror that I hadnt got my belt from the body check I spent minutes contemplating how I was shortly destined to be walking round London with my trousers falling down because I didnt have my belt on As we were summoned to the gate I was overjoyed to hear an announcement from Bergerac Airport or Ryanair saying that my belt had been found I am so happy I feel moved to thank and complement whichever staff or system meant that I was reunited with my belt Well done

My two sons arrived on a flight in the pouring rain the flight had arrived ten minutes after the Ryanair Stansted flight had touched down So two full flights and two passport control officials trying to deal with two full flights of possibly around people I waited minutes from the time my boys flight landed to the time they got through passport control Absolutely ridiculous They stood in the pouring rain because there was no room under the hangar of an arrivals hall My sons could have flown to Bordeaux which is minutes from our home and we would have been home quicker travelling mins than me sitting in the carport for minutes waiting for them to come through Bergerac airport had better wake up and smell the coffee and realise you can not treat passengers like this They are not cattle and security checks are carried out heavily in the UK so why on earth they have to interrogate every passenger that arrives One family of four took ten minutes to answer questions Bergerac can not possibly compete with the other international airports in France unless it changes its attitude and builds a better hall for arriving passengers Their car park is being heavily invested in only to make money from people needing to park their cars there Start to invest in a better arrivals hall more staff and a better carousel for the suitcases otherwise they are going to lose passengers who would prefer to travel to Bordeaux or even Toulouse Please get your act together Bergerac

Its a small airport with the most basic of facilities but there were no delays in either direction I hope that means they have sorted out immigraton though it may be that my BA flight from London City arrived at a quiet time My only gripe is about one woman on security who was quite unfriendly when she told me I had to return to checkin because she didnt like the look of a vase I had in my carryon bag Otherwise the staff seemed quite friendly

Once again Bergerac have failed to provide any passenger comfort with long delays at arrivals because of increased security measures Whilst we all understand the need for this why is it impossible for the airport to lay on extra staff I was approximately half way along the queue and waited hr and minutes to get to the control booth on th April Meanwhile one lady had to face the embarrassment of asking to jump the queue as she urgently needed the toilet I have written to this airport before pointing out the need for a toilet at arrivals airside especially when there are delays I have never received a reply which is both rude and suggests a complete lack of respect for customer welfare I found this review page by trying to find any kind of information for a flight I will be meeting this coming Sunday So far I can find no information on how long the arrivals delay is likely to be

I went to meet someone off the flight from Brussels and he took minutes to get through passport control This happens all the time since security has been on high alert can understand that However the airport should put more people on the passport control in order to get passengers through quicker I shall be flying to London next Jan and again in March and I know it will be a long wait to get through ridiculous

Besides an airport that is not userfriendly designed too many stairs unfriendly environment the security check is an absolute nightmare And it is getting worse day by day Yesterday it took me minutes to go through checkin because on Sunday evening they had only three checkin counters open I went to T and cut various corners otherwise it would not have been possible to reach my flight in time The only good thing about T is that you do not have to take everything out because at T I have experienced several times over the last weeks that they check everything in your carryon luggage They take Christmas cookies away they take presents away they are slow unfriendly and it makes me feel so ashamed to be a German because of this Its a disgrace for the German capitol All international travellers and Germans as well are embarrassed of the way they are working there If you can try not to use this airport

Absolutely one of the worst international airport I have experienced and I have been to many airports all over the world On arrival passport control took another hour with just then out of counters occupied and only EU citizens allowed to use the very poorly marked eGates yet we allow Germans to use the eGates in New Zealand and Australia Our luggage took two hours to appear with no reasons given for the delay other than a repeating message that due to operational issues it was delayed no sht sherlock Departing from that airport was even worse After fighting Berlin traffic to get out of the city check in passport and XRay officials were particularly unhelpful Access to the gates was super confusing with one area closed off with no clear signage where to go The layout on airside is a debacle Restaurants and shops are miles to walk to with no conveyor belts The ceiling is so low and dark it feels really oppressive Terrible airport If they had kept Berlin Tegel open as a city airport they would have seen that people and airlines would have refused to use the new one but as it is Berlin travellers are stuck with that Albert Speeresque monstrosity miles outside the city

After over years of air travel and twenty transatlantic return flights I experienced the worst check in and airport experience at Berlin Brandenburg in September My wife and I completed the online check in but that proved to be of little help as it provided us with no means of obtaining the necessary Baggage tags for us to use the bag drop procedure With minimal staff available and a long line of people requiring help in fully checking in we lined up for over an hour before we were able to check our bags We then lined up for minutes Im order to go through security The treatment we received going through security was appalling My wife and I are not fluent German speakers and when we did not immediately fully understand the instructions they were simply repeated louder and in a very exasperated tone We were then thoroughly frisked iand required to take up pistures difficult for those in their seventies It felt as though we were being punished and the hostility was palpable Throughout Berlin Brandenburg the lack of Lufthansa staff to respond to inquiries was a problem and we were unable to get necessary information about our connecting Lufthansa flight The signage in the airport is very poor especially for those arriving at the Flughafen Berlin railway station and there were no staff around to help people Im future we will avoid Berlin Brandenburg and use a different airline than Lufthansa

Its been the third time that we had to depart from this airport and its not getting any better The way this airport was designed is inefficient causing long lines at security Its a nightmare to watch how slow the entire process works Security staff on all three occasions have been rude despite us speaking German making sure to lecture us in one way or another It took an hour and a half to go through it and if our flight hadnt been delayed we would certainly have missed it We travel a lot on business and Berlin must be the worst airport we have ever experienced As we have to return to Berlin at some time we are flying into Hamburg in the future to avoid Berlin Brandenburg It was a disaster even before the delayed opening and if they dont change the staffs attitude nor security layout and operation it should be shut down again

Disorganised airport Security controls too long Food Hall small and with few offer Burger King closes at pm Cannot understand why they close so early Mountains of garbage at their restaurant tables very dirty At the Tegel Lounge the receptionist does not speak english Really poor airport If you fly from T the taxy driver needs to drop you off at T and then you have to walk around m not covered Is the famous German organisation and precision

Berlin Brandenburg BER is not probably is definitely the worst airport I have ever been in more than years of flying all over the world It is an embarrassment to Germany with its stereotypical image of order organization and respect As many times the case things are not always as they are marketedsold but here the gap is truly wide In my ranking of over airports Ive been at BER excels as the international airport with the most miserablerude staff I have ever had to deal with a definite Probably never flying from here again

Insane long check in times and staff working slowly like they dont give a damn I have now for the rd time experienced the longest check in times in Europe Up to hour The staff works sadistically slowly and is being overly pedantic over just about everything Also way too little toilets and some gates dont even have dedicated sitting spaces Considering that BBA is Germanys capital airport and the time and cost to build it over the past years its just an utter and total embarrassment for entire Germany

Disgusting people scammers and dishonest service I left my phone at the security check and came back like min after to have it back The people refused to make it ring or to ask their colleagues if they saw it I had to leave without it It came out that if it goes to Lost and Found you have to pay to have your stuff back This is why they refused to help because they can easily scam you

I have never seen such a sad airport Flying from this airport made me feel like flying back to the normal world while coming from a rd world country Holes in the road to the airport no nice place to eat something and a very very poor departure terminal Actually the only good thing there was was the wifi connection which was surprisingly good Other than that nothing nice to say about this airport A real shame for Berlin and for Germany

Was disappointed by the lack of space and the blandness of the terminal arriving and departing from this airport located in a capital city Ive been in and out of nonprimary regional domestic airports which are far more impressive I wouldve opted for Berlin Tegel if available This airport is not as convenient as it is further away from the city centre No seating in the precheckin greeting area No shelter going to and coming from the car park Very noticeable when the weather is bad as it was when I was there There was a convenience style shop which was quite well stocked but nothing exceptional by way of gifts In the postcheckin area the hallways are very narrow and tiny and hard seats are either to be found in a long row along the corridor or in tiny boxes around the departure gate Airport lounge was not worth the bother Shopkeepers only spoke German even after speaking English to them first Passport clearance consisted of only one booth for the or so passengers boarding and again a very narrow passage Baggage collection was quite quick but this is probably because of how tiny the terminal was The distance from the plane to passport control then baggage collection is so short and badly signposted that you could easily overlook that you are actually in the correct baggage claim area The airport app was not very appealing and the wifi signal weak

I was flying outside of the EU and having the nonEU passport I waited more than an hour in a narrow corridor to go over the passport checks There were only officers for planes departing almost simultaneously What a shame for the German capital

Im autistic and was nonverbal unable to speak when I went through security but the staff were incredibly kind and helpful It was very much appreciated as its obviously very difficult to navigate the world when one cannot speak and the staff were completely understanding Be proud

I believe Tegel is one of the worst airports I have visited in Europe Its organisation is uselessly complicated how many security check areas do they have one for each to gates How can that be financially viable The wait times and queuing are ridiculous The staff are unfriendly and unhelpful The amenities outside and inside the airport are truly lacking No smoking areas inside Smokers with a long wait need to exit the airport

The airport is in no way adequate to that of a capital city airport it is incredibly dirty the organization is an absolute disaster after the landing the transport buses are ready on the plane but it took minutes to get at least escalator to the plane The toilets are partly out of order and extremely dirty you can see at every corner that the cleaning costs are extremely saved All in all it is infinitely embarrassing to present a cosmopolitan city like Berlin those responsible should be ashamed Der Flughafen ist dem eines Hauptstadtflughafens in keiner Weise angemessen es unfassbar dreckig die Organisation ist eine absolute Katastrophe nach der Landung stehen die Transportbusse zwar am Flugzeug bereit aber es dauerte geschlagene Minuten bis man es geschafft hat wenigstens Rolltreppe zum Flugzeug zu bringen Die Toiletten sind zum Teil ausser Betrieb und extrem verschmutzt man merkt an jeder Ecke das extrem bei den Reinigungskosten gespart wird Alles in Allem ist es unendlich Peinlich eine Weltstadt wie Berlin so zu prsentieren die Verantwortlichen sollten sich schmen

Awful experience I am a very frequent business traveller and have seen a lot of airports in the world But this one exceeded my worst nightmares We were in the line for the security check to Amsterdam combined with Paris We had over hour to go through security for Amsterdam Paris flight had min but it took ages Only one gate was open another one was idle no personnel The guy performing the screening was taking all the time in the world as if we were not in a hurry Personnel were very unfriendly yelling at us Paris passengers were really getting worried they could not make their flight The screening guy did not notice this In the end someone called all the Paris passengers to the front which upset the screening guy very much He really flipped and sent back the passengers to the end of the line When we started complaining about this ridiculous situation the guy even stopped the scanner and called the airport police He deliberately stopped the process to make us miss the flight After minutes the police came and we could explain the situation They checked our passports and convinced the screening guy to start checking again We barely made our flight It was the worst airport nightmare of my life Never again Berlin Tegel It is a disgrace for the Germany capital a country that has the name of being well organised and pnktlich I advise them to check out Schiphol Amsterdam for a much better experience

This airport is a disgrace Poor or nonexistent facilities and tiny duty free insane overpricing for a small bottle of water and it is basically a portacabin I cannot believe that this is how Germany wants to introduce visitors to its capital

Me and my family just arrived today and had the worst experience ever in the Berlin Tegel airport First of all the queue of immigration was terribly long and we waited for an hour and a half just to go through immigration Once we got through the immigration me and my brother got our baggage but my mums baggage went missing so we waited till there was no baggage on the belt anymore I called the missing or damaged baggage but no one picked up Then I saw staff with a bright green vest so I went to her for help But the answer she gave me was missing baggage is not my area dont ask me is not my business then she walked away quickly I was standing there feeling helpless then I saw the sign of baggage service so me and my family went there for help The staff there asked me to fill in a form and wait till they have any news We are really worried so I ask her when exactly can we get back our baggage she replied she didnt know We felt the answer she gave was really unhelpful so we went to the customer service counter I told the guy at the desk that my mum has health issues and all of her medicine is in the baggage then he replied thats not his problem because my mum shouldnt have put the medicine in that bag in the first place He was really rude and judgemental since the reason my mum didnt take the medicine out of the bag is that the cabin bag was supposed to be taken onboard by herself but the easyJet staff told her that the plane has not got enough space so they had to check in her cabin bag My mum has all of her heart medicine sleeping pills and antidepressant in her baggage Now my mum might have to fly back to the UK since she has been in serious health condition for over years

Templehof is a dream The architecture is beautiful and the departure hall is stunning Some of the original features can be found a true jewel It oozes nostalgia and would be a tragedy to lose such a wonderful piece of history The most civilised journey Ive embarked on to date was Templehof to Brussels

Very convenient for the city centre Unfortunately there are a limited number of routes but Brussels Airlines offers a good service several times per day The advantage is that the airport is uncrowded at times almost deserted I regret that it is now living on borrowed time There is a Berlin Underground UBahn station nearby but there are quite a few steps so it is difficult for passengers travelling with luggage let alone disabled travellers

I travelled from Berlin Tempelhof on I arrived at the airport at for a flight I have never experienced a more chaotic airport When I finally cleared the initial security screening and checked in for my flight I commenced queuing once more the queue which was very slow became absolutely chaotic when people entered the queue from the sides and no airport staff or security staff intervened The entire experience showed a level of inability in the security or airport staff to ensure orderly queuing and safety of passengers I will be very reluctant to use this airport again

Tempelhof is Berlins pre WWII airport and is one of the older operational airports in Europe Its an arrchitectural treasure Its also a friendly nice and peaceful airport Unfortunately they are going to shut it down in the next few years because of lack of travel demand and because it is in the located in the middle of a densely populated residential area

One for the historians of airport architecture a real timewarp from the s and earlier This was the original preWW Berlin airport The paucity of flights serving Tempelhof make for a very stressfree environment Emerging from the terminal one finds oneself in an ordinary residential street the facade of the terminal blending in with the neighbouring apartment blocks The UBahn station is just m away and one is in the heart of Berlin cheaply and in doublequick time But look again at that facade towards the top theres a gap Wasnt that where the old regimes notorious symbol used to stand

Easy to get there free parking just in front of it super fast check in and so on It took me minutes from the moment I parked my car to the lounge Highly recommended The only problem is nearly no flights leaving here

International Airport What a joke Although new this airport is lacking in accommodations and facilities for travelers For example theres only place to get anything to eat or drink in the entire airport Stand in a Long line to order burgers n fries chips and two drinks for For that you can enjoy a course meal at star Ascots for two Or you can feast on a huge Sunday Brunch at Fourways for for two Ive included photos of the restaurant poster and then of the Real restaurant Only items actually offered none from their poster There is one shop which closes at pm There are very few travel supplies typical of any other airport They claim that the shop is duty free but liquor prices are higher than in town Do not expect any common airport facilities other than this If more than plane arrives or departs at the same time expect a backup at every stage of your experience Honestly Ive had better accommodation and service at regional airports handling local traffic and single engine planes Bermuda is an extremely friendly welcoming and inviting country with Much to offer any traveler What a shame that the Airport authority leaves a holiday traveler with such a ugly parting view Clean up your act folks Its embarrassing

Like Bermuda itself this airport is a thoroughly civilized experience not very busy so not crowded with a rather predictable traffic pattern of arrivals and departures Facilities are very adequate and the dutyfree shop has a reasonable variety albeit a bit expensive On entry customs officials are polite and welcoming When checking in for our departing flight the official who had to pat me down for a followup security check the machine beeped when I went through apologized for having to do so and thanked me for accommodating the security process All in all a refreshingly unique experience one that is alas vanishing amid the alltoocommon post overzealous and ironically ineffective security measures elsewhere Bravo to Bermuda and its airport

BerneBelp is a small but excellent regional airport It is currently connected to Orly with Air France and Munich with Lufthansa There is a bus shuttle upon each regular flight arrival even delayed flights travel time to Berne railway station is around min A major problem is the heavy fog in winter I have already been diverted to Basle airport twice

Like many other domestic airports in Nepal Bharatpur airport offers very basic facilities only Check in counters dedicated to the serving airlines security check little parking area few basic seating chairs in a small area toilets not so clean though no AC For arrival a small baggage collection counter outside The airport currently operates flights to Kathmandu and Pokhara Sauraha a tourist spot is nearby this airport

We were travelling from Bhubaneshwar to Hyderabad recently The airport was clean and nice but was shocked a little later at the security at this airport While we were flying a person behind my row was complained about dripping water The stewardess was puzzled and checked the luggage rack There was this bag belonging to a passenger that contained a bottle of water that leaked drenching all the bags in that part before trickling down on the heads of people below Note that this is a colored rectangular serrated bottle and not one of those branded mineral water bottles sold inside the secure zone Also note that the passenger was ablebodied It is clear that the security checks simply waved the bottle past Having travelled from Newark to Hyderabad via Mumbai and suffering innumerable checks and having spent a small fortune on buying water inside the secure zone I was shocked at this incident I suggest that the rules be strictly implemented and a refresher course be held for the personnel

I was pleasantly surprised by Biarritz a small airport where everything seemed to work fine I was particularly impressed by the fact that the immigration officers on arrival and departure were smiling and courteous I wasnt expecting to see the negative reviews below but they are not too recent so maybe things have improved

Ugly airport with hardly any restaurants and the few present close at pm To describe the person screening arrivals as unfriendly would be a mild understatement being extremely unpleasant wont get you a bonus In short if you can avoid flying to Biarritz avoid it at all costs next time Ill take my bike

This has got to be the worst airport in terms of BorderCustoms that I have ever seen There were two immigration officers that took over one hour to process one Ryanair flight They were deliberately slow unfriendly and rude officer chatting on the phone Just unbelievably poor

Chronic organisation when two planes arrived it took almost an hour to get through passport control On return the famous Gallic shrug came to the fore with noone seemingly interested or caring about chaos and delays Police attitude was unbelievable with their insistence of accompanying people visiting the toilets The joy of flying into German and British airports

I was travelling with my wife back to London from Bilbao airport We are both doctors working in England and of Indian heritage I was selected for random complete check I have no problem with that except that I feel I was racially profiled We both stood near the counter to see who else was picked up for random check Only other person was another black male I accept that you have to check people randomly but I didnt feel it was random at all Do you have any figures to justify it What was suspicious about me except that I brown

Because of the items in the news about delays and queues we were quite worried about going to Bilbao airport We did have to wait a few minutes at passport control but not too long The airport is a new building very light and modern we didnt have to use any steps at all which was brilliant On our return journey we purchased food and drinks in the cafe they were nicely prepared and the area was very clean and tidy All in all a very good experience and the area can be proud of the facilities

Bilbao is not the most comfortable airport getting to the plane is quite fast minutes maximum and leaving the airport after landing is fast too minutes You can get to Bilbao by bus theres a bus each minutes

What a contrast to arrive from the chaos of Stansted Plane lands bags come off quickly passport line mins maximum Taxis right outside airport arrivals or bus stop turn right and go to the end of the concourse My record for checking in at the hotel is mins from the wheels touching the runway Coming back on Easy Jet last flight out of the night so its a bit quiet but again you get through quickly Grab a beer Dont even bother queuing until you see the incoming plane land and reach the gate Very relaxed place to fly in and out of

Flew to and from Bilbao Arrival was quick plane unloaded by Gateway The building looks nice and is clean The bad surprise was that we had to wait more than minutes to see the first bag on the belt at a time we were the only plane arriving I find this unacceptable in big airports and even more in a small one Departure went well coffees breakfast facilities everything on time A pity we got stuck in a bus minutes while the plane was at minutes walk

Simple airport but security check is a joke compared to the other airports I used A usb cable is considered electronics and is rechecked separately tooth paste is repacked into a plastic bag I go through this airport times per year and it is the only one my bags dont go through first pass Not a single time Out of these or rechecks of my bags they never found anything wrong Like I said it is a joke

Firstly there were no family queues so I had to wait in line for min with two crying month old toddlers We were not allowed to take the twin stroller upstairs they said it was to big for the security check which was wrong would have gone through easily Most twin strollers are designed to fit standard doors and a wheelchair bigger then our stroller rolled through easily But the danish computer says no mentality was not budged Anyway we had to hold crying twins and the hand luggage a lot of luggage comes with two toddlers while the stroller was folded and marked After that the guy said then you take it to the odd size luggage desk Yup holding a folded twin stroller while holding a crying toddler is super easy Going through security no priority for baby families we had no place to put the toddlers while taking out electronics liquid baby food etc out of the bags so they were running around crying Finally after coming through security there were some strollers available at the airport very nice strollers as put by the guy that checked us in There were strollers there were broken so we took the two dirty ones that were left Never ever flying through there with toddlers again

Travelled from HKG to FRA then to Billund for a business trip A tiny airport with insufficient facilities A serious lack of staff while they were not helpful at all already Self checkin machines available but not enough assistance at all Medium length queues but moving very slowly

This is a fantastic airport Short walking distances nice staff good easytonavigate easytouse layout a stressfree atmosphere nice cafs I used Billund as a transit passenger on my way from Copenhagen to Berlin and my only minor remark is that the TRANSIT signs just pointed to a locked door I had to walk back exit and go through security again Never mind there was no queue and I doubt the locked door is standard procedure since the security folks got a little bit puzzled when they saw my Copenhagenissued boarding pass Dont hesitate to use this airport

An airport serving domestic routes in Nepal capital Kathmandu to the capital of Koshi Pradesh and two other places in the eastern hilly regions Very basic in services and facilities IATA code BIR For arrival a belt is there to collect luggage that is manually handled Aircrafts that this airport gets is ATR Beech Twin otter and the likes For departure a small hall is there which houses check in counters dedicated to domestic operators few seating benches toilets security check points and one cafe Not clean looks dirty Parking is available outside Taxis are available for conveyance

Honest to goodness its an embarrassment when you come from a developing country in Africa thats got their act together then you come back and you suffer the degrading humiliation of Birmingham Right from the drop off being over a mile from the checkin The departure lounge toilets not having seats or broken and the standard of hygiene I simply cannot understand how environmental health allow them to operate at all The duty free was three times the price of buying retail at the destination My one takeaway of the airport is to never use it again

It took hour and minutes from joining the prequeue for bag drop to getting through security on a Monday afternoon at the end of September What is a prequeue When they hold you for minutes before getting to the bag drop queue Then a minute prequeue for the lift to take you to the queue for security They took out the staircase last year and made everyone use overloaded lifts Our lift said Out of Service before it wheezed up to Departures three minutes to climb one floor When a Ryanair plane is a haven of peace and civility you know you have just emerged from a circle of hell Is Michael OLeary paying them to ruin the airport so that his planes seem better The airport works so hard to ensure it is the worst airport in the UK Couldnt they spend of the effort on making something anything at the airport actually work I cant review airport shops as my minute queue meant I had to run to the gate Could I have arrived earlier Wouldnt have helped as you cant check in a bag more than minutes before departure

Avoid avoid avoid at all cost unless you like queueing Its a shambles of an airport You queue at every point in the departures Ive never seen anything like it They took escalators out and put lifts in and thats where the queueing starts

Avoid this airport at all cost I have traveled quite a bit in my life but Birmingham Airport was an experience I never voluntarily hope to relive I now better understand why my year old mom preferred NOT seeing her son than having to go through this ordeal This was twenty years ago Nothing much has changed Chaotic going from one long snake line into the next being herded into an elevator only to be driven into the next line I truly felt like cattle I wonder how those taxfree shops make any money because you sure have no time or energy left to shop or get a bite to eat And when you finally arrive at the gate and actually glad that the plane was delayed otherwise it would have been a close call you have to sit on the floor to rest your feet from being on your feet for hours on end My advise pick another airport and take the train to Birmingham OR go via Dover and drive up to Birmingham Driving on the left of the road is less stressful

Staff should be retrained on customer service Especially American They are very rude and disrespectful Flight crew got off the plane and went to another gate min after we were suppose to board When we asked whats going on we received nothing but attitude from the gate agent Another gate agent walked up and totally ignored our concerns Were at B for flight to CLT Shortly after the gate agent says there is a maintenance issue and they wont be in for another hours We all had the same question Why wasnt the plane inspected the night before being its an early morning flight Secondly why isnt maintenance onsite during hours of operation This is very unprofessional If there were other options outside of this place that were closer Id explore it because no one deserves to be treated this way especially early in the morning Id rather drive hours to Atlanta than to deal with these Attitudes after we pay our money for a service My recommendation Dont fly out of BHM especially with American

Security lines are insane This is my rd experience with it and Im starting to piece together the scam Dont we pay a surcharge on every ticket purchased for the delightful experience of trusting TSA to keep us safe by making us remove our shoes and other useless acts They keep the security lines long creating stress and panic so you consider signing up for Clear year and more privacy invasion with a retina scan and fingerprint capture So the elite those willing to fork over the dollars on top of their federal and any other taxes that fund airports and plane ticket fees cruise on through security while the other of passengers languish in line and miss their flights How on earth the warlord of the Birmingham airport allows of TSA staff to service the elites on the TSA PrecheckClear side vs the TSA employees on the side of the regular people only makes sense in a corrupt government deal I thought that this would be aggravating for the airlines on the other side of the curtain wondering where the passengers were who paid a pretty penny to fly like cattle while being prodded to pull their masks over their nose the whole time But a little research revealed that the airlines invest in companies like Clear Silly me Its a circular racquet probably formulated along the lines of the Chicago red light camera and parking meter debacle Bottom line pay your toll at the troll bridge or suffer along with the peasants

Recent Improvements have made this small airport quite reasonable There are a few dining and shopping options and the area is fairly large and pleasant They still play terrible elevator music Free internet is a bonus The airport is conveniently located to the city but there is no public transportation available Parking is day bit it is often difficult to find a spot

The airport has been and still under going renovations The issues with no food past security have been fixed The wait times are typically very short Security can become long on Monday mornings but typically it is very quick as well Walking distances to and from gates as well as to and from parkingcar rental are rather short There are no miles walks to gates or otherwise The biggest issue with the airport is the quality of staff at food outlets but that is not much different at a lot of airports Overall it is a very good midsize airport

Small airport which seemed a bit chaotic Flew with Turkish airlines their first flight was delayed so check in for mine was busy due to counters checking in two full flights Immigration was quick didnt ask to many questions Security metal detector doesnt work they just pat down everybody coming through After security not much food places on one end can get busy in the departure area Boarding was a mess no queuing system for two flights with desks close together so people kept getting into the wrong queue Fine airport for a short time

Simple clean and functional airport Check in and security ws doe with ease The food vendors are on the expensive side and do not accept credit cards Seeing as most passengers rid themselves of local currency prior to leaving this presents as a problem

It is a small airport with standard facilities Need more Jetways as most of the time the aircraft is forced to park far away from airport building However the officers attitudes in the CIQ area are amazingly modest compared to the ones from the other neighbouring Central Asian airports such as Almaty and Astana

Overall the airport does the job and is an adequate small international hub but travellers beware of a dangerous scam by unregistered taxi drivers here My driver was touting for custom with the rest of them as I came out of customs and immigration but turned out to be working with a fellow passenger who stopped the car between the airport and the city and extorted money from me to complete the journey Two young men to one older man no contest here Foolishly I only spotted the warning signs that the two of them were trouble too late and am grateful that it was only my pocket that was dented Only ever take a registered taxi with the yellow taxi sign on top or better still have someone meet you It sounds obvious but as most flights arrive here in the middle of the night it is possible to be caught out as I was

This airport is a blast from the past Its very basic very small and with very few services After passport control all they have is a small cafe and a little souvenir shop Xray and metal detector was not working so they just did a basic manual search for everything There is a small lounge upstairs before passport control but not working and terminal is full of insects Its like a s bus station and they only have or flights a day GuineaBissau is very poor and this airport reflects that

Myself and husband have used Blackpool airport times in the last months yes you pay each departure tax but you can see nothing has been spent on the upkeep I will still say we prefer going from Blackpool there is less trouble and a lot less fuss From landing and picking up our cases we can be home in an hour we are very sad at its closing We have just arrived home last night we went from Blackpool put had to come back in to Manchester which we think is a nightmare very sad customers

This place is the pits Ever since they took over which is several years ago the owners impose an Airport Development Tax ADT of per person Yes if you are going to be back in less than weeks it entitles you to free parking how can a tax of per head be free on a quagmire at best with absolutely no security The tax was allegedly to develop the airport hence the name but every cent of it goes into the pockets of the Directors Not a single penny has been spent on improvements The owners will argue that the place has been improved and it has However the franchises that use the place duty free cafe newsagents etc all paid for the improvements so dont believe the owners The place is also filthy and cold and when it rains they have to use buckets to collect rainwater As for the security and checkin staff the checkin staff turn up when they feel like it and the security staff are rude and surly and totally objectionable Completely different to the pleasant and helpful staff at Manchester

Dreadful do not let your student sons and daughters fly home from Blackpool My son had to scrape the ADF fee from his pockets He is a student with virtually no money and had no warning that he was going to need an extra Very unfair and simply disgusting I intend to complain to Jet about the airport they are using

We travelled to Turkey on Jet midAugust returning earlySeptember We travelled from Blackpool as the holiday was some cheaper than using Manchester The car park ticket machine had run out of tickets but that didnt matter as the barriers to P had been broken off We parked a good minutes walk from the terminal but its free so I dont really see that being a problem The terminal building is very basic and is more reminiscent of a coach station but checkin and security were both quick and easy as was paying the ADF and we were sitting in the bar area enjoying our first drink of the holiday while wed still have been in the security queue at Manchester An important point was that because we were going on a small plane to a small airport checkin at Dalaman on our return was incredibly easy drawing jealous stares from fellow travellers who were in long queues On our return to Blackpool from wheels stop through security and baggage reclaim to leaving the airport took less than minutes You absolutely cannot get better The airport has a runway planes somewhere to sit and somewhere to get a drink What else do you need

Whilst the amenities are those of a small airport they are still extremely limited My main concerns regarding this airport are the poor services offered by the lounge and payment charged is way in excess of services on offer There are limited drinks no WIFI limited snacks and maximum stay without flight delays is approximately one hour Also when flight arrivals are able to collect their luggage and able to visit the conveniences there is only one female toilet one male toilet and one disabled toilet all with insufficient toilet rolls Totally unsatisfactory when approximately people are landing

The poor lighting inside makes it look as if you have just walked into a fairground dark ride The gents toilet singular youll notice always smells of something unpleasant The advertising blurb tells of facilities that are never open and it has a help desk that is manned only when the staff feel like it which is as good as never It looks like an uncompleted job on which the builders have walked off because the service pipes are all exposed and there is not so much as a false ceiling to hide it all It has been like this for decades To then ask the public to pay each to refurbish something that should be done out of the operating profits over many years is a disgrace Forget expecting to see a terminal akin to those airy ones with glass and steel as at proper airports this is a chickenshed inspired windowless dark oblong box You are unable to see any aircraft from inside or outside so plane spotters stay away

Arriving at Blantyres Chileka airport is a colonial experience Arriving from Johannesburg the airplane is taxied in front of the arrival hall School classes have already been run out to see the big bird landing The building has a wooden veranda and there is a special area were people are expected to cheer after the president has landed The first time I arrived at Chileka the luggage was simply dropped on the tarmac The passengers had to fight to get their possessions Of course quite some passengers did not find any luggage at all as it had stayed behind in Joburg Immigration is quite impressive with a lot of stamps in passports and on listings To get out you have to go through a door then you turn sharply turn left and right Again left until you bump into the departing passengers and their luggage Since half a year we have a new arrival hall at our airport

I flew from Blantyre airport a number of years ago and was struck by just how quaint the whole set up was It is a very basic airport not far off the common tin shack analogy that comes with most African airports There is very little to do and there is just a bar to distract you The best thing about Blantyre airport is the Duty Free shop A selection so limited it is almost refreshing Malawi Gin Whisky JW Cane spirit macadamia nuts coffee and nick nacks I bought to W light bulbs that had been turned into paraffin lamps Wonderful

Bloemfontein airport is currently undergoing improvements to its buildings and facilities This is with a view to the FIFA Soccer World Cup to be held in South Africa I love this little airport because there is an air of excitement and a bustle of activity While the upstairs cafeteria is undergoing improvements there is a downstairs cafeteria where refreshments may be purchased The airport personnel are some of the friendliest i have ever met Their are ample parking and car rental facilities available

Very pleasant and easy airport Rental car lot a few steps from the exit door Spacious airport has gates but only about half are in use Only complaint is restaurant is before security and closes their grill well before the last flights depart in the evening

I personally really like this airport Its small but does everything it needs to It looks more like a sand castle than an airport but every time Ive used it its been easy to check in Unfortunately there is no smoking area anywhere in the airport and considering a fair portion is non smoking I find that a bit strange Also once I was delayed and as there are no tannoy announcements you are left wondering about that status of your flight which if youve travelled TACV can be understood However if youre a resident of Cape Verde you do get used to the no stress mentality even if it can be frustrating sometimes Theres a bar either side of check incustoms and they serve snacks Theres also a small duty free shop but most airlines stock would be more comprehensive

BDTPAC The airport is located on the Colon island you can actually walk into town but still taxis will charge you only usd thats nothing really Theres only one building very small one xray and two counters one for each airline there are no carousels youll have to wait them to offload your bags so you can pick them up on arrivals hall on departure the airline staff will open your bags to search for dangerous goods etc The airport was under refurbishment but I believe it will soon need a better upgrade

We departed from Bodrum Airport decided to try get some food Theres hardly any eating outlets what there is are extortionate we looked at chicken burgers but at we decided against it bottled water was also expensive Surely lowering prices would encourage people to buy

What a shame this place leaves you with such a negative feeling of Turkey No place for filling up water ridiculous prices by any airport standards for any liquid or food staff generally acting as if they dont want to be there and finally a random intrusive search of body and hand luggage in the waiting lounge by people who should be working for correctional services Also free wifi requires espionage search to find the kiosk you need to get a required pin to connect

Worst experience ever I felt totally unsafe in a sort of hostile territory Firstly resent having to scan my passport in a random machine to access WIFI The vending machines are in Turkish only Something went wrong after scanning my card I asked several officials All i needed was help with translation not my job ring number etc It seems they were sort of enjoying it as the people I had asked were all around me on their phones though at work while i was obviously distressed Uncomfortable too

Very unfriendly staff almost aggressive Very slow check in euro for cheeseburger and euro for a coca cola euro for a coffee Never experienced this before and we travel a lot I will never go there again Better go with Izmir airport

This place is an absolute joke The new amenities are useless there are lots of staff doing nothing and the Covid checks and extra security checks means everything takes times as long with long queues The only water you can get is from a vending machine or the only food booth charging extortionate prices This place is the worst Ive ever experienced including Moscow The new management should be held accountable and sacked

Perfectly adequate facilities spoilt by sullen even aggressive staff The place is expensive and food availability and options poor as you would expect In contrast Izmir airport two hours to the North is altogether different so if travelling to a destination anywhere north of Bodrum give that consideration They also have more extensive flight options

Everything was delayed staff were all over the place and not communicating with one another Im and had to be pushed in a wheelchair Im not a small person I know that but for the staff to sit there and say Im fat was very inappropriate I was tempted to ask for her name and manager but like I said I had a broken ankle and I didnt have any fight in me to go back and fourth I just needed to get out of there My friend had to push me around even though we had handicap service and she had to follow behind a worker who disappeared eventually Like I said before very unprofessional Another experience we had was at the ice cream shop The lady was refusing to serve my friend another flavor because we couldnt do that we need to pay more granted money is not an issue but she refused to serve her even after my friend told her to charge her I dont know if everyone was having a bad day or what but everything was made difficult Staff needs to be trained better and have hospitality

Modern airport and hub for flights in South America But we cant find staff that speak English apart from the immigration officers and they are rude as well We were here several times connecting between various flights in South America

Most of the staff doesnt speak English and doesnt understand etickets At first they insisted to send us to the check ins and make hours of queue despite us already having the tickets and only hand luggage Afterwards during the boarding they kept bouncing us from a gate to another because they didn bother checking properly the tickets In both cases we had to search for the only member of the staff who could understand how an airport works and explain it to their colleagues They should be more professional organised and should learn english given its an international airport

All staff pretty rude and didnt speak any English Nobody seemed to want to help in any way Thats fine but I get to security and basically all I have is my wallet and a water bottle They snatch my water bottle and throw it away Very wasteful and rude Would have chugged it right there no problem Extremely annoying and frustrating way to end my time here in Colombia
