Upon arrival at the airport there was a huge line but only a few staff I went through Alaska Airlines It was very confusing where I was supposed to go because there were so many people and so many different lines The lines didnt look like lines at all I checked in at the kiosk got my boarding pass then a lady who was walking around helping people said I needed to get a bag tag printed So I had to go back in line and wait to get the tag printed I had to pay a fee even though I have elite status and have never had to pay a bag fee before I had never gone through the kiosk before Then when I got to the front she said I needed to wait to answer some questions After standing there several minutes and seeing many people get helped who were there after me I was finally helped They just needed emergency contact name and number Then going to the line for the security check there were about people there I got to the airport an hour before my flight and when I got to the gate they were already boarding Seriously they need more organization and more staff to help customers

Pleasant enough airport small yet not crowded enough for it to be oppressive Free internet for your laptop throughout the terminal is good take note Seattle Dulles and OHare Easy enough to find your car hire too and the petrol station outside the airport isnt too much of a rip off Only real complaint is the signs tofrom the airport could be better

In a comment it was said that the airport is great for arrivals but terrible for departures This is absolutely true It was the worst service Ive had and the worst airport Ive ever used for a return flight from abroad On February we were passengers with my husband on flight PGTBB from Bologna to Istanbul Sabiha Gken Airport It took so long for us to checkin our baggage When we saw the queue to pass through to the airside before passport control we couldnt even do a tax refund As we were hoping for this disgrace to end so we could return to our country boarding started from gate and we were lucky enough to sit and wait until the line thinned out When the queue decreased we joined it Two female ticket agents were handling the boarding Despite having no cabin baggage with us we had checked it in the ticket agent told me that my two pockets one about x cm and the other about x cm contained too many items and that I wouldnt be allowed on the plane with them At that moment my husband was also waiting for the other ticket agent to do the boarding Since I had never heard such nonsense before I told her that if I had too many pockets I could transfer some items from one to the other and discard one pocket Clearly this didnt sit well with her as she was going to ask for money Suddenly she told me she wouldnt let me on the plane and instructed me to go to the back of the line I raised my voice and warned her that she had no right or authority to do that and that she was obligated to let me on the plane In response the other female ticket agent rudely turned her back and made threats like Well call the police and we wont let you on the plane An airport that shows such disrespect to tourists should be ashamed In the end they should be thankful that I didnt call the police because I didnt want to take the passengers time They ruined the end of our wonderful vacation because of their attitude which we had never encountered in any airport before

Not enough seating after security No fast track before am for business passengers No lounge after security No respect for priority due to all in the same bus In fact the business travelers stand longest in the bus No priority boarding after unloading passengers from the bus Front door not ready so from the back door all the way to the front

This is the worst airport we have ever flown from Our cruise ended in Ravenna and we had the choice of flying home from either Bologna or Venice We chose Bologna because it was nearer Big mistake Through no fault of our own we arrived at the airport at am for a pm flight to London We couldnt check in until pm so we had to hang around with our luggage for hours The checkin area was heaving and there was limited seating The seats were metal and very uncomfortable There were shops and food outlets so we could eat and drink pm came and we were able to checkin A large queue quickly formed behind us but the lady in charge refused to open the checkin until she had had the floor cleaned to remove a few scuff marks We checkedin eventually cleared the long security queue and found ourselves in Departures If we thought the checkin floor was bad Departures was an absolute nightmare For an international airport the area was very small and horribly overcrowded Seating was even more limited than downstairs and people were sitting on the floor We saw one woman sitting in a corner breastfeeding her baby There were long queues for the toilets There were a couple of food outlets but no seats so it was a choice of stand up or sit on the floor All in all Bologna airport was a very unpleasant experience and we will never fly from there again

Terrible airport like something from the dark ages Old and no signage Lots of staff in the wrong place Its not set up for transit Forget about seating they have for hundreds of people The staff though friendly dont have knowledge of things You just have to wonder around hoping for the best

This might be the worst airport in Europe Ive traveled here twice and The gate area is a zoo People constantly climbing over each other to just find room to stand let alone sit The checkin and security are bad but not as bad as gate area I literally created this account to vent because I simply do not understand It is pure misery and adds stress to an otherwise wonderful trip to see family and friends in the region Airport management and regional authorities should be embarrassed about this Other Italian cities like Firenze have terrible airports too but I really cannot compare to Bologna EmiliaRomagna is one of the few regions with relative wealth in Italy which makes this more tragic Tourists come spend your money on rag and get back in your cattle vans and go away Whats worse is when you make comparisons to midsize cities in countries like Spain Mlaga Valencia etc which have less money but still have comfortable clean and wellorganized airports

The airport is misery Bagagge lost and no info of when to receive it Had to go back to airport the next day and stand in a queue for hours in a small corridor without air and with angry and stressed others who lost their luggage several days ago Only one part of the queue could be helped during too short service times The staff was overcrowdwd and work under nonworthy circumstances At departure no seating and overcrowded because people need to circulate to buy in the shops or restaurants I will never use this airport again

We flew British Airways from LHR to Bologna on th February Despite a halffull plane BA failed to load my suitcase We reported this to the Lost Luggage office The young lady who assisted us was rather casual about the matter even though we told her I had no clothes but what I was wearing and we were only in Italy for days and we had a hour drive to Jesi She told us that we could wait to have it delivered to us but it wouldnt arrive until the day we left or if we guaranteed we would come and pick it up today we could collect it at hrs pm We said we would definitely come back at pm to collect the bag even though it meant wasting a day waiting around We confirmed that time three times with her We duly showed back up at the Airport at and rang the bell to the Lost Luggage Office Noone answered We then noted the sign on the door that said opening hours Another set of people whod also lost luggage were also trying to make contact with the office After trying the phone number provided to us by the girl in the morning and ringing the bell repeatedly we found an information counter and explained our problem to the woman there She rang and spoke to someone INSIDE THE LOST LUGGAGE OFFICE but they refused to speak to us or answer the phone or door Finally at pm they answered the bell and let the now THREE groups of people trying to get their luggage in By then we had accrued a Euro parking fee and then had to drive to a rural area near Jesi and get into a farmhouse in the dark Bologna Airport has flights coming in pretty much but a lost luggage office that is only open hours a day and refuses to help people outside that time even if people are present in the office I am extremely disappointed with the level of service at Bologna Airport I have informed all my friends some of whom travel to Italy regularly to beware of routing their travel through there unless only taking carryon baggage

Congratulations everyone on the wonderful new airport at Bonriki The building is such an improvement on the previous facility and now provides travellers to and from Kiribati with a modern beautifully designed space to start and finish their Kiribati adventure I understand their are more features such as a cafe and lounge still in progress but in the meantime could airport management please think of a way to provide water to passengers in the departure lounge as we just experienced nearly hours in hot conditions without water Many thanks cant wait to return and see the next stages of the development

The stay at the airport was okay The baggage claim on arrival worked quickly The signposting could be better The arrows were often unclear to me eg pointing downwards when you should go straight up a flight of stairs Unfortunately I came across a very unfriendly person at security control who became downright arrogant when I initially didnt understand her in either French or English Its a shame that people like that work in customer service Other airports can do better

Born and raised in the Northshore of Massachusetts Logan is the only choice I have really when flying anywhere domestic or international My last experience at Logan was when I was traveling to Indianapolis with my partner to visit with his family back in July Ive had both sides of the coin in terms of experiences with Logan over the years really good experiences here with nice staff everything being clean and organized to awful experiences where staff are rude the bathrooms are gross seating areas are dirty disorderly queues and more Both times going there ranged from fair to poor bathrooms need serious cleaning and the interior needs an update it looks like some areas havent been swept or vacuumed in ages The gap between great experiences and worst experiences at Logan Airport is one of the worst Ive ever dealt with in my life I feel like I have been going to Logan at the best times and the worst times and it is the sharpest gap between good and bad that Ive ever witnessed The airport in Indianapolis on the other hand is way better way cleaner way more organized way more selections to choose from etc Logan Airport itself is not a bad airport but overall there is better airports out there Logan is in need of improvement though I wouldnt recommend it because there is such a sharp gap between the good and bad here you may get the really good or the extremely bad Better options out there Sadly this is my only choice to travel But to others beware You never know what you will get Logan is the most unpredictable airport youll ever witness Think twice

Returned from a week away in the Algarve We landed around on Friday My partner had a big problem with walking huge pains in her right leg A ramp had been put in at the rear of the plane for her to get off of by way of a wheel chair Young lad by the name of Oliver was her helper in this Walked us through passport and customers He asked where we were parked I had cases and small bass on a trolley He took us all the way to where our car was parked Massive thank you to him for going beyond what he would normally do if he was much busier

Bournemouth airport assistance staff gave my disabled fatherinlaw priority treatment right from precheckin to the aircraft entry ramp as did the security team It relieved us of much difficulty with the wheelchair security check and long walk from security to aircraft The staff members were super staying with us throughout Thankyou Bournemouth airport you are light years better than Heathrow for passenger convenience parking as well as disabled assistance and friendliness and we will recommend you to others and will actively select to fly from Bournemouth many times again
The airport app does not work on busy periods there are dirty tables everywhere older people cannot do this order online and there is wee everywhere in the male and female toilets

In the present climate I cannot understand that Bournemouth Airport fails to have a drinking fountain or even just a tap in the toilets that supplies cold water I appreciate that normally the Cafe at the airport oblige but presently they are shut due to the pandemic and so the only available free water is out of hot taps in the toilets

As a favour to my very good friends who were having a short break in Malta following yrs of being together i offered to drop them off at the airport their flight was at pm so we arranged i would drop them off at am to save them having to pay for a taxi I had never done this before and as they were literally travelling with two small pieces of cabin luggage the plan was to drop and run as you would expect however once my friends had got out of the car i was forced by a very unsympathetic car park attendant we will call him that to be polite into the car park as apparently that was what you need to do for drop offs I had assumed there would be a tiny window of time for such purposes ie mins or so which would be free of charge but i was then charged an extortionate fee of for literally taking a token from the entrance barrier and going straight to the payment machine I think this is absolutely disgusting and just another way of ripping the public off when they are trying to do someone a favour there definitely should be a small area for these sort of situations allowing people the seconds it takes for someone to get out of the vehicle and collect their baggage from the boot and then leave When i confronted the car park attendant about this he just shrugged his shoulders and said that what it is with absolutely no sympathy at all although it is only i feel like i have been robbed as all i needed to do was turn around an leave but as there was another car coming up behind me i did as this man said but had no idea i was going to be charged for obliging him As you can gather Im still fuming about this so wanted too make a formal complaint about it and will be contacting the airport directly as well once i can get through there is plenty of space there for a drop off point to be put in place so completely outrageous as far as Im concerned

The problem is there are never enough check in desks open and queues are horrendous because of this People getting stressed as a result as no time airside to look around or have a coffee etc Needs addressing as an hour wait to bag drop is not acceptable

Departure We often fly from Bournemouth because it is convenient for us In comparison to other regional airports it is backward Luckily my wife and I had no hold luggage on our last flight so we were able to avoid the long queues at the luggage checkin deskThere are no auto baggage checkin machines as there are for instance at Bristol Airport The cafes ability to provide a good service is widely variable and on one occassion the simple act of obtaining a coffee and snack was a flustered staff ordeal There are not enough staff at the gate resulting in slow loading of passengers and the solo girl was struggled to cope when a passenger problem occurred Arrival Very poor No auto passport machines where on average it takes five minutes to pass Bournemouth has three desks with border officials average time to pass is about to minutes if towards the middleback of the queue Make sure that you arrive at Bournemouth airport with pounds sterling as there is no ATM at the arrivals terminal If you need cash for a taxi you have to walk to the departures terminal to get it Transport by bus is not available on weekend afternoons after about to drop off passengers which is also added to taxi fares Conclusion An underfunded for profit only airport which has failed to modernise It has very little attraction for those who have wider airport experiences

Hartford airport is very small I arrived hours before my flight because I was coming from Vermont and wanted to allow for traffic but that was way too early for what was available at the airport The hall immediately past security has plenty of restaurants to choose from along with a number of rocking chairs that have a nice view of the apron The Gates concourse also looked like it had been recently renovated and also had a nice selection of restaurants and shops However the presecurity areas and the Gates concourse were dark and dim and were unpleasant places to wait Fortunately everything at this airport is very close so if your flight leaves from Gates you can wait in the postsecurity hall and go to your gate at the last moment Still itd be nice if the airport would renovate the Gates concourse and the presecurity areas so that it looks as nice as the Gates concourse

The TSA pre check line is not adequately highlighted when coming in to depart As a result we ended up in the annoying line where you have to remove coats belts shoes laptops everything but tooth fillings Plus a full body screen breast area pat down leg pat down Really I have no artificial limbs no metal knees Tampa isnt nearly as annoying TSA pre check lines are clearly identified from the moment you enter the airport Cmon CT shape up

Arrival from Lisbon long queues for nonBrazilian passport holders at Immigration and then again at Customs after baggage pickup Only one person checking everyone from an A plane it took over an hour so decided not to line up but sit down and wait it out At least there is a small shop to relieve the tedium Bring a good book Plenty of taxis outside to take you into the city Mine was metered so the fare was as expected Departure on an internal flight to Sao Paulo Check in was rapid and lines at security not too bad But eat outside in the pleasant concourse before you go through security There is only one small snack stand that we could find on airside and the seating area waiting for the transfer bus is small and crowded No wifi either Essentially many parts of the airport seem not to have expanded with increased traffic How this airport will cope with the crowds attending World Cup can only be imagined

As noted the checkin area is open air and spacious The shopping area beyond that was expansive All in all nice The gate area used by most domestic flights however would be more suited for a small provincial airport with few flights There is not nearly enough room for the lines of people waiting to board Thel snake thrugh the small terminal making it difficult for others to walk by My fight was not through a jetway but via a shuttle bus The monitor above the door we were to use first correctly reflected our flight and time and then suddenly switched to another flight leaving from another gate there had been no gate change Brazilians commented that a tourist eg for the World Cup in would be completely lost The bus trip to the plane was very long For arrivals the directions on where to go for the baggage claim area vs connecting flights were confusing The bagage claim area is rather big confusing and dirty It took over half an hour to get my bags Signage to taxis busses etc is inadequate Still all in all Id rate BSB above many other Brazilaian airports Its easier to use than Rio or Sao Paulo at least until you get to the cramped gate area

BSB has its modern part but it is still a quite bad airport seems that they dont care about changing anything on this airport its busy on weekends Staff can be quite rude and as in most of Brazilian airports everything is overpriced Youd be better eat somewhere else before flying

The apparent discrepancy in previous comments is easily explained The BSB terminals quality is strikingly different between the boarding gate area and the presecurity one The latter is really nice The citys highaltitude tropical climate makes for amenable temperatures almost all year around and makes air conditioning dispensable in the wide open entrance area which is a really pleasant place Checkin is usually fast and efficient except on late Thursday and on Friday because of the already mentioned busy traffic of Congressmen and their aides going to home states there is a fairly complete shoppingmallstyle food court with many options including movie theatres good shopping with not only the usual luxuryitem style but also plenty of those lastminute simple essentials Once past security however things change It wouldnt be bad were it not for the fact that the boarding gate area was simply underdimensioned for the traffic it gets Pray to get a jetbridged gate because the ground level boarding area for bussed remote positions is very small and can be really chaotic at times Arrivals are usually fine though enough conveyor belts and luggage arrives fast enough to ensure a quick turnover Signage could be better on arrival and transit areas Transportation is indeed a problem the buses mentioned are regular urban buses with no space for luggage and are infrequent Taxis are really expensive but are mostly the only practical choice But a lightrail line is planned for the next couple of years and that should improve things a lot

This is a nice airport people are friendly check in efficient It is a clean airport and it has a nice building with plants and water fonts Brasilia is a modern City and it is airport is like the city just fantastic

Perfectly tidy airport that is well connected to the city making it perfectly comfortable to arrive at Unfortunately the departures side of the airport leaves a lot to be desired There is only one Duty Free store with limited range and bad prices The options for food and drink are also poor after security the only options are a small bar for beer and a snack kiosk The WiFi service is fine but only if youre in the tiny part of the airport where it seems to work most of the time youll find the WiFi network nonexistent which made the idea of doing any work a nonstarter Particularly bad is the area past the immigration kiosks The only amenities there are vending machines which charge nearly for a bottle of coke with nowhere to fill up water bottles or even to get a bad coffee The terminal itself is draughty when there are gates in use which is particularly noticeable in cold weather All in all a very disappointing experience

Nothing special to write it looks more like a train station than an airport but its a small city anyway so thats fair Access from the city center by tram makes it the easiest cheapest and fastest airport to reach Ive seen in my life Fans of space will love the huge International Space Station model in the main hall and aviation fans will love the souvenir shop where you can buy many Airbus collectors items One thing they should put more power sockets

I agree with Jurgen Arnold regarding this airport and its proximity to the lovely city of Bremen I flew there last year on Easyjet to and from London Luton but they dont do the route anymore it seems Squeezed out by the inferior product from Ireland I guess so the comment about other low cost competition may be a pipe dream Now if Easyjet were to try again from Gatwick they may give Ryanair a fright My advice to Jurgen when next departing this lovely airport is to use the facilities in the main terminal first much nicer and not much blue before travelling to Ryanairs plastic chairs at the last possible minute
Providing potable water free of charge in order to fill up a water bottle is one of the most basic requirements at any airport Zero out of to BRI where the only water available must be purchased

They are investing significantly in the airport site yet have no consideration for the terminal building itself the check in area is a nightmare if your check in desk is not open the area cant cope with crowds waiting no area to sit or wait and results in people hanging around in any spot possible you are then are presented with the farce that is security They have spent i would suggest millions on scanners and equipment to have them sat idle and happily watch the crowds grow and get increasingly annoyed invest in people all the fancy car parking means nothing when you cant even move people through security in a timely manner to then go into the departures lounge absolute carnage and unsafe the amount of people down stairs upstairs at gates was completely full you struggled to find a spot just to stand which was leading to frustration amongst the passengers to find out flight was cancelled and no assistance from anyone apart from phones on the wall that just rang and rang then to be told to go to gate to exit the airport to find a long queue on finally reaching the end to be told we are not dealing with the cancelled flight at the moment and return to the lounge and wait which i refused was not being held hostage at the airport eventually they agreed to let me leave to be approached by a very rude border force officer and turn the heating down its always boiling in the terminal Invest in people and the customer experience instead of over priced parking spaces terrible airport and no support staff for passengers priorities all wrong

NOT A CUSTOMER FRIENDLY AIRPORT Its a shame I couldnt give no stars or minus stars The airport is a joke you have to walk miles and miles I clocked up miles today I was dropped off the bus from the plane you have to walk upstairs There is no lift then you have to walk for an eternity to get to the baggage carousel I felt really sorry for anybody that was elderly Or has a little bit of problem walking why didnt they put in travelators Like they have other airports Car parked in the silver zone costs a fortune I wasnt aware they move your car after you parked it Dropping the keys off before your holidays is easy its not so easy getting them back yet again another queue with those stupid upanddown tapes Only two people and a very long queue Only one person per party allowed to pick the keys up the rest have to stay outside What happens if its raining Do they just get wet And when you have to walk miles to get your car from where they have parked it there are no covered walkways In the UK it rains a lot Do they just expect everybody to get soaking wet

The airport is pretty average but the access road A is appalling It is not much better than a country lane For the first hours of morning flights there is an average of take offs The airport can handle it but the road cannot There is a small junction several hundred metres away which is controlled by traffic lights which causes traffic to jam at the entrance There are no alternative routes

Longest wait for security I have ever experienced Very poor information not telling us the flight was delayed until half an hour after it was meant to depart Then trapped in an aircraft for an hour waiting for busses to unload us I wont be back

I flew into EZE and out of EZE a week later international flights for both The arrivals process took about an hour and the lines moved slowly but the staff was proactive in getting us through the process as quickly as possible including by waving us over to the Argentine Citizen lanes once all the citizens were processed Departure however was a considerably worse experience The signs on the road into the airport clearly state that all international departures check in at Terminal A so thats where my taxi driver took me However it turns out that Delta and Aerolineas Argentinas international departures check in at Terminal C so I had to make the minute walk over there in the hot sun it was in the s Fahrenheit that day After arriving at Terminal C I changed into long sleeved clothing because I was flying somewhere much colder however the Air Conditioning in the buildings was poor so I sweated through my clothing very quickly just while waiting to check my bag Finally it seems that EZE has a rule that nobody can bring liquids over mL onto a plane going to the United States This rule seems was enforced on all flights to the US But I have not seen that rule enforced on flights to the US from Europe or Asia so it seems like its airport or at least Argentina specific It was incredibly annoying because it meant that I couldnt take any water with me on the plane Unfortunately if youre visiting Buenos Aires from very far away youll likely have no choice but to use EZE But be prepared for confusing directions poor climate control and stricter security protocols then youll see elsewhere

Very clean airport and great lounges However prepare to be ignored if you dont speak Spanish Check in queues are pathetic and need review Modern display boards work well but show random and irrelevant times Staff are very unfriendly and not able to help with anything

Modern but has poor circulation in and out The wait for immigration was glacial and there was a customs form that wasnt collected The line for the bank to change money was glacial Terminal B the location for the shuttle into the city is really just a kiosk in front of the back entrance for terminal C some distance away The taxi ride from the center was about US plus tolls Departure was relatively easy which may have been a reflection of being a Saturday afternoon although there were few places to sit while waiting for the airline to begin checkin Few places to eat or shop in the departure area Note that there is no exchange after immigration so you must change money when you checkin with the airlinethe selection of goods postimmigration was disappointing and you cannot take water onto flights The lounge used by Star Alliance was ok with a range of things to eat The same vendor runs the lounge for Delta and American which I would assume are similar Bathrooms were in need of better upkeep Not the worst of airports but one Id happily never use again

The airport is quite a distance from the City It took me about minutes It is a modern airport with all the services you expect Let me speak first about the arrival We arrived early in the morning Other flights had arrived too The lines snaked and coiled for passengers to clear immigration It took nearly an hour That however was enough time for our checked luggage to arrive in baggage claim Our bags were put through a scanning machine by customs and we stepped out from shops to a concourse full of tranportation services We purchased a taxi service USD to our hotel A taxi driver escorted us out of the terminal building made us wait at a spot while he went off to fetch his taxi It all worked On departure which was late at night we arrived in the evening Check in was smooth Security check was also smooth Lines to get your passport stamped again on departure moved fast The American Airlines lounge was jammed with people what with five flights to the US departing in a short span of time The lounge offered a large variety of food and drinks but not enough place sit and relax Only one major shop selling duty free items Very few if any Made in Argentina products except for wine There is a McDonalds As is the case an additional security check is conducted just before boarding the flight to the US with the carry on bags opened up by security men and women wearing rubber gloves There are quite a few chairs in the departure area This is the primary airport to enter Argentina so if you are visiting this country it is next to impossible to avoid it I would be happy not to use this airport again

The most basic airport I have been to Having been brought up in Burundi and been travelling there and back to the UK over several years I think this airport has gone downhill Many years ago this was an exciting airport People could see you off from the observation balcony but gone are the days My dad wasnt even allowed into the airport to see me off Airport staff will make your life hell just to say your last good byes to family My Kenya Airways flight to Nairobi was slightly delayed coming into the airport due to a power cut I have never experienced anything like it My arrival into the airport was just as bad with airport staff wanting to open all bags and wanting bribes in order to keep things Thank god my family had airport entry passes which meant we werent left short changed In all honesty I would still recommend as its just a crazy yet brilliant experience

This is a very basic and small airport Facilities are limited Most parts of the airport are covered but are not air conditioned relying on natural ventilation Mosquitoes could be a problem at some times Fortunately there are not too many staff hassling for your money baggage reclaim was reasonably efficient No real problems departing Again there are very limited facilities There are a couple of shops selling the usual tourist fare and expensive bottles of alcohol The barcaf is not bad but is overpriced for a simple snack The business lounge is nothing more than a room with a TV

BUR is a no frills no wow no stress airport and those are the best things about it Easy to park with valet getting through security is usually a breeze and there is little fog to cause delays Theres a Peets coffee and the cafe is overpriced but decent Do you really expect fine dining on what is primarily a short haul airport basically an SWA airport Other than the charming s air about the place you get on and off the planes old school style with stairs and with SWA can enter through the front of back of the plane the latter to avoid the slow pokes SWA boarding lines are well organized If I were to complain the rest rooms are smallish and Terminal B for United is too small Seating can be somewhat tight close to boarding time Baggage claim is usually reasonably fast but there are only two carousels so dont dawdle If you are going to the westside or even downtown youre in for a long cab ride but most travelers live in one of the nearby valleys and if youre a tourist its close to Universal Studios Theres a train within walking distance that will take you downtown or to Ventura County during limited times Overall a very good travel experience because it is easy and stress free

Security took about mins Checked in online but the line to check in didnt look long Seating was a bit tight at our gate but we were next to other gates Boarding you walk straight to the plane and board using stairs Minimal restaurants and shopping but this airport is small Didnt have to use WiFi

Burbank provides a convenient and easy alternative to LAX although the departure hall in Terminal B is too small to accommodate more than flights at a time There were flights an MD a and CRJ regional jets boarding simultaneously and the small space and cramped conditions caused confusion and delayed boarding for everyone

BUR provides a pleasant alternative to LAX The terminal complex is a bit small so during peak times it can get crowded but security and checkin lines move quickly There are no jetways but being in California weather is seldom an issue and its quite nice walking onto the tarmac to board your plane by stairs If youre in a wheelchair they will use a mechanical lift to raise you to the aircraft door The food and shopping offerings are bare bones and quite disappointing If using the Metrolink rail is convenient to your travel BUR is an excellent alternative because there is a station across the street from the terminal but the airport is a bit difficult to get to by road because there is no freeway access within miles Traffic at rush hour can be difficult

Small airport dating back to the early days of aviation when the thinking was that would be aerodromes in most towns Today BUR is convenient airport for those wishing to avoid LAX You pick up your bags from the baggage conveyor belt outside the terminal

I work with people with intellectual disabilities and we were traveling to Burgas for vacation with very big group of ID people with all kind of diagnoses including Down syndrome and other At the passport control the police officer screamed at one of our patients in Bulgarian When I saw it I explained to police officer that they are people with special needs and they dont understand him he started also shouting at me When I asked him why is he talking like this even if they did something wrong he can tell it in a nice way the response I got was Because Im allowed to talk like this And stop arguing with me if you want to fly Horrible experience Absolutely unacceptable behavior from the police man

Small NW Tasmanian airport with flights to Melbourne Tasmanian destinations Neat tidy with easy checkin baggage collection Small cafeshop enough seating for size of aircraft using airport Not a bad little airport

Cagliari Airport is an absolute shambles From the moment of arrival its clear that chaos reigns supreme The staff seem overwhelmed resorting to shouting to manage the crowds Flight delays are the norm and passengers are left completely in the dark with no information provided The airport is plagued by frequent blackouts adding to the confusion and slowing down everything to a crawl The situation is exacerbated by the lack of proper air conditioning With temperatures soaring passengers are forced to endure sweltering conditions leading to discomfort and distress While the airports train connection is a positive aspect the closure of flypasses leading to the airport is an added inconvenience Its truly disheartening to witness such a poorly managed airport in this day and age Cagliari Airport is a black eye for Europe and a complete embarrassment for Sardinia Its clear that urgent improvements are needed to bring this airport up to even the most basic standards I strongly advise travelers to avoid Cagliari Airport if at all possible

The only complaint is the lack of logic in boarding flights In COVID time would be ideal to board from seat number starting from the back of the plane in order to avoid contact with people seating in front rows In Cagliari dont seem to know at all this method that we have experienced at Heathrow airport and Fiumicino airport as well We tried to suggest it to the airport staff doing the boarding but they seem clueless and helpless Big crowd gathering at the same time with no proper queue and security distance I wish a manager at Cagliari airport would have the kindness to reply and explain why It would be so easy to update the system and believe me the boarding will be quicker and safer Thank you

This is a European regional airport and a tale of two airports really The nonSchengen flights come from Gatwick BA Stansted and Dublin Ryanair as well as a flight from Moscow When all four arrive at roughly the same time Passport Control is chaotic There were two snake queues those with identity Cards only were ushered into one and those with Passports ushered into another A third queue then formed and this is where the chaos began and people were jumping from queue to queue The departing situation was a lot better Quite a busy departures area but nicely designed The gates for the nonSchengen destinations are Passengers can go here straight away and clear Passport Control Once through Passport Control Ryanair passengers should head downstairs to gates while BA passengers should wait in the lounge just through Passport Control Not sure where the Mosco flight departs from I doubt if I will be travelling here again anytime soon but departing from this airport is much better than arriving at it

This is my home airport Completely renewed a few years ago its now a very good and modern airport Near the city center just minutes by car Its a small airport but its probably the better choice to come to Sardinia Depending on winds you can have a fantastic view over the famous sardinian beaches from your airplane window In the summer sometimes you may find crowds at security checks There are just a few overpriced shops but this is common in italian airports Car rentals taxis and bus are easy available

International airport is just conveniently next to the domestic one Only one coffee place and another shop to grab a bite souvenirs shops inside the gate Considering only a handful flights I think these are sufficient Theres one filter water fountain near gate Overall it can be improved when it gets busier more flights Both elevator and escalator were out of order on the day we departed

International airport is just next to the domestic one Two coffee shops and souvenir shops Consider how small the airport is these are sufficed One water fountain near gate Coffee from one of the vendors was alright Both of the elevator and escalator were out of order on the day I flew

Nice airport but everything at it is exceptionally expensive Bought a meal and paid about x what I would normally have to pay Ridiculous prices anyone would think itd be cheaper than Sydney or Melbourne but is more

Very poor transport links to the town and accommodation Flight was late luggage took over an hour to arrive This put a few hundred people outside at There were no busses and almost no taxis The taxi queue was meters long and moved very slowly At the queue was still meters long All the car hire companies were closed There was no where open for food or drink The airport experience gives the first impression of the town Cairns needs to consider the impression it is giving out Worst airport service I have experienced

I was traveling with my months old baby of course I need to bring some water for the long flight I didnt mind the security they checked the water and my bags But the security officer lady was so rude she sounded like a police officer talking to the criminal Asked what was my water bottle for and told me I cant touch my bag I just carried my little baby to travel and I had been treated like a offender Cairns airport security is the worst airport I ever seen Once again I didnt mind they asked me any questions check everything they needed but please be nice and friendly If they want to treat a passengers like a criminal please be a police or they get the job in Karen restaurant
The security check staff were unbelievably rude and disrespectful Nil communication skills and as a result we felt most unwelcome Not a good look for the gateway to the Barrier Reef

Cairns Domestic Airport has to be one of the worst airports in Australia Make sure you bring comfortable shoes as you will be doing some walking The terminal actually has gates connecting to the aircraft from door however it does not direct you directly to the terminal rather than a venture down ramps and semi outdoor corridors eventually into the terminal building When you arrive with another airline you will need to pick up your bags in a different building then walk the long way around to the departure building Then even the runway layout is special where the aircraft have to turn against the runway then turn degrees for about a few hundred meters this means that at busy times you can ensure some stationary time waiting to take off

This has to be the most inefficient airport Ive experienced Countless security checks Very limited seating which resulted in having to sit on the floor The cigarette smell looms everywhere in the airport

Worst airport ever Long long queues for first security screening for both economy and business then passport Took hours Then another long queue to get into departure gate Lots of bribery to jump queues Not enough staff or antiquated equipment Everyone scanned and then patted down Will not go via Cairo again

Departure is very tedious Our flight got delayed not due to the airports fault but it took hours for them to get our luggage back Most of the luggage returned were wet and damaged Arrival however is very quick and easy

I have traveled through Cairo airport multiple times before and my experience this time was a significant improvement A marked improvement in signage and organization within the terminal itself which made navigation through it a breeze The checkin process was quicker wifi stands and mobile charging stations were finally added the major downside however was the security procedures which were as slow and unorganized as usual and needs a ton of attention Despite the many areas for improvement i was impressed by the positive changes implemented since my last visit and hope they will continue

Previously Kolkata was one of the worst airports ive experienced but now it has a new terminal which is sufficient in size and clean It is still not anywhere near to compete even IGI Delhi or Mumbai airport though I appreciate the cleanliness I would like to see more restaurants or food courts and cleaner toilets Presently there is one food court at the domestic departure and couple of cafes at the international departure No shopping plaza Wifi is poor and only free for min but you need to have an Indian phone number to connect Staff are slow

Calcutta Airport has come up to speed in the recent years and its about time too I only used to fly into CCU because it was the closest International Airport to Orissa and cut my journey time by a day However it was always a tiring and bothersome task fighting my way through the immigration and baggage handling policies they seemed to practice slow slower and at one stage stop Flying in wasnt too bad on a good day I could be off the plane and in a taxi within the hour depending on the carrier However departing from CCU was a chore Immigration then check your baggage tags to bags then Passport Control then a small tussle with Security and Baggage Check then finally the what seemed like a mile hike to the plane However those days are gone if you fly in with BA they insisted on a proper Gate being constructed and it is now up and running Much to my delight its just a hop and a skip to the plane and then youre on your way Yes you still have to grapple with Security and Passport Control but the last three times I have flown intoout of CCU I have been spared the ordeal of searching for my bags and tallying them up with my ticket tags

Security is the absolute worst we have experienced Flew all the way from Armenia and had a delay necessitating an unscheduled overnight in Calgary Stopped the next day at security b and scanned our bags Security checked manually and questioned a liquid they claimed that honey sugar solid mass was a liquid We insisted it was not they asked us to open the sealed container and put it upside down to see if it was liquid and we complied and sure enough it was solid Then told us oh well its a liquid Manager insisted it was a liquid even though its a solid They took it saying it was a liquid No problems at Yerevan Tbilisi Frankfurt or Charles de Gaulle But Calgary has an issue Staff not reasonable at all and terrible attitudes All other staff volunteers and airline staff we encountered were fantastic

I am deeply disappointed by the treatment I received while going through security at Calgary International Airport on September st The security staff were unprofessional and seemed to be on a power trip showing no respect or courtesy to passengers I was subjected to an invasive patdown despite wearing skintight clothing which felt entirely unnecessary and violating One agent threatened to confiscate my iPad simply because it was dead and I didnt have a charger which is absurd Many passengers myself included were left concerned about missing connections due to the slow inefficient process Furthermore a female agent exhibited clear discrimination showing leniency to some passengers while treating others like myself with harshness Additionally I witnessed an agent in customs speaking to another traveler in an extremely unprofessional manner once again displaying behavior that felt more like a power trip than proper procedure This was the worst airport experience Ive had in all my travelsand Ive been all over the world I strongly advise others to avoid Calgary Airport and I will be doing the same in the future

Seating is awful No place to charge anything so bring your own power backup Businesses close ridiculously early Domestic flights are scheduled willy Milly all across the vast terminal with no rhyme or reason

I have mixed feelings about this airport Upon arrival the checkin process took almost no time at all and I was on my way in a matter of minutes Terminal signs presecurity were limited but easy enough that I was able to find the C security checkpoint quick enough Security was a different story The wait was brutal taking over an hour to clear On top of this the staff were not very fast chatting to everyone about travel plans flying etc Terminal signage postsecurity was much clearer and my gate was found quite fast Departure was also very efficient and boarding went by fast and I was departing on time Overall this airport has good and bad but its one of the better airports that Ive been to

The security experience in the Calgary airport was by far the worst In fact it was ridiculous So so slow Maybe people in front of me and it took minutes to get through Refusal to open other lines or security staff just standing around talking What an embarrassment

Worst experience at an airport I have ever had I am a casual travel writer and photographer and tend to carry sensitive equipment depending on the project In this case I was to be shooting a film project and had a few rolls of mm film The day before I arrived to the airport I called both the airport and the company handling security and was assured that my equipment would be hand checked at my request and that they deal with film often enough that they dont run it through the scanners Upon my arrival at the security check I was told that they didnt care what I was told and I was to do it their way or be removed from the airport The individual behind the scanner proceeded to not only unroll fresh undeveloped film making it useless but proceeded to treat my gear as unprofessionally as I have ever seen My cameras were thrown down on the belts and tossed into bins My canon AE now requires fairly large repairs to the shutter and the lens mount This is a vintage camera so repairs are costly I have flown through rd world countries with better airport staff then what is seen in Calgary Absolutely unprofessional unpleasant and overall uncaring Very pathetic

Security staff opened and manually checked my bags normally this is fine however my belongings were showed off to non security personel like a show and tell session Incredibly unprofessional behaviour that is totally disrespectful Security was also very inconsistent and had rules that were not advertised for example I was unable to take sand and stones that I had brought with me from another country in my checkedin luggage I had never had an issue with this on any other domestic flights I had taken they also dont allow you to fly with honey

I recently had an appalling experience at Canberra Airport A security guard was dismissive and on a clear power trip telling me Ill take my time then when I asked for clarification during screening This was the worst customer service Ive encountered after travelling extensively around the world The behaviour of this staff member was unacceptable I submitted a formal complaint and am yet to receive a response Extremely disappointed

The CBR airport security people tried to gas light me They claimed that I could not take a narrow roll of scotch tape not gaffer or strong tape but clear tape for wrapping a present I asked to see where this was listed as a prohibited item They showed me a card carefully putting their thumb over the word gaffer so I would only see the word tape I called them out Supervisor then backed them up by calling on his authority to prohibit any item rather than to admit this was an overreach and unnecessary Security should be spending their time identifying harmful items not confiscating harmless items

Another review from complained about the wifi well Dec its still useless Cant connect to flyCBR noone to get assistance from Qantas cant help Not good when youre now expected to do everything online Limited very expensive food choices of course airports have got a captive audience But what do you expect when the people the airport wants to encourage are all members with privileges others dont get The rabble are to be tolerated not encouraged

Love arriving in Canberra perhaps the exit sign could be more obvious though but it is so easy Loathe exiting though I have never not had a problem I am elderly female and I found it a tad offensive to publicly strip to my undershirt as apparently cardigans are a security risk and I was requested to remove mine I found this embarrassing I did remove my coat but seriouslycardigan Then my knee was an issue with their body scanner and I had to be patted down there My husbands ankle likewise I have travelled extensively and I feel Canberra staff are too aggressive and over zealous Perhaps they dislike the elderly as the young bloke in front of me was wearing a huge bulky jumper but that was OK There is no consistency between Australian airports what is ok in Melbourne is not ok in Canberra I think I will take some calming medication next time It is way too stressful Or maybe the manager can man up and watch to see what is going on

I love arriving at Canberra airport light and bright The luggage belt is designed so its easy to lift off your bag Departure was a bit of a mess You have this spacious airport but the two security lines are too close together which is compounded by the extra line up for body scanning You have to shove your way through that line up to put your things on the belt then join a line up of others to go through the body scanner Meanwhile your most valuable possessions are just sitting out there vulnerable to theft

I did not travel today I am here to pick someone up They have loud loud music playing like it was a disco in speakers throughout the ceiling so there is no way of getting away from it I cant even listen to something on my own phone with headphones as it is too loud Unacceptable what are they thinking I have been through some of the biggest airports in the world and have never encountered this If people want to listen to music they are perfectly at liberty to do so with their headphones People should have the choice This is incredible Ive been here minutes and Im already stressed

Arriving is easy everything is close by and there are rarely any crowds Departure Well that was horrid The security belt is obviously designed for business people on a day trip Only enough room for a couple of trays So I was trying to balance three trays in my arms to get them across to the belt with others cutting in front of me Then my bags went through I could see the security lady pointing at my e cigarette and battery on her screen now I know they are allowed in carry ons however she had a young man search my bag At no point did anyone talk to me I told him where these were Meanwhile it confused me as I did everything right I felt like a criminal and I was embarrassed Finally when that was sorted I looked for the water fountain to fill my bottle Gone So I had to buy water Sat in the hard seats then and eager to leave this disappointing airport They have a huge sign saying they want to be the best small airport they are dreaming The airport is not touristfriendly it is probably best only for business people on day hops
Professional courteous security Definitely a credit to the management and the leadership team Well done Definitely recommend the team for their professional approach and execution of their duties

hour to get through customs upon arrival Our block had agent serving our line compared to agents per other blocks Additionally we had the handicapped line flowing into our block We tried to plead with staff that just walked around aimlessly around the blocks but they would just say that they cannot move customers from one block to another as that is against their policy One of the customs agents event threatened to take my passport Fortunately one of the agents listened from another block otherwise we would have spent another minutes waiting On my departure Jairo a TSA agent tried to take our food He also removed sardine containers that actually came with us from the US saying they were liquids and took a frying pan that was light stainless steel per TSA only skillets are not allowed

With electronic boarding pass for a Delta flight to SEA USA Carryon luggage only Time from drop off at terminal to clearing security minutes Delta flight departure time pm Arrival processing time with USA passport using electronicautomated entry booth which prints your entry document with photo scan of passport and facial recognition scan Line was long and people were trying to cut into the line with resistance from people in line Delta flight arrival at pm Approximately minutes Waiting line organization could use some work on their part No contact with immigration personnel In advance paid Yucatan tourist tax and immigration processing feesfilling out forms No water stations to refill containers unreasonably expensive bottled water Finding a reliable and honest rental car agency prior to trip was difficult and only found using other peoples reviews Required car Insurance costs are misleading or intentionally hidden Some agencies refused to provide a copy of their insurance policies and prices when requested for review

The prices for food and drink at this airport are predatory especially at Terminal used primarily for international departures There is no free drinking water available and passengers are required to pay at least pesos for a bottle of water that costs pesos in town Prices for restaurants are double and triple what one would pay in Cancun for a similar meal The checkin kiosks where one scans a passport or inserts a credit card were inoperable for our American Airlines flight Overall not a good experience at CUN
I waited for over an hour to get my bags The new airport at Tulum is now open if you can try that one or Coxumel I have travel to Cancun very frequently and it is getting worse

Scam you out of money When we arrived we wanted to get strawberry Daiquiris from the coconut bar outside by shuttles The first red flag was he wouldnt accept US currency Then young girls kept getting drinks and he would only use their credit card As I was waiting for my drinks the phone rang was my shuttle was leaving so I gave my credit card When I got to the room i checked my credit card invoice he scammed me Canadian for drinks no phone number no email to contact hoping my bank reimburses me When going to those places use pesos only they will rip you off huge

Very frustrating getting to the airport in Cancun Traffic was horrendous It took us over an hour to go km Once we arrived and got in line with frontier airlines it was very slow an hour in line with only one agent helping checked baggage for our group and finally reaching an agent we were informed that we should have printed out our baggage ticket at the kiosk if the agent printed our baggage ticket out it cost an extra Our luggage weighed pounds and they wanted an extra to check it The airport needs to have agents instructing travelers to print their baggage claim The airport knows the difficulty due to road constructions in arriving on time and then to pressure you more while youve waited so long its just bad business It doesnt take a smart person to know they should inform their travelers will not be going back to Cancun in the near future
Airport staff sleeping and sitting in charging booths meant for Travellers Why are these staff members not working Bad management Please see what can be done to make the experience better

I prebooked special assistance with Turkish Airlines for my flights CTIstanbulBudapest and AthensIstanbulCT There is no security or special assistance area at the entrance I used drop and go upstairs I had to hop to the checkin counter and wait until a wheelchair arrived The rest was fairly smooth and return trip was prompt with wheelchair assistance to my vehicle

Firstly the sky bridge was late arriving at the plane Why There was only one international flight arriving is it too much to ask that the bridge arrives on time Secondly the e gates were not operational Why on earth have them if you are not going to operate them Then to top it all after collecting our baggage everyone had to load their baggage onto a manual scanner of which there was only one I have not seen one of those use in SA ever Why introduce such an archaic system

Got off a hour flight from Dubai and had a connecting flight to Namibia with a layover of hours of which hours were spent at the first passportImmigration control Only booths open Then afterwards the scramble to get to our gate because there is no transit area You literally have to go out to the exit and back in through the whole Airport to Departure Area then to a Security check and another immigration counter where another hundred people were queuing with min left We had no choice but to cut into line because other travellers still had plenty of time and then we were still told that we are late by the Immigration Officer Some of the Staff was friendly and helpful while others were not and just didnt care Will never use this Airport again

After weeks of touring around South Africa we experienced nothing but efficiency and kindness from everyone That is until we checked in at Cape Town International to fly back overseas What a total catastrophe CPT airport is because they are totally understaffed Six international flights all leaving within minutes of each other and this is what we experienced A minute wait in front of security Then hours yes min in front of passport control because passengers were trying to leave all impatiently waiting and pushing and getting verbal as they got more and more nervous about missing their flights There was one passport booth open At some point a second one opened and eventually a third to process people I am so disappointed in Cape Town airport and will avoid all international travel from there from now on and recommend everyone does the same What a disaster and actually a huge pity A beautiful modern city full of international flair that has such cool vibe and it has a disaster airport It just doesnt add up The few and for the most part friendly staff on duty tried to keep things going but they were so understaffed that things just fell apart

Firstly after an hour flight we were met at the immigration booth by a very aggressive immigration booth worker we had an issue with one of our family members passports and he the gentlemen in the booth basically threatened us that he would send us a family with kids back to our country without even explaining what the issue was or even trying clarify that is a solution which does require such extreme measures Only after a really friendly immigration officer came to help did we end up finding a solution So after the passport issue was resolved a few hours later because of help from the embassy we had to have another situation with an erratic staff customs lady who made a scene claiming to be pushed by us even when no such incident occurred and demanded an apology loudly screaming When we asked for security to please have a look at the camera footage to see just how absurd this lady was they did not even want to help us and sided with the customs staff lady This airport is a disgrace and unprofessional to even have such members working there in such important roles when dealing with people if it had not been for the friendly staff that we did encounter there a single star would be too gracious Please check your seats when sitting by windows they reek of urine

I arrived at Cape Town International Airport and had to wait for my baggage almost minutes This was a local flight from JNB to CPT This is not my first bad experience of the same nature in recent weeks

I find the VAT refund claim procedure at CPT to be a bit of a scam There are no signs at the checkin or prior to going through security to advise where to go to claim for tax refunds but as soon as we got through passport control there was a sign and a counter advising about tax refunds When we enquired we were told that you have to claim the tax back before you clear security This desk was just to pick up the card with the amount that you had claimed on it So now we have to wait until we get back to London fill in a form and get it stamped by the customs staff then send it back to South Africa along with all of the original receipts in order to claim the tax back If I do that I cant insure any of the valuables that were bought as you need an original receipt as proof of purchase and to prove actual value So I guess this is how they stop people from actually being able to claim the tax back as people either dont bother to do it once they get back because of the hassle forget to do it come across a problem with the info they were provided at CPT airport so cant claim or choose not to if its a choice between claiming the tax back or insuring the items against theft etc Any airport I have been to before you have to clear security to get to the tax claims desk I guess to prove you are actually leaving the country So I find this a very underhand way to keep hold of tax that visitors have paid and are entitled to get back

One needs more than arriving hours before takeoff time for international flights I would suggest Queues are terrible everywhere checkin taxes immigration And why taxes cant be paid by card On arrival migration services seem more efficient search me and luggage is delivered efficiently It is a pity not to be able to get money from an ATM in the international space only local cards seem to work On departure when you pass migration you get into a renewed part of the airport with plenty of space totally different from the departure area which is crowed Duty free shops are nice as well as the food offer Some dont like the patterns on the floor of the departure area but its one of the charms of Maiqueta airport Another one is the takeoff and landing especially at daytime I always enjoy the landscape

Caracas airport despite many improvements still has a very long way to go to be thought of as anything more than adequate The mad tax system where you pay to get out A rather surprising total of six separate search points The woeful queues at Immigration both inbound and outbound The lack of a covered walkway between International and Domestic terminals The constant unwanted attention from taxi touts and money changers

I have flown into Maracaibo via CCS twice this year both Air France and after both experiences I have to remind myself to fly via Aruba next time even with the extra EUR of flying KLM AMS Aruba The reasons All European flights arrive around the same time so you can imagine the line at the immigration counters Of desks on both times there were only open First time we queued for hours and the suitcases were waiting outside next to the belt The second time we risked missing our connecting flight so an officer kindly let us skip the hrs queue at the time we got on the line The international and domestic terminals are not connected so when transferring it takes a min walk and carrying your suitcases under a devil sun You are not allowed to take the trolleys out of the terminals so the option you have unless you carry it yourself is to pay for a porter I dont know how much it is since we decided to carry them ourselves Be sure to cool off later on as the AC is barely noticeable inside the terminals Domestic terminal same chaos as international Upon departure make sure to check in as soon as it is open same immigration queues We were almost the first ones checking in and it still took us more than mins to get through immigration I must say however it is being remodelled and the new international departure area before entering secure zone has a nice food court incl Subway and TGI Fridays Among others I have flown into Nigeria via Lagos and I must say Caracas is the worst airport I have ever encountered and will avoid it whenever possible Departure tax is also more expensive than when flying out directly from Maracaibo nice small international airport

On my last visit I found many issues which dismayed me regarding Simon Bolivar International Airport Only ATMs in the entire international Terminalside by side unsignposted and upstairs in the Mezzanine Level both out of order Several Bank outlets in the main terminal concourses closed in the middle of the day Inability to take luggage carts from the baggage claim area outside the exits into the main Arrivals Hall Excessive number of pushy unregulated and mostly uninsured taxi touts The airport authority regulates or attempts to taxis and there is an offical Taxi Transportation counter in the Arrivals hall On Departure from the country there is an airport user tax which must be paid prior to security immigration The organisation and collection of this farcical and woefully inadequate In the airports defense I would say it has one of the better Tourist Information desks of many South American airports but while the staff may be friendly and helpful there are all too few of them Food selection and outlets are reasonable and shopping appears quite inexpensive

Through a lack of concentration and waiting to board at the wrong gate I missed my flight to London Stansted I returned escorted to the checking in counter to get another ticket for the following day The agent who was available and did place order for the ticket said rather acerbically that it was important to concentrate when going through departure This is self evident and I resent the comment made as everybody lacks concentration at times and mistakes are made On departing the airport for an overnight hotel stay near the airport I was told the printed boarding pass would be issued the following day which he then repeated for confirmation On arrival at the airport I saw the same agent who asked if I had my boarding pass Now who is lacking in concentration Another agent I spoke to and who did hand me the boarding pass was courteous and very understanding of my situation and if the other agent was of a similar nature and character I would have given Airport staff stars On departing Narbonne I had a choice of airports Carcassonne or Beziers On reflection I wish I had chosen Beziers

I understand that scanning both luggage and the person travelling is essential at all airports for the safety of all who fly At a recent departure at Carcassonne airport my bag was cleared through the scanner and showed no items of dangerous content and the all clear given The bag was then scanned with a hand scanner and opened items were removed and a hand search made showing the bag again to be clear At all other airports once the bag has been cleared by a full scanner and the all clear given you are then able to proceed to pick up When passing through the full body scanner the all clear was given but I was then given a hand scanner search although no beeps or signs on a screen would have indicated reason for the hand scan After years of flying this rather excessive scanning of bag and person has only happened at Carcassonne airport Of course acuteprecautious judicious procedures have to be made but sometimes they become excessive bordering on paranoia

A very poor quality airport No ventilation or air conditioning so its always hot Very few wcs so theres always a long queue and apart from a very small outside cafe which is good the catering is abysmal The seating areas at the gates are basic and too crowded

After spending so much money on the new airport they have forgotten the basics When you arrive there are only two toilets one male one female in the main corridor There are no trolleys for those of us with luggage The car rental office is over the other side of a busy road The lift to get us to the underground tunnel and up the other side wasnt working so we had to cross the very busy road with our suitcases and no trolley The guy in the rental office shrugged his shoulders when I complained about this The same happened on the way back and there were still no trolleys at all What a shambles

There were no taxis at the airport as our plane the last of the day landed at four in the afternoon I mean none I found a card for a taxi company rang them to be told it would be at least an hour and my best bet would be to take the shuttle The shuttle arrived about half an hour later just one bus and it seemed at least half the flight needed to get on People were crushed standing in the aisle The nearest drop off for our hotel was quite a distance for two elderly ladies to drag their suitcases So if you are flying to Carcassonne I recommend that you book transport online from your own country beforehand

I flew to Carcassonne from Glasgow with Ryanair just when they were having all their major problems about cancellations Fortunately my flight was pretty much on time with only one drunk man aboard The flight was pretty standard for Ryanair and was plesent enough When we landed we all had to walk a virtual marathon to get to the arrivals hall in the degree heat Then once we finally made it there we had to wait over an hour in a stuffy baggage hall before our luggage arrived The next problem I faced was at the car hire depot I had to wait over half an hour before someone turned up at the desk A week later when Im heading home is where the worst part happened Even though it was only early afternoon half my flight back to Glasgow seemed to be heavily intoxicated and sitting in a tiny departures lounge with only one cafe was quite possibly the worst experience of my life When I got on the plane we didnt take off for another hour because the cabin crew couldnt get the door shut The and a half hour flight home was possibly the longest few hours of my life due to the noise and commotion from the drunks The only thing I got out this holiday was to never fly Ryanair again

I was booked on the FR service to Faro on the evening of the th Arrived at the airport at pm for the pm flight and proceeded to drop my vehicle in the meet and greet area which was across the road from the Departures entrance Inside the airport we proceeded straight through security with our cabin baggage and onto the gate The whole process was under minutes And an on time departure Upon arrival it was slightly more disappointing Immigration being fast The meet greet wasnt Cones placed everywhere designed for the driver to get lost in an absolute maze and fellow passengers encountering issues exiting the automated barrier Overall for my local airport and its location being miles from my home Id definitely use it again However saying that I do not think this airport can handle more than flight at a time Airlines like Qatar would encounter many issues getting their passengers through the short staffed terminal should they choose to return in the future This airport has potential Hopefully more flights are added soon so the people of Cardiff Vale can finally travel without going miles south to Bristol or miles to Londons airports But that would require staff expansion and funds

Monday th August am flight to Corfu Approaching baggagesecurity check all we could here was this lady screaming orders out at passengers as she directed them to different counters Short stocky blonde lady early s take a look around at your colleagues they were clearly disturbed as much as passengers with the way you were speaking to us As I passed through the scanner myself I said to two other members of staff Why is she behaving like this They genuinely shrugged their shoulders Is this regular behaviour from this lady if so someone put her on afternoon shifts as she is clearly not a morning person The only positive I can say about her is she is in no way discriminative everyone got the same treatment

Id love to able to write something positive about this my local airport but alas this isnt the occasion Travelling with my son who is autistic but in no way challenging in his behaviour we came up against the most officious security officer in the passenger search area My son was wearing his highly visible autism puzzles wristband which proclaims they are working in partnership with Cardiff Airport All was progressing well until the officer demanded my son push a tray being used by another passenger forward into the search machine My son had already pushed his own tray forward and was confused by this brusque instruction and when I interceded the officers response was it wasnt his job to do this He then petulantly turned on me demanding I empty my pocket as this sharp eyed Sherlock had observed a handkerchief which he insisted must be xrayed This experience encapsulates the mountain CWL have to climb to rid themselves of the entitled and self important attitude which is now all pervasive since they were recipients of the ill judged handout from the Welsh government It is difficult to avoid the conclusion that CWLs desire to facilitate the travel of disabled passengers is nothing more than a shallow marketing exercise which clearly hasnt been communicated effectively to their staff

Tried to book weeks parking in August Nothing available This is an airport that is trying to increase passenger numbers but they have not even got enough parking for the low number of passengers they have got at the moment Rubbish service they need to put someone in charge who knows what they are doing I checked the same dates at Bristol options available Wonder where I will fly from next time

Worst airport experience ever I was taking a flight from Cardiff to Faro with my two children and husband When we arrived around am for our flight at am the airport was the busiest Id ever seen it there were about three other flights all going off around the same time as us queues were massive and people seem very stressed I went straight to airport assistance as we had requested this for my son who is autistic Cardiff proudly portray themselves as working in partnership with autism I was given very bad advice at special assistance I was told that there was no one available to help me at present and as it was so busy I may be better off just joining the queue unassisted I did this and when we finally checked in our baggage we joined another extremely large que for security and passport control During this queue I again noticed a section for special assistance and so I told a member of staff he then guided me through a gate and placed me right by the queue for scanners there was only one working and at this point we suffered at least three passengers directing abuse towards myself my daughter and my husband I have never before been the target of such anger merely because staff were not able to control the passengers and perform their roles adequately I had to argue with about three people justifying my sons disability Once I got through passport control I complained to staff who just offered me some sympathy In Faro airport the opposite was true I received special assistance from beginning to end with the staff member staying with us through the whole process I am ashamed to be British and ashamed to be Welsh
