Its an old airport but there arent any other choices in the area Terminal is rather dim considering the perpetual sunshine for which El Paso is known It seems that theyre expanding the terminal Queuing times acceptable Being a border area may elicit additional screening from the immigrationcustoms officers no matter how long youve living here Foreign citizens lawfully in the Country are recommended to take their passports in addition to their IDs Excellent wifi signal shopping options are limited but ok Again the terminal looks dim and this makes it look less inviting

Ive lived in El Paso for two years now for school and I often use the airport to visit my hometown as well as other destinations The busiest Ive ever seen the airport from the time of walking through the doors checking baggage going through security and getting to my gate was about minutes Christmas vacation time Ive even got through in minutes Its a smaller airport with only one terminal thats ever used and about gates so from security to walk to your gate takes maybe minutes This isnt one of the airports youll need to devote hours in order to get through it Id say hour is fine because you never know even if it does only take minutes to get to your gate and maybe during busy holiday times or if youre going to have to check the whole family might even be hours for that

Small airport with a southwest theme much like ABQ All the employees were speaking spanish instead of English so I wasnt sure which side of the Rio Grande I was actually on The airport is easily navigable and shuttles to hotels were readily available No problems besides Spanish being the unofficial language

A new terminal has been built but was not yet open so I used the old facilities Arrivals area was a simple opensided area of the main building Checkin took place in a single room at the other end of the building At the xray scanner an operator gazed in the general direction of the monitor screen The main hall had no AC not even a fan and had a very oppressive atmosphere Baggage handlers manhandled checked bags out through a back door After checking in most passengers seemed to go back outside where it was much cooler The waiting lounge had decent seating some airconditioning unappealing bathrooms and no shops it was quite full as there were two flights departing Flying from Ende was an interesting experience but I think the new terminal will remove a lot of what makes it special

Arrived at the airport only to find long queues outside For baggage screening We went through all the checks passports etc only to find a further check just for uk passport holders we had to queue here for a long time only to find no seats or toilets We had to wait more than hours before boarding I think this is totally unacceptable and needs sorting out it made travelling from this airport unnecessarily uncomfortable experience

Clean spacious airport in March WiFi is available although the signal is weak Upon arrival you have to queue for longer than necessary a simple passport check should not take long Upon departure there is no online checkin All passengers must checkin at the counter even those with only handcabin luggage I guess the airport run by TAV has not upgraded its systems for many years There are too many security checks Food and drinks are very expensive on the airside and there are no water fountains This is extortion

By far the worst airport experience I have ever had Yes it is clean new and modern but these were the only good things about it There were at least flights within the space of an hour and then nothing for the next or hours the result total chaos I think there were literally or so security lanes serving what would have been probably passengers in an hour We got to the airport about and a half hours before departure and queued for almost hours to get through security Some people were panicking and trying to jump the queue as their flights were being called but rightly so the passengers near the front stopped them Its the only time Ive ever had to run for a flight in my life Turned out they were still missing over passengers on the flight as they were still stuck in the terminal Consequently Thomas Cook had to delay the flight The airport shouldnt allow so many flights to go at once if its totally incapable of handling them all If you somehow manage to go at a quiet time though Im sure it would be a very nice airport

I am very dissatisfied with the service I got here on the th March the airport staff could not show me where the UN offices were they were useless and unfriendly I would never come back here or recommend it either to anyone poor service

The worst thing is after you go through security there is no water available and no bathrooms There is nothing but seats Thankfully they have installed air conditioning If you dont like security you will hate this airport you have to go through security when driving in to the airport You have to go through security to get in to ticketing and you have to go through security to get to your gate Outside of the boarding area they have restaurants and shops Its not a modern airport so its difficult to find a plug to charge your electronics

Baggage reclaim was swift There was no air conditioning in departures and so we got very hot waiting to check bags as we arrived early There are very minimal check in desks so expect delays if you dont arrive early You need to climb exterior stairs to get to the departure terminal and so extra work driving around would be needed for people with disabilities There is security in the car park security before check in and security at the gate so expect a lot of waiting around for security checks The cost of food was very expensive so eat before you arrive All in all the airport served it purpose and we both arrived and delayed without an issue Bathrooms were also clean PS the WiFi is free and provided by the CAA
The airport is old Staff is friendly The airport is no longer capable of dealing with the large numbers of traffic passing through

Inbound they are now taking the passengers thru a temporary barrack on the side of the terminal At the moment the arrival hall is being upgraded for CHOGM Anyway it went quite smooth through immigration but the baggage area was very tiny for a A full of baggage Departure was smooth Remember that all of the airport is nonsmoking If you pass immigration there is really no way back Lots of crafts to be bought if you have not bought enough already One restaurant with a ok selection Need new airconditioning

After standing at passport control for over hour It was our turn Seconds earlier a couple appeared in another queue next to ours My partner who speaks the language perfectly pointed out that there was a queue Also someone else in the queue pointed it out as well The passport officer told us to go back over the red line And told this couple to come forward Not military not late for the same flight as us Cant believe that someone should get preferential treatment at passport control

Arrived at on a Sat night along with other flights and went into immigration hall only to find that whilst there were booths only of them were for EU passengers and the rest for Turks Northern Cypriot people and as a result the queue was back to the door and then back out onto the apron area Eventually an official told everyone to use all available booths but even then the immigration officials were extremely slow and scrutinised the passports to the point of overkill taking ages with each person On return we had to go through two security screenings why They told us that it was ok to take bottles of water through the second one Also why are all the prices airside in Euros or nothing on them Surely a last chance to get rid of the Turkish lira

Nice small airport easy to manage Reminds me of Luton airport circa Very cheap duty free shops and security checks on entry to the terminal building as well as the normal checks going thru to airside which possibly only a small airport can deal with But good security none the less

It is clean quick and efficient passport control Landed at was driving off at My return leg was the same desks open for the flights that were going to London around the same time with CTA Very cheap cigarettes and alcohol airport staff are friendly and helpful The chap that said announcements were not made in English is wrong all flights are announced in Turkish and English You can hardly miss your flight as there are only gates A small airport with only around flights coming and going in one week but very efficient

Very clean and security conscious majority of staff willing to help unless they belong to Turkish Airlines I found them to be most uncooperative lazy and downright rude to the point of looking at you when you ask a question and then turning around and walking away So be warned even the locals told me to watch out for this attitude and like a fool I walked straight into it

Smart clean and modern north east of Leftkosa Nicosia Security conspicuous and efficient check in very efficient immigration slow form filling Arrivals baggage collection was very slow and the baggage belt was to small for passengers The departure area has two cafes which take a variety of currencies and credit cards numerous small duty free shops alcohol mainly all keen for your custom Walk to the planes no buses No complaints

Exeter used to be a first class friendly efficient and welcoming place In fact I went out of my way to use it Nothing could be further from the truth now The check in staff are rude insulting and ill informed The security staff could get an award for being the most obstreperous rude and difficult to grace an airport They are also wrong on so many counts and semm to enjoy being wrong whilst flexing muscles that they would be unable to do anywhere else The airport seems to attract jobs worths and is run by a poorly qualified manager who seems to be operating above his ability levels Many staff in departures the lounge and duty free ask for travellers to complain formally as they hear so many complaints and there is nothing they can do about it As they say they want to protect their jobs and that cant be done if passengers are cross and irritable not spending money and not using the airport I actively use Bristol now That is hardly an example of great practice but at least it is anonymous and busy Exeter needs custom and it does not go the right way of achieving this goal I would strongly suggest that the Manager is retrained andor the staff are trained at other busy airports where customer service is paramount

Bar staff very rude wanted to go home early so told passengers to go to gate as flight had landed and was early I regularly travel from Exeter and was tracking the flight so I was well aware this information was false I explained to the staff member who then shouted that she works at airport and knows when a flight has landed I went through the gate and no sign of the flight just a very rude staff member who obviously has no customer service experience and needs retraining

This review is regarding the security checks and instant irreversible decisions taken by the security staff on items packed in carry on luggage I arrived at security at Exeter airport and it was not busy at all I removed my belt and electronics and placed them in the tray for scanning I had checked the airport website on permissible and banned items from hand luggage and was confident that I complied with all the current regulations My bag however was pulled for inspection and two rolls of duct tape was removed as banned items I had checked the website especially looking for the reference to duct tape and saw that it was listed as allowed in hand luggage Not though at security point I protested and informed the officer that the web site said duct tape was allowed no impression at all they would not even check the website I did ask why it was banned and was told that you could tie someone up with it I replied by asking if womens tights were also banned as you can tie someone up with them ridiculous reply I know but removing an item which was clearly allowed was also ridiculous I had to get friend who dropped me off at the airport to return to pick up my duct tape which cost time and fuel money Come on get yourself together either things are banned or not but let the public know

A very tired and faded airport Seats in the upstairs lounge were ripped and worn no bar available upstairs or downstairs carpet was worn and hadnt been cleaned Check in was ok security efficient but the comfort and facilities after security were very sadly lacking Not a patch on what this airport used to be

Keep an eye on your valuables as you pass through security My sister and I were late to board the plane departing st July at am Blue Islands Airline to Jersey by about minutes with boarding time of am The check in desk staff were very good No problem there The security staff Woeful Plainly annoyed one middle aged woman handling the belongings trays decidedly slappable with her sarcasm while looking down her nose at us The machine you walk through twice beeped at me necessitating my watch and bracelets to be placed in a tray That was the last I saw of my watch A Rado make so not cheap and a rather attractive black and gold enamel type strap During the rush of bundling us out of the security hall and across the tarmac to the plane I forgot to pick up my jewellery from the tray I noticed as soon as I sat down on the plane I immediately advised the excellent lady steward who instantly asked the captain to radio the security staff to bring my belongings to me My two bracelets duly arrived to the plane for which I am grateful but no watch Immediately upon my return to Exeter airport I attended Customer Service desk to be directed to the security hall where I spoke to a tall man clearly in authority He seemingly went to look at the footage of cctv and returned very quickly saying he could not see anything I was fobbed off and treated very dismissively by him Did he really look at the footage of days previously in detail so quickly My watch must have vanished into thin air I dont remember any other passengers being present We were the last to board the plane Something happened to my watch between being placed in the tray and us boarding the plane Watch your stuff

I was booked to travel Club Europe from this airport on st August No dedicated checkin no priority security no business lounge I managed to find a quiet place to sit upstairs in the bar area the outside seating area was closed After about minutes an airport employee entered the bar area to inform all of us who were seated there that the area should have been cordoned off and that we had to move downstairs Apparently this was because the floor was unstable We were told there were plenty of seats at the bottom of the stairs so we went downstairs to sit which was directly underneath the unstable floor Very odd and very dangerous I would have thought I got the distinct impression that the jobsworth employee just did not want to patrol the upstairs area so he moved us all downstairs Because of the danger of the upstairs floor caving in on us we all moved to the main seating area in a windowless room which was extremely busy and required some considerable searching to find empty seats The area soon became very busy without a seat to be had All those people sitting so close to each other in a room without a window and all I could think about was Social Distancing Before long my flight was called and I moved to the boarding gate Here we all waited whilst the ground staff went into overdrive because they spotted an elderly woman who was reliant on oxygen and who had a tank strapped to her back I overheard the member of staff ask of another about how the lady got through check in and security without being challenged about her oxygen I too questioned this and wondered how easy it would be for a terrorist to get through the airport This thought soon dissipated when a door suddenly opened and an airport employee shouted Theyre ready for you now at which point there was a mad rush for the door We are all so used to polite announcements made over the tannoy that to have someone open a door and shout an instruction was quite refreshing not In all a shambles from start to finish I dont think I have ever been through such an unprofessional airport in my life And Ive been through many airports in some of the most back of beyond places in the world

Faleolo airport in Apia Samoa is a small airport We found immigration customs etc very quick and efficient as well as baggage handling At the moment the airport is not really pretty to look at but a new terminal is being built which should be spectacular when completed Its really refreshing to be able to walk through the airport on arrival departure and not be forced to navigate through a giant shopping mall like at Sydney The airport has done duty free shops which you are free to go into or not go into rather than having to go through them to get in out of passport control a few small food shops reasonably priced and a bar Parking is Samoan Tala Staff at the airport are friendly welcoming and helpful The only negative side is that there is no air conditioning outside the security areas and check in is a bit uncomfortable when its humid

Faleolo is the international airport for Samoa located hour from Apia on Upolu island A pain for late night early morning arrivals and departures but conveniently close to the ferries for Savaiii Apolima and Manono islands Used Faleolo airport this last weekend as a business class passenger First pax off the plane to a stretch limousine awaiting at bottom of steps Together with police guard and band true but alas this VIP welcome was not for me but for the Samoan Head of State seated across from me on the plane However no pomp and ceremony for me once inside this basic airport Immigration was slowmethodical but courteous Baggage claim and clearance even slower On return check in handled efficiently by Polynesian No lounge facilities at Faleolo provided for premium passengers only a govt lounge for VIPs Landside toilets are derelict and filthy Better to hold your water until you get airside One rung above Port Moresby airport in PNG which itself IS one big toilet Immigration at APW outbound even slower than inbound due to a disorganised pax on an Air Pacific flight also departing at am am Once airside an overpriced cafe and dutyfree but at least theres aircon On the bright side this could be a really good airport with a just little attention to cleanliness from the Samoan Airport Authority such a contrast to the country itself Samoa is kept spick and span by its people Note that you have to pay WST departure tax at ANZWestpac banks on departure not incl in ticketNo big deal but for this amount of money equiv USD airport could at least keep the loos clean

There have been a number of improvements at the Faleolo international airport but I still cannot get over how expensive duty free products are I travel to and from Samoa at least three times a year and I have yet to purchase anything from duty free Its just so much more cheaper at other international airports even taking into consideration the rate of the Samoan tala in foreign countries Airport taxes are just so ridiculously high its unbelievable Look at the departure tax for instance I remember when they lifted the tax to and justified it to the public by claiming that children under a certain age did not have to pay tax My husband and I have two children an eighteen year old and a year old we still have to pay which calculates to more much more than the four of us would have to pay to get out of Auckland International Airport even taking into consideration the Samoan tala exchange rate And I need not elaborate on the many luxuries times over that are available at the Auckland international airport and NOT available at the Faleolo airport Once the tax hits the mark you might as well include it in the ticket like everyone else around the world whose departure tax is over We pay tax on our tickets and at the airport why not just put them together and leave them on the ticket That would be one huge improvement and less hassle when flynig out of faleolo

On arrival into APW in the evening heat arrived into immigration waiting for minutes as there were no immigration officers to process our docs as if they were on lunch This was a bit of a shock Apart from that dilemma baggage was swift on the conveyer belt pretty fast Custom officers very polite efficient Faleolo airport is very open spacious In a hot humid climate tiles are laid through the entire airport There are no main entrance doors to the terminal as it is one open place but very modern indeed Departure lounge quite nice with the Tropical Pacific feel to it a big beautiful bar dominates the one huge departure lounge This would be the only place together with the PH J Class lounge is airconditioned

Disgusted again at lack of any progress in this absolute dump of an airport Arrival into usual passport queue and gates still not working Been traveling through here for years and surely the management ought to have been sacked by now Arrivals hall had marginally improved Departure was awful again overcrowded and absolutely filthy catering area and toilets disgusting Passport control had gates working out of Booths closed and queues horrendous Holding area before flight filthy and gate staff unfriendly as always Faro how long must we all suffer this before you look at new leadership for what could be a great airport

The queues for immigration on arrival at local were long and disorganised no proper queuing system with snake line zig zag queue organisation A freeforall until you reach the short queuing system near the immigration booths none of the egates were working and no information The odd staff member looked disinterested and bored On departure the queues after security for immigration through B gate were very long hour wait with no organisation or communication the only staff member was calling for Irish passport holders who were able to jump the queue as they had EU passports I understand that the nonEU passport holders will have to pass relatively slowly through this process but to have gates with manned dedicated to EU passport holders and only manned for nonEU passport holders smacks of discrimination against the Brits on a massive scale There were flights between and on the departures board in full view of us in the queueing line all going to UK destinations I dont suppose my familys decision to change our holiday destination to a country that gives us the impression of welcoming us will change anything but it is a great shame as the Portuguese people we encountered on holiday were delightful and would be very concerned that the airport authorities are sending out all the wrong messages If the consensus amongst the people queuing alongside us are typical it will not be long before the owners of restaurants bars cafes taxis hotels etc notice a decline that will not be of their making The beneficiaries will be such businesses in destinations such as Turkey and Greece

An absolute joke Standing here in a queue that goes on forever passport gates open not an airport worker in sight what a kip This is the biggest joke of an airport I have ever stood in and to top it off there is no AC working Do they honestly think people will put up with this Well I will never go through Faro nor indeed Portugal ever again

Waited almost an hour to get through passport control Holiday season One guy for three airplanes People starting arguing as different planes landed and people were shunted into two lanes by some airport worker in a high vis jacket Exact same experience for my daughter who arrived the following day What a poor way to be welcomed to the Algarve Get your house in order Not good enough

Northwest Arkansas Regional Airport may be the best smallmedium airport in the United States In spite of being a regional airport in a small state XNA has direct flights to New York DC San Francisco and LAX This unparalleled service is ideal for business travelers and those making connections to international flights Most of the planes that fly out of XNA are regional jets CRJ or Embraer but they fly to most of the countrys major hubs The ground services are also above and beyond what is typical of an airport this size with a large brewpub and highquality furnishings I am definitely impressed and would fly from XNA again
Totally not as bad as all the reviews had us expecting No printed boarding pass needed They just gave us one Ryanair No long waiting time Only thing too cold and no smoking area after security check

This airport is one of the most weirdly inept airports I have ever been to even for a rd world country The Moroccan style cafe we waited in initially in the main airport lounge presecurity check was open but completely unstaffed for a couple of hours until finally they closed Whats up with that Then at the security check in they took from me and tossed my silver plated miniature forks that I had bought as souvenirs as well as a miniature metal fork that I got on a Lufthansa flight on the plane all of these had prongs no longer than cm when up to cm are allowed and I have previously passed through at least airport security checks all over the world without any problem with my metal Lufthansa fork last time as recently as a week ago on my way to Fez Clearly their security staff are illinformed and need retraining Inside the departures waiting area despite being in Morocco all the prices were shown only in euros which makes no sense since this isnt even Europe but Africa This made it really hard what to choose in order to spend the maximum of my last Dirhams For the boarding then even though the big screen would read boarding open it didnt provide a gate number and the guy staffing one of the gates didnt know either If he doesnt know who would Bizarre experience overall

This airport is chaos and a mess There is little or no information regarding procedures at the airport Even though you hold your pre printed boarding pass they require you to still use a check in desk first even though you are only using carry on Security are supposed to stop anyone from getting to passport control who doesnt have the official stamp on their boarding pass but they dont so you queue for ages for passport control only to be sent back to Check in So it makes pre printing the boarding pass a joke but you have to do it because thats what Ryanair want you to do Queues are long and slow for passport control but I suppose thats the case for many airports these days Security is pretty thorough although your not required to remove liquids from your carry on Gate staff were however very efficient especially enforcing queuing prior to boarding Theres not much once your at the gate area a couple of shops a lounge and a prayer area Its quite a small terminal so space is tight and if you e got two flights departing close together youll have to fight for a seat Theres free wifi at the airport but be aware you only get hour minutes over a two day period So bottom line is if your a regular at this airport and you know their particular requirements then its not that bad but for first time visitors its s nightmare

A rather small airport serving Firenze I used the airport in the winter season so imagine it during the busy summer season Theres bus boarding only and max small gates It has a abundance of dutyfree shops and food beverages counters Prices are reasonable Staff is friendly and efficiently working

Florence is a joke not an airport Passengers are boarded on a bus under the sun with no air conditioning and kept there for minutes The same happens during winter where passengers are kept on the bus for long time with the bus doors open and the engine on so you basically breathe the exhaust gases Poor airport services complete the picture

Not often I have felt so embarrassed as a Florentine living abroad on how my city welcomes its visitors The luggage collection is a pain as with most Italian airports and not only but the worse is the indifferent and arrogant attitude of the people working there To top it all is the transfer from the Terminal tiny and overcrowded to the car rental It is a couple of meters but cannot be reached by foot especially not with heavy luggage and therefore there is a shuttle Instead of driving in a loop one waits and waits and waits till finally the driver shows up with cellphone in his hands while driving While the meanwhile accumulated masses of people try to squeeze in the tiny bus unapologetically the driver continues the phone conversation and lights up a cigarette Even when after seconds the bus is filled with people eager to finally move on the departure for the mins ride is after the driver finishes his cigarette Dont think the option of taking a taxi is any better out of the times it takes an hour to get one as the line is horribly long if you must be in the centre take the tramconnection it costs and takes mins I have traveled through the whole world and Florence Airport definitely is in the top ten of the worst

This airport is woefully short in filling the needs of travelers It is understaffed and when I was there all of the automatic check baggage kiosks were not working I waiting in one of the very long lines there with no announcements or information You are I strutted to strive at the airport hrs in advance for an international flight I arrived at am for an boarding but the check in counter for my TAP flight did not open until ish For a major tourist destination this airport is one of the worst I have encountered

I was having one of the worst times of my life and I went up to customer service balling my eyes out simply asking if there was a phone booth near The customer service attendants that day were a nightmare they hate doing their jobs I simply asked for a phone booth and a man pointed to the right and told me there was one over there with no directions I came back and he was gone It was only to get me to leave no type of humanity or empathy My flight also left even though we were there extremely early like six hours before our flight because they didnt have enough people for covid testing But there was this one security girl officer who was so sweet to me I even told her god bless you because she helped me by giving me saran wrap when my suitcase burst open I love Italy but that experience was a nightmare

I was returning to Madrid from Florence on June This was an utter nightmare First the checkin took nearly hours There was only person at the counter and the queue was moving very slowly At the stipulated time of boarding and gate closure there was no sense of urgency at all and still a very long line Secondly when it was finally my turn they assured me that the plane would wait for everyone ie a delay which was not even announced to anyone at all thirdly the flight was delayed significantly because of this long queue Fourthly by the time we landed in Madrid everyone rushed to luggage belt as announced on the plane and waited like fools for hour only for an Iberia staff to appear to usher us to the baggage claim counter There was no explanation of what was going on After queueing for hour we finally learnt from the baggage claim service counter staff that the plane had taken off from Florence airport with not a single piece of luggage Those with trackers on the luggage have been noted that the luggage is in Florence airport and yet nothing is being updated yet till today hours later I hope you realize what a complete nightmare this is everyone has important and valuable items in the suitcases and to think we even paid extras to check in our luggage because we were told the flight was full To all reading this please never fly off from Florence airport and also be careful about flying via Iberia from Florence airport There is also no way to contact customer service at Florence airport only the tourist office picks up the phone nor is there any platform or email to lodge a formal complaint or feedback This is why there is probably hardly any improvement because they just ignore everything No amount of compensation can make up for the time inconvenience fatigue anguish and emotional stress that something like this is causing Luggage delays do happen but if the plane knowingly took off without any luggage they could have at least informed the passengers if not at the start then at the end of the flight we waited like idiots at the luggage belt what a sheer waste of resourcesfuel

So I write this review mainly as some form of coping with the situation my family is in We flew into Florence airport days ago Our luggage was no where to be found The lost and found office was an absolute joke under staffed and fairly rude We were given some paperwork with a promise of a text updating the progress of finding my familys luggage Three days later we have received zero communication You cant call because it is apparently open for call for hour a day Our routine is to Drive to the airport and wait in line with to people with one person trying to help them We did find of the bags We are still missing my father in laws heart medicine When we mentioned the urgency of that situation the person told him to go to a doctor here We have been looking forward to this vacation for about a year and it is now ruined by shear laziness and incompetence We have found out that not one person on our flight from Chicago to Florence got their luggage the day they landed Please do not use this airport It is completely unprofessional and a complete disaster
Terminal does not have a single chair to sit on People sit and lie down on the floor giving the terminal the aspect of a refugee camp Not acceptable for a large international airport

Our flight arrived on time but the airport was unable to receive the plane We had sit again and wait in the plane Then they told us that they had no resources to unload the baggages from the plane and we had to wait another hour Finally there are way more travelers than what the customs could manage and we had to wait in the side and then we were moved to the line Because of that we lost our connecting flight We had hours between arrival and departure which is normally more than enough for a so small airport The airport is accepting much more flight than they can manage and the customers are who suffer only The airport attendants did not care at all In consequence we had to stay the night at the airport outside the security area with nothing to eat and no where comfortable where to seat They were not willing to lay anything because they said it was a uncontrollable situation We booked the flight a month ago so they knew how many flights were arriving it was not an uncontrollable surprise If I can control it Ill never fly through Fort Lauderdale airport again

What a Zoo For Jet Blue Terminal it was a minute wait for a kiosk for checked bag minute wait to drop bag Then TSA precheck and regular are in the same line for F Concourse And regular line is backed up to easily before where you enter TSA PreCheck No waiting at TSA Precheck line Terminal TSA has the entrance to TSA Precheck blocked off so that you have to wait in the regular line for minutes before you can get to clear or TSA Precheck entrance

Fort LauderdaleHollywood International Airport FLL is a total shambles Unbelievable waiting times to park the plane to access the luggage area and another two hours for customs and immigration It really is a disgrace to treat visitors like this I travel a lot globally and this is much worse than countries the US really does not want to be compared to In Houston two weeks ago this thing ran extremely smoothly

One of the TSA Security Guys on C were extremely rude this morning Lack of proper communication was a huge issue Please tell me politely to not take my small electronics out of my carry on bag which has always been the procedure before instead of yelling the words so quickly that I did not have enough reaction time to process what was being said Patience and kind words were all that I needed Please work on this

Two staff members were extremely rude this morning Lack of proper communication was a huge issue Please tell me politely to not take my small electronics out of my carry on bag which has always been the procedure before instead of yelling the words so quickly that I did not have enough reaction time to process what was being said Patience and kind words were all that I needed Please work on this

Staff were extremely rude Every part from ticketing to security to boarding all spoke down to us customers Very disappointed in the continued disrespect Security were also beyond slow I can appreciate good security but the airport wasnt busy at all and it took forever as they kept just taking their time

I think everyone can count on more than two hands the amount of rude experiences at an airport that theyve had but todays stood out more than usual My boyfriend and I set our backpacks down after having gone through TSA already to go grab a bagel which couldnt have been more than minutes When we came back to our seats there was a guard standing near our stuff with a dog We didnt think anything of it and then he approaches my boyfriend to belittle him in front of other people that you cant leave your bag unattended and it makes people unsettled He went on for about minutes and then told us some other people may be coming to talk to us All for a backpack What is TSA for if youre still worried about my bag Maybe this airports needs to put signs up saying not to leave bags unattended before they belittle their customers for their unwritten rules Attached is a picture of the dangerous scary backpacks

We are under a pandemic and I am wearing a mask and gloves respecting ft distance Workers at security didnt want us to maintain feet and told me they didnt care if we all got sick one guy called me sick girl and said you decided to fly you should have stayed home This is awful and disrespectful Security needs to be more aware of the part they play in helping keep people safe Otherwise they can stay home

This airport is clean and welcoming The problem I recognize is the preponderance of dogs not being carried or placed in a designated kennel During my last visit I saw an emotional support animal lying on the floor in the TSA queue Three dogs on leashes were seen at the Jet Blue gate Announcements about dog rules and regulations are made repeatedly but are ignored Signage would be helpful enforcement is needed

We dropped off and picked up twice in March and went to cell lot to wait Parking there is a mess Cars are parked everywhere they shouldnt be and people cant move or get out Has no one ever checked this problem out Wish I would of known I could of taken pictures and sent in I will definitely next time

Not Verified Fort Wayne airport is so busy trying to save dollars they have created the worst customer service Ive experienced in my entire life flying all over this country and several others I will go to any other city even if it means driving hours out of my way to avoid flying in or out of this airport They have all their counter employees going out and helping in the loading departments and because of it they leave before the designated time and then lie right to the face of customers saying No we were here until far after it was time for you to be here The security guards screamed at my entire family we had children with us telling us we should have been there sooner you were late They have done this to every professional friend we have They just dont want to have enough staff to do the job so they fail to provide for those of us spending thousands of dollars for flights out of their airport Well never again

A nice airport except for the parking charges Its highway robbery I was charged for days of parking in the Short Term Parking lot Evidently the word Short Term Parking means a short walk to terminal and not the length of time you plan to leave your vehicle there I would encourage everyone not to park your vehicles at the airport for any length of time Otherwise you will be robbed by the airport I know I will never do it again Shame one you FWA
Still a bit of a dump The airport expansionmodernization project first promised for then is now scheduled to be completed in and even that may be in doubt since a new bidding process may be required

Still no noticeable changes to increase capacity or comfort in anticipation of the World Cup No decent hotel options anywhere nearby Options to get to the citys beach areas where most hotels are located are taxis and crowded public busses plus a limited number of hotel shuttles

Clean and modern when it was inaugurated maybe years ago this airport is showing its age The large arching windows meant to let in light into the main ticketingcheckin areas are perpetually filthy Checkin area usually not too crowded especially with the de facto demise of Varig Airlines and de jure demise of Air Madrid but lines can vary widely by airline and time of day There is one line to get into the boarding area and at times the airport folks will now allow you in until a certain time which makes no sense since you will just be sitting in the boarding area Pretty boring airport for a long wait Food and shopping alternatives are limited and nearly nonexistent once you go through security Competency of airport staff uneven at best Wait for luggage can vary widely but usually not too bad I have arrived only on domestic flights so cannot comment on immigrationcustoms procedures I departed once on an international flight with domestic stops en route and the only difference for boarding was having to take off my shoes and show my passport

Mainly domestic airport serving the Brazilian side of Iguassu Falls Busy airport with a air bridges and some remote stands Shopping opportunities as you walk from the gate to Baggage Reclaim Baggage Reclaim is on the ground level and has main baggage carousels Domestic arrival so no Customs or Passport Checks Small and busy Arrivals area with parking directly opposite Small but efficient airport

The agents are grumpy on July after a hour flight I went to gate which leads to B to check my bags When my turn came they decided to accept people with special needs and let us wait The lady was not nice she gave us orders as if we were a herd of animals No smiles just cocky looks and sighs as if she hates what she does or hates the people she sees After min of waiting they sent us to other gates I chose door the gentleman who was watching the scanner machine asked me something in English but I didnt understand him well he yelled at me saying you dont understand english and he sighed like it was the end of the world What arrogance and what unprofessionalism I have often heard that the service in Frankfurt was bad but this time I experienced it Please teach your agents to respect people We pay money to travel and not for free I am very sorry you are losing customers at this rate

Poorly guided transfer for incoming flight from elsewhere and then transferring from Z gates to DTW Dropped off at tarmac then bus shuttles changes then airport security checks Almost missed my flight Do not take Lufthansa or transfer through Frankfurt airport
This airport is either totally understaffed or totally mismanaged The security line took hours on the arrival we waited more then one hour on the ground Avoid this airport if you can

The conditions of the toilets are horrible Also they have a single duty free if you can call it this way and there is almost nothing Empty shelfs dirty bathrooms the only thing that is nice are the employees You cant get out to smoke only if you will pass the security every time and thats it The most horrible airport where I had been in my entire life

Dreadful service from start to finish Staff unfriendly and unhelpful Toilets were extremely dirty Was there early in the morning but dont know when they were last cleaned Avoid using this airport if you can Would not recommend at all Absolutely no redeeming features

While the departure experience is improving thanks to new scanning equipment the rest is still the same as ever long ways poor signposting ridiculous prices for bad food and worse service After walking for a kilometre was surprised to find the epassport gates working for once for those with nonEU passports only two counters were manned Waited mins for baggage delivery at am Glad no customs control this time

Arrival from IAH took an hour to get our luggage Sign counted down expected in and then just saying delayed please be patience hour Rest of the airport is kinda under construction with leaking ceilings mouse traps and blue fences There use to be a moving walkway between terminal and the long distance railway station gone Out with the convenience and service in with more greedy retail space
The area looks is not designed for such a huge passenger number some of the staffs are rude and unfriendly The terminal has a nice overview of the taxiways and runways

Possibly the worst airport transit experience you can imagine I had hours to transit and made it to my gate minutes before the gate closed First there was a long line for the one shuttle to bring you from B to A gates Then there were multiple baggage cars and vans blocking the shuttle route Once we got to the other side of the terminal they made us go up to the Z concourse and walk through to the other end for yet another crazy long line at immigration where there were only agents The signs were confusing since the arrows pointing to the A gates led to a staff member blocking the escalator to the gates saying that there is no way to get to the gates from here you must go to the other end None of the staff seemed to care that many of us were about to miss our flights One staff member responded sorry I dont know when asked where A gates where and another staff member said just miss your flight take the next one when people were complaining about the long line at immigration Several of the moving walkways were also out of commission

I understand that we need security in this day and age but having got off the plane and going through four to five security check points is that really necessary What I dont understand is going through security again you have to throw away your water bottles why You just got off the plane and making a connection not like you have exited the airport and have done reentry On top of all these just going to your gate there is another security check point Its kind of ridiculous to go through many check points Have some common sense and think how to better check the folks getting off the plane I would never recommend anyone to use Frankfurt as a transit airport Talk to one of the agent and she said composing Lufthansa management Lufthansa being star alliance partner does not even honor the other airline statuses What good it is For future I am going to make an every effort to avoid this ridiculous airport

Lufthansa flight late from Madrid They unloaded us to buses and we had a slow transportation to the terminal Many people had connecting flights The new gate was B a very long walk from where the bus deposited us Very unfriendly and unhelpful staff in terminal Very slow and mean customs officer I made my connection to SQ with minutes to spare a sweaty mess before a hour flight I have another hour flight to follow the hour flight

Brand spanking new airport Built and operated by Turkish airport company Touts and money changers etc all kept outside wich is good Landing departure USD each tax payment is a real pain and slow and unpleasant experience Rude airport and security staff Departure immigration officer ultra rude and very low on skill and job knowledge Facilities all clean and fresh Restaurant and shopping still very limited Business class lounge is good for that part of the world No beer no ice no sugar free drinks any where in the airport All things considered its a nice little airport Staff and officials need some serious training and attitude improvement Signage is bad Communication is worse Why not tell people to pay all taxes on arrival or on arrival at airport not once you are past the security check points

Possibly the worst airport of an African capital And I know very many Arrival are pretty much okay given the extremely poor infrastructure But departures are a true mess Apart from being exceptionally far from the capital on the contrary of most African airports that are usually very close with a pretty bad road it is not only extremely old and small but also extremely dirty Staff are plentiful but only busy discussing between themselves The tiny business lounge which was confirmed as opened when I checked in was in fact closed for my hours waiting for no reason other than the staff had something else to do according to of the local shopkeepers The only seats are most uncomfortable steel benches Loudspeakers are impossible to understand I have been trotting all around the African continent for tens of years so I am comparing apples to apples The sun everything in one word shameful

Few improvements to report Checkin is still slow and chaotic There are a few more air conditioners inside so it is not quite so hot There have been recent problems with theft from checked luggage Some reports even suggest that bags had been cut open Definitely do not leave money or valuables in luggage And do not let airport staff see if there is anything valuable in there Business class passengers have a better experience because the initial queuing is reduced and the lounge provided some good food

I have been using the airport almost every month during the last year Some improvement in arrival procedures has been made There are not usually long queues at immigration and baggage arrives quite quickly For departures the entrance hall is still busy and too hot but if you take a fan and pay a porter you can survive A couple of positives the duty free shop remains good and cheap and the food in the upstairs barrestaurant is good The check in area has been improved with modern counters Hopefully this will reduce the queuing time in the entrance hall once it is fully up and running

Much better than it used to be they seem to have clamped down on the baggage handlers and general hangers on trying to extract dollars from you on the way in On the way out no real problems aside from a few panhandllers trying to take a last opportunity to rip you off Dont miss the duty free shop it looks awful from the outside but is really well stocked and cheap

Back again at the end of March This time not such a good experience On the way in baggage was late because the handlers could not be bothered to do their job On the return we suffered a very long wait in the extremely hot entrance hall This is caused by the very slow and beauracratic check in procedures The air conditioning in the main part of the airport is proving totally inadequate and many units do not work Some of the staff are quite unhelpful Sierra Leone needs tourism but no respectable tour company would let their customers suffer this

This airport has improved significantly over the last years It was badly damaged during the troubles The only facilities were a partly destroyed hanger Now the main terminal has been refurbished it is quite respectable Arrival is easy enough You will need to be firm with the baggage handlers They have been clamped down on recently but they will still try there best to relieve you of a few If you let them one will carry your bags to the door another for a few more feet etc Just say no and try not to look as if it is your first visit Once you have got your bags you have to visit the customs bench You will now need transport to Freetown which is the other side of a large estuary There are helicopters a ferry and a hovercraft Take the Paramount helicopter the other two take too long and are unreliable It is cheap on my recent visit You may have to change this into the local Leones before buying the ticket There is an exchange office which gives respectable rates The helicopter departure area is the old hanger that used to be the main terminal It is dirty and hot so try to get the first helicopter These are old but reliable Russian MIs You will arrive at the Mammy Yoko heliport Here you will most likely be met by your local agency or whoever you are visiting If not local taxis are available A trip to most parts of Freetown should cost no more than Le If you do not have accommodation booked go to the Cape Sierra Hotel or Bintumani Hotel which are very close On the way back the helicopters leave about hours before the time of departure You then wait outside the Lungi terminal for an hour or more before suffering the long and bureaucratic check in procedure This is typically African and can take an hour The main lounge is air conditioned There is also a very good duty free shop and a reasonable restaurant upstairs You will probably not be hassled by airport officials for bribes unlike other countries in the region

Freetown Lungi International Airport is a small airport terminal building It recieves very few flights the majority being international It has so positive attributes like no congestion speedy check in and checkout A hotel is conveniently located near it There is a duty free shop and restaurant There is also a VIP Lounge for the elite and other first class passengers Beware that the airport is very small It needs renovations and a series of expansions effort due to its small size The government is in the works of expanding it to accomodate the international passengers

The airport is very small with just about million passengers a year The few checkin desks are enough service is fast no queues travel agencys most big car rental companys have a desk and restaurants and visitors terrace with a nice view are available

A typical Ryanair airport Small and miles from anywhere although perhaps suitable for the Alps and skiing access or unless you have relatives nearby However it meant that from the plane to the car hire desk was about metres and we were on our way less than minutes after landing If you need a train the station is literally metres from the terminal door Its not an architectural gem the seating is limited and hard but it has a cafe and a shop and its efficient and has what you need The staff were friendly and allowed us to board first on our return to the UK as my wife had a broken hand in plaster As long as the plane is on time it does the job well

Going through security I had a pen in handbag which caused problem even though I have travelled with this for years and had no problem before I didnt mind being stopped for it security is paramountbut the rudeness of the staff there was unforgivable Made to feel bad as I did not understand what was required basically through security once more Just grunted at and very offhand Chap was going on a break it turned out so that was his problem Woman who took over very slightly better Happy going through procedure as should be questionedbut attitude needs sortedafter all we are their bread and butter Politeness goes a long way My scoring only really went down because of securitycafe staff werent friendly either Jet departure on boarding chap was exceptional really customer focused and friendlyperfect for the job
Ryanair made us wait an hour in a queue with a passengers who had large luggage just to receive printed ticket for visa checks Annoying not fair We were really dissatisfied and disappointed

Terrible rude staff especially with special assistance I travel with my disabled son and when we arrived at at the desk for check in the woman who served us was so rude My son isnt an ambulatory wheelchair user but he walks slowly and we would be happy to get help to the gate She said if he needs special assistance he needs to sit in a wheelchair otherwise she is going to cancel it I tried to explain to her that he is fine without a wheelchair but she kept repeating herself not accepting any other answer My son started to get very anxious and nervous because he thought he needs to be taken to hospital by using wheelchair and finally she said if he doesnt want using wheelchair chair he isnt disabled person Does she have the medical education to comment on this I tried to stay calm because my son was stressful enough so I didnt want make him more feeling stressed anyway she cancelled special assistance for him The airport staff having this job only because so many tourists coming to visit Fuerteventura so they should respect that instead of being horrible and making people feel like an unwanted intruder on their wonderful island Nowhere else have we been treated so horribly like at this airport

I am a non ambulatory wheelchair user accompanied by my husband After prompt check in I was obliged to wait at least minutes with other disabled before being guided to another place in departures I was told that I would be contacted at this point at least half an hour before departure We went immediately to a refreshment area to buy a much needed coffee but were sought out by an attendant who told us that we need to be at the departure gate I told the attendant that I must first use the disabled toilet and was pressured by him that I needed to be quick What a joke I have never been in such a badly equipped disabled toilet and discovered to my horror that there were no fixed grab rails to help me stand to pull myself together Only one wobbly drop rail I opened the toilet door knowing that I could pull myself up using the door frame Fortunately a lovely attendant was there and realising my dilemma she helped me to pull myself together I have never been so mortified in my life but she was very sweet The impatient attendant was waiting for me in the public area On the verge of tears my husband calmed me as we followed the attendant to the departure gate where we waited for another minutes It the door of the airplane I was transferred to a small loading chair and was dragged on board amongst the confusion with other walking passengers We have used this airport more than and always rated it fairly but now a recently disabled amputee I am disgusted with the whole departure experience

Absolutely terrible customer service Got frisked twice and kept having to go to the back and queue again for the privilege All my of things removed so fast still on the tray to another place I didnt know whether I was coming or going My belongings were gone and I couldnt find them Luckily I asked a man where they could be and they had been taken to lost and found My car keys phone purse tablet and Apple Watch Much to my horror I was spoken to like a fool and he demanded evidence that they were my belongings I managed to convince him to let me have my phone so I could prove they were mine

I am disabled and had just been given a cancer diagnosis by my doctor on the phone whilst in Fuerteventura I had one of the last two flights that night and had been ill all week I had mentioned this to the team and said I was very weak as a result and needed a bit of extra help My flight was due to depart at and by I found myself in the special assistance area with one other couple who were on the other plane leaving at the same time members of the special assistance team came over and I asked if someone was there for me I was told to calm down and that I had to wait my turn I had asked in a low voice and was perfectly calmly I waited another mins and when I looked there were other people in the airport cleaners mins until my flight left and no staff or any way of contacting them Getting distressed and being in pain the cleaner helped me by going to find someone Last call for my flight had been announced twice already When the members of staff arrived they were so rude to me I couldnt believe it I asked why I had been left and they just laughed at me it got heated and she stopped pushing me and said Do you want to walk I mean really Thats what you threaten disabled customers with when they are unhappy with service I tried to get out of the chair as by now I was so upset and felt so belittled by these women but she pushed the chair so I couldnt catching my foot and dragging it

Very pleasantly surprised by this airport especially after our home airport of East Midlands Arrived to find airbridges to the aircraft so no busses or walking across the tarmac baggage didnt take long and easily found a taxi for the short journey to our hotel When we departed we checked the bags into a check in area with no one queueing we were a bit but only a bit early and had a drink outside before going through security This was a bit confusing got turned away from one security queue as it was for families could have been a bit better sign posted The actual proper security was just behind the check in desks again this could have been made a little more obvious But once through the actual departure area was vast spacious and light with outside areas at least childrens play areas lots of different eating choices and quite a few duty free options Didnt try any eating places so cant comment on prices Plenty of places to sit and wandering down to the end of the hall there were some deserted and very quiet parts All in all very pleasant and far better than most in holiday destinations

When I arrived at this airport from incheon the immigration lines were long It took me more than an hour to get out of the airport I headed to Incheon a few days later Security and immigration was actually fine although I found the facilities a little old There were plenty of places to shop and relax but I wished that there were more food choices Overall this is a small but functional airport

Never have I been to an airport with staff so keen to help and so lovely After a baggage mishap at Shanghai Airport I arrived at Fukoaka knowing that my bag was not on the flight that I was on Upon arrival immigration was a breeze even with a British passport and I went straight to the arrivals desk where four people immediately helped me They were so kind and helpful and sorted out my problem immediately They reassured me that everything would be ok and even gave me a yen note to pay for the delivery of my luggage to where I was staying somewhere around hours away from Fukoaka The whole airport experience was wonderful in comparison to the rude service I received at Shanghai Pu Dong Airport Thank you to everyone who helped out a traveler who had lost his baggage

Upon arrival moved swiftly thru immigration The luggages for all the passengers did not arrive some malfuntion was announced it took minutes for the luggage to finally arrive No announcement during that time There are no seats in the areas so every one sat in th floor waiting Upon departure also check in and immigration moved very fast Went to the Fukuoka lounge very spacious but very limited food Soup Noodles and bread

Arrived in FUK on Nov and departed Nov fromto Shanghai Arrival was a breeze Baggage reclaim immigration and custom clearance were fast and smooth Staff efficient and smiling Departure was terrible Only Xray machine for all check in bags from flights of pax resulting in long lines looping around the entire check in island Waited mins before bags scanned and allowed to check in Then carry on bags had to subject to another check with long lines again Another mins wasted standing in queue This was clearly quite unsatisfactory and a pity as the airport was otherwise very clean modern great looking with helpful and friendly staff

Nice airport pleasant staff and security excellent Poor check in resources for a BA flight to Heathrow took ages for them to set up I think due to lack of staff Lead lady did the work of people Lounge nice but on the basic side but I expected this One staff member officious Then the horror of having to wait after the gate was called before they would open passport control which was a dour experience Then a wait to be allowed in the gate Same overworked lady managing on her own

I was a disabled passenger on the Tui flight departure date which eventually took off All Madeirian staff at the airport were polite very helpful in particular the disabled Assistance staff The poor weather affecting the departure will not deter my family from coming back to Funchal All the very best for the new year

I could not buy any gluten free food at the airport I ended up with a big bag of crisps Sem Gluten the previous shop told me none of the crisps where GF and she sold the same ones I bought It was an experience I will not be repeating the last time I visit Madeira It is disgraceful that a person is left hungry by greedy cafe owners

Their covid testing team do a terrible job I felt my brain tickled and stabbed It is sharp its stabbing I cant even really describe the feeling Ended up with an intense taste of blood in my throat My legs of their own accord not controlled by my brain shoot up and start kicking as if Im flailing as if Im in the electric chair If its done correctly it shouldnt be excruciatingly painful as it is in my case on both times I arrived in this airport this summer I would prefer to be punched in the nose while leaving the aircraft than going through this again Both my mother and father felt the same My question is who are the people doing these tests Be careful

Going through security screening was a nightmare I was told I was an explosive threat after having my hands screened twice and producing a positive result twice They said this can happen to people who have used certain body lotionscreams medications touched certain items ie flowers I was then escorted very indiscreetly by armed police officers to a separate room where I was searched my hand luggage searched and I was questioned After all this I had to go through the whole process again security hands screened positive result by which time I was very distressed A terrifying experience for a year old woman I do understand the need to keep air passengers safe but this screening technology is clearly not efficient or sufficient if it can be triggered by ingredients in creams and lotions I will never return to Madeira

TSA Combination locks changed by baggage handlers at Madeira airport My cabin cases were put in the hold by easyJet at Bristol Airport I handed the two cases to easyJet staff just before going up the steps when boarding as they were concerned there was not enough overhead locker space No problem Ive done this many times before When picking up the hire car at Funchal airport I needed to access the cabin cases only to find my combination lock numbers had been changed The hire car reps managed to open the one case but the lock on the other had to be broken open Apparently this is not unusual at Funchal this was the fifth time they had experienced it These mindless pranksters should be sacked A great start to the holiday Has anyone else experienced this problem

The signs at Fuzhou airport are quite helpful since available in both English and Chinese The border security counter has a rating system where you can rate them based on your experience If you dont speak Chinese it may be slightly difficult to get around Queue was quite long and it took quite long to find your baggage However it was an OK experience The staff was very friendly and friendlier than I had expected

The Internet connection is timed to minutes and so bad mobile is far superior theres not enough seats and those that are there are extremely uncomfortable hard plastic with dividers No quiet zones low temperature makes you catch cold and then theres the staff The service is forced and makes you feel bad for even ordering anything and dont try resting at any of the restaurants better chairs theyll call security even in the middle of the night Reason Well who really knows maybe they like seeing people resting on the cold floors since theres not enough seats Theres even a dedicated announcement just to remind there are thieves If you can avoid especially if you have to lay over pay a bit more and choose one you know to be peoplefriendly

I am partially disabled with restricted mobility I have metal in my leg and hip following reconstructive surgery As a frequent traveller I know I set off the security metal archway detector therefore I know what to expect and ensure I carry no additional material which might exasperate my situation Noting some airports adjust the sensitivity of these detectors So back to the Gdask experience Having detected the archway I am directed to remove my footwear My trainers are clothplastic no metal This is the default situation and very annoying It is obviously not my shoes that cause the alarm Of course there are no aids by example a chair and I am forced to comply or no fly So no shoes but despite my explanations I again alert the archway I did tell you that would happen me to the suspicious security person now a physical search Remember I am partially disabled Stand on one leg and show me your sole Im years of age and there is no standing support aid I am then very roughly treated by a security thug who has the compassion and intellect of a slug Frankly this was probably my worst experience over the years Shame on you Polish Civil Aviation Authority Treat partially disabled travelers with restricted movement with more respect and compassion

Airport Security very bad was a big queue take as more than hour to pass through no speaking English shouting and screaming all the time with out no reason They dont let us priorities to catch our flight and we miss our flights Straight away they remove us from airport with out any help during to rescheduled our flight down stairs

Health and safety rules are very loosely followed I was marked for a random check the one where they check your hands for traces of explosives The female security worker was not wearing her mask and I asked her to put it on before approaching me Since then she was plain rude to me and barked orders The two hand sanitizers that I could locate were empty When I looked around practically none of the staff were wearing their masks correctly even though it was crowded

I arrived on Sunday nd February to go skiing for a week and from entering the terminal building after getting off the plane to getting through passport control took over two hours A complete and utter shambolic airport On the way back on the th from being dropped off outside the airport it again took two hours to get to the departure lounge complete chaos and no one cares All they want is the money from us for using their airport My best advice to anybody is to avoid the airport at all costs so you do not get really disappointed and frustrated that I did

Terminal is an absolute joke it is akin to a bus shelter The airport is losing so much money by making passengers wait for bus transfers to the main Terminal and by the time they arrive at Terminal there is no time to eat drink or spend any money in the shops You provide transfer bus every mins whilst you are checking in flights at a time This is the worst airport that I have ever travelled from and I have travelled the world Third world countries can do a lot better than this Very disappointing

Absolute chaos departing from Geneva yesterday Monday February It took just over an hour to get our passports stamped which was about the same time as the flight to LHR The queues were enormous as there were far too few staff available The number of positions open varied from three to five with staff just closing up and walking off It wasnt much better for Swiss and EU passengers Probably not their fault as they would be instructed by management An appalling experience made worse by airport staff not putting our skis on the aircraft Overall a dreadful advert for Geneva and Switzerland

Third world system Absolutely awful The queue to get out of the airport is going to be longer than the flight Sweating because its so hot in the queue Screaming kids and babies because theyre hot and tired UK flags covered with white stickers to hide them just to spite us for leaving the EU really Dont be so petty You didnt have them covered when we first left No markers to tell you how long to expect No staff to make sure everyone is OK Lanes not properly marked so people in wrong queue and lots of queue jumping just a shambles shame on the Swiss I thought you were better than this Arrived in the terminal an hour ago and still no end in sight Apparently several UK flights land at the same time on Saturday night Transfer companies know it and expect it so its not a one off Fly to another airport if you can assuming theyre any better

Utterly inefficient organisation Checkin and organisation of security queues were totally chaotic with inefficiency everywhere On the evidence if this airport I have no idea where the myth of Swiss efficiency comes from Also extravagantly overpriced for everything and poor quality food and beverage Really unfriendly security staff

Far better experience at Geneva on departure Checkin queues were long but moved quickly enough No delays at Security or Immigration so got the gate minutes early despite the long walk Reason being I assume because there were few other departures around that time Shopping area is cramped and crowded

Geneva really must get its act together Arrived at about on Sunday Queues for immigration were one hour plus for non Eu and minutes for eu passengers Admittedly three large intercontinental flights had recently arrived together but still unacceptable

We transitted via Geneva on our way home to Copenhagen after a holiday in Malta Ive flown into and out of Geneva a number of times albeit not for around thirty years The airport is poorly designed with long walks to and from the various satellites Its certainly showing its age and is in dire need of an update The most noticeable thing was that the majority of the staff seemed unhappy With the sole exception of a smiling women at Security all of the staff wore a scowl and ony helped begrudgingly Unless its your home or destination Id suggest avoiding Geneva Airport

Everything looked well as we arrived from Palermo en route to Manchester as our bags arrived within minutes and checked in within minutes Thats where it started to unravel The security was inept with people checking flights It took minutes to get through passport control despite Ryanair calling times to get us all boarded Even when the security guy was told the Manchester flight had priority over the Tirana flight which was an hour behind ours We just got on board with minutes to spare More staff needed and better communication rather than a s PA system Avoid Genoa airport if you can

Flight to Amsterdam was canceled due to the weather conditions thats how it was and acceptable The handling at the airport was unacceptable all over The help desk appeared ignorant and arrogant to the affected customers The assisting crew only at the counters were ignoring our need for help and it appeared as they picked people by names and not from the huge crowded lines Compared to other airports around the world this incident yesterday October th was the worst I have ever been a part of and the airport should absolutely evaluate the lack of service provided to KLM and the customers involved Do hope for improvement in the future matters concerned

My husband suffers with neuropathy and towards the end of our holiday his feet were very painful which made walking difficult I did not arrange assistance at the airport and was concerned he was unable to do all the walking at the airport and worse still the amount of walking at Heathrow I enquired at the help desk and explained my predicament The staff were amazing and not only arranged assistance at Gibraltar but also contacted Heathrow on our behalf I cannot thank them enough for making our Journey an amazing experience at both airports which would have been a nightmare their kindness was was very much appreciated and I cannot thank them enough
Its an absolute disgrace that all mens toilets and the disabled toilet at Gibraltar Departures have run out of toilet paper How can that happen Very unhappy

I recently slipped a disc and needed assistance at Gibraltar airport I cant say just how heartwarming it was to be met by the lovely Sam and guided through what can be a pretty stressful experience with genuine humanity and not a few laughs along the way Shes a real gem as were all other staff involved from check in to departure Another client asked what happened as we were raised into the transport and an attendant whod had a similar injury gave some really good supplementary advice as we disappeared I do a fair amount of travelling and that was a rare experience Thank you all

I visit Gibraltar airport regularly for trips backwards and forwards to the UK and to pick up friends and relatives who are visiting I am appalled by the condition of the glass screens on the viewing tower and stairs leading to the viewing tower the glass screens gave not been cleaned since the airport opened and are now at the stage where you cannot see through them Equally the stairs are dusty dirty and litter ridden

The airport is much improved since I was last here in Arrivals not much to say there was just my flight in so the baggage queue was pretty tame Departure check in was a breeze even though there were three flights due to depart that morning There is free wifi and plenty of seating The new terminal building is spacious and modern with a nice outside seating area overlooking the runway and apron Security was also a breeze with only a very small queue and security staff seemed pleasant enough No air bridge though so if its raining you have a couple of minutes walk before you get to your aircraft Overall a nice little airport

As per usual security is minimally manned with very long queues They seem to be surprised by flights arriving and leaving When I complained that a second machine needed to be opened at security to process people quicker they all laughed and said they were waiting on a break I think the two crews that were obviously available were rotating around rather than sound security processing This shows a lack of leadership in an important part of the airport

Quite busy airport in South Korea Arrival went relatively fast since i arrived from Mongolia you had to fill a health declaration form at the airport which you could do on an iPad or simply write a paper form Didnt take much time and also the queue to passport control wasnt very long Luggage was already at the belt after clearing all formalities Had a hour layover in Busan so wanted to leave my luggage at the airport and upstairs they do have a left luggage office so that worked nicely Airport is connected to the metro network so moving around is easy On departure later in the evening it was quite busy it was difficult to find empty seat on airside All seats are cramped in the middle of the corridor surrounded by shops and restaurants you cannot really get by the window so not a good place for planespotting Terminal feels more like a train or bus station
