The national terminal used this time for a flight to Havana unexpectedly via Cayo Coco with Aerocaribbean Everything as before but two tips for travellers I had purchased my ticket in Havana earlier in the week it was en eticket and so I was surprised at the delay minutes at check in whilst the official went to a back office and wrote out a paper ticket I queried this and was told that the worldwide disappearance of paper tickets had not yet taken effect in Holguin In the departure lounge was a small counter selling drinks and basic refreshments it accepts only CUP Cuban pesos the national currency as opposed to the CUC convertible peso Therefore foreign travellers returning to Havana on an internal flight requiring refreshments need to obtain some CUP in advance of their flight I would not recommend unofficial currency exchange with fellow Cuban passengers within the departure lounge

Holguin is a small airport not used to more than movements a day so when things go wrong they simply dont have the staff to sort out the problems I experienced delays in both my inbound and outbound flights so I got to see a lot of the airport Immigration is a major hold up since they are very thorough at checking and have few staff I went through the gates times and each time spent over an hour in the queue The departure lounge is small but with plenty of seating and an excellent view of the apron and runways from the observation balcony upstairs There are a few shops and a money exchange kiosk that changes money at the exact rate ie it doesnt charge commission There are two bars serving food and drink but this being Cuba the food selection is limited I was there for days and all they had was cheese and ham rolls for the entire time Overall its a pleasant enough place for normal transfers but you wouldnt want to spend a lot of time there Expect to get wet if its raining as the covered airstairs the busses and the terminal building all leak during heavy downpours

I highly appreciated how clean the airport was and gave points to its clear signs and directions as well as fast WiFi and FB services Immigration both Arrival and Departure however was a disaster and a big shame to the airport management team At the Arrival a very long line of tired passengers was patiently waiting for the slow staff to complete their inefficient processes Took me an hour to go through the immigration The staff who handled my documents was super slow kept checking and asking even though I showed him everything flight ticket hotel reservation tour reservation and even told him it was not my first time to Hong Kong He even checked the other visas and stamps in my passport slowly one by one Same as the Departure those who could not use the echannel had to queue and wait hopelessly Staff suddenly stopped checking passport he walked out of his cabin for minutes and then came back and we needed to wait Not deserved a star airport quality at all

I noticed my cell phone was missing going thru security They directed me to the Airport assistance Desk behind Gate I pleaded with the lady there to have someone visit the plane and retrieve my phone from the pouch under the tray She immediately called her colleague and gave her my arrival gate Cathay Pacific Flight my connecting flight and gate leaving in a few hours time I walked to my departure gate and my phone was waiting for me Great service thank you

Very clean and big airport Nice facilities Good open space Lots of shops and restaurants and fast food services including MDS and KFC All of it was pretty much airside The queue in Security wasnt that bad Nice airport and a lot of air conditioning
Excellent hardware but the signs to transfer gate are unclear The gate security staff were rude
Shocking to find no city check in services provided both in TST and Central All city counters closed and I cannot find any online information to advise passengers accordingly

I do not understand how people claim this is a top tier airport I found the staff to be very rude and abrupt with voyagers on arrival immigration officer was nice to me but I saw them being very nasty towards certain nationalities The lavatories are filthy and no staff near to be found The signals on the old part of the airport are actually better than the ones on the new terminal which can be confusing to say the least Prices are the same as in town but I found the airport express to be a little bit expensive considering the distance Check in staff seem not to know what they are doing and have to be calling their supervisor constantly it leads to huge and slow lines After this experience I can attest there are so much better airports in Asia and Southeast Asia

First time ever in Pacific Islands working for two months in Honiara I had several trips to and from the airport collecting and dropping off our staff K Joseph has summed up Henderson International extremely well You walk from the plane to the terminal its less than metres Queue on arrival was not too bad and luggage was available fairly quickly Plenty of trolleys but note that they are all kept by the baggage carousel Be warned though that if youre bringing in any equipment for work I had a couple of computer monitors with me you will get stopped by Customs and charged a refundable import bond only took ten minutes to get the refund when departing If you need a trolley when departing the simplest thing is to walk straight through the open security door where you came out on arrival across the Customs area and grab a trolley nobody will stop you most of the time theres nobody there TO stop you Most departure days are nightmarish the plane for Brisbane leaves at pm and you really do need to be in the queue by Although we had a couple of flights where it only took ten minutes to get people checked in the average was at least an hour an a half The day we returned home it was over two hours One advantage of the airport being only minutes from the centre of town is that its possible to check in really early and then go back to your office or hotel until after pm The only thing to make waiting at the airport bearable is the quality of the milkshakes the best in town and at SBD about NZ its no more expensive than anywhere else in Honiara The toilets dont always flush and the taps on the handbasins didnt work so use those facilities elsewhere if you can

The staff at the airport were by far the worst I have ever experienced The airline staff made a mistake with my bday so with my ticket could not go through check in after waiting in line When rushing back from the ticket counter with the right ticket there were only min left from the final call so I asked the queuing staff if they could help me both of them answered with cold voice and poker face NO After finally getting to the front of the line by asking favors from passengers I told the lady who did my security check that I was terribly late Shes like thats why you need to get here earlier I explained to her that airplane made a mistake and this was my second time thought the security line She said with a big smile looks like not only you were not able to get in the last time you are not going to get in this time either You are going to miss your flight And she said in a way as if shes super happy that this happened to me This is beyond bad service it felt very inhumane After all what type of human with basic integrity would dosay things like this to a months pregnant women whos worried sick

TSA security screening area is in desperate need of improvement Took an hour for us to be processed No air conditioning or decent fan system The single huge fan was pointed directly at agent sitting on his butt not the dozens of sweltering passengers Possibly not enough tsa agents Because the dog is here according to agent everyone was given precheck We paid for that convenience apparently for nothing Also we travel through HNL frequently a transferring between mainland and inter island flights is confusing and time consuming No matter how many times we do it

I found this airport very confusing When we got off from the plane there is no sign for us to take that shuttle and nobody was available for us to ask In the airport no clear signs for where to get food The only Elevator signs are outside of gates and nowhere to be found inside Oh man Tell me about how annoying it is running around with a child Plus no free wifi after mins It is ridiculous

By far one of the worst airports I have ever had to endure All be it there are signs of improvement being made The security area is pathetic Very crowded with no AC and total chaos I described the checkin area as a giant parkade and that still holds true Very dark open area The food court consists of kiosks with the eating are just outside Birds flying all over the place and eating from the tables left uncleaned We have been through this airport since the early s and have seen it grow over the years Maybe it is time for a complete refit

Think again before flying into Honolulu If you have a connecting flight thats over hours waiting Be prepared to sleep outside the airport on concrete while you wait with people around for security to allow back into terminal Apparently social distancing isnt a think anymore

I am disappointed to say that I think Hobby perhaps the whole Houston Airport system has quite a problem with luggage cart rental I was traveling on Monday evening with my daughter and grandson from Denver to Houston While on vacation my daughter injured herself and was wheelchair bound When we arrived at Houston Hobby baggage claim where I needed to rent a cart to retrieve luggage and get her to the handicapped pickup place while getting my year old grandson to move along with us easily I swiped my credit card and was unable to get the cart loose so I swiped again and got the cart and was charged twice I am now trying to get a refund on the second charge and am unable to get through on the email address they provide Then I tried making a complaint As I did so I marked complaint on the format they provided to contact them It kept deleting my phone number so their system would not accept the complaint I decided to check compliment where it promptly took my request for a refund What has happened to the Houston Airport system It should not be difficult to contact the right person for a mistake

Hua Hin airport offers a direct connection to the resort city of Hua Hin and the surrounding towns of Prachuap and Cha Am and saves the visitor the relative hassle of a and half hour bus ride from BKK airport and a similar time from DMK Don Meuang Bangkoks other airport Especially if you are coming from Malaysia The only airline currently operating a service into Hua Hin is Air Asia God bless them from Kuala Lumpur to Hua Hin The route has been a success and rumour has it that other routes will open up from Hua Hin ideally Chiang Mai to begin with OK to the airport review Its a relatively simple regional airport With checkin counters a small snack counter and adequate seating in the checkin area You go upstairs by escalator to passport control security and then the departure lounge again with adequate seating and a bathroom There is plenty of car parking by the airport and about metres out of the main gate is a Family Mart like a which sells snacks To get in to Hua Hin you can catch a taxi or walk out the gate and catch a Green songtao baht to town then another baht if going on in the direction of Market Village and Khao Takiab One of the pleasures of using the Air Asia service is that as the plane pulls away from the terminal building the ground staff wave you goodbye Thai gesture of respect its a nice touch Anyway many thanks to Hua Hin airport and Air Asia for making this route a reality

This is the second time I have used Knock It is a bit out of the way and coach connections are not very good But the timings of flights suited me better than the ones on offer to Shannon or Dublin so I used Knock My flight yesterday was the last time ever They do charge a departure tax of euro which I had no idea about until I got there Annoying but you can put up with this This time I had to spend three hours in the departure lounge as coaches were either arriving too early or too late to catch flight Never mind I thought I can relax They are doing repair work in the departure lounge which is minute The noise was horrendous Walls were being knocked down sawing hammering etc All in a small area and three groups of workers spread around the room All wearing ear protection so they were really enjoying themselves making as much noise as they could it seemed I asked if there was anywhere quiet we could sit and a staff member told me we have to put up with this all day Try the bar The bar a small area in one corner So not much help there I have tried to find who to complain to but no one seems interested My point is my flight was the last one of the day So they had many hours when work could be done to not inconvenience travellers It is a very small area where everyone sits The food selection is the worst I have seen so all in all a miserable three hours Never again I have two other airports to use both have been good in the past Passengers have a choice and my choice is never to use Knock again I warn anyone else to think again Staff seem fed up and Ireland has such a brilliant reputation for their hospitality it is a great shame

I was not expecting that I would be forced to pay extra fees at the airport Like any other airport I used so far the ticket included all the charges This was a nasty suprise should not be allowed any airport fees should be part of airport taxes and included in the overall price of flight Otherwise you are being misled about the flight cost in my case given we were a family of an additional euros could have meant we decided to fly from Dublin instead In principal I find this practice very dishonest and will avoid flying from Knock again if for no other reason but not to support sneakiness and dishonesty

I flew into this airport on Islay island from Glasgow on a Loganair flight in the morning and returned almost a week later This is a rural airport close by the sea and is extraordinarily easy to use The SAAB aircraft was parked close to the small terminal building we picked up our bags that had been unloaded on the tarmac and walked in The walls were decorated with posters of the many distilleries for which Islay is justly famed There were also individual displays of whisky bottles and other items from these distilleries A small cafe provided a good range of snacks and also some souvenirs for last moment purchases There were ample spaces to sit A short conveyor belt brought in checked luggage quickly Across the check in counters are kiosks for the local car hires I had a car to be picked up The agent had all the paperwork ready The car was parked just outside I was out of the airport grounds driving on the left in less than minutes after landing On my departure I parked my rental car across the terminal building and slipped the keys into a slot in the kiosk The check in counters were staffed by Logan Air personnel in their uniforms that sported the easily recognized tartan plaids Security check was very thorough including patting The waiting area after security check had a rest room and was enclosed by glass which offered panoramic views The aircraft was just outside and we walked to to it It was a very relaxed experience with a high degree of friendliness and efficiency The airport is situated midway between the islands two larger communities Bowmore and Port Ellen

Absolute shambles Closed the runway as we were taxying the runway due to staff shortage Only set of steps which led to a delay loading the plane I have never arrived or departed this airport on time or had so many cancelled flights We was looking to move here but until the airport shambles is fixed Ill stay in London

Arrived just before midnight with TA from KRK and was surprised with a hrs delay of my flight to Hong Kong The airport facilities are subpar in comparison to Zurich or even Helsinki which I could have chosen as alternative transit for the same journey So called nap zone is far from comfortable when youre drilling the walls past midnight No matter how many dining and shopping options provided you cant call it a worldclass airport if they dont get the basics right for such circumstances that is a comfortable lounge with reclined chairs Its all utterly useless and irrelevant to a passenger who transiting at midnight and expecting to spend a whole night at the airport when they are drilling the walls around past midnight Signages are confusing Flight status boards displayed in local language only Not the way to go Turkiye

Beautiful new architecture doesnt make up for an airports miserable customer service Upon arrival security officers shooed me away from several busy passport control areas before I found one where I could get in line after a very long walk Lufthansa lost my bag Dealing with Celebri their baggage handler was a dragged out exhausting ordeal I had no communication from them after making lost bag claim for more than hours Phones were not answered and calls not returned after leaving messages three times Bag was finally located four days later when I had boarded ship for Viking cruise but was still in port The Lufthansa baggage service Celebri refused to deliver my bag to cruise ship at the port or release it to Viking representative at airport Celebri made me return to airport in person to claim my bag The airport is a LONG ride from town Celebri is hidden in a secure area and can only be reached by a telephone by an unmanned information kiosk Celebri employee who answered phone said she was eating lunch and would come out to help me in ten minutes Multiple other travelers showed up called Celebri and were given various snarky answers as to when a representative would come out to help us It was more than minutes later when a surly young man came out and guided us back to the secure area The only answer I was given for why I had to claim my bag in person was Customs After four days without my suitcase being forced to retrieve it in person at the airport was an abusive four hour descent into a hell of rude indifferent Celebri employees in an airport that is already not passenger friendly They didnt just ruin my day they ruined my vacation by treating me like garbage I strongly advise NOT checking a bag if you are flying to Istanbul

Nothing inspiring about this airport at all Dull overcrowded and expensive Arriving and transfer to Istanbul I gather trains and buses are expensive and infrequent So theres taxis Firstly like restaurant menus there is a local price and a tourist price Get into a taxi and youre snared The journey to the city centre is some distance and the trip can take anything from mins to hours depending on the traffic so the taxi driver will be able to justify the cost We paid for each trip by private taxi organised by the hotel Seemed reasonable Top tip As the passport queues when arriving are the usual length v long avoid logging on the airport WiFi to update the taxi people until youre through as the connection only lasts minutes Phone package was a day if thats an alternative for you Departing You have to join the queue to get your bags and self scannedso you can join the next queue to get your bags and self scanned again Not that anyone seemed too diligent in inspecting the screens Once through there arent enough seats and theres no water fountains anywhere What we thought was enough lire to buy a couple of drinks and a snack each was actually just enough for the former Again the free WiFi lasts just minutes but theres loads of machines around to buy more time Dont know how much but lengthy queues at all of them Expect to be searched and wand scanned again at the boarding gate

JMU is located in the far northeast of China approx two hours flying time from Beijing and three hours flying time from ShanghaiPudong With a single runway doubling as the only taxiway JMU doesnt see much traffic One has to walk across the runway to the terminal building no provisions of covered walkways in this singlestorey terminal building Ok in summer but imagine in winter with degrees And it does get that cold up there the Russian border is only a few hundred km away The single belt means it can get crowded when a full China Southern disgorges is complement of passengers Trolleys are free but in a poor state As soon as the airport staff matches luggage tag against baggage receipt means youre fair game for the taxi touts Which is meaningless since they all use the meter The drive into Jiamusi city is uneventful and mercifully only RMB away Departing on Hainan Airlines was easy though the ticket counter accepts cash only should you need to purchase the ticket at the airport like we did The two checkin clerks went about their job quickly and efficiently Security was equally quick The single departure hall consisted of two gates a souvenir shop selling Russian matrioshka dolls and manicure sets and a smoking room Again boarding was by walking across the aircraft parking bay My only gripe were the taxi touts filthy toilets and lack of covered walkways

Feedback on my initial visit to MCI new terminal I am a Kansas City native this review is critical as it should be Overall impression is outstanding compared to the s era terminals It addresses the needs of a st century Midwest airport with all the modern necessities one would expect as a flying customer First impression walking in its big It spans wide and the design incorporating natural lighting with an abundance of windows is refreshing The evening sunlight streaming in through different angles really provides a nonrestricted feel as you walk about the terminal The respective airline checkin counterplacements are easy to identify and span the width of the front end of the terminal for easy access Security access is fairly streamlined and the entire process is able to accommodate large volumes of travelers nonTSA airport VMD corp more natural light as you progress through each arm of the terminal ABC with interior lighting not overbearing The walkways are wide and allow for excellent views of the tarmac exterior gates and various angles of the entirety of the taxiways and runways Additionally the escalators and walking escalators are positioned nicely and push you through terminal in a speedy manner More shops etc at each terminal branch providing basically anything the traveler would need The vibe and local venues are all a welcome addition and definitely fulfill the needs of the traveler Individual gates and structured well and offer comfortable seating and ample wireless device charging The one thing that seems odd is the placement of the gate flight monitors It is essentially in the seating area of the individual gates Why not place it directly behindabove the agent boothdesk for easy and quick access and explanation poor design decision Boarding the plane the traveler is treated to long glass jet bridges that allow for excellent views of adjacent aircraft and outside weather conditions This is a well thought out design that many major airports do not offer Overall the new MCIKCI terminal is a massive upgrade to the Kansas City area It has the opportunity for expansion and I would expect future modifications to address design shortfalls and customer feedback We concluded it feels like a mall when walking though the new terminal Three things need immediate addressing Mens restroom upkeep and sanitary conditions unacceptable Need to revisit the options of installing automatic hand blower machines and look at the cleaning schedules to ensure conditions do not deteriorate to the point of being an embarrassment Cleaning crews need to maintain a regular schedule on vacuuming the terminal carpet paper and debris everywhere Please explain how the gate flight monitors are controlled by the city How is this beneficial to the traveler or airline staff Local control to changemodify the monitors shouldnt even be a discussion This new terminal is supposed to represent the pride of Kansas City aviation

delays there is not much to do at this airport so take some entertainment There are no airline staff inside the terminal so in case of cancellations there is no one to turn to besides airport staff here alone Checkin process is OK security screening is strict but not a real hassle Short queuing times as it is not a very big and busy airport Englishspeaking staff is difficult to find at the airport FB and retail options in the departure lounge are very limited So do not expect to have a nice diner before your flight They do sell very nice local sweet and dried fruits Wifi is available One of the smallest picturesque airports in the Greek islands currently with very basic services but located in a scenic mountainous spot on the island of Megisti also known as Kastellorizo It is in need of an upgrade that could transform it into a one of a kind airport Currently this airport is servicing Aegean and Olympic Airways flights from Rhodes in Greece A taxi service is available EUR to the main town square of Kastellorizo

Terrible airport I was supposed to leave Nov I show up to the airport hours early and was told that the airport decided to shut down half of their flights and are no longer doing night flights and my flight was canceled and they didnt have enough flights going out to get me rebooked and they didnt know when I could get a new flight I emailed the airline at the airport and the airports reservations area and they never replied The airline was good enough to get everybody a hotel until they could get us rebooked which took days I had to miss work and accrued additional expenses the whole time I finally get my new flight and checked my bags and went through TSA which was all fine but then we take a shuttle to the plane where they search everybodys bag again and then do a pat down again right in front of the aircraft TSA and security must not be effective if they have to go to these redundant repetitive checks at multiple locations Overall the airport is very ineffective will change regulations and restrictions randomly and without any notice

My experience with the security staff at the departure security checkpoint was absolutely terrible They pulled out every single item from my bags and if an officer liked any item they simply kept it claiming it wasnt allowed on the aircraft Even after bringing airline staff to confirm the items validity the security officers would just laugh and still refuse to return the item This was a very distressing and frustrating experience and I would strongly recommend avoiding this airport if possible Their behavior was unprofessional and unacceptable

The worst airport Ive ever experienced Appalling immigration They dont have good customer service Their check point disgusting Employees act like they are helping but they start pulling your luggage and asking for money in front of all the airport staff I have never seen this at other airports They dont have signs and they dont have good customer service even at the customer care front desk According to international airlines policy customers have the right to carry two pieces of luggage under kg But they charged for both pieces of luggage I feel like all the staff are just only looking for money

I am from EU so I should not care Terrible experience for non EU visitors passport control waiting time Do something with that It is shame to have airport like this in the middle of Europe with feeling like rd country airport How you can keep complete empty windows for EU travelers and let few hundreds of non EU people wait in line of windows for hours It is not about capacity it is about organization Small change can have a great impact Please reconsider it

I cannot believe what unprofessional customer service we received Most staff is making very unpleasant comments especially for those that dont understand Polish language They have no idea who they are checking and how many people they are checking for the passport controls even though they were given all the passports checking every possible luggage even for those who are travelling with small children repacking backpacks as they were over the limit by cm I found the airport staff absolutely useless

The worst security screening Ive ever experienced They are creating their own rules and give you a small plastic bagone per passenger for your liquid cosmetics even these are properly packed in see through cosmetics bag The comments workers make are unprofessional and offensive Ive lost very expensive and not replaceable items because I had to make a choice which will fit into their bag

Airport was absolute chaos this Sunday the security line snaked through pretty much the entirety of the terminal with no clear beginning or end and took well over an hour to navigate Once I got to the departure area in Terminal A I took the escalators down to the bottom floor however the room was so crowded I couldnt actually properly get off the escalators as the whole floor was blocked Because the whole area was so busy there were no real clear lines to see which queue people were in for which flight The temperature was degrees outside and there seemed to be no AC in the building too which caused the very long wait to be very uncomfortable too

Staff apparently does not understand the principle of paid for Priority Boarding First they mixed up the gates switching from Priority to Nonpriority back and forth causing confusion and causing people to run from gate to gate pushing each other and annoying each other from losing their spaces in line over and over The duty free shop in Terminal A cannot be classified as functional as they told me they do not have grosz to return me from purchase when I paid with Zloty Very hard to believe since there are cash machines in the store In addition staff hardly knows any English and the safety control staff once regarded my Nintendo game console released around for a dangerous device could use an update on recent technology Despite the many negatives there are some positives about the airport worth pointing out These would be functional phone charging stations plenty of seating piano in the waiting area Nevertheless many aspects to improve in
Massive lines for non EU citizens Bad experience Some officers were doing nothing Many counters were closed Not recommended for traveling if you want a great experience

If you are in a hurry to get somewhere never travel with this airport especially in the evening Your flight will arrive on time but you will spend hours waiting in queue to get your passport checked and getting out Absolutely no information about why no personnel is working Waiting in the queue for hours white the line not moving at all people at the booth to get passports checked are standing in booth for over minutes They accepted planes landing at the same time and absolutely no staff to get people checked out I understand if it was a big airport and multiple plains but even there you have movement in the queue I normally do not leave reviews but this experience was absolutely atrocious

This is the worst airport I been travelling to There is a long waiting time to go through passport control Toilets are dirty There are no places to eat only a bar I wanted to rent an automatic car Four companies were closed on a weekday another three said they had no automatic cars to rent and another said it is only possible with advanced booking Customer service skills were poor in all cases I decided not to take a taxi as the price of driving into the town was too high euro for min drive There is only one bus connecting to the town It was filled to the brim yet the driver was stopping every min trying to squeeze in the commuters on top of the people traveling from airport It was min drive from hell I got off at the bus garage and called eight companies to high the car there was not a single automatic car in the whole town

Its a small airport No toilets close to check in or when waiting for check in No sign to the check in place Bad English skills Unfriendly personnel at security Two young security guys started to argue at me not asking for a explanation from me trying to irritate me

Kaunas airport is small and modern Arrivals is super fast especially if you dont have any checkedin luggage you can be out of the door in min Super tiny bathrooms A bar kiosk and souvenirs in the main hall Departures are compact Staircases to go up to security and down to the gate Another bar kiosk and a small duty free in the departures side Once again stairs to go to the plane Overall its fine wouldnt mind using it again

This airport serves Cappadoccia a major tourist attraction in Turkey It really needs an upgrade The whole process in and out is one of utter chaos There are no updates on gates no place to wait since there are very few seats With crowds milling about waiting to board with the staff unable to control anything

It is a small airport but very modern easy to get to Plenty of shopping available and some food as well I came across the nicest security ladies ever which is good for a change Sockets to charge the mobile are a bit limited and wifi did not work for me

I traveled to Kazan for business purpose and was surprised to see that this airport is rated as star one This does not correspond to other airports I am familiar with Access is only by expensive taxis Space in the international area is very limited Refreshments almost missing Security area very limited and uncomfortable The only positive feature I found was cleanliness

Flew in on a domestic flight from Moscow SVO and exiting the aircraft getting luggage and leaving the airport took no longer then minutes No checks at all though due to it being a domestic flight I guess Because of those minutes I didnt get a chance to check the airport in itself During departure though we needed to wait for minutes in the terminal or what you can call a terminal Had a small bar and some seating areas There was TV broadcasting a russian soap and that was about it Coffee was good though and again boarding the aircraft was relatively quick It is definitely not as also stated in another review a place you want to stay for hours Luckily boarding and exiting goes really fast and I had no problems at all doing both Overall impression is Fair

Kazan Airport has two terminals but T a square shaped building some m from T seems to be used mainly as a VIP facility Terminal is a small rectangular building with separate sections for international and domestic services Most likely it is the international section you will encounter on the regular LH service from FRA that arrives departs in the very early morning To say that Kazan has few facilities for departing passengers is rather an understatement a preliminary baggage scan leads immediately to a few check in desks and a very short walk to immigration control and a further scan for hand baggage In the small waiting area there are some hard seats in a small waiting room and a bar The business lounge has a few soft seats a fish tank and a television Drinks here even coffee are to be paid for nothing is free apparently There are no shops banking or change facilities at departure They bus you the m to the aircraft of course On the plus side this very small facility is a pleasant change from the corridors of FRA but not a place to linger to arrive too early or any place to be delayed either It is a reasonably long way from the city but linked by a good road so it does not take very long to travel to the city At that hour of the morning the roads are empty also The domestic area from one glance does not seem to have much to offer either

I flew in on Lufthansas twice weekly flight via Samara no February st They are the only international carrier Apart from immigration refusing to acknowledge the computer generated form from the Russian Federations London Embassy which meant I had to fill one in by hand everything was fine I was in and out of the airport inside halfanhour

A nightmare is the only way to describe it The airport infrastructure is too small to handle more than one plane at a time and you will be made to stand on the tarmac in the sun either to board the plane or to have your passport checked on arrival You may also be halfway through deplaning when the ground crew stop you while another plane taxies out Tip get the crew to shut the doors quickly or all the fumes from the departing plane will go through yours like a dragons breath Our skipper lost his cool with the tower when it happened to us on arrival The temporary baggage hall is literally a joke the bags keep jamming the belt as they enter from outside due to poor design and expect a wait of minutes while the luckless lady on duty tries to sort out the mess At the end of your holiday when you go to leave from the newly built terminal building you will discover a number of things there may be four flights getting ready to depart but there are only seats in each of the four gate areas The dutyfree shop is too small and the snack bar usually has a queue around people long tip buy your food on the way to the airport When you do go through the gate and down towards the ramp you may well have to stop for minutes while the ground staff do their thing it does not matter if you are old ill or young you will all be made to stand there without any shade Still its a nice island when all is said and done

The arrivals building is still inadequate for handling more than one incoming flight at a time We were warned towards the end of our flight from Stansted that we might have to queue for quite some time outside the building in direct sun and that we should consider buying extra water or juice to keep us hydrated Whilst this was probably a good sales pitch I think that this could be good advice for this summerhave some water on you We arrived at H and there were three more holiday flights on the apron Tui Norwegian and Easyjet We deplaned by steps and walked across the apron via a narrow concrete path not particularly evenly laid to the new escalator leading up to arrivals thankfully it was working Parents with small children were able to get their buggiesstrollers at the airport steps which was useful because it wasnt a particularly short walk if you had had to carry them Passengers requiring special assistance had to wait onboard as there is very limited capacity on the ambilift and very few wheelchairs It was suggested that those accompanying wheelchair requiring passengers meet them once they arrived in the baggage hall Passport control was swift and we entered the baggage reclaim hall which has only one baggage belt The baggage is brought up from the aircraft on trucks one at a time so it can take up to mins to offload the baggage from a Boeing Patience and good humour are good qualities at this time There are toilets just before passport control and just outside the baggage hall landside but there were noticeable queues so go on the aircraft before arrival Once you have your baggage its a very short walk to outside where the car rental desks are and the tour company representatives This can only get better work is in progress to provide a new arrivals hall and they were certainly working on it on a Sunday

This airport is really tiny but can be chaos depending on how big the arriving plane is You will deplane on the tarmac and will have to walk to the terminal it gets messy as there is not enough space for everyone I remember there was only one luggage belt and people will crowd around it Make sure you pre arrange your transportation because taxis here are a rip off Such a beautiful island but the infrastructure is terrible

Arriving at Kefalonia wasnt too bad luggage came through quick and we were off the plane and out within mins Departing was another story chaotic check in queing only desks signage is appalling you have to weigh your bags at check in then fight through the throng to get them on a Xray machine belt The chap checking passports was plugged into his iPhone the food from the overpriced kiosk in the departures lounge was woeful the toilets were appealing with doors that didnt lock and toilet paper on floor The departures area is too small with inadequate seating and poor public information All in all a complete dump needs some severe investment

Queued outside for minutes with Thomas Cook Airlines then again indoors Two checkin desks only We were stood for hours Unsmiling passport guy and one baggage scanner only Once through to departure its tiny no smoking area a tiny kiosk with overpriced snacks and nowhere near enough seats people are stood sat on the floor and on tables Power kept going off as did the departure screens there is no tannoy so the staff have to yell If only I were exaggerating honestly Im not the worst airport ever

I passed through Keflavik Airport September and October on my way from Helsinki to Toronto and back The airport does not deserve the negative reviews so often published on this site The transit terminal is crowded during peak hours with many incoming and outgoing flights between Europe and North America but you manage to transfer within an hour which often is the time you have between Icelandair flights The automated passportID document control lines were long on both travel dates but not worse than on other airports The logistics are not the best especially not for older people since you have to go up and down a couple of times If you follow the signs there is no problem I have travelled through Keflavik and to and from the airport many times and find the selection of shops and eateries very good

The arrival area was dark and sad looking the stores didnt have walls separating them Poor lighting and haphazard displays I didnt buy anything to eat but the food options looked really limited Very few places to seat so everyone was sitting on the floor Classy It was hard to find the restrooms then there was a line for the mens because there were only four stalls No one wanted to use the urinals because there were no partitions or anything to give you any privacy Very weird layout There was lots of space but most of it was wasted or unused

Very frustrating and disappointing experience Starting with the brilliant system of tax refund desk which is completely lack of system only windows for hundreds of customers After min queing up I had no choice but leave the queue if I wanted to catch my flight I saw quite a few people doing the same So well done tax refund desk at KEF you managed to secure lots of unclaimed tax refunds Then I needed to rush after wasting those times but no clear and visible sign about security checkin So I needed to find a staff member who directed me upstairs Needed to go through security check twice as again no clear sign that you have to take your laptop out of your bag Out of dated technology and facility other airports are much more advanced Then when I really needed to be in a hurry I find out that my gate is in min walk So no food or toilet break in order to get to the gate on time I was truly happy to leave this airport

One of the worst airports that I have experienced It is always overcrowded has very limited seating and the food options are poor Although I am not a huge fan of Heathrow it is inferior to it in just about every way It feels more like a regional domestic airport than one befitting an international hub Best summarised as not fit for purpose

Keflavik airport in Reykjavik is very poorly organized The interior resembles a concrete barn The service area includes one diner which is closed in the middle of the working day as well as a couple of bars besieged by crowds of passengers On offer are prepackaged cold sandwiches sold to you by equally cold unwelcoming personnel The tables in the service area are not cleaned with dirty dishes piling up and with nearly all tables filthy as they are occupied by passengers waiting for their flights In order to get to any other eating establishment besides those three you have to go back beyond passport control and then reenter the terminal through passport control once again That is what a service person told me in all seriousness Perhaps in Iceland such standards of service are acceptable but elsewhere they certainly are not Neither Icelandair nor the Keflavik airport are worth your money Avoid and choose a different route and a different airline for your travel
Terminal seating is very difficult Wooden chair with gaps are difficult to seat No chance seating for more time No cushion seats It should improve

Horrible experience with immigration officer When I went through passport control I asked kindly the lady not to stamp on empty page because I was running out of my pages I have plenty of passport pages with just stamps I travel a lot and it was important for me The answer was I will stamp whatever I want And she just stamped on my empty page that I was trying to save
The airport is very small however the staff provided a very good service We went through the airport very quickly

Excellent airport Car park to checkin to security to departure lounge within steps Then only another steps to the aircraft At the moment KLM is the only passenger operator using a small Fokker so not busy at all Only a small cafe but considering check in time and flight length to Amsterdam mins it is all that is needed I have flown from here twice in last couple of months and both occasions have been a pleasure Both have also been to connect to KLM long haul services from Schipol as got fed up with the journey time to LHR and the departure delays from there and the amount of times have to do circles around London before landing on return Next flight already booked from here

Lovely little airport parking minutes from the terminal clean and quick and efficient security baggage handling etc It is very convenient for those of us living in the south east However due to endless bureaucratic wranglings the airport is much underused and rail links to London are tedious

Manston is a wonderful airport to fly out of I walked next to my bags as I left the aircraft and collected them withing two minutes The airports size means within another minute I was at the main entrance Departure is wonderful check in was quick despite there only being six desks Within the blink of an eye you are in the departure area Dont expect vast shopping areas or money eating distractions here though

I am a cancer patient and was picking up my someone from Kerry airport I have problems with my throat and need to drink a lot of water It was a very hot day degrees and I went to the coffee shop to ask if they could fill my water bottle and was told no it was against company policy I had to fill my bottle from the gents bathroom tap Very disappointed to be treated like this

I flew in with Ryanair from Dublin into Kerry Stressfree and the aircraft parks ft away from the terminal building at Kerry Only around bags on the carrousel and they were there as soon as we were off which was only around mins after landing Departure from Kerry was alright The terminal is small and cute Check in opens around an hour before departure but the staff working in Kerry airport give off a rude vibe The person in front of me had to pay euros for being a tiny bit over their check in bag and I find this stupid since the flight wasnt near half full Security staff in Kerry were rude too which I was surprised since the airport is very quiet The detector seemed to beep everyone but it was quite modern There is a small duty free shop after security and the staff there were rude too no manners Airside is just a small cute bar and a waiting area gates All in all Kerry airport itself is nice but the staff there arent

Recently travelled from Kerry airport to Dublin on Aer Arann It was my first time using this airport The airport itself is a short ride from Killarney However the road signage could be improved especially in Killarney itself The airport is a nice small airport in design complete with a selfservice restaurant landside and a small shop where one can buy Irish gifts airside The main comment I would make however refers to the overall cleanliness of the airport The checkin area is next to the restaurant and the wafting smell of dinner can be offputting for passengers In addition the floors and toliets are not shining which is a pity as with a small airport like this it should be very easy for the authorities to maintain this image I recently was in Pau in France and although somewhat bigger I was really impressed by the ultracleanliness of the airport First impressions last and I think the airport managers should carefully look into upgrading the overall airport image This can only help tourism Finally I found the checkin staff somewhat indifferent

Calling Khartoum International Airport chaotic would be quite a euphemism On arrival you line up in front of a few uninterested imigration officers who manage to economize arm and head movement to the point of imperceptibility Thereafter you and the other passengers are squeezed through a bottle neck where your hand baggage is xrayed presumably really for bottles etc Baggage carousels are of course not labelled but if you dont mind physical contact with your fellow travelers you will find your suitcase sooner or later You exit through a further bottle neck where your baggage tag might be checked into a small hall featuring some telephone company booths Now you only have to fight through the crowd of yelling taxi drivers and you are happily in Khartoum The way out is pretty much the same precedure in inverse order with the notable exception that as soon as you approach the crowds in front of the terminal building friendly helpful porters will materialize seemingly out of thin air and carry your bags through the masses towards the security check and onwards to the checkin counters We really appreciated this The rest as above forms slow passport stamping no proper seating in the departure hall no shops and one filthy cafeteria Regardless which airline you chose you will look forward to the boarding call

Beware of the entry visa it needs payment of US you cannot use a credit card Arrival is slow and there is a great deal of checking of documents etc Departure entry area is overcrowded and chaotic The departure board did not work and you have no idea which desk is for your airline until the desk light goes on Once through passport control etc there is very little at all except for departure gates There is a cafeteria between passport control and the entry gates that is the only one The decor is old and not clean but the coffee was ok There is nowhere else to have something to eat or drink Plenty of evidence of poor maintenance eg wires stuffed in plug sockets etc and dirty toilet facilities The airport and the security staff were friendly and helpful

Everything that has been written here is still true including the mystery unannounced departure fee US one time Sudanese pounds another made more interesting because Sudan is transitioning between dinars and pounds Flights do leave in the middle of the night because the middle of the day is unbearably warm and they do leave late so patience and flexible travel schedule is a must Bureaucracy is still in full effect with multiple Xrays and searches Courtesy is in rare supply And yes Sudanese do not queue for anything You just shove and elbow and get to the front of the crowd any way you can Even for no reason the mob getting in the front door resembled a rugby scrum but once inside there were no big crowds and thus no reason to push and shove rather than just wait in line its just the way theyve always done it I had the chance to leave via the new International Terminal that opened this month and was pleasantly surprised Air conditioned spacious ceilings numerous clean restrooms watersnacks for sale plenty of seats in the departure lounge actual flatscreen TVs showing when flights are scheduled to take off It is dare I say closer to what other international airports are like than it has ever been That being said if you have reason to travel to Sudan than you probably already know to expect the unexpected

I fully endorse the comments of Malachy Roscoe regarding Khartoum airport I have travelled extensively around Africa and elsewhere and it is by far the worst airport I have ever encountered The only things he does not mention is the endless queuing for each stage of the mindlessly bureaucratic departure process and the frequent sense of panic as you are separated from your baggage during the numerous security checks All this is compounded by the fact that most passengers and staff are half asleep and extremely irritable due to the fact that many flights depart between and in the morning I am sure that Skytrax does not wish to offend countries and governments by announcing a Worlds Worst Airport award but I am also sure that it would have a great effect in improving airports such as KRT So please accept this nomination

The obligatory show of your boarding pass on boarding the plane Dont expect duty free air conditioned waiting areas business lounges or facilities smiles hello thank you goodbye catering information desk assistance even from airline representatives or toilet facilities and you wont be left disappointed But once outside the Worlds Worst Airport you will meet the most pleasant courteous and honest people that I have ever personally encountered Welcome to the real Sudan

The airport is one of the most efficient overall On departure you rarely spend more than min on overall check in desk to gate route Security checks and border control are well managed on departure Toilets kept tidy Eateries are rather sad and overpriced but if you need just fast snack and coffee youll be fine Duty free outlets are worth visiting Lots of seating lots of charge points for mobiles nice and airy departure hall good lounges On arrival things are less brilliant Immigration is poorly managed so people get confused jump lines No clear explanation of COVID control measures for different categories of travelers Once through immigration things get back to normal Bags are on the belt within minutes from deplaning and when landside no taxi scammers anymore Train to the city is sub par experience however serviceable Overall good and efficient

I had a transit in Kiev in March nd to Amsterdam and I needed rapid covid test I asked many people and either they didnt know or said I dont need it but I did I went to info point and asked a lady that where the point was and how to get there She made lots of phone calls and finally mins before my gate was going to close came airport staff She walked me through the airport to take the test then I went back through the security checking and after passport control she was waiting me there and escort my to my gate just in time I was so shocked that I reached my plane on time

I frequently fly through Borispol to get to my home city Usually its an alright experience This time around flying back to the states I was getting my tickets for my flight to Warsaw and my carry on was kg and luggage wasnt included because I came in with it being much lighter The women at the registry said it will be a total of or if I want to get it for cheaper I can give her cash never happened before I said no so I went to the separate register to pay the At the register I asked the woman multiple times does this cover my luggage to be transported from Kiev to Warsaw and then from Warsaw to Chicago She said yes When I came home I checked in my bank statement that I was charged another dollars by Lot Airline registry at Borispol airport This same thing happened to my mother flying back days before me Ukraine is my home country so Im extremely disappointed and hurt by what they are doing Please be careful and look at the amounts on the receipts

I have used Borispol terminal F on several occasions over the last years when you enter the airport you have a security check of your personal belongings this is not the main security and everyone has to go through it to get into the terminal this naturally causes long waits and it is totally unnecessary I have not had to endure check in here as I normally use hand luggage only The main security and passport control are upstairs and are fine and the guards speak good english Once through passport control there is very little to do but to wait for your flight with no duty free shops or in fact any shops There are two extremely expensive snack stalls with very limited choice On the plus side there are plenty of seats of the normal uncomfortable airport style Also lots of great views of the apron and runway In the last years of travelling to and from Ukraine terminal F it is now worse than ever The owners have modernised it since my first flight here in although it is now Borispols LCC terminal but the lack of facilities and shops lets it down its a pity because the empty shops are there just waiting for companies to take them or waiting for the airport owners to allow shops in to this terminal

NotVerified My first experience with this airport was good Ive arrived to Terminal F and then have walked to Terminal D The Terminal D is good checkin was quick and the duty free zone normal The smoking rooms are so small but you can buy cigarettes there On the other side my experience with waiting on Terminal F is horrible There were just two small buffets with very expensive food and drink If you want to buy anything else its not possible because there are just these two shops Smokers buy cigarettes before you go there yes there is smoking room but you can not buy cigarettes Also the police are arrogant and awful and they dont speak english Also personnel on checkin dont speak english They told us that there is everything but honestly There is nothing Toilets are like wc at summer festivals smell really bad You will sit on bad chairs no comfort there Its really a huge difference between Terminal D and Terminal F They told us that F is new but to be honest its not new and modern Just go there before your flight and be prepared Maybe after some months it will be better but one man told us that is the same for some months

On the th August I was at this airport passing through security to catch my flight back to Lisbon Portugal which was due to leave at pm this was the only flight being operated on that afternoon since all operations have been cancelled due to the decision by the Ukraine Government to forbid foreign nationals from entering Ukraine I passed through security normally but was then asked by a young security guard to go to a red check at the end of that security airport space He then proceeded to tell me I was carrying psychotropics which are a big offense in Ukraine Those so called psychotropics are drugs for which I have a medical prescription to take in order to cure my mental depression Those are escitalopram rivotril and xanax alprazolam They made me enter a room further at that security space without cameras and said no flight to you big offense Apparently I had to register those medications before entering Ukraine They then ask me if I had any family or friends in Ukraine I told them my travel purpose was to visit the country and all I wanted was to get back to my country I tried to show them my medical prescription but they refused to even see it The older security guy ask me to withdraw grivneas euros at the closest ATM machine so he could let me go In my despair I passed security again and did as he told All I wanted was to leave that corrupt country as soon as possible Stay away is the best advice I can give you
This airport was very efficient no lines or delayed services There are a lot of shops where you can shop and places where you can have a bite Delicious coffee and bakery items to buy

Pretty small airport A bit of queue at the passport control at Arrivals Very quick security control at departing in a Sunday afternoon h Very small duty free and the distance to gate probably is not that minutes walking A free spots to buy some food or drinks Didnt find any exchange office at the departures hall

Zhuliany airport is located close to the main business district of Kiev Very small and cosy it is pleasant to fly to and from there on international destinations as everything is done very fast However the airport is not made for international travellers who dont speak Russian or Ukrainian The airport has a bad connection to transit system but taxi fares are attractive and solve the problem if your driver as of January asks you more than to go to the city center then he is abusing you Security and passport check staff are professional and polite The domestic terminal is much more simple and has no service at all for passengers

Used Zhulany for arrival and departure domestic services No queues things went fast From car to plane in minutes and minutes from plane to car no hold bags The domestic terminal B looks bad but the new International terminal A is a good quality facility Overall ok but just for regional low cost flying

I arrived a good hrs early only to be told that I could not enter the airport literally So I later found out whilst stood outside with the other few hundred misrable people that this is not operated like any other airport you literally can not enter heavy security and rude until they call you This can be hours sat outside Honestly baffling for such a forward thinking country a backwards airport

I had an hour layover here The airport is tiny and has only one restaurant Bourbon Coffee has terrible food and service with outrageously expensive prices Half the items on the menu were unavailable It took almost an hour to complete most orders We were there observing for about hours as there is nowhere else to go on a long layover there We paid over for tasteless mini pizza and the worst chicken and rice I have ever eaten The chicken was dry yet undercooked the sauce was disgustingly tasteless There are only shops a duty free shop with chocolates and liquor and an artisan shop with very overpriced Rwandan handicrafts that I am not even sure are made in Rwanda Very similar to items I purchased in Kenya for x less Boarding and takeoff were late One positive side was the bathrooms were clean and spacious

A bit of a confusing lineup for immigration took a while lanes open for people but officers quite friendly bags already there ATM and shop for local SIM card just outside For departure take some extra time bags and cars are inspected deeply when arriving in the area Very small airport so basically you cannot go wrong anywhere All staff greet you with a how are you seems they had some training Check in queues also confusing takes quite some time to get checked in Security area check very deeply shoes out took my lighters ok they are officially forbidden anywhere but no one really took them then he showed me even that he dropped them in a box they really take it seriously with briberycorruption Dutyfree and cafeteria pretty simple but its a small place in the middle of Africa Then you walk to the airplane but with the mild weather not a problem Wifi shall not be an issue any more as you get local SIM cards for almost nothing GB for

There are two entries into Kigali Airport a newer entrance with an automated security screening and an older entrance with screenings done by Ks Both are slow so expect min wait time You are not allowed into the building terminal unless you can show proof of an itinerary None of the staff are friendly or helpful they expect you to know where you are going and are brusque even rude in conversation The other traveler who spoke about the unprofessionalism of the terminal security staff is one I experienced as well There were security agents yet one male made the sole female do all of the checking for both of my bags not even deigning to speak to her just pointing at things he wanted searchedand even though he knew my flight was at final call After the initial boarding announcement I went to the bathroom and min later it was final call another issue I have with the airport He refused to let me inform the ground staff that I was there when they were just through the checkpoint only meters not even allowing me to call out to them and making me almost miss my flight with the min search He pulled out my EmergenC and Advil packets and accused me of being sick when I told him I am preventing myself from getting sick and told me that my small packets of energy gels and anti malaria pills were not allowed I was so frustrated with their lack of professionalism and empathy Kigali Airport needs to train their staff to be gender equal and educated on what exactly what is banned and what is not I was able to take all my belongings at the end as a superior staff came and told the man that I was able to take everything he told me I couldnt If I could avoid this airport I would if notgive yourself an extra min for the in terminal security

This airport is the worst thing about flying Rwandair as it is pretty much just a hot and crowded hall with seats Pathetic dining options absolutely nothing to do during a layover lack of toilets past security screening The staff could also be more polite and informative

At second security check my carry on bag was selected for thorough checking which was fine But after checking first pocket of three he pulled out alkaline batteries which were spares for my torches for upcoming safaris and said they must be confiscated as not allowed in carry on baggage I told him that was opposite rule to what applies around the world He would not listen He then pointed to a sign with a cross through batteries however sign clearly referred to checked baggage I do not think he could read or understand the English His training was appalling and I lost my batteries This is very disappointing as my opinion of Rwanda which had been very high died then and there Needless to say after finding the batteries he stopped search His work was done And he missed another spare batteries in another pocket Inefficient and poorly trained

Small airport on a hilltop you walk into the terminal and descend down while arriving and you take the escalators up when departing We walked to and fro from the aircraft affording a glimpse of the hilly city of Kigali Visa on arrival meant filling out a short form at a manned counter who gives you a receipt which you present to an official at the adjacent counter who stamps the receipt gives you a copy and waves you out into the country The luggage took a few minutes longer to arrive though There is a Bank of Kigali counter as you exit the building to exchange your currency Taxis outside they take both local Rwanda Francs and US dollars and the drivers speak English Very pleasant experience stepping out of the terminal with lots of open spaces and no crowds Clean airy and uncrowded terminal with friendly airport and airline staff At departure terminal there are shops selling handicrafts in addition to the standard stocks of a duty free shop liquor and chocolates Multilevels of security at departure had to remove shoes belts and the like twice Procedures were generally quite slow and there was a tendency for people to be brought in front of the line by airport staff further enhancing the waits

One of the better airports in Africa I made use of the pay lounge at USD where they served snacks and drinks I had a medical situation was referred to the medical station and received good medical attention

This is the worst airport for customer service The employees were rude and very disrespectful From the moment we walked in the door it was pure chaos Not person wanted to tell us were to go We went to the nearest person we saw and she told us to go check in No one at the counter we waited a lady came in and told us go down there by then we were aggravated go where She turned and walked way no answer Then another lady went to another check in stand and were were able to check in Went to the next phase and waited mins for the woman to get off her cell phone then she fixed her chair and sanitize her hand before she called us up to the counter From there it was down hill no one knew or wanted to tell us our gate number but they did want to sell us food Never again

The arrival at a first view seems organized professionally some employees are kind Even in the evening its very humid and warm must be terrible by day with degrees and you cant communicate with any host or friend or driver because its difficult to connect yourself with the airportnetwork The worst point for me I cannot imagine that an uniformed was not able to difference between Dollar and Euro Its written in several media Visa for the damn foreigners Dollars OR fourty Euros I gave an Euronote to the officer but got no balance Would be nice to get some Tanzanian Shilling why not but nothing Theres no problem about ten Euros But I expect correctness from an uniformed justice and fairness Very bad Outside the building the same view No public transport just taxi drivers and they all want yes Dollars Because a silly white man must have that money The fact that this tourist already paid a flight ticket for more than a thousand Dollars doesnt interest to nobody My opinion Who likes to be treated by that way welcome to Tanzania All the others There are nicer places around the globe

The airport was hot stuffy overcrowded and understaffed The process of checking through security was long and drawn out and the staff was not helpful at all The restaurant food was inedible We sat in the airplane for over an hour while the airport crew scrambled to find the correct equipment to get the engines started on the aircraft

From Dar es Salaam to Kilimanjaro with Precision Air Since Kilimanjaro is a small airport our flight was the only arrival When I arrived it was already dark I was at the baggage claim in the airport building waiting for my trunk to come out But all of a sudden power went down in the airport Power went back mins after the power cut It was an interesting experience to see a power cut in an international airport The airport itself is clean and very simple But it has all the essential facilities

Compared to so many airports a delightful experience I was first off my arriving flight and so did not have to queue for a visa Only one person was doling them out so I guess that stragglers had quite a wait On departure plenty of shops for such a small airport with plenty of seating both indoors and out no problems in either direction with passport or customs

Used Kilimanjaro as our entry point for Tanzanias northern safari circuit KLM was the only flight arrival at the time the airport though small had the fresh feel of yester years relaxed airports walking to arrival area ushered by ground staff No soulless airbridges and automatic sliding doors leading to empty spaces The whole ambience was relaxed Immigration was quick and efficient they had a green and red channel when tried to walk through green channel were asked politely to go through red were asked a few cursory questions and waved through total time from disembarkation from the airplane to the waiting car less than minutes The charm of this airport is that it is not like the other mega airports small and fresh

Another charming African airport where you can bribe your way into any area of the airport and where power cuts tend to be a problem and staff have to run to the generator to get lights back on Surprising that KLM actually lands here no other western airline company does such a thing

Recently opened airport because the former airport in Matshapa is now being used as something else The new location is quite inconvenient because it takes more than an hour from Mbabane city centre and I would strongly recommend that you use the road from Johannesburg to Mbabane because it takes only four hours from SA Cost wise it is also efficient to use the road

Norman Manley KIN is an airport of two halves Arrivals is a bit shambolic We arrived on a and people had to be ferried in a variety of minibuses and coaches to the arrivals hall Following that queuing for immigration took over an hour even with most of the desks open The arrivals area is shabby but will be updated shortly The baggage collection is also a novelty with cases pilled up and scattered across the arrivals hall near customs Departures is totally different A modern light and attractive area with well marked check in desks and orderly waiting Beyond the fairly efficient security checks is a relaxing lounge with many retail outlets of both Jamaican and international food and goods

Kingston Norman Rogers Airport is the best kept secret of southeastern Ontario I enjoy taking a minute drive to Kingston instead of driving hours to Toronto It is a small terminal building Checkin is quick and easy Air Canada Jazz operated flights daily to Toronto and seasonal service to Montreal using the Dash and Beech D It is worth the connection in Toronto A lot less trouble There are rumours that WestJet is going to be launching daily service to Calgary

Get ready for some long periods of misery at Kingston Airport which is now under renovation One hour queues at immigration upon arrival Checkin system down at departure long queues at security tip take the utmost right security gate which will bring you directly to immigration passing the queue of the other security gates The fun factor was at arrival the baggage handlers remove all the bags of the carrousels and stack them together in one corner although there is plenty of space in the luggage hall without any space to move around making it quite acrobatic to remove your bag from the pile Some organization is required here

Norman Manley Airport originally Palisadoes Airport is an old military field that like MBJ has grown As most tourist arrivals are via MBJ KIN gets overlooked when improvements are in the works Indeed an old tired airport with crowding a problem both inside outside the buildings There is an improvement programme underway for the airside facilities with pax facilities coming in second place Walking tofrom the plane is interesting but the smell of jet fuel can be nauseating Like MBJ the approach provides interesting views Kingston and surrounds notably the hills above town The drive in from the airport is a beautiful ride along the peninsula though if going into town will be through some rough spots Recent hurricane damage has been repaired for the most part Overall a far below MBJ in all aspects but workable

Norman Rogers Airport CYGK in Kingston Ontario Canada is a small regional airport located about km east of Toronto and about the same distance west of Montreal Air Canada Jazz offers Dash and Beech service to Toronto times daily The return flight from Kingston to Toronto costs about if you have a connecting flight in Toronto Otherwise a flight from Kingston to Toronto costs a bit more Avoiding checkin in Toronto and the three hour drive to Toronto is worth the extra cost Kingston is a one building terminal and there is never anymore than pax to checkin for any flight Security is very thorough but is done efficiently and saves you the hassle of going through Toronto Pearson for security The terminal is one building and is currently undergoing renovations to improve service There are no restaurants in the terminal but there are a few vending machines AVIS does offer a car rental service but requires advance notice so a representative can meet the flight Overnight parking is only per hr period and is much cheaper than parking in Toronto The flight to Toronto takes min Baggage can be checked through to your destination from Kingston so there is no need to reclaim baggage in Toronto A nice little airport that makes a trip through Toronto Pearson a little more bearable

I read horror stories and read terrible reviews about Kinshasa FIH Ndjilli Airport I was very nervous about going through there What a lovely surprise awaited me A brand new terminal clean bright air conditioned well a big plus in Africa all employees well dressed and polite Procedures took time and were very detailed but nothing out of the ordinary You dont really need to pay a VIP service to go through you will be OK on your own Make sure all your travel documents and stay details ready for inspection

I had read the worst reviews about NDjili International Airport and did not exactly look forward to the experience of arriving and departing there But my hopes were set on some other articles I had found about a new international terminal that opened end of built by Chinese contractors I must say the new terminal the staff working there and the guarded parking and dropoff areas in front of it are exceptionally good It is a small but very bright and clean building Customs officers are professional and nice to the passengers same applies to security staff at Xray machines and where one must pay for an exit visa when leaving DRCongo Airconditionong works well and there is a nice business class lounge Do not expect any shopping outlets there is only one bar but the latter can easily compare to those in the better European airports Thumbs up for the new terminal hope it stays like it is today The road from the airport to downtown Kinshasa was also completely refurbishes good pavement lighting at night Travel times tofrom the airport to the embassies area of the capital are now only h to be compared to h a few years ago I was said

Having got past the xray machine you arrive in a large circular domed room with a balcony Its very noisy and the only shops are the other side of a partition which you can no longer access There appear to be no facilities but at the far end of the room from the entrance between the gift stall and the DGM control is a staircase Go up the stairs and you will find toilets and just past these a decent restaurant overlooking the ramp Prices are not cheap for a coke but theres no helpers to hassle you and its calm compared with the waiting are in the domed building Beware engaging with the locals even if they look official in a hi vis vest as suddenly they will ask for for assistance Also remember to pay your departure Tax at the DGM office near the entrance well before departure time as this can be very busy make sure you retain the pink receipt which you will need to hand over before getting on the aircraft Having got out onto the ramp the airline will carryout a bag search of all hand baggage

Not much has changed They are now using buses to take you tofrom the aircraft a backwards step in my view The m walk from the aircraft was a relief after the flight No real problems arriving It may help to have someone meet you called airport protocol if it is your first visit Check in can now be done at the airline offices in town if you can finish work early enough This can save a lot of hassle at the airport The business lounge is in poor condition now The air conditioning is near non existent
