Ndjili is certainly an experience Arrival was reasonably smooth and would have been smoother if South African had actually had some landing cards Departure is a bit of a performance with any number of checks and people with different rubber stamps involved Checkin is entirely a manual process with handwritten baggage labels and seating worked out usually a handdrawn grid representing the cabin But it all seems to work You need to identify your baggage walking out to the aircraft and final security check is at the foot of the aeroplane steps At no point did anyone approach me looking for bribes although that might have been because I had a local escort provided by my employer

I travelled in and out of NDjili with SN Brussels in August Its reputation seems illdeserved Yes it was a bit chaotic but not very intimidating I didnt have to hand over any tips going in or going out Checkin for the departing flight was downtown which made life easier The departure lounge was adequate with a small snack bar They are building a new dutyfree shop Be aware that the final passport check and hand baggage check is at the plane steps There are all sorts of odd people wandering around at this stage so keep a close eye on your hand luggage when you leave it for checking

The airport is not as bad as some of the earlier reports suggest Having a local guide meet you and handle the formalities will help a lot Most people hand over their passports tickets and baggage to these people and allow them to sort out the problems

David De Beer needs to visit other airports in Africa if he thinks Kinshasa is the worst With most African airports you will get hassled either by baggage handlers customs or the Document man who guide you through the complicated checking in process At Kinshasa ensure you have x notes in your pocket and nothing else Each person in the customs line will insist on opening your bags unless you dib them so dont bother packing nicely when you leave the hotel Memling is the best Let the first two officials rumble through your smalls without payment and the others dont bother when they see you havent handed over the dosh The is for the document man who takes over as you arrive at the terminal Let him take over otherwise you will be there for ages he sorts all the tickets out baggage etc and will ask for for his trouble and for his sidekick who carries the bags he always asks for this whilst he has your boarding cards ans passports in his hand so take out the and show him your empty pockets Also dont count on asking for legroom or aisle seats be grateful for anything as they can seem to be overbooked this is another scam to get money from you dont offer money if they say overbooked stand your ground Try Lubumbashi Kitwe or Lusaka airports for a real fun time

Travelling to and from this very small airport regularly Today it was a complete mess because of a couple of cancellations the day before The staff couldnt handle the queues which caused so much agony for the travellers Only very few people working here but one blonde female staff member is especially known for unfriendly behaviour and rudeness

Kirkenes has a brand new airport terminal which really looks nice and may be adequate to handle some handful of passengers I arrived with a Widere turboprop flight from Vard and we were passengers on board We had to walk the few metres from the plane to the terminal building but unfortunately both doors to the arrival hall were locked The guy who drove the little baggage cart for our flight suggested to follow him So we entered the terminal through a back door Two suitcases were on the brand new belt immediately so we didnt had time to watch the modern interior of the terminal Unfortunately both suitcases belonged to the other passenger So I ringed somebody out of the closed SAS office to complain about my missing luggage When he took the details about my blue suitcase he suddenly stopped went back into the office and came out with my suitcase It arrived on an earlier and direct flight As the airport bus runs only once a day on saturdays he offered to call a taxi This will need minutes to arrive from town because there usually are no taxis at the airport waiting So I spent the time waiting in the sun on a bench in front of the terminal NOTHING happened there during these twelve minutes Overall it was a funny and sympathetic experience at this minor airport at the edge of Europe

The airport is as good as you can expect for a small airport There are checkin desks on one side and bar and cafe on the other Security departures are just past the information desk and open typically when inbound flight lands or is on arrival The staff are good and helpful The one area that is woeful is the parking How can such a small airport have a permanently full car park

A fantastic little airport Arrived from GLA plane pulled up outside the terminal building One Luggage Belt very quick reclaim The terminal is one open plan shed type building with Checkin Desks for the main flights to the rest of the UK and Europe The Departure Lounge opens about minutes before the flight is due to depart usually once the inbound flight has arrived Once through Security large waiting area with seats and a toilet look out onto the apron There are Doors to allow for flights to be dealt with In the main part of the terminal there is a Tourist Information Desk with local information a Cafe offering a range of hot drinks and snackssandwiches and a small shop with a few basics and small souvenirs There is also quite a large seating area connected to the eating section There is also a nd lounge area by the Inter Island part of the terminal this deals with the flights out to the islands that form Orkney handled by Loganair Here Checkin and Baggage Reclaim are handled and DeparturesArrivals are handled completely separately from the other flights Maximum aircraft size is passengers so it is all very cosy and informal but very efficient Flew out to PPW for worlds shortest scheduled flight and back later in the day and could not fault the whole experience

Small airport with a coffee shop domestic travel only Local bus is there when a plane arrives and takes you into town The bus company keeps up to date with flight delays so there is no panic it will be there when you land No smoking room once you pass the security check

Small airport Lack of ground staff so long delays with baggage reclaim Not much seating Not many facilities Staff not particularly helpful Staff not sure which belt our luggage will even be on when it finally arrives Not a good start to our holiday Toilets have run out of toilet paper Avoid if possible

This is one of the main gateways to Lapland and nearby ski resorts and other outdoor activities Terminal has been recently expanded and refurbished but its still quite small for an international airport so during peak season in winter when there are plenty of charter flights from the UK and Central Europe they do run out of space sometimes However the place is cozy and they even have rocking chairs Outside peak season its very easy and fast go through security and checkin

Fast efficient little airport to arrive at your luggage arrives quickly and is usually carefully handled It is almost impossible to get lost and the airport has good transport links for Carinthia and the ski regions of NW Slovenia Flying from Klagenfurt is not quite so good the departure lounge could do with some toilets after passport control so if you need the toilet be sure to go before you go through On the positive side the cafe upstairs is very good for the size of airport

How is possible that still use buses to satellite Gate C it must be years now or more for maintenance works of the train tracks I think they built it in shorter period of time and usually the maintenance is done on track while the other one still working The train from KL Sentral is saving a lot of CO emissions but the hundreds of buses running all day at the airport is not helping What if they have to do maintenance to the train to the City instead of few hundred meters satellite train at Klia Moreover every morning the airport register some delays officially due to heavy traffic It doesnt seem KLIA airport is on the top for traffic It was a fantastic new modern efficient airport years ago The solved the problem of very long queuing on arrival now I spent hours queuing there in the past Thats good

No help staff at AirAsia luggage drop off machine There were two security checks performed before reaching the boarding gate which seems unnecessary and redundant but causes more troubles to passengers Third the carryon luggage weight limit of kg is measured strictly The customs officer asked me if I had used the same US passport to enter and exit I said of course and told her that she should see an entry stamp on my passport She looked very unhappy I felt unpleasant too by her unfriendly attitude

The setup is poor and unable to handle large numbers of travelers The flow is chaotic the officers sitting around chit chatting very few counters are open and the space is small We went thru the custom scan with all our pursesbags carryon luggages jackets and everything in our pockets There wasnt any officer managing the traffic so we had people cutting queue left right center By the time we got to the other side of the custom scan we realised that our belongings fell on the floor due to the short conveyer belt why would any airport make a conveyer belt that could only fit bags Before we could pick it up we got scolded by officers and said that we were too slow She sat in front of the monitor screen and couldve paused the conveyer belt before our belonging fell on the floor but instead she only paused it afterwards to get a chance to lash out on us After we collected our belongings we heard another yelling by the same officers aimed towards the travelers behind us

As a Malaysian on arrival only immigration auto gates were dedicated to Malaysians arriving This lead to a long queue As the remaining AUTOGATEs were for foreigners which also had a long queue Being a Citizen the airport need to sort out the long waiting time and line
Brilliant little airport with thoughtful touches such as free snacks and water Only downside was the open air departure lounges so no air conditioning ie humidity very high

From the first step of the airplane at Koh Samui Airport I felt that I was in a tropical paradise It was not a standard airport bus but a train of small wagons painted in bright colours Airport is a complex of many small buildings in Thai style connected by open galleries A lot of open space just covered with roof from rain Many trees and flowers Even an aquarium in WC There are minibuses for transfer to Samui hotels and of course you can take an individual taxi with fixed price

Ive been coming to Koh Samui for over a decade but my first time since they expanded the airport The airport is spread out with quite a distance between departure gates and checkin counters The security counter staff member was rude but nothing compared to the baggage security staff I was asked if I had a power bank in my backpack and I said yes then asked to show it but was trying to put my belt back on The woman kept saying hello hello hello mister show me and I said can I put my belt on first stopped and showed her the power bank to stop her carrying on I must say the way she carried on was very unprofessional and rude to say the least

Koh Samui is a real unique airport almost everything is openair As they dont have any air bridges all passengers will be carried by little unique trolleys from and to the planes They do have a roof on most parts of the airport but no walls a very airy experience and a fine contrast to the usual

I arrived early in the morning from Singapore I had trouble locating my suitcase at the baggage claim as someone had taken off a color identifying tag that was wrapped all around it I had to wait for over an hour before noticing it as the last one left The worst experience was at the security check There were no lines and nobody to ask questions It was a major struggle to find trays but I finally managed After waiting for a good minutes the personnel just closed the security booth The passengers including me had to find another booth The security personnel were downright obnoxious It was a nightmare

Kolkata Airport is a complete mess The security process is unbearable not due to long lines but because of utter disorganization and a total disregard for queues The pushing and shoving in lines reflects a severe lack of discipline contributing to an unnecessarily prolonged and chaotic experience
This is a surprisingly filthy airport where the majority of the seats were dusty or stained There are hardly any restaurants post security Creates for a very poor travel experience

Rude behaviour from the security guard at the entrance Travelling with my wife and daughter a mixture of New Zealand and UK passport holders The man could not speak English or Bengali and could not understand Qantas bookings or boarding passes codeshare with Indigo nor had no idea what an OCI for my wife was Had difficulty reading the English names and then took out his frustration on my wife of Indian origin who kept saying speak in English or Bengali only and kept telling me in Hindi I presume to stop showing him my phone with two names in one booking my daughter and myself Then the worst most shameful behaviour was shouting at my wifes cousin in Hindi and asking him to leave because he had no ticket and obviously had no confidence to stand up to this staff member Airline staff could say or do nothing as they explained it was another jurisdiction My wife finally had the last word by saying we have international passports this despite this mans threat he could detain us for time wasting he of course could not This is not the first time we have seen such inefficient and jobs worthy behaviour from a domestic airport in india but today was the worst most unnecessary form of communication Thankfully checkin security and boarding staff were clear and polite with their communication and behaviour I have no doubt if I had not been a white man then my wife and her cousin would have received even worse conduct from this so called security official in a faux uniform Please could these staff be trained in English foreign passports foreign namereading and understanding code share or international airline boarding passes on a smart phone app before they are given such jobs and how to behave with fellow human beings Quite clearly he was biased against younger men and women of his own ethnicity

Of the many airports that I use frequently Kolkata Airport is one of the worst Seating many bus stations and railway stations today provide more comfortable seating The seating area is very unclean No cleaners are seen Toilets very poor indeed Today th Nov the temperature was terrible I had the misfortune of many early morning onwards travels from Kolkata today I am fortunate there are better airline connections Dread to spend night hours here

This is the worst airport I have ever been to I have travelled across so many countries from a number of airports but Kolkata airport has to be the worst of all Starting from cleanliness to the processes from security processes or their knowledge the airline executive knowledge the airport managers knowledge and their incompatibility to address issues or guide the passengers This airport and the management is clearly deserving negative ratings if available I definitely wont recommend this to anyone Also would like to tell them that go and see how Mumbai airport has been performing and serving the passengers

We arrived from Bagdogra on IndiGo GE arriving around and transferred to an Air India flight AI bound for Delhi with the UK as ultimate destination scheduled to depart at We had to collect bags and then book in again with Air India this went without any issues Air India bookin was operating very slowly until one member took it upon himself to call all Delhi passengers to one counter which allowed bag drop to complete more quickly than normal We were not advised to skip the visa check however and stood in a queue for minutes until advised to move directly to security Here the queue was horrendous and moving very slowly We spent an hour in this queue There were insufficient baggage scanning machines the security personnel were oblivious to the problems of overcrowding those close to missing their flights were barging to the front of the queue in sum it was an utter shambles The head of security made a fleeting visit made no attempt to resolve the problem and left again There was no coordination between airline staff trying to get their passengers through security and onto aircraft and the security detail consequently several flights including our own were delayed We are used to travelling through Indian airports and know security can be difficult but this was not only being run very incompetently but there were also insufficient resources for the number of passengers due to catch flights

Its mainly a domestic airport Internal sign and direction system is clear and well arranged Immigration check procedure is efficient The Japanese officers are well organized Public transportation from Komatsu airport to city downtown only relies shuttle bus The schedule is not frequent The time interval is often more than one hour

Ive been using Kona Airport for over thirty years from back when there were no luggage belts but instead bags were put on a large wagon and wheeled in Its generally a good little airport except twice per day when the major airlines have their flights arrive and depart around noon and at night At those times the airport is overwhelmed If the airlines would stagger their arrivals and departures better especially since they are now using larger planes it would function a lot better The renovation might make things better but the aesthetics airside have suffered

I have flown in and out of this airport several times and it is by far the worst airport I have experienced in the USA and throughout the world There is no air conditioning or adequate seating When it rains propel are huddled under limited cover There are no walls or physical buildings but a series of open air pavilions There are too many slights arriving and departing for the airport There are limited restrooms As an inter island airport it might be adequate but this is an international airport serving s and s There are no jet ways no cover to protect from heat or rain A disgraceful experience

The worst airport that I have experienced in years of travel Even worse than airports in developing countries It is dark dirty brown low ceilings no functioning toilets in the gate area there are almost no services food shopping Scarce electrical outlets for recharging There are two souvenir shops and the restaurant was in disarray old uninviting Seating in the gate area is restricted to wooden benches Big s deplane and board from the tarmac It took over minutes for the handicapped and disabled to be hauled up ramps by the one porter on duty Staff were friendly and tried to reassure people but we were late leaving because how long it took them to deplane clean and load people in wheelchairs If you have to fly to Kona plan things so you can spend as little time as possible in the airport I cant understand how a state that prides itself in beauty and tourism would want this airport to be the first thing tourists see or the last thing theyll remember Perhaps there are plans for a new airport to be built and so they are not spending anymore on the old one Who knows But there is no excuse for dirty and a lack of facilities in the gate area

Horrible No air conditioning Ridiculous agricultural inspection happens twice Twice Why The seating is uncomfortable Everything is outside Its hot And the buildings block any natural breeze that could provide relief Ive traveled to several third world countries and all of them have better airports Not sure I would recommend coming here unless you get an evening flight out And eat before you get here
Do not come early They obviously do not want you to be comfortable Alcohol only inside the restaurant but zero chairs to sit in You have to stand Ridiculous

Worst possible experience in any airport I have ever travelled through The queues we have had to stand in tonight are absolutely horrendous People with small children standing for extremely unreasonable amounts of time We had such a fantastic time in Kos but will never come back

The staff were completely incapable of managing the check in queues We were moved from one queue to another and waited in line for one hour or more It was a total chaos I asked the staff what was the procedure to make a complaint and they were not able to tell me the steps but all they said was sorry Worst experience ever and Ive seen many airports until now

This airport is currently undergoing construction however the problems with the flight departures is a disgrace One or two people to check passports for hundreds of people is ridiculous to say the least I was still having my passport checked mins before my flight was due to take off

Few years ago a new terminal was built Although it looks relatively good for a small airport it is hard to get anywhere from here since it is expensive for airlines to operate here There are only two small duty free shops with limited offer and enough place for sitting If you are flying outside of Schengen area you will go through the old terminal that looks terrible
Small but very pleasant Nice staff and decent facilities Better than any of the larger airports

Arrived to KSC on a SkyEurope Airlines domestic flight from Bratislava on one of the last days in March The airport was modern but at the same time still very small the baggage reclaim area was just a short walk away from the aircraft you could easily follow ramp activity and your luggage on its way from the aircraft through the large windows and you didnt have to wait long There is a bus service to downtown Kosice but I dont think that they connect with arriving and departing flights I took a taxi to my hotel instead On the landside I noticed that despite the size of the airport and the relatively small number of flights handled the car rental desks were staffed and not just equipped with a directdial phone to some downtown office or so I would not hesitate to use Kosice airport again

Shame on Kota Kinabalu Airport For a basic necessity such as toilet you cant even manage it properly Airport toilets are filthy and no toilet paper Can you update toilet bowls with installed bidet Train your janitors how to clean toilet properly Have more frequent cleanings Really Shameful even shopping malls toilet are cleaner and dry

Im in transit to this airport before continuing my journey to Kuala Lumpur The cons to this airport is the boarding gates are shared between two airlines There are two queuing lines in front of the boarding gates A B and the boarding room was full and hot Its a mess when both passengers queuing at the same time Other than that this airport had basic services and amenities for the people The toilet was clean There are plenty of shops and food

Its a fine airport however for International travel they scan the luggage twice the first time at the entrance of the International Terminal and no outside water is allowed as per usual They then after being inside the gates check your carry luggage once more after you have filled your water in the terminal and at this point they make you dump your water again and then of course there is no water from that point on The you have to purchase water onboard Makes no sense

Such a disappointment that a basic neccesity as such cant be provided for the comfort of the visitors Toilets were smelly wet with no toilet paper Rubbish and sanitary pads were thrown inside a cubicle with the bins not cleared Obviously no cleaner to maintain the standard of cleanliness If one do not show that standard it is difficult for others to do their part in respecting the use of such amenities Please do something about it and let visitors leave with a good note

Third time transiting in this airport Terminal and was not satisfied with the quality of service from the staff around the airport Staff were not professional and lacked basic etiquette Airport is empty and has hardly anything to do Immigration and immigration staff are not professional and lacked basic communication skills as I was told to wait for hours without any notice or information before being able to exit through the immigration Once I went through immigration I was shocked as the airport looked very untidy unclean and old The toilets are also very unhygenic and unsanitary as it reaked of waste and the floorings were all wet The only good experience that I had whilst on my transit was eating McD Would not recomend transiting through Kota Kinabalu better to transit through Kuala Lumpur or Singapore

A modern medium size airport with ample space airside got plenty of outlets at the departure area and efficient checkin counter The airport is near to the city centre and it is easy to reach by taxi and private transportation Once through the security check you will be greeted by an airy airside with an ample seating area near to the gate and due to the design of the terminal the distance of the gate is really short and gave ample time for the passenger to catch their flight

Terminal is modern clean and spacious Arriving hrs there were several Immigration Desks open No Landing Cards required and fingerprint scan for ID purposes A few minutes wait for bags and we were landside within minutes of landing Taxis are a fixed price of MYR to the city We departed late at night and there was a burger place open landside but everything was closing around midnight airside Good security quick and efficient checkin and Immigration Not much comfortable seating air side

Relatively a modern mid sized airport located quite near the city Arrivals and departures were fast and hassle free with polite immigration Several food venues with OK prices and a gift shop and as usual selling post cards but never the stamps Even if the city is very close by taxis still charge MYR for the ride which is USD which I find rather high seeing that I pay the MYR equivalent when I return to Bangkok to the city The formers distance is less than km and the latter is around km including tolls

Krabi airport underwent a recent renovation and extension The old airport was well organized and kept The new one looks already old and rundown within a year after opening Toilets were dirty with no hand dryer or tissues to dry All air bridges were available at time of my departure Both flights departing at that time were handled simultaneously at the sole bus gate number it was total chaos because the holding area is not suitable for so many passengers There is no loudspeaker system and the gate agents were shouting and screaming at the passenger equally frustrated having to handle two flights at the same gate Its

Small airport arrival was smooth half hour queue at immigration but bags waiting for uson departure ten minutes from check in to be sat at the gate on comfortable seats and soft carpetairport is very clean and did not come across any rude staffin fact they were very polite

As expected Krabi is a small airport We had no issues with the arrival however the departure was a whole other story Staff were extremely rude and dismissive from the start They wouldnt attempt to communicate and explain why I could not bring a power bank even though I brought it into Krabi via Bangkok just kept showing me a card to read Annoyingly the wattage was no longer viable and they just kept saying no prove even though they could clearly see the power pack was very small and was nowhere near the wattage limit I even pulled up the official product website to show them to which they just laughed and said no I wouldnt be so annoyed if there was signage showing they arent allow or if staff had attempted to communicate why it wasnt allowed rather then just laugh and put it in the bin
Absolutely the worst aiport in whole Thailand The most rude staff ever Especially ladies who check lauggage at the gates Try to avoid it as much as its possible

This is the worst airport Ive been to and I travel often The staff are completely rude and have no sense of customer service When you try to speak with them its like talking to a wall They took my portable cell phone charger with no reason They assumed it was over mvh which a monkey could tell that it isnt that powerful They also let another person keep theirs so they are quite biased and not consistent I have a lot of friends traveling to and through Thailand and Im advising them all to avoid this airport completely They should either completely shut down or hire competent staff members If I could give negative stars I would

The staff are extremely unfriendly from the beginning they treat you with no respect and bad manners I have never had such a bad experience with all of the staff of an airline before They are disorganised and they do not understand English

I use the KRK airport about x per month for commuting and this for already a period of years From my visits I can state that the KRK airport is very consistent in its ability to provide poor service You could almost call it an achievement how practically everyone who works in this airport and interacts with customers fails to have any basic understanding of how to treat a customer This mainly valid for the ticketing offices the checkin desks the duty free shop and especially in the business lounge
Absolutely worst place never check in your bags you will be robbed I didnt want to give my luggage but they forced me they forced me and few ppl to give away their bags Dont recommend this airport

My family and I experienced a great time in Krakw and thoroughly enjoyed our stay We met some wonderful people and the service anywhere we went was exceptional Unfortunately we had a bad experience at the airport when we were leaving the country The security staff were extremely rude and almost barked orders at everyone What a shame A bad end to a great holiday I really do feel the behaviour of these guards should be looked at and reviewed

I have been surprised to learn that Pobeda does not feature online checking for the flights from Krasnodar Airport Consequently you end up queuing in an ugly soviet time like terminal which is very small and overcrowded Navigation in the terminal is not very easy given all signs are only in Russian You cannot even connect your notebook because WiFi authorization has to be done by the call from your mobile The only seating in the terminal is in two coffee shops Moreover Pobeda is checking the size of the each single piece of cabin luggage so the whole process of check in is very slow and unpleasant No Priority Pass lounge Airport is unfriendly messy and mismanaged

Left on domestic flight at height of summer season Very long check in queues and staff worked hard to try to get people on their flights No dedicated bag drop counter so no real advantage from on line check in Terminal and number of counters inadequate for demand Terminal was not very clean Regular announcements re flights etc

Kristiansand is very small airport just one story Apart from being very small I have never on my few trips had any problems No long queues in fact almost none at all speedy checkin quick baggage claim Since the airport is so small youre almost out of the airport before youre inside This may fit KRS particularly well since more than of passengers are business travelers Anyway my last trip KRSOSL and OSLKRS Arrived well in time for checkin there had been rumours of cancellation and not surprisingly SK was more than three hours late luckily with a seat for me minutes before the flight departed Total time at the airport was less than minutes When arriving back three weeks later we parked just at the baggage claims had to wait five minute before the belt was moving then right in the car Total time at the airport was minutes

The staff were extremely unfriendly not professional and not helpful at all I had a quite big piece of luggage and they asked me to put the baggage in a different place from where I was checking in I was struggling to put the baggage on the XRay and the staff just stood watching me Not helpful at all Im quite petite woman and the male staff member just stood there watching

Staff and service are unfriendly Trollies arent provided on arrival Waited quite a long time for baggage and we were supposed to rush home for family matters Service was not professional If visitors from international countries sees services like this it would be a shame Other than that I think the airport quality was good

Used Kuantan airport last week flying Firefly from Singapore to Kuantan return It is a small single storey domestic airport which has check in counters eatery outlet before immigration and a special holding area for Club Med guests Bought a taxi voucher from the airport to Hyatt Hotel for M Taxis in Kuantan are non metered and reasonably priced Once passed immigrations there are only immigration counters there is a small shop and a eatery outlet Prices were times higher than the malls Only the arrival hall and boarding areas were air conditioned There are scheduled flights a day between Kuantan Singapore and KL

There is nothing after immigration for international departures No shops no cafes no drinks nothing Also no business class lounge The business class lounge is in the domestic side Terrible flow arrangement I highly recommend everyone to enter immigration at the last possible minute Otherwise you will be bored out of your mind and suffer from dehydration Pro straight forward flow from immigration to security to waiting area Coz nothing to do It is just one straight corridor

The worst airport experience ever Imagine heading early hours prior to check in for international flights yet check in counter do not start operations until hours before departure So the waiting game of to minutes start After check in similar occurrence at departure immigration side Not even able to cross over to Travel Club lounge Rejected entry till the eleventh hour into departure hall So another round of time wasting As such never recommending travel to East Malaysia ever Above mentioned never ever happens in Kuala Lumpur or Penang Quite disappointing to have the capital city of a state to have such operation standards Conclusion DO NOT come to Kuching if youre an international traveller DO come to Kuching if youre a domestic traveller ie within Malaysia
Still no facilities in international departures Airport management say there are too few passengers it will stay that way if you dont provide basic amenities and signage

I suggest Kuching Airport to improve their amenities inside departure halls Our flight was cancelled for few hours and there is no convenient shop to buy drinks food There is food court but the prices are ridiculous Souvenir shops are around but limited common food supply vending machines with exhausted supply coffee bean shop marry brown famous amous cookies sox world cosmetics shops what happen No varieties please improve We were left hungry because not enticed with the food inside Learn from KLIA at least

A small and modern international airport with clean facilities and adequate staffing There are reasonable shopping options KFC and Starbucks until you go through passport control If you are on a domestic flight the options look good However on the international departure side you are in a deserted shiny new hallway with no chairs A major negative This leaves you wishing you had waited on the other side Free WiFi works slowly
Airport is quite small and toilets are not so clean Not much to do while waiting for your flight but for a short wait the experience is not that bad

I have travelled through Kuching many times in the past even before the current new terminal although this was the first time in years The airport has become very grubby especially the general waiting areas post immigrationbag xray The toilets were in an appalling state The air conditioning is set far too cold even for a westerner My Malaysian wife also noted that the airport had deteriorated since she last passed through Not a good advert for tourist arrivals into Kuching

Looks nice but thats all On arrival they broke my luggage It seems to be happening often at Kunming airport Nobody absolutely nobody at the airport speaks English even the main information desk There are people spitting on the ground everywhere so although the airport is quite new the floor is already very dirty Passport and security can be extremely long gates are far with no travellators and very poor signage They seem to have some obsession about lighters they take away lighters even from checked in bags The worst of all Kunming airport doesnt have a transit service Meaning even if you connect with the same airline you will need to collect your luggage go through immigration passport and security control once again and have potentially valuable stuff taken away Its not worth the risk coupled with one of the most primitive and disgruntled airport employees in the world

The airport itself is OK for transfer domestic to international The lounge for China Eastern business class and Skyteam elite members is very disappointing It is almost empty without warm foods The personnel there explained that the cook does not like to work in the evenings such an excuse appeared on some websites two years ago and the airlinesairports have not taken any actions to improve

Worst customer service rude staff not helpful at all Its an international airport at least learn some English and manners Why do I need to collect the luggage and checkin again even it was just for hours transit Why so long process for checking passports manually While handing over passport at least read out the name on passport dont ask who is this Custom police and security are very rude No shops in the whole airport accept dollars just accepts Yuan only No display of airlines on screens This would be my first and last travel via Kunming airport Guangzhou is far better

This airport is quite the improvement from the previous one The old airport reeked of different terrible odours was terribly under capacity and badly designed This new one has addressed some issues Firstly the terminal architecture is impressive albeit I find it unnecessary There are very few widebody departures yet the airport is extremely large Unnecessarily large I like airports in Europe because they tend to have shorter walking distances The check in hall is very confusing It lists the airlines and on the Thai Airways website it literally just says Row HJK And my tour guide says that what that means is that some days it is row H some days it is row J etc This is really confusing as I went to row K only to find Cathay Pacific Security seems to take forever and is such a weird practice the screening is done in small rooms I dont like this at all as if you get separated from your companions you literally have to wait for them to emerge from one of the rooms One thing that bothers me is the immigration There were no automatic passport lanes for Chinese passports which meant half the lanes for foreigners were taken up It was a rather long wait at passport control Staff can barely speak English The only English proficient staff member I met was the Thai Airways station manager For an airport which is served mostly by As and Bs I cannot fathom why in the world would they deem it necessary for such a large terminal LAX has the gates close to each other which is very convenient for walking My mum did not enjoy the long walks especially having to rush to the gate as she has knee problems All business class lounges are operated by the airport itself none of which at least in the international wing have a window They at least have some hot food and various snacks Also seats by the gates only come in the form of cheap massage chairs To sum up this airport in a word its designed improper to its purpose I think this airport is really a bit of a design failure and without bringing too much ethics into discussion I believe it is designed to awe passengers than actually function as an airport Unfortunately all the large airports in China have this problem Luckily with my next destination Guangzhou I can use Hong Kong airport which is by far one of the best airports in Asia

A very modern building and a large terminal but very long walks to and from gates Not very clean including the toilets The persons cleaning the toilets would keep the toilet rooms locked and you would have to request him to open it up The security and immigration staff are very rude and disorganised I stood in a queue for immigration security staff were shouting and screaming at passengers My hand bag had already been screened and cleared and just as I was about to go a lady started screaming at me Check Check and wanted me to put the bag through again Their systems were clearly not organised much like our Indian airports The worst experience I had was when I had arrived the previous night from PVG at around am Not a single airline counter was open in the arrival or departure hall and there were touts openly moving around the arrival area soliciting people for hotel and taxi I will avoid this airport in future

A very long walk between gates and between terminals Little in the way of eating we could only find one restaurant that was opened and this was in the morning A very disappointing place and I will try and give it a miss when flying out of Chengdu

On arrival a very large new complex A long walk from arrival gate to baggage claim area For a new complex it looks old Dirty windows and patchy paint I will have to wait and report on the departure process in weeks time
Beautiful and good looking airport but there are not enough public transport options to leave I had to wait hours for a bus to leave the airport The trains also run or times a day which is useless

The worst airport Ive ever been to Very disorganized The staff is unfriendly and terribly unprofessional I wouldnt advice travelling through Kutaisi airport to the wheelchairusers because the staff shows no respect and gives almost no attention to them I travelled with my son who is wheelchairdependent and I was told by the airportstaff that I had to carry and transfer my year old big son myself from his wheelchair to the planeseat as they had only one assistant in the airport Unheard of This airport should be avoided by travellers

The most unorganized airport Ive ever seen At first all passengers waited for an hour in line in front of the passport control as the airport service was changing shifts A bunch of employees just stood around grinned talked to each other and often went to smoke Then we sat on the plane for the next hour as the airport didnt give permission for departure because they wanted to put passengers from another flight to whom migration service didnt give permission to enter the country

Modern terminal with efficient security However there are not enough checkin desks during busy times they dont accept digital boarding passes food and drink is relatively overpriced WiFi keeps kicking you off prices are confusingly in both on GEL and EUR there is only one small departure board screen in the entire terminal before security cigarette smoke from people just outside fills the terminal not enough capacity for people using womens bathrooms

This airport is completely mismanaged I arrived on Saturday morning and there were two Wizz Air flights arriving There was such a long line for immigration that people had to wait outside the terminal Out of desks for immigration only were in service The whole process was very slow and inefficient Unfortunately I have to use this airport frequently and I cannot see any improvements or even any attempt to improve the matters

Terrible experience A very long queue at check in desk Completely chaotic No priority for priority passengers Than follows security check with even slower queue They operate only two lines and this is despite an overwhelming number of security staff The whole process is not managed complete mess No business lounge Crazy price charged for any snack Toilets are dirty Duty free is charging for wine the same prices like in the normal shops but in EUR rather than in GEL The cars are parking everywhere alongside the main road because the airport parking is insufficient to the demandI am using Kutaisi airport for many years Never every service was good but I feel rather than improving they are deteriorating

Modern building but huge waiting lines to practically anything just one plane arriving and you wait for over an hour at passport control when you try to leave they let you stand in line to print your boarding pass again on the airport paper even though it has the same information as that one you just printed Even if its some weird regulation they could provide kiosks or something instead of letting you wait in line with hundreds of other people or at least a sign please first go here before security check
The worst airport Ive been in last years It is visually nice but the organization is pathetic Expect h waiting times at securityregistration points You cant use electronic boarding passes

No one should transit in Kuwait like me They dont give u a chance to charge your phone here anywhere or smoke for free beside if you pay then u get h access to a lame buffet and some chairs and a smoking area Couldnt even find a charger there while I sat in their expensive smoking room Food was okey but not for dollars and it was like nothing Some dry fika desserts as bread and stuffed sweet bread and only rice and like two salads and two different pot foods with chicken and potatoes Machine coffee not good quality or taste And its only men here

Overall very pleasant experience Landed in Terminal Kuwait Airways Holding on to a Singapore passport and it took me just mins to have my evisa stamp Very efficient Custom clearance done under mins and luggage out right on time I was out of the airport in mins Departure from Terminal Qatar Airways fuss free Few DFS stores and cafes Not much options but all good

The transit has few Duty free shops and only coffee shop The air condition is very strong and is freezing They have lounge that you have to pay just to access it even for just hr Then the prices of the beverages and snack are very expensive I Dont think they can ever compete with the airports in the same region I hope I will not have to transfer here again

For one of the richest countries this airport is bad at all fronts Not organized rude security staff below standard lounges services This should be compared to Doha or Dubai Airport but they are light years behind even compared with the smaller yet much better airports in Muscat or Bahrain
The worst experience in my life time Limited number of toilets and with long standing queue just to enter Worst internet connectivity Try to avoid the airport Not spacious and congested everywhere

High marks for LGA new Terminal B The building is spacious with plenty of light Long walks from checkin to the gates and one has to walk through the shopping mall to get to ones gate Arrived on a Thursday at Went to the TSA PRE line There were about people ahead of me but with stations open to check ID the line moved quickly Found myself in a tooslow security lane People why do you wait until you get up to the scanner to remove your watch belt jewelry etc Especially if youre in PRE you know who this works Still and all I arrived at checked luggage and was through security by Not at all bad for this newly refurbished airport

Terrible signage inefficient layout understaffed Its bad reputation is well earned Not much else to say Ridiculous that they are trying to renovate the airport but simply better signage would go a long way

I had a flight scheduled to leave a in the morning connecting in La Guardia Several delays and flight changes later I finally managed to get on a plane and then had to wait in the plane for another hour because La Guardia had shut down airspace I will have to figure out another connecting flight because of this and they made me check my carry on so God knows where that will end up This has been a complete nightmare I will never fly through La Guardia again

This has to be the worst airport Ive ever been too Not only is every terminal a minute drive but the shuttle service drops you half a mile from terminal C Wait it gets better you have to walk another mile once you get through security to get to gate because they refuse to open a closer security checkpoint site This is a pathetic excuse for an airport and honestly should be shut down

We flew from Dallas to New York where we had a lay over and changed planes before going to Portland Maine We thought However our flight to Portland was delayed several times and then cancelled late at night when shops closed There were elderly people and handicapped people and some medical issues No assistance was offered The passengers stuck together and tried to help each other as much as possible Had to ask for snacks and water but no wheelchairs no blankets no directions just a lot of rudeness We spent the night on the floor freezing in the airport then next morning when trying to leave nothing but rudeness everywhere Security screaming at deaf boy because they wouldnt calm down long enough to realize or listen to us trying to tell them he was deaf Eating places the same way Dont mind taking your money but dont care if you get what you pay for and rude to boot Check in very inefficiently run

Overcrowded and no consideration for passengers Arrival was chaotic and we had to wait as computers were reset for British passport holders There were no organised queues just an overcrowded room with no explanation for the delay We come here every year to the island spending our hardearned money on our annual holiday but we feel we are no longer welcome Departure was even worse We were herded like animals from a large crowd in the main concourse where we couldnt even find the end of the queue We waited with crowds all around us for at least minutes while the new passport machines seemed not to work at all Eventually we had to present ourselves to officers behind glass who checked our passports manually We then spent to minutes in an overcrowded lounge with limited seating while waiting to board We are in our seventies and found this experience extremely stressful

I was absolutely disgusted to reach this airport to find that I couldnt check my bag more than two hours before my flight This gave me grave concerns and anxiety relating to getting through security and whether Id be able to afford the plane on time To be asked to arrive at an airport three hours in advance and not check your bag for an hour is ridiculous and I have never experienced this in any other airport Furthermore if the signage had directed me to this fact I would not be so disturbed having already waited half an hour to check my bag

First impressions count so as a result of the UK not being part of the Schengen agreement we are the ones who have to wait nearly an hour for the single passport control staff member to scan everyones passport on arrival Not a good start but our cases looked a little forlorn as they were the last ones on the belt The airport is small and well designed and kept very clean There are plenty of seats When it came to leave the signage in the lift doesnt make it clear that the departures floor is not the same as checkin floor Nice lift if you dont mind riding up and down a few times Next easyJet tell you their checkin is open and a half hours before departure Not here an hours wait in line until an hour and a half before any staff appeared Passport control for departures was much faster still only one staff member who was cheerful and polite but only a perfunctory glance at each passport no scanning The airport is functional When its busy I imagine it would be bedlam as it doesnt have large spaces for more than one full flight at a time

La Rochelle airport is tiny and small however is efficient Arrival EZY th July We arrived mins late into La Rochelle however got off the aircraft and was out of passport control in mins however you did have to wait outside in the pouring rain The walk to the car hire facilities was long and there was no undercover path Thus we got sodden Departure EZY We got to the airport hours before to drop off the car and then walked the very long walk to the terminal building Once there the security opened earlier than usual so was in the departure lounge early Unfortunately the duty free lounge didnt open and one of the vending machines was broken The services in the departure lounge are poor and there needs to be consistency on when the duty free is open Boarding began before the plane arrived and we were off quickly mins late as expected Overall La Rochelle needs to improve its walk to car hire and have more services in the departure lounge

This airport is bad It has to cope with several RyanairEasyjetJetHOPFlybe flights in the summer and doesnt even take the opportunity of opening up the duty free store The check in opens far too close to the flight which causes massive queues and the security channels open mins after check in starts Then you sit and wait for mins until your all called to queue up for your flight that hasnt even arrived yet However upon arriving it was quick but now you have to wait outside for immigration The staff however are fine except when boarding and the airport is maintained to a ok standard of cleanliness Travel here every summer with Ryanair or Easyjet

This was my first time visiting my homeland and my experiences both on arrival and departure were disappointing The staff were all asking me for bribery starting from the carrier staffs till the immigration officers What baffled be was on my departure time the purposely didnt tag my luggage leaving it behind had to send my sister to retrieve my bag

A bit chaotic but not as bad as some of the reviews I have seen lately We arrived and queued at the non Nigerian queue which was short Had to queue and try to complete the landing card at the same time Why cant we get this on the plane Then immigration checks the passports If you travel in a group then one person presents all the passports while the others wait to one side hence the chaos as several officials now begin to ask the rest of the family where are your passports I think they were asked times I presented the passports to the st chap then I had to move across to the other chap next to him He checks it again Then he says to me have you got something for me In other words money A bit aggressive and unfriendly I give him and go on my merry way Then we wait for the luggage Well That took about an hour for our bags to arrive And thats my biggest gripe I will be travelling light next time Out of the airport was just as chaotic Touts everywhere asking if you want to change money or a taxi or a trolley Best thing is not to make eye contact and just walk away Getting out of the car park was just as chaotic that took an hour too

So as always when arriving it is hot one surprise the escalator was working The staff were very rude at immigration and customs When we got out people everywhere trying to help you but when they do they expect you to pay them and their friends Once you finally get out of all that its fine Not a very good first impression for newcomers

I arrived at the Arik Air domestic terminal having taken an internal flight from Abuja and departed on BA from the international terminal Arik Air use remote stands and bus you to the terminal Business class passengers get their own minibus which is more than BA offer when they occasionally use a bus at LHR The terminal is in a decrepit condition but quick to get through Fortunately I didnt have baggage to collect The worst part of the experience was the chaotic taxi queue area outside the terminal Fortunately I was with a Nigerian business partner who knew the form but I wouldnt have wanted to navigate that on my own I departed on BA from the international terminal I had heard the horror stories about Lagos traffic so allowed plenty of time to get to the airport In the event the cab ride from Victoria Island was only mins so I was very early I checked in online and printed by own boarding pass so bypassed checkin The terminal is in a bad condition although not as awful as the domestic one but there were no queues and it was actually quite efficient As I had checked in online I didnt know about or have a departure card The immigration officer filled in it for me I think he was expecting a tip but I just smiled and walked away The BA lounge is like something from the s but plenty of seats and a reasonably good selection of snacks The priority boarding procedure was a bit chaotic but not too bad They let infants board first which seemed to include kids of up to about years old All in all not as bad as expected

Lagos Airport cleanliness was horrible Checkin time was outrageously long Checkin hall was not air conditioned Lounge was fine Customer service was fine not great though WiFi is not secure Flight info boards are incorrect when I flew South African Airways last year our flight was late but the board said On Time overall airport was poor

The slowest checkin process I have ever seen The ticketing officers keep chitchatting with each other meanwhile the the queue is extremely long No sense of urgency at all All of a sudden the officer missing in action for almost minutes

Very small considering that it serves such a large city but a clean airport There were very few options for food inside the departures lounge The burger meal at Mr Cod was decent considering we didnt have much options However the escalator to the CIP lounge upstairs was nonfunctional and the outside of the lounge area itself gave the feeling that the lounge would be closed The arrivals terminal was also very small but no complaints there since we got luggage quickly and were able to exit

We arrived well in time for our flight and stood in line for terminal entrance During our time in Pakistan we have been guided to the front of lines quite a few times so were not surprised that this happened here as well by members of airport staff We gave a small tip when inside but soon they asked for big amounts of western money we gave which is quite a lot for Pakistani standards they wanted We ripped away our luggage and walked away They dripped off Once inside long lines for passport control lounges closed but a decent departure hall with enough seating

Make sure to have a printout of your visa to Pakistan and of your boarding pass Without the latter you will not be allowed into the building They request to see the visa into Pakistan in one of the many document checks Officers are not pleasant Very ugly old airport There is the option to pay GBP to access a lounge that does not have much to offer regarding drinks and food but you have access to a comfortable seat and wifi

I am a frequent domestic traveler The route usually I take is LHE to KHI When you reached Lahore airport you can always sense negative vibes Poor management poor hygiene seat comfort level at the lounge is at the worst When you will land at KIHI airport it seems a bit high end in terms of infrastructure and glass bridges

When arriving you can see the agricultural beauty and the city of Lahore and the country of Pakistan The airport is very nice Immigration is busy and crowded Staff were vigilant and happy to assist with any baggage related queries and baggage also arrived on time The washrooms are very wet and needs improvements The airport needs more duty free shops WiFi and connectivity are fast and quick to connect The checkin is a bit slow and there is always a big line

The airport is very nice and average The check in is a bit slow Be at the airport terminal at least hours prior to the flight The arrivals is busy and crowded The washrooms are wet and needs improvements The airport needs more duty free shops The WIFI and connectivity is very fast and quick to connect

Arrivals lounge was very tidy and we reached baggage claim without a hassle Staff were vigilant and happy to assist with any baggage related queries and baggage also arrived on time Departures lounge is very small and the CIP lounge which was on the upper level was closed due to some unknown reason Lack of snacking options was visibly noticeable Otherwise an OK experience

The current airport consists of two buildings The first houses the security scanners and the second an open air thatched building the manual check in Very pleasant for small groups A new terminal is being constructed and should be ready in a few years Like most things in Lamu this is a simple functional relaxed airport From the terminal you walk meters to the fast boats for the minute ride to Lamu Town or to Shela Beach

Arriving was a breeze You have to use stairs though Everything was fast luggage hire car easy Leaving was not as nice I advise that you buy any snacks before you go through security Airside it is very tight Nearly all the seats were taken there is just a small cafe selling a very small array of snacks which looked unappealing and a newsagent Thats it The toilets were the worst I have ever experienced in any airport the smell was horrendous The fan going in there did nothing to make it better My husband is a smoker nowhere to smoke airside Our flight was delayed and this is not a place to spend any time in if you can avoid it

Small functional airport which is a bit drab for a holiday destination like Langkawi Clean but a bit rusty A decent common hall with shopping and eating before check in after baggage claim but next to nothing to do on the airside Still more pleasant than KLIA or Subang
No boarding bridges But views are very nice Not much wait for luggage The ground service is good

Small airport only serves a couple of airlines Landing process was pretty fast seem the airport does not have air bridges Bags delivered pretty fast Check in at airport was fine many dining options Security check was fast Not sure about transportation options because we were picked up and dropped off by our hotel It is a very sufficient regional airport

Used this airport recently It is nice and efficient Managed to retrieved luggage within mins There are about belts at the arrival hall We booked a taxi at the taxi counter for M for our min journey to the hotel At Langkawi there is no meter in the taxi they offer fixed prices unlike KL Check in at Air Asia counter fro flights to KL was quick Passed through immigrations within minutes They offer an only lady immigration as well Plenty of Arabs in the airport and was told that it was their peak holidays season There is a number of shops and food outlets Overall its a nice airport

Dont use this airport if you want to park there is limited parking particularly if its long term and expensive and a total rip off in comparison to OR Tambo where you can prebook and pay in advance or a reduced rate There is construction going on to build a multi storey car park no thought has been put into how to deal with the parking issue in the interim Customers have to walk near a construction site and some pathways and exits to the terminal have been fenced off If you are using this airport at peak times good luck with the traffic and the roadworks leading to the major centers such as Randburg and Fourways Any advice Stay away from this Airport for at least a year to give the construction and roadworks chance to be completed There are limited facilities in the terminal and at peak times queues at security are long Would I recommend this Airport No definitely not

Really pleasant and convenient airport Minimal queues and pleasant staff A really nice touch is the free coffee tea and newspapers for all passengers in the departure lounge I just wish that the runway was long enough to permit direct flights from the UK to land here

I understand Im in a foreign country but I do not expect to be screamed at in their language while going through security Obviously I couldnt understand what she was screaming about I have MS and have had strokes etc Apparently it was my bracelets she wanted me to remove She then continued to rant as I walked through It was not a pleasant experience I also had priority boarding and my grandchildrens boarding passes on my phone I didnt need to pay for luggage for them as they are and years old yet she refused me entry

There is no food available in this airport after pm The only option normally is Fast Food but incredibly they all close at pm So in an airport full of people taking and hour flights there is no option to eat for adults or children only crisps and sweets This is absolutely ridiculous you could not make it up If you dont want to work put signs up and tell people so at least the people there at would know about it No person from any other location would believe a business would close at pm and both deny people a service and deny the business the income incredible but a reality bad end to a great holiday

Absolutely disgusting help with special assistance We had two assistants screeching and shouting at both myself and husband and then I was just left dumped at the gate when everybody else had left for the plane I have serious heart problems and was so upset my heart rate went sky high Im seriously considering never going to Lanzarote again as this completely ruined our holiday Have some respect please If you dont like your job leave then dont take it out on the disabled

Told to board and then kept in a boiling stairwell No help for mother and babies who after nearly a hour needing to feed and go to toilets Apparently not enough bus drivers The ones we saw where busy joking around This caused our flight to miss the a lot and we are delayed by about a hour Still sat here on the th January Really disgraceful service from a poorly run operation Cattle get treated better than this place Terminal not enough seats and not attempts to queue manage on any gates so the terminal just got blocked up

Since I last visited this airport they have replaced most of manual passport control with Egates which families with young children cannot use This is a bad error of judgement considering how many families with young children come through this airport We queued for over half an hour for passport control My daughter needed the toilet and there was access to none because they had barriered them off until you got right to the front of the queue We then missed our transfer as were it took an hour to get through the airport The Egates were only being used by about of travellers and staff were walking down the queue trying to find travellers who could use them What a waste of money installing them or so many of them

This airport is one of the worst airports I have been into in my life Disability with my mum pushing me in a wheelchair no help whatsoever they could see us struggling and just say staring at us but helped everyone else Didnt help us get the bags or anything Airport is tiny crowded No room to do anything especially with a wheelchair Gates are all squeezed in with the restaurants and cafe so your standing next to people getting food while their in a queues at their gate number No food available for allergy sufferers Special assistance people have to wait until the whole plane gets on first then they get on last even though your put at the front to get on first Makes no sense Theres a reason why its called special assistance Jet woman did not care at all that we were distressed stood there like a wet lemon Not sure why she was there Absolutely no staff to look after the ones needing special assistance Very unorganized and unprofessional Wont be returning back to this airport

Flew from CKGLHW on Sichuan Airlines a pleasant enough flight We used an airbridge in the older Terminal while the booking hall is now closed the baggage hall and arrivals remain the same for Terminal The high speed railway has been completed so I decided to catch the train to Lanzhou West railway station The train station is a short walk to the left from the exit of Terminal opposite Terminal There was only a short queue for tickets in the Ticket hall to the right of the station entrance about for First class on the very next train Travel time was about minutes All in all it was much better than slow airport bus and taxi options

Having travelled via this airport several times before this was the first time using the new Terminal Access to the airport is still painfully long and slow from the city with no advantage over taxi and the airport buses however progress can be seen on the highspeed railway to cover the km into Lanzhou The new terminal is light and airy and much better than the concrete lifeless box that is Terminal The multitude of checkin counters are a big improvement on the old terminal Security check is typical of China with little space actually given for the lines of people trying remove laptops and metallic objects The choices for food and shopping has also greatly improved both on air and landside My gate was still within the connected old Terminal which required a very long walk with no travelators available The old terminal checkin hall seems to be closed and mothballed at the moment awaiting renovation after the opening of the newer terminal The airport staff were fantastic when they gave me their personal phone to call my destination hotel after it was apparent that my flight was to be delayed All in all it is a much nicer experience flying through here

A very small regional airport Up to flights a day all to Manila Single storey building with Checkin at one end with Departures and Arrivals at the other end Checkin Desks a single Security Lane and doors in Departures to walk out to the aircraft parked outside Single runway with no taxiways A very small friendly efficient airport Checkin and Security NB had to show ID and TicketBoarding Card to get into the airport In Departures a lot of seating small cafe and toilets A number of screens showing news promo information but no departure information A very small efficient airport Similar setup for arrivals

The airport has introduced a screen check at passport control on departure EEC passports go through in minutes British passports took about minutes when I departed on March at You need to either build this into your schedule or avoid the airport and use Paphos

Appalling organisation at the airport took hours to get through passport control and security with no one knowing what was happening Then delayed and no communication at all stuffed in hot room Clearly committed to too many flights and not enough capacity Need to get it together and provide a better service

Absolutely terrible experience on all levels The staff is unprofessional and unhelpful The checkin took a little less than hours while the counter opened hours before the flight so the whole process was unexpectedly stressful The tax free agents are not centralized so you need to go to different parts of the airport to complete the tax free process The wifi is extremely weak Again absolutely terrible It is unfortunate that a country who relies on tourism has this airport as its main airport
A lot of noise They were talking all the time on the speakers The food on Burger King were not fully cooked nice staff but irritated by all the bilde on the speakers

I left on early BA flight and was very impressed with the helpful staff in the airport check in hours ahead fast empty security and border control Nice airy feel and clean although some cafe prices shocking cost me more than Scandinavian airports euro for potato chips Generally modern and relaxed despite a number of early morning flights and there was a machine where robot gives you jelly beans I like distractions in airports takes your mind off stress BA gate staff helpful and whole experience was stress free compared to disgraceful regional airports in UK

The airport is a relatively small international airport that is easy to navigate The checkin lines are a gamble as some airlines have short queues and some are ridiculously long The passport control and security check was a relatively quick process even though the security staff is one of the most unfriendly Ive experienced The duty free area is large however the prices especially for food and drinks are very high even for an airport The seating area is relatively quiet and there are usually enough seats available with bathrooms and kiosks in walking distance from the gates Due to the small size of the airport even the bus journeys are not long to the plane although we had airbridges on both departure and arrival Besides the indifference of the staff the only really bad thing at the airport are the sometimes very long wait times minutes at the luggage carousels This is especially the case during off peak times when it should actually go quicker This time however it was a relatively quick process and the bags where already there when we arrived I think the airport is nice small airport without any thrills but also nothing that makes me hate it

Quick and easy security and immigration at departures weekday afternoon Departure terminal is overheated All the food outlets are overpriced and a total rip off All the duty free goods are expensive apart from tobacco and cigarettes Announcements are too loud The terminal carpet was absolutely filthy

The most disgusting bathroom I have ever used in an airport in any major city and Im usually not picky I had to change clothes so I wasnt even using the toilet to go to the bathroom If I did I would have had to probably search for an hour to find something I would possibly use Urine and feces on the floor in multiple stalls I didnt see a place to mark please clean but I did mention it to a worker that was coming in Not sure if he understood what I was saying I just got a glazed over look from him It was in C gates I had actually come over from B because it was bad there too

I have TSA pre check I stood in the pre check line minutes without it moving even one person Meanwhile people were going through regular TSA with NO WAIT How on earth is that So I switched to regular TSA where of course I had to take off jacket shoes and remove laptop Then as Im standing in bare feet suddenly the long line of pre check people go flying through Whats the problem with your pre check

I cant express enough how grateful I am for the exceptional help I received from Hilary the gate check agent at Spirit Airlines I was in a complete panic after losing my cell phone at the airport With no way to contact my family and let them know when Id be arriving I was extremely stressed and worried that theyd be concerned about me Hillary noticed my distress and went above and beyond by offering to let me use her personal phone to send a quick text to my family Her kindness thoughtfulness and willingness to help me in a moment of crisis made all the difference Thanks to her I was able to let my family know when to pick me up and I could finally breathe a sigh of relief Never did find my phone but there was a silver lining Hillary truly saved the day for me and I cant thank her enough for her generosity Spirit Airlines is lucky to have such a compassionate and dedicated employee Thank you Hillary for turning a stressful situation into a manageable one You have no idea how much your help meant to me

This airport is disgusting The bathrooms are filthy with urine and unworking flush mechanisms Floors throughout terminal appear to rarely get swept or mopped Im amazed the airport can pass a foodservice inspection We ate breakfast at the wendys and the seating areas and tables had spilled drinks and food all around the dining space Trash overflowing It seems the cleaning crew are non existent or inept Avoid this airport at all cost Tsa was friendly and efficient but the rest is a zero

The TSA employees were very rude TSA Pre Check was closed The airport is one of most unclean airports I have ever visited Seating at Gate A has no charging ports on the seats The experience at LAS makes me extremely grateful to go back to my home airport BNA

I just want to have an explanation for why I was charged cents on top of the purchase for a glass of Chardonnay when paying by card savings account The bars preferred method of payment is card There should be no eftpos transaction fee for use of card when this is their preferred method of payment This is wrong and your airport personnel need to address this issue especially when dealing with COVID I would like an explanation

I was transferred to a later flight and couldnt check my luggage in as it was too early I decided to wait in the restaurant shopping area and have a coffee Well I had to take my large suitcase through the security area I am an older lady and had to get someone to help me lift the suitcase up onto the Xray carousel I had to first take my nail scissors etc out It was embarrassing and no one was able to help me and the staff were unfriendly There is no other entry to the shops etc but through the security area It is ridiculous I am so stressed and upset over the whole episode

Travelling in and out of Launceston Airport proved a pleasant experience Since the terminal is still fairly new everything seemed to be in very good working order Facilities were very good having large coffee shops and well stocked souvenirgift shop selling real Tasmanian and Launceston branded items Check in and customs were hassle free No time lost waiting for luggage or taxis

Good airport with facilities to cater for the number of flights Slight delays on arrival due to fruit and vegetable quarantine but no problem read the notices and listen to the announcements makes it easy It does the job

Pleasant little airport in Tasmania with limited flights and destinations But easy to trot through and all staff most pleasant Beware do not bring fruit from the mainland Do not rent a car from Lo Cost they take a charge Damage deposit off your credit card and I am still working on having this refunded Limited facilities
