Launcestons airport is rather small with two distinct gate areas one for QantasJetStar the other for Virgin Blue On the plus side it means relatively short queues and a short walk from the plane to the parking lot The secure area is glasswalled from the nonsecure area so nonpassengers can still watch their friends and loved ones get on that plane something you cant do at many airports todayOn the minus side it means a lot of things we take for granted at other airports are missing There are no jetways so boarding is the old fashioned way via stairs A minus in poor weather and for those with physical ailments it can be a plus depending on airline and aircraft as you can board via two doors simultaneously Theres only one small cafe and I dont recall any shops if you want a lastminute souvenir of your Tasmanian holiday Another minus is that like many of its bigger cousins the rental car facilities are offairport and not onsite like youd expect for a small airport While the major chains like Hertz Avis Budget etc all have counters within the terminal their offices are located on the main road into town When dropping off my Hertz car I rented it at Hobart the clerk who accepted my car also drove me in the same car to the terminal Im not sure if its the same for incoming passengers or if a shuttle bus exists like at other airports with offairport rental car offices A really big minus is that because the airport dates back to a more innocent period in air travel the toilets as well as everything else are outside the secure area with none inside I got there real early and noticed that people didnt enter the secure area until starting about minutes before their flights However that causes the non secure area to get quite crowded at times Again due to the low passenger numbers security queues are relatively short compared to large airports

Atrocious airport that not only needs a rebuild but an almost clean sweep recruitment of staff Lazy lethargic behavior topped off we cant get the staff Alcohol Drinking from am Unbelievable Over priced with poor shoddy ill thought out product Whoever runs this eye sore needs the license revoking

Once again the check in desks struggled for over minutes to sign in and queues for security are going outside Paid for fast track but waiting longer and longer due to pushing late flights through This airport really needs to spend some effort improving its service as its getting worse

Having travelled extensively it should be welcoming to travel from a local airport not so Leeds The car park is rough and disorganised the departure areas unclean with overpriced food and teas etc and the staff unhelpful Thankfully Jet the airline are different and great ambassadors for their airline Arriving back into Leeds was worse with a cold walk along a third world shelter into a building with filthy walls and floors that looked disgusting as a first impression for visitors to Yorkshire On attempting to leave the car park too the ANPR cameras were not working creating huge queues with one camera taped with packing tape and plastic Quite frankly it was embarrassing having flown in from the pristine cleanliness of Barcelona Unfortunately Leeds Bradford Airport is a sad reflection of a lack of care lack of interest and lack of respect for itself

A small airport that is a bit tired and shabby but convenient due to its small size Generally security is quick to minutes It can get a little crowded at times so you might not have somewhere to sit I regularly use this and Belfast City airport as alternatives to Dublin and Manchester bigger airports more crowded longer security queues etc and this airport is nowhere near as nice as Belfast City In particular the lounge in Leeds is quite poor in terms of food drink offerings cleanliness However if I have the choice between Leeds and Manchester for a flight Id choose Leeds because of the faster security But they could make it cleaner and put more into the lounge experience

I had no complaints on departing from the airport but on arrival compared to Alicante airport the toilets were grim there was even rubbish on the floor on the way to passport control Going through Nothing to Declare the area was filthy dust and fluff everywhere mixed with hairs and dirt It is is embarrassing Please pay for a cleaner

This was a quite different airport altogether from what I have seen to date When you look from the outside it is surrounded by beautiful Himalayan mountains and blue sky Me and my husband were flying back to our home after a days best ever vacation of Laddakh Our experience of its Airport though was not very impressive The security check was different from a normal airport After submitting the luggage we had to claim it once again before boarding the flight The flight management didnt seem to be very punctual and professional We were allowed for boarding the flight hour after boarding was announced Announcements and actions were completely out of sync Food served were not fresh When asked she told me samosas were made hours earlier Quite to my surprise there was hardly any airport shopping Airport authorities should take serious measures to amend these shortcomings as Leh Laddakh is becoming a favorite holiday destination for people all across the world

LeipzigHalle is my home airport I like the short distances and the good accessibility with public transport long distance buses commuter and long distance trains Parking is comfortable and the number of direct connections is acceptable for the size of the metropolitan region LeipzigHalle Waiting times at security checks are usually predictably short It seems like they usually give me priority access with my Lufthansa frequent traveler status But there were times when I was standing with other business people at one check point for minutes whiles less than tourists were quickly checked at two other open check points The bathrooms are terrible and need a renovation quickly In combination with the fact that you have to leave the Lufthansa lounge to use them I avoid using them in all circumstances The Duty Free is very small and I can not remember that I ever found something worth buying it There are plenty of seats in the public areas As soon as boarding starts you have to move into a hall that is connecting the gates If boarding is delayed then you have to stand in the line and there is only a hand full seats in front of the gates My standard LH Business and Senator lounge is one of the most boring LH lounges I have been to No daylight in Senator lounge things like prepared Bratwurst or Leberkse waiting on a cold plate until somebody is hungry enough to take it Very low food standard No own toilet as described above One really good thing in Leipzig is the quick baggage service at arrival I never had to wait more than minutes after arrival before the belt started to rotate Sometimes when I have to take the bus from a small airplane to the terminal the suitcases arrive before the passengers All together I would say that I like the airport for quick services and short connections Some details need improvement
Easy to get to with car from the Autobahn or from Leipzig with the train The airport is large but not confusing or crowded Security was a breeze All the people seemed nice

Huge airport serving the cities of Leipzig and Halle and good connections to Berlin as well roughly hour by express train Oversized shiny modern Due to its huge size one has to walk quite far through the whole airport to reach the rail station oversized as well which is located at the opposite end of the arrivals departure hall Good and fast connection to the city centres of Halle and Leipzig but very unfairly calculated fare they let you cross several fare zones so you have to pay more than for comparable distances in that region Because of new restrictions for landing and taking off after pm interestingly there are NO restrictions for cargo flights many budget airlines have cancelled their services to this airport and now only few major European cities are still served by nonstop flights Very sad since the alternatives now are Altenburg Airport or one of the Berlin airports However having to go there first from Leipzig or Halle increases the overall time of your journey massively

LeipzigHalle LEJ is modern with shiny terminals and stateoftheart information systems Travellers might wonder why the whole facility is so grotesquely oversized The answer is simple after Reunification the German government spent billions on new infrastructure in the East and Leipzig got a huge share of this Too bad in a way for what could have been an efficient regional airport with sleek operations and short distances turned out more like a ghost town leaving the traveller with long walks through deserted buildings and sitting lonely in ridiculously large lounges Ground staff usually is very helpful especially the checkin staff by GlobeGround is always friendly and pleasant

A very easy to use and convenient airport Arrival was quick and easy to prepay for taxi to Guanajuato pesos was the cost Its less than minutes to Guanajuato We arrived at for departure much earlier than necessary No line for CO checkin and no line at security The snack bar was affordable and there are a couple of decent shops Even though the airport has jetways they apparently dont go low enough for the regional jets that provide most service so you have to walk outside Just before boarding there was an additional patdown security check

The service to get from airport to the centro district to Guanajuato is too expensive No options Just get on the taxi Last fall it was around usd This is an mile trip which takes minutes The bus from Guanaujato to San Miguel is about a one hour drive and cost about usd There should be alternatives at your airport Maybe a bus into town

Ive flown in and out of BJX a half dozen times and have no problems Take along a book or knitting as there are only a couple of souvenir shops but they are colorful and reasonable My destination has been San Miguel de Allende the art colony thats popular with US citizens

This is a small and nice airport Ive landed and departed from this airport before and it has changed a lot I dont know why it is called Leon Airport if it is closer to Silao Gto I landed there a few months ago my destination was Romita Gto my mothers hometown This airport is very convenient for us since it is only about mins away from Romita Also this airport is not very far from Guanajuato city I recommend people to visit Guanajuato this is perhaps the most European style city in Mexico

I have flown in and out of this airport on several occasions although I dont live in Kentucky I mean it is a small airport serving a small city so dont go expecting any big city amenities other than just a couple of sitdown restaurants a Dunkin Donuts and a small store But it is surprisingly spacious extremely clean and very modern Signage is clear staff and security are friendly the terminals are small and manageable and there is even complex and beautiful artwork on the floor in security honoring the regions thoroughbred horse racing heritage Lastly where else can you park in the parking garage that is only around feet from the terminal The ease simplicity and friendliness of this airport makes it one of my favorite airports in the world and Ive been all over North America and Europe

Whenever I travel I try to avoid having to go through Toronto or Newark airports two places that seem designed to discourage people from travelling Ive just added Liberia to that list It clearly was not built to handle the traffic of increased tourism and both arriving and departing reflect that fact Clearing Customs takes time as the lineups can be long and slow moving in a hot humid building Departing is also an exercise in patience as waiting passengers are jammed into an area designed for a fraction of their number Seats are cherished items boarding lines are more like boarding scrums and the prices for everything in the building are beyond ridiculous Water can cost US a bottle basic burgers and fries Last minute souvenir items are similarly overpriced even by airport standards There is nothing appealing about this airport other than the fact its bright inside A necessary evil if its by far the closest airport to your destination but one to be avoided if you can arrange to go through SJ

Immigration systems went down and executive director of security wouldnt answer his phone for manual overload Made us wait in very first security line for at least an hour so far hundreds of people Sheer incompetence and stupidity

Used Liberia Airport to depart on JetBlue to New York JFK Its midsize compared to other airports in Central America yet it seems more crowded and things are more expensive They have the usual airport shops but on a smaller scale and less organized Travelers are scattered all over confused with no clear indication as to where a line starts and ends Staff make no real effort to make things more efficient As a matter of fact they barely speak English There is a lack of seating both in departure and arrivals areas You have passengers standing around before boarding their flights Bathrooms are large but still a lack of facilities for the number of passengers Boarding announcements are done with a microphone often times speaking on top of each other which made it hard for me to understand Lots of confusion Food and drinks are overpriced Its located about miles from city center and taxis overprice at USD on average I stayed about miles away and was still charged USD When considering this airport calculate prices to see if youre actually saving money when you add in higher prices for transport food and accomadation in the area Would fly from here again if savings outweigh the stress

We use this airport at least times a year as we have a residence there They have been increasing the number of flights in and out but the new terminal was built too small to handle the additional traffic Seating often fills up and people are forced to sit on the floor and wait for a flight to depart to free up some seats Check in is slowed by immigration and security agents checking each passengers papers before you get to the airline counter Security lines can back up since there is only two lines If you didnt prepay your departure tax you can wait a long time on a line to do that at the airport as there is only a small office counter to handle this Food is very limited and very expensive Arrivals are the best part as the immigration and customs people are efficient and courteous All in all the new terminal is better than the old one but it already too small and inefficient

LIB aka Daniel Oduber International Airport is the second main airport of Costa Rica The current terminal opened within the last year Bright cheerful facility with windows viewing the runway etc Security was tight shoes belts etc to be removed Currently flights a day Sunwing TACA United American Delta and Westjet Adequate ground transport Only issue was the food concession US for a bottle of water and a chicken wrap Our flight was the only one Monday morning other than a small TACA regional plane The other all leave within the pm window

Libreville Airport is certainly not the worst airport in the region but not the best either Staff very civil servant minded with a lot of arrogance vis a vis passengers A good point is that on arrival luggage is quick to be on the belts A bad one is that air conditioning is not efficient at all and we are in a tropical country

This is a welllaid out and efficient airport On international arrivals passport control was efficient as was the luggage claim On international departure the various formalities checkin immigration security were all adequately staffed and efficient Facilities are plenty before security though minimal after clearing immigration and security a few duty free shops selling alcohol perfume and cigarettes and a quite limited bar The domestic part of the airport is more or less the same though the facilities after security is even more spartan limited to a vending machine for water or soft drinks Notably there were no restroom facilities in the waiting lounge

ADD YOUR COMMENTS Very pleasant and open design Arrival was easy and there was absolutely no hassle once we cleared the secure baggage area Marked taxis were available outside Check in was conducted in a secure area which you cannot leave once you enter so ensure you are not hungry because nothing other than a small cafe and some duty free stores are available on the gate side Compared to other airports in the region this one is very good

Because its a very small airport flight per day the controls are strict unpleasant formal and questionable ml crme and a Tape were taken because of procedures so they argue No coffeeshop open no restaurant open nothing open Very unpleasant

A modern building a short distance from the departure hall to the gate No hassle airport There is however no train or tram connection to the city and the city bus is not equipped for passengers travelling with luggage The bus times are not electronically indicated and it is not clear what route the bus will take If you dont know the city or if you dont speak French finding the optimal ground transportation might be difficult Recently Spring a list of new destinations was added to this airport noncharter flights

It is a small airport so time to get to the gate isnt long There arent a lot of shops but enough to eat and drink something The Wifi is good but only free for min There arent enough spaces to sit when you wait at the gate but I can understand that there isnt enough space

I chose this airport for my summer holidays back in as a familiar airline started operating a scheduled summer route and provided very appealing promo prices It seems that is airport is mostly used by charter and low cost airlines providing allinclusive offers to leisure destinations However you can still find some scheduled international routes operated by bigger European airlines throughout the year such as Air France of course but the prices usually go through the roof meaning you can buy a train ticket to Paris and fly from there at half the price The current trend is that bigger European airlines will use this airport just for a couple of months per year mostly for the summer season That being said the airport is very small but on the other hand there is also not much traffic so it is as big as it should be I suppose It is very easily accessible from anywhere within France or northern Europe This is because Lille is a train hub in northern Europe you can use the Lille Europe train station in Lille to reach multiple European capitals There is a bus shuttle from Lille Europe train station to Lille Lesquin airport for euros allerretour or euros single journey not very cheap but not expensive either The airport is also very nice from the outside and the inside and you have perfect view for landings and takeoffs while waiting in the gate for your flight The airport has a very informative website a facebook page and a twitter page There could be more adequate toilet facilities in the gate I was waiting the was a single facility with just one or two toilets inside I do not remember correctly On the plus side the facility was spacious and appropriate for people with mobility issues eg wheelchair

Kamuzu Internation Airport KIA LLW is a small but pleasant airport I left at night and had some problems with a taxi not able to find my house so I finally arrived at the airport minutes before take off No problem at all The luggage scanning machine was broken so had to open my bags and everything was thoroughly checked but all was in order Then went past immigration and its so small up there and the shops were closed at night so couldnt buy anything There is no smoking area after you pass immigration so keep that in mind if you smoke All in all fine airport friendly staff one cannot get lost in here like in western airports

Modest airport staffed by cheerful smiling people typical Malawian experience Took about mins to get through immigration and another mins to reclaim bags Most peoples bags are opened at customs for a cursory examination On the way out check in was a bit Heath Robinson systems were down and bagsboarding passes manually processed Only downside was the check in agent tagged my bag through to LHR using a handwritten tag and told me unconvincingly it would be fine Just as well that I took the precaution of checking at Johannesburg as the bag came out on the belt and I had to check it in again Overall a satisfactory experience

Lilongwe airport Malawi takes you back to some of the delights of s travel no announcements so you have to listen carefully when the staff shout which plane is boarding Fortunately its a small and quiet international airport so you cant go too far wrong unless youre asleep Theres enough shops to keep you entertained for minutes theres a cafe and you can watch the planes from the outdoor balcony and theres not much else But what it needed to do it did so efficiently and pleasantly nice to be aware from the security paranoia of LHR or other big western airports Note the duty free doesnt come in sealed duty free bags so you do run the risk of losing it all if you transit to somewhere else as we did A shame as the prices were really ok and I dont know anywhere else outside the country that you can get Malawi gin

Which airport can be worse than Lima International There is always line in womens bathroom because each womens bathroom has three toilet stalls and four think They let you keep water bottle at security to enter the gate area but at the gate they have agents who check your carry ones and personal bags and confiscate all liquid including the bottles of water which we just bought at duty free area Im a diabetic and need to drink a lot of water So I was thirsty all hours of flight Little cups of water which flight attendants give is not enough

Despite arriving at the airport three hours early for the first time ever I almost missed my flight First there was a long line to enter followed by baggage screening After that another lengthy line awaited to speak with an immigration officer Just before boarding there was yet another line for additional bag checks as if the machine wasnt enough Plus you cant bring drinks or snacks bought outside through security I didnt even have time for shopping due to the delays The airport staff was unhelpful when I explained I was about to miss my flight they asked to wait like everybody else

After many years since I frequent this airport I have seen NO improvement My last visit was on JAN Why Almost no place to sit unless you are in a restaurant bad choice of restaurants even if the food is fine in a very few of them Crampy and not comfortable bathrooms No airport WiFi Complicated and lengthy lines at customs but here there is another responsibility too In conclusion it reminds me of a bus station instead of an airport

It was the worst time lost in an airport queue that I ever experience in my life It was about two hours to clear customs a huge queue and just a few employees I am very hungry now although I do have money to spend on the airport and I thought I had time for a breaksfast there But I ended up in a customs queue for two hours Now I am inside the plane I needed to run to be on time inside even though I arrived hours before my flight You guys need more staff for the number of people in the queue

I travel from Limoges to and from Paris The terminal is a little bit small but it is very clean There is a not a very long queue time and the staff were very proactive At this airport there is one bar and one restaurant but there are no lounges or dutyfree The boarding area is very small and there is not much seating This is a little but very efficient airport

Linz Airport is not great Nothing here Officious overzealous staff Probably nothing else to do apart from deal with Ryanair flights There is a little cafe near the entrance to departures If you fancy a tea coffee or a pretzel get one there before you pass through departure There is a small duty free shop and a small grotty bar at the gate Nothing else For a small Airport youd have thought it would be better organised

It was by far the smallest airport I have ever been to Actually I wanted to go to Austria and I found a ticket a this city so I booked and stayed there a couple of days The airport handles only a few flights per day so nothing is really professional We got off the plane walked to a hall immediately and then it was the exit and taxis were waiting I guess all the way from the plane to the taxi was less than meters Hopefully it was a flight in the schengen area otherwise as I took a glimpse the border control would be a bit of a nightmare

For a small airport the organisation is almost unbelievably poor when passing through here twice last week it took an eternity to exit passport control because of the officiousness and deadslow working speed of Austrian immigration staff On the way back there was chaos around the boarding gate area as two yes two flights were boarding simultaneously through adjacent gates leaving others empty and no attempt was made to direct queues or instruct passengers to wait for their number sequence for a Ryanair flight A useful airport yes but as poor as other contributors have said

The airport is tiny the shops are few and expensive even when compared to other small Austrian airports such as Salzburg The opening times are poor by western standards this is a general trend in the country There is a departure room at Linz where once you have gone in you cannot go out There is no prior warning of this fact there are armed police there to stop you leaving something to do with international law depends where your destination country is It is literally one room before the runway with one drinks machine poor and one food machine poor The airport is terrible but it may still be the best option if you want a cheap flight to that area of Austria

The airport is ultrasmall I arrived some hours early and found myself trapped in an airport with nothing Theres a dutyfree shop a cafe and if I remember correctly nothing else There isnt even a TV well I dont understand German but at least a TV gives you something to watch Those hours were the worst part of my trip to Austria While the airport itself is obviously underused certain facilities simply have to be provided to make the life of the handful of users easier

Linz is a really small airport It is only a few kilometer away from the city but to go to the city is either expensive or takes a lot of time The taxi costs EUR from the Central railway station to the airport for this distance it is a lot The Bus costs around EUR but there is only bus an hour I wont spend their more time than necessary because there is nothing one or two shops and cafes but not more Its ideal for Ryanair but otherwise I would try to bypass this airport
Chaotic First time we missed the flight after traveling for thirty years Avoid this airport Beautiful country but terrible management of airport Peoples shouting because everyone is fighting for time

Sparse toilet facilities on arrival Disinterested staff grumpy jumped up securitycleaners with headphones oblivious to others Information desk unmanned Seating areas packed Wifi hit and miss Lane separation unnecessarily long at departures difficult for the elderly and infirm

You often have to wait on a remote parking slot for buses to arrive flights have narrow time windows to land or take off which leads to delays both at the origin and destination Can definitely be better managed Geneva airport model would suit it perfectly It is extremely central and convenient You almost arrive on the historic zone of Lisbon

Lisbon Airport is one of the most crowded airports to fly from The queue at Terminal was extremely long and EasyJet did not help the situation as they were slow in attending to the earliest passengers The security control at the airport was particularly inefficient with only a few security processing lines functioning out of many available in the terminal This caused long queues at security and the processing of passengers took much longer than expected As a result the five of us missed our flight despite having already checked in Although we reported this issue to EasyJet and called to explain our ordeal there was no assistance offered It was apparent that they were already aware of the chaos at the security control yet the airports management did nothing to improve the situation Passengers were left to bear the loss without any accountability or remorse from the airline or the airport authorities It is unbelievable that we missed our flight after arriving at the airport two hours in advance

Arrival was very efficient but departure was stressful Very cramped Inadequate signage Endless pointless chicanes for nonexistent lines No seating presumably in very old airport Totally inadequate for today but improved signage would help a lot Eg we were told at check in that we had to go to Security but there was no sign to security We were given the impression that it was extra and not part of the route to the departure gates Everyone exasperated and short tempered Not a good experience Allow loads of time

Humberto Delgado Airport LIS avoid if you can or youd have to arrive at least hours before your flight they lack staff at customs officers for people Weve missed the flight in October half term as the queue at the customs after Security check on between pm was over two hours there are no staff on the ground and youd be refused help if youd ask to be fast tracked or given priority even if you could still make it to your flight If you miss your flight youd have to queue again for over hrs to get your stamp cancelled No matter if you complain no one will respond assist or help you Airline staff say it happens all the time Airport cant cope people are welcome to raise a complaint with highest authority custom police but do you really want to risk it and possibly get locked up

A delightful regional airport set amongst the lush valleys and hills of the Northern Rivers District of New South Wales Nice well designed terminal and with more convenient flight schedules with Regional Express down to Sydney than nearby Ballina which handles mainly tourist traffic Lismore Airport is close to town and has all the usual car rental facilities and is only minutes to the coast Byron BayBallina etc Only downside is as is usual at most airport terminals in Australia blaring televisions all around the terminal causing a racket and breaking the pleasant peace of this delightful place

Little Rock National Airport LIT is one of my favorite midsize airports It is on par with the Bob Hope Airport BUR and Ft LauderdaleHollywood International Airport FLL in that it is easy to get in and out of the airport complex the location is close to downtown and the presence of lowcost airlines keep overall ticket prices among the lowest in the country

The facelift is complete After years of construction everything appears to be complete LIT is smoke free so smokers must cross security and go to a covered outside area Several coffee shops and a mini food court were added however while several open early for early bird flights most close long before the last flights arrive A couple of little news stands and a book store was added but the gift shop is not on the secure side So if someone one that has a lay over must cross security to shop Free wireless internet has be added that can be accessed from almost any where between gates Overall not bad for a small airport

Our plane landed at about pm Once we left the plane we had a lengthy walk in bitterly cold weather to join the long queue for passport control We were queueing outside in freezing temperatures for well over thirty minutes before our place in the queue reached the inside of the building where we queued for at least another thirty minutes The walkway outside interspersed with glass tunnels was totally grim dirty unpleasant unwelcoming and unfit for purpose The intense cold and wind made it incredibly uncomfortable and whilst the tunnels provided slight respite from the biting winds for a huge part of the time there was no protection at all Thankfully it wasnt raining There appears to be a complete lack of any consideration for the welfare of customers I can honestly say our arrival into Liverpool was the worst we have experienced in over forty years travelling around the world If the airport buildings cannot support the number of people arriving at any one time then something needs to be done The current situation is totally unacceptable

On the th of October i arrived at the airport with a Uber rider Shortly after i left i noticed i left my phone in the uber who has driven off My flight was hour and minutes away from departure I tried asking for multiple people within the airport for help if they had the uber app to help me contact the driver as i would not be able to check in to the flight without my phone The kind police security gentleman by the name of Chris kindly helped me contact uber let me use his phone to call the uber driver and with only minutes left for depart kindly helped me through the security queue Honestly a life saver and I couldnt be more grateful for finding this man this day and i would like to once again thank you if you ever read this review

Its a long while since I have posted a review here but I have not changed my opinion of Liverpool Airport for my wife and myself it is always our first choice It is never crowded we know our way around and we have never had a negative experience when passing through About three years ago we had to switch to Manchester Airport when our flight was cancelled and we hated the crowds the queues and the struggle for seats In comparison passing through Liverpool is a doddle Weve never had any problem at security which is light and airy compared with the claustrophobic equivalent at Manchester It helps that we travel hand baggage only so we can bypass the queues to hand in hold bags and dont have to wait at baggage reclaim on the way back Were not interested in buying food and drink prior to our flight and we know that even if we are delayed en route to the airport well still progress through the airport to the boarding gate with time to spare Passport control can be a bottleneck on return but even that seems to have been speeded up in the last year or so As long as it does not overexpand in terms of flights we will be content to use Liverpool Airport for as long as we continue to fly

Upon arrival at Liverpool Airport it was just a disaster the moment we sat foot on the tarmac in the pouring rain The young lady with the Swissport vest organising our movement was completely out of her depth We were told to wait in the rain for to minutes before we were moved to what I can only describe as the luggage train area Once there we were told to move here there and everywhere while the polite baggage handlers drove their luggage carts in between us all At one stage a young man arrived wearing a health and safety vest and showed no initiative in any way so he seemed completely pointless in holding this position Another time elapsed as the passengers could not enter the building for whatever reason Once in the arrival building all baggage carousels were stopped and it seemed everyone for themselves to wonder around when we found our luggage at an area where they had just been thrown about on the floor and belt that was not on It was a complete fiasco and the staff need to be trained properly and professionally and to be informed that if they do not want to be in the position of employment then they need to be told to seek employment elsewhere They were extremely unprofessional and extremely poorly trained for the positions they hold I will fly and arrive at an alternate airport in the future In my employment I have been in and out of airports all over the world and due to the serious lack of knowledge and professional of the staff at this particular airport I would rate this international airport as one of the worst airports I have experienced

My review is that the service at this airport is the worst Ive encountered for a long time I would not recommend it to any traveller wishing to get home It took more than one hour to provide baggage at am with only passengers in the whole terminal Give it a wide berth at all costs travellers
Dirty and smelly public washrooms Good food and beverage options Long queues at security screening Cramped baggage reclaim area and long wait for baggage to be delivered to the Carousel

Lovely airport but for some odd reason theres security checks which all goes to creating queues No airline lounge yet there seems to be plenty of lounges on the first floor and most unused On arrival the immigration process was long winded cant understand the need for a manned diplomatic line Livingstone cant be getting many not being the capital though on the plus side Zambian Immigration now allows you pay for your visa with a credit card

Terminal is very small so if there are plenty of passengers or more than one plane arrivingdeparting at the same time it will get packed My own experience was a good one though and it was a breeze to get the visa collect luggage and get out There is a new much larger terminal under construction next to the current one

Long lines await you when you arrive and need to visa to enter the country There are only two counters one for visas and the other for travellers who do not need visas The arrival hall is small but the waiting drivers etc are gathered respectfully outside the terminal building The airport is not far from the town

Arrived on the only SAA flight into Livingstone a fairly basic operation though there was a mad scrum to fill out the visa form out as there were no pens on hand This slowed everything down as people were getting their Dollars out to buy the visas you have to have Dollars in cash as well About mins after the BA flight arrived to add to the lines so thankful I flew SAA In the past the flights into S Africa used to dish out visa forms on the flight before you landed they should do this on this flight too

They have removed all the ceiling tiles that might have deadened the sound so that the bare concrete is exposed in the departure area As a result its like being in an echo chamber and the announcements are impossible to understand Its very unpleasant Also there are very few seats in the checkin area even though there is plenty of space so people end up sitting on the floor Finally the taxi drivers have a scam where they add all sorts of illegal charges so that a normal EUR fare for a ride to the city center costs EUR or more

Lovely airport amazing views of the Alps Checkin was ok Wizz airline desks were poorly managed with long ques but the rest of the airlines seemed fine and so was security Shops were a bit lacking but overall a good airport

Excellent little airport A bit tired cosmetically but everyone was friendly and everything worked seamlessly Dont rush through security unless youre desperate to look at aeroplanes as theres not much else to do Theres a little smoking box that takes people after security next to gate upstairs Its free and the ventilation works well

Avoid at all costs This used to be a reasonable airport nothing special but at least flights were punctual This seem to have degraded in the last couple of years Queues at this airport resemble a rock concert I have been to many airports around the world but have never had to wait hours for a simple baggage check and sadly this is the rule rather than exception Flights are almost always late and frequently cancelled Absolutely no care for passengers itineraries If you are planing a trip try to avoid this airport particularly if your itinerary involves connecting flights

A small airport right in the east of the city center with a convenient metro connection readily available The terminal itself is small but well organized and has enough small shops for food and beverages Security queuing times late in the evening were nonexistent border control only inbound was equally fast Best airport if youve to be in London itself
The toilet facilities are disgustingly filthy Shopping experience is rubbish too Some of the seats in the waiting areas are not very clean this is the worst UK airport I have visited

The most awful airport Have not used for years or so Used to be a great airport which was quick and easy to use Now has terrible snaking queues to get through security Much worse than Heathrow or Gatwick Avoid if you can

Crowded as ever Security was OK no longer than minutes but once inside admittedly it was hard to find anywhere to sit The airport is a brilliant idea but the concourse areas are too small for the size of aircraft they are now handling Not enough toilets eg One positive with the Elizabeth Line now in service a transit from LHR can be done in under minutes via Woolwich and the DLR stationtostation I managed it in

Gatwick is above all an experience An experience for the eyes nostrils and hygiene that might not exactly be considered favorable Bear in mind I come from the US We have some excellent major airports but also some rubbish ones Gatwick would easily be considered to be among the worst of what Im used to in the US and its the worst major airport Ive seen yet in Europe other than possibly Otopeni in Bucharest The only nice part of Gatwick I saw was the train station upon exiting the national rail Otherwise the checkin areas are depressing and run down like a throwback to whenever Thatcher was prime minister yet without any good cleaning since that time The checkin as well as gate personnel with Norse Atlantic Airlines were honestly surly professional but surly The security process is a hot mess and lines are incredibly long at least I had paid the pounds or so for expedited security While I made it through security quickly I still had to swiftly pay attention to what was going on Walking through the south terminal there were very few places to sit and eat At least the employees at the Pret were nice The floors were dirty and sticky The toilets and accompanying sinks looked like they were also from the Thatcher era The terminal had a pervasive damp dank flatulentlike odor to it not sulfur but still odd and gross Final point I usually like British people for their politeness but Gatwick is a place to see some of the worst in British people In closing if you have to come to London fly to Heathrow as at least some parts of it feel like a proper airport or to London City which is very small and easy Very clearly the privatization of many British airports has not served the British traveler well at all

Arrived today and was disgusted by the cleanliness of the airport Dust which looked like it had been there for days Floors old but no excuse for not giving them a good clean Moving walkways with piles of muck around them Hopefully will never need to use Gatwick again

Gatwick North terminal is not big enough for the number of passengers We are treated with contempt by the airport There is nowhere to sit nowhere to get an alcoholic drink all outlets were absolutely heaving and no bar space or tables available Passengers have to beg for some service Travelling on my own and I had to walk the terminal times to find a seat at a bar

Average airport Ive been here many times since I live in the UK but my experience never really changed There are a lot of shops which I find good and the food is meh I do often see some rubbish on the floor and wet floors with no wet floor sign which is quite dangerous If you come here I do recommend to go to the lounge since it is relaxing you get tasty food and a view of planes taking off The flights are always massively delayed but overall a pretty average airport

We arrived on a delayed flight which deposited us in the South Terminal at around am instead of our normal pm As all hotels at the airport plus a km radius were listed as no vacancy we had no choice but to settle in for the night As you are not permitted to check baggage until hours prior to the flight and our flight was not until am we couldnt even cross into the better postsecurity gate section Be that as it may security gates are closed then anyways Seems this airport hasnt even considered this as a possibility from a human being perspective There were close to of us in the same situation The couple dozen comfortable seats were long gone occupied by the longsince asleep The rest of us were forced to curl up on tile flooring or leaning against walls and pillars The toilets were disgusting The fact that airports dont consider that people can arrive at all hours for all sorts of reasons this long into the air travel game boggles my mind But some do it well Gatwick doesnt even attempt to make this comfortable at all The stewards of this airport need to spend a night in their own airport as an eyeopener

The only things that seem to have changed since the last time I flew through Gatwick is that the prices in the food court have somehow gotten even more expensive for a small lukewarm flavorless and inedible breakfast wrap is a disgrace The staff at security screening are still unsmiling and unfriendly barking orders at passengers and the holding penwaiting area is still a cramped and poorly laid out mess where the departure boats are impossible to see from the seating areas The whole place feels dirty and in need of a good clean and it needs quite a bit of maintenance Its convenient for getting to the south coast but I always feel like I need a good wash after being here A pretty poor overall experience again Im afraid
The arrival immigration process was very slow We had to wait for so long All the queue was full and not moving It is clear that the is not enough staff for the passengers

They made me throw away a small Benadryl bottle for my Allergic child The manager was belligerent and nasty when we explained why we needed the medicine I am also pregnant and once we got to the gate I couldnt use the bathroom I asked the staff and they said you can go but the gates could be closed on the way back

Drove to the airport to meet a visitor At the barriers was met by multiple and confusing signage that proved irrelevant The barrier machine itself was confusing and the enquiry line was unanswered Finally got the barrier to work Terminal is looking dated and the lifts were slow and crowded Inside the terminal the mens toilet was grubby and stank of urine Hand washing water was a trickle All in all this relatively new terminal and the airport approach and layout is third world

We use the BA lounges here to avoid the horrendous crowds everywhere in the terminals This airport needs at least two more terminals to offer the space and experience many of its rivals offer When we landed at Terminal we had another interminable wait for our luggage Not a great experience again Id recommend it only because it is better than the other London airports

Arrived from Saudi Arabia expecting wheelchair assistance but none was provided I was directed to a buggy at the gate where a rude employee refused to let my wife join citing space Forced to walk through Terminal s maze we arrived at customs only to see the buggy arrive with four empty seats Confronting her she showed no empathy refused to apologize and argued even more when I asked for her name A shockingly poor welcome back to the UK compared to Asias serviceoriented travel culture

We were lucky enough or unlucky enough to use the Fast Track in Terminal on leaving the UK from a holiday On entering the line was blocked with a mother with infant in a pram with no effort from security in getting her to move to the side while looking for something On entry through the doors all security staff were looking at bag ignoring all those waiting to get their luggage screened for more than minutes What is the point of having modern faster equipment for scanning when there is no one manning them

I am convinced that anyone that has anything bad to say about Stansted is either paid delusional or a banker that hasnt got anything positive to say about anything Ive travelled to airports so not quite as many as some people but Ive been to enough to say that Stansted is bloody marvelous at what it does Its simple clean efficient has a beautiful single terminal building some of the fastest security queues Ive ever seen no matter how many people its trying to push through Stansted is quite simply operationally one of the best ever and Ive never had to wait more than minutes departing Even arrivals moves ridiculously fast and while sometimes you can wait in a queue that looks lengthy to enter the country it never takes that long The people working at Stansted know how to move Its an absolutely marvelous display and it always astounds me whenever I go Its a well signposted airport very easy to navigate the quiet area is fantastic loads of shops and food options My only MINOR criticism is that it can sometimes be difficult to find a place to sit down upstairs but other than that its absolutely a class airport

Worst airport I have ever experienced mainly because of the staff and the security process It was incredibly disorganised and the staff were beyond rude Only allowed one small plastic bag that had to seal If you couldnt seal it then just told youll have to throw away whatever doesnt fit Ive used a clear plastic wash bag at many airports recently with no issues including the return flight of this journey through Budapest Not Stansted though and because the small bag they gave me would only half seal I was told with a shrug of shoulders better choose what youre throwing away My bag then got pushed over for further inspection which took approximately minutes of waiting for it to be my turn By the time they got to my bag it was re scanned and I was told there was nothing in there that needed checking She swabbed some of the items in the small plastic bag then proceeded to struggle to seal it up again To which I said dont bother Im transferring it back into the wash bag now She said Im sorry I have to its silly I know So I watched her seal it pass it over to me where I unsealed it and put it all back in the original bag Pettiness to the extreme Return journey through Budapest no issue with plastic wash bag had a little look through and a lovely chat about our trip A completely different experience I feel embarrassed that our country is like this

I have travelled widely around the world in my years on every continent and Stansted Airport is about the worst airport I have travelled through Stansted airport many many times and it continues to steadily deteriorate and has now reached the level of a third world country There are no working jetways at the airport instead you have to climb down a steep staircase to get out of or into the aircraft Then once you are out of the aircraft walk across the apron tarmac then you have to walk up two flights of steep stairs with no elevator available Third world stuff The last straw on my latest trip was the complete lack of adequate toilet facilities for men and women We stopped at a couple of loos one in the domestic baggage claim area and another in the rental car village men and womens side They were all filthy lacking in toilet paper and had few if any working stalls The majority of the stalls were not working at all ie were out of order and in the rental car village there were no working male stalls at all The Hertz guy at the rental car village told me there was a male stall somewhere but I was not able to find it and there was no signage supporting that mans claim Overall Horrible filthy disgusting and a total disgrace Welcome to Britain

The entire STN experience was a humiliation ritual We arrived at the airport hour before the gate closure We didnt have any baggage We acquired our boarding passes pretty quickly but the horror started at the security check There was a lane colossal queue towards a narrow gate that goes towards the hall where security check starts and people were packed like cockroaches getting pressed under a hydraulic pressure The security check was a complete disaster engineered to maximise the chances of having a stressinduced stroke and missing your flight Despite the crowd security insisted to go through everything single procedure in a slowest possible way It took us mins to get through the security and when we were over with it only minutes left for gate closure Then a marathon started because of the distance between gates and shopping corridors We ran through mazelike corridors and made it to our gates exhausted and stressed That was easily one of my top three worst airport experience

Long Beach Airport is one of the nicest airports to fly in and out of without hassle or delays However if you intend to park your car with the Long Beach valet service dont expect the complimentary car wash to be a car wash It was the most pathetic car wash Ive ever received A toddler could have hosed it off better The cost to park was a day I was gone on a business trip for hours and when I returned I expected a nice clean car I was wrong Dont park your car with the valet expecting a decent Car Wash Thank you

I fly out of Long Beach airport whenever I can business and personal travel My friends and family choose to do the same Ive only had good experiences until today while picking up a friend and her family The bad experience was related to a Long Beach police officer monitoring vehicles curbside I was approached by the officer as I was opening up the back of my SUV for loading luggage He asked me to move my vehicle twice even after I told him my friend and her family were walking over from the luggage area outside of the airport His demeanor and tone were aggressive and he didnt care to listen when I said my friend and her family were approaching the vehicle He raised his voice and came very close it made me uncomfortable Fortunately my friend and her family walked up greeted me and asked what was going on The officer just walked away The officers conduct was unprofessional and not appropriate

This airport is highly recommended Many of the reviews below are pre which is when the facility completed a full upgrade of terminal and gates I would discard any pre reviews as irrelevant to the current condition Long Beach Airport is a welldesigned and pleasant experience compared with LAX and to a degree John Wayne Its a smaller but more efficient facility with competitively priced parking within an easy walk of your gate The TSA Security Checkpoint is relatively fast compared with other airports The facility boasts two outdoor seating areas for two of its restaurants a comparative luxury in this age of airport design being little more than shopping malls with airline gates The central area between the two terminals is an outdoor seating area allowing for a retreat from the madness at the gates One of the unique aspects of LGB is the lack of jetways Walking out onto the tarmac to board a plane is a fun and different experience which adds significantly to the charm of this facility Long Beach doesnt have the cold and sterile feel of most modern airports and that is a welcome aspect of flying here There are a number of restauranteating choices available though the shopping is a relatively weak area In general Long Beach is easily my favorite American airport and is qualitatively far better than the vast majority of facilities I use

As you pull into Long Beach Airport the parking structure is conveniently located right across from the terminal Checkin and security screening took less than minutes in the afternoon hours Long Beach has an open natural and airy terminal You will find palm trees small birds and abundance of sunshine on this terminal There are enough seats for you to sit and relax Dining options are very good Free wifi also works well This airport does not use jet bridge so you will enter and exit the aircraft using stairs or ramp Baggage claim area is small but appropriate for an airport with a vintage look

I fly to LGB twice a year or more to visit family I really cannot say enough good things about this airport especially after the remodel a couple of years ago The place is beautiful It is well laid out it is small and so very easy to deal with I fly Jet Blue and it is almost always on time The restaurants in that terminal are quality and very reasonably priced This was one of the first airports to provide unlimited free wifi I love that you can board and leave the plane from both the front and rear It is so quick If you have to fly to So Cal this is the place to fly too

Ive always enjoyed flying in and out of Long Beach Airport but this time was a big disappointment They used to have remote lots for longterm parking at a reasonable price but now those have been shut down At this point the only option is the shortterm parking which is a bit of a walk from the terminal with a cost of hour maxing out at day or day depending on which building you use That really adds up

This is such a convenient airport Reminds me of a small midwest airport where you park close by check in and at the gate so quickly While not a lot of fancy amenities like the larger international airports this airport is such a breeze

It is simply an airport and not trying to be a shopping mall or anything else Very quick passage through the airport if youre only dropping off bags TSA efficient but thorough bit of a crowd in the north portakabin as JetBlue DL and AS had simultaneous departures but as you can turn up so close to departure its not a long wait Restaurant upstairs is good as well though not cheap and it would be good to have more of the balcony given to noneaters maybe its busier midweek than on a Sunday afternoon

While it is beyond the reach of New York City taxis ISP is five minutes away from Ronkonkoma railroad station in turn a hm train ride to Penn Station This may seem very inconvenient for Newyorkers used to La Guardia airoport but it isnt so bad if compared with JFK The airport is small and efficient There are little or no delays on the ground This field is used primarily by Southwest as its gateway to New York Southwest partner ATA is another visitor while some legacy carriers only offer regional service to their respective hubs or focus cities For those passengers who dont like turboprops be advised that Piedmont Airlines operates from this field with DHCs for Us Airways express while Colgate uses tiny Beechcrafts on flights for Usair express and Continental I find those tiny planes charming but many passengers complain Overall a very pleasant passenger oriented airport

Very nice airport closely situated to New York City and very convenient for all travelling tofrom Long Island Decent selection of shops easy to navigate and not crowded at all when I flew threw both times Local hub for Southwest airlines

Just recently MacArthur Airport here in the middle of Long Island recieved a makeover The makeover included a big new concourse added terminals and new concessions Its beautiful It is a big relief to see the airport go from old and small to new and bigger The new concourse was built and is now primarily owned by Southwest Airlines The layout of the airport is very simple and easy to navigate As soon as you walk in the main entrance you can either make a right to get to the checkin counters or make a left to get to the carousels and pickup a friend that just arrived Security is fairly fast There are a number of concession stands as well as souvenir shops located before after the security checkpoint The following airlines service MacArthur Airport some of the airlines may use a codeshare partner for some flights Southwest Airlines Delta Connection Continental Express US Airways express Brand new concourse terminals concessions

The addition of the new Southwest wing has been a good improvement for all those who enjoy flying on this airline Flying out of this airport has been very convenient because of its location for many Long islanders especially those living in Suffolk and eastern Nassau counties The one drawback to the Southwest facility expansion is the distance from their new gates to the baggage claims area
for this rinky dink breakfast sandwich that has one paper thin small piece of ham on it to call it a ham sandwich This is just highway robbery
As usual gate changed twice necessitating walking between terminals Happened every time visited this airport Most restaurants shut down at pm which means no food on internal flights

My family had a stopover in LAX a few weeks ago My elderly father is disabled and also has a cognitive disability We told a female LAX employee he cant walk on his own She offered to drive him on her cart but told us we my mom my aunt and I we couldnt go with him Then she drove off without telling us where she was going to drop him off After we went through security we did not see my father We started to panic and frantically looked for him for him all over the airport We asked a few LAX employees where we could possibly find him They shrugged and acted like they didnt care None of them got on their phones or walkietalkies to communicate with each other We also informed a customer service agent behind a glass booth and told him we couldnt find my father He was unhelpful and wouldnt go on a public speaker to page my father After over an hour we randomly found my father at an Alaska Airlines counter The airline we were supposed to fly with was Air Canada LAX this is unacceptable You should let family members travel with disabled passengers and train your staff to communicate with each other and with passengers

Its a few years since we last landed or left LAX and things have changed for the better Ahead of the game LAX has installed new scanners so passengers do not have to remove liquids from their bags liquid sizes seem to be the same as before Body scanners are widely used and seem to indicate things in pockets or concealed regularly On entry and leaving it said there was something in the groin area something unusual that is causing me to have a very thorough frisking around that area A few more shops and refreshment options airside now than before The Star Alliance lounge for my transit and the One World Lounge coming home are okay Seating was easy to find and the buffet and drinks were plentiful if simple

I was well on my way to missing my connection flight from Cancun on United to Brisbane via LAX on Qantas The Cancun delay of hour had changed my connection time to one hour Usually an impossible task I was in luck and was travelling using disability services due to a broken foot The disability services had been arranged for each leg and when I mentioned my predicament the staff were just absolutely amazing Firstly the lady who name I cant remember got me through customs and bag pickup in minutes handed me over to a waiting disability transfer van she had called ahead for Once in the international terminal a gentleman by the name of Lyn made a personal effort to get me through all the check points radioing ahead to let all staff know he had a passenger whose flight was boarding Once through all checks he got me on a golf cart and raced me to my gate Without the tremendous kindness and effort of these staff members I wouldnt have made it I made an extra effort to be courteous kind thankful and called everybody by name Its amazing how far people will go if you are actually thankful and polite The bus transfer lady and I had a lovely conversation whilst getting between terminals Im forever grateful to those individuals Thank you LAX for giving me the experience I never thought Id receive

Not inclusive to folks that need assistanc I waited over an hour before my flight started to board which they never showed up If you travel to LAX and need assistance dont expect help here I actually hurt myself worse because I could not get a wheelchair

A very pleasant experience both arriving and leaving this airport the terminal is well designed with some good places to eat and purchase last minute items too There is a business lounge which is a great oasis to relax and catch up on business for a fee which offers drinks and food Baggage collection was fast and was on the reclaim by the time we had walked from the arrival gate to the reclaim The customer service and information is very good and professional as is TSA who all appear to go the extra mile to assist passengers departing

Looking forward to our holiday in Portugal we decided to book TAAG as this would be the quickest flight This is the first time my family and myself have flown using your airline and I can honestly say it will be the last We departed Johannesburg on Monday the th June We had a short layover in Luanda whereby the plane should have left at approximately pm Come boarding time the board read flight boarding however we were told by staff that there was no plane for us and we had to wait The wait took until am after there being another mess with the boarding pass machine written boarding passes were made for what I dont know as all the info on the written pass was the same as the printed pass We thought this was a one off problem however when we returned to SA th July we were met with the same confusion at Luanda Airport No plane available to accommodate us and another long wait of hours and not much information was given from TAAG staff I find this unacceptable The flights cannot be faulted however the airport and ground staff need a lot of work If you are booking flights surely planes should be available and not this hash up

What a horrible airport First off theres no proper ventilation Its stuffy as hell Secondly I tried to buy a beer at a bar and was told they only accept Master Card not Visa Then I went to the food court to buy a juice and was told they only accept local cards This airport can definitely not be classified as an international airport

Wanted to go out and explore Luanda Staff at the airport lied to us and said visa was necessary kept us busy for an hour with no feedback General poor communication No charger ports in the lounge area not properly cleaned

I have travelled all over the world including countries of lower economic standards such as Indonesia India and parts of China I have never seen such a horrible airport Came to airport cant tell where to go with nobody to help or any signs Wait through lines to get boarding pass Then wait at immigration Immigration decided to take a hour break for which nobody got through Afterwards they take all your Angolan currency as part of a government regulatory requirement but dont warn you until theres only one thing to do give it to them Ticket said plane departs and I can board Screen says board at on time comes and nobody knows anything People are rude food should not be called food I liked Angola more than I thought I would but for this airport dismal would be a understatement

One of the smallest airports Ive ever encountered Due to required visas for Laos there was a bit of a hold up at immigration but staff were thorough Luggage made it off the aircraft in an efficient manner so waiting times were minimal The whole arrivals area was so compact you could see the baggage hall from immigration and visa versa Interesting as the chaotic arrivals hall had all doors continually open and once you left the baggage collection area you could easily go back Our arrival was an evening one so most retail outlets were closed and inconveniently also the money exchange Not a bad little airport but renovation and refurbishment needed

I had a problem with the immigration I somehow missed the immigration check after my evening flight from Hanoi to Luang Prabang my responsibility of not having checked if I had a stamp The next day I went back and they charged me on top of what I already paid made me sign a paper written in Laos not a copy or a picture I was able to take after I asked I paid as there were no other option They were not nasty but not kind they kept telling me its my fault for not checking No sharing the responsibility or acknowledged that they might have not done a proper job on their hands So check your stamps before you leave there are different separate lines to do one for the visa the other for the immigration stamp and be aware that they can play the game they want At the end all is good you pay and you have your passport back with a big smile from their side

Luang Prabang International is a small and pleasant airport with a decent selection of amenities and relatively good service Upon arrival in Luang Prabang immigration officials will direct you to the relevant desks for passport checks if you dont need a visa you will be directed straight to the passport control desks The airport has a money changer located right outside the arrivalsdepartures area where the US dollar rate is relatively similar to the rates quoted in town There is a desk to order a taxi for kip per person or if you prefer a cheaper ride you can try to hail a tuktuk from outside the terminal Checkin was very quick on my flight departing Luang Prabang and I cleared the immigration check within minutes as my SilkAir flight had few passengers Inside the airport there are some shops selling local crafts and duty free outlets though they werent very interesting Anyone whos flying Bangkok Airways will be pleased to not that they have a waiting lounge in this airport There was plenty of seating in the gate areas and boarding of my flight was very efficient All in all this is a good airport to use if you ever have a chance to use it and if your flight isnt full

Arrivals worked well with friendly staff quick bags and an efficient visa on arrival system My flight was lightly loaded but there might be a significant delay with a full flight Departures were a little unusual Check in emigration and security all worked well but the airside facilities are a little unusual The departure lounge is on two levels the lower level has a small cafe with limited food options and two small duty free shops Upstairs there are a number of shops selling tourist gifts plus a large outlet on a third level which has most of the items you find in Luang Prabangs night market but not at the same price When I visited there were no catering facilities in the upper lounge but there was a massage parlour with six passengers all having a foot massage I would have been happy with this small airport whose terminal is a couple of years old but for the fact that some bags were not loaded on my Vietnam Air flight to Hanoi due to a Technical Problem I dont know whether this was the fault of the airline or the airport

The staff are helpful and the airport is so user friendly I accidently dropped my Aadhaar card somewhere maybe in the flight or the airport without me knowing They found it and gave it to me in the shuttle bus They saved me so much trouble

There is no jet bridge at Lucknow airport so you have walk down the stairs from the aircraft and board a bus Overall the airport is very small so there isnt much walking to do During my return flight I arrived at Lucknow airport hours before departure standard practice at many US airports I was told to sit in a waiting area and checkin hours before departure Checkin bags are screened before you visit the checkin counter Once you clear security the boarding area is small with limited seating

Travelled into and out of here on a LCYZRHLUG long weekender last summer and look forward to doing the same again this year Incoming as smooth as expected outgoing return complicated by a fault on the outbound plane but didnt miss my London connection as a result and the small but civilised departure area think those few Ryanair routes that involve local airports that arent hastily assembled wooden shacks offered a wellstocked duty free shop and a sporadically manned bar Shopsbars available outside the airport for departing passengers and accompanying friends and family no problem with one final Swiss beer before checking in at short notice All in all a very pleasant experience

Arrived and departed from Lugano Airport last week It surely is one of the smallest airports I have ever seen Passport control is extremely fast baggage reclaim too SWISS does not yet recognize priority labeling from other Star Alliance members Regular shuttle service to and from Lugano city centre is timed to match arrivals and departures from and to Zurich There are a few shops and restaurants outside the airport Checkin on departure is very swift too The staff are highly motivated and efficient They managed to have our luggage checked through to final destination although our onward flight from Zurich was not booked under the same reservation code Yet again no priority labels You then go through security control and are in the waiting area about five minutes after entering the terminal building Only downside there is not much you can do after passing through the security control But then it is only minutes from arriving in the departure area to boarding

Incredibly poor and unsafe customer service In the departure hall at the gates I cannot find hand sanitizer anywhere They have bottles of it standing at each gate but behind glass and only for staff use

For international flights Lusaka now has a brand new airport and it is considerably better than the old airport which is now only used for domestic flights The new airport is spacious and currently clean and well maintained and well ventilated Check in is usually quite speedy Airside there are a few shops and cafes and currently a basic lounge though another is opening soon My only criticism is limited use of the airbridges but I was told that the airlines need to have a correct tow bar which some have and some do not hence some planes parking and passengers walking tofrom the terminal In rains you can be bussed Lots of immigration officers means it is quite quick to enter Zambia now

We passed through LUN briefly on two occasions in September and found it to be a pleasant small airport with a couple of interesting features The first one was that when disembarking from a domestic flight one is led into the terminal building but the door to the main terminal is always closed so the person leading you has to knock on an adjacent partition wall to get someones attention to come and open the door We thought that was cute The second feature was the presence of a coffeecappuccino wagon in the terminal area dispensing a variety of freshly brewed coffees as well as freshly squeezed orange juice We thought that was a very civilized touch and considering there didnt appear to be any restaurants or cafes available that we could see at least that simple option was appreciated

Considering this is an airport in a poor African country Lusaka Intl Airport isnt that bad The arrival hall is rather small en dark but it is possible to leave the airport only minutes after landing The immigration officers Ive only seen female ones are kind and easy going and I can say the same about the airport staff in general The sanitary provisions are old but clean The departing hall is more modern from the late s and there is more space and light Theres one bar and one shop Just be aware of some huge leaks in the roof during rainshowers at some places miniwaterfalls come into being

I had a bad feeling as we queued for the temporary drop off zone at Luton airport as I had heard horror stories of this airport in the past but I went into the journey with an open mind We flew out with Ryanair and check in was an absolute breeze with no hold ups at all Security was very busy but we had FastTrack purchased and cleared the lanes within a few moments the staff were very friendly and helpful to us as we passed and even were open for a laugh The departures area can feel a little claustrophobic with low ceilings till you reach the main area There is good choice of FB as you pass through with a nice selection of shops to spend some money Seating is decent as well outside the FB areas so there is space to take a load off I spotted a nasty spillage on the floor and spoke to a cleaner who told me she would attend to it straight away The gate are for Ryanair and Wizz was a little cramped down the corridor with limited space but if you time it right you wont be there long Overall a very surprising experience at LTN and one I didnt expect
Giving up on Luton Parking is so ridiculously expensive were picking Gatwick or LHR from now on All good other than that so not much else to say

Arriving on a cold wet after Midnight flight I was delighted to see a shuttle bus to take us to the pick up in the Mid stay car park So we sat on the coach and after about minutes we moved off Down the road about yards it stopped at what I assumed were red traffic lights on the main road no that was the end of the journey We then had to haul ourselves and luggage up the hill into the car park This was made worst by the pick up point being located at the far righthand corner What a waste of time Whilst operational difficulties due to the fire are understood the arrangements are very poor

The worst of the London Airports by far I have used this place for some YEARS now and all its done is take one step back for every step forward They save money at the expense of the traveller by simply putting too few staff on Departure checks and even at am on a late October morning they only had a handful of overworked checkers and MANY empty booths yet a long LONG line of travellers getting more and more anxious as the time frittered away ON top of that they have progressively expanded the ridiculous farce of making every one waste time by being FORCED to go through a serpentine retail experience with no chance of any short cut It may be the easiest for us to get to but in future I will travel the extra miles to Stansted and I recommend others in East Anglia to do the same A Cheap and NOT Cheerful Airport to use Be warned

I got to the airport two and a half hours before my flight was due and joined a queue to check in as I couldnt do it on line and put baggage in hold after queuing for nearly an hour because there were not enough desks open was told to go to help desk definitely not helpful to pay each to check in then go back to the first check in and get boarding passes Then had to take luggage to yet another area as it was a large case so yet another queue Then it was on to security and that was another massive queue where nobody new what the other was doing and due to the time we had to spend there the gate for our flight was closed and we were unable to fly When asked for help was told we would have to buy another ticket for a flight that wasnt for another hours and go through it all again The staff in every department from security airline help desk and Airport are all agency staff and they dont want to take responsibility for anything Over on Flights Luggage Parking and Transport to and from Airport and I never got to leave the country I beg anyone reading this do not use Wizz Air or Luton Airport as they are unfriendly unhelpful and unprofessional
This Airport if you can call it an Airport is the worst place i have ever been and it gets worse every time Unorganized crowded expensive filthy no food no service Avoid this place at all cost
