This was my first time going to Myanmar We landed in Mandalay International Airport An airport clearly built a long time ago awaiting the prosperous times ahead The immigration control took a bit of time since there was an aircraft arriving from China Eastern at the same time as ours Airport staff directed some of us westerners to the Diplomats counter which cut the waiting time at immigration substantially At the airport the currency exhange rates offered for US and Euro were best at the Farmers Bank

Mandalay International Airport was built at the turn of the st century It serves both domestic and international destinations and is designed like many airports around the world it just works slightly differently somehow Arriving on a domestic flight you are bussed into the single terminal building where you walk passed unmanned Passport Control Desks to one of baggage carousels before having your baggage hand and hold scanned and into a large Arrivals Hall with the usual selection of booths and a small cafshop selling bottled water There are TV Screens showing which flights are coming or going Marble floors and air conditioned Departures start with the need to scan all you bags hand and hold before going to Checkin Counters which are clearly numbered in banks A B C and D After this is the a boarding pass check and into the Departure Hall which is upstairs Checkin and arrivals are on the ground floor There is a large selection of shops and a couple of barcafes not all of which are open for domestic flights Security Scanning is done at the gate and Gate seems to be where all the domestic flights leave from via a pier down to a bus In the Gate area there are no shops or toilet facilities just rows of seats looking out on to the apron and in the distance the runway parallel to the terminal building The airport is larger than the current traffic levels so it does not feel crowded or too busy but it has a new feeling that none of the other airports in Burma Myanmar have

After the splendour of Yangon Airport International not Domestic which hasnt been updated since easily the s Mandalay Airport is reminder of what could have been Coming in to land the airport looks deserted We were brought to the larger looking terminal by bus and instantly I recognised the Japanese design having lived in Japan for several years Aside from the outstanding design nothing else was even close to Japan Most of the lights were off immigration desks looked abandoned and one of the panels of glass separating the baggage and arrival halls was badly smashed Still service is efficient if only because there is no one to serve facilities mostly work and taxis are plentiful If the reforms continue to improve Myanmar this airport could be a real gem If you need to fly to Mandalay and domestic flights are not as scary as they sound it will do just fine but lets hope for better days

It seems very under used airport comparing the facility and the passengers go through here Its all new a couple years old with very long runway Arriving from CNX on Air Mandalays prop plane seems odd on this runway Its located pretty far out from Mandalay city center The airport seems deserted after all passengers left

I have been flying from Mangalore International Airport domestically for a very long time Ill be honest the checkin baggage claim or the security is just literally the same like any other airport with less people The airport is calm and clean Restrooms are provided The only drawback is there is no source of recreation and entertainment here We have a couple of eateries but very very very limited WiFi is provided But when we speak about shopping Dont depend on Mangalore Airport it has nothing Trust me nothing The last time I visited there was a food stall at the ground floor and an umbrellaraincoat shop and a metal item store at the first floor That is it No clothes no alcohol no McDonalds etc But all in all its a good airport I mean its catering for the needs of Mangalorians Arrival also went very smooth

Never seen such a laid back airport as Mangalore I had a flight to Mumbai at am and I reached the airport by am only to find out the checkin counters are all closed and open at am only There were many passengers like me waiting for checkin After staff for Jet Airways arrived the counters opened and I got my boarding pass again was made to wait for security checking to open The counters of security checking opens only after am all employees were seen gossiping having their tea and so lethargic And there were so many passengers waiting even passengers with special assistance Never came across such a lethargic airport

Very small airport with very limited facilities I am amazed that this is an international airport If you are stuck in this airport for a few hours there is nothing to do However check in and security a breeze and seems very organised

Main airport to Philippines terminals squeezed round runways Terminal International Arrivals has airbridges and a shortish walk to Passport Control Important to get your eTravel declaration done before passport control usual baggage reclaim and customs check before getting out of the airport Very busy arrivals area with many taxi offering their services and congested parking directly opposite Terminal is mainly Philippine Airlines with a domestic and international section You have to show your passport and ticketBoarding pass to get into the terminal and get all your bags scanned Checkin Desks and a few other amenities before going through security The Departures Lounge is for domestic flights and separate to the International one A small selection of cafe and similar and gatesair bridges Limited seating means it can get very busy if a few flights go at a similar time There is patchy WiFi

Worst airport I have ever visited Less comfortable chairs for the passengers to rest worst is many are with long hours transit You will see many passengers sleeping on the floor along the walkway to the departure gates Foods are pricy with limited choices Luxury stores are with less items on display WiFi is not strong enough Internal looks old and a bit run down The airport has to be upgraded to preserve the image dignity of the country

Worst airport I have ever seen No food selection available only a scarse choice No place to take a seat to eat in terminal Very old and outdated airport Also arrival was very chaotic Taking a taxi is an adventure Sim card for Internet is at extortionate rate Security do not follow international rules set by Civil Aviation Authority but they have their own rules Be ready to have unexpected issues when going through security I travel the world and can confirm thst Manila Ninoy DAquino is definitely the worst airport in the world

I have never experience such chaotic and overcrowding lines to Terminal checkin counters of PAL Four lines waiting for our turn to have our luggage xrayed by One machine Average wait is about hours Then another average hours in line to checkin luggage And all this waiting is just to checkin on one airline PAL Even at LAX Tom Bradley terminal with more Passengers coming and going is never this chaotic

Waiting for our luggage took me hr mins to wait for my luggage to show up as most of us passengers did The fact that only there was only airplanes that has arrived Immigration officers were as efficient as they can be

I have never see anything like this They scan your carry on bag it is ridiculous They scan it again before entering the plane and after you pass customs They sit you behind the a gate like a bunch of animals if you go to the washroom just beside your seat but the other side of the blue ribbon you have to go in the line up again It is my last time with Philippine Airlines never again

I fly almost every month abroad for work and sadly always end up in Terminal of NAIA If youre departing from the terminal theres only restaurant before the immigration so if you arrive before your check in counter opens sadly you wont even have anywhere else to sit Always crowded and since the checkin counter area is pretty small the lines between airline counters can get confusing esp when the terminal is busy Arriving in the Terminal however is much worse There are I think electronic counters open and most of them dont work properly Other than that there are only manual counters where those who cant pass the ecounters coz they dont work all fall in line at There is an electronic checkin supervisor booth beside the ecounters but they dont even assist the passengers who have a hard time passing through And dont get me started on baggage claim Itll take you mins hr to get your luggage

Manila Airport should be avoided at any cost Last three times I have been there Airport lounges are fully booked and can not accommodate passengers Dirty unorganized ridiculous cues at immigration There are no smoking zones at the airport and if youre a smoker better avoid this airport and Manila itself Food will be served with plastic cutlery so you can imagine cutting a piece of meat Philippines has been such an awesome place warming welcoming affordable and reasonably priced foreigner and tourist friendly Unfortunately not any more Next time I am flying via Singapore irrespective of cost Simply avoid Manila at any cost if you care about your dignity and you value your money Thank you

Eventually helpful staff but they are all transfixed on to mobile phones constantly so fairly hard to get their attention Departure area is an uncomfortable chaotic hot very old area with absolutely nowhere to buy water or a coffee whilst waiting for your counter to open I had to stand for hrs with no water as my previous domestic flight to Manila arrived hrs before the next Be careful when transferring from one Terminal to the next very tricky and a lot of scammers everywhere There is WiFi in the airport but it is the slowest WiFi on earth All in all not a good experience at all

Having visited over airports worldwide Ive heard tales of corrupt security practices but my recent experience at Maputo International Airport has left me genuinely shaken The entire process felt intrusive and intimidating leaving a lasting negative impression My taxi was stopped at the airport entrance and police officers searched through my belongings While I understand the countrys ongoing conflict with rebels this level of scrutiny seemed excessive After passing through the initial security check I had to wait for a green light from the police before proceeding to checkin The checkin area was minuscule serving only a handful of airlines The air conditioning was barely adequate and the overall ambience felt cramped and uncomfortable A few souvenir shops and snack bars lined the waiting area along with two VIP lounges The real ordeal began after checking in As I ascended a staircase two security officials approached me in a forceful manner demanding to know how much cash I was carrying and if I had any local currency or USD I explained that I primarily used digital payments and only had around in cash for purchasing a snack Despite my explanation they insisted that Brazilians are wealthy and should have more money They proceeded to rummage through my bags scrutinizing my belongings with an aggressive attitude I remained calm throughout the ordeal reiterating that I only had the clothes on my back and some cosmetics Their search yielded nothing and they eventually gave up appearing visibly frustrated This unsettling experience left me feeling deeply intimidated I noticed that the security officials worked in groups making it clear that travelers should never attempt to pass through security alone The entire encounter left a sour taste in my mouth and I sincerely hope to never return to Mozambique

Maputo airport is very close to the city centre It consists of two vast glass buildings domestic international totally of proportion to the small numberof flightspassengers However checkin area was quite busy security was rapid and airside was bright and airy A few souvenir and dutyfree shops and a number of airline lounges most of which were closed Airbridges looked tired and rusty

Arrival at Maputo Airport is via air stairs to the ramp to the terminal There is no covering that I could see in the event of rain Inside the arrival area is what seems to be a mass of confusion at the desk where one collects his visa unless you are one of those coming from a country not requiring a visa Following issuance of the visa one then has to clear immigration to have an entry stamp put in hisher passport This is a slow procedure and one is frequently asked where one will be staying so best to keep a copy of your hotel confirmation with you Customs is simple enough where all baggage is screened in an xray machine Following this you are finished and can exit the terminal Note that there is presently no air conditioning in the terminal and it can be hot Also lighting is rather limited Departure is likewise slow I arrived hours before my flight time and had to sit and wait almost hour for the counter to open Again the terminal lacks air conditioning the story being that the system is under repair Following check in one takes an escalator to an upper floor where one processes through immigration which oddly enough is a fairly fast process The departure area has a few shops and some airline lounges but is otherwise fairly devoid of anything Flights are called over a loudspeaker system and one descends again to the ground level and proceeds out of the building across the tarmac to hisher plane The very worst part of utilizing Maputo Airport is the arrival where it seems that confusion reigns mostly due to the matter of issuance of a visa and having it applied to ones passport This occurs even if one has acquired the previsa on line and involves paying the fee for issuance of the visa Note the visa fee can be paid by cash or credit card Visa Master Card only If you have secured the online previsa be sure to bring a print out of it to show to the visa issuing clerks There are some countries that do not require a visa and apparently this number has just been expanded although the expansion has yet to be implemented as of this writing If you have not secured a previsa and are from a country that requires a visa you can be delayed by this process for as much as hours In my case I asked the tour company with which I arranged my bookings and tours in Mozambique to arrange a meet and assist service for both arrival and departure at Maputo Airport This was a good investment and I tipped to man who assisted me with US I highly recommend this type of service for a firsttime visitor

One nice feature of Maputo Airport is that it has one of the few remaining exterior viewing terraces so you can stand outside and take in arrivals and departures A worse airport on arrival than on departure with the slow waiting around for visas on arrival be sure to have exact change if you can and the relatively slow delivery of baggage which may or may not have items missing or delayed if your transit was via JNB

A pretty basic airport but seems to function fine At customs people needing visas need to line up in the visas line if you line up anywhere else youll just be told to go to the visa line Its a bit confusing as the booth is slightly behind the others Visas are US cash there are no change facilities so be prepared They take your money and passport and then walk over to an office near the baggage claim where the visas are processed Everyone has to stand around and wait in front of the office until an immigration official walks out with a stack of passports and starts calling out names at which point they will give you back your passport with the visa inside In the meantime you can collect your bags the carousel is literally metres away Plenty of taxis right out the front you cant miss them Barclays ATM also just outside so easy to get local currency Outbound the checkin is pretty straightforward though I would suggest getting there a bit early as it looks like it would get mad in a rush Public toilets on the second floor a little bit away from the action but nice and clean Not much past customs other than the ubiquitous bar but nice to have one last Laurentina premium before leaving
I am not sure when you went to the airport in maracaibo but things have change a lot Prices are not as bad and there is lots of choices to eat and drink very reasonable

Maracaibo city is the hottest city in Venezuela and so is its airport degrees or more it would appear that the air conditioner system is not working at all This airport itself and its staff is another story compared to Caracas Intl I spent hours in Maracaibos airport and I found nothing but rude and careless staff all around the airport My flight to Miami was delayed apparently for some problems with the jet bridges that at least I did not have the chance to see or walk through to get to the airplane The prices are extremely high in restaurants and stores I just cant understand why Maracaibo being such an important economic centre in Venezuela since it is the heartland of the oil has such a dull and unfriendly airport

The worst airport experience ever Security check after security check Police is performing racial profiling selecting anyone travelling from a non EU countries and taking fingerprints Signs in the airport are extremely confusing Check in personnel are lazy chatting among themselves rather than working No fast food in the waiting lounges just some extremely dry sandwiches

The Cleaning ladies in all toilets at the airport remove the toilet paper from the cabins and if you ask for paper they ask for a charge I think its really mean and it should not be like this Toilet paper should be provided for free

Our experience at Marrakech Mnara Airport was an absolute nightmare The checkin process was a complete disaster primarily due to an apparent shortage of baggage handlers This caused a massive backlog resulting in an unreasonably long line that moved at a snails pace Passengers were left stranded and stressed with no clear communication or guidance from airport staff It felt as though no one was in charge and the lack of organization was appalling What should have been a straightforward process turned into an ordeal that left us scrambling to make our flight For an airport that serves as a gateway to such a vibrant and beautiful city the management here is a glaring disappointment If youre traveling through Marrakech prepare for frustration and delays Truly one of the worst airport experiences Ive ever had

Marrakesh airport off season is a breeze and my opinion may be different if I was arrivingdeparting with the European holiday crowd My biggest focus when traveling business class is an airport than can offer differentiating services for that class of service It was not clear on arrival if we had access to Fast Track and could not find much information about it but with the limited number of passengers queueing at immigration we just went with the crowd On departure we had a better experience Getting inside the terminal requires queuing with all passengers but we obtained access to Fast Track for security and immigration following our checkin at Air France business checkin counter There is a chocking point following immigration where all passengers converge but it was fairly quick considering the slow season Great shopping and an amazing little Royal Air Maroc full service lounge made the rest of our airport experience enjoyable One really concerning point The free airport Internet was not working well besides the light crowd I cannot imagine how bad it gets during the busy travel season

After reading all the poor reviews I really readied myself for my arrival and departure I had to leave this review because I actually had an ok experience Im a regular traveller and have been to many airports Arrival yes it took about an hour to get through and out the airport I didnt need to collect luggage and sat at the front of the plane so was first in the queues If I was at the back I expected it to take or maybe longer hours to get through Deparute had me most worried I was flying out at pm so arrived at it took mins to transfer from centre of the city to airport the driver said it or Ally takes mins tops Yes there was a queue to get into the airport but we spent about Mins waiting Its a simple Xray machine and the time it rakes it just the time it takes people to push their bag through There was no messing around You have to check in even if hand luggage only There were about checkout outs ope For jet and and I was through in about mins Next is security which again was fast no people took mins or less Passport control was straight after and again hardly anyone there so it was through in less then mins Overall it was a normal experience with only the arrival taking long and potentially causing a problem Overall this was not as bad as I thought it would be Maybe I was very lucky But if you are revelling too just expect a long arrival And give plenty of time to depart

Ive been in lots and lots of airports in my life this is by far the worst incredibly poor We booked vip longe per person and for that we got a cup of tea and a cold slice of pizza The staff where charming but not very helpful Because we where VIP we were speedily passed through a security check this only took hour We were stopped at desks to check our small hand bags after every stop and search I told security weve just been checked he answered in Arabic Im bored and my boss is over there I bit my lip as I understand limited Arabic but I knew they were playing with an old English couple By the third check I asked in English this is third check He smiled this quick you VIP check Then I answered in Arabic to see his boss our bags where swiftly zipped through with an apologetic statement and a shy smile I called over the police security man and told him in Arabic what was going on in his hall He apologised and rushed us the right way through This spoilt our holiday immensely paying to be played with and cups of tea and a cold slice of pizza Was going back to Marsa Alam in February Not again will I step inside this circus of an airport Hargahda airport is head and shoulders above Never again in Egypt sorry

The departure from Marsa Alam was very unsatisfactory Security procedures were slow queues were long and personal was very customerunfriendly It took hours from entering the airport to getting to the gate checkin time was just minutes though Passengers are treated unprofessionally

The airport has not changed since I was last here two years ago On arrival we collected our visa from the bank desk cost now which was very slow because everything done by the teller had to be checked by the person watching him Only one of the six passport desks was open although there were a lot of staff around watching the queue for the rudimentary non checking stamping of the passport followed by two more staff independently checking it had been stamped Baggage arrived quite quickly Upon departure all our bags were Xrayed on entry to the terminal queue then we queued progressing very slowly at the only two desks open to checkin queue Then we queued to go through passport control passing through clouds of cigarette smoke from those watching the queue Airside facilities cafe food etc nothing has changed including the erratic quality of the free WIFI and the attempts of the toilet attendant to get a tip of or for use of the free toilet Queue relatively short was that for the airport bus As airports go this is better that any other Egyptian airport I have been to it would be superb is those watching the queues or watching others do their job would work as well

This airport is almost third world in many ways Terminal T has a staff of immigration which is woefully understaffed rude and inefficient It need more staff and also machines that work would help T immigration can be even worse Toilets are closed the restaurants are expensive as most airports and often do not have much choice No seating after security in Terminal if you remove shoes queuing is inefficient at security The airport Terminal is modern ie a shopping centre but the staff are not well trained Baggage handling is slow and slovenly sometimes waiting minutes for bags Management needs to look at operations This is a busy airport with an increasing number of destinations it needs to update services

This review is solely for T We visited Terminal as there was no where to sit in T literally sits all taken T for larger carriers is good and plenty of seating so if you arrive early for checkin Id recommend going to T T on the other hand is the worst airport Ive been to and Ive been to Basrah during conflict As mentioned pre checkin seating is poor and the whole venue is like some poorly put together art piece concrete floors and walls Really nasty place to be Once you checkin you then have to walk your bags around to another location for your baggage to go be scanned and loaded first time ever for that The security are rude and abrupt and in one case verbally aggressive but for legal reasons I cannot divulge the details Then once you get through its like a cattle shed hot and stinking with a lack of resources so after spending on some sandwiches we were ushered to the plane where once again there was no seating just some planks of wood to lean on I only gave based on the time it took to get through the airport to the plane which to be fair was swift thankfully Avoid where possible

Where to start On arrival it appears to be a temporary structure converted for use as an arrivals hall Two flights landed at the same time and we were herded into an endless queue for passport control with only officers The electronic passport control was no better as only of the lanes were working As bad as that was departures was even worse Again endless queue for a bag drop as no designated line for that got stuck behind a huge school group who were all checking in bags Then once you finally reach the end of the queue they give your bag back to you to go around the corner to enter another queue to hand your bag to a porter so he can check the tag against your birding pass and put it on the conveyor belt Next ANOTHER queue for security this one actually wasnt too bad On to duty free not bad but not enough seating There are apparently lines to go through passport control But they dont tell announce which line is yours until the last minute just so everyone can make a mad dash to the line only to find out that both sides lead to the same place We were directed to the electronic passport control EU passports only out of were working but it was still quicker than the other queue We then entered a corridor leading to the seats at the gate But the door was locked and we had to queue AGAIN until somebody came to open it and check our passports and boarding passes m past the actual passport control There is a sign at the entrance stating Terminal was inaugurated in but it really feels more like something from Avoid if you can Im giving it a rating of out of only because the website wont let me give

We entered terminal where we dropped a friend off to their flight Terminal was lovely Air conditioned and seemed like there were no queues Then we walked towards where terminal was this was where our flight was leaving from There were queues outside the airport for what we thought was the baggage drop off was We queued for over half an hour before realising this wasnt the queue for the easy jet flights The signage was atrocious there was nothing to say that this was the baggage checkin for Ryan air We then went into the building knowing we had wasted over half an hour On entry to the building we were greeted by yet more queues We queued for about half an hour just to get the bags weighed only to be given our bags back to then queue again with our bags This next queue was like the herding of cattle into a milking parlour It was horrific People were so squashed together now trying to funnel through a small space like sand in an old fashioned sand timer We then queued for another hour to place our bags about m from where they were weighed By this time we had only minutes to get to our flight and we hadnt even gone through security yet Thankfully the rest of the process went more smoothly if it hadnt we wouldnt have made the flight The whole experience was stressful and a horrible end to our lovely holiday Shambolic The staff were overwhelmed and couldnt help The system was archaic and reminded me of family holidays over years ago Appalling

I came by taxi to the airport and it felt like the airports doesnt have a nice place where the taxi could stop Inside it felt confusing with two different security checks In the security check to the left in nd floor one young man was kind but the others seemed to have get bored of their job long time ago So far this is minor flaws but the real reason behind this review is to let go of some frustration related to the almost total lack of providing something to eat except some dry sandwiches and just a little more

This airport is a mess and whilst they are expanding the terminal the present areas are poor The shopping and cafes restaurants are very limited and poor for what calls itself an international airport Toilets are a disgrace filthy and poorly maintained Boarding gate areas are overcrowded hot with very poor aircon dirty carpeting and no sight of a cleaner anywhere WiFi is non existent and the handful of charging points are almost inaccessible for most For what is effectively a state owned airport Marseille Airport is an absolute disgrace and needs private owners to come in and make it fit for purpose

Its beautifully located airport in the outskirts of Marseille and next to the sea Good public transportation from Marseille city center to the airport Bus after every mins Airport structure is lacking a good maintenance although big part of the airport is going through major facelift renovations that could really confuse the departing passengers as the signages arent very clear or bilingual to guide passenger towards a right direction Waiting area and washrooms temperature is warmer than outside temperature Passengers were literally sweating bullets and kids were crying its just too hot I enjoyed the tarmac view though and also like how they let people to board either by jetty or just walk to the plane I will review it again once all the work would be done and hopefully airport would be in much better shape

I was there at am to catch a flight to Istanbul It wasnt crowded but the airport simply lacks basic facilities which appear to be a problem when it gets crowded Very few shops after the passport control were open and there werent any restaurants at the International terminal or I didnt find one open The airport is clean The passport control is fast but the security guards are not very friendly Actually if you have to travel to Mashhad its not that bad Even comparing to the airport in the capital city Tehran it is soso

I was in the airport international terminal around am International terminal is quite newly built and not completed No food or snack or shop available Passport control fast and efficient Not enough seats after passport control Check in area is very crowded when there are two three flights It is better to be at airport at least hrs before departure time Normally you do not need more than min from the city to airport but in some seasons and for some events it may take more than an hour so check with hotel reception not to miss the flight

My fiancee and I flew in from Cape Town and had a hour layover at this airport prior to taking our next flight to our first bush camp in Kanana So we strolled outside to do some souvenir shopping and get some refreshments at the cafe just outside the airport On the way there I stopped at the smokers hut and had a cigarette Obviously I pulled my mask down in order to smoke When I finished I threw my cigarette butt away in the provided trash can and adjusted a few items in my backpack about seconds had passed bw my throwing away my cigarette butt and thats when Maun airport police officer approached me He rudely asked Why are you not wearing your mask I replied I just finished a cigarette He even more rudely said to me And that is your defense I replied Well it is my reason I pulled the mask up he scowled at me I expect this sort of behavior when I go to the post office or to renew my drivers license but I would imagine the city of Maun the airport and definitely the many bush camps in the region largely benefit from tourism that comes to the area and those tourists do have a choice One disgruntled mans actions will harm an entire region and people and that would be a shame

Just landed and I didnt realise I had to fill in a form umtil I was in the customs queue Once I knew I immediately started filling in my form and once at the counter I was asked where i would be staying how long etc all the usual stuff He then asked how much cash I had which I found extremily unusual especially holding an Australian passport When I told him he seemed alarmed and consulted his workmate next to him It was then they told me I needed to have such and such a day being in Mauritus Internally I was laughing thinking yeah of course I have money in the bank to cover costs while here I just had little cash on me at the time Anyway this is what really annoyed me the most theres no train no bus services etc to the airport at least not after pm so I was told so the only way was via taxi Their taxis have no meters so it seems like their all working together to rip off every potential customer They have one head guy with a taxi badge he says it will cost so and so amount you think to yourself thats a rip off considering what my dollar is worth compared to yours I cant believe their government allows these scammers at the international airport what a joke coming to a small island and having this happen as your first or second port of call I think something so simple as metered taxis need to be implemented

No bookstore or magazine stand Our flight was delayed and except for the ridiculously priced shops there was nowhere a person could buy a book to read while waiting for the delayed flight I find this unacceptable as most flights with Air Mauritius will be delayed at some point during your trip so please assist passengers that are not glued to their phones and would actually like to purchase a book to read

Probably the best island airport in the Indian Ocean Well designed structure the only challenge is the long queue in the immigration hall The authorities need to arrange extra officers during peak timings

Check in was slow but this was the airlines responsibility and not a reflection on the airport Signage around the airport is good and the terminal was nice and clean There is no smoking anywhere inside the airport Smoking is only permitted in designated areas outside the terminal building As I was a business class passenger I used the fast track through passport control and security and I was pleased I could as the queue to use the normal passenger route was very long indeed Security screening was as efficient as it could be and the only delay to the process was passengers unpacking items which needed to be screened separately It still amazes me that passengers still dont know how items need to be separated for screening and what items should be removed from the body belts coins watches etc So passengers slowed the process and not the screening and security staff There is a good amount of seating available in the departure lounge A good range of shopping and food and beverages is available in the departure lounge but there is no electronics shop hours free WiFi is available and while speed isnt fantastic its sufficient

I was extremely impressed My flight from Paris arrived at and there was a bit of a walk from the arrival gate to immigration but there didnt appear to be any other arriving flights There was no queue and I was processed within seconds of arriving at immigration On arrival at baggage reclaim my bag was already on the carousel I think its safe to say I was out of the airport within minutes of arrival

I must say I was quite surprised with this relatively new airport It is well designed and all checkin security and boarding processes were very efficient The free wifi connection is probably one of the best services Ive experienced so far The choice of dining and shopping are also very good The airport itself is quite far from the city but there is a train service to the city

First time contributing to this thread and I must say Kuala Namu International Airport looks pretty modern and roomy indeed something I truly want to see in a functioning airport I mean yes it has opened recently yet I saw in the preopening photos a lot of modern features from streamlined checkin desks and a variety of shops Im surprised I saw a branch of Cotton On at the airport to modern jetways and small plants placed along the waiting areas near gates I wonder if those are actual palm trees
This is a well designed airport There is no hassle from porters and taxi operators Checking in is very fast and efficient Arrival luggage handling is very good

Finally the new Medan Airport opened after a few years delay and it was just weeks old when I touched down at Kuala Namu The terminal building itself is stunning a combination of Suvarnabhumi and KLIA with lots of daylight The gate holdrooms are huge with comfy chairs and you can see the tarmac clearly Airside and landside shops and restaurants are not entirely opened but lots of interesting shops and restaurants will open soon Check in area is also airy huge shiny and modern This is the first airport in Indonesia with a direct rail link to the city and the train station even though its not entirely finished also stunningly designed Arrival areas still has a lot of things to be completed as the airport is just soft opened Hopefully when its officially opened in September all the facilities are ready

I and my wife travelled via Medan Polonia Airport twice in December I lived in Medan for over years in the past and have relatives still living there Im trying to review this with appropriate comparisons against other airports Ive visited by taking into account their relative sizes and passenger movements I think Polonia airport was still terrible As soon as we stepped outside the arrival terminal taxi drivers approached us making us feeling uncomfortable The taxi was unmetered We were charged IDRk for a short travel On the departure we arrived earlier hrs before flight and had to wait until the Garuda checkin counter was opened There was absolutely no single seat or chair anywhere from the entrance up to the checkin area We were forced to sit on the trolley and on the floor The checkin process was messy Some people stood in between queuing lines Some people blocked the queue although they did not intend to checkin When I compared Polonias today with Polonia years ago I absolutely saw almost no improvement except for a renovation that followed a fire disaster a few years ago

I have used Polonia six times in the last four year both international and domestic arrival and departure No problems with taxis overcharging just as for any airport do your research Be affirmative informed and polite

The state of Indonesian airports is sad This hub is dank and dirty Wait until youre on the plane to use the restroom If youre just arriving you will be besieged by porters who will grab your bags without asking then hustle to the exit Just say no with a smile and that should do the trick The airport uses a taxi voucher system which will charge you a flat tho grossly inflated fee depending on your hotel Expect to pay IDR easily double what you would pay on a meter Not the best introduction to Indonesia if this is your first port of call
The airport services were very attentive to the plane we arrived at local time when we left the plane the luggage gang was already in operation and the suitcases were in very good condition

First time arriving in this beautiful country together with wife for umrah Arrived by Malaysia Airlines A and departure with same aircraft Facilities well kept staff welcome us with a smile Easy flow for arriving and departing

Not Verified Bags didnt arrive with us Jeddah staff were probably responsible for this mishap Didnt issue a receipt for luggage Medina staff were very efficient and tracked and delivered bags a day later However they still kept on calling us back to ask if we received bags Staff at check in counter not efficient at all Didnt return our passports We walked off only to realize that it wasnt returned to us and returned to fetch passports Check in and departure were delayed Most disgusting of all was the foul smelling toilets below the beautiful mosque outside the airport

The airport is incapable of maintaining basic facilities and cleanliness standards One if the two water fountains in the international gate area adjacent gate not working Seems to have been broken for some time Windows in the gate area have clearly not been cleaned for days The grime and hand prints were terrible Car parking exit wayfinding signage at the new T terminal carpark is plain absent in some areas It all about greed

On th September our plane from Dubai landed at am On exiting the plane we found toilets very small and run down mens toilet with just cubicles ladies toilets hidden some distance away around a corner totally inadequate for hundreds of people disembarking Massive queues starting well before the dutyfree area Electronic passport checking initial set of machines were randomly refusing to issue tickets to many people about No border force staff monitoring the machines that were malfunctioning No clear directions as to how to queue having been rejected by the machines Hundreds of very tired people milling around trying to figure out what to do next After progressing for about mins border force directed us to the non residents queue where overworked staff processed us quickly once we reached the counter Arrived at baggage carousel and many bags had still not arrived including ours mins after disembarkation Finally picked up our bags and found another huge border force queue snaking around the carousels with one staff shouting directions from a distance Finally that queue seemed to speed up and we finally emerged hours after disembarkation Followed signs for taxi rank and discovered Uber has taken over the original taxi rank and we had to walk right the furthest queue after the buses to find the taxi rank

This is probably my most visited airport been here over times in the past years flying domestic and international Nothing changes but thats not a bad thing Some check in areas are hard to find and queues are always long and very congested in the international terminals its not big enough for the amount of foot traffic it used to be adequate but its become a more popular destination as years have gone by On the other side of the coin domestic terminal seems too big for the amount of passengers checking in No smoking areas after going through to departures but that doesnt really bother me good excuse to quit Darwin does though Getting dropped off and picked up outside is always megachaotic and theres a lot of works going on now which makes it even worse Shops bars and restaurants are all good before and after departure gate Arrivals is usually speedy and quick baggage claim From stepping off the plane to walking out the doors with my suitcase its usually only mins max which is always satisfying after a long flight

Melbourne International arrivals hall is very poorly designed and chaotic It is a disgrace that this terminal is so congested poorly signposted and lacking any natural daylight All the immigration and customs staff should be retrained in order to provide a more friendly and streamlined service to all arriving passengers The very long delays and queues at this terminal are unacceptable and create an unfavourable impression in particular for international travellers who are visiting Melbourne for events

The airport is very poorly organised I was transferring from international flight to domestic flight by Qantas and there was absolutely no signage or directions of which terminal should I be going Despite from long waiting time of my luggage I have tried to reach out help from the T terminal staff and Qantas staff because of the limited transit time However they are not helpful I have talked to them about my situation and my luggage could not be checked in because of the machine issue The self check in staff referred me to the economy queue staff and then to the special assistance staff after a long queue My domestic flight was missed

Worst airport experience in Australia Long queues incorrect baggage tagging checked me in as a different person and worst of all the discriminating attitude of the customimmigration officers Look a bit international then youll be a prime candidate to get abusive questions from different officers

Avalon is a small airport outside of Melbourne As it is small it is quite quick to get through immigration on exit and security The best option is to get a bus from Southern Cross station and this helps as it meets the plane so you can get to Avalon with plenty of time The new international departure area is big but with a few shops and a bit pricey Not too bad with more international it may improve a bit

Writing on behalf of dad who called me from within the terminal My parents took hours to come out My dad was unable to locate a trolley and there was no help on the ground He was unable to approach anybody and he also received no help to push my mother who needed assistance with a wheelchair He was not able to push mum who finds it hard to walk due to a knee surgery and pull their bags After a long wait they finally walked out as they had no choice There is a reason for one to request for wheelchair assistance If support cannot be provided then dont provide the service

I have never experienced such strictness in regards to carry on luggage I had not only my partners laptop bag but also my hand bag Has anyone ever had such ridiculous money grabbing methods used on them Not only will I never fly to Avalon I will never fly jetstar Very disappointed

In my experience ground facilities showed little improvement There is nothing to do unless you want gaming machines the food shows little imagination and is very expensive and you have to checkin long before departure Then you have to climb up steps to the aircraft difficult for someone with disabilities

Its small and its clean and its easy to use On arrival from the stairs hitting the plane door to my driving off in a hire car took me mins and that was with checked luggage You can deal with the hire car people while waiting for your luggage and the carhire parking spots are seconds walk from the terminal Driving into Southern Melbourne took maybe mins longer than it does from Tullamarine its further but the traffics better and you dont have to deal with the toll roads On departure there were no queues and no delays Food choices are limited and you have to pay for WiFi access those would be my only criticisms

A very basic terminal More like a tin shed with temporary stands for business counters While it serves its purposes I hope that they improve terminal facilities and appearance given the increased levels of traffic It cant be that hard to install proper car hire counters and have some coffee shop facilities in the arrivals section When Albury airport has a better terminal facilities than Avalon you know its time to improve

What an absolute joke of an airport Young people working there are disrespectful and absolutely clueless in regards in what needs to be done Upon arrival we saw families with young children who had been queuing upwards of hours Jamaican culture as a whole is one of laziness and nothing better typified that than the carefree do as little work as possible by their immigration staff After asking constantly where we should go I decided to open up the self scan passport queue and help the additional passengers reach through immigration as the staff their refuse to do so unless you make commotion as I did If youre lucky enough to have a good experience going through this airport youd certainly be in the minority My advice is avoid this airport altogether and go to an island where you will be shown respect like Bermuda or St Lucia Will not be returning ever again

The most disorganized and bureaucratic airport I have ever seen I have been there a few years ago but things have changed First we had to line up for an hour to go through the computer kiosk then other line ups to see different custom officers who asked the same questions on the computer printout Total hours later to get out of the airport It seems like they have layers of bureaucracy to keep people employed
The smoke detectors all have low batteries and keep chirping The announcements are loud and never ending The ambiance is like that of a prison but even less nice In short I would never return

The airport is really compact so the distance to walk between the gate and the curb is small The departure and arrival processes are really fast On the other hand because The Carrasco Airport has a small Terminal the commercial and service options are really limited and there are just a few options to eating drinking or shopping The immigration and emigration services are efficient There is an electronic system to verify passport egate that makes really agile the process of documentation verification The Security area xray needs better attendance When I was passing by the Security inspection Xray there was one senior couple slowing the only one row available The security officers did nothing neither helping the senior couple neither opening an extra row and xray equipment The baggage claim works well and is efficient In this travel time I had one normal luggage plus one special sport equipment bicycle that arrived to the baggage claim area earlier than me The WiFi is good when you find an antenna to connect but you will need to search the signal that is not available in all the spaces The signal is better on the second floor checking area but it did not works well on the ground arrival and curb so if you need the signal to send messages chat in WhatsApp or call Uber or taxi it will be difficult

Sitting and overlooking the abandoned runway at Carrasco International in Montevideo waiting for the mysterious fog to disappear makes you imagine what the world will be like without people The airport closed due to fog and to help with the delay there will be a strike in the fog that got few passengers stranded and roaming this modern but today useless building However the lights are glistering bright on the far side of the runway and you cant help think that South American mentality is taken much further in Uruguay than the rest of the continent I wish I could upload my photo of the massive visible concrete slabs and the runway lights chasing away airplanes completely shying away from their function I think you can even see the new Pearol football stadium they recently completed in the distance and luckily it doesnt snow in Uruguay

Flew in and out of here on flights to and from Sao Paulo A striking modern terminal with reasonable facilities Very pleasant

Spacious clean well located well serviced bright naturally illuminated airport Large halls with folk articles shops and chemist money exchange bureau and wrapping baggage service A breeze Fine areas for check in and spotless lavatories Once checked in fast track to security and immigrations available Smiley faces all over the airport Excellent Duty free shop Very good VIP lounge

Montgomery Regional Airport Dannelly Field has been completely modernized and is one of the most attractive small airports in the US Checkin in close to the curb and security is efficient Food and drink groundside and airside is basic Deplaning is easy and baggage claim is close to the street Parking is reasonably convenient unless you are travelling mid week It can be a longish walk to the terminal

Small airport clean and easy to navigate The airport is very basic no major queues as there are no many flights Waiting area is clean not many places to recharge iPhoneiPad and laptop I was not expecting too much but at least a decent taxi experience When I arrived there were no taxis at all outside the airport I had to call a number that I accidentally found at the taxi rank A taxi driver replied saying that he would have arrived in minutes No one turned up After minutes another random taxi showed up Bearing in mind the experience taxi drivers are totally unreliable I booked a taxi on my way back well in advance as my return flight was at am The taxi driver did not turned up impossible to find other taxi drivers as no one was answering also the hotel reception could not find anyone and I missed the flight I travelled all around the world and I have never missed a flight in my life Its like this place is stuck in Rent a car maybe the experience is better

A small yet very convenient airport in the south of France From the plane to the exit takes no more than min Signaling shopping etc is all fine given the size and role of the airport Its not the most modern airport but everything is well maintained Theres a convenient bus service to the city center

We visited the Airport Restaurant Le Terrasse The rudeness was unbelievable We were ignored for over mins while tables who arrived after us were served before us When the waitress did arrive I ordered a carafe of wine in French She literally jumped down my throat to say she spoke no English and only spoke Spanish as an additional language Wow Such prejudice in the assumption that we would not speak French She had not listened to the fact that the initial order was in French As a Head teacher I raise my students with good manners and question those who have not taught so by their parent What the three waitresses do not understand is that they make themselves look bad Why do they want to carry themselves in such a negative way It takes energy to be rude It is less stressful to be polite They really made themselves look bad As we travel to the airport frequently I have a home in a France it would be good to see a change of attitude After all we are paying they are not doing us a favour

Better to arrive at than to depart from Baggage reclaim was quick and efficient and decent transport available shuttle bus and taxis Taxi to centre of Montpellier less than Euros so not too bad as four shared the expense Departure was ok but with a Duty Free shop saving very little and just one snack bar the place is one not to be delayed in Fortunately we werent but the departure gates are designed poorly and there is confusion especially when the priority boarding is progressing I would welcome a ticket system where those first into the departure gate area are guaranteed to be the first to board the aircraft This would enable the latecomers to risk having their cases put into the hold and those with regulation size bags would be able to use the gauges and thus make boarding a little more civilised

There is a frequent direct bus from the city centre to the airport which only costs euros and only takes mins The building is large and modern and air conditioned inside We had no luggage to check in so went straight through security which was speedy We had hrs to wait and I was dismayed to find the international departures area is very small with a single tiny coffee bar and one small shop selling duty free perfumes and local products Seating also very limited although thankfully the airport wasnt busy I dont think there are any air bridges so all departures mean walking down outside stairs onto the apron Nice if its sunny

We flew Air Canada Frankfurt to Montreal and final destination Quebec City When arriving at Montreal airport we tried to follow the In Transit signs but at one point we could no longer see them We asked an airport employee for directions and he gave us the wrong answer as did a second employeeWe had the feeling we bothered them After wasting minutes we finally ended up at Security the second time here The overall impression of the airport is that its management is unable to handle the very heavy flow of passengers There are not enough places to sit as we saw passengers sitting on the floor Even the security staff appeared overwhelmed and stressed apart from the lack of English fluency No way to eat in a restaurant as there were waiting lines We have experienced at least a dozen or more airports and this was by far our worst experience We will avoid in future

The airport is dirty and disorganized Westjet staff at this location were rude and not helpful I was returning to Canada from an international trip and had to remove my luggage because I was switching airlines My luggage could have been moved for me because it did not get re inspected I had to wait at a WestJet booth which was not open to allow the transfer I was not directed to a drop off line and got in with a crowd of new Canadians checking in and weighing multiple bags Staff knew I was just dropping off and refused to help me It was hard to find the drop off area because of signage I went through customs twice The waiting areas were dirty and crowded seats were comfortable and it was a nightmare Shopping areas looked ok but not many accessible from my gate area

Arrived in Montreal hours late from my original flight from London I was very worried I would miss my connecting flight to Ottawa I had to pass through customs and make my way through what seemed one end of the airport to another The signage was confusing and inadequate I tried to get directions and information from airport personnel I was brushed off almost every time I was given incorrect information which delayed my progress Some even told me they did not know where I could find a particular gate People were treated like cattle being moved along with no time to even give a word of explanation The moving conveyor belts were not working I had just come from Heathrow and although that airport is huge it is well organized and the signage is clear If I can avoid this airport I will Rude staff poor layout and signage are its characteristics

Please avoid this airport very rude staff and lack of mannerisms full of youngsters at the passport control and dont know how to treat tourists and they truly dont realise that they are the face of Russia and how important their job role is I will never ever fly to Moscow no even for a stopover and you all should do the same I travelled with a British passport and they almost tore my passport by doing some silly checks

The airport itself is good but the design looks simply ok The airport is big it has old and new parts the new part looks better It has many checkin desks fast security check and very nice that they have priority security check and priority passport control Some nice business lounges and good duty free

Probably the worst airport in Eastern Europe and the world Only huge fancy terminal building Inside very congested and outrageously expensive Traveled through here twice in the winter and the summer I had to wait days for my flight as there was no seat available for my destination so I had plenty of time to see what kind of lousy torture like facility it was Huge terminal with planty of space But the most shocking thing was that the Airport staff did not allow passengers to rest or sleep they said it was rule set by Airport management Thousands of people transit here plus many delays on domestic destinations It looked like prison with Airport staff approaching passengers and waking them up every minutes Even if people slept on the floor No matter who young old tourists Can you imagine this nonsense hours a day The air conditioning system was terrible In the summer only departure checkin area was properly air conditioned While level where passengers await their flight was like sauna Was very hot and suffocating The entrance area to the Terminal is very crowded and badly arranged I have never seen such an lousy planning Passport control takes long time Avoid this airport if you can Sheremetyevo Airport is much better and less crowded

I cant say that Domodedovo is very good airport staff is ok good business lounges the standard Russian duty free Cosmetics and snacks I think it is nice because of business security check and passport control

I read some scary reviews here which made me leave for the airport more than hours before my flight But after a very good journey on the excellent Aeroexpress train I have nothing to report DME is no Changi for sure but it is a completely average airport No big queues and from checkin to lounge it took me minutes max The bulk of it spent with a slow passport officer who did not speak English and was confused by my dual nationality and me living on a third country But the rest of the security measures XRAY of all luggages on entry second check of boarding pass and passport are on pair with other specially Asian airports Granted this is a Sunday afternoon so things could get busier during the week But this is it just an adequate airport Not one of the modern Shopping Centers you find these days but just a regular place to wait for your next flight Maybe the view from the lounge is different but I learned long ago to not leave home without my Priority Pass Contrary to some of the reviews here the airport does offer wifi and it does accept any international number Maybe this is one of the benefits of traveling after the WC

Having arrived very late at Domodedovo we wanted to leave ASAP The queues arent long at passport control but they do take forever to verify everything so we waited about minutes at the desk Baggage arrived very quickly The arrivals hall can be a bit dodgy with all the illegal taxi drivers etc and the car park is a good m walk from the terminal you can imagine in Moscow at this time its On departure everything is quite well signposted The security section is a mess with only two lanes open with lots of people and baggage Passport control again has very short queues but it takes forever to get through The Duty Free is ok but far from cheap There is WiFi if you have a Russian number but if you dont prepare to sit there bored There is Wifi just outside the S lounge on the top floor if you really need it but not next to the gates There isnt much seating but the airport wasnt too busy so it was ok Overall the airport is a bit of a struggle and I will look to travel to SVO in the future primarily due to location but its ok if you really need to take a flight from it

The Immigrations process took the longest ever What a waste of time Fortunately we stood in front of the line Otherwise we wouldnt get to the Aeroexpress train in time All the staff should consider learning to speak English fluently since they have to deal with foreigners every day Some spoke to nonnative speakers of Russian and got upset when they didnt understand what they said This wasnt civilized

Wait at Checkin lines are way too long had to wait almost hours Personnels are too slow and rude and not enough staff at the airport If you are exchangingbuying tickets or paying extra for whatever reason at the register they are handwriting most information and takes so much time Navigations are not too clear even for Russian speaking people Improvements needed

Transfer from international to domestic flight and back last week My flight from London arrived into Terminal D and transferred to Terminal B for the domestic departure Efficient experience overall clear signage but some long walking distances from arrival to the shuttle train Terminal B has a nice interesting design and plenty of seats with chargers Nice selection of lounges for cardholders Overall recommended

My wife and I had a twohour transit at Muscat between flights with Oman Air Our time in the airport was unexpectedly pleasant The terminal building gives a new and modern appearance but with features of traditional Arabic architecture The total effect is aesthetically very pleasing and supported by mellow background music Travel through the terminal was not onerous although distances between gates and other transit points were long most of it could be covered by moving walkways Security check was painless and efficient with short queues At the departure gate there was a nice separation between boarding pass check and seating in the waiting area There was plenty of seating in the gate and we appreciated the boarding procedures being separated by zone One negative there was no obvious place to get a coffee in the transit areas we passed through although signage pointing to another part of the terminal suggested eating and drinking options elsewhere

MSL is minutes from my home instead an hour twenty to HSV The staff is beyond exceptional up to and including the TSA employees Over the years I have had less problems with connections in Memphis than any other hub in the southeast Two years ago we dropped our year old daughter off for a flight to her grandparents We left for parts far and wide before the flight departed as we knew she was in good hands This wound up being one of the occasions when mechanical problems caused a delay The staff called me on my cell phone and explained the options to get my daughter to her destination We chose to allow her to stay and wait for the next flight that afternoon as her arrival time would not have varied much had we turned around and put her on a flight out of HSV I asked that they make sure she was fed since her wait would go over lunch time Long story short when we checked to see how she accomodated the staff insisted my daughter accompany them to lunch and picked up the tab She was provided vouchers for the hour layover in Memphis and the staff explained in detail how to use them where the eating places were located in Memphis airport etc She was treated exceptionally well and other than the long day actually enjoyed learning about the pitfalls that face air travelers at times first hand The same smiling faces that helped my daughter two years ago are the same ones that greet you at the counter today My only complaint is the limited flights dont allow me to fly out of the shoals as often as I would like

Flew out of MSL for a trip last month June Booked on the morning flight and was scheduled to arrive at my destination in the early afternoon on Northwest Airlink However due a mechanical issue the morning flight was canceled Northwest AirlinkOperated by MESABA called me at home and already had me booked on the late afternoon flight to Memphis getting into Arkansas that evening When time came to catch the connecting flight we had a gate hold due to severe weather over the airport in Memphis Finally arrived at my destination about minutes late I have to give the MSL Northwest crew a Job Well Done They showed excellent customer service and did everything they could to make my flight out as pleasant as possible Mechanical issues come up from time to time and the weather tends to throw a curve ball at us causing one to adjust travel plans This is to be expected The return flights operated on time from gear up to gear down from Arkansas back to Memphis on into Muscle shoals Weather Clear skys and mild temps during the trip home We even arrived in Muscle Shoals about minutes ahead of schedule As Mentioned in my previous comments MSL is a good alternative to other nearby airports Parking is just a day and if you book weeks ahead you can get fares lower than at the other larger nearby airports Granted flights are limited and experienced some challenges on my last two trips out of MSL Will continue to utilize the airport for future trips One additional fact Avis Rental Car does have a Rental center adjacent to the airport terminal building They Do Not have a counter inside the Terminal only Enterprise Rental Car does If North Alabama and Southern TN are in your plans check out MSL as an alternative to other nearby airports
