Very quick visit through this airport its small and gets very busy but I did not encounter any issues Bags arrived on belt within minutes was out in mins Check in efficient small duty free shop kiosk airside security staff polite Am embarrassed to witness how rude some passengers are when using this airport They dont use bins for their litter talk rudely to staff and have an air of arrogance It will never be Changi but it works for the short time you are there

You know an airport has major problems when the number of welcome assistants exceeds the number of check in staff If I am going to hell when I die Mykonos airport reminded me what I can expect The new private owners give every indication of wanting to milk the profits without considering passengers at all It was completely unclear where to queue to check in and I wasted time where you hand your bag over and had to queue again Several people made the same mistake Departures horrible No spare seats minute queue just to get a cold drink No vending machines

Considering that Mykonos is a small hilly island this little airport does well It is small so transit through from disembarkation to exit is really quick and not far to walk Arrived on connecting flight from Athens on Aegean at am Bags were out in around minutes Return flight back to Athens a week later Afternoon flight so busier as flights departing together Check in was busy big queues but efficient check in staff Small coffee sandwich counter and gift shop airside and small duty free shop toilet facilities and snack bar with hot drinks once passed passport control and security Its not the Business Lounge at Changi but it does the job for the short time people are there Good job

This place doesnt even deserve to be called an airport Nothing Ive recognised from years of air travel is present here Certainly nothing thats made travelling easier Its total chaos Badly designed and totally disorganised From arriving to boarding the flight I was stood in any of four different queues for two hours Checking in on advance saves no time You have to queue out of the airport at a desk which has no sign so you just hope its the right one People push in constantly After an hour of that once youve it a tag for your bag you have to queue again to deposit your bag because the scanner is before the check in desk conveyors Then queue again for passport Then stand in a packed gate area in another queue until you board We got in a bus that left us near the wrong plane and had to walk across the Tarmac Stressful chaotic tiring and a massive time waster

So upon the approach of my gate for my first departure minutes after boarding time none of the flight details in the entire airport had been updated to inform me that my flight was delayed This is Spirit Airlines that Im referring to My flight had been delayed over hours due to the lack of crew I know this is a small airport but it is not hard to update your information in the airport the terminal the gate or online in order to inform your passengers before potentially going through security On top of all of the inconvenient change of plans the lady at my gate attempting to inform us of all that changed was quite possibly the most incoherent person I spoke to on my day stay here in South Carolina I will never connect here or fly Spirit again The only bit of accommodations or considerations I received was a free upgrade to vacant exit row seats I didnt receive a voucher for breakfast no help trying to find another airline that could get me there sooner or a voucher for a future flight for satisfaction Had it not have been for the pilots coaxing all of us passengers and explaining what she apparently was incapable of there would have been an outrage in Gate A

We were delayed for nights due to bad weather on the th and th January The staff at Mytilene Airport in Lesbos were excellent they kept a smile during a very difficult time for them We were given a voucher for food and drinks each time our flight was cancelled times in all and they sent us to very good hotels both nights In addition when we asked if they could extend our journey for the days that we had lost they did with no problems

Noise announcements My flights had been delayed today Its now more than hours that Im still waiting Im right now at the airport gate Not sure if ill get my flight But my disappointment is for the amount of repeated announcements Ive been counting its less than seconds between announcements and they repeat over and over the same message This must be the most noise airport Ive ever been and Ive been to big ones I love Fiji islands This has nothing to do with the numbers of repeated announcements they do

International layover international transit queue was slower than customs Security check required but never left secure zone of the airport Had a lady behind me have her sealed duty free purchases taken She purchased from her last location and was given no opportunity to access her checked bags Based upon experience and other reviews Its a nice airport friendly staff with absurd and antiquated policies blindly followed by staff Do not recommend

Airport itself is fine Simple Easy to get around and not too large There is a Tapoo shop and Burger King checkin side Once through security there is a couple more eating places and bigger duty free shops as well as a WHSmith There is a very weird rule that you have to carry your Toiletries in a ziplock bag for checkin This is OK except they want to charge you for one It seems a very pointless rule for rules sake But then after youve gone through the gate things get strange Water and stuff youve bought in the departure lounge also has to be under the ml or in a duty free bag They check all your bags and so I had a small bottle of unopened water just for the flight and had to throw it The shops should tell you this or everything should be put in a dutyfree bag tho thats a bit useless for water Its a weird rule and completely pointless since no other countries do it It ruins all the rest of the experience if the airport The staff also cant tell you why they are doing it

Nadi airport was very busy when we arrived We had to use steps to exit the plane and then walk a way Three international flights landed so immigration was very crowded Many people with children and elderly having to line up for some time It was very slow Some passengers must have had issues as some were with agents for a long time Shame these are not dealt with separately Bags were already there by the time we got through Then we headed towards car rental to get our SIM card F card saw our whole trip through digicel Departing was ok Note there are only two options to eat landslde but far more airside Also if you buy water airside they will bag it so it is ready as you board the flight as your bags get searched before boarding

The custom security was ridiculous Traps everywhere Started with the custom security who was asking for the little zip bag for small items where we only had a lipstick The security was very nice to advise the bag cost cents from the shop next to the checkpoint When we went there to buy we were told there was a minimum spend of Walked around the shop nothing is Then we bought the cheapest item of plus the cents plus transaction fee ended up spending almost No other countrys security actually have this kind of requirement Fiji is the place for tourism to be shaved by the locals Be careful

Absolute worst experience with the customs officer I had arrived from Sharjah with Air Arabia and customs wanted to check the baggage of each and every passenger Slowed the exit process Even though the signage says green channel and red channel they force all passengers to go through the red channel by checking all the bags and questioning them on any electronic device I was moving to India for good and by law Im allowed to carry my personal effects They made pay for my year old camera and year old gimball The person from the bank who is supposed to validate the receipt wasnt there on duty and came almost an hour late Despite complaining to the customs department no serious action was taken I will never fly into NAG and will never recommend anyone else to fly into NAG Unprofessional staff who rob you in broad daylight

Its a smaller airport compared to Mumbai not a problem actually Some toilets on the arrival hall are not good This airport has more shopping options now and its enough actually There are spa and lounge facilities available here The lounges are okay I have never experienced any delay to date Overall an above expectation feel It gets my job done

Its really shame how the facilities are at this airport Authorities seriously need to look into certain issues if this is to be called an international airport A There was no snacks or refreshment counter in waiting area open past which is extremely inconvenient as there are some flights scheduled past hrs PVK Bar is open though B The waiting area was not clean and it looked as if the maintenance guys left sweeping work halfway through Air conditioning was not working properly it seems C Lighting is extremely dull D Its good to use TV screens for entertainment purpose but at least a few can show flight updates as well

It is sad to write a negative review about the airport of my hometown But it is so inconvenient to travel from here Now Nagpur airport is called as International airporr but it is shameful that they do not have wifi facilities at the airport or ask for Indian numbers to get the code Not a single telephonecoin box to call in case of emergency Staff are so unprofessional and slow They have no idea about the airline they are working for with flight timings Please make basic arrangements so that we dont have to feel awkward when bringing foreign travellers with us

I visited Nagpur City in August I flew from Sharjah to Nagpur The experience of Nagpur Airport is one of the worst I have had The staff are unprofessional Customs officials present at the airport are the worst they will check each and every passenger their way of checking is to treat you as if you are a thief or a prisoner Second worst thing is the luggage belt it took one and half hours for my luggage to arrive on the belt I advise everyone to avoid this airport as much as possible

Nagpur is the largest city in central India and the second capital on Maharashtra Nagpur Airport Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar International Airport is a small airport located km from the city centre The airport is very small in size and also in the amount of destination it serves so it is difficult to judge Given its capacity it can handle max up to aircrafts at a time and anything more than that there will be congestion and the flight will be delayed The airport is clean and the staff can be rude at times

A truly awful airport to fly from in so many way We had to pass through stages of security starting outside the airport which was so cursory it was meaningless Then we had to go through fullon get undressed security stations one within yards of actually boarding I wouldnt mind if it made you feel safer but it didnt There was zero signage to find the Premium Plaza lounge that BA use and staff sent us in different directions All in all a depressing way to end a great holiday

Always the same Coming off a long haul flight and transiting through JKIA Even as a business class traveller the queue for the transit security check takes at least an hour Total chaos reigns Only two gates are open Security staff totally overwhelmed This is by far the worst airport to transit through

Due to a late arrival of our international flight we needed to stay overnight in Nairobi Though we had a great stay at the hotel it was really short because all took so long at the airport after landing It was confusing and messy As I was traveling as a mum alone with young children it always a challenge in itself so late at night Landed around pm if not mistaken My childrens boarding pass was printed but not mine so staff took my original boarding pass and went to print it so I ended up totally at the back of the queue Despite asking I was not allowed to shift back forward with the children I showed them my Tz residence permit while I was in the queue so I was told I didnt need to fill in a form But minutes after completing the immigration check I was called back to fill a form anyway Immigration officer was very insensitive by yet again asking out loud and in front of my children are these your children When I commented that he should be more sensitive with this question in front of the children he refused to stamp our passports Then he went to watch some videomovie on his phone We waited really long both in the immigration queue as well as downstairs WiFi was not working there had also been no WiFi in the plane so had not been able to notify anyone Nobody of the staff provided much information We were dumped in another queue downstairs not knowing what was meant to happen We waited a really long time for the hotel pick up with no info Six weeks ago we also passed through Nairobi airport and both going and return we a small group of passengers got lost in transit up and down stairs It took a while to figure out where go Both building and staff are the most disappointing I have ever encountered in any of my trips Will do whatever possible to avoid this airport in the future Kenya What a missed chance to shine

Very expensive compared to any other airports that I have used Facilities are very basic The inflight information board does not update making it difficult The announcement is also done in a local accent that is not clear

Worst airport I have ever seen in all my travels boarding started way too late for all documents incl COVID to be checked Same documents have been checked at queues till boarding No priority boarding for business No social distancing whatsoever The plane is a Covid timebomb sadly No seating available at checkin area No one to ask anything at the multiple airport queues I had to endure My plan was to come back to Kenya but to pass this airport again that would be an ordeal Better to visit other African countries maybe they work better than Kenya which is a mess

This typical Thai regional airport is surprisingly busy Perhaps also due to the presence of the Chevron offshore helicopter base There are about flights a day tofrom Bangkok Facilities are limited so its not an airport to linger in That said the land side restaurant upstairs has a nice view of the apron so you can have a beer until you see your plane landing before going through to the departure lounge where seating is limited The car park is always crowded which is due to people using it as a park n ride when they fly to Bangkok it being free of charge

Terminal of Nanchang Changbei airport is horrible and a complete embarrassment to Nanchang and China It is supposed to be international but Ive seen small town bus stations in a better condition They seem to be forever renovating the international terminal meaning that when passengers arrive to checkin they must stay in a waiting area that is tiny and becomes very cramped Furthermore there is no heating or AC in this part of the airport so you feel uncomfortably cold or hot depending on the weather Checkin desks only open hours before and once you clear immigration there isnt even a restaurant just a shop that sells limited confectionery and duty free products Finally you can never get a taxi at the international terminal If youre lucky a tout might appear but you will get ripped off or you can walk across the car park to the domestic terminal and if youre luckier still you might get a metered taxi but they are reluctant to use the meter Overall a pathetic excuse for an airport and I always dread flying out of here as travelling from Nanchang Airport especially the international terminal is an ordeal

The airport is very new and modern I have flown through this airport multiple times but this is the first time at the new terminal It is a lot larger than the original terminal There was finally free WiFi and it was pretty fast considering the internet in China It was mainly based off of Shanghai Pudong the airport I was actually flying to and had the identical announcement system that PVG terminal had Although there were a few foreigners including me it felt very open and very welcoming

Worst airport Security control took away hard cheeses claiming food cannot exceed g a piece Also took away a climbing carabiner that Ive traveled countries with Never seen such ridiculous rules implemented in the rudest way possible by the staff there For a flight within the EU Apart from that airport is very old fashioned and not very clean

Feels old and outdated Outside is chaotic confusing on a first visit Inside feels cramped and old lighting all artificial barely any outside light entering in the areas before security No matter its not meant for you to stay anyway there are barely anywhere seat The waiting area is really small with low ceiling that would need a good cleaning Finally some natural light but not a view still Only thing to see out the window is the large bridges with people disembarking A place to go through not to be enjoyed

Judging by the other reviews here I am not alone in my disappointment In addition to everything others have mentioned I will add that I was flying with a well traveled backpack on which I had a cm long section of bike chain attached to it impossible to take off without a chain tool or to cut the pack itself Not even enough to put my fist through It was used to pick up the pack and secure a lock to Ive traveled far and wide with this chain on the pack even to the USA where Homeland Security is notorious for its scrutiny of such things Well at Nantes at the security checkpoint they considered this small piece of bike chain to be able to be used as a weapon They said I either needed to check the bag EUR or cut it off As the pack is not worth EUR I told them to cut it off after giving them an honest if not perhaps sarcastic comment on how they operate their airport After more than years coming through this airport to vacation in and around the surrounding areas I am calling it quits I will go elsewhere as all of my experiences over the years have added up to enough negativity that I no longer wish to spend my hard earned money in this region Farewell

We had thought of a walking holiday but we got one free courtesy of this airport After walking a long way to the departure portal at the far end of the building we had to walk another long way on the ground floor up stairs and back along the same but reverse route to get to security The officers there were anything but friendly and it was obvious that they escalated their searches and arrogance if one responded with anything other than utter compliance Not a smile or a please or thank you in sight They all wore identity badges but would not allow me to inspect these Utterly the worst goodbye I have ever had from anywhere After more walking we were directed down to the waiting area on the ground floor which just happened to be adjacent to where we left our hold baggage The signage is abysmal amazing us that anyone got on the correct flight Then more walking across the hardstanding and up yet more stairs to board the aircraft Both my wife and I are over years old and were completely exhausted by this preflight activity We were so looking forward to using this airport but found it abysmal soulless even hostile

The worst experience ever Very poorly organized and very poor quality Lack of staff and lot of waiting If you transfer remember that you have to go out and do the security check again which takes ages Security are very grumpy and unfriendly If anyone is planning to carry on a skateboard forget about it Mine got confiscated due to the airport rules even if I havent had any problem anywhere with this and I have been traveling with my skateboard for last years Avoid this airport

It is so poorly organized that even if you tried to design a more inefficient system you wouldnt surpass them Not to mention the staff constantly chatting with each other and treating you like a burden Being an Italian myself I feel ashamed about this airport
Having read the previous reviews Naples did not disappoint Rude staff even in the shops they couldnt have been ruder The place is filthy and unorganised Hope to never visit again

Tax free department is very disorganized No one in the office Called the number posted and no one shows up You have to check in the luggage then carry the luggage to their office and still no one there Called the number again and they said to go the machine to do it Of course the machine is not working then went back to their office still on one there Called them again She said well we need to see your luggage still no one is available I talked to the lady in the front of the airport they said tax free department is very dysfunctional In the end we DID NOT GET OUR MONEY so many people had the same experience This is one of the worst airport to steal others money without any regards What a shame for the Naples airport because of this department

Despite booking special assistant for a severely disabled years old lady there was no assistance available unless we had to wait two hours in which we wouldve missed out on the flight We travelled with British Airways but the service provided is by Naples airport management which is absolutely ridiculous Disgusting I would avoid coming here at any cost if you are disabled

Lives up to its name no signs chaos rude airport staff overflowing rubbish bins of flight delayed and no aircon but great food Unless one wants to fly to Rome and drive not many options to visit Campania and it is worth visiting so just have to roll with it and accept it

Naples Airport Welcome to chaos As usual I have arrived at this airport about times the time to get off the plane and to baggage reclaim via an airport bus was minutes It seems to take forever The baggage reclaim area is too small to handle multiple flight arrivals It becomes a scrum with insufficient space to negotiate the identified belt the one exit point and the hordes of people with their luggage And then theres the minimum minute wait for your bags Its painful The experience gets better as you then have to get outpast the reception committees And into fresh airno wait Here we go again Exiting the airport means inhaling lungfuls of secondhand cigarette or vape smoke So I survived the experience again but wait for the return Itll be the same painful process but in reverse The takeaway This is a small and congested airport surrounded by vehicle drivers who use their horns to communicate Last time earlier this year I couldnt drive back to the airport and went around in circles despite having a Satnav before eventually working out how to get to the hire car return Enjoy its a bumpy ride

Horrible experience Many of the people on our flight did not receive our luggage We spent hours being given vague advice by lost luggage and information often contradictory and which involved being continually sent to different carousels Finally we gave up as for many of us we were at the point of missing connections Despite the number of times we had queued and been sent away and despite our time running out for making connections we were forced to queue for another hour as there were many people who had arrived much later than us also missing luggage The staff were indifferent and uncaring to our situation even to the point of letting us have a pen to fill in their forms The arrivals lounge was full of unclaimed baggage Its days into our holiday and our baggage has not arrived I feel genuinely upset by the uncaring attitude and unhelpful mess of the staff It felt like they would say or do any old thing to get rid of us I would never use this airport again

Please ever fly out or in to this airport It is the absolute poorly run least efficient and incompetent out of all Ive been to There are only buses running for all of the gates Our flight was severely delayed and will miss our connecting flight

I would like to say a very special thank you to the security staff that helped my friend and I last week at Naples Airport A friend had travelled earlier that day and inadvertently left his iPad behind in security We only had a short time before our departure to try and retrieve it for him The staff were fast efficient and located the iPad within minutes After running through some security checks we were able to take the iPad home back to its owner saving everyone a lot of time and energy I dont usually write reviews but the service we received from the security staff was first class and deserved a mention

We arrived hours early to check in and it took us hours in line to actually check in People were fainting as its June and the air conditioning was broken Then the ticket agent said she wasnt sure they would hold the plane simultaneously the tracking system for checked luggage broke down It was a nightmare experience there were so many people going to Dublin for connections They ended up holding the plane because no one could get through to get on it Ill avoid Napoli airport like the plague it is

Im not sure what ultimate plan is for gates C C is but in its current state its awful I have never walked as much as I have in an airport as I have here The shuttle bus process is really bad Driving in a fully loaded bus with NO air is un excusable The two tiny windows that were letting a tiny bit of air were not enough We ended up sitting on the bus for a good or minutes while we waited for Southwest planes to pass When the last jet went by and started throttling up we got a nice HOT blast of the smell of jet fuel I cant say that I wont be back but we may change airlines so we dont need to endure the poorly planned annex wing

Worst experience arriving to an airport Have to stand in extremely long line waiting for shuttle to take you to main terminal to then get your bags and rental car Took over minutes standing in line with no official information from the airport staff All information came from locals who were also in the line Worst experience arriving in a city No soap on the ladies bathroom Finally get on the shuttle to stand on the runway waiting for planes to taxi in and out So now on a crowded shuttle watching planes move all around and still not to the terminal Absolutely ridiculous and a miserable introduction to a city

After having stood in line with my family for an hour and finally reaching the checkin counters for our airline we were told to wait while while another people checked in before us causing us to wait another minutes We were the only ones going to a separate state so it would have been so easy to just check our bags when we first got to checkin So because adults couldnt plan ahead and get to the airport with plenty of time for their flight we were the ones that had to stand there and wait for them We finally made it to our gate with minutes to spare To say I was angry and frustrated that the employees had zero sense is an understatement

I am writing to complain about the cost of longterm economy parking I have lived in large cities around the country and longterm economy parking is around per day This airport has continuously raised its longterm parking fee over the last few years to a now astronomical amount of per day That is unsatisfactory and unacceptable There have been no improvements to the parking lot and there are not buses running more often to them Why the unreasonable raise The traffic at the terminals themselves is also horrible People will be waiting for almost an hour to pick someone up around the holidays

Flight Dec AM We have been sitting on the tarmac for hours tonight Yes there was some snow here We were told there are no open gates Get the other passengers off the planes at the gates if they arent going to fly out There is no reason for planes to stay boarded sitting and blocking the gates Ridiculous Very very dissatisfied

I have flown with Bahamas air to Nassau at least time It was the first time we flew on a two engine prop plane The plane was not the issue It was boarding the plane We entered the normal location then had to decline stairs The problem was with our carry on baggage There was no attendant at the top of the stairs I saw a shoot beside the stairs and placed my bag on the shoot I had not looked to the bottom and had not realized someone was removing their bag at the bottom I trust the sound of my bag travelling down the shoot caused her to look up and remove her arm before my bag slammed into hers She looked up and was not happy There needs to be attendant at the top to monitor when a bag can be place on the shoot which also runs very fast and could damage items in the bag On our return to Tampa we departed on the ground and walked to another staircase which would take us the normal departure level From prior experience I knew it was stairs to the top I am with a heart problem and my wife is in her s I was not going to carry our carry on up stairs There was no attendant present I told the security guard I was not going to carry the bags up the stairs The guard tried calling someone without success There where two ground crew standing by the plane which she approached and one came to take the bags to the to the top

Last week January my wife and I flew out of Nassau Bahamas We arrived at the airport two and a half hours early for our Delta flight to Atlanta Georgia I along with about other passengers was randomly selected by the US Transportation Security Administration TSA for extra security screening My wife went through the regular security screening The security screeners took an unbelievable to minutes to screen each passenger in the extra security line There were eight passengers in the extra screening line ahead of me More than two hours passed before I was screened As a result I missed my flight and had to rebook another flight to Atlanta and also rebook my connecting flight to BaltimoreWashington Airport My wife waiting over two hours for me to be screened chose to not get on our scheduled flight but to wait for me Almost all the passengers in the extra security screening line missed their flights

Probably the most difficult thing is to get to this airport If you are not staying in the hotel but in private accommodation as we did and you are far from Nassau downtown you will hardly see any taxis around There is no bus going directly to the airport You might ask the driver of bus route to drop you off at the nearby roundabout and then walk around half a mile to the airport The airport itself is divided into three different section You must have in mind that you cannot just ask from which terminal your airline departs as that also depend on your destination The US departures have a separate terminal

Nassau Airport has extremely over priced shops and restaurants A pasta dish for over in one of the restaurants I tried Funny thing is that the airport speakers dont stop telling you to enjoy the excellent customer service and affordable prices Customer service is average to bad to be honest Staff is moody they know they get tourists any way so they dont care much All shops closed down at pm without a place to buy a bottle of water Not good when your flight is at pm and gets delayed for hours Overall it was a bad experience and I dont recommend anyone to fly to the also overly price island There are other Caribbean islands with more reasonable prices for sure

Arriving Lines for immigration lasted minutes US charge for minute no exaggeration cab ride that the hotel had said would cost no more than Departing airport merchants ready willing and able to rip you off if your guard is down for a minute

This review is for International arrivals and US Departures Ive used this airport in December and then again in March In general a much better experience this time around On arrival sufficient immigration desks were staffed and customs was quick enough so that I was in my hotel within minutes of touching down On departure the new US Departures terminal is much improved from the older version Check in and security is quick and efficient The only place where there are lines is the US immigration pre clearance Airside the terminal is quite pleasant with lots of shops restaurants etc While the main restaurant Kafe Kalik I think is pleasant with outdoor seating I would not recommend ordering food there unless you want to risk missing your flight they took minutes to bring our food

Due to a mechanical fault the plane that landed was too small for all of the passengers So the ground staff at Nevsehir had to work really hard to deal with about people who could not fit The staff in this small office tried so hard to identify the most urgent passengers who had connecting flights then they prioritised everyone The staff were faced with passengers who all thought they were the most important person in the airport We did not have a connecting flight and were lower priority So the team arranged for about of us to be bussed to nearby Kayseri airport our flight was going to be hours later than expected So the ground staff refunded the cost of our flight not once but twice We were able to collect the money from a counter at the airport immediately then we were upgraded to Business class which meant we were able to sit in quiet and cool comfort while we waited Then on the flight we were very impressed with the food and service and priority baggage service I know the fault was not due to the ground staff but they really tried hard and were very successful at getting people through to their connecting flights and what they offered us really helped ease the pain of our delay I am really impressed with the people in that small office I wish I da their names to thank them personally I highly recommend flying with Turkish Airways after this experience

Was departing New Orleans two days after jazzfest Had no problems with queueing anywhere Had some time to kill before my flight and sat outside in a cool spot close to where buses depart Spent some time chatting to n airport employee Absolutely delightful polite young man

Disgusted by the employees and customer service here Traveled with someone who left their purse with identification and the whole nine in it in a bathroom and we were sent on a wild goose chase to find someone who was even willing to help us retrieve it We were met with horrible attitudes and treated like a bother by everyone we encountered and were even told by multiple employees I cant help you with that and after being sent to them by another employee at that If it werent for the law enforcement office we would not have received any help at all Not being able to help is one thing but being rude and completely unwilling to help is another Do better

This is the worst airport experience I had since I have been traveling All passengers have to go through big lines its only one way to get to all gate access one hour is an average wait time just to get by the security check and another to minutes for the security check Most ridiculous set up I have ever seen I hope I would never have to come back here again I still at the line writing review its been an hour I hope I wont miss my flight One more thing to add if you are retiring a rental car that you picked up from another location good luck with that add some extra time you will not know where to drop you be be lost your phone GPS can be your best option

The wait for the rental car bus is unbearably long No organization This airport is a total chaotic mess The rental car situation adds at least an hour on to your trip whether you are arriving or departing They need to get their act together

This is simply the worst airport I have ever visited Departures are an absolute shambles Terminal am joke You do all your pre boarding checks online passport photo boarding pass all of that You then go to drop your case takes forever check in and bag drop all in the same line They then take your case and yep print you a new boarding card to add to the two you already have Then you get checked again with some random person then you go through security and its a free for all Lines all over the place constantly moved out of one line to another and at the end of it yep another photo taken Oh and then photo machines break and you go to a guy who puts your passport through a checker in a second Why not just have these like most normal countries Then you bottleneck again whilst the TSA staff shout at each other for who is doing the least amount of work Absolutely horrendous Then after what seems like forever you want something to eat good luck with that one small concession place selling an sandwich This is supposed to be the gate way to and from the leading country in the free world Its no better than a market bazaar The USA should be ashamed of such an incompetent useless and inefficient airport

Avoid like the plague Waiting for hours with people processing the entire queue Absolutely ridiculous Asked why it takes so long and all I got was Its like this everyday Sort it out people

Last time I visited Newark my review was overall very bad Since my last visit the quality of service has improved a lot especially with the TSA staff at security checks The United Airlines staff also provided good service The airport was clean and the transportation system between terminals was efficient The only negative part was the long queue at customs due to a lack of CBP officers a point to improve

The ladies at the United bag drop off were great they communicated well were very polite and helpful and the bag drop off was simple and speedy Pity the security staff were so offensive doing their jobs Of the six security staff encountered were rude and had minimal idea of any service to the client Poor instructions were mumbled with a gesture to go elsewhere or do something when clarification was asked sorry Im not sure where you mean I should go could you please tell me again was met with a glare of disdain and a repetition of the same mumbled incomprehensible directions with a very offensive level of attitude The security staff ushered through or more airport staff with little more than a cursory glance of IDs the opportunity for fake IDs being presented was breathtaking Meanwhile people catching flights were left standing in line while airport staff basically ignored them I have never seen such a poorly managed security system

Fix your lane system Waited for hours to check in Slow service for checking baggage in minutes per person in the queue The US and especially Newark Airport has to fix their organizing systems Shopping was boring

Over minutes to get through passport control Travelers and staff looking cold and tired as midnight passes flights luggage all coming onto carousel others silent and still It was an opportunity to shine and it wasnt taken even a hot drink would have made it more bearable No explanation for delays given by any staff

My husband and I have never used Newcastle airport before but I though we would give it ago and this time I need special assistance as Im waiting for spinal surgery and loosing the use of my hands and feet I booked it easily enough with Ryanair and the special assistance was easy to find and I found the staff very kind and courteous and nothing was too much trouble We arrived the hours before we travelled as per the warning message from Ryanair so the special assistance man took us through the process of Xray and boarding cards so easily and left us for a drink and they came back when they said for me and everything was perfect except the food area was slightly dirty but the special assistance people all I can say thank you for making my travel easy and you all were brilliant

Very nice to have more flights at a local airport but still lots of improvements are clearly required from a passengers point of view Bad signage in airport the security queue blocks the main entrance after it was supposed to have closed The bag measurer was littered with half full cups of drinks Non priority passengers were told to go to the left many went left to the next desk but were not meant issues are all very simple things that can easily be corrected without any cost Just having staff there when a flight arrives would be handy and is completely necessary Its no good putting sings at When arriving at the airport in a taxi I was met by a very nice viewing point for people to watch aircrafts taking off and landing My flight was from NQY to LHR when Flybe was still alive when I entered the airport there were check in desks and a caf right there so not at all difficult to find them when arriving with only hours of sleep at am I had already checked in online so I went straight into security which was very conveniently in the next room It took about minutes to get through security and into the Airports Lounge On first impressions it was quite small with not really much to do but what more can you expect for a local Airport There was only places where you could buy stuff in the departure lounge which was a caf and a Cornish shop that sells Cornish alcoholic beverages and other snacks and the caf sold quite a few things but I only got a water bottle which I think was around There were also toilets which were kept to a reasonably well standard and we boarded our flight with no problems and took off about minutes after departure time

This airport cant cope if something goes wrong We flew out on the th June There had been a number of flight delays that day Our flight was not delayed and we arrived within plenty of time for check in Check in was chaos not enough desks and a queue that never seemed to move Staff were not prioritising passengers to get to their flights in time The information desk had a huge queue it was impossible to speak to anyone We were lucky to find a member of staff who then rushed us to the front of the queue We were then told the flight had closed After voicing our opinion on this incompetence the flight was reopened for us and all the others stuck in the queue We were then given a personal escort through security I didnt get her name but she was very helpful and professional the only professional staff member we encountered After all this our flight hadnt even landed when we got through to the gates If travelling from Newquay allow lots of time for check in as the process moves at the rate of a snail

Whenever I depart from this airport it seems that the planes are always delayed for silly reasons and for a very lengthy amount of time Its a very nice airport and nice staff they just dont seem organised routine maintenance that occurs when the plane is supposed to fly Surely you would plan the hours it takes on another day

Been living here for years If you ever park you car in the airport parking be sure for remove any important items from the car I have had my car broken into twice in during parking while on business trip It is simply the worst airport in Europe in regards to parking security and the airport police are doing anything to help or enforce security Apart from that service is generally pretty French as in none existing

I was waiting with my fellow traveller to board my BA flight on September nd We were hoping to have a glass of wine and something to eat at Bellota Bellota where we usually stop However this time there was no one to be seen I and several other travellers waited for minutes to no avail I walked just inside the area to check if there was a notice computer till wines food etc were all open and unsecured I turned by the unsecured opening and an enraged and shouting female demanded what I was doing I explained she said that there was no one to cover for her and that she was entitled to a break I returned to my seat and this female came screaming over to me seated with other passengers asking if I had photographed her as I had no right I hadnt I am an older female and found this altercation embarrassing and humiliating and not up to the high expectations of wonderful Nice Airport I have been using Nice since you could walk to the plane

At T Checking in was ok and so was security screening Walked into the departure area and it was filled with a queue for passport control I set my stopwatch and minutes later was finally through The biometric readers were out of action so everyone had to use the human inspection method I have never experienced such poor management

I am writing this because we are currently having a bad experience of Nimes Airport This is the worst airport experience Ive ever had The main problem is the lack of basic logic used in relation to the queuingcheck in system In very small writing one queue is marked as bag drop If you mistake this for the queue to go through to security which many did then you get turned away by a disinterested staff member and told to join the other queue Even if you do check in luggage you cant go through the door to security Instead of utilising the many potential entrances they were determined to make everyone in the airport form one queue and not for lack of staff If the airport read this then I would suggest letting people go straight through at that point And make your signs clearer Once through security you are welcomed with a lovely waiting room Phew

Ive been using Nimes Airport on and off for years and never found anyone working there particularly friendly or helpful maybe its because most of the interior is painted black During my last visit Oct I was subject to a new rip off they have devised They advertise parking deals which have to be purchased in advance so I asked to buy the month deal for the advertised tariff of euros The guy took my money wrote out my receipt and prepared a little plastic credit card for me to use for entry and exit When I asked why my expiry date was shown as st March he explained that all parking contracts have to start on the first day of the month so despite the date of purchase being th Oct my pass had to start on st October Furthermore there was an additional euro fee to issue the card My other memory of Nimes is the airport restaurant Service there was so sloppy and slow that despite having nearly two hours available it was never possible to eat all of your rather poor quality overpriced course meal without missing your flight Other gripes The little newspaper book shop closed in and has only recently reopened I would say in summary that I only use Nimes Airport if I have to Nearby Beziers is a much better option if you have a choice

A very small quiet airport and with only a few flights a day checkin is very quick and hassle free Probably one of the easiest airports I have ever used as long as transport to and from the airport is planned in advance or is directly connected to your flight Between flights a great silence descends on the place In the main hall there are several car hire desks one cafe stand offering good quality hot sandwiches and a small restaurant upstairs for those needing a traditional large French lunch There are no shopping opportunities either in the main hall or in the departure lounge a small cafe stand there The main point is that because there are so few flights passengers are easily organised and you are unlikely to spend much time at the airport and what could be better When arriving you need to rent a car OR pick up the ONE shuttle bus service linked to the flight that will take you into Nimes city OR have a friend collect you There is a taxi rank if you need to leave at a time not linked to a flight but taxis seem very infrequent we once needed to leave the airport at a time not connected with a flight and waited half an hour for a chance taxi to arrive as there is so little activity apart from the few flights a day The rentacar car park is directly across the road from the airport main exit just a few steps Most customers seem to use Hertz because it is advertised with Ryanair but there are several other car desks and it would pay to plan ahead and find the best deal regarding rates and maybe avoid the problematic and hefty supplementary insurance fee that Hertz offer unsuspecting customers on arrival Going back to the airport after a stay in Nimes there is just one shuttle bus per flight Dont miss it There are four points in Nimes city centre where the shuttle can be picked up and the main hotels have the timetable The hours on the hotel timetable were slightly different from the times displayed on the bus stop but the hotel timetable seemed to be the correct one The time allowed between shuttle arrival at the airport and last checkin time seemed too close for comfort but in fact it was fine just right and things work smoothly because there are so few flights Going back with a hire car the airport is very close to exit on the A autoroute very easy access Hertz and perhaps the other companies also have a base in Nimes at the railway station where a car can be collected or left as an alternative to the airport

Nimes is one of the most pleasant airports Ive experienced Its quite small is a favourable alternative to Montpellier for those of us whose eventual destination is in the Herault area not least because of its close proximity to the motorway and current absence of major roadworks It is a place to relax and stroll about while waiting to meet incoming friends and carparking is a doddle The flight to and from Liverpool with Ryanair is direct

Great Little Airport easy to find just off the motorway Departure Lounge only has seats toilets drinks machine but allows own food Reception is again sparse of amenities but has small cafe souvenir shop of camargue items at a hefty price Car park is literally opposite Disabled passengers have toilet share toilet with baby changing No disabled lift to from aircraft local fire crew manhandle wheelchairs down stairs very scary

Modern airport medium in Chinese terms Incoming by bus from runway efficient and fast very simple to get your bearings Outgoing fast very clear information very efficient checkin good facilities About min from city center

I have been flying out ofinto Norfolk airport my whole life and have always had a pleasurable experience with it this time was no different The Southwest checkin agent was very friendly as were the TSA employees at the checkpoint My bag got flagged as a possible explosive but luckily they figured out it wasnt A major plus ORF has to offer is its new bathrooms which were installed less than a year ago These are sleek modern and wellmaintained by airport staff The terminal itself reflects the era it was built in with smaller windows and lower ceilings than say SEA Instead of inducing claustrophobia though it gives the entire a building a more cozy feeling New seats at the gates with electrical outlets are also a major plus allowing you to charge your phone while you wait for your plane One downside of Norfolk International though is the WiFi It is very hard to connect to and hardly works Aside from that though this is a small practical nofrills airport that is impossible to get lost in and is located near the Norfolk Botanical Gardens another positive

As someone whos travels constantly for business Norfolk Airport is honestly the worst airport I have ever been through I have traveled through here well over a dozen times and not once had a pleasant experience here The ticketing agents are rude The TSA are frustratingly incompetent The airport is dirty and falling apart in many areas If you have any other option of airports I suggest you use it

It is a second tier nonhub airport so traffic is lower As others have noted it is surrounded by a botanical garden so the setting is beautiful Recently all of the food options were significantly upgraded Security moves quickly and efficiently The arrivals area is large and conveniently located next to the parking garage for a quick departure Rental car counters are right in the arrivals area Which brings me to the only negative waits for checked baggage are noticeably longer than almost any other airport Figure on a minimum minute wait Would recommend getting your rental car while you wait on your bags

Over the years have had the pleasure of travelling through this airport surely the best planned facility of its size anywhere in the world Maybe all wouldbe new airport planners should pay Norfolk a visit to see what a well designed airport should look like and thats not even mentioning the surrounding beautiful botanical gardens a very pleasant change from the usual grimy industrial areas adjoining most airports

what they were going to cook on that would take so long to produce a breakfast the only thing they were able to provide was tapas for breakfast I think Norwich Airport ought to reconsider their choice the flight But I dont think we will be flying through Norwich any time soon

Poorly organised and limited airport with backwards practices The first issue is that the long stay car park is not signposted you are funnelled into the short stay with no way to back out and the contact on the exit barrier then acts surprised at your mistake even though others were doing the same just for the short time we were there Next is a Development fee that all adults are required to pay on checkin at around I was aware of this before attending but it feels like a ripoff as there are no modern amenities to speak of its the sort of scam you expect in a banana republic We had to wait hours for a replacement aircraft as ours had a technical fault and although this is not directly the airports fault I cant help wonder if the issue could have been dealt with at a betterequipped airport There are lots stories about the issues caused by the fact the airport closes over night Our return flight was affected by this not because we travelled late but because a delay to our aircraft because due to this from the early morning where it had to divert to the midlands Then final point and the one that left the bitter taste in my mouth and the reason for this review was that when I went to leave the prepaid carpark hours late because of our delay I wasnt allowed to leave until I paid a fee for the overstay With the fact I paid them for the parking and the development fee this felt like daylight robbery and the man on the barrier intercom simply told me it wasnt his problem and to contact my airline Overall a poor show Norwich Stansted is slightly closer for me and friends laughed when i said I would try Norwich that it would be backwards and not fit mof the modern age unfortunately you proved then right

Pretty boring airport Not much on the way of amenities or food places Lack of working power plugs and comfortable places to sit Rude cleaning staff Staff at S lack basic English competencies Only recommended for short layover hours or less

A friendly airport if you just want to watch the planes from the viewing area but not passenger friendly poor layout Up a lot of stairs for passport checks when you arrive Had to go through security the past twice on departure the both times they claimed I had passed through a public area after the first check Security patdowns are embarrassingly intimate

Having walked up and down several flights of stairs and then left standing on them to get to Passport control If any accident had happened we would have been stuck on the stairs Health and safety measures need to be examined there Passport control at this airport was extremely slow Queues of people with no toilet facilities was very disappointing They need to get their act together

Nuremberg is an amazingly convenient and fast airport You get there easily by public transportation from the metro station to check in its not even one minute walking and you can be at your gate within minutes of arriving Baggage delivery is quick mostly your baggage is already at the conveyor belt when you get there

Extremely ignorant staff particularly a female on the gate She was the cause of patient passengers awaiting an explanation becoming upset and feeling mistreated She waved her finger in one persons face She shoed another passenger away with both her hands She stood with her arms folded grinning Her manner is appalling and perhaps would be more suited in a prison The gentleman on the desk downstairs however was the complete opposite He was understanding and compassionate The row of employees downstairs knew who I meant when we mentioned this female to them It is not the first time was one comment Another passenger has witnessed her vile behaviour on a previous trip This one employee is the reason I will never return to Nuremberg airport The security process was good The food was very poor No warm food just sandwiches and pretzels The airport was clean Transport to the city was quick and easy

Public transportation to and from the airport is great Easy access to the city center and local attractions However the employees that work at the gates are by far the rudest I have ever encountered as a traveler If the job is that stressful then maybe customer service is not for them Carrying on a personal conversation while passengers are trying to ask questions about the gate or delay times of a flight is probably not the right thing to do

Its always very relaxing to fly from to Nuremberg Its a really small airport but everything works so easy and uncomplicated You can get there easily by train a subway station is directly in front of the entrance or by car you can park just min walk away checkin is very fast and boarding too There is no shopping and not that many food options but when you just want to get relaxed and easy from A to B its perfect And the staff are nice too even the security staff is always goodhumored More airlines should use this airport

Bagan airport as most westerners will know is a small domestic terminal all very efficient as they do not seem to use computers Bags are weighed at check in luckily as a group of they just calculate all the luggage together which in my case was good as I was overweight Again usual screen luggage before entering departure lounge which is small with a caf for Tea or Coffee and rows of plastic seating again unable to hear announcements but they give you a sticker to put on your shirt so they know who is on which flight

What a dump Arrived in the morning only coffee shops open and each had lines out the door No other food options On the return trip layover I made the mistake of stopping by a Mexican restaurant The menu was limited and food tasted like reheated frozen food The layout is poorly thoughtout The queues for the airlines spill out into the walkway Anytime a flight is about to take off you are unable to pass through the area Worth avoiding if possible

Compared to SFO SJC and SMF OAK is a total dump Food selection is really poor The airport closes food vendors and the walls stay up for years The terminal is very small The location and weather at OAK are good but thats it
hours at custom check point That never happened to me before One person helping over people Will never go to that airport again for an international flight

If given the choice I will always fly into Oakland over SFO Its small efficient and flights are most of the time on time With the new BART connector train its super easy to get to

As we speak the new terminal is only used for arrivals Departures still go through the old dated terminal My first complaint is that there are no baggage trolleys at the parking place Very uncomfortable My major complaint is about how departing passengers are transported to their waiting aircraft on the platform A bus waits outside the gate and is so crammed with passengers that I worry some elderly people or children may become unwell especially in the summer heat A second bus is waiting behind Its an absolute insult to passengers that this second bus is rarely used Odessa Airport you are treating passengers worse than pigs

The most horrible service I have experienced Staff are rude ambience is stressful and not organized Even domestic flights seem like a nightmare as staff do not know how to be professional and organized Big attention to people who will travel from October if you dont have a printed ticket the airport has a right to charge you which is ridiculous How is it possible nowadays to charge for what you have already in the system

Arrived and departed as a domestic traveler between Tokyo Narita and Okinawa Naha Small and basic area for both arrivals and departure check in with only one small shop selling some souvenirs and cold drinks and a hot coffee stand but no actual food for lunches etc On departure the waiting area again has very limited food options with one small souvenir shop only offering some anaemic looking ham sandwiches There was one actual food stand but the sole employee was working at such in incredibly slow pace that after minutes waiting without being acknowledged that along with another passengers I had to give up waiting still hungry as my plane was now boarding A nice and easily navigated small airport with very friendly staff but I recommend bringing your own food with you

The international terminal of Okinawa compare to the domestic one is a lot smaller Like all other airports in Japan signage is clear clean and very organised Be warned the early birds for flights may not get the worms what I mean is due to its small size and limited counters available Very often an airline will only open its counter for check in at hours before the departure time There is no benefit to arrive early as you cant checkin yet plus very limited number of seating and restaurants The number of gifts shops and food stores after immigration is also very limited to a scanty few It is a little underwhelming so just dont expect too much its nothing like Osaka or Tokyo

It appears that conditions at Naha have changed somewhat in the two years since B Walberer commented on it While I havent been inside the domestic terminal the international terminal was small clean and efficient There are two restaurants in this terminal now The number of retail establishments is still limited but that wasnt a problem While I had to board a shuttle from the plane to the terminal upon arrival an airbridge allowed me to board the aircraft directly on the return flight One thing Naha could improve on is the waiting time to go through immigration upon arrival
I live here and fly regularly New terminals are open airy and plenty of seating Limited but appropriate shopping Nice caferestaurant selection for a small airport Security swift and courteous

Easy in and out airport Decent selection of food outlets and shopping options for an airport its size Flew in for a day trip to visit and old friend and had no issues whatsoever Security screening was a breeze less than minutes Flew in and out of the B concourse

I was brought to the airport by a friend There is both adequate paid parking and also free minutes for drop off and pick up The terminal building is a little dated but it functionas well There were a couple of flights being checked in while I arrived and there were sufficient counters open so that queues were reasonable The security check was fast and worked well You then went upstairs where there is a lounge and cafes and space to sit Boarding in my case was on a bus but no problems

Worst wheelchair assistance experience ever Attendant assigned to me did not speak enough English to understand my needs ended up parking me off to the side and walked away

Traveling to Florida with friends for a cruise our arrival was fine The departure was not We arrived at the airport around am our flight did not leave until pm We were fine with this and tried to make the best of it The airport was clean but there is limited food selections prior to going through security The employee at the registers was extremely slow and not very friendly When you pay plus for a burger and fries you would expect better service The Allegiant desk representatives were rude I asked how soon before our flight could we check bags I was told hours which was great but the representative didnt look at me smile or ask how can I help The absolute worst was the TSA agents extremely rude and arrogant They were demanding and extremely unfriendly

I would like to share a positive experience I had with airport staff on December I came back from a weeklong trip to find that my car battery had completely died We called AAA but it was a long wait time due to the holiday weekend A very nice gentleman in an airport pickup stopped by to check on us and offered to jump start the car He was respectful and courteous and saved us quite a bit of wait time We will forever be grateful for his kindness and professionalism

If you like large airports with lots of shops restaurants and people then Sanford is not the sort of airport you would appreciate However if you prefer a small regional type airport that you can pass through quickly both in and out without stress then I strongly recommend Sanford We now look at TUI flight options first simply because they use this airport The staff are friendly including immigration and security and yet its only about miles north of Orlando and roughly a minute drive to the Disney resorts We havent been here since but I can confirm from the time we started queuing for immigration to collecting baggage was only minutes Compare this to Orlando International where you would probably be held in a holding area due to congestion

Very very poor experience A Wednesday middle of the day and there were two passport booths open Absolutely huge queues Waited over an hour You expect this in poorer countries over the world You do not expect this in one of the supposedly most civilised and wealthiest Really unacceptable Spoils things a lot Not good Norway not good at all

Badly organised extremely chaotic and long passport queue For a country that manages exceptional feats of engineering and superb tourism all around the country it is extraordinary that it fails to organise such a basic airport function leaving millions of air passengers with a really negative impression of the country as they depart The Oslo airport building itself is modern and impressive this is simply a case of bad management With a decent plan it could be fixed if they can be bothered
Poor signposting of amenities The Information desk was closed in arrivals I tried to find the walkway to Radisson Red but only found it by accident

There was one entrance for two gates Also there is no display in front of the concerned gate for which airline city the flight is flying to As they give more importance to Norway language and the slang of the English it is very difficult to go through the gate by simply assuming

Avoid this airport if you have a wheelchair I travelled through Oslo airport with my year old disabled mother yesterday We flew in collected our suitcases and stood in line to recheck our bags on a British airline We had three hours and plenty of time to check in First the woman at the checkin was told by someone in Cargo that they wanted a photo of the battery Then they asked for some obscure information about the battery that we did not have and told us we could not fly unless we somehow produced a paper with the information My mother has been disabled for years and has flown several hundred times on flights in Europe and the USA with the same model of wheelchair she still uses Its a well known brand We have only ever been asked for the weight and dimensions of her wheelchair and the type of battery dry cell and how it turns off by key After standing there for an hour and a half another checkin person finally found some information online and we were told to go as quickly as possible to the gate I asked for help getting there as it was minutes before the boarding time I pleaded with the checkin person to get our suitcases on board they had been taken off the plane half way through this incident No help was given as we had to negotiate security the length of the airport and passport control by ourselves There was no time to use a disabled toilet which we knew from our trip through Oslo a week earlier had a broken seat and was dangerous which resulted in my mother not being able to use a toilet for hours she cant walk to use the ones on the plane This was a nightmare experience which only got worse when we landed at the next airport

Could have been quite nice small airport but some things has to be improved Its always understaffed security passport control cleaning and maintenance Especially on holiday time Its always the same management forget to check the calendar for holiday or peak times For the cleanness and tidiness looks like management fired everyone hired some incompetent externals and never leave their office chair to walk around the airport and check how nasty it looks

This was my second trip to Oslo this year but I have never experienced such an interrogation by Norwegian Immigration during my previous visits You would think that coming from a country with one of the most powerful passports in the world would help Im not trying to sound arrogant but one would expect that Oslo Norway Immigration would have done their due diligence regarding passengers arriving in their country especially given the high number of tourists As someone who travels frequently the officer would have seen that I have visited Norway numerous times before and would have access to intelligence regarding my background Instead I felt subjected to an interrogation with questions about what I was doing there how long I would be staying my return flight and the address where I would be staying This unnecessary scrutiny made me feel as though Norway does not welcome visitors and treats everyone like a potential criminal especially if their flight originates from Istanbul I understand the necessity of conducting checks on visitors but there is certainly room for improvement in their level of security and scrutiny

Check in procedure was absolutely a terrible experience Staff seemed very tired and frustrated Very few people working No staff checking how people put their belongings in the trays in the first place before entering the scanners only checking this carefully after the trays go into the scanners causing them to be returned back into the machines causing further delays and items getting lost In that procedure one of our ipads got lost causing further stress and anger even more anger when staff show no empathy at all Lines of people waiting and nothing moving Staff not helpful at all and not pleasant to deal with at all Very disorganized and this experience was totally unexpected from Oslo Airport It seems that very few people work over there in these types of jobs which could easily be replaced by more intelligent machines These staff members clearly seem to be tired frustrated and show lack of motivation to such a routine nature or work Our experience in Helsinki airport in comparison was wonderful and smooth They had super intelligent machines which did not require us to remove one single thing from our handbags and staff there were cheerful and very helpful
