My home airport thus I use it a few times a year Check in has been as easy as anywhere else I have flown with similar wait times Terminal A can get busy midday but I have always found a seat I never expect in any airport to find food and drink at bargain prices thus not shocked I see some talk of coffee I had a coffee for pesos which is under As a resident I can bypass the hoards that arrive midday when entering the country There is a lane set up for residents and citizens to the right of the concourse I always feel a little guilty but hey I am a resident Best try to get flights that do not arrive between pm The baggage handler I had assist was obviously in cahoots with the customs official who tried to intimidate a propina out of me He told me to leave it with the baggage guy I left him nothing The airport does need more capacity to process those arriving or perhaps an automated system that is often found these days

People that work here seem more preoccupied with talking amongst themselves than paying attention to customers Although immigration has improved its processing of passengers there are still quirks Security procedures here are not lined up with US guidelines they took a pair of nose hair trimming scissors from me that had a round tip and not even in blade Just absurd Shops are expensive dollars for coffee from an automatic machine seems excessive

One would think that after years PUJ would figure out how to operate an airport Whoever runs the place has no clue with respect to airport operations or management It is definitely a rd World airport Customs and Immigration is ridiculous and laborious Staff are extremely rude given its a tourist airport The departure lounge has maybe seats for travelers and restroom The worst part is the PA system wont tell you when aircraft are boarding until the last call By then you are scrambling to get to the plane Checkin counters are openair with no ac They think their thatched roof and openair are cute but we want ac when we get to the airport on degree days Weve had enough sun and heat and dont want to sweat all the way to the plane The coup de gras is some idiot thought it was a good idea to put a pool by the departure lounge so you can swim while waiting for your plane Good news though There will be a new airport in Bavaro to compete with PUJ Should go a long way to put PUJ out of business The new airport investors seem to know what they are doing and how to run a good airport We will see My advice is to fly in to Santo Domingo and get transportation to Punta Cana and avoid the hassles

Long lines Unable to hear employees calling for flights that need passengers to skip to front of lines that are hour long Missed my flight because they cant communicate with passengers I was literally there in line I got a call asking if I was going on the flight I confirmed I was but was waiting to check my bag She told me check bag time for the flight ends minutes before departure and it was too late for me and to find a representative I cut everyone in line and spoke with a lady at the counter who said they announced for all people on my flight to go directly to the counter ahead of the line I told her no one in line can hear anything they are saying She said thats what shed been telling her coworkers After she confirmed I couldnt get a new flight for days I sat and waited for my ride to come back and get me and I then witnessed an employee walk around and shout the names of destinations whose flights were needing to have customers go to the front of the line immediately to check in I was furious because had it been done sooner I couldve been on my way home with my seven year old who was sobbing because he couldnt go home to his dad I will never use this airport again I am so frustrated

They should spend more money on putting gates in the airport instead of a multi million dollar resort Plus there isnt any place to eat and minimal places to sit When a full plane comes in and you have to stand for a minimum of hour it gets pretty bad at least for seniors

Pretty good facilities The negative side of this airport is the bad customer service from the custom officers I had to fly to Singapore and lacked one of the documents that was not required from previous trips the custom officer told me that I was not allowed to pass immigration and confiscated my boarding pass No more help was given other than telling me that someone from Singapore had to fax me or mail me the document They left me hanging there One of the young custom officers tried to help but was immediately directed away by his superior If there is one thing to improve about Qingdao airport it would definitely be the level of service provided by the custom officers At the end of the story the document they required can be printed within minutes and was not required of course I missed my flight

Not a bad little airport Plenty of space and seating if you need to wait a while But like all most Chinese airports the departure shops are terrible and expensive Bring your own snacks drinks or something to read Nothing to see there but it is comfortable enough

Nice modern airport Efficiently run Arrived here on an international flight from ICN and was bussed to terminal despite most finger docks being empty Immigration was a breeze and luggate was efficiently delivered On outgoing domestic flight to SZX our flight Shandong airlines didnt appear at all on the departure screens but was correctly displayed at the gate Flight delayed and no announcements made Good selection of outlets Pleasant environment waiting for the plane big bright airy About minutes drive out of Qingdao

We flew out of YQB UA on Tuesday October at pm I became very disabled after a bad fall in old Quebec Clty on Monday October After going to the Blessed Sacrement emergency and having much pain due to pelvic fractures After much pain we had to delay flight plans back home from Oct I contacted UA for disability help I was assured we would be taken care of at the car rental area and throughout the airport terminal also YQB website assured they are very proud of their disability service Fortunately after Avis personnel refused to help an airport employee saw us struggling to manage our luggage walker and wheelchair and offered to help get us to Avis Sadly I had to beg for help because the response was Our airport is too small Finally at Avis a young man behind the desk said I will help you And then took us to the UA Ticket Counter He refused an offer of a tip Then after getting baggage etc taken care of again we asked for help to go through TSA and boarding area At first the response was again Our airport is too small Fortunately a young woman said she would help And she did with kindness and refused a tip She dropped us off at boarding area after letting us get some food at a vendor and stopped so we could use the restroom She said she would be back to help us get our boarding pass and onto the plane SHE DID We are giving an excellent rating because of the people that did take the initiative to help us despite others refusing

Very rude and impatient security personnel It wasnt very busy which was good However making sure instructions are enunciated and understood before being rude would be better served The attendant that was supposed to be instructing you to enter metal detectors was more concerned with personal conversations than directing travelers and proceeded to yell at me advance move She was so far away from the metal detector I had no idea she was referencing me Bad ending to an otherwise excellent trip

We have traveled to many countries including throughout Europe China Russia etc but the Quebec airport is truly the most disorganized we have ever experienced First you cant check your luggage in until hours prior to departure which means you have to drag your luggage everywhere until that time We were coming off a cruise and were there hours ahead of time There were so many people there was no where to sit Then when it was time to check in it was huge lines with representatives giving out conflicting information kiosks not working properly etc Once we did get ourselves checked in and went upstairs the few food locations they had were jammed with very long lines Maybe flying into this airport would be okay but I would discourage anyone from flying out of this airport It is utter confusion

Small airport dealing mostly with flights within Canada and USA Security was quick and easy no language problems either and we were through into the departure lounge which only has a shop and cafe but does have good free wifi to give you something to do while you wait A good experience

Arriving from the US was easy and fast No long walks not monorails no buses You get off the plane go to customs get your suitcase change some money and grabbed a taxi all with a minimum of traipsing around Most efficient arrival anywhere Departure not so good Airlines staff was late opening checkin lines Baggage check man ridiculed my attempts to speak French and the woman operating the Xray was rude to passengers Furthermore the airport offers little in the way of food for purchase and dutyfree items
Love Quebecs airport Small but offers all of the facilities in a big airport Not too much people

Worst security queues and management The security team were either poorly trained or had poor equipment as my bag went thru times and found nothing It seems that the domestic market is not important and this maybe an airport management decision as international passengers had no queue while domestic passengers queued for minutes Not good enough

It is unbelievably customer unfriendly Baggage took over minutes to be off loaded There were no taxis waiting for passengers that arrived There was no one calling for taxi service There is very very limited shade Lucky it was a hot sunny day but imagine arriving on a wet winter night Its not rocket science This has to change Absolutely disappointing experience

Departing from here is like a form of torture The departure gates all face the sun and it streams into them without any blinds or sun shades The gates are therefore like little greenhouses filled with a hundred or so people all getting hotter and sweatier Only two rows of priority seating are in the shaded area the rest of lounge is entirely bathed in sunlight It could be helped with some airconditioning but sadly no There seems to be no cooling at all as I sit here quietly roasting To top it all off the sound system is tinny and like something from the late s which makes even The Who sound like a poor high school band Horrible cant wait to Board and get away

Oh Queenstown Airport You folks really let the side down coming and going This exkiwi visiting family with her partner had a minute queue for biosecurity coming in I fully support protecting NZ flora and fauna but how about some more staff then a minute wait simply for bag drop on departure again where are all the staff No apology at any stage either You need to do so much better
Worst airport ever Immigration had no people working and everyone waited over an hour and some hours Its like they had no idea flights were arriving
It was perfect I love everything about thr airport It was quick and has good staff Good food and its modern Just love it but I dont like the national airlines like TAME

Small airport and with almost no seats before airline check in Counter check in line only available to ticketed passengers Be ready to show passport and boarding pass physical or electronic ticket or Web check in Space for queues is limited so it could be crowded especially if theres another airline during check in process in the same area Restaurants for general public in another building outside the airport Almost nothing once you clear security and emigration Only one very simple paid lounge No courtesy lounges for Airlines

When you get off the plane at Quito Mariscal Airport you are greeted with a stunning view of the mountains The staff are all very friendly and the airport itself is quite modern While there arent tonnes of bars and restaurants like the airports at home in Britain it doesnt matter Because the facilities are satisfactory and the staff behave the way staff should I arrived in Quito after transit in Panama which was a total dump with extremely rude staff so to arrive in my final destination where I now live and to be greeted to my new country in such a friendly manner by immigration and customs was lovely

We only used the airport for arrival so cant comment on departure related matters The arrivals hall had all the facilities one would expect of a modern airport but was let down by very long immigration queues We had to queue for just over an hour There were two queues one for nationals of Ecuador plus nationals of a few other South American countries and the second for Foreigners There simply werent enough desks open for Foreigners but there were plenty open for Ecuadorians so they never had to wait more than maybe or minutes This really needs to be rectified and also there needs to be clear signage as to which queue to join In front of us was a couple from Peru who could have used the short queue had it been clearly marked On the day of our arrival Sept the new road from the airport to Quito had just been opened that very same day so the journey to the centre took us just minutes even though it was a busy time of the day Shame about the immigration queues as immigration staff were pleasant enough and this should otherwise rate as a good airport

Still not in full working order March One hour for bags to arrive from international flight Immigration fast and terminal clean The worst part is getting to Quito The traffic is terrible and there is only a one lane bridge across the gorge Try to arrive on Saturday or Sunday when you can do the trip to the city in about one hour Otherwise it can take you hours

Tale of different airports arrival was horrible Stood in the immigration line for hours Heard similar if not worse stories for arriving passengers for the next day Departure was fine Check in was fairly quick immigration was painless Appeared to have many storesfood options available but went to the lounge to wait An additional inspection was required to get into the gate areabe warned you are not allowed to bring in bottled water even though obtained post security Airport is very close to town minutes to hotel new airport appears to be about an hour drive

The airport itself is nice and clean but the staff were awful I consider myself pretty easy going and let a lot of things brush over but the way my daughter and I were treated was completely uncalled for It was myself and my year old learning disabled daughter traveling home from a vacation visiting family in North Carolina TSA yelled at and berated my daughter for struggling to follow exact instructions scaring her and made following instructions that much harder It turned our already stressful day into a nightmare I understand millions of people move through the airport and there are protocols that need to be followed for everyones safety but I can say with absolute certainty we will never fly into or out of Raleigh again Experiencing one moodyrude person is easy to pass off as they are having a bad day but literally everyone Staff really need to get in touch with how to treat travelers like human beings not prisoners Chicago OHare TSAstaff are top notch and were so kind for our trip flying out making our experience this morning that much more shocking

This airport is fine but the TSA agents terminal are rude and condescending I frequently fly with small children my th flight with twoyearolds and have never had a worse experience with TSA practically berating me over stroller Most airports have you breakdown the stroller and run through machine NOT here If you dont want to be harassed do not break your stroller down I would suggest you refrain from asking either because they will make jokes about you in front of everyone They are slow unhelpful and unprofessional

I fly every week RDU is always the worst airport I have to use And this is saying something since I have to fly out of NYC airports The security check point is horrible Regardless of time of day even am The line is so long it spills out into the baggage drop area And its ALWAYS this way The staff are so rude They obviously enjoy harassing people Then should you have enough time for food or coffee the lines are huge for these too Dont even think about Starbucks unless you get to the airport hours before your flight

I had a Frontier flight that was scheduled to depart at pm and found out it was delayed Upon hearing that I was ok and figured I could just enjoy some of the restaurants and found out that every bar and restaurant closes at pm I was told by an employee that when flights are delayed they are supposed to receive a memorandum that will keep the restaurants open until those flights have departed There are too many people that pay good money to fly and there are no accommodations to keep them comfortable and entertained until their departure I strongly recommend the hours change from to pm for closing time I understand these places open up at or am but you still have fliers who take flights late in the evening These little stores that stay open does not meet the demands of customers I am extremely dissatisfied

The Terminal AADelta etc arrival area where most airlines come in is the most poorly run pick up area I have ever been to Twice this summer I had to experience the gridlock of cars attempting to pick up people at this terminal There is no way to pull over to pick up people even when they are right there waiting out front The security officers yell at you to keep driving around adding to traffic issues and do not give you a chance to pull over My yearold mother was stepping across several lanes of traffic to try and reach me and the security officer was yelling at both of us I had already circled around times The poorly run arrival area looks like a COVID hotspot If they would let you pick up passengers there would be fewer problems They should redirect rental car buses to another location or spread arrivals out so there are fewer people trying to be picked up at the same time The security officers should get off of their Segways and try being helpful instead of yelling at elderly people and those picking them up

The woman taking care of boarding was very rude and overbearing She made me pay for a carry on bag I have a small under seat bag that I use all the time and went under the seat when I sat down I asked a flight attendant if the bag was alright there and she said yes I was told that she is not well liked by Allegiant staff and I cant imagine why she is employed by Allegiant I fly Allegiant all of the time but usually go out of Grand Island and they are wonderful I will not fly Allegiant out of Rapid again According to passengers this happens all the time

Personally Rarotonga airport like most of the Cook Islands is a little overrated Had to stand for minutes in a queue to check in on a concrete floor while we waited for the check in desks to open which they did minutes past their advertised time After checking in we were told we had to pay a departure tax which I was told is not part of the airline ticket price Customs and immigration not that helpful and my wife had to give up some perfume we had just bought or they would not clear us Limited shopping there but the toilets were clean Blaring music non stop which made it hard to hear the announcements so at times you were doubting you were at the right gate Not overly impressed

Half the terminal has been demolished to make way for the new terminal under construction Bit of a shock on arrival but should be fabulous when finished Befitting a gorgeous island such as Rarotonga Previously RAR didnt separate Arrivals and departures bit of a problem for the once weekly flight tofrom LA No airbridges in the new terminal planned from the renderings I could see So still a bit of a problem to from aircraft when a tropical downpour arrives as it want to do Reason being this is such a tiny aerodrome with short runway of approx m just enough for a Accordingly turnaround and parking area for aircraft precludes a fixed airbridge New departure area will still have the outside garden area so you can have one last look over the airfield to the beautiful mountain peaks before boarding On another note duty free no longer the stupendous bargain it once was Still pretty good compared to many big airports around the world Happy to see such a new terminal being built but also a shame that Raro is geting all grown up Hope the new terminal can retains its island feeling

Small airport by international standards Immigration and customs smiling and welcoming Departure easy with only one aircraft departure tax has to be paid and quite rigorous security procedure but done with typical Cook Islands good nature Walk from terminal to aircraft across tarmac necessary Could be a wet one in a tropical downpour

The airport might be nice small and clean but there is a big BUT hours before departure the queueline was already going all the way through the airport that means the double length of a normal full line but the checkin counter was not open They didnt work I am sure you had to queue for more then hours with that airport service I am sorry but the airport is not modern since they dont accept boarding passes on a smartphone they make you to go back in to the line to get the boarding pass printed Since I did already the checkin online and had no baggage I could go to the fist class line and skip the hour checkin line otherwise I would have been very upset and angry with the Recife Airport Also not perfect It is a bit complicated to store the luggage inside the airport and its very difficult to find it you have to ask a person

The airport terminal was built from scratch beside the old building currently closed It has a huge skylight from end to end making good use of natural light that reaches all floors through an atrium Many sculptures are integrated in the project which gives it an interesting touch Facilities are good enough The local delicacies stores are surely to be visited Totally sets itself apart from most Brazilian airports whose problems usually begin at finding a parking spot and extend through all possible aspects up to the boarding ramps

One of the nicest most modern airports in the country Decent array of shops and restaurants Not a large selection between security checkpoints and departure gates but that is typical and here it is still far better than at Fortaleza a city of similar size Airport is close to town especially beach areas so transportation is usually easy How many agents are actually working at the checkin counters can vary widely but I assume that is the responsibility of the airlines

Redding Municipal Airport Newly Remodeled with Same Shortcomings Not Ready for Prime Time For years using the Redding Airport RDD has been an exercise in frustration Much of the frustration stems its primary subpar I dont care airline United and pathetic staffing levels Heres the truth Redding Airport is treated like an inconvenient afterthought as connecting airports regularly delay inbound planes not once but at least twice You have a pm flight no worries count on departing around pm You had better hope your connections are not too close lest you miss them The new remodel has helped speed up what typically was a minute wait for checked bags for the one and only plane that has landed at the airport Now you wait about minutes for arriving guests to get their luggage Want something to eat while waiting Need to speak to a gate agent Looking for professional and knowledgeable advise Look elsewhere The lone restaurant Chus Too is rarely open to attract customers to the bar while waiting for a plane Ticketing is a ghost town until hours prior to flight so you better have your phone app at the ready and have your carry on bag packed like Bear Grylls with snacks and other necessities if you need assistance Need a car rental to escape the lack of services in Redding to drive to San Francisco in hopes of catching your connecting flight Not in Redding rental agencies are consistent in their underwhelming inventory no oneway rental availability and exorbitant rates to rent a roller skate Redding airport is great if you have lots of time built into your itinerary for frustration delays and intentional understaffing and lack of assistance otherwise make the drive to Sacramento Airport SMF

This airport is too small and outdated for a region serving million people in ten different counties It is definitely worth the drive to Sacramento or San Francisco to get better flights and many people around here dont want to make that long cumbersome drive The terminal hasnt been updated since but all that was remodeled restrooms and new seats and carpeting We desperately need a larger airport with more flights and parking options

Regina International Airport is viewed by many as a municipal airport as they only have domestic flights and their only international flights are during the winter holiday season The airport is trying to expand but with the loss of transborder flights its limitations to serve the global network are seemingly smaller That being said their amentities presecurity include a full service Tim Hortons SubWay and a restaurant alongside a Relay In the departure lounge there is a Tim Hortons express a cafe a bar and another Relay The airport would benefit from a lounge such as Plaza Premium Departure and arrival are very quick as the only delays are due to the inbound flight or the deicing of an aircraft

Flew in and out of RNO on Southwest The terminal layout is compact and easy to navigate There are plenty of slot machines but unlike LAS there arent so many that they take up too much floor space and leave not enough room to walk past Smoking is also not permitted anywhere inside the terminal which is a nice change from LAS The foodbeverageshopping options in the gate areas are limited but there is a nice food and shopping court in the main terminal area before you pass security The rental car facility is just across the street from the terminal so there are no timeconsuming shuttle rides The airport is only miles from the city centre and traffic tofrom the terminal is usually light The TSA screening area however is too small and understaffed for a gate airport If youre travelling at peak times expect long lines and delays

Awful airport Very few staff for a great deal of passengers Queued for nearly an hour to check in with staff No water fountain facilities as is standard everywhere else Staff in restaurants unwilling to help but you can definitely buy water Its degrees outside And the air conditioning is terrible Announcements are poor Fraport are more interested in making a ton of money Thats what happens when theres no competition around Theyre making a bad impression of the great country of Greece

Absolute carnage huge queue at checkin but in fairness had desks open so got through fairly quickly security pretty quick as well then the problems begin On entering the departure area there was extreme over crowding No seats people sitting and standing everywhere the limited food venues totally full with large queues passport control was reasonably quick which takes you to the non Schengen area departure area which was also extremely busy with the same overcrowding Too many tourists in too small an area Not sure if always this busy but beware of potential overcrowding

Absolute chaos Boarding queues stretched the length of the terminal back to the duty free section Constant Greek language tannoy announcements No guidance offered at any stage Delayed an hour and a quarter

Just one small step above cattle barn status This so called Airport is not set up and unable to accommodate the hordes of tourists that pour in an out of Rhodes Shengen flights are delayed beyond anything I have seen anywhere else There are not enough seats except if you fly nonShengen Great advertising for Europe incapacity to treat with a minimal decency travelers spending their cash in this island The spectacle of people and children laying everywhere in the floor in overcrowded rooms with no or not enough AC feels like being in a third world country hospital after a disaster Official airport staff will explain that its much worse in other places I think they should be allowed to travel This place is despicable Stay away by all means

We had a weeks holiday in Rhodes so arrived and departed Our arrival at approx local time was easy and quick We were off the aircraft through passport control baggage collection and customs within minutes Our departure was longer and check in queues were lengthy with over an hours wait however I believe that is the responsibility of the airline not the airport All staff were courteous and cheerful We had a snack whilst waiting for our flight the quality wasnt good and it was very overpriced so whilst I wouldnt choose to eat in the airport again I would be happy enough to use the airport and look forward to visiting Rhodes again soon

One member of our party has special needs and requires the special assistance service The airport ground staff were exemplary We travel regularly The assistance kindness efficiency and responsiveness of all the ground staff we encountered was the best that we have experienced I would recommend Rhodes airport as an airport with staff that genuinely assist those with special and additional needs
TSA pre check is so slow Its supposed to be faster than general boarding thats what Im paying for The lady doing the check in appears to be new or just slow She needs help am

Never had a problem til now TSA was extremely rude they were pushing everyone around not just me Speaking to me as if I were a child This was th June at am No respect whatsoever very unprofessional It was obvious they were abusing their authority

Airport is clean and seems to be efficient as airports go However the food service is dismal There are no brand fastfood which is what we needed in order to catch a bus out to a conference center The only offering was some place called Cheeburger Cheeburger yes a dated reference to an old SNL staple which food was neither fast nor flavorful Fries were greasy meat was halfcooked and the service was slow Certainly an international Airport can do better

Richmond International is a new stylish and perfect sized airport on the outskirts of Richmond major air carriers serve RIC flying to over domestic and international destinations in the USA and Canada The airport is mediumsized and easy to find your way around The security lines are short and hasslefree The airport atrium has a large glass roof giving the airport interior a very open feel A restaurant in the atrium has a large window with a full view of the apron for all the plane spotters Travel into and out of RIC is always hasslefree and fun

Richmond is a medium size airport that has recently been extensively renovated My experience flying in and out was very pleasant RIC is a human sized airport so it is easy to get around Baggage recovery was fast and painless with our checked bags appearing only about five minutes after we had arrived at the carousel The rental car desks are conveniently sited and the rental car garage is a two minute walk from the terminal Our total time from landing to driving off in a rental car was less than thirty minutes The airport is well connected to the adjacent Interstate highway so the airport is easy to get into and out of On departure checkin and security was quick and painless There is a restaurant in the secure area offering a view of the ramp a pleasant thing for the travelling aircraft buff Overall I was very impressed with Richmond airport and would use it again anytime

A pretty average airport quite dated and gloomy especially landside Going through security was no problem airside things are slightly more bright and modern The prices in shops are an absolute rip off even by the standards of an airport

We were in transit through Riga Airport We have three children one of them four months old We were having a baby stroller which we handed to the ground crew before boarding the plane in Milan and no other luggage When in Riga we have asked one of the ground crew to give us the stroller which was five meters from him telling him that we are in transit and we dont have any other luggage He refused us telling us that is not his problem and he dont careWe have asked couple of times after he just turned his back and left We have asked two other ground crew and they have tell us that we need to go to pick up the stroller from the luggage hall We have asked inside the airport four different staff members and received four different answers of how to proceed none of them making sense In the end we have exit the airport retrieve the stroller going through security again with three children just because they dont care None of the staff members were nice but the guy on the ground crew was very rude We have traveled a lot of countries but never faced this issue If you could avoid this airport I will recommend you to do so

Never been to another airport where the staff wont empty your reusable bottle for you nor let you empty it yourself on the spot you have to go to the bathroom facilities with all your hand luggage I poured it into the trash container and they told me off and threatened to call the police next time The security control is also really slow although there wasnt any queue The containers are provided individually by the staff so you cant lay out your stuff while theyre checking another passenger I cant say I dont recommend the airport but you have to be prepared for how the security control is handled

Use this airport only as must Once you are through the passport control toilet use is done only in group excursions So god forbid you have human basic needs Beautiful touch to this regulation is you will be called to the gate at least two hours too early

Its a small airport at an island abt km from Rijeka Checking in and out goes quite fast at our experience Some staff members in the shop are kind of grumpy Nevertheless we are very happy with this airport how they have arranged a hotel in Opatija for our group when our flight was cancelled all of a sudden in the evening Our flight company Transavia told some people to find and book by themselves a hotel but the airport arranged bus transport and a luxurious hotel so our compliments

It is a small easy accessible airport with a huge unexpensive parking lot where you can easily drink a coffee outside while waiting for your check in But after check in the true horror begins There was just one girl who checked the passports before security check and we had to wait for minutes in a small very hot alley The alley had no AC but a glass roof it was incredible sweaty to stand in a pushy crowd just to get your passport checked Around there were kids mothers with babies and older people heavily breathing Who builds a glass house in a sunny country as waiting area At this moment there were just two middle sized planes boarding and the people were almost rioting because of this horrible situation

MUCRJKMUC We arrived at Rijeka Airport on Croatia Airlines twenty minutes ahead of schedule Ours was the only aircraft in service at the airport The offloading of the hand luggage went extremely quickly After immigration control there is only one conveyor belt for all arriving aircraft It took quite a while before baggage delivery started There is no money exchange at the airport so you should have a few kuna with you for the taxi or the bus The checkin for our flight back started two hours before departure There were two counters open for only passengers Boarding passes were only available for the first segment After security and passport control there is only one snack bar with limited products and a dutyfree shop which can only be accessed when the aircraft is ready for boarding On the plus side a very nice terrace where passengers can sit in the open and wait for the arrival of their aircraft

I flew to LCY from RTM in the middle of the day when it wasnt busy The only way to get there by public transport is the bus from the city centre Had to ask staff at the ticket counter to open bag drop Security staff were more interested in chatting amongst themselves than paying attention to passengers Food options poor with shelves barely stocked Toilets airside smelt revolting and needed a deep clean Staff in the dutyfree shop were eating their lunch at the counter also chatting amongst themselves while serving me Overall the staff throughout the entire airport didnt seem to care The plus side is its a small airport and the queuing was almost nonexistent In summary I would only use this airport if I were living near to it

I travelled from London Heathrow to Rotterdam on February and returned the following day On the outward journey I was through immigrationpassport control in less than a minute Arrivals area contains an information desk which provided useful information on onward connections and provided me with change for the bus travel recommendations and a complementary city map Bus number leaves from virtually outside arrivals and takes approx minutes to reach Rotterdam Central It costs euros at the time of writing and the driver has limited change On the return journey there was no queue for checkin and virtually no queue for security This is a small airport but there are decent airside facilities including a duty free shop cafe newsagent and an upstairs bar which has an outdoor seating area and viewing platform If you are travelling with BA there are no lounge facilities but you are allowed three complementary items from the airport cafe for which you will need to complete an information card Clear information throughout the terminal and announcements in English and in Dutch Free Internet in departures which was fast and required no password Overall this was a stress free experience and I was impressed with Rotterdam Airport

As I live nearby its a convenient airport for me especially because of frequent flights to London and Southern France You can make use of free Internet Parking is cheap Connection to Rotterdam City and Port area is good and quick Hardly any queuing you can arrive mins before departure without any problems Whenever possible I make use of RotterdamThe Hague Airport

On arrival on Sat nd March we had to queue outside the building then inside the building for a total of mins to get through passport control two unmanned counters on what I assume is busiest slot of week and season No signs at luggage reclaim as to where to collect skis found out from another passenger that they are left outside the terminal building in the bus park On flight home one week later even more chaotic with skis metre queue outside terminal with people directed to join it to check skis in People in front confirmed we were in the right queue After about mins in this queue we came across a small sign that said this queue was for TUI and other charter carriers Asked Crystal rep and he confirmed we were in the wrong queue and that we should check in skis with rest of luggage in Jet check in desks One hour later the woman at checkout said that I should now rejoin the queue outside to drop off my now labelled skis Fortunately by now the queue outside was only about metres long so I resigned myself to about another mins waiting My prayers were answered by a helpful Crystal rep who said that I should take my skis back inside an ring a bell on a door to the right and simply hand my skis over I was overjoyed when this worked I was then able to help out some fellow Brits who had also been misinformed by checkin desk staff A few signs in the airport would be much appreciated I will try to avoid using Salzburg airport again as it is incapable of handling the passenger numbers in the ski season It seems it is happy to take the money but unwilling to provide the service The contrast with Innsbruck Airport at the same time of year could not be greater A really poor experience

Overall good level of cleanliness and amenities However security systems are poor Despite not being busy in the least security lines were bottlenecked disabled passengers neglected staff frazzled and harried all passengers treated with the minimum of civility Most airports are significantly busier and flow more smoothly A top to bottom review of systems may help pinpoint why such a small number of passengers can cause the entire process to break down continously

Trip Verified On my way from SJC to SMF on Saturday morning I had to transit through SAN San Diego International Airport I arrived at Gate and departed from Gate in SAN Terminal However to get from Gate to Gate I had to exit the secured area and go through the TSA security checkpoint again This terminal layout is highly inconvenient for travelers yet there is no other option As a TSA PreCheck member I expect a smooth and efficient security process Unfortunately this was not the case on the morning of Saturday March th around AM when I was traveling through SAN At the secured area I entered the TSA PreCheck line at the first station on the left An officer scanned my drivers license took my picture and sent me through the bag and body scanners After walking through the scanner I was asked by a female officer if I was years old or older When I said no she told me I needed to remove my shoes I reminded her that I am a TSA PreCheck member which typically exempts me from this requirement but she insisted stating that I should have a card for it She then added Thats OK just take off your shoes and put them on the scanner Not wanting to waste time arguing I complied though it felt completely unnecessary While waiting for my shoes to emerge from the scanner another female officer approached and told me Lets take all your bags and redo everything at the standard line This meant my items were scanned a second time wasting an additional minutes First I dont understand what card the officer was referring to as I didnt see anyone else in line holding one If a physical card is required I should have been provided with it when my ID was first checked The lack of clarity was frustrating and added to the confusion Second the entire process felt disorganized and inefficient TSA PreCheck is designed to streamline the security process but instead my experience was filled with confusion delays and unnecessary steps While I understand the importance of security this encounter seemed to prioritize confusion over safety The TSA officers at SAN San Diego International Airport clearly need more training This process was not only inconvenient but also embarrassing and it wasted my valuable time Its disappointing that TSA an agency meant to set the standard for efficiency allowed such confusion and frustration to occur I hope this feedback prompts improvements in TSA operations at SAN Airport

TSA female working directly after I was scanned was rude She began by mumbling directions I could not hear or understand then she began barking orders at me and rolling her eyes Completely inefficient the whole crew Ran out of tubs to put our items in while workers were busy chatting off to the side laughing These people are responsible for assisting with detection of potentially dangerous passengers Seriously they are a joke

Ive traveled extensively in my lifetime to Airports all over the world SD Lindberg Field is always disappointing I flew out midmorning on a Wednesday to Atlanta ATL Seating at our assigned gate was full not adequate so we sat at an empty gate nearby ATL I feel is what every big city wishes there airport to be Large clean and efficient for people planes and cars ATL has a great ground transportation system in place and a Rental Car center which is next level with easy freeway access My flight back to SD arrived early but we spent the time gained sitting on the tarmac waiting for a gate Once off the plane I visited a small crowded restroom across from my arrival gate which obviously hadnt been cleaned for a while It smelled like an outhouse Baggage claim took longer as they had two flights using on one baggage carousel The ride back to our car at an area parking business was problematic another issue due to short staffing Also of note riding in the overcrowded van was how poorly maintained the roads into and out of the airport are I know airport construction has been going on forever but the roads around the airport need to be repaved Good first impressions are important If SD truly wants to be a worldclass destination it has to quit trying to make a small single runway airport do the job and build a new modern air and ground transportation center You cannot shoe horn a large efficient airport into the space Lindberg Field occupies Sadly in todays dollars I dont see that happening Ill look to use John Wayne Orange County or Ontario next time

I am a local Easily the worst airport I have experienced in a long time Always under construction Short staffed Incompetent baggage handling Flight arrived nearly on time at pm Kept us on the tarmac for min waiting for a gate when the plane occupying our gate was having mech issues and there were open gates available Did not announce baggage carousel for min Even turned off the carousel location board for a while since it was midnight Welcome to beautiful San Diego where we have zero clue about efficiency
This place is so tiny its a fire trap Way too many people for either terminal Bathrooms are also small It needs expanding for sure Plus the carpet at security was so gross

Had to make a connection here Got off the plane Had wheelchair assist Went to Einstein Brothers picked up a drink take my meds for the next flight and a bagel Then find out we are changing terminals and have to go through security again so purchasing an expensive airport drink only to throw it away minutes later Every major airport I have traveled through has secured connections from one terminal to another This is totally crazy for an airport that has this mini flights Had to turn around in the other terminal and buy another expensive airport Drink not mentioning wasting time going through security for the second time which I had done hours earlier in Honolulu Overall if youre making a connection avoid this airport at all cost

First of all this airport was absolutely packed to the gills and filthy it was holiday travel weekend and expected to be busy We arrived from a hour flight from Hawaii with TSA precheck already gone through the checks in Hawaii so we had snacks and waters not knowing we would have to exit the terminal and go back through TSA As we approach we are told we do have to go back through so we queue up and realize these people are literally stopping every single person families with kids and tubs of vasoline families with candles and things they purchased myself with an unopened bottle of water I purchased in the airport after going through TSA We all just had them throw our stuff out The hubs are set up so that its just a big circle with gates and one bathroom for men and one for women so once again we queue up to go into another filthy area that clearly had not time available to clean because it was so busy Then we couldnt find seats to wait for our flight out because there was already so little space until the last flight left This was the worst airport in our travel and probably the worst one Ive ever been to La Guardia seemed like a country club in comparison
We walked about mile to our connecting gateno shuttles or moving walkways until we reached our gate This is unacceptable We will never fly out of San Francisco again

The stores at SFO do not have stated prices for most of the products they sell We wanted to buy some candies and little presents for family and friends and found out that the choice is very poor for such an airport and a lot of prices were not stated only savings if you buy two three or more The staff at the stores were also very rude when asked for the prices

A pathetic excuse for an airport After departures eating options are limited and to make matters worse everything shuts at midnight which is no good if you have a midnight flight that is delayed for hours or longer The information provided as well was nonexistent other than by Philippine Airlines San Francisco is supposed to be a global hub so surely they could afford to make more effort for their passengers in terms of facilities especially shopping and dining after midnight Staff could also be more helpful

This airport is well organized and easy to navigate its become one of my favorite airports in the world On this trip JFKSFOTPE I flew into and also left from Terminal One recently renovated attractive and spacious It also contains quite a few spaces for relaxation plus many restaurants and shops On arrival my bag arrived before I did On departure I checked in at the Interational Terminal which is connected to Terminal One Going through security at International was fast and easy The only negative was that several of the restaurants in Terminal One were closed in the evening

I am delighted to share my exceptional experience with Officer Lucas at San Francisco International Airport His assistance in locating my lost phone and guiding me to the correct boarding gate was invaluable Not only did he ensure I found my belongings but he also took the time to ensure my wellbeing before departing I am sincerely grateful for his kindness and assistance

We got here with more than hours delay due to weather conditions landing at PM SFO did not plan any crew to take care of the suitcases and we ended up laying down on the floor next to a stopped carousel at the baggage claim There is no seat here No vending machine We heard unclear messages but its already hour and minutes and nothing is moving Not serious at all

I am quite disappointed about how I was treated by the people with power here at SFO namely immigration officers and employees at security Perhaps these people have an inflated sense of their own importance shouting out orders asking questions in a suspicious tone and not seeing the need for the most basic politenesses no please no hi no thank you no smiles Perhaps it would be good for their employers to remind these people that they are dealing with TRAVELERS not PRISON INMATES While I have noticed rudeness at other airports San Francisco is now the winner as the rudest airport I have encountered

Our flight arrived very late and the hotel shuttle stopped running Bryce was very kind to help us find transportation to our hotel He went above and beyond his job to make sure we arrived safely I was very satisfied

As a rule of thumb we avoid changing money at airports unless the country were visiting isnt credit card friendly or weve been advised to use cash for certain purposes Although Costa Rica is credit card friendly we read that changing money at the airport is advisable This was a big mistake In comparison to the exchange rate and charges at a bank in San Jos city we lost around due to changing at the airport this was the largest percentage weve lost amongst all money exchangers at an airport For us this was a very unpleasant experience especially for incoming new tourists Moreover one of our luggage was lost and there was only one person for the airline accommodating it took us over an hour in the baggage claimlost and found area

San Jose is a small but plucky tidy and efficient airport marred by a couple of flaws and bottlenecks It is modern and adequate for the passenger flow except Upon departing the early morning flights to cause the security line to grow enormously though it is processed in the most efficient way While more and more airlines have switched to include the departure tax the line can still be huge and at some points of the day its poorly staffed Upon arrivals there is a critical rush hour at noon where several flights from the US Mexico and Central America arrive at the same time causing immigration lines up to hours Other than that immigration is usually quick and baggage claim is very efficient around minutes Customs clearance is also very quick The other topic is the criminal price of the food inside the terminal Costa Rica is an expensive country but it goes to cringe worthy levels where you pay for one Cinnabon roll you pay in CLT for a burger with fries and refreshment You seriously need to come with some food in your stomach especially if you fly in the early morning flights Another uncomfortable point is that there is no arrivals hall per se and once you cross customs youll be literally thrown to the street

Used this airport several times over the past decade at various times of the day and on long and short haul flights A small pleasant airport where it is usually possible to find a quiet corner Staff are helpful and usually smile Dining is American fast food variety and expensive Pay the departure tax in advance at your hotel Avoid the postsecurity shopping as the prices are high

Not a bad airport Flew out of Terminal A with American Airlines I thought Terminal B was nicer than Terminal A Plenty of places to eat and view the runway My only complaint was the longish wait at security Other than that San Jose is a very functional airport

The airport is functional and adequate for a shortish stay But it is unbelievably expensive There is a simple measure for this Terminal Heathrow The Perfectionists Cafe Heston Blumenthal proud holder of a few Michelin stars food delivered by friendly waiter etc Burger San Jose airport Smashburger fast food burger in plastic tray And sadly that sums up too many experiences in Costa Rica I spend a lot of time here and the feeling that everything is horribly overpriced just grows and grows The airport is a good example of that feeling they are abusing their visitors
Small airport with few but good services Reasonable time to check in and pass passport checks Excessively expensive duty free It offers a good free wifi service also available outside the air side
No smokers lounge in the entite airport is a serious strain on my nerves Im off to a hour flight and having to be there hours previous makes it almost unbearable

Landed at San Jos airport at pm from ATL as scheduled but we had to wait minutes for our gate to open Once I finally got off the plane and inside the airport it was difficult finding the way to the parking garage because the signs are confusing It took longer than expected to get out of the parking garage For a small airport this place is packed The good thing is weatherrelated flight delays are rare which is what makes me prefer this airport over SFO

Nice terminal though no seating space at the checkin area seems to be very congested After security check the seating area is much better though limited options of food and shopping The terminal itself is new and well maintained not much walk times The view of the runway from the terminal is good so you can pass your time quite well Free wifi with reasonably good connectivity available Announcements are adequate Overall quite good

This was the worst experience trying to board the flight The ticket agent didnt understand or speak English She was saying no over and over She was trying to tell us to get at the end of the line because we were in the wrong zone Then they made us throw away our belongings even though the Cleveland airport had no problems with the same bags I will never use this airport again

Took over an hour to get through security Quality of food abysmal Terminal was changed several times for no reason forcing us to run across the airport then when we finally arrived at the last relocation over an hour early there were no seats left forcing us to stand or sit on the floor For the WiFi they try to get you to fill out a full survey with contact information Also to make everything somehow even worse there isnt any sort of usable map available online simply states food for restaurant locations Good thing this place is a monopoly because otherwise theyd go under in a week

I was flying out of Puerto Rico through American Airlines and I must say this is the worst airport when it comes to customer service I ask an American airline employee for help as I was trying to check my bag and she was extremely rude she told me no I dont speak English I then asked her in Spanish and she got irritated and told me no I dont think so Once I got to the counter the guy that check my bag was extremely rude with an attitude Ive traveled through plenty of airports and this airport is cleaner than others airports Ive been to Its not a lot of good variety of food

San Juan airports water fountains are disgusting They are dirty and many are nonworking When they do work the water tastes like it came from a sewer Since you have to dump liquids at security your only choice is to buy bottles of water Two oz bottles of Dasani are That is obscene Decent airports have water available in drinking fountains and refill stations for free In addition to the obscene cost it is an environmental issue We carry refillable Yeti bottles but the water is unfit for consumption This opinion about the water quality is from a year infantry US Marine who has drunk some pretty disgusting water Clean potable water is a basic function like toilets

Small and easy to navigate airport but immigration customs is rude and not friendly at all I had a question in refence to the permit how to fill it out And they were rude because I didnt have a full physical address to my grandmothers house She passed away yrs ago and they kept insisting to call and get the address
Easy to use airport with less than flights a day Very short distances easy to handle A god alternative to Biarritz if you need to fly in this area

Met an unaccompanied minor arriving on an Iberia flight The aircraft taxied right to the windows of the cafelounge we could see her escorted as the first passenger off the plane We were allowed into baggage area to meet her baggage arrived within minutes two minutes later we were in the car Sending her back was just as good No queue at Iberia checkin we could escort her into the gate area she was taken on as first passenger aboard Cannot fault this airport

Better than I had expected but you wont forget that Yemen is a developing country Small terminal but ample staff at Customs and Immigration Both were friendly and professional and lines not out of control in either direction The airport checkin staff seem to work for all airlines as there are not that many flights per day They were also very friendly even though passengers could be a bit of a handful common in this part of world Porters fairly aggressive but will lay off without hard feelings if you say no Dont wait for airport to buy souvenirs everything is very expensive and theres not much there anyway The business lounge is clean and spacious and has a few drinks but not much else I would trust to eat or drink Main seating area not very comfortable

Santander airport feels like it needs to modernise It is a small airport that is dealing with a larger number of passengers Everything feels a bit worn it could do with sprucing things up a bit The cafe before check in was very nice and had a good selection of food at a reasonable price

Quite a small modern airport which is only minutes by taxi from the centre of Santander Extremely limited facilities ie one small cafe bar and one small shop with a very limited choice No facilities airside not even a toilet Insufficient seats airside

Despite being a resident in Chile travelling business class there are long waits to exit and enter the country I often wonder when dealing with the airport staff and border guards why anyone would want to come here ever again Rude unprofessional and utterly incompetent the border guards create long queues for which there is no apology or sympathy for those that have to wait You then get barked at by rude PDI border guards who cannot muster even a smile or mildly empathetic attitude why they need to scrutinise foreigners leaving the country is beyond me

Absolute nightmare of an airport No pharmacy past passport control No soft seating anywhere not even many seats in general Im in the middle of a hr flight from southern Chile to Australia with a bad back No showers unless you pay USD I love this country but hands down one of the worst airports in the world The USD million upgrade is a joke Only people happy to help are inside California pizza kitchen

Cant understand how LATAM sell tickets with connection of hour minutes if just to leave the first national terminal takes minutes by walking without waiting in the lines Just walking for minutes if you are in a hurry and need to go for the next flight There are almost no signs in airport if you want to make connections Inside of the airport on the ground floor which is for arrivals dont know why all few signs from one terminal to another for transfer providing you to incorrect floor you dont know how to reach another floor with departures and need to ask someone of the staff The Staff is very unprofessional I was lost and had minutes for the next flight and went to the staff of LATAM the guy was watching my boarding pass and trying to understand how to help me when I just asked where is the zone of boarding and then he told me that Im late for my flight and boarding is closed The best thing is that when I was in the gate in minutes there was the sign BOARDING but it was not boarding yet Really the worst airport

Very poor performance Two immigration kiosks operating after pm for international flights Waiting times for immigration were hours No effort made by airport staff to secure more officials at a very busy time

Terminal International Departure Efficient passport control and security check within the terminal an incredible amount of dining and bar options for every budget Wonderful new terminal maybe with not many toilet facilities as only negative point

The design of this airport makes almost no sense I only came on and off domestic flights in Chile well beside my entry flightbut I am talking about legs domestically Its the arrival that is the problem For example for domestic flights in the US you come out of your gate and even if you have checked baggage you can proceed directly to your next gate or go to baggage claim Yes depending on where the gate is or in the rare situation that you have to proceed to another terminal it could take a while but I have never walked more than mins ever in any US airport You come off of your domestic flight and whether you are connecting or not everyone is funneled out into a separate hall and during my domestic arrivals the walk to baggage was at least mins and I am a spry yo guyjust glad I only had my computer bag and not a carry on roller I cant imagine the difficulty the elderly or handicapped have to go through to get to their connecting gate or even just to baggage claim And on one of my arrivals I still had to wait another mins to see any bags from our flight coming out on the carousel

One of the worst experiences at an airport ever First of all the airport doesnt serve alcohol and wont allow you to purchase any for drinking at duty free Next they had a bunch of extra security checks and even dumped all our water at a check right before boarding The flight also left late Overall it was unfriendly and rude and made us feel like middle school students getting punished for nothing eg filling our water bottles to have hydration on the flight Weve been through multiple airports in Chile and theyve all been great experiences this is not a Chile issue Its a Santiago airport issue Really upsetting and wont be traveling through here again if we can help it

Why is there no pharmacy in this airport I have come from a long flight from Australia and during the flight I started feeling bad the tipics flue symptoms you can imagine been on a plane for hours sweating but cold muscular sore running nose and the only hope I had was to buy some pills at the airport As all the developed countries and not developed too to calm those symptoms and due the long layover ahead hrs nothing could go wrong As I landed I ask to one of the airport employees where is a pharmacy nearby and surprisingly she told me that there is no pharmacies on the transit passenger area So I ask can I go out a buy one on the pharmacies at the airport outside the international passenger transit area and then come back and the answer was a NO Apparently if you are traveling trough Santiago Airport and for some reasons you forget your pills and you get sick the only solutions is suffering Plus there is just places where they are allowed to sell beer knowing that the airport is massive imagine been walking around and nobody knows where you can get a really nice coldie

I was on the first flight of the day out of Santiago de Cuba airport We were told to be at the airport hours before departure However staff didnt even turn up until minutes after this time and by the time they were ready for checkin it had been a minute wait Then another wait ensured as we had to wait for security to get ready This other wait was another hour in the checkin hall with minimal seating and no one anywhere near the security area Once finally getting into the departure gate the seating which was abundant in here was set up like a maze The shop was unmanned and the food was stale Only praise I could give was cold beer and great wifi speeds

Avoid transiting through this airport The transit desk appears to keep banking hours and you will be forced to collect bags pay for a trolley and clear immigration You cant go back through security If your flight is more than hours away even If you have a lounge pass You bought duty free Too bad Airline staff seem uninformed Airport staff are either uninformed or lie pretty sure they lied based on repeated experience with the same staff member to make sure you leave the secure zone Generally treated with an I dont care not my problem attitude from airportcustoms employees

I have been using the Las Americas Airport for more than years and over recent years with much more trepidation On my last departure the Friday before Christmas I arrived before pm for a flight to Madrid leaving at pm travelling business class After clearing security it took more than minutes to get through the immigration people and at I was called to go to the departure gate where I was escorted to the downstairs baggage area because I was told they wished to search my bag which was not locked I could see my suitcase but no one wanted to sit down so I waited for more than minutes and there I witnessed young security men opening cases and throwing items all over the table and floor They opened Christmas presents of people flying to Europe they opened cigarette packets and emptied the cigarettes on the table they opened baby food and destroyed much and laughed in the faces of the passengers Finally I saw a terminal worker from my airline and asked her to try to get someone to inspect my case A customs official came and found only clothes and wanted to know why my case needed to be inspected when it had gone through the xray machines as had all the other cases I was the last person to board my flight and the flight attendants all told me of their dread of Santo Domingo airport try to avoid it

Drove here from Casa De Campo with some buddies returning from a golf trip Myself and a friend walked through security holding our money in our hands We were then questioned in a side room where they laid down the money on a table that was completely broken A young security guard then took from us and told us we were OK to proceed Also there was about people trying to fill out the customs card and the pens didnt work Staff didnt care We then had lunch as was told were not able to leave a tip on a credit card Cash only tips they said Felt very unsafe and abused by staff here I hope I never have to go back Place is a joke

SDQ has become a nightmare for Dominican residents leaving Now you need much more time as you are sent from one person to another to have the residency card photographed and then another person to have your ID checked and finally another person to stamp the passport Worse for people who are paying the penalty charge for staying longer than a month Once through the lounges are basic in the extreme duty free items except some alcohol more expensive than the Santo Domingo stores and the process of loading passengers on board chaotic it used to be so good but no longer

Our Easyjet flight to Manchester due to depart was delayed almost hours Although other delayed flights were advised on the airport screens ours was not I presume that delays are communicated to airports as other delayed planes including Easyjet were advised Airport staff did not know Check in staff who may have known did not advise SO we spent hours we didnt need to in a crowded airport Catering was fine and not too overpriced Duty Free used to be cheap but not anymore I have flown out of Santorini times The time before it was dirty with blocked toilets and rubbish everywhere Now it is a better building but not a better experience The time before that I was allowed to leave the departure gate to spend my Drachmas on a final couple of cans of beer Returning the officer had left so i walked around the metal detector to avoid setting it off I love Greece Not so much Greek airports

rd world conditions Departures involve a stampede for a standing place on a bus which takes you yards to a plane you could have easily walked to No boarding by row or zone We expected better on an island like Santorini Arrival is similar you take a yard bus ride from the plane to a long set of steps which you climb only go down another set of steps seconds later Police at the airport were actually very good and act more like airport information officers than law enforcement Its the only way in if youre flying Just dont have any high expectations

Frankly in shock after going through this airport times better to ferry to Athens instead and take a flight from there Airport authorities screaming at passengers to get on the plane pulling people out of line to charge them arbitrary amounts for additional baggage fees that has happened at no other airport with the same airline and then denying that the fees were paid and demanding money again People were sitting next to the bathroom on the floor in the stairwell crammed into the upstairs patio because there are no chairs anywhere else The bathrooms had no toilet paper or soap This was really really horrible

This tiny airport cannot cope with the number of visitors that come to the island For our departure all standing room in the terminal upstairs downstairs was taken up with people also sitting on the floors and stairs A roving customer service person was diligently telling people to delete pictures of the crowds and then checking that they had I was told it was so American tourists dont see it on social media A new terminal is being built but is only scheduled to open in Though the island is beautiful and we enjoyed our stay perhaps wait till then if you dont want to suffer

Sanya International Flights Terminal Flight got delayed and had to wait at the airport with no aircon and fan Very warm during hot season No other food except for KFC which does not serve precooked food Have to wait for at least minutes for food to be cooked Souvenir shops are closed and they are only open when nearing flight timing It is like a deserted airport with no proper facilities Only toilets are airconditioned

No real problem with the airport As with most chinese airports its rather recent with pretty efficient baggage claim Its also relatively close to the city ab km which means there are cheap and crowded regular buses and taxi will cost you maybe yuan But what I really love is the waiting area outside

Time passes and Congonhas remains the same with the same old problems The most irritating matter is the constant changes on assigned gates which may require you to cross the entire airport unnecessarily youll see flocks of passengers doing the same since changing the gate originally assigned seems to be a standard procedure at this airport There is no subway station Theres a local bus connecting to the nearest subway station but its not a proper vehicle for passengers with luggage Queue for a cab usually took more than hour but its taking less time on recent days since many passengers are using Uber Everything except the boarding gates area look old and filthy The smell of sewage in some toilets is so strong that passengers can feel it at the terminal hall this is particularly true at the toilets close to Starbucks Food and drinks theres a good number of options but prices at least x higher than youll find elsewhere Expect lines everywhere WIFI no wifi unless you pay for it I recommend you dont because its slow and unstable

Compared to GRU and other SAmerican airports it is not that bad For arrivals the metro does not exactly reach the airport but there is a city bus that can get you to the nearest station English signage is totally lacking so finding that bus is not going to be easy for international travellers Airport is crowded but for Brazil amazingly somewhat efficient For departures dont even bother to check the gate number on your boarding pass It will change often more than once before boarding But there is a modestly overpriced barstall after checkin where you can watch the monitor as your gate changes
One of the best domestic airports in the country Wellsituated Come prepared for delay gate changes and high prices Be careful with illegal taxis

Interesting experience This airport is very close to the city mainly for domestic flights and is extremely busy However even though really crowded all queues seem to move very quickly A reasonable mix of retail outlets and I thought the prices were OK Plenty on taxis on return there are prepay ones but for journeys into the city a metered cab is fine

Have some mixed feelings about this airport I enjoy its atmosphere and the boarding area from where the runway and planes can be seen On the other hand many of the usual Brazilian airport inefficiencies are present high prices constant gate changes no English announcements in boarding facilities and a chaotic luggage claim area

This is an interesting airport for Domestic flights throughout Brazil Check in area is full of lines for all different airlines and like old style the airline offices are opposite to check in Many people buy tickets same day at the airport Not many people speak English but if you ask someone if they do they will try or get someone who does if they do not I checked in for my flight on GOL and had hours They would have put me on the earlier flight if there was seats available even with the departure leaving in minutes Prior to security the main building has a round waiting area with shops food areas and so forth If you go to the second floor you will find an Internet cafe barber pharmacy police etc Go to the third floor for a wonderful outdoor bar and a full service restaurant full of TVs and a wonderful buffet You can stay as long as you like and be away from the throngs of folks travelling especially on weekends Past security is the new terminal that is huge and if your gate is at the end it will literally take you between to mins to get there No moving walkways There are snack bars and little shops along with plenty of seating NOW You need to understand that there are several gate changes and the ONLY main screen is after security So be sure of your gate if you can Anouncements were made in Portuguese and then English every time People will help you if you dont speak Portuguese just ask Signage is also in English but if you are going out to get a taxi or bus you must take the elevator if you want to keep using your free trolley Taxi line can be long and if you are going outside the city to say the International airport they will charge you additional to the fare Thats the law Take one of the buses if you can to transfer to Guarulhos

Airport help and customer services are bad No actual details or information about things that I tried to ask No real service and I am stuck here since the airport service screw ups Employees dont speak anything else than Portuguese or if you are lucky Spanish I speak only English all the information available are as squared as an circle It is nice to wait unknowingly how many more hours I need to sacrifice from my holiday I hope that these problems are not daily Ive been here at least time before and had problems then as well

Organizational mess Interactive signs show wrong info or not info at all Voice information are only in Portuguese and gate service does not speak English Near gate buses stay all the time near the doors running inserting its fumes constantly inside the terminal Ecology

Its a small modern airport with a really nice look On arrival there were some people arriving from Lisbon So lines for immigration and visa counters looked really long at first However it took only minutes to clear immigration and collect baggage As there is only one or less international flights per day there is no bank at the airport and the ATM wasnt working You can still pay with euros for taxis if needed and there is an official list of taxi fares posted close to one of entrances On departure for domestic flights everything worked well There are some small shops and a caf with normal prices in the main hall There was nothing opened on departure hall as you enter it only before flight departure They probably open the small cafe for international departures The strangest thing was that there was no security control at all before domestic departures I have no idea if its usual or not but many locals were surprised Its easygoing life on the islands but it seemed too chilled for me

Being in this airport was so much fun From the royce chocolate factory to different shopping areas there are lots of thing to do I arrived hours early but still did not have enoungh time to explore the airport The immigration was systemized and there were almost no lines Although it is not a star airport I think it has to be one of the best in the world

I have been to some of the worlds best star SIN ICN HKG HND airports but Sapporos New Chitose tops them all Why So much to do and enjoy Airport History Museum Royce Chocolate World factory openair Observation Deck Movie Theatre Onsen Sky Museum interactive airline stuff for kids and adults Hello Kitty Theatre Hotel amazing number and variety of food court options Aside from these frills New Chitose excels in what really matters to travelers Despite huge crowds SapporoTokyo is one of the worlds busiest routes terminal is spacious and easy to navigate Efficient checkin countersone dedicated to just school groups Spotless restrooms plenty of seats in departure areas Easy to use frequent every minutes JR train connections minutes to Sapporo Station Polite hardworking security teams Short waits on the runway for takeoffs

A modern and convenient airport in Hokkaido Island There is a direct train service from the Sapporo train station to the basement of the New Chitose Airport station The only negative point about the airport is there are too many shops selling the same local stuff
