This is a pretty nice small airport where you can find anything you would expect from it There are flaws like anywhere else They definitely need more staff which is obvious The offering of time killers are updated with new shopping places but still have to work on it My main issue was the parking which was pretty expensive so I had to search around for other solutions since the parking at the airport ended up more expensive than my Wizz Air ticket I use Google and found a private parking spaces but you can also look for others I suggest this one definitely Overall it is a decent airport that keeps on upgrading every year I visit it

A small airport yet convenient for the amount of flights they receive Checkin is mostly fast and efficient yet you cant use any online checkin yet due to restrictions by law The airport has jetbridges and gates the others are used for walk or bus boarding Border control is friendly and efficient The airport has duty free store but not much other facilities Beware of taxi drivers demanding outrages prices for a trip to the city center KM should be more than enough Theres a bus service to the city center but timings are a bit off

Sarajevo Airport is very small and very manageable After you enter the main building there are check ins Afterwards you have to go to the first floor where is one departure hall with or departure gates There is plenty of seating they also have big beanbags for seating which can be quite fun and relaxing There is only one bar with snacks and one shop If you are travelling with children the signs for baby changing room is misleading after you follow the signs there is no baby room You have to follow the signs for the bathroom for disabled If you wait for a long time you might get very bored
Small airport small queue size fast passport processing airport Staff are reasonable but not a single smile Smoking is unrestricted Taxi service available outside gate

Very small but clean and cozy airport with only gates Going through the passport control and customs was a breeze I do agree with the previous comments about taxis There is no public transportation from the airport to the city so unless someone is picking you up or youre picking up a rental youre forced to take a cab which will routinely rip you off and not even turn on the meter For a minute ride I was charged marks currently USD If you can arrange some type of transportation other than the taxi my advice is to do so

Small very clean and efficient from security check through checkin immigration and baggage claim But its not really a hospitable place theres no restaurant only three cafes offering the same things little or no food a very modest and unappealing dutyfree shop and a newsstand selling only locallanguage press If you have to spend time here youre out of luck Dont take the airport taxis which all overcharge instead call the official city cabs by dialling they arrive quickly and charge the relatively low official rate

Its very small but convenient airport There is small duty free area and coffee bar in upper floor after immigration and also one coffee bar before immigration Toilets are clean Immigration procedures on arrival and on departure are simple and fast

I have arrived and departed SJJ several times in the first half of and find very little to criticise It is fairly small and not very busy so checkin luggage handling passport checks etc tend to work quickly and effectively I have only encountered helpful and friendly staff in all areas One criticism is that there is no public transport to the airport except taxis and you should agree the price before you get in I did once walk from the nearest tram stop probably about km not recommended even with only hand luggage particularly when it starts to pour with rain halfway

The security staff do not speak clearly and some speak too fast Speaking clearly to customers should be top priority Also they could be more patient in telling people to remove clothing The instructions for the circular scanner were vague and resulted in a humiliating pat down

Saskatoon airport is small and simple to get around The signs pointing to the right place are just perfect Renovations were being done at this time but it was still super easy to be there and get to my flight on time

This small airport is relatively good but lacks selection of retail and food options The website is poorly maintained and customer service email is not monitored There is currently construction but information is not readily available on what the upgrade entails The check in counters are in need of an upgrade

SAV Airport is the only place to rent cars from the process seems seamless but its not For people coming from a flight directly to the airport it is but for locals it can be a headache with the parking of their actual vehicles The woman at Thrifty counter was beyond helpful she made this experience so seamless and easy The lady at the exit point for ticket collecting was rude and unprofessional Im usually a nice person but she had the nerve to say this is why people need to know how to read when we were trying to exit following the directions given to us since we had to cross load our vehicles Ive never felt so insulted

Coming from a large airport Chicago I was expecting better service and cleanliness in Savannah GA The security employees were pushy Unfriendly and rude to my three young sons as they were walking thru security We arrived at our gate only to find food and wrappers all over the ground It was filthy For a Saturday we were surprised to find restaurants closed Id choose OHare and its massiveness and cleanliness over this airport

I loved Savannah but will never return because I never want to step foot in this airport again Not only was every single food option closed at pm the vending machines were broken as well Literally the worst airport ever Never coming back to Savannah

Not Verified Baggage arrived on an earlier flight no baggage claim personnel present at the office until numerous phone calls and asking for help minutes later a lady arrived who was not helpful and kept saying she could not release my bag to me without the claim ticket which I had in my hand After a few minutes of asking what I needed she finally actually looked at the claim ticket saying Im sorry thats all I need

This is one of the nicest airports I have visited The staff are all helpful and cheerful The security system is quick and efficient and the seating areas are comfortable and spacious The woman playing piano in the area prior to security really sets the tone The whole expereince was professional polite and efficient

Flew in to SavannahHilton Head International September and departed October Once again an absolute pleasure to use My wife and I use this airport frequently when we travel to Hilton Head Island South Carolina On arrival my wife goes straight to the car rental desks about yards from baggage reclaim and I get the baggage from the belt Baggage retrieval usually takes minutes or so and by this time the car rental formalities have just about been completed The cars are just outside the Terminal doors and in about minutes we are on the Interstate On departure checking in with United Express is a breeze after handing back the rental car and then there is a very pleasant courtyard with retail caf outlets before going through security Even through security there are a surprising number and variety of eating and drinking outlets with a few retail shops Usual caveat if you have a late departure they may not all be open If only all Airports were this charming and nice to use

This is Tel Aviv domestic airport with only regular flights to Eilat Just one big room with enough seats for about people or so and a small cafe all next too checkin areas Do not let the tiny size fool you though security was absolutely out of control bordering surreal absurdity even with my Amercan passport with no questionable background or former travelled countries they just could not comprehend why a single man would take a day trip to Eilat questioning me over and over and then giving me a fullscale strip search and not even allowing me to take my wallet with me in the plane Word of caution if youre a single man do not take daytrips travel with a group and stay overnight

This is the most dirty airport I ever been to Garbage left on ground around chair area While my staying there from am to pm no one come to clean Waiting Seat around window are so chill Global entry is useless for connecting fly in this airport

First time at this airport What a disappointment after such a great cruise vacation Long line backed into traffic just to get to departure gates When we tried to check our bags at the kiosk it wouldnt work so we waited in line minutes to get assistance only to be told that Seattle doesnt allow bags to be checked more than hrs before flight What the heck So now were stuck standing with pcs of luggage because AA pushed our flight back by hrs No place to sit The or small eateries were quickly taken up with people dragging lg suitcases who refused to give up their seat once they finished eating The area near luggage check quickly got overcrowded with people pulling many large suitcases To have this hr policy no general seating handicap only makes no sense Once we finally checked the bags went to TSA another nightmare An hour at least in line One of the employees directing people said the reason for the madness was cruise ships just disembarked with ppl Miami doesnt have an issue Workers are rude not enough body scanners I and my carryon went through the metal detector only to be told that because my knees set it off I should now go to the line lanes over with a full body scanner Crazy Put scanners at all the TSA lanes Once we got to our gate escalator was broken it was dirty torn seats and smelled Only working bathroom in that concourse it was nasty with no soap in any of the dispensers womens The air at the terminal was stagnant warm Due to the construction I dont think there was any ventilation The icing on the cake is when I overheard an annoyed pilot speaking with a flight attendant saying how much he hates flying into this airport If you can avoid this airport do it

Late arrival due to fog Global Entry couldnt read my info Rescreening after customs is understaffed and slow Reader boards are not working right and dont match boarding pass gates My assumption is that checked luggage will not make it to my destination with my connecting flight it never has when passing through customs Just avoid this airport if you can

SeaTac now rivals LAX in terms of chaos in my opinion We waited in a line of people for the shuttle After spending about minutes trying to even find where to go There was no signage and the path to get there is a construction zone right now we had to weave around various obstacles We got on the th shuttle after about minutes of waiting Then we had to wait min in line to actually get the car that I had already paid for and had already prechecked in for well thats Budgets fault not SeaTacs Between these issues and taxiing on the runway I didnt leave the airport until hours after touching down I also had a bad experience last year when flying out of SeaTac I almost missed my flight despite arriving minutes early because of their spot saver program People are allowed to just cut in line for the security check This is not the regular precheck program this is just people who know about the app before they arrive to the airport and can sign up to skip in line

Small regional airport and the only airport in Malaysia not managed by MAHB About an hour bus ride from JB Sentral if you are coming over from Singapore Decent FB offerings such as Starbucks KFC Marrybrown secret recipe etc along with a smattering of other retail shops AirAsia self check in kiosks are available at the airport with other airlines flying from here being Malindo air Jin air Malaysia Airlines and Firefly Free wifi is available and the airport doesnt operate for hours although you can still enter and leave the airport even when its closed Most of the times you have to walk on the tarmac to the aircraft

A small airport with around just gates When I arrived immigration had only people in charge Many restaurants around and wifi is fast which really helps to order uber One problem is the check in counter baggage drop with only counter open and a long queue Really need to improve cleanliness
As usual Gimpo security check is failing Long queue as they do not know how to manage it They should open more security check point during peak hour

Totally outdated airport After check in you have to watch a screen to see if your luggage is security cleared Boarding pass security check long lines up to minutes Security up to minutes A real nightmare It is a shame for Korea image

The worst airport experience I have ever had The waiting time for the passport check was almost hours A lot of people had a hard time standing in line for that long Even old people had to queue and were unable to sit down They could also not use the priority line because you have to have a special medical card for that

The airport was well connected with the public transportation bus subway and even linked to a shopping mall Staff was friendly and professional In overall the signs were clear with both of English and Korean listed with fast and free WiFi The international terminal however was a bit boring not as busy as the domestic one
Gimpo international is not good Crowded check in long line for ticket control Longer line for security check Passport control ok This airport is a second tier quality Especially compared to Haneda

It is a privilege to be able to travel via GMP in Seoul Not because the airport is extraordinary but because it is within the city of Seoul and much closer then the island of Incheon GMP can be be reached by metro It is a domestic and an international airport the international connections are through towards Asian destinations GMP has the Advantages and the disadvantages of an old city airport easy to reach more efficient security procedures but old facilities like lounges

Terminal Check in good but long delayslines to check passport and boarding pass up to min Security and immigration The experience in this long lines are like a third world country Incheon airport authorities should be ashamed to offer such a poor experience And as it takes so much time no time for shopping

I fly a lot and this airport has become the worst I have ever experienced in terms of delays accessing departure lounge At the beginning December we waited hours to get through baggage inspection and beginning January we are again awaiting over one hour to get to baggage inspection For an airport that used to post being the best in the world it has really descended to the depths of the worst in a short period of time Note for business class passengers there is no fast track lane

The security clearance was horribly slow with extremely long queues which required to hours to clear terminal departure gate pm There were so many passengers but only security lanes were functioning This is probably the culprit This is incompetence on the part of the airport Read that Incheon airport is ranked rd best airport Is this a joke This is absurd and is not in keeping with the experience There were many shops and restaurants at the airport but this was completely moot when all the time was spent queueing at the security clearance with no time for shopping What a farce
Decent airport but inadequate for a country such as South Korea The airport has the most ridicolous control queuing system you unnecessarily have to queue for almost hours Avoid if possible

Checked in at am on Sunday morning The security lines were never ending at every security station in Terminal New scanning machines for bags and humans but still hopeless slow putting people through Over minutes to get through to passport control Allow yourself plenty of time

Incheon has become one of the worst airport Easy to check in but if your flight is in the morning be prepared to wait over min at security control Definitely they are ill prepared They should open it earlier and have a better indication on waiting time Korean airports authorities are not know to be clever

I had a smooth experience in the airport until I had to go to toilet They are super dirty Went to check different ones and none of them had paper Very unhygienic Make sure to have some tissues before you visit the restrooms

At the airport as I am writing this review I havent come here with high expectations knowing it is a smaller airport and so I am not disappointed by the few shops and services However I am hugely disappointed by the state of it especially when it comes to cleanliness My very first impression when I got out of the taxi and approached the entrance was that despite Spain being in the European Union they clearly dont respect the laws that are there to protect nonsmokers from the cigarette smoke Designated smoking areas should be at least meters away from any entrance The further the better Yet here you are greeted by huge smoke clouds as you are trying to make your way into the building I dont care if smokers kill themselves by I find it utterly unacceptable that everyone else should breath in the smoke and is disrespected by smokers let alone airport management My second impression was even worse after checkin and before heading to the security check I needed to use the toilet which was close to the entrance Boy did I regret entering that space Based on the lack of toilet paper in both toilets and the rubbish left everywhere and the toilet seat that was clearly dirty the lack of hand washing liquid it was clear that this room was not visited by cleaning personnel for very long In general the whole airport that I walked up and down many times was in desperate need of scrubbing The other toilet I used also was lacking handwashing gel and the floor was covered with toilet paper also piling up and falling down from the overflow bin I sat for over an hour in the big hall by gate B to charge my phone during this time I noticed a lot of dust and other dirt gathering under the seats and while cleaning ladies showed up during this time they only poked with their mops under one or two rows of seats then left not touching the rest of the area No tables were cleaned no plastic bottles that were left behind by lazy passengers were collected Later after another walk around I ended up at Gate where I wanted to continue charging my phone at the long table which has many plugs fixed in it but sadly none of them were accessible all were closed and I couldnt manually open their lid so I walked back to my previous charging table where i am right now and where the built in plugs are willed with dust dirt crumbles Based on what I have seen so far I must say that this airport is pretty neglected and badly maintained For me it was truly disappointing I will probably not return although Ive had a wonderful days in town Should have taken the train on the way back to Barcelona too
The best assistance so far for arrival and departure For someone who has less mobility and needs a wheel chair Superb and faster assistance Everything in place on time

First time using this airport it is modern has plenty of seats good signals and clear information security is also a breeze You can only reach this airport by bus or taxi Plenty of food options but very expensive for Spanish standards even more expensive than Madrids or Barcelonas airport But now what shocked me most as people have mentioned it in here the total lack of cleaning I can not explain why but this airport is filthy Toilets floor seats all dirty litter all over the place I could not believe it

A small very basic airport with basic facilities so do not expect a lot On the landside the checkin counters are not airconditioned so expect to stay in line while hot air irritates you unless you love hot air Other than that on the landside there are a few currency exchanges and car rental booths a small souvenir shop a pharmacy and a few eateries a bar a coffeesnack shop and a Burger King and that is it Almost no seating for passengers except a few on the domestic side so passengers will have to either purchase something from one of the eateries or pass through security to find somewhere to sit On the other hand on the airside there are two nice facilities on the first floor of the international waiting area a rum bar operated by Takamaka Rum Distillery and a lounge operated by Air Seychelles basically the only lounge in the airports international terminal so all business class passengers will have a class reunion there Apart from the rum bar and lounge however the waiting area on the ground floor is once again pretty basic with only a few dutyfree shops Queuing times at arrivals immigration have improved over the past as Seychelles now requires all passengers to predeclare their travel plans digitally but make sure to have enough time for security and departures immigration as the airports capacity is still limited to process large planes Finally do not fully trust the departuresarrivals screen as flight updates may not be reflected timely

This is one of the worst airports I have ever seen and I have been in more than Very very long lines I waited hr min to pass the arrival border check and h m to check in at Qatar Airways counter on departure There is no organization smart people just skip the line honest people complaining all the time and the airport staff doesnt care Covid social distancing and face covering rules enforcing is inexistent Unfortunately things were so stressful that I am never coming to Seychelles ever again and I dont recommend anyone to

Very small airport very few amenities Only counterprinted boarding passes are accepted neither mobile nor selfprinted boarding passes are accepted at the airport No self check in kiosks are provided check in desks open hours before departure Waiting area for check in is actually not an enclosed room but open and thus not airconditioned Immigration has only very few counters thus large queues are to be expected Immigration requires a precise address of hotellocation on the Seychelles Security does neither care for tablets nor for liquids No airbridges are provided all boarding and deboarding is only on the trarmac Would generally avoid this airport

This is a small but friendly airport The checkin area is not air conditioned and is hot Checkin was efficient immigration and security were efficient with hardly any queues In departures there were two food and drink outlets a dutyfree shop and several other shops Boarding was efficient

Arrived on almost full Emirates flight to an airport arrivals area that was flooded with passengers No orderly lines for immigration Arrivals area was hot no air conditioning no fans even the air was still and hot Very uncomfortable A local music group was set up just inside the door in the arrivals area with the loudest music it was not the greeting many wanted People standing in front and behind were commenting on the volume Local Seychellois arriving pushed their way to the front ignoring foreign passengers and making fellow passengers feel unwelcome When they were challenged their attitude was indifferent Police and immigration officers just watched on and ignored this problem Immigration processing time was extraordinarily slow Random bag check was a faux pas After being asked a series of questions and then being told to put bag through scanner I noted there was actually no one observing the monitor Departing Seychelles was slightly easier But again the processing time to get tickets and check bags was so slow The bag check and line up area is open air Upon going through to immigration and security I noted two of the immigration officials on the Internet looking at everything but what they were supposed to be doing The whole experience was not impressive Quite an embarrassment for such a beautiful country

The traffic of Hongqiao Airport is very convenient It is very close to Hongqiao high speed railway station There are two subways and many airport buses There are many selfservice checkin machines in the checkin area of Hongqiao Airport which is very convenient There are many counters open at the manual checkin so there is almost no need to queue up but the service attitude of the staff is general The queuing time of airport security check is too long There are many restaurants after security with free wifi Airport Arrival triage is very good People without checked luggage can take another channel to leave quickly But its not good to wait a long time for luggage The design of the arrival exit is narrow and crowded

This is the second airport in Shanghai and has a train station next to it Traffic can be very bad here especially during holidays so recommend giving yourself some extra time or take the subway Security is just ok does move slow often and not many lanes open Restaurants are better here than PVG and there are options on the other side of security Shops are plentiful and appear to be good for alcohol candy perfumes and Chinese goods The only large issue is the lack of jetway use This airport likes to make passengers take a bus especially when arriving here Even if it rains they still make you go outside Not sure why when jetways are open but its happen times for me out of the times Ive used this airport Also I would avoid flying into this airport at night because they will make take a bus and it adds about minutes on to your travel time Bags arrive at a good rate and there are taxi stands outside Just avoid the people asking to give you rides just like most airports they will charge you more and technically are breaking the law by being there I always just ignore and go outside to taxi lines which move quickly Tip Avoid travel during Chinese vacations This will save you loads of time because when Chinese travel they all use train next door and taxi lines are ridiculously long

Shanghai Hongqiao Airport is a good airport by Chinese Airport standards but is not up to International Airport standards Overall experience of the airport was pretty averageish The only plus value of this airport is the accessibility to Shanghai Railway Station and two Shanghai metro lines Not recommended for stays of more than hour

I arrived at the airport from London Heathrow and travelled via Beijing On arrival at Terminal it was nearing pm and I had been travelling for over hours I wanted to get a taxi to the hotel and go to bed However none of the ATMs in the terminal accepted any of my debit cards I have had trouble in the past in rural areas but never at an international airport I was told to go to terminal one which had international arrivals and try there Fortunately the shuttle bus was free and I go to terminal Only one of the ATMs there which also happened to be the last one I tried accepted my card with one other machine down At other Chinese airports Beijing and XiAn Xingang they have always had ATMs from the big four banks Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Bank of China China Construction Bank Agricultural Bank of China I have never had a problem getting cash from these banks I would also note that the underground station just outside terminal one has multiple big four ATMs and is an excellent way to travel into the city I finally got to my hotel at midnight I wrote to the Airport while in China but never received a response

I took the subway from my hostel to the st terminal of Hongqiao airport the airport is pretty close to the downtown however the subway is quite far from the airport and there was no exit inside the airport The food choice in the airport was insufficient Airport staff were very unhelpful I tried to find a place to return my metro card and get back the deposit but the subway staff refused to handle it for me When I tried to seek help from airport staff they either do not know where to do the return or told me to go back to the subway station which is quite far from the airport Inside the airport the airconditioning system was very bad The direction to the checkin counter and the boarding gates was unclear and insufficient Not enough facilities in the airport for example ATM or bank counters

Overall Shanghai Hongqiao is a good airport if you are flying domestically There is not much you can do inside the terminal There are not many restaurants and shops there On the up side you dont need to arrive too early for departure because wait times are typically not terrible Arrival can a bit painful since you may have to walk pretty long distances to get to the exit Shanghai Hongqiao Railway Station is adjacent to the airport and they are connected indoors thus if you need to make a transfer between a flight and high speed train it will be easy

I have done my fair share of travelling this is hands down the worst airport out of the ones Ive been to Rude and incompetent staff Had such an awful experience I will avoid flying through China in the future At least through Shanghai China is also one of the countries I havent travelled to yet and now have absolutely zero desire to There are so many nice countries with lovely people in the world There is no need to travel somewhere with people so rude Awful first impression Avoid Pudong airport at all cost The people there have no idea what they are doing are unhelpful and will treat you like trash On a side note its also a huge mostly empty airport Very few shops and eateries

We were transiting through to Tokyo from London Gatwick Immediately upon arrival we were herded into a corridor with lots of other people trying to transit to other flights and given zero information After some time which we could have spent navigating the Airport independently we were herded to the transit section This whole process was a massive time suck and not needed it felt like they didnt trust foreigners to navigate the airport on their own The whole feel of the place is very eery We both felt on edge as they monitor everything with an excessive amount of cameras watchingrecording you constantly We had to endure so many painfully long queues that seemed illogical We were getting a transfer but we had to go through the exact same processes we had already cleared hrs prior in London Gatwick Our liquids and hand luggage was intensely scrutinised even though again we were cleared at London Gatwick We had to constantly show our boarding pass provide lots of personal information and photos constantly and it all felt quite invasive It felt like a massive overkill We thought having a layover of hours would be plentiful however we ended up after enduring the most surreal and stress inducing transfer weve ever been through with only mins to catch our flight It seems judging from previous reviews I was lucky to be able to buy drinks prior to getting our flight as we were desperately thirsty using my card but again I had to sign things and it was a very elongated process I am dreading our return journey No one speaks English they seem unconcerned about time pressures with flight transfers and while we saw quite literally over members of staff congregating at various points in the airport they have minimal staff processing flyers The presence of so many staff loitering around is also intimidating as is very intensive security procedures Ie everyone goes through the metal detector gate but noone escapes a pat down It so excessive and massive overkill You cannot access the free wifi unless you are prepared to give more personal info like your phone number or passport details with current photo and if you do take that deal everything is blocked unless its a Chinese website so massive issues of censorship here which is deeply uncomfortable I would not recommend unless you are into the vibe of a dystopian escape room

This whole airport experience was a complete and utter joke The debacle began the second we left the plane where we were subjected to long queues and no apparent wifi connectivity The staff slap a sticker on you without consent and herd you like cattle to the transit area The best description of the transit area is a skeleton Yes it is modern and clean with the initial appearance of many shops and restaurants but spend more than minutes there and you will realise there is hardly anywhere to eat where the food is inedible and there is hardly anywhere to shop and the staff dont speak English So to pass the time we decided to splurge on entry into the airport lounge However we were told in broken English that they only accept Chinese yuan for entry Slightly annoyed we asked where we could withdraw cash or exchange foreign currency the staff member advised there was no ATMs nor currency exchange outlets in the airport So if you want to spend more than minutes in a place with barely any edible food a smoking room resembling a scene from Black Mirror Gulaglike environment covered with security cameras and that simply makes you hate life then I recommend a transit at Shanghai Pudong

Recently had a stopover at Shanghai Pudong for a TokyoLondon flight Arriving at Pudong at around pm we were greeted with chaotic scenes At no point were we told that we needed to go through immigration get a transit visa pick up our luggage and go through the whole checkinimmigrationsecurity check procedure again thanks air China for not making any effort to explain this process To make matters worse We spent an hour in the wrong queue The whole process was a joke The passengers in the very slow line there were only desks open werent allowed to proceed to baggage collection until every passenger had been processed We were just told to wait over there Rudeshort tempered staff who couldnt speak much English throughout A hour transit time left us with about mins to spare before boarding We couldnt buy any drinks and the WiFi was only available to Chinese more about this later On the return flight we were given boarding passes for the onward connection to Tokyo Thinking we were in for an easier time was nothing short of wishful thinking Same again really except we didnt have to go through immigration One desk open told to wait by the toilets Once the whole flight had been processed we were allowed to proceed through yet another security check where my duty free purchases from London were scrutinized Dont bother with the free WiFi You have to scan your passport at a terminal another queue and once connected the internet doesnt work The few minutes we had in the duty free area wasnt enough to get some drinks and the stores only accept Chinese currency On top of it all one of my suitcases hadnt arrived in Tokyo Terrible experience Never flying Air China or transiting through China again

I arrived yesterday morning at am for a Ryanair flight to Faro departing at am I had no luggage to check in To my surprise there were hundreds queuing at the desk with one lady checking boarding cards There were obviously a few more flights departing early yesterday At the security check in one lady decided to take her tea break leaving one man to check all cases etc No consideration given to passengers trying to get to the departure gates Luckily I just made the flight and was the last one to board Management need to monitor this situation and react when staff decide to leave their posts Never had a problem like this before at Shannon

I had a flight from Malaga to Manchester via Shannon My first flight was delayed and my second was boarding when we landed I just want to thank the staff particularly at passport control the lady was amazing and rushed me straight through The security and boarding staff were excellent too All made sure I made the nd flight in order to get back to home to my mother who was and still is gravely ill Without their kind actions Id have missed the connecting flight So thank you all the staff for your compassion and haste Ill do the overall rating but in all honesty I was not in the right state to pay much attention

Very efficient from arriving on stand getting though immigration baggage and leaving in the hire car in less than an hour Departure was a breeze Only minor issue was WiFi only seemed to work once you go through security Much prefer Shannon to the chaos that is Dublin
The pleasant experience of arriving and departure in Shannon Airport was above all else Efficiency professionalism courteous Dublin needs to take a look and see how its done Well done Shannon

Very narrow airport inside with few facilities Very crowded airport that is being used mainly by Air Arabia The outer design of this airport is good though Rude and not courteous airport staff All of the staffs speak either in Arabic or in Hindi Very unclean toilets and insufficient in number Insufficient seating arrangements Very few airport shops and very costly Boarding bridges are not available Difficult to get wifi I will try to avoid this airport in future

Worst airport experience to date Beggars posing as staff providing unwanted help and then demanding tips Extremely rude staff Unbelievably disorganised flights all boarding at the same time from the same place massive queues chaos and delayed flights Despite a wonderful time staying in Sharm the airport experience has meant I will not returning

Worst experience of my life after a lovely holiday this airport has definitely put me off ever returning On arrival you go through passport control and one security check which is fine however when returning there are about security checks each time if you are female you get completely touched up in a body check as someone who is under this left me feeling violated and very uncomfortable there There is no sense of order and queues are awful if you are planning on going there arrive very early After going through loads of rounds of the exact same security checks you get to duty free and the terminals these are very unhygienic with an inside smoking lounge with no door or separation from rest of airport there are bugs and roaches all over the floor the toilets look like they have never been cleaned When entering the gate there was random security checks these were no random at all as everyone who got sent into the line was definitely under the age of where everything gets taken out your bag and rummaged through and you and your belongings get swabbed you are then expected to clear out the area with all your belongings that have been thrown all over the table quickly This airport is absolutely vile there are staff everywhere with guns which would be terrifying for families with young kids There is no WiFi available I would try to avoid this airport at all costs

The arrival hall was very good Quick and easy to navigate No issues The departure hall is a different story Rude police looking for a fight corrupt staff asking you to pay to get through quickly Shocking service and not representative of the airline standards I was shocked how much the security police looked for trouble

Shenyang airport traffic is not very convenient only airport buses and trams especially few flights no subway After entering the terminal the design is more atmospheric Except for China Southern Airlines other airlines can only check in minutes in advance which is not good In addition there are few automatic checkin machines so the queue at the manual checkin place is serious Security is fast and funny There are a lot of rest areas and mobile phone charging areas after security check WiFi is fast The fly in the ointment is that there are a few restaurants In addition there are many turntables at the baggage claim area and the luggage will arrive soon The guidance signs are perfect

Shenyang is my home airport The recent move to the new terminal is a big improvement although there is no smoking room Food and beverage shops ok but overpriced Check in always quick and efficient Same can be said for passport control and security Lounges for frequent fliers are nice with if depart around midday a decent lunch Delays are not very frequent here and if there are delays they are always caused by traffic control Warm in winter and cool in summer Clean toilets Good signs and all within walking distance of minutes maximum

Terminal in now already in operation for more then a year Spacious clean clean toilets food and drink very limited Still impossible to find Diet drinks or have a decent coffee No smoking room Announcements in English poor not understandable and very limited Underground parking is a long walk from the DepArr area A real nuisance in this airport is the fact that priority handling of Gold members of any airline is not honoured Finding a taxi is sometimes also a challenge There is a new rail line now connecting the airport with the city but have never tried

Showing its age quite badly even though a relatively modern airport It does not look like the roof structure has been cleaned since it opened Distinct lack of departure information boards on the departures level only one it seems but otherwise departures is quite easy to navigate and security check area is right next to the gates Arrivals is a challenge especially if you are looking for the tax stand An extension is under construction which creates limitations

Its very convenient to get tofrom Shenyang city centre The nearest boading gate only meters from security check and the airport is full of shops and restaurants chinese style But its sad to see the airport is kind of showing its age now only completed in or so I think this is due to the fact that the construction quality is not up to standard The new T is adjacent to the abundant T which is now looks like a ghost airport terminal itself Apart from that SHE is an airport which is being well used

I would agree with the comments on poorly lit baggage area in arrivals It still appeared that there was some work going on increasing the size of the terminal Very modern and clean easy access to city Only disappointment was price of food and beverages once airside compared with landside Chinese prices for sometimes same product

Very clean and modern airport New terminal added in New access highway to Shenyang Limited air traffic with few delays Baggage area is poorly lit Not sure why As the Chinese economy grows who knows what will come of this airport Right now its a clean well run airport albeit with little air traffic Interesting for an American to see Air Koryo planes and personnel at the airport

Flew from Johannesburg to Schenzhen connecting flight to Chengdu Before we landed stewardess announced that if we are connecting to another city must wait in the transit area Arrived at Baoan airport asked the security people where to go or where to go to the transit area keep pointing to the queue Nobody speaks English Asked nearly everybody in the queue not interest Eventually got through to customs asked again where Transit area is just say th floor Went to th floor dont see any transit area went to Information Counter nobody speaks English Very hesitant to help Again asked everyone if they speak English so they can translate for me nothing Went back to Information again the lady took me to Check in counter issued me with a ticket kept saying must check in Asked what must I do she eventually wrote on her phone your luggage has no business here so said I know but I did not collect my luggage because in all my other international flights your luggage gets put on the next plane on your connecting flight My luggage from JHB has got a big yellow tag with TRANSFER attached So I presumed that it will be put on the plane to Chengdu Meanwhile by now I am stressing out because my luggage was not collected downstairs Was told to go to ground floor to collect my luggage went into the lift it only went to the nd floor ran around and cant find a lift going down Went to the th floor again and asked the lady to help me They do not seem interested I kept asking and asking people standing around too Nobody is interested in assisting One security man was standing there so I kept asking him and he said to follow him we went to a restricted area waiting for a while and eventually he managed to get my luggage to me I had to run and check the luggage in again nearly missed
