Tehran IKA Airport looks like an isolated domestic terminal rather than international Arrival immigration is small and if two or more flights arrive at the same time it will be chaos Baggage conveyor belts are limited to three which seems no maintenance has been performed for a long time At the same place the toilets are dirty most of the time The departure section is little better in comparison of Arrival Wifi is free but could not be used at all Passengers security checks are conducted two times Departure section is a little bit organized The airport website is just in Persian language Finding a car park is so hard At the time writing review no public transportation except taxi are accessible In comparison of other region airport like Dubai Qatar and Istanbul airports IKA is messy

For a city of this size Tehran Imam Khomeini airport is quite small Overall a modern airport but immigration procedure at arrival took a long time Also a bit chaotic at baggage claim as the space on the belt is tight if a B arrives At departure all went fine but the food in the restaurants was awful Even in duty free no alcohol was avaiaible and there are no smoking rooms after security check No free wifi available

I have traveled a few times there and had no problem but this time I missed my flight due to the malfunction of the airport The flight information board doesnt work properly any more and they only announce your flight once so be careful Pay your exit tax in a bank before you go to the airport Dont rely on the bank there like me The cashier was serving one of us form the queue and passport from a travel agency without our knowledge so some people from the queue were missing their flight The police or security office werent helpful and were nasty It seems as if the Airport site doesnt let you to write a review since its getting probably lots of bad ones Hopefully they sort the airport out soon

Tehran Merhabad is the old main airport of Tehran Easy access from city center Before security check there are plenty shops and restaurants after security check the choice is lower Long queue and chaotic scenes at check in also at first security check before entering the airport Second security check was taken a bit easy they not even use hand held dedectors No wifi available smoking rooms after security check available Waiting area after security looks like a bus station

Very modern newly built structure with passport control relatively smooth I expected tighter gothrough experience If you think of your immigration check at JFK going through passport check at IKA is a walk in the park I had carryon luggage so I rushed through exit with one more X Ray control to go Nothing major but of course avoid to bring in alcohol Departure was early in the morning Very congested security check before you check in you have to squeeze all your luggage and metal stuff under the x ray and then your physical check is very slow If you fly economy not much to do in the airport Couple of good coffee shops with plenty of tables and seats few duty free shops There is one nice handicraft shop tough Careful about public announcements that are delayed Flights were announced departing when I had seen them happily taking off minutes earlier Smoking area is below the main floor with very nice view of the apron No internet available in the public space Once you move to your departing gate there is another security control The boarding area is okay with nice reclined seats overlooking the runway and one small coffee shop Overall a nice airport with huge room for improvement given the beautiful building and the fair share of international traffic

Departing on am flight to Kerman All bags Xrayd before you enter the terminal There was one queue for my flight and only one person checking everyone in but she was fantastically efficient and once at the head of the queue the process must have taken only seconds Amazingly people behind me were thrusting their tickets at her whilst she was dealing with me Airside departure lounge was full and despite a lot of seats very few free There seemed to be about flight leaving at the same time as mine The lounge reminded me of a s bus depot Plenty of shops around to get souvenirs and snacks although I didnt use them It is a small affair and all gates are in the one area Toilets were grim with long queues Go before you arrive Flight information screens toggled between English and farsi but the English version stayed on screen about of the time It seemed I was the only European person there Suddenly the screen above the departure door flashed up for my flight Bus to the plane for an on time departure On the return journey bus journey back to the terminal and baggage re claim was very fast I was out of the airport within minutes of landing Some taxi offices in the arrivals building Overall Mehrabad is a place to catch a domestic flight no more no less A long delay would be a nightmare here The transfer to the international airport is about an hour through heavy Tehran traffic

Although the computer information screens are in Farsi and English I would advise completely disregarding the English information Flying from Terminal to Esfahan on Iran Air the computer screens read Delay without estimate next to my flight An hour after the scheduled departure time this suddenly switched to boarding When I enquired I was told I was too late to check in By this point the info screens were showing Await further information on my now departing flight Moral of the story Ignore the screens and be at a check in desk any check in desk an hour before your flight is leaving and stay there until someone gives you a boarding card Dont take no for an answer and dont ask the airport info desk theyre nice but clueless speak with the airline Airport itself is fine but frequently descends into chaos that only a minimal amount of planning or thought would avoid You quite often see hordes of staff racing around and shouting trying to resolve a confused multi flight boarding situation when it would have taken just one of them to head off the problem with clear directions half an hour earlier Would strongly recommend arranging for your hotel to send a car to pick you up on arrival It is not possible to figure out how the airport taxi system works without practice and often its the last thing you need when youve just landed Taxi touts attempting to charge a markup on the maxmimum rate are common Ensure a fare at the start and dont let him drive off until youre satisfied

Tehran Mehrabad Airport is what you expect Very basic very s and just not that great Its not modern shopping facilities are limited and eating and drinking is minimal also its very crowded at certain times especially around midnight I always wondered why Iran didnt put some money in airport improvements Because as we all know an airport is the first and last thing visitors to the country usually see It turns out that they didnt improve the airport because they were quietly building a super modern airport Imam Khomeini International Airport that will be fully operational in

Good airport no delays it was fairly quiet when I travelled Security and passport checks all done efficiently Staff were polite and helpful

The International Terminal seems and feels like a temporary after thought There is a major expansion of another terminal building next door so maybe proper facilities may exist later As it is the check in area is separated totally from the rest of the airport requiring everyone to show ID to walk through a door to go through a customs area before actually checking in for the back end of the row of counter Then you retrace your steps to access the immigration area before the typically cramped security screening which only had two of the four points on duty leading to a long wait in line Once through the main terminal area is obviously a temporary scenario by the way the duty free shop acts to block access to the other gates However the toilets were clean and respectable the food and beverage were not too bad and the shops were okay to browse through

I arrived on a national flight from Guadalajara The gates of the Tijuana Airport are quite modern with jetways at each gate There are restaurants and shops along the concourse It was necessary to have my passport checked by an immigration officer who saw it was a US passport and waved me through without looking at it The customs inspection was minimal The baggage claim area is OK When I checked in for my departing flight I found passengers were required to go through screening and customs inspection to enter the checkin area It is possible to exit and go outside while awaiting boarding time after you check in The street entrance to the airport is under construction and it is necessary to walk past the boardedoff areas to enter the terminal There is a bus station at the airport right by the terminal for shuttle buses to CA Overall this airport is not bad and will be very good once construction is completed

Very very weak services with luggage on arrival airplanes worth of people waiting for one rail of luggage under the pretext that it is under construction even though one already arrives at the supposed new terminal All in all a very poor service for a new and modern airport

It is a small airport operating both line and low cost flights The security check and the boarding went very fast the waiting areas are ok The quality of the sound system is low it is difficult sometimes to understand the announcements especially those in English

My recent visit to Tivat Airport left me utterly disappointed and frustrated to say the least From the moment I arrived until the moment I finally boarded my flight the experience was nothing short of a chaotic nightmare Understaffed and Overcrowded Upon entering the airport it became immediately apparent that the facility was severely understaffed There was only one person checking flight tickets leading to an outrageously long queue that snaked through the terminal To exacerbate matters there was also just one queue for both hand luggage and personal control causing massive congestion and delays No Relief from Crowds and Heat The airport quickly filled with travelers waiting in line and the atmosphere became stifling There was a complete lack of adequate air conditioning or ventilation making it unbearable to stand in the packed queues The lack of seating aggravated the situation leaving elderly passengers and families with young children particularly vulnerable and uncomfortable Unprofessional and Unhelpful Staff Adding insult to injury the airport staff were shockingly unprofessional and downright rude They displayed a complete lack of courtesy and seemed indifferent to the plight of passengers struggling with the chaotic conditions Requests for assistance were met with dismissive gestures or simply ignored further deepening the sense of frustration among travelers Overall Impression In summary my experience at Tivat Airport was one of the worst I have encountered in my travels The combination of understaffing overcrowding lack of basic amenities and unprofessional staff created an environment that was not only unpleasant but also distressing For an international airport these conditions are simply unacceptable and reflect poorly on the management and operational standards If you have the option to avoid Tivat Airport or choose an alternative route I strongly recommend doing so

Arrived on full QF from Sydney on April Fantastic new airport that does credit to New Caledonia Clean modern and very quick from a full plane to bus transfer to Noumea

Tontouta Airport is a building dating back to the s offering basic facilities However it is undergoing an amazing expansion and facelift which looks promising modern with pleasant architecture and more userfriendly The new airport should be completed by On arrival pax climb down steps and cross the airparking zone to enter the airport There are fivesix immigration booths open per flight however the quarantine service is small and slow Tontouta airport is a no smoking area The departure hall is of reasonable size for the current traffic and the ground staff is friendly The caf is expensive and basic but it could be worse The whole airport is a free WIFI zone On departure after checking in the luggage pax often wait long minutes in a line to perform the immigration and security controls The police and security staff are usually friendly enough though cruelly lacking the ability to communicate in English The boarding lounge where the gates are located is well air conditioned though boring The main features being a largish dutyfree shop and a caf on the st floor The business class lounge is comfortable and obviously more interesting There is a postoffice and a bank in both arrival and boarding lounges for money exchange however the only ATM distributor is in the main hall across from the souvenir shop

Tontouta is a fairly basic international airport There are no skybridges so on arrival you descend the stairs and cross the tarmac to the single terminal and vice versa on departure Customs and immigration are fairly straightforward although a little bit of French will help The airport is a long way from Noumea so it is best to arrange a transfer with your hotel pre booking before you leave is the best Arc en ciel was the best company we thought Heading back out is always a nightmare at Tontouta there is no order for anything Customs is always straightforward when departing Only a small duty free on the other side and only cafe not much to do There are no tv screens or monitors for the flights You just have to rely on the French announcements and a piece of paper at the gate Overall was a good experience and a very good airport for a small tropical island

Ive travelled through Tontouta a few times now and have thought the place relatively unremarkable Basic with few luxuries and an unfortunate distance from Noumea township NOU finally earned a brickbat on my last visit Security screening caused the delay of two very busy flights to SYD and Tokyo Appallingly slow and with little or no organisation its a wonder pax remained calm and goodnatured as they crushed in against the one tiny door With Tokyo pax getting priority my QF to SYD left a full hour late wholly as a result of this woeful process Only one of the two XRay machines were in operation because apparently of a lack of trained staff When I reported it to airport officials the response was Oh

Not a great airport but not the worst either The only really bad aspect is the cost of food and drink Australian dollars for a stale sandwich and two cokes at a selfservice cafe is over the top The fact that smoking is allowed is also a black mark Make sure you have arranged a transfer to and from the airport because there are few taxis and the ride is not cheap because of the distance from Noumea

Tontouta is a fairly basic international airport There are no skybridges so on arrival you will descend the stairs and cross the tarmac to the single terminal and vice versa on departure Customs and immigration are fairly straightforward although a little bit of French will help The airport is a long way from Noumea so it is best to arrange a transfer with your hotel this will cost XPF EUR payable to the driver in cash I did not see any ATMs in the arrivals area so it would be as well to buy some francs before you arrive New Caledonia Tourism also has links to a number of transport companies that provide airport transfers The airport is a smoking zone and many passengers take advantage of this When you depart your hotel should recommend you leave for the airport three hours before your scheduled flight Again it will be a XPF cash bus fare to the airport There is no additional departure tax as it will have been collected by the airline when they ticketed your flight At the airport you will need to fill in the departure card before you approach the customs area and there are no pens anywhere Customs and security are uneventful Just through security you can turn to the left and go up the stairs to the two airline lounges Air Calin and Air France Air Calins Hibiscus Lounge is very small and basic whilst the Air Frances Salon looks much larger and has nice tub style leather chairs I was flying Qantas and they use the Air Calin lounge There is one duty free store airside on the left after the stairs to the lounges There is really only one gate area although there are a number of gates doors to the tarmac At the far end of the departure area you go up the stairs to the public bar and cafe The boarding procedure is very relaxed and does not take that long

The arrival process at YTZ is very smooth quick and easy Unfortunately the same cant be said for the departure process As traffic from the airport has increased the lounge can no longer accommodate all of the passengers It is very rare that I am able to find a seat Equally unfortunate are the constant announcements directing passengers to exit doors and gates These two things combined make for a very loud stressful experience

The Pick up and drop off area at this airport is ridiculously small for the number of passengers currently passing through Parking and pick is basically total chaos at this airport the rude and aggressive parking security guards do not make matters any better If you are driving seriously consider an alternative

Upon arrival to Billy Bishop there were no wheelchairs My husband used a luggage cart for mobility through the tunnel We registered as needing assistance We also submitted doctor form Cancellation was given way later than seems appropriate It was a very stressful experience for ourselves and others

As much as people complain I found entering Pearson to be a breeze The whole process of disembarking walking and clearing immigration went quickly and I was through within minutes most of that walking and enjoying a coffee while I waited for my bus The staff were courteous and pleasant On my departure once again seamless with efficient customs officials Terminal has improved the seating and I was impressed As always the beer is overpriced but tell me an airport where it isnt The PA announcements were very clear a bonus compared to a good number of airports I have been through Maybe it was just the day but the complimentary WiFi kept kicking out after minutes or so Overall no complaints

Small cramped airport with limited seating facilities one shop in arrivals terminal Wi fi is pretty decent but this airport doesnt seem to be big enough for the numbers of people departing and arriving Toilets not the best Ive ever seen cant recommend Torp at all
Parking is extremely expensive at Torp Sandefjord Airport NOK Approx an hour better to go to OSL No customs staff available for customs refund of VAT

Arrival was very easy other than Norwegian Immigration officials who seemed to think that one could understand Norwegian if they shouted very loudly Bags arrived very quickly cash machines are hidden away there is one near the duty free which your can visit when arriving before baggage and one behind screens in the middle of the arrivals area Departure was a surprise in that they have fast checkin for Ryan Air even if you have not paid for it you go to the usual type of checkin machine do the business and then drop your bag off at a fast baggage drop From then on it went smoothly other than five different queues to actually get on the plane On the downside water is very expensive NKr for a small bottle and we could not find any drinking fountains on the upside there are a number of free internet terminals landside and airside

Before flying in or out of this airport make sure you do your research online and get the current Torpexpress bus timetable the service is not frequent though is generally designed to suit landing and arriving planes The Torpexpress bus costs NOK per person There is an hourly train service from Lillehammer via Gardemoen and Oslo Central to Skien which serves the station at Sandefjord A taxi from Sandefjord station to Torp recently brought up NOK on the metre So if youre going to be in the Lillehammer or Hamar area and theres a group of you going to Torp Airport this might be a worthwhile option The airport itself is small and quite compact there is a restaurant past the security gates though the selection isnt huge But the dutyfree shop I felt is poor plenty of alcohol and tobacco but very little else I was looking for souvenirs and gifts from Norway but this shop has little or nothing from Norway Plenty of Belgian and Swiss chocolate but how can you go home to family and workmates and say Ive been on holidays to Norway I brought you all back a box of Swiss chocolate Doesnt work I managed to get a small box of orangeflavoured chocolates actually produced locally at Sandefjord and they are very nice But no souvenirs gifts items of clothing jumpers hats etc In other words apart from those chocolates nothing Norwegian If you want real Norwegian souvenirs to bring home buy them before you get to Torp Airport

Agree with Paul Groves fine little airport A word of warning if youre trying to tie in returning to the airport for a Ryanair flight give yourself plenty of time We had a number of passengers on our bus who had left it rather late to get back to the airport having had their flights rearranged and had opted for a few more hours in Oslo rather than being stuck at the airport big mistake
Little airport very nice Not many dining choices not very important for me because it was a late flight Fast boarding procedure Pleasant view of the tarmac

We use Toulon four or five times each year to travel via Paris to wherever just wish Air France would link TLN to CDG instead of just to ORY which then requires about minutes for the bus transfer between the two Its a small and very quiet airport with about seven or eight flights per day maybe ten at weekends therefore everything is all very laid back Air France checkin is always super efficient with two or three staff in front of the check in area security a breeze and on the CRJ most of the year its a nice meter walk in the sunshine to board at an apron stand Drinks and eats in the terminal and departure lounge are half the price of Nice and Marseille Enough facilities for a couple of flights at the same time but this rarely happens so no queues or crowds anywhere
Outrageously expensive Duty Free Even tax free prices are more expensive than UK prices Wines a shocker Also my empty Evian bottle was discarded behind my back as it was scanned

A reasonable airport but very linear which means long walks The lounge was well appointed and comfortable Things were a bit difficult at departure as the machines would not read my details so there was something of a wait
The airport still ask toilet products to be shown separately in a transparent plastic bag Security checks can be improved

The worst airport so far I had to stand in the checkin even after doing the checkin because of some mistake they did My flight was cancelled so I got a coupon but when I wanted to use it a cashier started to argue with me At the security it was way stricter than at the other airport i took almost half of my bag apart but it was still wrong My liquid plastic bag was too big so I received a new one but when it didnt fit I was refused to get a new one I was treated poorly by almost all the staff I spoke to today Half dont speak english

Dive of a place Avoid for tight connections they pointlessly make you collect your luggage boot you out of airside and then you need to check in and go through security again For no reason The shops are sparse the staffing is minimal and yet you have to walk for miles to get nowhere in a tiny regional airport

Plus side Light and modern little regional airport with parking very close and hotels within walking distance Security and passport control quick and smiley though if several flights arrive at once the queues are long Down side Long walk round in circles to get anywhere Everything was shut landside at am Very limited food and drink airside especially once through non Schengen No wifi Toulouse is a key business hub home of Airbus and its well in the outside world anyway Be nice when its finished

They have downsized this airport in terms of spaces to relax get fooda coffee One tiny cramped stall to get food and just a cart with sandwiches once you go through security for passport control Instead of a place to sit and have a bite to eat and a cup of coffee there is just a ton of very poor quality and expensive duty free shops which take up a ridiculous amount of space They have the selection of the poorest corner shop in Toulouse with similar prices This is an incredibly badly thought out airport plan There used to be a larger restaurant area but they got rid of it for more duty free space Getting out of the airport for departure is easy with short security gate queues however arriving can take a long time for passport control

We speak french but do french people speak any other language than french Its an airport right Secondly when we arrived at our terminal there were only automated machines with chips and water so we ended up going way back to the duty free department to get some food Thirdly and the only thing that extremely bothered both of us was that at the hand luggage check they tore apart the gift wrap of a gift without even trying to be gentle Of course we commented upon it but it didnt seem to matter We received no apologies of any sort It wasnt rush hour and even if it was there is a protocol of how they should handle we are clients mind you passengers objects I mean you get a souvenir from their country and they tear it up it made us feel really unwanted

This is a lovely little regional airport barely minutes from Tours It took just a few minutes to clear immigration then off to the car rental office which is in a hut outside the terminal building in the car park Be warned that car rental here is scandalously expensive It cost over for days Anyway on my return I went to the small caf before security which offers a small but tasty range of snacks and drinks at reasonable prices Clearing security took a couple of minutes and boarding was a breeze All in all just how air travel should be in an ideal world
The security staff at Townsville Airport are the most friendliest efficient and personable I never dread having to go through screening at this airport pity Brisbane AP doesnt operate as efficiently

I have been a member of the Qantas Club for many years Recently departed on flight QF from Townsville to Brisbane on Qantas at pm On arrival at the Qantas lounge it was closed and I soon discovered that it only opened one hour prior to a flights departure time which for my flight was am My flight boarded on time at pm This gave me minutes in the Qantas Club The food on offer was disgusting and very basic to say the least The bar opened at noon I had time for one alcoholic drink which I had to drink very quickly I dont know why this Qantas Club is not closed permanently It is just a waste of space So much for the Qantas Club hype and advertising benefits for QF frequent flyers

I use this airport to get to and from work Flight at the start from Cairns and a flight from TSV to Cairns Because I just missed a flight to Cairns at I had to wait hrs for the next flight to Cairns with Qantas Cannot check my luggage in with Qantas as no one is there have to sit near the the strand cafe bar as there is not one shop outside of security to buy a book etc Would have to be one of the most boring airports ever Certainly about time the airport requires an upgrade

Arrived for domestic flight to Cairns checked in online and no hold bags so straight to departure lounge Security queues reasonable at early morning departure On arrival back straight off plane there were other aircraft at the gates and lots of people inside the terminal Arriving and departing passengers not separated so bodies everywhere which slowed down getting outside Being a small domestic airport everything is compact so no long distances to traverse

Trabzon Airport is a really small airport It has only a few gates This comes with an advantage actually Because there is no need for more gates You dont have to wait in line for boarding Youll literally walk to the plane after leaving the gate Baggage claim is an issue Baggage carousel is too small and sometimes you see that some bags literally fall off At the first enterance of the airport even they have like gates staff is using only one Therefore a long queue might be waiting for you and the enterance

I am miles short of a million miler This might be one of the most inefficient and unfriendly airports I have ever entered The only word I can think of is line Two words slow lines Do not be fooled of a small airport running smoothly I had a am flight that I arrived at and just got to my seat at An hour and fifteen minutes for what two small planes Maybe they should serve coffee at the airport Slow and grumpy is all you get at this airport

This airport has the worst seating of anywhere There is not enough and the benches that are there are metal and freezing cold to the point that it could easily give you a numb bum A second bad thing is the vip lounge not a VIP lounge as its basically a room with comfortable seating and a kettle that you have to know a PIN code to get into On the positive side its clean and has lots of space and the staff whilst not very friendly are professional

The best thing about Trieste airport is the train link to the city The airport seems to have been newly renovated but there is no air conditioning and with a very clinical holding area before boarding the flight it was a very long and clammy wait hrs which was as uncomfortable as it sounds There is no water fountain so you are forced to buy drinks from the bar as you cant bring liquids through security It reminds me of the bad old days with Ryanair where you were interrogated about bags and made to put your bag in the holder despite the fact that the person in front of you had a bigger bag and you always traveled with the same bags without issue I had to explain twice before getting to security that the extra bag I had was a change of clothes I needed before boarding the plane given that we were going from degrees to degrees

A small airport near the city of Monfalcone and Trieste The airport is quite basic and has bus boarding only Arrivals is equally tiny which means from plane to the exit in less than min The interior looks rather dated and not always well maintained Theyve some shopping and food beverages but its all nothing to rave about Theres a train station with connections to Trieste and Venezia which is very convenient

Surreal A bit like traveling in Belarus Queues that recall Soviet times Non existent customer service that makes you wish automatization of work would go faster so that humans at this airport could be replaced with machines Horrendous luggage service my luggage lost on the way in took some heroic efforts to recover Shops are sad and deserted Absolutely a nightmare Avoid at all cost Apparently they are struggling to sell the airport no surprise there

A very small airport that mainly serves Trieste Udine Gorizia and the western part of Slovenia More similar to a train station as it often happens for small airports A few shops that mainly sell local food and wine a very small duty free and a couple of bars It also features a small but comfortable lounge

Two years after my last comment still no improvements and I use this airport on regular basis If catching first morning flight no way one could have an easy cup of coffee Bars open at am queue too long to get your coffee on time Toilets were worn out years ago so one can only imagine how they look now after traffic increase At ham toilets were impossibly dirty which means they werent cleaned the night before People were sleeping all over airport in corners It all remembered to some rd class railway station rather than an airport Personnel not bursting with kindness

Airport conditions are fairly reasonable given the recent difficulties Do try to have your visa in good order before arriving Visa on arrival is only possible if it has been arranged in advance and takes some time to issue at the airport Apart from that the arrivals process is OK Just follow everyone else Departing is also not too bad However as has been pointed out the signs are all in Arabic so it can be difficult to know where to go Check in is a little chaotic Finding the departure lounge may not be that easy Staff are actually quite helpful and polite There are a few shops and a basic business lounge Wireless internet is available and works quite well

Small airport that seems to work more or less OK All signs are in Arabic only so navigation can be tricky for a nonarabic speaker Airport staffs grasp of English was slim but enough to get you to where you needed to be with a bit of common sense Upon arrival we followed the crowd to the Passport Control and said English to one of the guards and were shown to the CDDipolomatic Passport Area where our passports had an initial check and were then pointed to an ajacent window were a lady said Group which meant we were on a group Visia which they then verified before having the passport stamped by stamps and we were in Libya Next a check that the passport had been stamped by a guard all hand luggage scanned and downstairs to Baggage Reclaim where the cases came through quickly Suitcases then scanned and we were in Arrivals Money Changing was simple no forms to complete Upon return for International Travel there is a Cafe and small Duty Free Shop and Gift Shop beyond Passport and Secuirty before the Departure Gates that only takes Hard Currency There is a th Floor Cafe in the general area that gives good views of aircraft coming and going and has a reasonable choice of snacks and cooked food It seems to close about in the evening

A rather small airport yet hard to navigate for Westerners as all signs are in Arabic only Both immigration and emigration take time my counter just closed when I was one person away of reaching it we are so tired now Business class lounge Austrian crowded attentdants do their best which is not too much

Used this airport countless times in the past months My opinion is that it has it has a long way to go before it reaches an international standard The Libyans know this and a new one is planned and will replace the old international one in a few years The domestic building separate is brand new and although spartan and modern it functions well though security checks could be speeded up and better organised You get on a transfer bus to be ferried over to the international side where a domestic plane is parked further out The buses are very old and on one occasion has broken down collapsed suspension The international terminal leaves a lot to be desired on arrival you are stuck at immigration for a long time and go through two guys Then you go through screenxray before collecting your luggage downstairs The luggage often falls off the conveyor and you can find old luggage behind the back of the stairs After this you arrive into the main hall which is in a drab dull olivegreen plastic decor For departing checkouts can take a long time and can be disorderly Then its a long wait through a myriad of security checks before leaving the green gloom for upstairs which has a better atmosphere but seating is very limited and they are cold hard metal seats First class lounge is very good but also very busy and popular with families with kids Gates are extremely basic and expect to change gates while they make their minds up Dont use the loos in the gates they are one of the worst Ive seen on my travels The whole airport is air conditioned and works well which is a must in subSaharan Africa

Tripoli airport works On arrival immigration is two guys the first checks passport the second your visa and any Wrong passport stamps Duty free on way down to baggage reclaim which I found very cheap but poor selection Baggage reclaim fast then through xray to arrivals lobby Departing similar immigration followed by boarding card stamping and numerous xray machines Better duty free on departures but still a limited selection New business lounge on th is OK with selection of soft drinks hot food etc better than old one But little chance of western newspapers Domestic airport interesting with an array of abandoned aircraft at the side of the runway and an informal organisation

Very rude staff Departure lounge has very limited food selection and most of the international flights are early on day and most of the shops are closed will open only on am Wifi is slow No international cards accepted Very rude behaviour staff with no service mentality
Very good airport Satisfied with all aspects of airport Best airport in Kerala Lots of new shops are opening on the airport I am sure this airport will make to top airports in India

Third rate design of outlets in departure Even domestic airports in India are better Pinnacle food outlet star prices at star taste Took minutes to heat a croissant even though there was no one there Very limited seating Bar one level up with no elevator Expected to carry your bags All outlets are not worthy of international airport Passengers taken by bus even though theres a boarding bridge Only good thing is plenty of seating Immigration and check in were good

The waiting area after security checkin at Trivandrum Domestic Airport does not have an ATM Neither do the snack shops accept creditdebit cards or any other digital way of paying Once checked in you cannot access the ATM which is at the main entrance gate You cannot have a coffeesnacks without having cash on you

I feared for the crush that is too common at any Indian queuing point but neednt have For an early morning flight the only short delay was getting in to the terminal like all Indian airport terminals you have to show your flight documents After that checkin immigration security all wellmanaged and smooth at least no problems for me

Worst airport in history Business class passengers wait in same check in lines because they have the signs completely out of whack People not from business or first not checked and hold the line min for actual passenger No fast track for security Only two lines needs minimum one hour Worst airport ever Still standing in security line minutes while writing this

Awful not for the first time this year alone This airport is the epitome of inefficiency incompetence disregard for customers Yes it has slick new buildings but it stops there Today just a simple local flight an hour in the snails pace security queue with only one of three lines open for the cattle No announcements no apology nothing The only airport in the world that asks for cameras and even computer cables out but only when you get to the scanner no notices More widely if you come here on a flight from Longyearbyen via here to Oslo you and your luggage will be offloaded very slowly rechecked and you will go through full security again This can and does routinely take far longer than the stated layover time to the extent that you may still be waiting for your luggage when you hear not only the boarding call but also the final call All very stressful and worrying In short if physically possible NEVER use this airport

The airport authorities were very slow to respond The flight was at am and the check in counters only opened at am There was a huge queue at security afterwards and they was only one baggage line in operation Upon telling the security that our flight has already started boarding they were quick to blame us when we were at the airport hours minutes before departure and were waiting for the check in to start

The airport is undergoing renovations so there are screens everywhere with attendant dust and noise They make you go through security upstairs then if you need gate throw you back out into the arrivals area that you have just left There are signs for a bus but unless you ask no clear idea of where to catch the bus which was hidden behind a town bus Confusing and in the snowy conditions we experienced not pleasant We finally found the shuttle but it was somewhat frustrating

It is a nice and small airport but it is in compliance with the city and the air movement in the region The most negative point is the few stores and food options There are checkin machines and circulation is relatively fast

What a shambles Constantly being directed to different queues as the self checking baggage machines were not working person at the check in counter for all airlines person at the special baggage counter Completely clueless No announcements Security only opening after with only line working Straight after the polar night Half marathon Passengers from all over the world trying to leave Tromso on an early morning flights absolutely pathetic What a disgrace to end an otherwise very enjoyable visit

Pleasant smaller airport Parking is easy as is dealing with rental cars if necessary Ive used both Tucson and Phoenix Airports Phoenix had a direct flight and was less expensive for traveling between Boston and Tucson From now on Ill be using Tucson Airport due to the ease of access and human scale

As I checked in my bag I was surprised that I had to use a kiosk to check in With all the employees standing around it would have been more efficient if they could actually help me I was told by an indifferent male employee that it cost to check in a bag I was unpleasantly surprised but paid the fee At security I was again met with employees that had bad attitudes and shoved me along quickly

Tucson International is a runofthemill small regional US airport The architecture is bright and airy and the Southwestern art motif is a nice touch The security screening process moves a lot faster and more efficiently than most other US airports but the dining options are limited to low quality unhealthy food TUS would do well to add a large sitdown restaurantbar between the terminals that serves decent healthy food

I have been going to college in Tulsa for years and have yet to have a flight home that didnt get delayed Ive missed more connection flights then I can count because of this mess of an airport If you can try to fly or connect out of literally anywhere else

Tulsa is a nice small to medium sized airport It now has free wifi available throughout the airport Only or so airlines fly out of the airport and it seems quite a few flights have been cut the past years or so The lines for TSA are rarely bad anymore I have been through security in less than mins after arriving at airport Obviously there are times when it is busier New seats at gates have plug ins available and this is a very nice touch

I fly American a lot The A terminal just got a nice revamp but there is a revolving door to get out of the gate area This is such a slow door that they have people there to let you around it about the time I have complained to the airport about it several times and received no reply You would think that after spending so much money for a remodel they would fix the one big thing I hear a lot of frequent travelers complain about

I had an extremely disappointing experience at TunisCarthage Airport during my recent visit Despite following all the instructions provided by the Tunisian Consulate the airport staff denied my entry and detained me under the INAD procedure The worst part was the room where I was held It was completely unhygienic filled with cockroaches poorly ventilated and far from suitable for anyone The staff showed little to no empathy and refused to acknowledge the clear miscommunication between the consulate and their own procedures This experience not only ruined my trip but also caused unnecessary stress and discomfort I expected better treatment and facilities from an international airport If youre traveling to Tunisia be cautious and ensure you are overprepared for potential issues at this airport

The Airport is starting to look a bit dated now but the staff are helpful the officials etc Check in is pretty much the same as most airports except online check in and boarding passes are not functional as yet or at least by my booking I catch this flight to London every couple of weeks Points of frustration and Im sure its down to financial during these difficult times However every time I clear check in you then go through a further passport control I find this odd as I havent done this anywhere else even flying in and out of neighbouring countries Alas though there is to little staff to accommodate the passenger flow and waits and can be very long I would add an additional mins to your airport time Once through you go to security pretty standard but I often see staff just chatting and not observing the machine screens which seems to negate the very reason we all go through this security Now my major frustration was with the duty free staff I found them rude and unwilling to help I approached lady staff and asked if they could show me the headphones of which I was pointed to an area and they resumed talking I am an Arabic speaker so I understood they were just talking of their Eid celebrations I went to the area and no electrical items were on display so I approached the ladies again to only have eyes rolled and huffing and puffing I thanked the lady and she just stated there was nothing in stock She then turned her back and walked off whilst I understand people have bad days but both ladies were rude and disrespectful I was then approached by an officer who asked if I had any money on me do t be alarmed at this but they Tunisian currency is not allowed to leave the country or so it was explained to me Now my only area of frustration in returning through Carthage airport is the passport control the lines are exceptionally long and it takes a very long time to clear Once you clear passport control your passport is checked again less than meters later The same security issues were noted and nobody seemed to care about monitoring screens to be checking baggage leaving the airport This has been the way pre covid and I dont see any improvement in standards its such a shame as I love this country and it sets the wrong impression to people here visiting

Wed read the reviews so our expectations we pretty low even then we were not prepared for how rubbish it would be The transit station is full of people smoking inside the terminal we had a hour layover in Tunis before our flight to Jeddah despite having Boarding passes for Saudia business class we were charged each for access to the lounge as it is only permitted for hour stints and our flight stint only commenced at am after a am landing It was really obvious they were seeking a cash payment and made using a credit card to pay more difficult than was necessary The lounge itself like is right here right now Awful lounge in so many ways music constantly playing bright lights irrespective of the hour kids running around with very healthy lungs food which looks like it came from a prison kitchen and attitude of really resentful service We got a great deal on the flight and now we understand why you get what you pay for and its rubbish

Corruption and extortion are alive and well at this airport Both myself and four colleagues in the following days were asked for our passports and then dollars to return them from officials at this airport It has been a while since this last happened to me in any country at any airport but this place stands out Who would want to visit this place for business or vacation Never again

I am Days on the road I have seen many airports but never ever have I seen such unfriendly staff incompetent people work here and thats the least Very disrespectful give you wrong answers just to get rid of you Maybe one of the worst airports I have visited so far Stars If you have the chance travel through another country Dont come to this airports its living hell

I have never felt more insulted or disrespected as it was in Tunis airport The airport has nothing and this is not a figure of speech it literally has nothing The transit area has nothing in it but bathrooms and broken chairs There is a free wifi but no plugs to charge phone or laptops They let people alternate using a shared plug that operates the scanning machine for luggage The chairs are broken or torn and extremely uncomfortable for a long transit The officers smoke in the hall as if cramping people in a tiny room is not suffocating enough there are no vending machines coffee shops water fountains or anything present for any sort of human decency Tunis Airways officer was not only rude but completely useless Didnt offer any solutions didnt provide any services Never use this unless you carry a European American or Canadian passport

Awful from front desk to boarding airport is like a sauna staff are rude and dont want to be here but then there is only a handful of staff No information for English lucky I speak Italian it makes you appreciate Gatwick and Heathrow

Designed to be uncomfortable I fly times a year and Turin is one of my worst airport experiences Cheaper basic air hangers are more comfortable Turin clearly has had a design budget spent on shopscafes and designer benches but its so poorly executed there are massive floor areas left upstairs with no seating at all strewn with bodies of tired and irritated passengers fancy circular glass lifts left out of order unorganized mass ques for departure gates brawled together and looping around the shopping area Only able to fill your water bottles in the toilet sinks Rude staff clearly irritated by seas of tired and uncomfortable travelers

Not enough seating The basics of any airport is waiting We are tired got up at am and just want to sit down and rest This airport has only a few hard plastic seats We went up the grande granite spiral staircase only to find a about more bench chairs Are we missing something I see others have complained about this
Turin does passport checks for departing passengers The service is absolutely appallingly slow Please get your act together Turin airport border service

Avoid if you can First of all it took about minutes to check in It was only about people ahead of us Security was actually quite good But after that it was horrible nowhere to sit we sat on the floor family of Impossible to get a table at any restaurant and of course a delayed flight How can they not have anywhere to sit for the people they let through I have never experienced anything similar to this and Ive been to Grenoble airport which I thought was bad They better do improvements or theyre going to lose more customers than me

The initial impressions of departures were quite good drop off being right next to the passenger entrances the large number of checkin desks all centred around a baggage conveyor using the available floor space to the max And even security seemed well organised with fairly thorough checks but at reasonable speed However things went rapidly downhill on the air side of the terminal Toilet signage was practically nonexistant There were very few food and drink outlets for a large airport and consequently all had massive queues waiting for service even though it was a Sunday The seating was totally inadequate And if you went thru passport control to the gates in search of toilets and more fooddrink outlets youd be disappointed Incredibly there were none at all Airport wifi seemed impossible to log into On the plus side there were no endless corridors to walk down to get to the gates and the airport was clean

Turin Airport looks new but it is clearly mismanaged The problem as is usually the case in Italy starts at the top and continues all the way down to those who are supposed to clean the toilets Staff at security simply look unprofessional and are busy chatting with each other At the cafe in the Center of the Airport there were staff chatting with each other or on the phone while my wife waited in the queue for a cappuccino The worst is boarding Passengers are checked for boarding in up to minutes before they can actually board the flight After going through boarding passengers do not actually board but they have to walk down two flights of stairs carrying their hand luggage and then they wait outside for up to minutes Next passengers walk up the steps carrying their kilo hand luggage to board the plane Meanwhile the brand new walkways that can take passengers directly from the terminal into the plane avoiding walking down and up stairs and waiting outside are idle I have been to Torino times since September and the walkways have never been used People talk about the difference between the North and South in Italy however I see the same incompetence from North to South Italy has one if the Worlds most significan historic and cultural heritages but the culture of incompetence permeates Italy

Absolutely horrible experience every single time If you do not arrive hours ahead you will miss your flight No one is willing to help as most of the people who work in this airport are soulless robots and instead of going with common sense they side with policy Never in my life have I been met with so much unprofessionalism

Ladies toilets were bad flush were not working Female assistance were cleaning toilet just before entry only for Foreigners why I am from Mumbai and highest contributing tax payer of India for so many years But then why service is bad for Indian citizens

Positive very clean toilets Fast checkin service Xray scan security Bad restaurant is closed The coffee shops have identically printed menu ie same items and prices Talking to the manager I learnt that ALL cafes are owned by same person So the choice is limited and prices are higher than other airports Looks like the coffee shops are probably owned by the son of some MLA Why is Udaipur airport authority giving the contract for coffee outlets to one owner

What a miserable little airport First up you show your ticket and passport to someone at the door Then step in and put luggage on a belt to be scanned where again you show passport and ticket Then you take luggage to the check in desk Show ticket and passport Plus credit card that you booked with Then a line for bag check Bags on a belt while you stand under a sign for women one or men four You get called into a booth that has curtains help where is my bag You are patted down and a metal detector scan all over Super sensitive even for my underwire bra My wrist went off operation years ago I had to explain that in detail The whole procedure was not done in a friendly way Then quickly rush back to the belt where all my valuables were in my bags The waiting area is dull with nothing to do One small store open airside Even the smoking room was closed I was happy leaving this airport

It is a modern airport built about a year or two ago Though small and only flying out domestic flights it is air conditioned and has a two shops and a restaurant Security and checkin was efficient and modern There is not a lot to do so if you get there early I hope you have a book to read

An almost new airport that is reasonably efficient up to and including the security checks Security checks are stringent unlike those at some other Indian airports The no batteries rule in hand luggage is strictly enforced Past security there are no facilities at all except a small shop And if there is air conditioning it didnt work So eat and drink before going through security Only one gate of the three on the ground floor is operational and there is no seating at all upstairs

Quaint little airport Easy check in with Nok Air hours prior earliest Few basic shops and Thai restaurants but nothing significant Many seats but dont sit on the monks seat by accident like I did because the English sign is written incorrectly should say Reserved not Please Offer see picture attached Efficient AC and lots of adjacent parking just m from terminal an easy ride

This is a very comfortable and affordable airport There are a number of shops on the ground floor with very reasonable prices also Thai massage at the end of the ground floor again with very reasonable prices Theyve replaced the lounge chairs in the past two years and the new chairs are nicely padded The only negative is that you will likely have to walk across the tarmac to board your plane No problem in the winter but Im not sure how that works during the rainy season

Small functional regional airport with all necessary amenities including nice buffet restaurant on upper level free parking outside and no airport entrance charge for vehicles I even checked in with Nokair with less than mins to departure as my Thai friends decided to stop off at the market on the way to go All passengers are expected to stand up for the national anthem when it is played by loudspeaker twice daily a quaint touch

Arrivals experience was very easy only a short queue at passport control and bags arrived quickly Watch out for the unlicensed taxi drivers touting for business and head straight for the green taxis on the rank to the left of the terminal door On departure check in opened early and had no queue again no queue for security or passport control Only a small airport but plenty of seating available and a couple of cafs and bars Theres a small smoking room Lots of duty free shops unlike main western airports these are several independent stores all selling similar items but different prices so shop around for the best deals On the downside despite having air bridges they are all accessed by a single gate which can get confusing if more than one flight is boarding at once

Time travel back to circa the building the service the ambience is completely midth century Checkin is completely disorganized there was no line for business class you simply had to shove aside others on the line while shouting business class Business class lounge looks exactly like a nottooclassy bar from Eastern Europe in the s Shops are like souvenir shops at a cheap tourist site But it is not a very busy airport so you pass through everything fairly fast Fun in strange sort of way They are building a modern airport for UB so you better go now if you want to experience it before the airport is retired

Departure MIAT Airline check in requires credit card verification from traveller This can be a problem if you book your flight through a travel agent as the credit card details wont match Very limited number of shops and lounge availability I suggest eating before you get to the airport Arrival Slow customs officers for a small airport Allow hour from landing to clear customs and collect bags there is only baggage carousel and travellers to UB often have a lot of luggage Wifi in arrivals area is unreliable and Taxis will most likely not use the meter unless prompted

Theres nothing quite like a small airport to really make commercial flying enjoyable Parking is very simple and convenient its like parking at your local grocery store right at the entrance to the terminal Its also inexpensive at a day ironically if youre able to fly to this airport with a light aircraft parking a single engine private plane here is only a day Food and shopping options are limited in the terminal but Irvings bagels and sandwiches are tasty and reasonably priced There is a portion of the terminal where you can sit with family members while waiting for your flight Remember those days when you could walk up to the gate and meet someone You can essentially still do that here because of the way the terminal is designed There are only three gates here and theyre all in one large room past the TSA checkpoint Because of the low volume of travelers here the TSA facility is small and the line moves quickly The rest rooms are very clean The only drawback is its sort of hard to find on the road Signage on the local major roads is inadequate As is the signage at the parking lot

Small airport in Uzbekistan mainly used by tourists following the Silk Road A few fights a day to Tashkent and one to Istanbul also flights to Russia and Saudi Arabia Arrival at remote stand and walk about yards to the terminal A single baggage carousel and a few seats in the Arrival Hall Toilets available Departures done in separate newer building Airport is of the Soviet Union design but had a refurbishment about years ago Car Park at the front of the terminal building

Flew in and out on my way from Asia to Europe with China Southern The airport was fine not great There is a mix of staff who speak no English basic English and good enough English Also could not go through the international departures security until hours before the scheduled flight departure time even though Ive said I would like to use the first class lounge which is at the airside WiFi is available however can only be used with a Chinese phone number to log in

Well organised for the transit process Airport service persons picked us up at the exit and allocated us in a special area There are free services for water wifi access and breakfast A lady registers and reminds each of the customers in the waiting area for boarding Very good experience

I had an early morning flight from Terminal to CKG Arrived early due to the scheduled shuttle from my hotel The security arrangements here are very tight but not overbearing CheckIn was simple enough while I virtually had to empty my carry on of all electronic items for separate scanning Once through I headed to the Hainan Airlines lounge but it only opened at am so I waited for minutes Then I had a wait until am until breakfast was served but it was plentiful and delicious My aircraft was at a distant stand so I had to board a bus but the boarding process was smooth and simple

Small airport and gateway to the Antarctica Ushuaia is a tourist destination and claimed by Argentina to be the southernmost city in the world Check in is straightforward on street level You go up a flight of stairs for security check and to your gate Ample sitting space There were a couple of small shops selling souvenirs Jetways to aircraft On the main floor there is a large duty free shop selling the usual international brands of chocolates perfumes and liquor Also a cafe for food and drinks Arrival is straight forward Luggage arrived quickly in baggage claim and put through a casual security check Taxi dispatcher at exit arranges for passengers to get into vehicles for their respective hotels English widely understood by airport workers They are also very helpful The town is very close by visible from the entrance to the airport aned reached in minutes The airport caters to the huge tourist flow there Views from the airplane while landing and taking off are dramatic with scenes of the Tierra del Fuego archipelago spread out Window seat is a must Nearly all the flights to Buenos Aires from Ushuaia are to the capital citys domestic airport which is far away from the airport that caters to international flights to the US and Europe

Ushuaia copies El Calafate in the design and in doing a lot of things right for a small regional airport but it doesnt do it as well The good things include using airbridges even for small regional jets helps get you out of the cold wind fast checkin and security staff a nice clean terminal lots of meter taxis less than to most of town However there were fewer toilets badly organised cafes with limited food flight info was often wrong and the wifi was unusable most of the time

Flew in and out of here on our way to a ship Arrival was straight forward and baggage arrived quite quickly There was a customs check on arrival for plant material even though this was a domestic flight Departure checkin was fast the departure gates are upstairs although we did not find any signs to tell us At the time of writing the airport tax is pesos There is free wifi internet available at the airport a cafe with not too high prices but little public seating Although a modernish building users will notice that the roof leaks in numerous places quite badly

This month I flew out of new Terminal at Vadodara Airport using three different airlines Jet Airways Air India and IndiGo Despite having built new Jet Bridge Vadodara Airport just doesnt utilize them I was transported from terminal to aircraft using shuttle bus on all occasions The new terminal still uses many of the old processes ex checkin bags are scanned before checkin On one occasion I couldnt enter security screening for am Jet Airways flight because the security personnel were shortstaffed Immediately after security screening there is no place to sit and organize your belongings The boarding area is very small The dining and shopping options are limited The terminal does have a nursing room for mothers During boarding the ground staff doesnt utilize the PA system so passengers struggle to hear the boarding announcements Overall the new terminal at Vadodara Airport just doesnt feel like a new worldclass terminal
Rude unfriendly staff I had a quick query and was just told move on However quick and efficient getting through scanner etc Very poor signposting

The worst airport staff I have ever seen They only speak Spanish or incomprehensible English and are very inefficient and unprofessional At the security check they took out every single item from my backpack for no reason at all and it took me minutes to put everything back in place to make the contents fit in my backpack They also made me go through some additional checks again totally unjustified and all the time they treated me with utmost disrespect and harshness The extra security checks might be justified it is good to be extra careful but the disrespect and harshness a foreigner is exposed to at this airport is something that needs to be changed Nobody has the right to treat someone with such cruelty just for being a foreigner It was the first and definitely the last time I took a flight from this airport and I do not recommend it to anyone

There was no access to toilets for more then minutes in departures hall We had a delay it was very busy and a very unpolite lady was cleaning toilets More than people waiting in line who had to catch a plane and not able to use the toilets

I am and have a hip replacement Yesterday evening I went through the security scan I was flying to Heathrow flight BA May th The alarm went off and I explained my hip replacement This was ignored I was man handled and treated very roughly and rudely The security man even pulled back the back of my trousers and looked down them I was humiliated and disrespected in front of passengers After I asked him for his number and name I did I was unhappy about how I had been pushed about and treated He put his face into mine and gave me a very threatening point with his finger I am a respectable professional man I also served years in the police I do not deserve to be treated in this discriminatory way and I hope my complaint will be heard

On the th of November I was on the phone to my friend who was having issues with a passenger locator form for arriving in Scotland The way the staff at the check in desk spoke to my friend was a down right disgrace and in other airports would such mannerisms be accepted The staff would not provide any help to my friend and would also not speak to myself over the phone who had flown out of the airport days prior This is an absolute disgrace and as an airport you should take immediate action Only for a kind passenger who over heard the matter would still not be sorted Then proceeded to go to security where the security decided the throw about two expensive laptops experience Would love to see their reaction if we treated them the same in any of our UK airports

Small airport mins from city centre Good coach links to other major cities Very clean Very limited resources and facilities Raciones and Tapas not recommended Prioritised boarding non existant so booking in rush a total waste of time Dont try to enlist help from other check in desks even if they are empty as they stick to the rules

A tiny little airport with probably only a handful of flights a day as such security and passport control get somewhat overloaded as does the departure lounge when a full flight is due a small restaurantbar is there as is a small shop which was closed for lunch when I was there

International flights from Shanghai Have to go out and come back in even without luggage Normal transfer procedure does not apply It is all verbal No lounge sign anywhere except on lounge Signs are badly marked

My recent experience at Vancouver International Airport was nothing short of a nightmare thanks to the appalling behavior of the airport security staff As an avid traveler who flies almost monthly Ive never encountered such disrespect and incompetence anywhere else Upon passing through security for my flight to Los Angeles I was subjected to an unnecessarily intrusive inspection of my toiletry and makeup bag by a particularly rude security agent This individual meticulously scrutinized every item treating me as though I were a criminal rather than a paying passenger Despite adhering to all liquid and gel rules with clearly labeled travelsized products he insisted on removing each item meticulously examining them and transferring them into a clear plastic bag This absurd process dragged on for a staggering minutes leaving me stranded at the security checkpoint while other travelers breezed through When I dared to question the purpose of such excessive scrutiny the agent responded with unwarranted aggression shouting at me in a manner that suggested he owned the airport and I was some sort of threat His colleague instead of diffusing the situation also joined in to defend his unacceptable behavior I was given an ultimatum either discard my makeup or check my bag neither of which was necessary had it not been for the agents rude conduct Thankfully a supervisor intervened after my confrontation with the agent and escorted me to a separate area to reorganize my belongings While the supervisor was at least understanding and tried to calm me down the damage to my experience had already been done Upon returning for a second security check I was greeted by yet another unpleasant surprisea different agent aggressively slapped my suitcase onto the belt for another round of screening This agent proceeded to meticulously search through every pocket and zipper of my suitcase despite my prior clearance and the absence of any suspicious items Her dismissive attitude towards my situation and lack of consideration for my time was downright infuriating Overall my visit to Vancouver was overshadowed by this deplorable experience at the airport The blatant disregard for passenger dignity and the ineptitude displayed by the security staff tarnished my impression of an otherwise pleasant city Vancouver International Airport you have a lot to improve in terms of customer service and professionalism Until then I will be reluctant to fly through YVR again and I certainly wont recommend it to fellow travelers seeking a stressfree journey

This is the worst service oriented airport I have ever experienced I was selected for a random customs check which took time and sent me out into the beginning of the security area with a connecting flight to catch in half an hour I went to the Information desk who then gave me a green stamp on my boarding pass and told me that would allow me to get to the front of the security line I showed the boarding pass with the green stamp to the security person who was dismissive did not look or read my boarding pass and said You go to end of line Worrying and stressed I did so I ran to my flight and barely made it on without a chance to use the washroom or get a bottle of water This airport has the worst care for people I have ever experienced and I fly all over Canada and the US I will now fly via Calgary to return home to Kelowna

I was travelling with my carry on baggage and personal item only As an experienced traveller I was aware about liquid and gel rules and packed them in my clear bag ahead and placed in the bin I was surprised when one of the staff has decided to check my bag She was extremely slow and arrogant She didnt ask any permission just opened a bag and without comments began to open all items one after another checking and reading labels of my cosmetics and medicine She started to place in the clear bag everything cream g eyelash lipstick When I asked when it became a rule she laughed and said years ago I am not arguing with the officer in the morning flight but I think that it should be respected environment If I breach any rule explain why so I would not do it again I never ever had any issues with those items in the baggage And I would accept it if not the tone and the face Train your officers on how to provide a customer service or at least be tolerant and professional

First time traveling with our skis we arrived at the airport hours before our flight barely made the flight The screening point for skis oversized luggage had hundreds of us it took nearly hours to get through it It was ridiculous I will never again go through Vancouver airport The security lines are ridiculous long even with Global entry The mornings are so slow and the agents so grumpy that we opted for the afternoon flight Hundreds of us were panicking over making our flights

I was with my mother at the entrance of the airport There was a young man named William He asked us if we needed help and I couldnt believe he helped us to get a wheelchair immediately That was awesome customer service compared to my experience in LA airport

We have traveled through Varadero airport on a number of occasions in the past In some respects not much has changed Im pleased to see more xray scanners at security This alleviated one of the major and very uncomfortable bottlenecks My concern and a very unpleasant discovery when we arrived home was that our checked luggage had been opened and a number of items stolen Its sad that Cuba has become another place where you need to be alert Please take care of what is placed in the checked luggage

Arrival Slow staff min waiting line for clearance Completely spoiled staff Staff demonstrated full ignorance to the time matter Demonstratively search plus years old women with hand metal detectors Poor women barely couldnt stand on her feet Departure The same as slow as possible staff doing as little as possible with demonstrative I do not care attitude Confiscated umbrella from retirement age women Refused to give written confiscation notice and when protested all officers on the place told her that they do not speak English Is Varadero International Airport or place where law and order does not exist What a shame Spoiled vacation Spoiled image of Cuba

Varadero is a small airport catering mostly to vacationers from North America Europe and some neighbouring country It has only airbridges When my flight AC from Toronto arrived we had to wait for about minutes on taxiway until some other aircraft left After deboarding it was smooth Only mins wait at immigration Right after immigration you have to go through security which I found odd for incoming flights But the officers were quite relaxed Baggage was already out when I arrived at the belt Airport staff unload it from the belt and demand a baksheesh for that Outside arrival is a small taxi stand and a currency exchange When departing checkin was quick and efficient AC but handled by local airport staff Long lines at immigration as three international flights were departing shortly after another Officers fairly slow though friendly it took us mins to clear Security check behind immigration was quick Departure hall offers sufficient seating a few snackbars as well as duty free and souvenir shops where you can blow your remaining CUCs Airport was fairly clean and overall well maintained There is no wifi

Utter absence of thought empathy and planning would synthesize our experience We initially headed to the departures sign to find it locked with a sign on the door pointing to another building Upon reaching the second building another arrow pointed to a third building and entrance to departures leading to a minute initial meandering which could have unsettling and anxietyprovoking effect on passengers There is no information board so you would have to be physically alert to movement to figure out which gate you would be flying from The experience with border control was very similar we headed through to the baggage control desk to be informed that we needed to return to a different desk for initial Covid screening and issuing of new boarding passes the ones we had already printed were deemed unnecessary The professional conduct of these staff officials leaves a lot to be desired Remnants from communist eras these privileged state representatives impose an extremely offensive authoritative and subjugating tone in the way they demand command and threaten passengers The screening of passenger locator forms and codes was precipitated by sharp military style commands and requests to provide multiple proofs of having booked and prepaid for postarrival Covid tests which was completely unnecessary and evident within the passenger locator forms only The tone was humiliating and demanding rather than humane and downto earth The exact justification for this was that staff needed to inspect all possible evidence to ensure I was not lying Needless to say my family had all the necessary provisions and the accusation inflicted pain and public insult Similarly the passport control officials demanded all of our dual citizenship documents checking each and every page and reading all of the information in a silent passiveaggressive way When asked for explanation they said that they had the right to request all documents and that this would make the procedure easier for them My experience was that the customer officials were deriving pleasure from inflicting fear and a sense of humiliation onto others I am utterly disgusted with the professional conduct of both customer support passport control staff and the border police officials at this airport The attitude is in the how classbased and passive aggressive and might not be felt by citizens of other countries However my family was left feeling humiliated and insulted by this demonic chain of proteges who are occupying key administrative and representative positions I would not recommend the experience and would advice to avoid this airport at all cost

Ok not much to do but not bad queues Very small and modern airport Has a smell of cigarettes in the gates where S fly There is an outdoor bar in the summer and has very expensive duty free There is also a McDonalds and a coffee store both expensive

I flew from and to Varna Airport in April The airport is good but the lounges were closed early in the morning There is only duty free shop and the prices there are good One bad thing is that boarding the plane is always by bus otherwise it is a good experience
