Terrible place On arrival waited mins around a baggage claim carousel that displayed the flight for it to change to the other one yes only claim belts in an arrivals hall So not a problem you may think wrong Literally hundreds of people One full British flight and one full Russian flight shoved in one room waiting for their luggage at the right belt then for it to be switched at the last minute is not a good combination On return flight check in speedy and good overweight baggage didnt stir an eyebrow to my advantage but then the fun commenced A queue stretching around the departure lounge and back again for security checks and the reason one person at the control desk There were at least flights due to leave according to the flight board Everyone queuing to get through but the queue just grew longer and longer as the names of flights were shouted out to try push past everyone in an attempt to make their flight we arrived in ample time thanks to our tour operator Utter unorganised chaos And all this in sweltering heat as very little in the way of airconditioning

Much the same to report as Tony Maddern I agree with all his comments Baggage claim is still taking a long time considering the short distance from the aircraft and minimal schedules Priority baggage tags dont seem to be recognised either The two baggage carousels are positioned on either side of the walk route to arrivals so if there are a lot of people they end up blocking the path There is a handy radiation monitor just above the exit from baggage claim useful if youre about to sit in the sun I presume it was UV radiation A clarification on the taxis unlike Sofia that have fixed fares the taxis in Varna and particularly those at the airport are allowed to charge by the meter AND the meter can run at whatever rate the driver chooses as long as its displayed on the window of the taxi So before getting in any taxi check the rate displayed on side or on the wind screen Level per km seems ok but many taxis at the airport will charge three times that amount per km Even Costa Sands resorts should only cost Leva let alone Varna City If departing from the airport be aware that there arent any eating establishments so if youll be hungry get something before you get there Overall not an amazing airport but it much better than many others of its age And if there is only one flight departing from your terminal it shouldnt take too long to pass through security

Varna airport is interesting Aircraft are parked on stands about m from the airport An old truck with airstairs pulls up beside the plane and you get off and wait mins in a really modern bus The immigration hall serves its purpose but once you get into the baggage hall thats where it gets interesting st century technology beside old world equipment It looks like they have just decided to put things in there without any real thought or planning There are baggage belts which seem to have been cut into the floor The baggage hall is about m X m and looks like it has been built to handle flights and there are only a couple of toilets in the baggage arrivals hall I think that mins was far too long to be waiting for my bags considering that my flight was the only one at the airport As you leave the baggage hall into the arrivals area its just like anywhere else scrum of people keen to get you into their taxi A word of warning about taxis though Its about a min drive into Varna about km The taxi drivers are always keen to rip you off and have a trick of pressing the meter button or times depending on how much they want to rip you off by A taxi fare into Varna should only cost about leva

One of the worst airports in the world in terms of customer care absolute zero queues at checks inconvenient and very expensive car parks obstructionism to shuttles boarding with buses that leave you endlessly huddled in the heat

Worst airport Ive ever experienced Signage is completely lacking as far as telling you where particular airlines are located for check in All you see is signs for check In or But no airlines attached to those numbers Plus check ins are in first and second floor So we saw signs for checkin second floor and went up Walked around entire floor and not seeing our airline asked where easyjet was and was told first floor What Ok back to first floor and again only numbers no names Finally find easyjet All self bag check lanes closed and checkin line for boarding passes closed What Stand in line for an hour until someone wakes up from their nap and attends the lanes to check people in and check bags in Slow Finally to security Slow and rude personnel Thru security and into gate areas Gates not posted until about mins before flight Signage to get to gates confusing and inconsistent Finally to gate Boarding at pm for flight but as of still no person at gate to attend to passengers Food options ok but limited For those traveling in from Venice from arrival at noon by water bus to checking in and getting thru security it was one hour twenty minutes Awful People say Paris Orly and Charles De Gaulle are worse no way We did both in the past two weeks and they were fine comparatively

Had to wait min for the buses to arrive to the plane and take us to the airport The flight was already min late I do not know why the buses were so slow and late We waited in the plane with very suffocating dry air and it was very hot The real time it would take us to come from the plane to the airport would be no more then min A very big disappointment and was a first one for me

I was there to help my mother during her travel home She had surgery few weeks earlier and was somehow unstable in her feet so she was holding on my arm all time and we were walking slowly toward the security checks We didnt ask for any kind of assistance but the security open up a line just for us and one of the security even held my mother and accompanied her through the security gate while I was unable since getting through security myself The place was crazy busy and finding these people so aware and helpful surprise me Also going through the check in and accessing the gate was quite easy

They asked me to buy a ffp mask almost euros for a pack no single mask available because they said I couldnt fly with my surgeon mask Then they let embark everyone and even the cabin crew didnt have the ffp mask The flight was h minutes late and all they gave us was a voucher when all the sandwiches prices are over euros Not enough sitting places in the airport

If you imagine the trip from hell then times that by then you have Treviso Airport This is a largely dysfunctional lethargic and poor quality airport Staff dont appear to have any idea what is going on Security doesnt fill me with any confidence and once youve made it through the never ending lines into departures you are faced with the lack of seating Multiple people sat on the ground in a small terminal Late flight topped it off Never again

Nice quiet airport however departing to East Midlands yesterday was unbearable Crowds were left waiting in a very humid area at the bottom of the stairs no air con on Passengers were all complaining about the chaos and safety Minimal seating Most were standing
Good little airport takes very little time to get through to the gate not much seating at the gate so dont go through too early Good shop What more do you want

No sense of organisation Only few staff for security control and loads of departures at same time slot People arriving to this huge queue minutes before flight departure knowing that will be fast tracked without paying If I knew better I would do the same and arrive late to the airport

Arrival no issue cannot complain Departure an absolute joke How can this airport belong to Schengen airport and European standard is beyond me You better arrive hours before to get through security or else buy fast track and you can wait only an our Staff including security staff that has no clue what they do rude shouting will not provide any information feels like year that no digital screens exist one could continue on and on really really bad airport

Dreadful airport if you can avoid it do so Far too small to cope with the number of people using it Because building work is going on TUI have an air conditioned tent in the concourse where you check in and get your luggage weighed you then drag your luggage to the baggage drop off point in the terminal You then queue up for an hour to get through security too few security guards on duty We had to be pulled put of the queue and fast tracked as we would have missed our flight they were so slow You then have to go through passport control where two men were stamping the passports at snail pace we along with other people just made our flight even though we were there and a half hours before departure

This has to be the worst airport I have been to limited seating Ridiculously expensive for everything staff rude and unhelpful Que to go to the gate was hours and reached the length of the airport Put me off traveling to verona again

Queues at passport control of over hr with police officer checking passenger ridiculous Disorganized Automatic passport check with digital passport not working Deserves to be closed and not used for passenger if they cant staff it

We travelled to Gatwick London with EasyJet It took almost hours to reach the Departure Gate No staff were visible Information was lacking No seats at check in area and few at the gate Overcrowded and inefficiently managed airport

NotVerified How this airport has changed since we last used it years ago Arrivals wasnt too bad with the inevitable queues but Departures was another story We arrived by taxi at am for a flight and checked in straight away with TUI with no waiting Then the queuing began straight to Security and joined a long queue there were lanes A to I but only were in use Several earlier flights were called through so we didnt move at all After about an hour we were through and straight into another queue for Passports This went straight through Duty Free but moved so slowly that we took turns to visit the shop buy very expensive water and visit the toilet Again they were not using all available lanes Once at the gate it was heaving with frustrated people but we did manage to find a seat We were put on a very hot bus and kept waiting on there for ages before being transferred to the aircraft Why is this airport so understaffed If all the lanes had been used it wouldve been much better although the waiting areas at the gates are far too small for the number of people using them at busy times

When I arrived at the airport on August rd flight FN one officer stopped me and asked me for the Payment Confirmation of my Visa I showed to him on my phone and he said that was not valid if was not printed and I had to pay it again Finally I didnt pay but when I asked others they said that he was trying to get money from them too

Small airport and rather run down but being refurbished with new buildings and new runway to take bigger planes Walk to terminal Staff very helpful Best to be at front of plane if you need to purchase Visa as can take a time Need to prebook transfers to hotels as a long way out of town and no public transport Check in easy although staff seem unable to book people or their baggage onto connecting flights so if going via Johannesburg you will have to enter the country via Immigration collect bags clear customs and recheck them at the International desks and then go through security and Immigration again Can take mins so allow time for that to happen Departure lounge basic and small no lounge for premium customers A few shops and one bar Short walk to plane on the airport

It is a small airport located about km from the town No public transport so you will have to arrange your own private transport If you require a visa to enter the country be prepared for a long line There are only a couple of shops landside none airside The departure hall is small and dark with a small cafebar

A very small airport no airways you walk on the tarmac to the terminal if like most people you need to buy a visa there is a line manned by only people and no organization at all then the customs man grunts at you or makes you open everything but then you are out and in one of the most beautiful places on earth

The security screening at your airport is tedious and slow I arrived hours before my flight in order to be within the hour window recommended by the airline The security screening line took minutes to clear I had arrived from Calgary International Airport where security screening was accomplished without any delay at all You have three lines available for security screening and only one was in use forcing people to wait This situation has not improved since my last visit to your facility Please do something to fix this problem

Foodservice options are very limited We went to only one before security and with minutes to departure and no lineup they could not guarantee service The only service after security has long line ups cramped seating for only

I had an appalling experience in Victoria International Airport We were flying with Pacific Coastal airlines to Vancouver YVR airport and the security lines took forever My father and I waited a tedious minutes in the queue for a minute flight to Vancouver We had several trays of stuff and a man thought I dropped a SD card and when he took it up from one of my trays and asked me all the security people turned to me glaring for no reason The four trays blocked the traffic of baggages coming through the Xray machine so out of respect I put them all onto one tray and moved away and a security personnel said kindly to place it on a table However as I was worried that wed miss our flight as the security was taking forever to screen my father I was talking in a loud voice as he was across the room and all the security were busy looking at me and it just took forever If you are flying from YVR to Victoria I highly recommend not using YYJ as the security is appalling I flew the seaplane to Victoria Downtown and there were no security measures so that is a much better choice However the terminal was well set out and we could find our way easily
I visited Victoria BC two weeks ago and for a small international airport I enjoyed the experience Security was quick the facilities were good and checkin was quick I recommend this airport

My trip to the airport was ruined by the unexplained policy to evict all passengers waiting for our flight from our waiting place at our gate This decision was baffling as no other airport before has ever required passengers to vacate the most logical and comfortable waiting place to board with little alternative

Very confusing for connecting passengers luggage not checked through to our final destination Ask Austrian service desk staff member about where to pick up luggage and she replied that she did not check it in Not very helpful Eventually she gave us the information we were seeking Self luggage checkin did not work print bag tag Staff at security screening very disorganised staff lady shouted at us for touching the wrong tray and then gave us a long lecture about why we should only touch the bag trays we are using No direction from staff at security on what they wanted passengers to do Duty Free seems to be Duty Plus more expensive than buying outside of airport Overall based on experience at Vienna airport would avoid if there is an alternative hub for transfer Of course Vienna itself is fabulous
Often late in dispatching luggage especially on weekends Crowds of people waiting for no good reason Often too few immigration officers at border control Overall tiring exercise

It is a nice airport but I was shocked to discover you need euro coin to be able to use the luggage trolley I had luggages and I carried a toddler It was impossible to carry all my bags after picking them up and my child I asked a security person for advice or a fake coin eventually for help He told me to go to Exchange stand I explained None of my countries I live in uses Euros He said it is my problem If it wasnt for some Czech passengers who heard me talking Czech to my child and who offered their help I dont know what I would do Its incerdibly rude from the airport management to require coins to use the trolleys I havent experienced this on any other international airports Also the toilets for people with babies are always occupied by people without kids and there is only one such toilet I think your trolley system should be reconsidered As the current situation makes the travel experience for people with kids and many luggages simply horrible Not to mentiom the rude security employee

Dreadful experience with airport security A security officer doesnt speak English well enough She harassed my husband saying you must put your bag there He has no clue unloading our stuff from the bins after security checkpoint There are bins with pieces of our luggage and he only unloaded of them After a minute she returns and this time she is really angry Says I told you to put your bags there It appears she wanted me collect empty bins and put them into the special cart So there are questions Are really passengers responsible for loading bins into the airport carts Why is passenger isnt allowed to take all his pieces out of bins first My experience with the same officer My backpack was selected for additional screening Normal operating procedure right After finding nothing restricted in the backpack she demanded to show her my purse It had already cleared the security by the way But even that wasnt enough She demanded I should unzip my under jacket She also said she needed to see my waistband I had none At this point I asked he if I could keep my pants If its not a passenger harassment I dont know what it is

After arrival from Doha we had to to wait ages on a passport control It is a real joke Vienna airport doesnt have Egates at least for EU passport holders Airport staff more than unfriendly Immigration officers were extremly slow and we almost lost our connection flight to Prague even when we had hour and something transfer time Very bad experience

Very basic all the way Very few shops or coffee places Passport and check in was fine but once through that it was bit like waiting in a big shed Finally found a food court to get a meal but was so badly signed most people did not know where it was and thats a shame as the food was good Only give minimum time to be there if at all possible

Wattay International Airport in Vientiane is a simple and pleasant airport Perhaps the ease of travel is due to its tiny size at any given time there will only be a couple of flights on the docket so checking in for your flight is very quick One does not need to arrive too far in advance of their flight The departure terminal contains decent seating with a couple of large televisions they were showing muay thai boxing when I was last there The arrival experience is also positive with a reasonably short visa on arrival line and pretty relaxed officials eliminating a potential source of stress on the final leg of ones trip My favorite aspect of this airport is the walkway between the plane and the gate It is elevated and fully exposed to the outdoors so that travelers get a blast of fresh warm air to set the tone for their stay in Laos

Singapore to Luang Prabang via Vientiane As this is the capital airport of Laos my expectation was way better than this However I was very disappointed The terminal was dirty especially the toilet Upon arriving in Vientiane before heading to Luang Prabang the ground staff was unable to handle our group properly We waited for minutes just for the ground staff to bring us to the domestic terminal The domestic terminal is insanely small and dark and we experienced elactricity cut off while transiting for our returning flight back to Singapore

Domestic Terminal is older than the International Terminal and was clearly the airport in the past Only few in and out on domestic flights The planes are parked on the apron and usually passengers walk to and from Arrivals is through the single gate to the Baggage Spur not a circular belt so things can pile up if there is a lot of luggage There are toilets before the Arrivals Hall The whole terminal is a single story with Arrivals at one end and Departures at the other end There are no facilities in the Departure Lounge after Security Within the terminal there are a couple of shops selling snacks and souvenirs and a Money Changing booth The whole experience is pretty good not many flights and a generally relaxed friendly attitude You would not believe you were in the Capital City
The staff forced me to throw away small tube of crme because it did not fit into their plastic bag One week ago I passed the security check with exactly the same items at the same airport

The airline counter had not opened when I arrived and was able to find a seat until it opened The Finnair desk was staffed with English speaking agents who issued me the boarding pass for my flight to Helsinki and also for my onward journey from there I was directed to the priority security lines which were only a few feet away The security check was a breeze I was the only person in this line Right in front was an elevator to take me to the business lounge which was a perfect place to relax and catch up on my emails The exit from the security area also leads to shops which one has to pass through before reaching the gates The airport is dated After the boarding passes were checked at the gate we walked down flights of concrete stairs to the tarmac where a bus was waiting to take us to the ATR propeller aircraft parked remotely in mid field We boarded the plain by stairs through the rear The airport was easy to use though I hope the stairs will be replaced by jetways soon

I read online before getting to Vilnius that a taxi from the airport to the hotel was not expensive less than and warned of using a meter when I got to the taxi stand there were not people nor cabs Started reading the notice for tourists which said a taxi should cost it had rates per km At that time a taxi drives by and asks me if I want a taxi I got in and asked him if he is using a meter and he said yes Get to my hotel and he tells me its The reason for the difference is he doesnt work for the airport and it was a holiday Sept I travel all the time and never heard an argument the prices posted at the airport is for taxis working for the airport I felt cheated and not a good way to go to a new country to visit it The note posted for tourists should warn tourists about cheaters If someone needs I have picture of his plate and the driver registration This is not the way to treat and protect tourists Besides this issue my stay was good

At the arrival I had an issue with m luggage The employees in the luggage office were helpful The airport is small but well equipped At the departure only the security control was slow a bit Somehow they rescanned my electronic devices from the hand luggage The departure terminal was small cozy the staff in one of the caf were friendly The plane took off in time

On June airport started renovation of taxiways as well as the installation of a new apron The inside of the airport is very clean it is easy to orientate the construction of a new terminal will begin The runway lighting is bad but will also be updated soon I very much hope that everything will be fine and that it will be easier and safer to travel

Strange airport Only saw the arrival side due to bus arrival from out of town Departure area a bit dreary at the check in I experienced no lines Seating is terrible throughout Unlike others I had no issue at security Going past security it was a lot more pleasant I ate at one place However seating at the gate are was terrible It is a hodgepodge of mostly old and some renos done in the gate area They could use a new airport building for sure but apart from the seating I had no real issues

Worst airport security I have experienced in traveling across over countries As other reviews have suggested the attitude and work quality of the security personal at this airport is completely unacceptable and a complete insult to anything to do with tourism hospitality or simple being human As a family of all of us were harassed through the security gates items were confiscated all items were already with us through our travels to Milano and Brussels the previous days The items were a toothpaste that was not marked for volume it was a regular tube ml I would say but as the marking of the volume was already faded they just throw it away because nothing say have a nice day than taking a toothpaste from a traveler It was a lighter that was not loaded it was bought empty but with a price tag of EUR I must assume they liked it They said its a blueflame lighter despite the fact that they couldnt light it up once tried it over and over just to prove their point The rd item was a perfume that was indeed ml it was half full but yes I know legally it should not be taken on board if the original load is over ml Two things that became obvious through the process The staff members are far more happy if they find something they also sent bags through the scanner times just to find that empty lighter The motivation behind that I let you have a guess The staff members have thug mentality they take pleasure of bullying people make inside jokes within each other on their language and talk to passengers including my elderly parents like dogs Disgusting vile unreasonable behavior Left the country after a beautiful holiday with a bad taste in our mouth

SAS misplaced my luggage While the agent at the airport was relatively helpful when we called regarding the status of my lost luggage the person on the phone was less than helpful In fact she was basically clueless Other than that when we departed Visby we experienced an efficient process

Super fast from plane touching down to exiting the airport at most minutes including walking passport control waiting for luggage Entrance hall of the airport had all services necessary for a new traveller tourist info on city and region taxi public bus train station all nearby and easy to access Money exchange booth and ATM also on the spot

Vladivostok is a fairly modern airport built in the last years it has lots of space for check in and a decent departure area There is one major problem though there is limited foreigh language support if you are a non Russian speaker If you have problems with your baggage all the forms are written in Russian with no translation all the support staff only speak Russian The people at check in have limited English language skills enough to check people in but I estimate of staff in the airport only speak Russian If you dont have any issues when you fly into or out of Vladivostok then it is a nice airport to travel through but if you do have any problems it can be a nightmare to try to find any people willing to help you they just dont care if you have an issue
Stay away in the Covid situation Masks are not enforced even though fines are announced constantly The majority of travellers and even staff are not wearing them No social distancing either

Arrived early for check in and flew through very quickly as it had not yet offically opened Unlike last year when I was a little late and it took more than minutes while my Passport was checked and rechecked Immigration was quick took about two minutes and the security check was also quick I came through here last year and had to be pushy to get both to Passport Control and then through Security as otherwise qiven the queues I would have missed my flight The airport is quite spacious and there are a few shops I went straight to Turkish Airlines Lounge and stayed there until it was time to board the place This was straightforward This was my third time going through Vnukovo and the experience was similar to that of my first time

Once you get over the endless checks of ticketpassportetc then the airport building itself is quite pleasant Sailed through passports with another check of passportticket straight after prior to security and security then into a vast hanger of a terminal However it looks half finished with most shops still boarded up Almost no power points anywhere in the terminal and seemingly no WiFi either No simple shop for watersweetsetc which is a bit unusual

Travelled via Vnukovo for Champions League final Bright modern airport which is being expanded As always the local staff could do with some charm school training but on a normal day It beats the other two airports hands down specific points the chocolates in Duty Free are usually months past their sellby date so check each packet and for the princely sum of ea in Roubles or Dollars you can pay for access to the business lounge where wine is free but beer isnt and the sandwiches are odd and you can smoke in there as well

Old style basic airport with Soviet overtones Arrivals is limited with a single baggage carousel Check over your baggage before leaving the airport as your baggage tag will be taken from you and checked against your luggage as you leave the building Departures has a rather casual feel to Security checks not convinced how thorough they actually are Only a single departure lounge witha small snack bar vending machines and a newspaper stand I would not want to be stuck here with other departing flights as there is limited seating If you want a meal go upstairs before you checkin to a small snack bar ask for the menu as it is not obvious that meals are provided

Waco Regional is not a bad airport overall They only have one flight which is to Dallas but I have heard rumors that United Express is resuming flights to Houston The reason I have given it stars is because their flights are always delayed or late My advice to travelers flying into Waco is to have patience The baggage claim takes a while The car rental facility is not bad for a small town Overall I think the airport shows good quality

I used this airport several times past few years This time I was traveling to Greenville SC I found the Airport was improving in terms of services and facilities This airport is not too large one but it has all basic facilities Moreover it is located in the central of Washington DC

Staff tried to say we had made a mistake assigning our kids regarding our only infant How ever we booked our travel flights to New Zealand and around New Zealand under one booking with no problems until we reached leaving New Zealand on our last flight One and half hours to check in bags Customs hold up with both parents with no thought on who would supervise our young children Airport is shockingly unorganised and staff are not aware of the live environment More than happy to go through procedures obviously if their are children involved there needs to be a little more planning and patience

What a joke of an International departure area Not enough seating only one area to buy hot or cold drinks and only one person serving Line of waiting to be served Only lot of toilets long line for ladies Only a few seats with an outdoor outlook so depressing wish I had stayed in the domestic terminal longer Will avoid this airport at all times from now on

This is a wonderful airport Staff providing good services to pick up luggage when arriving It has a good transportation centre with taxis bus routes to downtown and shuttle buses to other cities near Wenzhou Many shops in the airport selling products with affordable prices Wifi is fast This airport is expanding to have another much larger terminal by

Worst TSA experience ever I am a corporate pilot flying for a fractional ownership program with Known Crew Member KCM status I airline weekly sometimes multiple times a week to commute to wherever one of my companys airplanes happens to be Even before my company had KCM as I would go through TSA at dozens of airports big small medium I would just show them my flight crew badge place my bags between the bowels not take my electronics out and walk through the metal detectors instead of having my body bombarded by radiation through the Xray machine Also Ive never had to throw out water which is huge when youre flying somewhere to pick up a plane to fly late into the night As I happen you only be doing today Today while airlining from HPN to ATL to pick up a plane TSA Made me go through security twice shoes off and electronics out shot me through with radiation twice and dump out my bottles of water patted me down twice and swabbed my hands and tested it What should have been minute process turned into a minute process This is insane This never happens at other airports big or small KCM or not This is totally unprofessional and someone in management needs to retrain their agents Treatment like this can easily cause a pilot to miss their flight creating major problems for flight companies

I really love this airport It is small and very quick Regular security is quicker than TSA Pre The Airport has nice entertainment and its a nice regional airport

Although Westchester County Airport is awfully small compared to JFK or Bradley it is amazing It has car rentals an actual baggage carousel five airlines going in and out of there local planes accepted too and even have gates This is so much better than some small airports Ive been to

Ideal location only short haul flights offered Terminal needs drastic expansion Too many flights departing at the same time causing people to be packed like sardines in one terminal They need to invest and modernize

Check your Covid test proof requirements carefully to void this chaos I entered Windhoek Airport on th Feb and left nd Feb On arrival at Windhoek Airport before customs I was asked for Panabios Covid test results I had everything else including vaccination certificates the RSA Lab negative Test results all were unacceptable Queues of arriving passengers on the Airlink flight also did not have this Panabios hardcopy report All without the Panabios proof were then required to establish internet connection using phones download the Panabios App retrieve their results and present this to the authorities with a bar coded reference number Chaos ensued as some passengers did not have internet on phones many others could not get into the App remember or get passwords etc etc Unnecessary frustration irritation and anxiety occurred as a result Clearly the Panabios requirement was poorly or not communicated to passengers before they left Then on my return I diligently got the Panabios report in hard copy presented it to Airlink checkin staff who said it was not acceptable they wanted the lab report NOT the Panabios document I did not have it in hard copy and they did not want to accept my phone lab report email as evidence so once again I ended up messing around until eventually I was able to get a lab report printed through the Airlink office OR Thambo wanted the Lab report NOT Panabios The lack of consistency in terms of the Covid proof of testing is unnecessarily frustrating If Windhoek requires something different to RSA can we at least be better informed Recommend passengers download and copy both the Panabios and the Laboratory proof of negative status to avoid this frustration

Windhoek is a small airport with an increasing number of flights Facilities are limited but everything you need is there and seemed sufficient for numbers passing through Arriving early departing late on Air Namibia fromto FRA arrival took less than an hour and departing security was a reasonable time Staff were efficient and friendly Much easier to pass through than major airports

The scale of Wroclaw Airport is small but lovely There is a lack of USB sockets in the waiting room and lack of seats for people who want to wait at the arrival gate When it is peak season it might be difficult to wait comfortably

The main idea of this airport is to delay and inconvenience Deboarding your plane via finger you then make two steep flight of stairs No lift or escalator can be used due to layout of nonSchengen arrivals Stairs only Then nonEU passport holders are welcomed to the long line served by just one officer for all who arrived EU passports are served by two officers who are now doing nothing since no people are in the corresponding line The only nonEU officer works as slowly as he can spending minutes per head It either means that border control are unable to comprehend that arriving plane can bring pax or they just enjoy seeing that every chance to make things worse is fully used Disgrace

Generally efficient and courteous staff However security will not allow aerosol cans either in the cabin or checked in There is no explanation for this I have flown into and from airports in China and around the world and never had this problem but for some reason Xian Airport has this policy So be prepared to lose your aerosols even if in checked baggage Very limited FB airside Airport is at least one hour drive from centre of city Take a highspeed train tofrom Xian if you can
Airport very cold No restaurant no coffee shop and no drinks machine smoking area very far from from the gate The announcements are not understandable Very bad experience

I departed on th April and was lucky to make my flight I was part of a tour group and as there were many groups trying to leave at the same time and not enough check in staff to process the travelers I made my flight with minutes to spare

Last time I was in Xian Xianyang airport was in I have visited many times before There was always a Scrum outside the airport building for tickets and to board the airport buses for downtown Returned this year a lot has changed with the airport and getting tickets for the buses You now go to a ticket booth inside the building Then a waiting room for your respective bus What an improvement

Domestic flight to Chengdu CheckIn OK and Security quick Interestingly no need to remove laptops or belts for scanning but ml fluid requirement enforced Airside a new wing has been built and some gates are quite a walk from the Security Check Area Very difficult to find Departure Gate information once airside no screens as you enter and despite lots of TV screens with advertising very few with the actual flight information Reasonable signs showing which direction each gate is A reasonable selection of typical airport shops offering the usual variety of gifts alcohol cigarettes and snacks Overall airport clean and tidy
Went through there domestically June and June Everything seemed to work the airside mens rooms left something to be desired All else worked including the airconditioning

Ive been though both international and domestic terminals The ground staff are very efficient I have to say It looks like the ground handing agents are China Eastern Airline and Xianyang airport However there is one thing I dont really like which is the VIP lounges are on the other side of the main terminal Last time when I was travelling from XIY to AKL I went to the on the VIP lounge it was very inconvenient What I mean is you cant check your bags in at VIP lounges and staffs in VIP lounge are not friendly at all I hope this is not a Chinese thing

Very bad checkin huge queue at Xiamen Airlines but only one counter open apart from courtesy Desk and checkin without luggage Unpleasant security people my checkedin suitcase had to be opened to check on my Swiss Army knife and this was coupled with a long waiting time Very limited choice of goods in duty free area general atmosphere similar to hospital morgue
No free WiFi at airport and if you want WiFi have to OTP a Chinese mobile number which we foreigners do not have yet Can the airport do something about the free WiFi

Transferring at Xiamen airport is a hot mess You need to go through immigration exit the secure area check in again from the outside and go through security a second time even if youre not even stopping in China At immigration they stopped most of the foreigners and questioned them intensely before letting them through My husband was questioned for over an hour before we could go on to our connecting flight Hes lived in China for years they already have all of his information on file But they questioned him anyway sometimes asking the same question three or four times Not sure if it was incompetence lack of training some new system or a mandate to heighten security but either way it was not okay Another family connecting from our flight was also stopped for over an hour The husband got through but they held the wife and their baby at the immigration desk for an hour and a quarter They were literally going from Bali to Seoul and had nothing to do with China but they stopped them and questioned them collected all ten finger prints from each of them made them submit to facial recognition photos etc It was a total abuse of privacy The search at security is also an invasion of privacy I went through the scanner and didnt set it off I avoid wearing metal on flights to save time But I was manually searched with a scanner anyway She felt me all over my body and even pinched me all over my arms my legs hips stomach extremely invasive especially considering I had just come from a connecting flight and had already been through security This airport is incredibly inefficient and treats passengers like livestock Dont transfer through here unless you have hours of layover time to spend on going through the insane process

Actions speak alot And to log in and post a review is alot to me Anyways the employees are severely understaffed for the amount of passengers there are If you are departing from Xiamen you can expect them to fly a plane halfway turn back and tell you theres a weather issue then take the entire passengers on busses to a hotel whom they promised us was free then start charging the folks in the back of the line for a room I paid for the hotel btw after employees suggested us to wait till the end I did check the forecast for the city we were landing at and it was clear at humidity with mph winds at degrees fahrenheit In my mind there was an underlying motive for the delay The airport customs wait line queues incosistent boarding gate changes and management are enough for me to choose a different place Expect to jog or run or feel rushed when transferring Flights are very often delayed My rating is You get what you pay for This quote resonates deeply Maybe I will mellow out with time because I am still shocked at my experience But my hr flight turned into a hour flight So I could have reasons for writing a post And I am sorry for sharing my experience

Having read earlier reviews of Xiamen Airport I wasnt looking forward to going there and changing from international to domestic First whatever the airline tells you at your point of departure you will have to recheck your bags on to domestic flights and vice versa from domestic to international From international to domestic the signage isnt helpful After collecting your bags go upstairs to the domestic check in area and recheck your bag at the transfer desk of your airline Transferring from domestic to international if the international check in section isnt open you just have to hang around until they open the doors There are plenty of cafes and noodle bars Once through the security screening go to the check in desk for your airline and recheck your bag in In fact at my point of departure Changsha they managed to check my bags through to Amsterdam but when I went to the check in desk to pick up my boarding pass for the next leg there was my bag waiting for me to check it in Apart from all that the airport is spacious and pleasant Lots of shops and cafes All the people I approached for assistance spoke good English
Lacking warmth lacking some basics lacking good Englishcommunication skills from personnel

I have travelled to Yangon many times in the past and this was the first time I used the new airport extension On arrival luggage has to go through baggage scanner just like some airports in Middle East Guests are also able to enter the airport too until immigration and passport control The airport is very large and spacious there are international branded shops and some that sell local products The products in the convenience store were not over priced The airport facilities are better than in some western European cities

Yangon is a relatively small airport Its setup is strange in that you are required to pass through security just to access the checkin counters Once in it appears you cant get back out so if youre there early you have to wait in an area with no services and no WiFi until your counter is open Air is circulated by fans only so it gets pretty warm They take security very seriously Luggage is scanned three times as are people We flew out of T which has gates so lines were pretty much nonexistent Immigration took about seconds We used the Priority Pass Lounge which was pretty sad and very cold so we ventured out about half an hour before boarding Shopping was sparse as was food and beverage Toilet facilities were basic but generally clean Gate services were good I recommend it because its the only game in town

Yaounde is extremely disorganised and dysfunctional Its hot and humid and there is no AC Upon arrival all flights exit through one security area At this point a lady from the Ministry of Health stops random passengers checking their Yellow Fever certificate At the customs desk lines form for visa stamps this is extremely slow Getting baggage out of the airport is also chaos as airport staff want to check baggage tags against passenger Again not everyone is stopped I wouldnt recommend a taxi there are a lot of touts Departure is equally frustrating no clear signage so always confusion Need to pay a departure tax Then you go to a window in the departure hall and give the CFA to a woman who will stamp your ticket After this you need to fill out a departure form and have your passport stamped Once you arrive at your gate your handcarry luggage is hand checked as are you Then you can proceed to your flight There are no announcements so make sure you know where youre going Not the worst airport Ive been to but difficult all the same

Yaounde airport is remarkably large clean and wellorganized for a central African airport with so little traffic Immigration is a bit confusing because they want to see your Yellow Fever card before passport control and they ask in French but after figuring that out Passport and Customs are easy with minimal lines Little bit of a mob coming out and I always recommend arranging for ones hotel or host to have a driver to meet you in a country like this Departing through NSI is very confusing Unless you are a diplomat you have to pay a CFA departure tax At one end of the ticket counters are a couple of guys behind a ticket counter who are actually exchanging dollarseurosfrancs etc for CFAs Then you go to a window behind them to give the CFAk note to a woman who will stamp your ticket Then you can pass the first control to go upstairs to the gates Someone inspects your carryons for size and number before you get to Passport Control After ppt control youre stuck with little or no shopping and a small bar My flight on Swiss arrived on time but left minutes late because it took so long for ground grew to load cargo and by the response of the airport staff that was normal No announcements nothing Security very tight with hand checking of all carry ons after xray Still everyone professional and did not seem dangerous or seedy

Horrible customer service at FlyOne and Sixt car rental If you have to go to Yerevan avoid this airline and rental car company Immigration was fine but quite demanding about my previous countries visiting but at least they were polite and reasonable But the sassy clerk at Flyone was rude and the crooks at Sixt will not refund your payment if you dont read all the tiny fine print buried in the policy details

The man working at the checkin desk is very rude and doesnt have any positive attitude which is a must for a person working in the customer service field Besides he was unaware of the rules and regulations established by Transavia Airlines He was trying to take EUR for kg of baggage insisting that I was not allowed to have it together with the kg backpack In general most of the workers at Zvartnots airport are badmannered and do their best in order to get on peoples nerves and make your registration much more complicated They mostly look like cold fish than human beings working in customer service

Most incompetent staff at the security check and a supervisor who was very rude apparently thinking he was a customs zar in the Sovjet times They would not security check our hand luggage as they said it was too big In other airports this is a question which the respective airlines decides The fact that we had arrived with the same airline with the same luggage made no impression The problem increased when they refused to acknowledge our electronic phone boarding card as they apparently had never had seen such a thing before The public information system is not being updated as the departures shown are the same as when we arrived here hours ago and all of them should have left some time ago Our airline staff has not yet come so instead of going to the business lounge as planned we are still sitting in the departure hall on the solid steel chairs This is a regretable bad last impression of the otherwise friendly and helpful Armenian people th Oct hours

I am an Australian but of Indian heritage Upon my arrival I were asked to provide more Australian IDs and more question were asked to me about India than Australia Immigration officer even asked me if I have any friends in Pakistan The same behaviour pattern was followed upon my arrival The immigration office checked my passport from every possible angle and checked at least times under UV light Customs were no different Super dissatisfied with the quality of service It seems like the last time any airport staff smiled was years ago Very sour experience Never returning back

One of the better airport experiences in recent times This may be due to this airport not being the big hub type with all its unpleasant experiences that come with it But from curb to boarding everything went smoothly Friendly bar tenders checkin agents emigration officer and security staff A pleasant surprise The building appeared very well designed For urban explorers theres the old brutalism style icon of soviet times next door to explore from outside Only downside is the air conditioning in the air side waiting area too windy and cold

The best airport in the Middle East and Europe Staff service is very good Checkin procedure was fast and efficient The airport amentities are quite good good cafes to eat something Segafredo for coffee Duty Free is really very big and the selection is quite large

Ive been to this airport several times And as time passes by I think this airport needs a major facelift Terminal A was okay clear signs but the layout was all over the place two waiting halls in two seperate areas which is quite confusing There were a good selection of FB stores the shops were good but they offer a small thin magazine at exorbitant fares Waiting times were good for departure but not for arrival One baggage claim filled with arrivals in one Ridiculous Taxi drivers would have shouted anything at you just to ride their taxi which is very expensive a mile drive costs US Terminal B was the worst part Leaking ceilings queues a bit disorganized and looks like a budget terminal or like a terminal that was converted from a conference centre Good thing that this airport has a BRT and Railway station WiFi was quite fast But the terminal building itself I think needs a major facelift

There are terminals terminal A for most domestic flights Garuda Indonesia Lion Air Wings Air Citilink and terminal B for international flights and other domestic flights Sriwijaya Air NAM Air Air Asia and Express Air Terminal B is smaller than Terminal A but the facilities are quite good The security staff and ground staff are good There are some shops that sell food and drink with reasonable prices There are also some toilets and ATM for the passengers Some minor issues are the lack of electrical socket for charging your gadget The seat in the waiting room is adequate in quality and quantity There are some traditional Javanese ornament in the airport

This is the worst international Airport I have come across Everything was so cramped in the arrival hall through immigration and up to exit that I was concerned about the safety of my family Any kind of commotion can lead to a stampede Similar experience while departing I was going through domestic departure so no immigration A single checkin counter and a cramped waiting hall One must also be careful about the Taxi services as the official taxi counter is quite a distance from the international exit There are several other Taxi services waiting to fleece the first timers Opt for the Rajawali Taxi

A small airport with a single crowded waiting room Only one restaurant and its food is expensive The check in area and the arrival area is very crowded I would recommend using Adi Sumarmo Airport nearby when visiting Yogyakarta

Pleasant but rather oldfashioned airport Most of the traffic is domestic and the terminal copes well with this A good range of shopsrefreshments in the departure lounge area which is well organised You are very close to the aircraft including the runway so it does not feel claustrophobic My only gripe would be the totally constant announcements of both arriving and departing traffic needed because the information on the boards was unreliable No airbidges so you walk to the planes but this did make for speedy boarding We had prearranged transport so I cannot comment on local transportation but it does have a train station which is rarity in Indonesia

This small airport is totally overwhelmed by the amount of traffic it handles For international passengers after checking in and paying the departure tax you proceed to a waiting room prior to passing immigration and security You are basically waiting for a prior international departure to clear the next holding room Once the prior international flight has departed you then proceed through immigration and security The next small holding room only has capacity to deal with one flight at a time and there are absolutely no facilities in the holding room other than restrooms If youre hungry or want to do some last minute shopping visit the few meager concessions in the checkin hall first

Noticed some improvements from last visit about years ago Basically it is the same structure but only interior is much fresher I noticed some new shops inside and outside Inside the arrival hall there is a traditional Javanese music band playing live music with traditional Javanese instruments It is quite a welcoming nice charm There is dedicated taxi stand outside the domestic arrival hall Get a voucher and walk to the taxi pier It is quite organized

Very small nice airport There is no shops at all no airco check in was OK no queues at immigration The only downside is to get to town was quite difficult as when I was there there was no any taxis or buses so had to wait for almost hour Staff was friendly but facilities poor

YuzhnoSakhalinsk is an old Soviet style airport built I believe years ago when air travel wasnt too common Both domestic and international check in areas are very cramped and not big enough to cater for the Bs that arrive Queues can sometimes be seen coming out of the main entrance as people try to check in to their flights and as with all Russian airports you have to go through security checks before entering the check in areas which slows entry into the airport down The check in staff speak limited English and are fairly inflexible to help people If you are flying direct to your destination great if you have connections it significantly slows the process down and the majority of the time the staff cant and wont check bags through to your final destination and wont provide you an onward bording pass There is very limited seating and refreshments in the check in and predeparture lounges and almost no facilities to buy anything before you fly There is a tiny cafe in the domestic departure area and a slightly larger cafe in the international departure area with a small duty free shop selling very expensive duty free goods There are no airbridges connecting to planes so all boarding means a bus trip to the plane or a walk to the plane This slows boarding down considerably too International arrivals is one of the worst Ive experienced it is paper based and slow Even with a flight of people if you are foreign it could take up to hr to get through immigration as preference is always given to local Russians There is a newer domestic arrivals hall with baggage belt which is a huge improvement on the previous hall but still poor compared to any other airport Ive travelled through Overall if you have to fly to Sakhalin you have no choice but to use the airport but if you had a choice you wouldnt use it They keep saying they will improve it but in the years Ive been traveling through Sakhalin Ive seen very few worthwhile improvements

This airport is in dire need of an upgrade There is a tiny check in area we flew domestic today with check in desks but there are no lines or barriers and in typical Russian style there is no coherent queue People are lining up all over to get in the correct queue Upstairs there is a nice cafe called Lime which does decent coffee although double the usual cost Still it is the only decent place to sit and wait Then you go through another security check into a waiting room full no seats left then downstairs again to board the actual flight This downstairs waiting room was also packed so we stood for about mins in total with our squirmy year old All announcements were exclusively in Russian and we had to guess when our flight was called No provision for families travelling with small kids that we were aware of

Yuzhno Sakhalinsk UUS On a trip ICNUUSICN had to pass thru the airport twice On the way in those passengers in the know bunched up at the door of the aircraft and ran for the entrance hall Those like me who hadnt a clue about what was coming walked normally and were confronted with chaos I know the Russians are paranoid about security but this was ridiculous took over hours to clear a load fortunately we were the only aircraft on the ground at the time The fire truck took about minutes just to start lucky there were no fires The baggage hall was interesting all baggage arrived on a tiptruck which backed up to a slide and you guessed it upended the tray and baggage into the room no carousel Customs Hall is something else one over eager passenger put his head around the door before he was called flashing lights and sirens erupted You didnt need to speak Russian to get the gist of what he was told Fortunately I had a Company courier waiting for me outside with a name board On the way out similar system this time however the flight was delayed due to heavy snow No information given by staff no flight info boards all passengers JUST WAITED In my case it was about hours this must be a fairly common occurrence in January as the same courier was with me and refused to leave until the aircaft was actually on the ground most impressed Food was available for purchase at a cafeteria acceptable by Russian standards but certainly not flash the stairs leading up to it were a bit scary their condition screaming for maintenance wont happen Seating inside the departure area is simple but acceptable Overall the airport is only just OK

Airport terminal is new I have arrived late after so we were only passengers in the terminal I had to wait for more than minutes for my baggage which was odd because only ish passengers were waiting for the baggage There were very few to no staff members which was almost disturbing Overall experience Fine but it could be much better

I am a frequent traveller tofrom Zagreb airport and find the experience consistently disappointing Taxi service a rip off Airport staff are unhelpful rude probably underpaid and definitely in the wrong customer facing jobs Very poor fooddrink choices also way overpriced Today I ordered something to eat from the pub menu the staff member told me they dont have food and pointed at the place behind me to go there I mean I could see couple of people half finishing a burger chips Admittedly there was a queue he was on his on at the bar so maybe he just couldnt be bothered He served randomly picked tea bags to a customer in from of me who clearly ordered English Breakfast tea from the printed menu on every table the gentleman corrected him and pointed out this is not what he wanted The staff member replaced it with another random picked tea bags shrugged his shoulders as if to say take it or leave it The customer was an English person he accepted the wrong tea bags completely rising a above it The abrupt and unfriendly approach needs to be addressed at every level and people from security check in shops eatingdrinking places dealing with the public at this airport should be educated in providing the basic customer service They need to be reminded they are not doing passengers a FAVOUR it is their job Its a disgrace

This airport is called international but service is ridiculous We checked in hours before our flight and only one line for security check was opened There was several flights around same time People were stressing out they will not catch their flight If you want to call yourself international airport you need to provide more efficient passenger flow Second line was opened only after people started to complain Extremely disappointed

Awful experience Drop off area is awful and barely sufficient for small traffic Zagreb airport has Connections to the city comparable to Tirana and Skopje Public transportation bus every min The only place where one can get fresh water is after security check but it is not working for days The water on the pipes in the toilet is smelly I would say on purpose so the duty free can sell more Toilets always have wooden piece on the entrance door and are open Toilets are smelly and poorly maintained Queue for security check requires you to walk around for meters althought there are barely passengers in the queue One can feel that the management of the airport is very bad Passengers are on the last place

Arrogant unprofessional and rude passport control police officers without a smile or greeting Do not expect anything better Welcome to the Balkans Although they think highly about them selves being western European country with western standards they are far far away from the west

The special assist for disabled passengers is terrible Passengers are removed from the aeroplane and asked to walk through baggage and passport control We were two disabled passengers and when I stated that we required wheelchairs we were told that its not a long walk Having used this airport many times I know this to be untrue and insisted on wheelchairs and assistance to which he rolled his eyes tutted and replied There are only five if us and seven wheelchairs To which I replied Well you better go and get them then The first passenger was attended to after minutes I waited half an hour Once escorted to the Cafe Nero at the exit I ordered a coffee from the bar and when I asked if they could carry it outside to a table metres away they yet again refused even though I had a walking stick and a small bag By the time I got to a table I had spilled half the coffee One cannot help but feel that disabled passengers are considered a nuisance here Very disappointing

Been waiting in line for passport control for two and a half hours Worst experience I have had Only one controller for the whole queue Some official kept coming with other passengers hand in hand and placing them in front of the queue And to make things even worse that single controller kept leaving his work post every now and then

Overall Modern looking airport but inefficiently designed Inefficient and incompetent customer service with an average IQ of about Recommendation If you want to travel to Zagreb use Graz Austria airport and rent a car or land in Vienna and take a hr super modern rapid and inexpensive train to Graz and then rent a car If you travel to Istra northern Croatian coast take a direct plane to Pula Istra or Trieste Italy The less money you spend at Zagreb airport and Croatia in general the better youll feel No access to free phone service For example if you are from outside of the EU and do not have local cell phone service and need to call airline company to change the ticket you cant There are also no tellers where you can go and ask to use a phone Wifi is disastrously slow At Mbsec this speed is insufficient to browse internet change your ticket online or make a wifi call Foreign airlines have no permanent tellers so after checkin is closed there is no way to get in touch with that specific airline see and above The local personnel behind information desk ID gives incorrect or misleading info I was late for a checkin and teller told me to walk across the airport to talk to some other person who then referred me back to the Information Desk This roundabout circular walking of customers from one teller to another without anyone assisting the customer is a signature of Croatian bureaucracy Car rentals are found out in the open a minute walk from the airport There is absolutely no overhead protection at any of the rental agencies If its raining youll be soaked wet as will your luggage Beyond coffeedrinks there arent any healthy food options so if youre stuck at the airport your best option is to fast Munich and Vienna airports have excellent superminimarkets Check in is a bit chaotic with local travelers acting like they grew up in a barn pushing not knowing how to form a line and local employees not being able to issue clear instructions Almost the only way to and from the airport is by car There is no rail between the airport and the city compared to Paris Vienna Munich etc Theres a bus service between main train station in Zagreb and airport but the service is unreliable and irregular On a positive note Its a modern looking airport Waiting lounge outside on a terrace has with big comfortable cushions Premises are clean

Absolutely joke Not enough shuttle busses to get passengers off planes and then onto planes gridlock Flights with similar flight departure times given gates next to each other so absolute chaos for seating etc So slow getting passengers boarded so inevitably leading to late departure times

Was booked in as requiring Disabled Assistance with processing through departures Due to the Covid problems paperwork required to depart the airport after our holiday The company I booked and payed for the Covid day test failed to give me a code for the Passenger Location form I spent days of our holiday just trying to get this code Without this form we could not fly home Finally just before pickup time I finally got this code and partially film of two of the forms I thought thats great can finish the two at the airport How wrong I was got to the stage they were calling us on the speakers I cannot thank the two young Special assistance girls at the desk We managed to board the plane mins before take off time Had they not been so understanding and helpful we would not have flown home Zante Airport you have brilliant workers on the Disabled Special Assistance

This was the last time we put our foot on this airport Of toilets there was one with door but there was no paper and did not lock that there was feces on the wall The airport is not made to handle the number of passengers is today Does the fact that tour operators must make more demands otherwise it is they who are losing customers in the end Never more Zakynthos Airport

I have never experienced anything like this before Zakynthos airport is a dump Far too many passengers for its capacity Toilets dirty no locks on doors no hand dryers not enough seats You have to check in even though we already had done on line and had printed boarding passes in our hands After a minute wait for that we had our baggage labels put on and had to take our cases and join another queue to put them through a scanner This had a bored girl watching the screen Security quite quick but then a very small waiting area for all the flights with not enough seats and more dirty toilets Duty free prices a joke as were prices for food and drink We couldnt wait to get on the plane and out of there

The infrastructure is poor as expected However this can be managed if the weather is not hot What makes the airport one of the worst is the staff Unfriendly service almost everywhere especially in the lounge This is better than the ground floor service still bellow any standards The airport is pretty chaotic and the security is more than questionable

The worst airport I have ever seen No organization huge queue everyone asks for money temperature inside is so hot you cant imagine I asked to switch on the aircon and they laughed at me for my request Never again

Horrible airport everything is chaotic and people constantly want money for everything The security searched my husbands bag checked luggage and decided that a mosquito repellent and a deodorant must go to rubbish cause of the inflatable liquid sign on them You must be joking When I explained to her the toiletries and personal care items are allowed and she could as well take another items from my suitcase following her logic thinking she said I need some education Who is the one who needs education Cant even do her job properly Or maybe she wanted me to buy out the items I was about to lose Hah The funny thing is that everybody who wants to visit Zanzibar will have to go through that horrendous experience as there is no alternative airport Good luck to whoever is flying in the future

I am lucky to have travelled to many remote places with small airports Zanzibar is the worst airport I have ever visited Arrival meant waiting for luggage in a barn in tropical heat as bags were hauled in by Departure started with queuing outside the airport for half an hour in heat for all passengers to put all their luggage through only scanner The entrance for this allowed only person at a time to sort their stuff Inside was hot dirty and provided no information on flights No one knew when planes were going or seemed to care It would have made a good comedy sketch but this is an international airport handling thousands of passengers

Zaporizhia airport Ukraine is probably the most original and exotic airport I flew to and from The airport serves a million people city and is unbelievabely small It did not see any main restructuration and reconstruction since the middle of soviet era and this airport is a real step back in times but it will change by I have nothing bad to say about this airport because it is impossible to compare with european standards The terminal consist in a small building where everything is included into a very small space It deserves a visit Landing in Zaporizhia is landing in the s You walk to the terminal from the aircraft then you pick up your lugguage straight on the tractor no conveyor For checkin you also bring you baggage straight to the tractor because there is no conveyor as well Then there is a very small cafe and a unique passport control and you arrive in a waiting room that youve never seen before To go to the plane you walk down outside stairs and walk to your aircraft again A very interesting experience

Pretty new terminal opened about a year and half ago Its an improvement on the old terminal Not many flights and of them from Ryanair Basic regional airport that does the job not huge lines to check in or pass security Dont go through security unless your flight its about to depart since in the air side there is only a little barcafeteria and two vending machines not too many seat if there are two flights at the same time In the land side good bar and resto Bad Bus connection to the city and expensive taxi service EUR to centre So overall small nice airport that allows you to show up h before your flight departs without risk of missing the plane

Zhengzhou is a dusty rural industrial city in central China so its hard to see why it has an international airport at all I havnt been called comrade once in my seven years living in China but I suspect the bad treatment experienced by the poster below is reserved for residents of HK Macao and Taiwan Province who have their very own queue at all airports Arent they lucky My most recent visit to ZZ confirmed my impression of a well run clean and shiny new airport As with most Chinese airports the departures area is big open with a sweeping roof while arrivals seems small dark and pokey by comparison The airport and the city as a whole seems to be swamped with coffee shops mostly local brands with western food on the menu At the airport they are quite expensive but at least one promised free internet access so its not all bad The best value food was in arrivals Dickos a Chinese fast food chain Only other options for eating are continence stores throughout the terminal with over prices snack food Once airside the only choice is the expensive coffee shop mentioned earlier at a higher price The usual situation for restrooms in China BYO paper but otherwise they are relatively clean and efficiently run but expect to have to put up with the smokers

A couple of points firstly there is now a new terminal so most of the tips above do not now apply Agree about the prices for coffee etc they are outrageous They now handle more international flights for example to Bangkok so I would like to think they are better equipped for international flights now I have Never been stopped by the immigration people I find them very friendly Last point the taxis There is no doubt they are expensive They are on the clock but from the airport the clocks run fast From my old apartment it was km to the airport and on one occasion km back Better to pay rmb for the bus directly outside the airport then get a taxi from the Aviation hotel in the city Hope this helps

Zhengzhou airport is about a minutes ride from the city center It is a hours flight from Hong Kong or hour flight from Beijing or Shanghai The only regular international flight it has is from Hong Kong That means all the immigration and custom officers there handles only China Southern flight in and out times a week They have the leisure of taking more time to examine the passports and the contents I almost always get searched going through the Custom One time the officer was looking for the magazines movies the other time they were looking at my milk powder as well as the dried meats Next to me was a woman with a baby They were trying to take away her milk powder They reason they gave was that these US made milk powder may not conform to the Chinese standard If you are a tourist you immediately feel you came back to the Maos age where you are being called comerade There is a regular airport bus on the ground floor that goes to the city center The cost is Yuan The regular airport taxi usually costs around Yuan The regular taxi costs around Yuans The trip to the city is a nice one with all the date trees on both sides of the highway There are two Chinese restaurants on both sides of the Departure Hall If you want a tasty regular noodle choose the right one If you want regular Chinese dishes choose the left one The price is reasonable Checking in is easy as all flights are well segregated The departure lounge is bright and clean There are massage chairs in every gate If you have time use them The cost is Yuans every minutes They even give you the bottled water free The small shops are nice since they sell local items like dates peanut biscuit and nice paintings There is a coffee shop at the far right I ordered a regular black coffee there and it costs Yuans a big wipeoff No wonder they do not place any menu on the table

Travelled domestically to this airport to avoid the higher airfares charged to travel directly to Macau or Hong Kong It was neat but showing some wear at the edges We were the only aircraft at the terminal so was able to move through quickly Was confronted by a barrage of taxi touts upon leaving the airport It is a long way out of Zhuhai Macau some minutes for the km the road was a giant construction zone for most of it

We reached TSA at a time when we had minutes to make it to our next flight if you ask why the rush it is because our previous flight got delayed We ask people online to let us go ahead of them so that we can catch the flight They all were nice and let us go to the front of the line Two of our bags got signaled as needing more search I approach one of the security workers and explained our situation She ignored me totally Then another security officer started helping us It took him over minutes searching through both of our bags as slow as he could be told us we should have known the rules granted we went through TSA in JFK Vienna with the same bags He took out containers that had much less quality than ml he took out our stuff into a bin and made both bags a big mess throwing our stuff back in We told him he could take whatever containers out we didnt care All we needed was to be done with the process and catch our plane Yet he went at his same very slow pace When I told him that this experience and his treatment would make us never come to Switzerland again he said That would not be a shame The real shame was the attitude of security officers at such a major airport And we actually ended up missing our plane by a couple of minutes

We queued minutes to get down one escalator If youre at E gate leave plenty of time Passport control was equally as bad poorly organised and long queues even if EU resident Good luck if you have a connection here
